job.title: QA Engineer (Web Team)
job.description:
Join Our Vision: We are building the next generation of Spatial Media - a new way people experience videos through interaction, multi-user presence, haptics, AI, and immersive storytelling.

DeoVR is the leading immersive streaming technology serving multiple enterprise customers and millions of users globally.

We are now expanding the boundaries of what video can be - moving from passive watching to active, interactive, multi-user journeys.

If this excites you more than it scares you, you are in the right place.

The Role

We are looking for a colleague to join our Web QA team in the segment of aglobal VR video streaming ecosystem.

What You Will Do

  • Conduct functional and non-functional manual testing of our web applications to identify defects and inconsistencies

  • Perform root cause analysis of the issues, report and track them

  • Contribute to prevention strategy of the identified issues

  • Create and improve test documentation to facilitate the testing process

  • Collaborate with the team and stakeholders on quality improvement, issue resolving and requirements refinement

  • Provide clear and non-ambiguous reporting on tasks progress, notifying about obstacles in a timely manner

  • Readiness to pair testing and knowledge share with other members of the QA team, fostering a culture of quality and continuous improvement

What We Are Looking For

  • 3+ years of experience in software testing

  • Experience in web application testing

  • Familiarity with Jira, TestRail

  • Keen attention to detail

  • Fluency in English and Russian

  • Experience in Playwright FE testing automation

Bonus Points

  • Experience with video streaming (VOD & cam-streams)

  • Experience in VR technologies

  • Ability to use AI tools for testing

Hiring Process

  • HR Screening (up to 30 min)

  • Tech Interview (1-1.5 hour)

  • Case Task

  • CEO Interview (30 min)

💼 Explore our hiring process.

What We Offer

Please note, that this is a fully remote contract role. B2B cooperation only - you will work with us as an independent contractor operating through your own legal business entity (e.g., sole proprietorship, limited company, or equivalent).

  • The chance to be part of a pioneering team in a rapidly evolving industry

  • Direct impact on the future of media and technology

  • Flexible working hours to accommodate your lifestyle

  • Work remotely from almost anywhere, or on-site at our office in Ljubljana, Slovenia

  • A culture that values innovation, accountability, and collaboration

  • Access to the tech you need from day one

  • A dynamic and innovative work environment in a cutting-edge industry

Stay Connected

Join our Facebook community to connect with like-minded people. Join us and embrace a role where your expertise meets technological innovation.

POSITION SUMMARY
The IT Applications Test Engineer will independently design, execute, and maintain manual and automated tests to ensure high-quality software delivery. They will support test planning efforts, leveraging their understanding of testing processes; collaborating closely with developers and product teams to troubleshoot issues, refining testing practices, and improving test coverage across applications. This role will also drive efficiency by increasing automation within the testing lifecycle. Additionally, this role will contribute to more complex testing initiatives.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES
• Develop comprehensive and reproducible test cases and execute them independently. Perform a variety of testing types, including functional, integration, and regression tests to reduce production defects.
• minimize production defects, conduct manual and automated testing. Automate key functionality, regression tests and ensure test scripts are efficient and reusable.
• Contribute to implementing and improving the automation test suite.
• Build and enhance JMeter performance testing framework to ensure system scalability, reliability, and responsiveness.
• Create test cases, test results, and bug reports. Provide concise test cases, reproducible steps in bug report and keep documentation up to date for medium sized features.
• Collaborate with Product Manager/Developers/BA’s to clarify product requirements and provide feedback from early version of requirements to release ensuring the software meets business and user expectations for medium complex features in their teams. Participate in UAT activities.
• Identify testing progress obstacles and collaborate with other teams to resolve them timely.
• Conduct thorough reviews of test cases to ensuring they are comprehensive, clear, and aligned with requirements. Provide feedback to peers on test cases and collaborate to refine them.
• Analyze results to assess testing effectiveness and proactively identify areas for improvement. Suggest improvements to testing processes.
• Expand test automation expertise and assume ownership of executing and maintaining automated tests.
• Comfortable adapting to changing requirements, system designs, new technologies, and shifting priorities or responsibilities.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE
• Minimum 5 years of manual and automation testing experience.
• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering Computer Science, or related field.
• Experience in test automation tools (e.g., Selenium, Playwright, Katalon).
• Experience in performance testing (JMeter, LoadRunner)
• Strong knowledge of SDLC and Agile Framework best practices.
• Proficient in managing defects and test documentation using ADO.
• Experience in Property & Causality Insurance or related domains.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Strong communication and documentation skills are important.

Salary: $85,000-$90,000

job.title: Senior QA Engineer (m/f/d)
job.description:
Your mission

  • Design and maintain test documentation, including test plans, test cases, checklists, and requirement traceability
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, exploratory, end-to-end, and acceptance testing

  • Validate configuration settings as well as data import and export functionality
  • Report clear and reproducible defects and actively support their resolution
  • Participate in release readiness, smoke testing, and post-release verification
  • Use AI tools to improve test analysis, test design, debugging, and investigation

Your profile

QA expertise

  • 5+ years of professional experience in Software QA
  • Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum, and shift-left testing practices
  • Solid knowledge of functional, regression, smoke, integration, E2E, exploratory, UAT, compatibility, usability, and localization testing

job.description:
About the company

Side (formerly PTW) is a global video game development and services provider, offering technical and creative solutions to many of the largest developers and studios around the world.

Founded in Japan in 1994, Side has grown to become a global force in the video games industry, with over 40 studios in 15 countries worldwide and offices across North America, Europe, South America, and Asia.

Our industry-leading services include codev, art production, localization, audio production, quality assurance, localization QA, player support, community management, and datasets. For more information, visit

About the role

As Localization QA Game Tester, you will work within our Localization Quality Assurance team and be the very first person to see the localized game in its entirety – translated text, images and the rest of the user interface collectively. You’ll get to experience the project in the way it will be consumed by the end users. You will work in a multilingual project team ensuring that the game is free from grammatical errors, cultural inconsistencies and ultimately ensuring that the game is accurately localized into the target language.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with a global project team.
  • Identify and correct spelling, grammar, punctuation, and other language errors.
  • Ensure adherence to console manufacturer guidelines.
  • Log details of errors and issues, providing improvement suggestions.
  • Ensure accurate translation within context and maintain consistency in terminology and imagery.
  • Identify missing or incorrect content and ensure proper display/format of dates, calendars, and characters.
  • Write reports on errors and bugs found and perform ad hoc translation.
  • Oversee the quality of your work, collaborate with the team, and contribute to the overall success of projects.

Our Localization QA team conducts language checks on upcoming games across a variety of cutting-edge platforms, including PC, Xbox Series X/S, PS5, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation VR2, and various mobile and tablet devices. As an LQA Game Tester, you will be working on top gaming titles for some of the world’s leading publishers.

Requirements

  • No experience required. Just fluency in LatAm Spanish and conversational in English.
  • Strong cultural understanding of the language you are applying for.
  • Computer literacy – particularly with Excel.
  • Robust Internet research skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Previous experience with using different software, applications, and websites.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and concisely and collaborate within project teams.
  • Candidate must be located within Schengen Area.

What we offer:

  • You will be working for the pre-eminent global provider of specialist services to the games industry and provided with full training and the opportunity to work on some of the biggest game clients, titles, projects, and tech in the world.
  • Attractive remuneration, holidays, regular team competitions with great prizes; and inclusion into an extensive social calendar. Our environments thrive with collaborative teamwork with people from all around the world, different nationalities, and languages.
  • A supportive community inclusive of LGBTQ+, and any age, ethnicity, religion, or disability. We care about the well-being of our employees and have a dedicated employee well-being program. We empower our people and offer regular progression opportunities to ensure our employees flourish.
  • Learn as you work and be part of something real that changes the face of gaming - forever.
  • Working with a global multi-lingual workforce with superb training and promotion and progression opportunities.

Working Condition:

  • 100% remote within Europe. If you're based in Braga, Portugal, even better!
  • With the possibility of transitioning to a full-time role. However, if you prefer to remain a freelancer, that's perfectly fine!

We are currently building a talent pool for future opportunities. If your qualifications align with a role/project that becomes available, we will reach out to you directly to discuss next steps. job.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
job.description:
Job Title: Quality Assurance Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours (with flexibility for release cycles, sprint deadlines, and testing windows)

About the Role

Our client is seeking a Quality Assurance Engineer to ensure software products are reliable, functional, scalable, and production-ready before release. This role combines manual testing, automated testing, defect tracking, and collaboration with engineering and product teams to maintain high software quality standards.

The ideal candidate is highly detail-oriented, technically curious, and passionate about delivering exceptional user experiences through structured testing and quality-focused thinking.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys identifying edge cases, improving testing coverage, and helping engineering teams release software with confidence.

Responsibilities

Test Planning & Quality Strategy

  • Develop detailed test plans, test cases, and quality assurance documentation
    • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and developers to understand requirements and user stories
    • Define testing strategies for features, integrations, workflows, and regression coverage
    • Ensure acceptance criteria and edge cases are properly validated before release

Manual Testing & Defect Validation

  • Execute manual testing across functional, regression, UI/UX, cross-browser, and cross-device scenarios
    • Identify, document, and track defects using Jira, Azure DevOps, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar tools
    • Provide detailed reproduction steps, screenshots, logs, and supporting documentation
    • Retest bug fixes and verify impacted areas after updates or deployments

Test Automation

  • Build, maintain, and improve automated test suites using Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or similar frameworks
    • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI
    • Monitor test execution results and troubleshoot automation failures
    • Improve automation coverage to reduce manual regression effort

Performance & Security Testing

  • Conduct load, stress, and performance testing using tools such as JMeter or Locust
    • Support vulnerability scanning and security-focused testing efforts
    • Validate system stability, responsiveness, and reliability under varying workloads

Documentation & Reporting

  • Maintain organized documentation for test plans, test cases, bug reports, and testing results
    • Track and report quality metrics such as defect density, pass/fail rates, and regression coverage
    • Prepare clear QA status updates and testing summaries for stakeholders and leadership

Collaboration & Agile Participation

  • Work closely with developers to reproduce, isolate, and resolve issues efficiently
    • Participate in Agile ceremonies including standups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and release reviews
    • Advocate for quality standards throughout the software development lifecycle
    • Provide usability and testability feedback during feature development

What Makes You a Perfect Fit

  • Detail-oriented and highly analytical with a strong quality mindset
    • Skilled at uncovering edge cases, usability issues, and hidden defects
    • Strong communicator who documents findings clearly and professionally
    • Comfortable balancing testing thoroughness with fast-paced release cycles
    • Proactive, organized, and collaborative within Agile engineering environments

Required Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of professional QA or software testing experience
    • Hands-on experience with test management and bug-tracking tools (Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, Azure DevOps)
    • Familiarity with automation frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright
    • Strong understanding of Agile workflows and the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
    • Experience performing functional, regression, and UI testing

Preferred Experience & Skills

  • Experience in SaaS, fintech, healthcare, or enterprise software environments
    • Familiarity with API testing tools such as Postman or RestAssured
    • Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines
    • Exposure to security testing, compliance-heavy systems, or performance testing workflows
    • Understanding of modern QA best practices and automation strategies

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

A Quality Assurance Engineer’s day revolves around validating product quality and preventing defects from reaching production. You will:

  • Review user stories and requirements to create or refine test cases
    • Execute manual and automated tests on new features and product updates
    • Log, prioritize, and communicate bugs clearly with engineering teams
    • Participate in sprint meetings and provide testing progress updates
    • Review regression testing results after deployments or new builds
    • Analyze quality trends and improve testing coverage and efficiency
    • Maintain organized QA documentation and testing records

In essence: you are the final quality checkpoint before release, ensuring software is stable, functional, and delivers a reliable user experience.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Defect detection rate before production releases

• Regression test coverage percentage

  • Reduction in escaped production defects
    • Faster resolution time for reported issues
    • % of successful releases without critical or severe bugs
    • Positive stakeholder confidence in product quality and reliability

Interview Process

  • Initial Phone Screen

• Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter

  • Practical Assessment (e.g., design a test plan or execute a sample bug testing scenario)
    • Client Interview with QA / Engineering Leadership

• Offer & Background Verification

job.title: Junior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
job.description:
As a Junior SDET at OrderMesh Inc, you'll join our automation-first quality team and help build test coverage across a complex microservices platform (Kafka, MongoDB, REST APIs, async workflows). This is a great entry point into modern quality engineering: you'll work alongside senior SDETs and developers to write and maintain automated tests, learn how quality gates fit into CI/CD, and grow your skills in test automation, observability, and distributed systems testing. This role is about learning and contributing hands-on not about owning strategy solo with plenty of mentorship and room to grow.

What You'll Do

  • Write and maintain automated tests for APIs, UI, and service-level validation using TypeScript, Node.js, and Playwright, under the guidance of senior team members.
  • Support the build-out of load and resilience testing suites with Grafana k6, learning how to benchmark and stress-test distributed systems.
  • Help integrate test execution into GitHub Actions pipelines, ensuring your tests run cleanly on commits, PRs, and deployments.
  • Get hands-on exposure to distributed-systems testing: Kafka event flows, service mocking with Microcks, and validating contracts between services.
  • Help maintain test observability dashboards in Grafana and learn to read quality metrics alongside logs and performance data.
  • Perform exploratory testing to complement automated coverage and catch edge cases.
  • Collaborate with developers, SREs, and product managers, and actively ask questions to build your understanding of the platform.

Requirements

  • 1-2 years of experience in software testing, QA, or automation (academic projects do not count).
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted engineering tools, for example: using or building AI coding agents, agent skills, or evaluation harnesses as part of your testing or development workflow.
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript or another modern programming language.
  • Exposure to or coursework in CI/CD concepts; hands-on experience with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps is a plus but not required.
  • Some experience with, or eagerness to learn, Playwright or similar browser automation frameworks, and load testing tools like Grafana k6.
  • Interest in learning about message brokers (Kafka), service meshes (Istio), and API testing, including test-driven development practices.
  • Strong problem-solving mindset and attention to detail; debugging skills that you're actively developing.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience (bootcamp graduates welcome).
  • Enthusiasm for automation-first testing culture and eagerness to learn from senior engineers.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Exposure to Azure, Kubernetes, or containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with contract testing concepts.
  • Any experience with Grafana, Prometheus, or similar observability platforms.
  • Interest in B2B, eCommerce, or fulfillment industries.

job.title: AI-Augmented QA Engineer
job.description:
AI-Augmented QA Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We are looking for an AI-Augmented QA Engineer to own and expand automated testing for an early-stage, fast-moving security platform.

You’ll work closely with frontend and backend engineers to build reliable test coverage, strengthen the existing Playwright test suite, and ensure critical product workflows remain stable as the platform evolves.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you’ll have significant ownership. You’ll receive clear goals around test coverage and reliability rather than step-by-step instructions, making it ideal for someone who enjoys working independently and improving systems proactively.

What You’ll Own

Test Automation & Coverage

  • Write and maintain automated end-to-end tests using Playwright
  • Expand coverage across critical product workflows
  • Build regression tests that run automatically on every pull request
  • Test workflows including dashboards, detection workflows, device management, user permissions, and settings
  • Keep the test architecture clean, maintainable, and scalable as the product grows

Test Infrastructure & Reliability

  • Own the reliability of the automated test suite and CI pipeline
  • Diagnose and reduce flaky tests
  • Manage test data and seed data requirements
  • Monitor and improve staging environment stability
  • Maintain reliable test execution as the product and test suite expand

AI-Assisted Exploratory Testing

  • Use AI-assisted browser automation to explore edge cases and uncover bugs
  • Work with Claude and LLM-based tools as part of daily testing workflows
  • Experiment with AI-driven testing approaches beyond scripted test cases
  • Identify issues that traditional automated regression tests may not catch
  • Continuously explore ways to improve QA efficiency through AI tooling

Engineering Collaboration

  • Work directly with frontend and backend engineers throughout the development cycle
  • Collaborate on testing requirements and critical product flows
  • Communicate test failures, bugs, and reliability issues clearly
  • Contribute to a culture where engineers trust and act on automated test results
  • Take ownership of QA improvements without relying on layers of project management

Requirements

  • 3–5 years of QA, software testing, or test automation experience preferred
  • Candidates with less experience will also be considered if they demonstrate strong automation skills and relevant hands-on experience
  • Strong TypeScript skills and the ability to write clean, maintainable test code
  • Hands-on experience with Playwright, Cypress, or a similar E2E testing framework
  • Strong understanding of web application testing
  • Understanding of DOM interaction, network requests, and asynchronous behavior
  • Ability to diagnose and troubleshoot flaky automated tests
  • Experience creating or maintaining automated regression tests
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of testing goals

About the Team

We bring OpenAI's technology to the world through products like ChatGPT and the OpenAI API.

We seek to learn from deployment and distribute the benefits of AI, while ensuring that this powerful tool is used responsibly and safely. Safety is more important to us than unfettered growth.

OpenAI is looking for an experienced Performance Engineer to help us scale the performance, reliability, and efficiency of our systems. In this role, you'll apply deep technical expertise to optimize infrastructure and application-level performance across mission-critical products like ChatGPT and our developer API. You’ll work cross-functionally with teams building core services, training models, and developing real-time user experiences to push our latency, throughput, and cost-efficiency to the next level.

We are looking for engineers who thrive in ambiguous environments, value deep systems understanding, and are motivated by delivering measurable impact. This is a highly technical, individual contributor role focused on root-cause analysis, profiling, instrumentation, and architecture-level performance improvements across our stack.

In this role, you will:

  • Analyze and optimize performance across application, middleware, runtime, and infrastructure layers—networking, storage, Python runtime, GPU utilization, and beyond.

  • Develop tooling and metrics that provide deep observability into system performance.

  • Collaborate closely with infra, platform, training, and product teams to identify key performance goals and drive systemic improvements.

  • Influence architecture and design decisions to prioritize latency, throughput, and efficiency at scale.

  • Lead investigations into high-impact performance regressions or scalability issues in production.

  • Drive performance testing strategies and help define SLAs/SLOs around latency and throughput for critical systems.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have contributed to observability, benchmarking, or performance-focused infrastructure at scale.

  • Have demonstrated success navigating ambiguity and aligning stakeholders around performance goals.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. job.title: Penetration Tester - Poland
job.description:
Location: Poland (Remote) Candidates must be based in Poland

Salary:90,000–230,000 PLN per annum

About Cognisys

Cognisys is a specialist cybersecurity partner helping organisations strengthen their security, manage risk and achieve compliance. Our services span Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC), penetration testing and managed security, supporting clients across EMEA, NAMER and APAC.

We work at the intersection of cybersecurity, compliance and technology, helping organisations turn compliance requirements into practical, measurable outcomes. As a trusted partner to leading security and compliance platforms, we combine technical expertise, consulting experience and innovative delivery to solve challenges that technology alone cannot address.

Our people are at the heart of what we do. We value Together, Ownership, Momentum and Excellence, and we're looking for people who are curious, collaborative and willing to take ownership of their work.

As we continue to grow, you'll have the opportunity to work alongside experienced cybersecurity professionals, contribute to challenging client engagements and help shape the way we deliver our services.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Penetration Tester to join our growing team during an exciting period of innovation and expansion.

In this role, you'll deliver security assessments across a range of client environments, including networks, applications and cloud infrastructure. Using a combination of automated tools and manual testing techniques, you'll simulate real-world attack scenarios, identify vulnerabilities and help clients understand and address their security risks.

This is a client-facing role, so technical expertise is only part of the picture. You'll also need to communicate your findings effectively, produce high-quality reports and help technical and non-technical stakeholders understand the risks and practical steps they can take to improve their security posture.

What You'll Be Doing

Penetration Testing & Security Assessments

  • Conduct penetration testing across networks, web applications, APIs, mobile applications and cloud environments.

  • Simulate real-world attack scenarios to assess client resilience against cyber threats.

  • Use automated vulnerability scanning tools alongside manual testing and exploitation techniques.

  • Identify, analyse and exploit security vulnerabilities across diverse client environments.

  • Assess technical security controls and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Apply appropriate offensive security methodologies, tools and techniques throughout engagements.

  • Stay up to date with emerging vulnerabilities, attack techniques and industry developments.

Client Delivery & Communication

  • Work directly with clients throughout penetration testing engagements.

  • Present findings and recommendations clearly and professionally.

  • Explain the potential business and technical impact of identified vulnerabilities.

  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear, accessible language for non-technical stakeholders.

  • Support clients in understanding and prioritising remediation activities.

  • Build positive and professional relationships with client stakeholders.

Reporting & Quality

  • Produce high-quality technical reports following each engagement.

  • Clearly document vulnerabilities, exploitation techniques, supporting evidence, risk ratings and remediation recommendations.

  • Ensure findings are accurate, well-evidenced and easy for clients to understand.

  • Maintain Cognisys' high standards for technical quality, consistency and client service.

Team Contribution & Development

  • Work collaboratively with the wider cybersecurity team.

  • Share knowledge, techniques and lessons learned with colleagues.

  • Contribute to the development of Cognisys' penetration testing methodologies and ways of working.

  • Take ownership of your technical and professional development.

  • Support a culture of learning, collaboration and continuous improvement.

About You

We're looking for someone with a strong technical foundation in offensive security who is equally comfortable working with clients and communicating technical findings.

You'll ideally have:

  • Hands-on experience conducting penetration testing and security assessments.

  • Experience using vulnerability scanning tools alongside manual testing and exploitation techniques.

  • A strong understanding of offensive security methodologies, tools and techniques.

  • The ability to assess, bypass and exploit technical controls in realistic attack scenarios.

  • Experience in one or more of the following areas:

    • Network penetration testing

    • Web application testing

    • API testing

    • Mobile application testing

    • Cloud security testing

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • The ability to explain technical vulnerabilities and risks clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strong client engagement skills and a professional approach to customer service.

  • The ability to manage your workload effectively and deliver work to agreed deadlines.

  • A proactive approach to learning and keeping up to date with developments in offensive security.

Certifications

Industry-recognised certifications are highly regarded and may include:

  • OSCP

  • CPSA

  • CRT

  • CREST-related certifications

  • Other relevant penetration testing or offensive security certifications.

Relevant practical experience will also be considered alongside formal certifications.


What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means becoming a trusted technical consultant who can independently deliver high-quality penetration testing engagements while providing an excellent client experience.

For example, you'll:

  • Deliver thorough, accurate and professional penetration testing engagements across a variety of client environments.

  • Confidently identify and exploit vulnerabilities using a combination of automated tools and manual testing techniques.

  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of how technical controls can be assessed, bypassed and exploited in realistic attack scenarios.

  • Produce clear, detailed and actionable reports that help clients understand vulnerabilities and how to remediate them.

  • Communicate technical findings effectively to both technical teams and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Present findings and recommendations confidently, supporting clients in prioritising remediation activities.

  • Take ownership of your engagements, managing testing, documentation and deliverables effectively.

  • Continue developing your technical knowledge and stay current with evolving offensive security techniques, tools and threats.

  • Contribute positively to the wider penetration testing team by sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues and looking for ways to improve our approach.

Why Join Us?

At Cognisys, you will be part of a collaborative and innovative team that values your input and shares support. You'll have the opportunity to work on challenging projects that make a real impact for our clients. We'd love to hear from you if you want to challenge, lead and innovate! We're not just about the work; we're about the people. Join a team where innovation is celebrated, and your contributions are valued. We foster a collaborative environment where fresh ideas thrive, and professional growth is encouraged.

What we Offer:

  • Annual Leave: 20 days per year (upped to 26 after 10+ years of work experience) plus 14 Polish public holidays.

  • Additional Leave: 1 day of paid leave for your Birthday.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Individual healthcare insurance plan and access to an employee mental health and wellbeing platform.

  • Professional Development: £2,000 annual training budget to support your continued learning and career growth.

  • Referral Bonus: help to grow our team and earn up to £2,000 per successful referral.

Applications

We’re always happy to help with questions, but to keep our process fair for everyone, we’re unable to accept applications via email—please apply directly through the job advert page.

Please feel free to reach out to Andrea, our Talent Acquisition Lead, if you would like any further information, to discuss accessibility requirements, or if you require this information provided in an alternative format –

We welcome applications from candidates from a range of diverse backgrounds and can make various reasonable adjustments to consider individual needs.

This role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the quality of our platform, with a culture that prioritizes autonomy, initiative, and accountability over micromanagement.
Note: This is a full-time, fully remote contract position, with the team operating on Eastern Time hours. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable working in a distributed environment, able to stay engaged and communicative across teams, and proactive in managing their day-to-day responsibilities. While the role is remote, collaboration remains a key part of the position, with regular interaction across engineering, product, and QA teams.

The Software Test Engineer Will:

  • Love working with back end services and large data sets.
  • Possess strong analytical, problem-solving, and creative thinking skills.
  • Excel in test case design and documenting test descriptions/test plans.
  • Enjoy figuring out what should be tested, creating the test, and implementing it. You're someone who can diagnose a potential bug before it occurs and isolate existing bugs.
  • Possess knowledge of and experience with Java, SQL, and Python. Experience with AWS data tools (S3, Redshift, RDS, and EMR) is a plus.

job.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
job.description:
Category: Legal

Location:


Paradigm is seeking a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer to support our client, a global provider of technology-enabled legal services. This is a senior, hands-on QA role supporting the development and enhancement of scalable, high-volume software workflows used in complex class action and remediation programs.
The ideal candidate brings a strong combination of manual and automated testing experience, with particular strength in back-end and data-intensive applications. You should be comfortable building and maintaining automated test scripts, writing SQL queries, working closely with developers and business analysts, and serving as a technical resource and mentor to other QA team members.
This environment includes both new development and enhancement of existing applications, making this an excellent opportunity for an experienced QA professional who enjoys solving complex problems and helping improve the overall quality and maturity of the testing process.
Job Title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
Type: Contract
Duration: 12 months*
Pay Rate: $42–$52/hr., depending on experience
Location: Remote within approved U.S. hiring locations (see below)
Job No.: Para_1499
* Assignment lengths are estimated based on the expected workload and scope of work. The assignment may be extended or conclude earlier than anticipated based on business needs.
Approved Hiring Locations:
Alabama, Arizona, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, D.C., and Wisconsin.

As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer, you will:

  • Develop, document, execute, and maintain comprehensive test plans and test cases covering component-level testing through User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
  • Perform manual testing, including smoke, sanity, regression, and UAT testing.
  • Build and maintain automated test scripts using Selenium or Playwright.
  • Test new and existing application functionality to ensure software is reliable, defect-free, and performs as intended.
  • Perform back-end and database testing, including creating test data and writing and executing SQL queries.
  • Review business and technical requirements to identify gaps, inconsistencies, risks, and testing requirements.
  • Partner closely with software engineers, business analysts, business stakeholders, and other QA professionals throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Identify, document, report, and troubleshoot software defects and verify fixes accurately and efficiently.
  • Participate in Agile Scrum ceremonies and support testing throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Develop and report QA metrics, including test coverage and test confidence.
  • Help advance test automation practices while determining when manual testing provides the most effective coverage.
  • Serve as a senior technical resource for other QA team members, providing guidance and coaching in automation testing and QA best practices.
  • Work directly with the Engineering Manager and help provide leadership and direction across QA activities.
  • Manage multiple priorities and projects in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Requirements

You bring:
  • 5+ years of experience in software Quality Assurance and testing.
  • Strong experience with both manual and automated software testing.
  • Experience with white-box and black-box testing strategies.
  • Demonstrated experience performing smoke, sanity, regression, and User Acceptance Testing.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining automated test scripts using Selenium or Playwright.
  • 3+ years of database testing experience, including the ability to read, write, and execute SQL queries.
  • 3+ years of experience working within an Agile software development lifecycle.
  • 3+ years of experience testing multi-tier client/server applications.
  • Understanding of software development frameworks, application architecture concepts, and software engineering terminology.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps and/or Microsoft Visual Studio Team System.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex software issues and apply strong analytical and deductive reasoning skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently with limited direction while collaborating effectively within cross-functional teams.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability and willingness to coach other QA professionals in automation testing techniques and practices.

Benefits

Paradigm offers a competitive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life, 401K, PTO, and sick days.

job.title: Senior QA Engineer (freelance)
job.description:
In short

If you're a Senior QA Engineer who's tested apps that talk to physical devices, and you know that "reproduce on my phone" doesn't end the conversation, we want to talk. You'd join us on a freelance, time & material basis: you're paid for the hours you actually work on real client projects. The first three months are about figuring out if we're a good match. When things work out, and that depends on the work itself, the project pipeline, and business timing, there's a real path to our core team with a permanent contract and full benefits.

Why intent?

We've been designing and co-creating connected devices since 2008. Wearables, smart audio, health-tech hardware for clients like Oura and BOSE, backed by investors like a16z and Founders Fund. We're 60+ people, fully remote, and AI-native since before LinkedIn influencers discovered the term. Our QA isn't "check the screens": it's a mobile app talking to firmware over BLE, sometimes with a flaky signal, sometimes at the edge of battery, sometimes on a phone that decided to update overnight. The bugs are real, the details matter, and good QA changes whether a product ships well or limps out the door.

Who this role is NOT for

If you like running the same test pass every sprint and closing tickets the moment the build is green, we're probably not your people. We look for QA who ask "why" before "how", challenge specs that don't add up, and dig into firmware logs when something smells off. We're AI-native and we expect you to treat AI as a daily multiplier, not a gimmick. What we expect: ownership of what you touch, straight talk when something is wrong, and the kind of curiosity that makes you actually care about the device, not just the app on top of it.

What you'll do

  • Compatibility testing: make sure devices, sensors, gateways, protocols, and platforms actually play well together

  • Functional testing: data collection, storage, processing, real-time monitoring, control, integrations

  • Performance testing: behavior under different workloads, networks, and physical conditions, finding bottlenecks and latency

  • Security testing: vulnerabilities in devices, communication protocols, transmission, storage, access, auth

  • Mentor less experienced testers, raise the bar on QA practices

  • Take part in requirement discussions and daily calls, flag inconsistencies and open issues early

  • Share knowledge inside the QA chapter and across the company

  • Use AI tools as part of your daily workflow, not as a party trick

How we work

Fully remote. We have a pet-friendly office in Warsaw and a coworking space in Gdansk if walls and coffee machines motivate you, but nobody will ask why you're not there. Working hours are flexible: most of the team operates between 10:00 and 18:00 CET, and that's when most meetings happen. Evening calls with US-based clients (up to ~20:00) are part of the rhythm, sometimes a couple of times a week, always planned ahead. You'll be part of the QA chapter for knowledge-sharing, and at the same time on a project squad led by a PM for day-to-day delivery.

What you'll get

  • 90-130 PLN/h net B2B, depending on your experience

  • Truly flexible hours: you organize your day

  • Fully remote, with pet-friendly Warsaw office + Gdansk cowork if you want them

  • Access to our internal knowledge-sharing: tech talks, experiments, side projects

  • When the first 3 months work out, and that depends on the work, the project pipeline, and business timing, there's a real path to a permanent contract with a fixed monthly salary, 26 days paid leave, 10 sick days, Saltus medical care, and a training budget

No sugarcoating: during the freelance period there's no paid leave or medical benefits. Those come with the permanent contract, and we're transparent about that upfront.

Your first weeks

We aim to give you space to ramp up before jumping into live project work, but this is a real company with real deadlines: if the project needs you sooner, we'll make sure you have the support to hit the ground running. You'll get paired with a buddy and tackle progressively bigger tasks, so both sides can see how the collaboration feels. Feedback comes early and often, no one waits three months to tell you something isn't working. If it's great, you'll know. If something needs adjusting, you'll hear about it while there's still time to adjust.

Recruitment process

The entire process is in English. All interviews are recorded for internal evaluation purposes.

  1. Application with a few screening questions

  2. HR call, ~45 min, casual

  3. Technical meeting, ~90 min, with the QA team

  4. Final feedback within a few days

Once we're in touch, you'll hear from us fast. We don't ghost and we don't drag.

One more thing

intent is an equal opportunity employer. We care about what you can do, not where you come from. Send us your CV and a few words about why this caught your eye. Bonus points if you share a bug you found that nobody else would have.

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years of professional mobile QA experience

  • Proven experience testing IoT systems: wearables, consumer devices, or connected audio (not "I read about it once")

  • Familiarity with IoT protocols: Bluetooth, BLE, NFC, Wi-Fi, Thread

  • Hands-on with test case management tools (TestRail, Qase) and the Atlassian stack

  • Solid QA fundamentals: test design, risk assessment, exploratory testing

  • English at B2+, written and spoken, because our clients are mostly US-based

  • Precision, curiosity, patience, and the kind of perceptiveness that catches things specs missed

job.title: Quality Assurance Engineer (Contractor)
job.description:
About Kadince

Kadince (pronounced cadence) is a fully remote American software company founded in 2013. In a nutshell, we build tools to help financial institutions track and manage the good they do in their communities.

Why We’re Looking for Contractors

As our customer base grows, so does our team. We’re committed to delivering top-notch software quality and ensuring every feature release goes smoothly. To keep up with the growing demand and maintain our high standards, we’re looking for experienced Quality Assurance Engineers in Brazil who can help us scale QA efforts, maintain product integrity, and contribute to a collaborative dev environment.

Who We Want to Hire

To be a QA contractor at Kadince, you should have 5+ years of experience in software development or QA engineering. You know how to plan and execute test strategies, create and maintain robust test suites, perform root cause analysis, and communicate your findings clearly. You don’t just test software—you improve it.

You’re great at spotting issues, solving problems, and helping developers build better code. Your detail-oriented nature, curiosity, and passion for quality assurance set you apart.

Since you’ll be collaborating with our US-based development team, strong English communication skills are important. We’ll occasionally have meetings to align on progress, share feedback, or collaborate in real time.

Let’s Geek Out

If you’re geeky like our QA team (hopefully you are), you’ll probably want to know more about our stack and workflow.

Technologies & Tools

  • Frontend/Backend: Ruby on Rails, React, GraphQL, Postgres, Redis
  • Testing: Cypress, Minitest
  • DevOps: Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, CircleCI
  • Collaboration & QA Tools: Jira, Rubymine, Sentry

You’ll be using these tools to build, execute, and automate tests while helping us maintain and improve QA documentation and practices.

Our Core Values

Our values aren’t just nice words on a wall (we don’t have one). They drive how we work and who we hire:

  • Integrity – We’re honest with ourselves and others.
  • People – We understand that people are the foundation of Kadince.
  • Care – We do our best work with purpose and intention.
  • Remarkability – We provide standout experiences.
  • Growth – We accept yesterday and improve today.

Even as a contractor, you’ll be expected to uphold these values in your work and interactions.

What You’d Work On

As a QA contractor, you’ll work alongside our development and product teams on:

  • Planning, executing, and automating manual and regression tests
  • Writing test cases and acceptance criteria
  • Identifying, triaging, and tracking bugs
  • Monitoring releases using tools like Sentry and Slack
  • Collaborating on documentation and QA process improvements
  • Mentoring junior team members (as needed)

You’ll receive assignments, collaborate through Slack and Jira, and give feedback directly to your Kadince point of contact. We’re open to your ideas—your voice matters.

Flexibility

This is a fully remote contractor role with flexible hours. You’ll need to coordinate occasionally with our US-based team, but we value asynchronous work and understand time zone differences. You’ll be free to manage your schedule as long as you deliver consistent, high-quality results.

Compensation

Kadince offers competitive USD-based compensation, above typical rates in the Brazilian market. Here’s what you can expect based on your experience and skills:

  • Tier 2: Mid Level (2–5 years): $5–$10/hour
  • Tier 3: Senior Level (5+ years): $10–$20/hour

Compensation depends on experience, technical ability, and English communication. Exceptional performance may lead to higher rates over time.

How to Apply

If you’re excited to work with Kadince, we want to hear from you. When applying, send us:

  • A PDF resume
  • A brief cover letter (max 300 words) explaining why you’d be a great fit

Show us that you’ve taken the time to understand who we are. (Seriously, if you don’t know our name during the interview… that’s a red flag.)

This position is open to candidates living in Brazil.

Salary: $5 - $20 / hour

job.title: AI QA Trainer – LLM Evaluation
job.description:
Are you an AI QA expert eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into enterprise-grade platforms. With rigorous evaluation data, tomorrow’s AI can democratize world-class education, keep pace with cutting-edge research, and streamline workflows for teams everywhere. That quality begins with you—we need your expertise to harden model reasoning and reliability.

We’re looking for AI QA trainers who live and breathe model evaluation, LLM safety, prompt robustness, data quality assurance, multilingual and domain-specific testing, grounding verification, and compliance/readiness checks. You’ll challenge advanced language models on tasks like hallucination detection, factual consistency, prompt-injection and jailbreak resistance, bias/fairness audits, chain-of-reasoning reliability, tool-use correctness, retrieval-augmentation fidelity, and end-to-end workflow validation—documenting every failure mode so we can raise the bar.

On a typical day, you will converse with the model on real-world scenarios and evaluation prompts, verify factual accuracy and logical soundness, design and run test plans and regression suites, build clear rubrics and pass/fail criteria, capture reproducible error traces with root-cause hypotheses, and suggest improvements to prompt engineering, guardrails, and evaluation metrics (e.g., precision/recall, faithfulness, toxicity, and latency SLOs). You’ll also partner on adversarial red-teaming, automation (Python/SQL), and dashboarding to track quality deltas over time.

A bachelor’s, master’s, or PhD in computer science, data science, computational linguistics, statistics, or a related field is ideal; shipped QA for ML/AI systems, safety/red-team experience, test automation frameworks (e.g., PyTest), and hands-on work with LLM eval tooling (e.g., OpenAI Evals, RAG evaluators, W&B) signal fit. Skills that stand out include: evaluation rubric design, adversarial testing/red-teaming, regression testing at scale, bias/fairness auditing, grounding verification, prompt and system-prompt engineering, test automation (Python/SQL), and high-signal bug reporting. Clear, metacognitive communication—“showing your work”—is essential.

Ready to turn your QA expertise into the quality backbone for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.

We offer a pay range of $6-to- $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

Employment type: Contract

Workplace type: Remote

Seniority level: Mid-Senior Level

job.title: QA Analyst - 1518
job.description:
About Fetch:

Fetch is a venture-backed company redefining multifamily living through four core services: Package Delivery, Valet Trash, Fetch Market, and Fetch Storage. From secure, direct-to-door package delivery to community-wide valet trash, 24/7 essentials delivered through Fetch Market, and flexible storage solutions, Fetch streamlines operations for property teams while creating unmatched convenience for residents. Operating nationwide with rapid growth ahead, we combine logistics, technology, and hospitality to shape the future of multifamily living.

Our Opportunity:

Quality is what keeps our support teams trusted. We are hiring a QA Analyst to administer quality assurance for our support organization as part of the Learning and Development team, covering our three main support teams: Claims, Customer Support, and Partner Success. Beyond grading individual conversations, this role sets the course for what is going well and what needs attention, turning what we see in the conversations into the training and process changes that raise the quality of every support team.

What you’ll bring to this job:

    • Grade support conversations at scale using our QA software, applying a consistent standard across every support team.
    • Work through the grading data to identify the key trends and behaviors that signal whether an agent is struggling or a process is struggling.
    • Partner with the Learning and Development team to turn those findings into the right training and process changes, closing the loop between quality and learning.
    • Deliver feedback directly, either to the agent or to their supervisor, so the supervisor has a full picture of where the agent is strong and where they need support.
    • Help conduct live training for agents, supporting the team in delivering the onboarding and ongoing learning that Learning and Development develops.
    • Maintain the QA scorecard and scoring standards and take part in calibration, so grading stays consistent and fair across every reviewer and team.
    • Report QA results on a regular cadence and track how agents and teams are trending over time, so leadership and Learning and Development can see where to focus.
    • Apply strong critical thinking to get to the root of why quality issues are happening, not just what is happening, and propose the right fix.

job.title: Implementation QA Specialist
job.description:
Join our mission to provide governments with exceptional experiences so they can do the same for their communities!

What do we do?💥

We empower governments to deliver exceptional citizen experiences.

Check out our ‘About Us’page for a deep dive into our product and what makes us exceptional.

How will you help us make an impact? 👩‍💻👨‍💻

Clariti is seeking an experienced Implementation QA Specialist to help ensure the quality, reliability, and successful delivery of our community development software solutions. As a key member of our Professional Services organization, you will serve as a quality gatekeeper throughout the implementation lifecycle, ensuring that configured solutions, integrations, data migrations, and business processes meet documented requirements and are ready for customer acceptance.

You will own test planning, execution, defect management, and quality validation across complex SaaS implementations. You will also lead System Integration Testing (SIT), support customer User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and help establish consistent quality standards across our delivery practice.

This role goes beyond traditional software testing. You will leverage AI-powered tools, intelligent automation, and reusable testing frameworks to accelerate testing, identify defects earlier, reduce rework, and improve implementation outcomes.

You will collaborate closely with Implementation Consultants, Delivery Architects, Engagement Managers, Product Engineering, customers, and implementation partners to deliver high-quality solutions that support real-world government operations.

What You'll Do

1. Test Strategy, Planning & Quality Assurance

  • Develop and maintain comprehensive test plans covering functional, system, integration, data conversion, regression, performance, security, and user acceptance testing.
  • Establish testing entry and exit criteria, defect management procedures, quality gates, and formal sign-off requirements.
  • Design and execute test cases aligned with approved requirements, user stories, functional designs, and acceptance criteria.
  • Validate application configurations, business rules, workflow automation, user permissions, and custom functionality.
  • Establish and maintain traceability between requirements, test cases, test results, and defects through the Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM).
  • Participate in requirements reviews, solution design discussions, and story refinement to identify gaps before configuration or development begins.
  • Build and maintain reusable regression test suites across implementations and releases.
  • Execute functional, smoke, regression, and system testing as solutions progress through development, testing, and production environments.
  • Identify and communicate quality risks early to minimize downstream implementation delays.

2. Community Development & End-to-End Workflow Testing

  • Validate complete community development processes, including permitting, licensing, plan reviews, inspections, code enforcement, approvals, and regulatory workflows.
  • Develop testing scenarios that reflect real-world municipal and county operations.
  • Verify complex business rules, approval routing, fee calculations, notifications, document generation, and application status transitions.
  • Test role-based access controls, permissions, and security configurations across citizen, contractor, reviewer, inspector, and administrative user roles.
  • Validate workflows involving multiple departments, external agencies, and third-party systems.
  • Ensure testing covers complete business processes from initial application submission through final approval, inspection, and closure.
  • Identify functional gaps, workflow inconsistencies, and user experience issues before customer demonstrations or UAT.
  • Work with Implementation Consultants and Delivery Architects to confirm that configured solutions meet approved business requirements.

3. System Integration Testing (SIT)

  • Lead and execute System Integration Testing across fully configured solutions and connected third-party applications.
  • Validate end-to-end workflows, system interactions, data exchanges, and cross-functional business processes in production-like environments.
  • Develop and execute comprehensive SIT test scenarios using validated requirements and customer business processes.
  • Verify integration behavior, interface compatibility, exception handling, and data consistency.
  • Coordinate testing activities with internal delivery teams, customers, and external implementation partners.
  • Produce SIT test reports documenting execution results, outstanding defects, resolution status, and readiness for customer UAT.
  • Ensure critical defects are resolved or appropriately dispositioned before recommending progression to UAT.

4. User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Leadership

  • Support customer UAT preparation, execution, defect management, and formal closeout.
  • Develop UAT testing templates, sample scenarios, and guidance to help customer teams execute meaningful business process testing.
  • Review customer-developed test cases for completeness, accuracy, and alignment with approved requirements.
  • Validate UAT environment readiness, including configuration deployments, test data, migrated records, permissions, and in-scope integrations.
  • Facilitate UAT readiness checkpoints and provide guidance on testing expectations, execution procedures, and defect reporting.
  • Coordinate defect triage with customers and delivery teams, including severity classification, prioritization, and resolution tracking.
  • Monitor UAT progress, testing coverage, defect trends, and risks to project milestones.
  • Prepare UAT summary reports documenting test execution, defect status, and completion of defined exit criteria.
  • Support formal UAT closeout and customer acceptance activities in coordination with Engagement Managers.

5. AI-Driven Testing & Automation

  • Leverage AI-assisted tools to accelerate test case generation, test script development, defect analysis, and regression testing.
  • Use AI to analyze requirements, user stories, and functional designs to identify missing scenarios, inconsistencies, and potential defects.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance automated testing frameworks using tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, ACCELQ, or comparable solutions.
  • Build reusable automated test libraries for common community development workflows and application configurations.
  • Explore AI agents and intelligent automation to improve testing coverage, execution speed, and defect identification.
  • Apply AI-assisted techniques to generate realistic test data, validate expected outcomes, and identify testing gaps.
  • Evaluate AI-generated testing artifacts for accuracy, completeness, security, and alignment with approved requirements.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to incorporate automated testing into development and deployment processes.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive manual testing while maintaining strong quality standards.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of Clariti's AI-enabled delivery and QA practices.

6. Integration & API Testing

  • Test integrations between Clariti solutions and external government systems, including GIS, payment processing, electronic plan review, document management, identity management, and other third-party applications.
  • Validate real-time and batch integrations against approved interface specifications.
  • Perform API testing using tools such as Postman, Newman, or comparable solutions.
  • Verify request and response structures, data transformations, error handling, negative scenarios, and exception processing.
  • Validate data synchronization, interface reliability, and cross-system consistency.
  • Coordinate testing and defect resolution with Delivery Architects, customer technical teams, and third-party vendors.
  • Identify integration dependencies and risks that could impact testing readiness or production deployment.

7. Data Migration & Conversion Testing

  • Develop and execute data migration validation plans aligned with approved mapping and conversion requirements.
  • Validate migrated data for completeness, accuracy, uniqueness, consistency, and referential integrity.
  • Perform source-to-target reconciliation, record count verification, and data sampling.
  • Verify field mappings, transformation rules, and converted data relationships.
  • Identify and document conversion defects, data inconsistencies, and mapping discrepancies.
  • Support multiple conversion cycles and validate corrective actions.
  • Assist with final production migration validation and post-deployment data reconciliation.
  • Collaborate with technical and functional teams to ensure converted data supports expected business processes.

8. Deployment, Release & Production Readiness

  • Support release quality assurance across development, testing, staging, and production environments.
  • Validate application deployments, configuration changes, and release packages.
  • Execute smoke and regression testing following deployments and environment updates.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to integrate automated testing into CI/CD and release management processes.
  • Participate in go-live readiness assessments and identify outstanding quality risks.
  • Support mock cutover testing, rollback validation, and production deployment preparation.
  • Develop and execute production smoke testing plans following go-live.
  • Provide QA readiness recommendations based on test results, defect status, and established acceptance criteria.
  • Support post-go-live stabilization and validation of critical defect fixes.

9. Defect Management, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish and maintain structured defect management processes using Jira, Azure DevOps, or comparable tools.
  • Document defects with clear reproduction steps, expected versus actual results, environment details, and severity assessments.
  • Coordinate defect triage, prioritization, retesting, and closure across functional and technical teams.
  • Track and report quality metrics, including defect escape rates, test execution progress, automation coverage, and regression results.
  • Communicate testing progress, quality concerns, and delivery risks to Engagement Managers and Professional Services leadership.
  • Identify recurring defects and recommend improvements to requirements gathering, configuration design, and implementation practices.
  • Contribute to standardized QA templates, testing methodologies, reusable test libraries, and delivery best practices.
  • Promote a culture of proactive quality ownership and continuous improvement across Professional Services.

What Do You Bring to the Team?

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in software quality assurance, enterprise application testing, or SaaS implementation testing.
  • Strong understanding of software development and implementation lifecycles, including Agile methodologies.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing comprehensive test plans across functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
  • Experience leading or supporting SIT and customer-facing UAT activities.
  • Experience testing complex, configurable enterprise applications and business workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, ACCELQ, or comparable tools.
  • Experience validating system integrations, APIs, and data exchanges.
  • Experience testing data migrations, including reconciliation, source-to-target validation, and data integrity checks.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, release management, and testing across multiple environments.
  • Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
  • Ability to interpret business requirements, user stories, functional specifications, and technical documentation.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written communication skills, including preparation of formal test plans, defect reports, and testing deliverables.
  • Strong customer-facing communication and facilitation skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with cross-functional delivery teams.
  • Interest in applying AI and automation to improve testing effectiveness and efficiency.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience implementing or testing GovTech, community development, permitting, licensing, or regulatory software.
  • Experience working with municipal, county, or state government customers.
  • Familiarity with low-code/no-code platforms and configuration-driven SaaS applications.
  • Experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or other LLM-based solutions for software testing.
  • Experience developing AI-assisted test automation or agent-based testing workflows.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, database validation, and data transformation processes.
  • Experience testing GIS, electronic plan review, payment processing, document management, and identity management integrations.
  • Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter or comparable solutions.
  • Familiarity with security testing, role-based access controls, and enterprise application permissions.
  • Experience working with third-party implementation partners and system integrators.
  • Experience supporting customer-facing implementation deliverables and formal acceptance processes.

What Does Success Look Like?

A Implementation QA Specialist will help Clariti deliver more predictable, efficient, and higher-quality implementations by identifying defects earlier, validating complete business processes, and improving the consistency of testing across projects.

Key measures of success include:

  • Quality Improvement: Reduce defects discovered during customer UAT and following production deployment.
  • Testing Coverage: Ensure approved requirements, critical business processes, integrations, and acceptance criteria are adequately tested.
  • AI & Automation Adoption: Increase automated test coverage and reduce repetitive manual testing through AI-enabled tools.
  • Implementation Efficiency: Reduce rework, improve first-pass configuration quality, and accelerate testing cycles.
  • Release Readiness: Ensure testing milestones and quality gates are completed before customer-facing releases.
  • Customer Confidence: Improve customer UAT experiences through stronger preparation, clearer reporting, and more reliable software.
  • Continuous Improvement: Establish reusable testing assets and scalable QA standards across Professional Services.

What Makes This Role Different?

At Clariti, quality assurance is more than validating individual software features. It is about ensuring that government employees, citizens, contractors, and other stakeholders can successfully complete the business processes they depend on every day. You will combine traditional QA discipline with modern AI-assisted testing practices to help deliver complex community development solutions more efficiently and reliablyYour work will directly contribute to reducing implementation risk, improving customer satisfaction, accelerating delivery timelines, and strengthening the quality of Clariti's software implementations.

What's in It for You?

We invest in and empower our team members with competitive compensation packages, well deserved time off and benefits to keep you and your family healthy! *

💰 The base salary range for this role is expected to be between $88,000–$110,000 CAD CAD based on the candidate’s skills, experience, and qualifications while considering internal pay equity and our broader pay philosophy. 💰

If you have questions about compensation as we move through the process, we’re happy to discuss further.

*Benefits depend on employment type (full-time, part-time, contract, etc).

Things to Note 📝

Background checks - Because our customers trust us with sensitive information, we require all successful candidates to undergo comprehensive background checks before joining our team. We focus strictly on global sanctions and criminal offences that are directly relevant to employment at Clariti, and follow all applicable privacy and human rights legislation.

Travel- Although we operate as a remote company, all roles are expected to participate in occasional travel for in-person company-wide or departmental meetings, typically 1-2 times per year. Additional travel requirements specific to the role, if any, will be outlined in the job description.

We're committed to building an inclusive culture where our team members take ownership over projects, tasks, and outcomes; bring a growth mindset to drive continuous learning and self-development; have the ability to communicate courageously in a direct but respectful way; and are customer-focused by keeping the customer at the heart of decision-making. It’s the diversity of our team that helps us make better decisions, by leveraging the diversity in thought & experience across to create impactful solutions as we explore new paths & challenges as we grow. We’re working to create a workplace and team that is as diverse as the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

Questions? We are here to help

If you require accommodations in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in our hiring process for any reason, please direct your questions to and we’ll be happy to support you.

job.title: Databricks QA Engineer
job.description:
About V4C

V4C is a pure-play Databricks partner, and in under two years we have earned 850+ Databricks certifications across 325+ customers and been named Databricks' 2026 Partner of the Year (C&SI Emerging).

As a Databricks QA Engineer on our data engineering team you will own the quality gate for enterprise data platforms, working directly with customers. You will work on live enterprise data platforms alongside one of the most heavily Databricks-certified delivery teams in the market.

The Role

This is a QA role for people who understand data engineering, not general software QA pointed at a data project. You will validate Lakehouse pipelines, which means reasoning about row counts, schema drift, late-arriving data, and silent transformation errors no UI will ever surface. Our approach is automation-first: suites in Python and PySpark, running in CI, blocking promotion when they fail. You own release sign-off, which makes you the last person between a customer and bad data in production.

Responsibilities

  • Own test strategy and release sign-off on engagements, including documented test plans covering scope, risk, and coverage
  • Build and maintain automated test suites in Python and PySpark (pytest), integrated into CI pipelines
  • Validate data pipelines end to end: ingestion, Medallion layer transformations, Delta Lake tables, and ELT workflows
  • Implement data quality rules as code, including Lakeflow expectations and reusable validation frameworks
  • Run regression validation after code changes and maintain CI quality gates that block merge or promotion on failure
  • Partner with engineers to identify automation candidates and raise the coverage bar across the practice

Requirements

  • 5+ years in QA automation or test engineering, including meaningful time testing data pipelines rather than applications alone
  • A data engineering background: you can read a pipeline, reason about a transformation, and write the SQL to verify it
  • Expert-level SQL
  • Experience with Medallion architecture, Delta Lake, and ELT-based data platforms
  • Experience building automated suites that run in CI and gate deployment
  • Demonstrable hands-on experience working on Databricks or similar platforms

Preferences

  • Healthcare or life sciences experience preferred but not required
  • Existing Databricks certification(s)
  • Hands-on experience with Unity Catalog, Lakeflow pipelines, or Databricks Asset Bundles
  • Experience with Azure DevOps pipelines, or equivalent CI tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI)
  • Familiarity with contract-based data validation standards such as ODCS
  • Experience using LLM agents or MCP-connected tooling to run validations, triage failures, or draft defect reports
  • Consulting or client-facing background

Benefits

Pay Rate: $70 – $80 per hour (1099 independent contractor).

This is a contract engagement rather than a salaried employee role. Where a rate lands within the range depends on depth of data-pipeline testing experience and automation capability. Open to contractors anywhere in the United States.

We are hiring Quality Control (QC) evaluators for a project that spans both Search and Linguistic tasks.
