job.description:
As a QA Analyst, you will test our internal tooling as we build and introduce it, and support certification testing as we work with external labs. The role is manual-first with automation exposure, and as both our automation and support functions grow, there's a real opportunity to grow with them.
We know that innovation ignites when we build and create together. This is a full-time role based in the Philippines, where you'll join our QA team and work closely with squads across Australia and Europe, shipping high-impact work with our fearless crew.

Responsibilities
Game Quality
● Write, maintain and execute test cases for games assigned to you across our studios: Twist, Massive, Knucklehead, Monstrums and The Originals.
● Test new titles ahead of launch: functionality, math and feature behaviour, presentation, and cross-device/browser coverage.
● Report, reproduce and track defects through to resolution, working directly with game
squads.
● Produce clear test reports and sign-offs as part of the game delivery cycle.

Customer Support
● Pick up operator issues however they arrive: our support desk, shared Slack channels, or passed on by account managers.
● Log every issue as a ticket, including ones raised in Slack or through an account manager, so SLA clocks are tracked and nothing gets lost.
● Triage each ticket: reproduce it where possible, classify it as integration-level or game-level, and set its priority (P1–P3) against our contract SLAs.
● Acknowledge every ticket within SLA, confirming receipt, priority and next steps.
● Resolve what you can at first touch: configuration questions, game behaviour queries, known issues and how-to requests.
● Escalate what you can't to the right L2 team (RGS/back-end for integration issues, the owning game squad for game issues) with a clear, reproducible write-up.
● Keep customers updated through to resolution, and close tickets out cleanly.
● Contribute the intake, triage and customer-comms view to post-incident reviews for P1 and major P2 incidents.

Patterns & Prevention
● Identify common defect patterns across games, studios and support tickets, and feed them back so issues get fixed at the source, not just per-title or per-ticket.
● Use ticket data to spot trends: a game that keeps generating tickets, an integration issue that keeps recurring, or a customer who needs more onboarding.
● Turn recurring support questions into known-issue notes, FAQs or help content.
● Help sharpen test cases and QA practices over time based on what keeps coming up in testing and in the field.

Internal Tooling
● Test our internal tools and systems (client portal, backoffice, CRM and others) as we build and introduce them.

Team & Priorities
● Balance assigned QA work with incoming tickets: P1 and P2 incidents take priority, and P3s fit around your test schedule within SLA.
● Work within a QA team juggling multiple concurrent priorities: games in flight, tooling releases, support requests and launch deadlines.
● Support test planning and estimation with the Head of Product and delivery function.
● Support certification testing as we work with external labs.
● Help shape our support process as it matures, including the rollout of our ticketing system and ticket logging in our client portal.

Desirable Skills and Experience:
Must Have
● 2–4 years' experience in manual QA / software testing.
● Strong test case design and defect reporting: structured, reproducible, clear.
● Sharp eye for detail; you catch what others scan past.
● Strong communicator. Squads, product and delivery all know exactly what you found and why it matters.
● Self-directed: you get through the work without being chased, and show initiative when you see a gap.
● Comfortable switching between multiple priorities without dropping quality.

Nice-to-Have
● iGaming / slot game testing experience.
● B2B support experience, especially with operators, partners or platform integrations.
● Experience working to contractual SLAs, or as part of an incident management process.
● Experience with ticketing tools (Jira Service Management, Zendesk or similar), including Slack-integrated workflows.
● Exposure to test automation, or interest in growing into it as we build out that function.
● Experience testing internal tools or backoffice systems.

job.title: QA Engineer, Contract
job.description:
Who Are We?

Xcelirate develops technologically-advanced platforms which are accessed by thousands of users every minute! We are proud to offer a workplace where the sharpest developers come together to strategically plan and swiftly execute practices which see us maintain our existing market dominance and attain global expansion. We owe our success to our customers who have seen us grow across a decade, and our talented team who have made that growth possible!

What are we looking for?

You’re a QA Engineer, but not the kind who lurks in the shadows waiting to yell "bug!" at the worst possible moment. Instead, you are the one with the capital "E" - the one who cares about quality like a craft, not a checklist. You know perfection is a myth like 100% test coverage - but reliability, predictability, and confidence? Those are very real, and you’re here to make them happen.

You don’t just break things. You read the room of the system. You feel when something’s off before it explodes into a 3 a.m. incident that people need to wake up to fix. You ask the uncomfortable questions early - the ones that save everyone later, and the ones the code monkeys will totally hate. You see patterns forming where others just see "one weird possibly minor edge case."

You’re a collaborator, not a gatekeeper. You don’t lob tickets over the wall and disappear. You talk, you clarify, you trace problems back to their roots and help rip them out. When it’s time to be firm, you are - but you never hide behind process for the sake of process.

You like structure, but you’re not a robot. You know when a release needs a microscope, and when "good enough" is actually the right call for the product and those who build it.

At the end of the day, you make everyone and everything around you better. Engineers trust you. Product listens to you. And once you are done with what you do, fewer people get surprised in the morning.

What will you be doing?

  • Validate that what’s built is what the business actually asked for - not what development thought they asked for
  • Help assess release readiness, verification and risk
  • Validate bug fixes and new features before release
  • Identify edge cases, regressions, and integration issues
  • Collaborate closely with engineers during development
  • Provide clear, actionable bug reports with reproduction steps and context
  • Plan, execute, and document manual QA across applications
  • Test backend APIs and frontend user flows
  • Work with existing QAs and Developers to define and improve QA processes, standards, and checklists
  • Where needed, support and maintain your own automated test cases to reduce repetition
  • Conduct internal and external UATs
  • Query databases when required to support the execution of your manual tests
  • Continuously look for ways to reduce recurring issues and rework
  • Support & Communicate documentation within project management tools such as Jira and Notion

Requirements

What will you bring along?

  • 7+ years of experience in QA for web-based applications
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • Excellent ability to manage and interpret product requirements
  • Experience in digital product QA, web apps, e-commerce, and similar.
  • Strong experience testing APIs (REST, JSON, HTTP concepts)
  • Experience testing modern frontend applications (React, HTTP, CSS, Vue, etc.)
  • Familiarity with test automation tools and frameworks
  • Comfortable working in agile / iterative environments
  • Experience working closely with product owners and engineers on technical products
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines from a QA perspective
  • Familiarity with iOS devices (Xcode simulator)
  • Basic knowledge of SQL
  • Experience designing test strategies or improving QA processes
  • Exposure to performance, security, integration and/or exploratory testing

We are always looking for the best candidates, so if you think you would be a good fit even if you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we would love to hear from you!

Benefits

How We Support Our Contractors

  • €38/hour + retention bonus scheme: Competitive contractor rate with a generous bonus paid every 6 months based on your time with us.
  • Top-Notch Workstation: We provide the latest MacBook, branded merchandise, and everything you need for an optimal work environment.
  • Global Co-Working Access: Work from a global network of co-working spaces to keep your work-life dynamic and flexible.
  • Flexibility: Enjoy full flexibility in work location and hours, supporting a work-life balance tailored to your needs.
  • Events and Gatherings: Participate in exciting events throughout the year, including team gatherings, cultural events, and other fun activities.

The company operates at the intersection of healthcare and legal services, helping improve operational efficiency, provider compliance, and client satisfaction through structured processes and high-quality execution.

Role Overview

Records Processing is the quality check between the provider and the customer. When records arrive, you confirm they are complete, correct, and ready to deliver. When something is missing or wrong, you send it back to retrieval with clear instructions. You also review the AI-generated summaries that turn raw records into customer-ready output.

Your Impact:

You will directly influence the speed and accuracy of medical records retrieval by ensuring requests are correctly prepared from the start. Your work will reduce provider rejections, minimize downstream rework, and improve overall turnaround times. You will contribute to higher client satisfaction by maintaining compliance and documentation quality. Your attention to detail and proactive issue resolution will help scale operations while maintaining high accuracy standards.

  • Review records as they arrive and confirm they are complete: correct patient, requested dates of service covered, and every requested record type present (medical, billing, imaging, and others)

  • Catch problems before the customer does: wrong patient, missing dates of service, duplicate or unreadable pages, billing records that don't match the medical records
  • Return incomplete or incorrect records to retrieval with specific notes on exactly what is missing and what the provider needs to send
  • Run and review AI extractions and summaries so the final output is accurate and customer-ready
  • Organize, label, and stage documents for final delivery
  • Flag providers who repeatedly send incomplete sets and suggest process improvements

What Success Looks Like

  • Records move from received to delivery-ready quickly; your queue doesn't age
  • Zero customer rework: nothing is delivered with the wrong patient, missing dates, or a bad affidavit
  • Your return notes to retrieval are specific enough that the fix is right the first time
  • You're spotting patterns and surfacing them, not just clearing the queue

    • Able to work carefully at volume without cutting corners
    • Clear, specific written communication: your notes tell a teammate exactly what to fix

    • Ownership mindset: you follow through until the job is done

job.title: QA Automation Engineer
job.description:
QA Automation Engineer

Location: Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role

We’re hiring a QA Automation Engineer to build, maintain, and scale automated testing systems for a fast-growing, product-focused technology company.

This is an automation-first engineering role focused on Playwright and TypeScript — not a manual QA position.

You will work directly with frontend and backend engineers to improve product quality, strengthen regression coverage, eliminate flaky tests, and ensure reliable deployments across the development lifecycle.

The ideal candidate is highly technical, ownership-driven, and experienced building scalable end-to-end automation frameworks in modern SaaS environments.

If you enjoy solving complex testing challenges, improving framework reliability, and working closely with engineering teams in fast-paced product environments, this role is for you.

What You’ll Own

End-to-End Test Automation

  • Build, maintain, and expand E2E automation coverage using Playwright and TypeScript
    • Develop scalable and maintainable automation frameworks for critical product workflows
    • Ensure strong regression coverage across frontend and backend systems
    • Write reliable, reusable, and performance-focused automated tests

Test Stability & Framework Reliability

  • Identify, troubleshoot, and eliminate flaky tests
    • Improve test execution performance and framework stability
    • Diagnose issues related to asynchronous behavior, DOM interactions, and network requests
    • Maintain stable and reliable automation environments across releases

CI/CD & Infrastructure Integration

  • Integrate automation suites into CI/CD pipelines for continuous testing
    • Ensure automated tests run efficiently within deployment workflows
    • Maintain test data strategies and reliable test environments
    • Support deployment confidence through automated quality validation

Collaboration & Product Quality

  • Collaborate directly with frontend and backend engineers during feature development
    • Participate in release validation and quality planning discussions
    • Support engineering teams with testing strategy and automation best practices
    • Improve overall product reliability through proactive automation coverage

AI-Assisted Testing & Optimization

  • Utilize AI tools to support exploratory testing and edge-case discovery
    • Identify opportunities to improve automation workflows through intelligent tooling
    • Continuously optimize testing processes for speed, reliability, and scalability

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You think like an engineer, not just a tester
    • You take ownership of automation systems and long-term framework stability
    • You enjoy solving reliability and scalability challenges
    • You are highly analytical and detail-oriented
    • You thrive in low-management, high-autonomy environments
    • You proactively improve systems instead of waiting for direction

Required Experience & Skills

  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript

• Hands-on experience with Playwright

  • Strong Cypress background is acceptable if willing to transition to Playwright
    • Proven experience building and maintaining E2E automation frameworks
    • Deep understanding of:
    • DOM interaction
    • Network requests
    • Asynchronous behavior
    • Diagnosing flaky tests
    • Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines
    • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills
    • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Preferred Experience

  • Experience building automation infrastructure from scratch
    • Strong understanding of test data management strategies
    • Experience testing B2B SaaS products or multi-tenant systems
    • Familiarity with role-based access and permissions testing
    • Exposure to AI-assisted testing workflows and automation tools
    • Experience working in fast-moving startup or product-led environments

What a Typical Day Looks Like

A QA Automation Engineer’s day revolves around improving automation reliability, expanding test coverage, and supporting engineering velocity. You will:
• Develop and maintain Playwright E2E tests
• Review failed tests and diagnose instability issues
• Improve framework performance and regression reliability
• Collaborate with engineers on feature releases and test coverage
• Maintain CI/CD automation workflows and test environments
• Identify edge cases and improve automation coverage using AI-assisted workflows
• Continuously optimize testing systems for speed, scalability, and reliability

In short: you ensure the product ships quickly, safely, and reliably through scalable automation systems.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Stability and reliability of automation frameworks

• Reduction in flaky or failing tests

  • Increased automated regression coverage
    • Faster and more reliable CI/CD testing cycles
    • Reduced production bugs and release issues
    • Test execution speed and framework performance improvements

Interview Process

• Initial Screening Call (Pavago)

  • Technical Assessment / Automation Review

• Client Technical Interview

  • Final Interview (Culture & Ownership Fit)

• Offer & Onboarding

job.title: Client Intake & Quality Assurance Specialist
job.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly intelligent, detail-oriented, and articulate Client Intake & Quality Assurance Specialist to join our team. This role is suited to someone who is quick-thinking, organised, and an excellent communicator, with the ability to manage both client-facing intake responsibilities and detailed quality assurance tasks.

The ideal candidate will be equally comfortable communicating with clients, gathering information, and handling administrative processes as they are reviewing documentation, identifying discrepancies, and ensuring accuracy across various processes.

We are looking for someone with a great personality, a proactive attitude, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment. There may also be opportunities to assist with other operational responsibilities as business needs evolve

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

1. Quality Assurance & Documentation Review

  • Review records, documentation and completed work to ensure accuracy, completeness and compliance with established requirements.
  • Identify errors, inconsistencies, missing information and areas that require correction.
  • Conduct detailed quality checks and ensure all required information is properly documented.
  • Maintain high standards of accuracy across records, forms and administrative processes.
  • Flag recurring errors or process gaps and communicate findings to the relevant team members.
  • Follow established quality assurance procedures and ensure corrections are completed where necessary.

2. Client Intake & Communication

  • Handle incoming enquiries and communicate professionally with prospective clients or individuals requiring assistance.
  • Guide individuals through the intake process by asking relevant questions and gathering the necessary information.
  • Ensure all information collected is accurate, complete and correctly recorded.
  • Explain processes, answer questions and provide clear guidance throughout the intake process.
  • Follow up on outstanding information or documentation where necessary.
  • Communicate with empathy, confidence and professionalism, ensuring a positive experience.

3. Administrative Coordination & Follow-Up

  • Maintain accurate records and ensure information is updated in the relevant systems.
  • Manage multiple tasks while maintaining attention to detail and meeting deadlines.
  • Identify missing or incomplete information and take the necessary steps to resolve it.
  • Communicate updates, concerns and potential issues to the relevant team members.
  • Adapt between quality assurance, intake and other administrative responsibilities as business needs require.

Essential Requirements

  • Excellent spoken and written English communication skills.
  • Clear, articulate speech with a neutral or light accent that is easily understood by US-based clients.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to identify even minor errors or inconsistencies.
  • Strong comprehension skills and the ability to process information quickly and accurately.
  • Quick-thinking, intelligent and able to learn new processes and systems efficiently.
  • Confident speaking with clients, asking questions and gathering information.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities.
  • Comfortable working with detailed documentation, records and quality assurance processes.
  • Able to work independently, take initiative and follow tasks through to completion.
  • Professional, approachable and confident communication style.

Advantageous Experience

  • Previous experience in quality assurance, auditing or documentation review.
  • Experience in healthcare administration or medical documentation.
  • Previous intake, admissions, patient coordination or client onboarding experience.
  • Customer service or call centre experience involving regular client communication.
  • Experience identifying errors, reviewing records and maintaining quality standards.

Software & Systems

  • Comfortable working with digital platforms, spreadsheets and documentation systems.
  • Able to learn new software and internal systems quickly.
  • Confident using email, online communication tools and data-entry platforms.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is someone who combines exceptional attention to detail with strong interpersonal and communication skills. They enjoy structured, detail-heavy work and take pride in ensuring that information is accurate, complete and properly documented.

At the same time, they are confident and articulate enough to handle client intake conversations, ask the right questions and communicate clearly with individuals from different backgrounds.

We are looking for someone who is sharp, quick to learn, adaptable and able to switch comfortably between detailed quality assurance work and people-facing responsibilities without compromising on either.

job.description:
Role: Penetration Tester

Location: Remote (must be located near London)

About Rhymetec:

Rhymetec is an industry leader in the MSSP cybersecurity space. Our goal is to simplify cybersecurity for our clients so they can become compliant faster and focus more on their business and less on the complexities of building effective and compliant infosec programs.

Description:

The Lead Penetration Tester is an experienced offensive security professional who reports directly to the Director of Offensive Security. In this client-facing role, you will lead and execute penetration testing engagements for MSSP customers, serve as an escalation point for other penetration testers, and help ensure high-quality, defensible deliverables across the team

Responsibilities:

  • Independently execute in-depth web application and API penetration tests, performing manual testing, exploitation, and vulnerability validation beyond automated scanning.
  • Identify, exploit, and document security vulnerabilities with reproducible steps, supporting evidence, defensible severity ratings, and clear, actionable remediation recommendations.
  • Participate in customer kickoff, scoping, status, and debrief calls as needed; explain technical risks and remediation priorities clearly to engineering and security stakeholders.
  • Validate and triage customer bug bounty submissions, confirming reproducibility, exploitability, impact, and the accuracy of reported vulnerabilities.
  • Support PTaaS engagements, including ongoing security assessments, vulnerability validation, retesting, and customer remediation tracking.
  • Contribute to vulnerability research, emerging threat and CVE analysis, custom tools, scripts, testing playbooks, methodologies, and the penetration testing report writing library.

Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 2 years of verifiable, full-time professional penetration testing experience.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience conducting both web application and web API penetration tests.
  • Strong manual testing, vulnerability exploitation, attack-path validation, and technical problem-solving skills beyond the interpretation of automated scanner results.
  • Ability to produce clear, customer-ready penetration testing reports with reproducible evidence, accurate severity ratings, and actionable remediation recommendations.
  • Ability to communicate technical findings and remediation guidance effectively to customer engineering and security teams.
  • Must be based in the United Kingdom and legally authorized to work in the UK. Employment sponsorship is not available for this position.
  • Candidates must hold at least one of the following certifications, or an equivalent certification demonstrating practical, hands-on penetration testing skills:
    • OffSec Web Assessor (OSWA)
    • OffSec Web Expert (OSWE)
    • OffSec Certified Professional (OSCP / OSCP+)
    • OffSec Experienced Penetration Tester (OSEP)
    • Burp Suite Certified Practitioner (BSCP)
    • HTB Certified Web Exploitation Specialist (CWES)
    • HTB Certified Web Exploitation Expert (CWEE)
    • HTB Certified Offensive AI Expert (COAE)
    • HTB Certified Bug Bounty Hunter (CBBH)

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience in one or more of the following areas is strongly preferred; proficiency across all of them is not required:

  • Red teaming or adversary emulation, including attack chaining, post-exploitation, and objective-driven assessments.
  • Mobile application penetration testing (iOS and Android).
  • Internal network penetration testing, including Active Directory environments and lateral-movement techniques.
  • Desktop or thick-client application penetration testing (Windows, macOS, or Linux).
  • Cloud security testing or configuration reviews (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Browser extension penetration testing.
  • GenAI and LLM application security testing, including prompt injection, insecure tool integrations, and application-specific AI vulnerabilities.
  • PTaaS delivery, bug bounty triage, vulnerability disclosure, phishing or vishing, and hands-on offensive tool development.

Must be currently based near London. No sponsorship available for this position.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive, company-funded private medical insurance for employees
  • Dental and Optical benefits
  • Generous annual leave package, plus sick pay and 28 days annual leave including bank holidays
  • Workplace pension
  • Wellbeing Support: An annual subscription to TalkSpace, our online counseling and therapy service

Rhymetec is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunities employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic background, disability, or age.

job.title: Test Architect
job.description:
About Tiger Analytics

Shape the Future of AI. Transform the World's Leading Businesses.

Tiger Analytics is one of the fastest-growing AI services firms, partnering with some of the world's largest and most influential organizations to redefine how business gets done. We help Fortune 500 companies harness the power of Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Data Science, Data Engineering and Advanced Analytics to solve their most complex challenges, unlock new growth opportunities, and create lasting business impact.

We are at the forefront of the AI revolution, helping enterprises move beyond traditional analytics to embrace Generative AI, agentic AI, intelligent automation, and cloud-native data platforms. A global presence across North America, Latin America, Europe, and India

At Tiger Analytics, we don't just help businesses adapt to the future—we help them build it.

Requirements

What you will be doing:

We are seeking a Test Architect to join our advanced analytics and AI team supporting some of our large enterprise clients. In this role, you will

  • We are looking for a hands-on, visionary Test Architect to design and standardize enterprise-
  • wide automated quality engineering frameworks across Databricks data platforms,
  • PySpark/SQL pipelines, and Power BI reporting layers.
  • The ideal candidate will architect scalable, reusable test automation solutions covering end-to-
  • end data ingestion, Medallion Architecture transformations (Bronze, Silver, Gold), source-to-
  • target reconciliation, Power BI semantic models, DAX measures, and report validation.
  • This role requires deep technical mastery in Python, PySpark, complex SQL, Databricks REST
  • APIs, CI/CD integration, and automated BI testing methodologies to establish shift-left quality
  • standards across engineering teams.

What we need

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, design, and build scalable, metadata-driven automated data validation frameworks using Python, PySpark, and SQL on Databricks.
  • Define enterprise test strategies, reference architectures, and quality engineering standards across Bronze, Silver, and Gold Medallion layers.
  • Design automated reconciliation and schema-evolution validation solutions for structure and semi-structured formats (Parquet, JSON, XML, CSV, TSV).
  • Architect automated Power BI testing solutions covering semantic model integrity (relationships, cardinality, star schemas), Row-Level Security (RLS), and report rendering.
  • Establish automated DAX measure and KPI verification patterns that reconcile Power BI datasets directly against Gold-layer Databricks/SQL queries.
  • Integrate automated data and BI test suites into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions) using Databricks REST APIs and workflow orchestration.
  • Conduct architectural reviews of data pipelines and Power BI semantic models to enforce testability, performance, and data observability.
  • Evaluate and introduce modern data quality and BI testing tools, libraries (e.g., Great Expectations, Deequ, Tabular Editor/DAX Studio), and best practices.
  • Provide technical mentorship and code reviews for Test Leads and Data QA Engineers across multiple squads.

Required Technical Skills

  • Extensive experience as a Data Test Architect or Principal QA Automation Architect in cloud data lakehouse and BI environments.
  • Expert-level hands-on proficiency in Python, PySpark, Scala/Spark, and complex SQL for large-scale distributed data validation.
  • Deep expertise in Databricks architecture, Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold), Delta Lake, and Databricks REST APIs/workflows.
  • Advanced expertise in Power BI architecture, including semantic models, tabular data modeling, DAX measure validation, RLS, and Power BI REST APIs/XMLA endpoints.
  • Proven track record designing reusable, configuration-driven data reconciliation and automated regression frameworks from scratch.
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Azure Data Services (ADLS, ADF, Synapse/Databricks) and Hadoop/Hive ecosystems.
  • Hands-on expertise integrating automated QA frameworks into CI/CD pipelines and containerized execution environments.
  • Strong analytical and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) capabilities for complex distributed processing and BI performance bottlenecks.

Why Join Tiger Analytics:

  • Drive High-Impact Business Transformation: Lead strategic engagements that go beyond traditional analytics, delivering enterprise-wide AI adoption, cloud-native data modernization, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Build and Lead at Global Scale: Collaborate with exceptional AI, data, engineering, and consulting talent across geographies to deliver transformative solutions and grow strategic client partnerships.
  • Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, Retirement Accounts, Long and Short Term Disability, Life Insurance, HSA/FSA Accounts (USA) and Discretionary time-off.
  • Continuous Learning & AI Upskilling: Stay ahead of the rapidly evolving AI landscape through continuous learning, hands-on exposure to emerging technologies, and opportunities to build expertise in Generative AI, agentic AI, and next-generation data platforms. Grow alongside a team that invests in developing future-ready skills and encourages innovation.

Benefits

job.title: Aerodynamics Testing Engineer
job.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

As an Aerodynamics Testing Engineer at Harmattan, you will bridge the gap between theoretical simulations and physical reality. You will be responsible for validating the flight physics of our next-generation UAV platforms—ranging from long-endurance fixed-wing aircraft to high-speed eVTOLs.

Your mission is to design, execute, and analyze experimental campaigns that ensure our aircraft are efficient, stable, and safe. You will utilise rapid prototyping techniques to transform aerodynamic concepts into flight-ready prototypes and ground testing mock-ups, closing the loop between CFD predictions and real-world performance.

You will work in close collaboration with the Mechanical (Meca) team to design and manufacture custom testing rigs and instrumented prototypes, ensuring that aerodynamic concepts are translated into robust, testable hardware.

Responsibilities

  • Rapid Airframe Fabrication: Design and manufacture prototypes using foam (CNC, hot wire), 3D printing, laser cutting and/or composites to iterate on aerodynamic shapes.

  • Flight Test Leadership: Lead flight test campaigns for fixed-wing and eVTOL platforms; define test cards and safety protocols to extract aerodynamic data and perform flight log analysis for model validation and system identification.

  • Wind Tunnel & Ground Testing: Design and execute wind tunnel experiments and static thrust tests, including the fabrication of instrumented scale models and the development of automated DAQ rigs to characterize propulsion efficiency and airframe performance.

  • Data Validation & ADB: Correlate simulation data with experimental results to improve model accuracy. Generate comprehensive Aerodynamic Databases (ADB) to characterize vehicle performance across the full flight envelope.

  • Instrumentation & DAQ: Select and integrate sensors (Pitot-static systems, alpha/beta vanes, load cells) into prototypes. Develop software to control automated test rigs and synchronize high-speed Data Acquisition (DAQ) systems.

  • Flight Log Analysis: Perform deep-dive analysis of flight logs to extract performance metrics, power consumption profiles, and stability derivatives.

Requirements

  • Education: B.S. or M.S. in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field with a focus on experimental fluid dynamics or flight testing.

  • Prototyping & Manufacturing: Hands-on experience with CNC hot-wire foam cutting, 3D printing, CNC routing and/or composites. Ability to design for rapid fabrication.

  • Experimental Rigor: Extensive background in planning and executing aerodynamic experiments. You know how to isolate variables and ensure data quality in noisy, real-world environments.

  • Software Proficiency: the ideal candidate must have hands-on experience with the following stack, or similar alternatives:

    • Data Science: Expert in Python (NumPy, SciPy, Pandas) for processing large-scale experimental datasets and automated report generation.

    • Visualization: Proficiency with Matplotlib, Plotly, or Seaborn for aerodynamic data visualization.

    • DAQ & Automation: Experience with LabVIEW, MATLAB/Simulink, or Python-based hardware interfacing (e.g., PyVISA, nidaqmx, pyserial).

    • CAD: Advanced proficiency in SolidWorks or CATIA for the design of complex test benches and wind tunnel fixtures.

Nice-to-Have

  • Pilot Experience: Radio Control (RC) flight experience.

  • ML & Surrogate Modeling: Knowledge of Machine Learning or Reduced Order Models (ROMs) for the creation of Aerodynamic Databases

  • System Identification: Experience with Aerodynamic system identificaton techniques to validate aircraft performance models using flight data.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

job.title: Senior Automation QA Engineer (Python / Cloud Infrastructure)
job.description:
Acronis is a global leader in cyber protection, delivering AI-powered protection for productive MSPs in a single, natively integrated platform that unifies operations management, cybersecurity, and data protection. Driven by our mission to protect, manage and automate every workload that businesses and lives depend on, we’ve built the industry’s only all-in-one solution.

We are looking for an experienced Automation Engineer responsible for developing and maintaining automated testing solutions for complex software platforms and infrastructure environments.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Design, implement and maintain automated tests for the platform: REST API, service, cluster-level and end-to-end scenarios across compute, storage, networking, guest tools and the management backend.
  • Build out and evolve the test automation framework and adapt it to the Acronis engineering environment, making tests reliable, fast to triage, and diagnosable when they fail.
  • Automate deployment and configuration of test clusters — ISO installations, multi-node hyperconverged setups, bare-metal and virtual labs — so environments are reproducible and disposable.
  • Cover the scenarios that decide whether an infrastructure release is shippable: installation, cluster expansion, rolling updates and upgrade paths, node and disk failures, recovery and high availability, backup and disaster recovery flows.
  • Build and own the automated smoke, regression, performance and long-haul suites, and wire them into CI/CD so that every build and every release candidate is validated automatically.
  • Analyze test results, logs and traces, triage failures down to a component, file precise defect reports, and drive them with developers to closure.
  • Convert existing test cases into automated tests and ensure automated test coverage remains aligned with requirements and specifications.
  • Measure and track performance and scalability with workload generators and benchmarks, and catch regressions before customers do.
  • Participate in requirement and design reviews, raise testability problems early, and contribute to the specifications the team develops and tests against.
  • Maintain and improve test environments, lab inventory and test data, including the hardware-dependent parts of the matrix.
  • Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools for writing and refactoring tests, log and trace analysis, failure triage and technical research.
  • Work closely with the compute, storage, kernel, guest tools and management teams and with support on reproducing customer issues.
  • Maintain clear communication with the QA lead on coverage, progress, risks and release readiness.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years of experience developing test automation in Python — frameworks and libraries, not only scripts — with solid object-oriented programming skills.
  • Strong Linux skills: command line, services, logs, networking basics, and the ability to deploy and troubleshoot a cluster yourself.
  • Solid experience testing REST APIs and web services, including HTTP, authentication and authorization, and API contract testing.
  • Experience testing distributed systems, clusters or infrastructure software (virtualization, storage, cloud platforms, operating systems) is a strong advantage.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD systems (Jenkins preferred), Docker and Git.
  • Strong QA theory: test design techniques, coverage analysis, risk-based prioritization, and a habit of thinking about what breaks under failure rather than only the happy path.
  • Experience with hardware or bare-metal labs (PXE, IPMI/BMC, disk and network topologies) is an advantage.
  • Experience with performance and load testing tools (fio, iperf and similar) or with OpenStack Tempest is an advantage.
  • AI-assisted engineering experience is mandatory, including practical use of AI for test development, debugging, log analysis and investigation.
  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership of a test area, work with an inherited product and incomplete documentation, and share expertise across teams.
  • Excellent English communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

*Please submit your resume and application in English


WHO WE ARE

A Swiss company founded in Singapore in 2003, Acronis offers over twenty years of innovation with 15 offices worldwide and employees in 50+ countries. Acronis Cyber Protect is available in 26 languages in 150 countries and is used by over 21,000 service providers to protect more than 750,000 businesses.


Our corporate culture centers on innovation, accountability, and impact. We encourage our people to think boldly, challenge conventional approaches, and take ownership of outcomes. As a member of our global “A-Team,” you’ll operate in a high-growth, fast-paced environment where resilience, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous improvement drive success.


OUR INTERVIEW PRACTICES

To ensure a fair and genuine hiring process, candidates are expected to participate in interviews without the use of AI tools, automated prompts, or third-party assistance. Interviews are designed to assess individual skills, experience, and communication style, and we value authentic, real-time interaction.


Use of AI or external assistance during live interviews may result in disqualification. For roles where AI skills are being evaluated, permitted use of AI tools will be clearly communicated in advance. Candidates may be asked to disable virtual backgrounds or participate in in-person interviews. All employment offers are contingent upon successful completion of applicable criminal, education and identity background checks


Acronis is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, medical condition, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

job.title: Test Engineer
job.description:
Lyntris is a defense technology company that connects sensing to action across the connected battlespace. Lyntris brings together the talents of Accelint and Vitesse teams under one mission, with each contributing deep expertise within their domain. Combining differentiated hardware, software and mission expertise, Lyntris helps customers sense threats, make sense of complex conditions and act with greater speed, precision and confidence in contested environments.

Lyntris supports U.S. and allied defense organizations across every branch — including Navy, Army, Air Force, Space Force and allied partners — spanning strategic, operational and tactical missions and every domain: Space, Air, Land, Sea and Cyber. With more than 200 active defense programs, Lyntris works at every level of the mission, from national command authority to the tactical edge.

Solutions are designed by operators who understand the mission, engineered for the conditions that degrade or defeat standard systems, and built on an open, modular architecture that integrates into existing programs without requiring them to start over. Lyntris moves faster than the traditional defense cycle — with integrated design, build and test capabilities in-house — and delivers systems that sustain and endure long after initial fielding.

Job Description

  • Test Engineer
  • Full Time
  • Remote

The Test Engineer plays a critical role in software validation by designing, executing, and assisting with the maintenance of test cases to ensure the system meets defined requirements, perform as intended, and is free of defects prior to deployments. This position is responsible for software verification and validation (V&V) activities, ensuring that enterprise systems meet functional performance, and compliance requirements – particularly for U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) programs. The Test Engineer will support formal and informal testing while ensuring the collection of Objective Quality Evidence (OQE) to support system certification and accreditation. The ideal candidate brings at least 2 years of relevant experience in software testing, validation and test automation within complex IT enterprise systems such as Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), or similar platforms in regulated settings – and possesses hands-on experience developing and maintaining automated test scripts.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and execute test cases to validate system functionality, data integrity, and end-to-end business processes.
  • Maintain and refine automated test scripts using approved automation tools (e.g., Eggplant, Selenium, Katalon, or equivalent automated testing tools).
  • Support end-to-end validation efforts across integrated systems, including PLM, ERP, and interface/data exchange processes.
  • Support in the coordination and completion of internal testing activities (e.g., smoke, system, functional and regression testing) to ensure timely development completion and quality devlivery of software.
  • Ensure all testing activities produce appropriate OQE artifacts in support of DoD compliance requirements.
  • Identify, document, and track defects, working closely with development and functional teams to support resolution and retesting.
  • Analyze test results and provide clear, concise status updates and report to the Test Lead.
  • Ensure traceability between requirements, test cases, and defects to align with DoD validation requirements.
  • Assist in building and expanding the regression test suite to support ongoing releases and system changes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., QA, IT, business users) to ensure alignment of testing scope, data, and expected outcomes.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing processes, tools, and methodologies to increase efficiency and quality.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field required; advanced degree, relevant internship experience, or equivalent hands-on industry experience may be considered in lieu of traditional qualifications.
  • 2+ years of experience with test automation frameworks, scripting languages, and tools (e.g., Selenium, Katalon, Eggplant, Python, XML, JSON).
  • Experience with PLM platforms (e.g., Windchill, Teamcenter, Enovia) or other enterprise systems.
  • Strong working knowledge of test planning, execution, and documentation aligned with DoD standards.
  • Experience producing OQE artifacts to support system certification/accreditation or acceptance reviews.
  • Proficient with tools such as Microsoft Office, Jira, Confluence, and SharePoint.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interface effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Currently holds an active U.S. national security clearance or be able to receive and maintain one.

Preferred Qualifications (Not Required)

  • Familiarity with DoD or federal system development lifecycle (SDLC) processes and compliance requirements.
  • Knowledge of DoD software documentation standards, including SDD, IDD, SDP, ICD, and CDRL requirements.
  • Understanding of RMF, ATO, and Cybersecurity Testing/Validation (e.g., STIG compliance).
  • Exposure to Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) and Model-Based Testing (MBT) practices.
  • Experience in Agile or hybrid Agile/Waterfall environments, and use of tools like Zephyr, TestRail, or qTest.
  • Security+ or other DoD 8570-compliant certification preferred.

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.
  • This position may require the ability to travel up to 5%.

Clearance Requirements

Some positions will require access to U.S. National Security information. Positions that require this access will be required to receive and maintain a U.S. government personnel security clearance (PCL). In order to qualify for this position, the candidate must be a US Citizen and either currently possess this National Security eligibility or be able to complete the investigation application process with a favorable determination and maintain that eligibility throughout their employment.

Pay Scales & Benefits

The listed pay scale reflects the broad, minimum to maximum, pay scale for this position for the location for which it has been posted and is not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Other compensation considerations may include, but are not limited to, job responsibilities, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, or other applicable factors.

Paid Time Off

Paid Company Holidays

Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance

Optional HSA and FSA

Base and Voluntary Life Insurance

Short Term & Long-Term Disability Insurance

401k Matching

Employee Assistance Program

job.title: Payment Integrations & Technical QA Manager
job.description:
We are an international broker. Our clients fund and withdraw through roughly 60 payment methods across Asia, Africa, LATAM and the Middle East.

Payments Product is a standalone function, and we are building the team around it. This is an early core hire.

We are looking for a Payment Integration Manager who will own payment integrations end to end: from the technical call with a provider through to stable production. You will also be the first line on every payment incident, and the person who decides whether a new integration is ready to go live.

This is a technical operations role rather than a coordination one.

Your responsibilities will be:

Running the full onboarding cycle for new payment providers: first technical call, credentials and sandbox access, configuration, test design, UAT, production launch and post-release stabilisation

Owning first-line response for payment incidents, including failed and stuck transactions, unconfirmed payments and method-level anomalies, and driving them to resolution rather than passing them on

Defining the acceptance standard for new integrations and holding the go or no-go decision before launch

Reading provider API documentation and turning it into implementation-ready specifications for engineering, including edge cases, failure paths and confirmation model behaviour

Running hands-on verification: manual checkout testing on mobile and desktop, callback verification through Postman, and SQL queries against transaction data

Maintaining the catalogue of payment methods and providers: what each supports, which integration types are available, what has been tested and where known failure modes sit

Building the first capability inventory of all live methods and providers

Later, producing a 90-day breakdown of deposit attempts by outcome: completed, declined by the provider, abandoned by the user, abandoned at redirect, and completed but never confirmed back to us

Requirements

What you'll need:

4+ years in payments, PSP integrations or fintech platforms, with hands-on ownership of integrations rather than tracking them, basic knowledge using AI tooling in daily work

Working knowledge of APIs, webhooks and asynchronous payment status, plus an understanding of confirmation models, callback mechanics, redirect flows and common failure modes

The ability to read a provider API specification and identify what is missing from it

Postman or equivalent for API testing, and structured checkout testing across mobile and desktop

Experience diagnosing a live payment incident from logs and API responses, separating provider-side causes from platform-side causes, and explaining the finding to both a provider contact and an engineer

The ability to turn ambiguous provider documentation and undocumented knowledge into specifications and catalogues that engineering can act on

Composure during incidents, and clear communication with the team and stakeholders

English and Russian at working level. Both are in daily use

Will be a significant plus:

Experience with APM and local rails in Asia, Africa or LATAM rather than cards alone

Experience with bank transfer rails, virtual accounts, QR-based methods, mobile money etc.

Background in brokerage, crypto payments, orchestration or another high-volume payments environment; on the provider side, at a PSP, gateway or payment company

Active use of AI tooling in daily work

Ability to work independently and make decisions without constant oversight

Proactive mindset: willingness to propose improvements, fixes, new approaches

What the first year looks like:

In the first months you take over incident first line, build the method and provider catalogue from documentation, existing knowledge and direct querying, and produce the deposit attempt analysis.

By mid-year you have defined the integration acceptance standard and applied it to a live provider onboarding from start to production.

In the second half the catalogue is current, the gate is running, and incidents reach you for decisions rather than for explanations. As the team grows, a Systems Analyst takes over formal verification while the acceptance gate stays with you.

Recruitment process:

HR interview, covering background, motivation and fit

Technical interview on payment integration knowledge, tooling and hands-on experience, including incident diagnosis

Product and problem-solving interview, covering integration decisions and prioritisation

Final interview with senior stakeholders

Benefits

We offer:

Fixed monthly compensation of [depending on experience]

Fully remote work within GMT to GMT+4, with no relocation required

End-to-end ownership of a provider from first call to production, and the go or no-go decision on every integration

Scope that grows with the business: cards, alternative payment methods, a card programme and new entities

Corporate AI tooling as part of the working process

job.title: Systems Engineering Test Lead - Clearance Required
job.description:
Overview

LMI is seeking a Test Team Lead who will serve as the technical authority for test planning, execution, system integration, and verification supporting the F-35 Logistics Information Technology (LogIT) solution. Reporting to program leadership, the Test Team Lead will be responsible for architecting, executing, and governing all test and evaluation (T&E) activities to ensure delivery of a robust, mission-capable system. This includes driving disciplined verification processes across Systems Integration, User Acceptance, and System-of-Systems testing, with accountability for meeting Limited Deployment objectives in addition to subsequent capability releases. The successful candidate will demonstrate deep systems engineering expertise, leadership in test strategy, and a track record of Agile test execution within complex defense environments.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain an enterprise test strategy encompassing the full system lifecycle, including requirements traceability matrix (RTM), test coverage analysis, and test architecture artifacts.
  • Ensure alignment between system testing plans and enterprise-level program milestones.
  • Govern all Agile quality gates, defining clear entry/exit criteria and defect severity standards for all test phases.
  • Validate test artifacts—including test cases, scripts, and procedures—against DoDAF architectural views (OV-1, SV-1, OV-5b), performing test readiness reviews that demonstrate linkage between technical requirements and architecture products.
  • Ensure comprehensive test coverage of integration points across legacy and modernized systems, assessing impacts to interoperability and data fidelity.
  • Lead the formal execution of full-spectrum testing, including systems integration, user acceptance, and system-of-systems verification for F-35 LogIT.
  • Develop methodologies and coordinate resources for planning, scheduling, and executing integration tests across multiple platforms, environments (e.g., IL2/4/5/6), and stakeholders.
  • Plan and conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT), collaborating with end-users to validate mission requirements and operational suitability.
  • Establish and maintain an automated regression testing framework, supporting continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) practices.
  • Monitor and manage technical risk throughout the testing lifecycle, including proactive identification and mitigation of risks related to performance, security, and system interoperability.
  • Track issues and defects, providing regular reporting to leadership on status, trends, and corrective actions.
  • Lead recurring test readiness reviews, test execution meetings, and defect triage with internal teams, program management offices, prime contractors, and external certification agencies.
  • Facilitate joint reviews with external DOD/OSW agencies in preparation for formal acceptance and interoperability certification.
  • Maintain robust documentation of test results, findings, and verification evidence to support audits, certifications, and accreditation.
  • Collaborate with product owners, scrum teams, and program leadership to integrate T&E activities into sprint and Program Increment (PI) planning.
  • Provide architectural and technical guidance to ensure the test effort supports evolving program priorities, contract deliverables, and incremental capability releases.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in systems engineering, computer science, software engineering, information systems, or a related technical field.
  • 10 or more years of relevant experience in systems engineering, software quality engineering, or test and evaluation leadership supporting defense, federal, or large-scale enterprise software systems.
  • Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary engineering and test teams in U.S. military services (e.g., USAF, USN) or multi-agency (Joint/OSW) Enterprise environments.
  • Proven track record architecting, planning, and governing complex system integration and verification activities, including alignment to technical reviews and compliance milestones.
  • Deep understanding of systems engineering practices, including DoDAF architectural views, interface control verification, requirements traceability, and system-of-systems integration.
  • Proficient in software development and Agile methodologies, including practical experience with Agile delivery frameworks (SAFe, Scrum), test automation, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with automated test management tools, defect tracking systems (e.g., Jira), and cloud-native architectures operating across multiple security enclaves.
  • Active SECRET security clearance or ability to obtain and maintain one.
  • Preferred: DAWIA Practitioner or Advanced credentials in Test & Evaluation or Systems Engineering, INCOSE CSEP, and/or certifications in Agile methods (e.g., SAFe Agilist, Scrum Master).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with formal acceptance testing and joint interoperability certification processes involving external DOD or OSW agencies, including interfacing with the Joint Interoperability Test Command (JITC).
  • Familiarity with DoD logistics data structures, Defense Logistics Management Standards (DLMS) transactions, and Defense Automatic Addressing System (DAAS) routing.
  • Experience integrating test artifacts and workflows with cross-domain DoD environments (e.g., NIPR/SIPR, Cross Domain Solutions) and understanding of associated security overlays.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise analytics and test reporting within environments such as Advana, Jupiter, or comparable mission analytics platforms.
  • Experience supporting aviation sustainment, weapon system logistics, or similar defense modernization programs.

The target salary range for this position is $101,144 - $174,591.

job.title: HIL Test Automation Engineer
job.description:
At Terabase Energy, we believe that digitalization and automation will drive the next wave of innovation and cost reduction in large scale solar. To fully unlock the potential of this opportunity, Terabase is developing an interconnected software and construction automation platform. We work alongside project developers, owners, and engineering & construction firms to support the design, optimization, and construction of huge solar projects around the world. Our team is a blend of solar-industry veterans and newbies, thought-leaders, dreamers, software, electrical and mechanical engineers, coders, product managers, project managers, and sales and marketing professionals. We are based in Northern California, with several other offices in the United States and around the world.

Job description

Test Automation Engineer is responsible to develop, and execute automated test frameworks for environments like SIL(Software-in-the-loop) and HIL(Hardware-in-the-loop), that allow us to test our power plant controller and SCADA system. Your mission is to build the automated frameworks that catch edge cases before they hit the field, ensuring every product we ship meets the highest standards of reliability.

Responsibilities

  • Automation Framework Development: Design, build, and maintain scalable automated test frameworks and scripts for power, control and SCADA systems using Python. You will transition our validation processes from manual intervention to a fully automated, scalable framework.
  • V&V Strategy: Define and execute comprehensive Verification and Validation (V&V) plans, ensuring all software requirements for the site controller and SCADA systems are met under normal and fault conditions
  • CI/CD Integration: Integrate automated HIL/SIL testing into our CI/CD pipelines, providing real-time feedback to the development teams and serving as the final gate for production-ready code
  • Requirements Investigation: Analyze and interpret technical specifications to author comprehensive automated test suites, actively tracking down gaps in system requirements.
  • Multi-Environment Execution: Execute automated test suites across SIL, MIL, and HIL setups.Analyze test captures, isolate system failures, and generate detailed engineering reports.
  • Root Cause Analysis: Work closely with the controls and systems teams to debug complex failures found during validation, using logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and telemetry logs to pinpoint issues

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Experience: 2+ years of professional experience in software validation or test automation for hardware-focused systems.
  • Programming Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in Python and Bash scripting, alongside a practical reading knowledge of PLC/RTAC/IEC 61131-3 Control logic.
  • Automation Toolchains: Direct experience architecting or heavily extending modern pythonic test frameworks (such as Pytest or OpenHTF).
  • Systematic Thinking: A dedicated mindset for "breaking" software. You have a track record of finding critical edge cases in complex state machines and control loops
  • Infrastructure: Experience with Git, Jenkins/GitHub Actions, and containerization tools like Docker for managing consistent test environments

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of NERC, FERC, ISO/RTO, and utility interconnection requirements is preferred.
  • Experience with utility-scale solar PV, Battery ---Energy Storage Systems (BESS), hybrid renewable energy plants, or inverter-based resources (IBR) is preferred.
  • Version Control: Advance user-level with Git and modern branch management strategies.

Communication protocols (e.g., IEC 61850, Modbus, DNP3)

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. This role offers a base salary of $80,000 – $100,000. Within each posted range, individual pay is determined (and may be greater or higher), dependent on work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. job.title: Senior Automation QA (JS) Engineer
job.description:
Ciklum is looking for a Senior Automation QA (JS) Engineer to join our team full-time in India.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Senior Automation QA (JS) Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain automated test suites for the platform, Frontend and Backend, including contract tests that protect the agent-developer experience as the SDK evolves
  • Build automated tests for long-running Temporal workflows including failure injection (worker kill, provider outage, retry storms) to verify durable-execution guarantees such as zero lost runs and correct compensation/saga behavior
  • Automate multi-tenant isolation verification cross-tenant data access, configuration bleed, and cost-attribution correctness executed per release as a platform acceptance criterion
  • Verify agent execution sandboxing and egress controls through negative testing of disallowed tool calls and network destinations
  • Design test strategies for LLM-driven behavior: statistical assertions over repeated runs (pass^k consistency), semantic-similarity scoring, confidence-threshold validation, and flakiness quarantine that distinguishes model variance from genuine regression
  • Build and continuously extend adversarial test corpora document-borne prompt injection in lease PDFs, tool-call hijack, and data-exfiltration probes aligned to OWASP LLM Top 10 and recognized red-team taxonomies
  • Verify Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) escalation behavior confidence thresholds fire correctly and no gated/irreversible action completes without authorization
  • Partner with the evaluation function on golden-dataset-driven checks, contributing test infrastructure, synthetic-data (synthetic lease) pipelines, and CI integration that make agent quality measurable and repeatable
  • Automate verification of platform NFRs invocation overhead (p95), concurrency targets, queue backpressure behavior, and LLM provider failover time and surface trends per release
  • Use tracing data (Langfuse / OpenTelemetry spans) as a first-class test asset: assert on trace completeness, token/cost-accounting accuracy, and alerting behavior for anomalous runs
  • Wire test suites into CI/CD as hard release gates with automated, per-metric regression flagging on pull requests
  • Produce auditable, reproducible test-evidence packs that feed directly into client milestone sign-off
  • Embed with AI and platform engineers from the design stage making acceptance criteria, testability, and observability inputs to architecture, not afterthoughts
  • Maintain test environments, mocked LLM/provider layers, and synthetic data generators that keep test runs fast, deterministic where possible, and affordable
  • Mentor mid-level QA engineers, codify AI testing patterns into reusable internal frameworks, and contribute to Ciklum's quality engineering practice and AI Academy

Requirements:

  • 8+ years of test automation with API testing, and building test frameworks other engineers adopt, not just test cases
  • Hands-on experience testing LLM-powered or other non-deterministic systems statistical assertions, semantic scoring, and managing model variance (this is the differentiator; cite real examples)
  • Experience testing asynchronous, event-driven systems failure injection, idempotency verification, eventual-consistency assertions; Temporal or a similar workflow engine a strong plus
  • Strong CI/CD integration skills (GitHub Actions or equivalent) and the discipline to design release gates
  • Solid SQL and data-validation skills; comfort building synthetic test-data pipelines and measuring dataset quality
  • A security-testing and adversarial mindset; familiarity with prompt-injection techniques or a strong AppSec testing background with willingness to specialize fast
  • Demonstrated judgment on what "tested enough" means under milestone pressure, and the ability to defend quality evidence to non-engineering stakeholders
  • Strong proficiency in Playwright and TypeScript is mandatory for building automated test suites
  • QA Automation Core: Extensive experience in building automated test frameworks (Playwright/Typescript-based) and integrating them into high-security CI/CD pipelines
  • AI/LLM Literacy: Deep understanding of Large Language Model behaviors, prompt sensitivity, and the common failure modes of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems
  • Analytical Mindset: Strong capability in statistical analysis to interpret evaluation scores and provide actionable feedback to AI Engineers for prompt tuning

Desirable:

  • Performance/load tooling (k6, Locust) for concurrency and latency NFR verification
  • Prior testing of multi-tenant SaaS isolation
  • Exposure to eval/observability stacks (Langfuse, LangSmith, Promptfoo, DeepEval, Arize Phoenix)
  • Compliance evidence experience (SOC 2, GDPR) or accessibility testing (Section 508 / WCAG)
  • Familiarity with Commercial Real Estate workflows (lease accounting, CAM reconciliation) or document-extraction systems (OCR, layout parsing)
  • Experience using LLMs to generate test cases, adversarial payloads, or synthetic documents
  • Performance Testing: Experience testing high-concurrency background processing within agentic systems
  • Experience with qTest for test management

What’s in it for you?

  • Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
  • Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
  • Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
  • Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
  • Care: We’ve got you covered with company-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial & legal consultations

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

job.title: Automation Test Engineer (f/m/d)
job.description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution.

 

Role Overview

Black Net is our internal digital platform and the operational backbone of the company, supporting everything from time tracking and absence requests to procurement and project reimbursements. As the platform and company grow, quality is essential. We are looking for an Automation Test Engineer to join the Black Net team as our first dedicated QA professional, working alongside two developers and a Product Owner to build, own, and continuously improve our testing framework and quality standards from the ground up. You will establish the right processes and tools, drive test automation, and ensure that we can accelerate development, including AI-assisted development, without compromising the reliability of existing functionality.

 

Qualifications & Experience

  • Proven experience in software testing and test automation, ideally with experience building or significantly improving QA processes and testing frameworks from the ground up.

  • Proficiency with at least one end-to-end testing framework, with Playwright or Cypress strongly preferred, as well as experience with API testing using Postman/Newman, VI Test, or equivalent tools.

  • Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript and experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar.

  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently establish testing standards, build scalable automation, and continuously improve QA processes in a fast-moving development environment.

  • Curiosity and adaptability to new technologies, with a strong interest in AI-assisted development, automated testing, and validating AI-generated code.

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Angular-specific testing tools, such as VI Test or Angular Testing Library, and familiarity with MongoDB or other NoSQL data stores.

  • Experience testing applications with complex data flows or external integrations, such as ERP systems, HR tools, or other enterprise applications.

  • Experience with performance or load testing tools, such as k6 or Artillery.

  • Background in testing internal enterprise tools or business process applications.

  • Familiarity with test management tools such as TestRail, Xray, or similar.

 

Our work culture

· People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key — we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

· Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

· Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

· We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

· We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry
