job.description:
Who We Are

Imprint is on a mission to make every customer a regular.

You know how it feels when you walk into your favorite coffee shop and they know your name and start prepping your usual? Imprint makes it possible for the largest brands to create that experience at scale.

We bring payments, loyalty, and customer intelligence together in one platform, so brands can recognize and reward customers as individuals and keep them coming back. With the power of our technology and data, brands create financial products that their customers’ use everyday, earning more of their spend and increasing loyalty. Customers are rewarded with money and time saved, and surprised and delighted with a more unique, tailored experience.

We first proved our business in co-brand credit cards. For decades, the same few banks dominated the industry, building brands’ programs on mainframes older than the internet. We took a different approach, rebuilding the technology from the ground up. Today, Imprint has more than two million members, with partners like Shell, Kroger, H-E-B, and representing half a trillion dollars in total US consumer spend. Now, we’re growing our partnerships, bringing on more members, and expanding beyond credit cards so that brands offer more ways to pay and be rewarded to recognize their customers as individuals no matter their income or preferences.

Better yet, we’re doing it differently with a lean team of the most talented people on earth. Historically, companies scaled by adding people. Imprint is taking on our opportunity with a small team of exceptional people, with the best AI and technology dramatically amplifying what each person can accomplish. That means you’ll learn faster here than you could anywhere else. You’ll be one of the few people building an entirely new technology with the ownership and trust to shape what Imprint becomes. You’ll work alongside people who make you sharper everyday, armed with tools that turn your best ideas into reality faster than you thought possible. This is a rare chance to do the most important work of your career and to help prove that a small team can build what’s never been done before, inside industries that haven’t changed in decades.

Role Summary

As Email Developer & QA Specialist, you will own the development, quality, and delivery of email campaigns at Imprint inside Braze. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with full accountability for both building and quality-assuring every send — you find issues, and you fix them.

You will serve as the primary owner of Imprint's email QA function: building automated QA pipelines, managing content catalogs and content blocks, and ensuring every email that goes out meets an exceptionally high bar. The team operates at high volume and high visibility, and this role is the last line of defense before every send.

Email development is also a core responsibility: In addition to owning and improving QA, this person will serve as the email developer when development needs arise.

This role requires deep Braze expertise, proficiency in Liquid, and a proven track record of building machine-assisted QA workflows — not just an interest in doing so.

  • By Day 90: Design and ship an automated QA pipeline that reduces manual review burden across the team and prevents errors from reaching production

  • Establish yourself as the single, trusted owner of QA

  • Demonstrate responsiveness, ownership, and reliability across tight-turnaround sends and time-sensitive incidents

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end email development in Braze, including content catalog management, content block creation, and campaign execution

  • Build and maintain an automated QA pipeline that enables machine-assisted error detection at the scale and complexity Imprint requires

  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners in Figma and Braze to execute on campaign briefs from development through deployment

  • Maintain and improve internal documentation, and operational workflows

  • Deep proficiency in Braze, including content catalogs, content blocks, and campaign architecture

  • Strong command of Liquid templating language — non-negotiable

  • Proven track record of building automated QA workflows for email, not just aspirational interest in doing so

  • Availability and responsiveness consistent with a team that operates across early and late touchpoints with tight send timelines

job.title: QA Engineer
job.description:
About Foundation Health

Foundation Health is an AI operating system for pharmacy - built by a team who lived the problem firsthand, not one that came to healthcare from the outside. Every day, prior authorizations delay prescriptions, pharmacists lose hours to paperwork instead of patients, and prescriptions slip through the cracks between health systems. We believe thoughtfully applied AI can finally change that - deep, integrated infrastructure that streamlines how care is coordinated, purpose-built for the complexity of specialty pharmacy.

We're building toward a world where pharmacy teams spend their time on patients, not paperwork - where AI handles the routine so clinicians can focus on what only humans can do. Getting there takes the right people. We're looking for curious, ambitious folks who want to help solve healthcare's hardest problems - for our patients, our partners, and each other.

The Role

You'd be one of the first QA hires in the UK, working alongside our UK QA Lead to build how we do quality here: frameworks, standards and process, with no legacy test debt to dig out of. Everybody here is hands-on, and that's what this role is: in the detail, every day.

Before anything we build reaches a pharmacist's queue in the US, someone has to decide it's ready. That's you. If you take pride in what ships, and you'll say "this isn't ready" even when everyone wants it out the door, you'll fit right in.

We've built an AI operating system for pharmacies, tackling the operational infrastructure behind things like paperwork and care coordination. It's in production with enterprise health systems across the US, and we're working directly with one of the biggest names in pharmacy.

What you'll actually do

  • Help shape our UK QA practice with the QA Lead: frameworks, standards and how we work day to day

  • Write automated tests in Playwright and test our APIs with Postman, across a serverless stack of Node.js, TypeScript, SvelteKit and GCP

  • Test AI-powered features in production, including agentic workflows and LLM outputs, and help build the evals that tell us whether they're behaving

  • Do proper manual testing, regression and UAT when a release needs it, and know when that beats automation

  • Work closely with engineers to catch issues early, so moving fast never comes at the cost of the product

Who you are

  • You've got the experience. You have 3+ years in QA or software testing, with solid work on web apps and APIs.

  • You're strong with Playwright. You also have a good instinct for when to automate and when to test by hand.

  • You know what's at stake. You've worked on enterprise products, so you understand what happens when something breaks.

  • You actually use AI. It's already part of how you work, or you've tested AI-powered products and know why it's a different problem.

  • You care about the outcome. Quality matters to you as a result, not as a process to tick off.

The setup

Hybrid, Manchester city centre, 1-2 days a week in the office. When you're working out what "correct" even means for an AI system, a whiteboard and the right three people in a room beat a Slack thread every time.

Not local? We offer relocation support for the right person.

We're Series A, there's early equity, and the work genuinely changes how people get their medication.

Our client PartnerLifebitis an open-source pioneer and their driving mission is to revolutionise bioinformatics and biomedical data analysis forever.

Their product is the world’s first federated genomics platform for unified, secure research over distributed big data. No one has anything close. Work together with Lifebit engineers, product owners and customer service, to identify risks, understand how new features should be tested, and then engage them in contributing automated and manual tests

based UI framework

Strong problem solving skills with a creative approach
Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced environment, learn rapidly and master diverse QA and testing techniques

25 days of annual leave plus the usual public holidays

job.title: Product Testing Lead
job.description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

We pair journalism with original research: every “best of” list we publish sits on a dataset our own team has collected, scored and can defend line by line.

The Data Research and Product Testing teams own that evidence base. We decide what gets measured, how it gets weighted, and whether a claim survives scrutiny. It is the difference between an opinion piece and a recommendation a reader can act on.

About the Role

You will stand up and run Forbes Advisor's product testing function in the US: two testers reporting to you and a protocol library that is currently being developed across teams. The function tests Health categories hands-on, commissions third-party lab work where a claim cannot be settled by testing alone, runs selective Finserv product testing, and also covers a wide set of SMB and related digital products and services. Its output feeds directly into the Data Research scoring models.

What you'll own as the lead

  • Develop and manage the protocol library: what gets tested, how, to what tolerance, and what invalidates a run. Version-control it and make it reproducible by someone who was not there.
  • Line manage the two Product Testers: objectives, feedback, growth, workload and performance.
  • Own the supplier relationships, including the recommendation on what we buy outright and what we are willing to accept from a manufacturer.
  • Own the third-party lab relationships: select the labs, scope the assay panels, agree turnaround and hold them to it. This is how we get the evidence we cannot generate ourselves.
  • Interpret complex lab data and interrogate it rather than file it. Ask the awkward questions, push back when a result looks thin, and satisfy yourself that the lab has understood what we actually need rather than only what we literally asked for.
  • Own the chain-of-custody and blind-submission policy, so that a lab result still stands up when a manufacturer disputes it.
  • Operate the editorial independence policy in practice. You are the person who says no when a supplied unit comes with conditions attached.
  • Own the testing calendar against the editorial roadmap, and be honest about throughput rather than promising everything.
  • Partner with the Senior Data Research Analysts so that test scores enter the scoring models correctly, including how to resolve a hands-on result that contradicts the published specification.

The hands-on work you'll still do

  • Run hands-on tests to a written protocol and record the results in a structured, comparable form.
  • Help design those protocols: decide what to measure, how to measure it repeatably, and what would make a result invalid.
  • Run selective Finserv product testing yourself, on budgeting apps and similar, where living with the product tells you considerably more than the feature list does.
  • Own the sample pipeline for your categories: sourcing, receipt, logging, retention, return and disposal.
  • Document testing as you go, so the editorial team can show readers the work rather than assert it.
  • Feed test scores into the Data Research scoring models, and flag loudly when a hands-on result contradicts what the spec sheet claims.
  • Re-test on a defined cadence so published verdicts do not quietly go stale as products and plans change.
  • Write findings up clearly enough for an editor to build an article on, and stand behind them as the person who ran the test. Telling a story in a way the Edit team can use the information is vital.
  • Bring a journalistic eye to what the results are actually saying. The strongest findings are usually the uncomfortable ones: that a category is largely nonsense, that the premium option is no better than something half the price, that readers are being sold a problem they do not have. Spot those angles and take them to editorial rather than waiting to be asked.
  • Keep the testing log auditable: who tested what, when, on which version or plan tier, under what conditions.

What the function covers

  • Some examples rather than the full list. The set is considerably wider than this, and it moves.
  • Health, hands-on: medical alert systems and hearing aids.
  • Health, by third-party lab: supplement assays for label-claim potency, contaminants and banned substances, plus accuracy validation against reference instruments where we cannot measure it ourselves.
  • Finserv, selectively: budgeting apps and similar, where the experience of using the product is the thing worth reporting.
  • Digital services: SMB software including accounting, payroll, CRM and website builders; tax software; banking and investing apps; insurance quote journeys; telehealth and therapy platforms.

About you

  • Around 10 years in product testing, QA, consumer reviews, lab operations or a comparable evidence-generating function, with ownership of test methodology across a meaningful part of it.
  • 3+ years managing testers or a comparable team. You will be managing two people from day one, and we expect you to raise the standard of their work rather than simply allocate it.
  • Demonstrable experience building test plans and test strategies from nothing, rather than executing someone else's. We will ask you to walk us through one in detail.
  • Experience setting up something that did not exist before. This is a build and a job at the same time: you will be testing from day one while designing the function around it, not disappearing for six months to write process.
  • A clear view of how to make a test repeatable across two different testers working in two different places. That is the central methodological problem of this function.
  • The judgement to open a new category well: what it takes to test properly, what instruments it needs, and when the honest answer is that we should not cover it yet.
  • Experience commissioning third-party lab work: scoping an assay, reading a certificate of analysis, and knowing the difference between a result that is significant and one that sits inside the method's margin of error.
  • A journalistic instinct for which findings are worth publishing, and the confidence to argue for them with editors who did not commission them.
  • Comfortable holding an independence line with commercial colleagues, politely and repeatedly.
  • Rigorous by instinct. You control variables without being told to, and you notice when a result is too good to be true.
  • Confident in Excel: you will be building and filling structured scoring sheets every week.
  • You can write. Findings that nobody can read do not help an editor.
  • Genuinely detail-obsessed: you investigate the outlier before you publish it, not after a reader emails in.
  • Comfortable saying a product is bad, in writing, with evidence, when the commercial wind is blowing the other way.

Nice to have

  • Prior work in a testing lab, QA function, consumer reviews outlet or product team.
  • Comfort with measurement instrumentation: sound meters, power meters, thermal probes, timers.
  • Photography or video skills good enough that the images are publishable.
  • SQL, or the willingness to learn it. Your scores end up in the same models the analysts use.
  • Existing relationships with accredited testing labs, or experience running a competitive selection for one.
  • Familiarity with lab accreditation such as ISO/IEC 17025, and with what a lab's scope of accreditation does and does not cover.
  • A background in journalism, editorial or publishing alongside the testing experience.

Overview

The Quality Assurance (QA) Manager will lead the development and implementation of a sustainable, scalable quality assurance process for the Enrollment Services department.

This process will establish consistent standards for prospective-student interactions and align enrollment practices with organizational expectations, partner agreements, program requirements, and applicable laws and regulations. The QA Manager will translate findings into measurable improvements across the student recruitment and enrollment lifecycle. In close partnership with Enrollment Leadership, Training and Development, and Enrollment Operations, the manager will identify skill and process gaps, strengthen coaching effectiveness, and promote an ethical, accessible, student-centered culture of continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

Quality Program Leadership

  • Lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of a scalable educational quality assurance framework aligned with organizational standards, university-partner requirements, program-specific expectations, and enrollment communication channels.
  • Establish, maintain, and continuously improve evaluation standards, sampling methodologies, and QA documentation, including scorecards.
  • Review enrollment interactions and records for quality, accuracy, student experience, policy adherence, and regulatory compliance.
  • Lead department-wide calibration and alignment efforts to ensure consistent scoring standards and uniform application of evaluation tools, scorecards, and supporting documentation.
  • Communicate findings objectively and foster a culture of learning, accountability, ethical conduct, and consistent student service.

Training Partnership and Skill Development

  • Identify performance, process, and compliance gaps through QA findings and partner with Enrollment Leadership and Training and Development to develop targeted, role-based solutions.
  • Provide trainers with evaluation insights, behavioral examples, and subject-matter support while maintaining confidentiality.

Analytics, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze quality, compliance, conversion, student-experience, and operational data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
  • Monitor quality KPIs and thresholds and promptly escalate results outside established tolerances.
  • Lead cross-functional improvements and advise on quality impacts of changes to systems, workflows, communications, policies, and program launches.
  • Other duties, as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Education, Quality Management, Organizational Development, or a related field.
  • Three or more years of progressive experience in educational quality assurance, including experience operating within university-partner governance and compliance requirements.
  • Three or more years of experience leading people, programs, or cross-functional initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience developing scorecards, conducting audits or evaluations, leading calibration and performing root-cause analysis.
  • Experience using dashboards and performance reporting tools to communicate quality trends and business insights.
  • Experience with Salesforce Education Cloud, Omnichannel, quality-monitoring, speech or text analytics, or third-party education technology platforms.
  • Ability to manage confidential information, competing priorities, and sensitive issues with sound judgment and integrity.
  • Flexibility to work evenings and weekends, as needed.
  • Ability to travel, on average 1-2 times per year.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of relevant privacy, consumer-communication, accessibility, records-retention, and higher-education compliance concepts, including FERPA and applicable calling and texting requirements.
  • Experience translating quality findings into training content, coaching priorities, or competency-development plans.

job.description:
About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

About Reserv:

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology

providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced QA Analyst to join our Quality Assurance team. This is a strategic, client-facing role focused on identifying systemic issues before they impact our customers. You will conduct hypothesis-driven target audits, partner with account management teams, and drive root cause analysis that protects our commercial relationships and drives meaningful operational improvements. This role is perfect for someone who loves investigative work, has deep claims expertise, and wants to make a tangible impact on business outcomes.

What You'll Do:

Proactive Issue Identification: Find problems before clients do by conducting strategic target audits across accounts, lines of business, and exposures

Hypothesis-Driven Investigations: Develop and test hypotheses about potential quality issues, then execute detailed audits to validate findings

Strategic Analysis: Conduct deep-dive, exposure-specific, LOB-specific, and client- specific reviews that require seasoned claims judgment

Account Partnership: Participate in account management calls, discuss client expectations, and serve as a trusted quality advisor

Root Cause Analysis: Lead root cause investigations with leadership teams, present findings with clear recommendations and action plans

Accountability & Escalation: Follow through to ensure action plans are executed; escalate when teams don't follow through on required actions

Collaboration: Work closely with the QA team on escalated issues and with leadership to drive systemic improvements

What Makes This Role Unique:

Unlike traditional QA roles focused on individual file audits, this is focused on strategic and investigative claims handling. You'll have the autonomy to identify what to investigate, design your approach, and drive change at the account and organizational level. Your work directly protects revenue and strengthens client relationships.

Required Qualifications:

  • Claims Experience: 3-5+ years of claims adjusting experience across multiple lines of business
  • Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of exposures, coverage, and regulatory requirements
  • QA/Audit Background: Previous quality assurance, audit, or quality review experience
  • Analytical Skills: Demonstrated ability to identify patterns, trends, and root causes in complex data
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable presenting findings to leadership
  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to see both details and big picture; hypothesis development and problem-solving skills

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working across multiple client accounts or business units
  • Track record of identifying and resolving systemic operational issues
  • Client-facing or account management experience
  • Experience with data analysis tools and dashboards
  • Familiarity with AI/LLM tools in claims or quality processes

Key Competencies:

  • Investigative Mindset: Natural curiosity about why issues occur, not just what occurred
  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop hypotheses and design audits to test them
  • Independence: Self-directed and comfortable working with ambiguity
  • Influence: Can challenge leaders constructively with data-backed recommendations
  • Detail-Oriented: Thorough in analysis while maintaining big-picture perspective
  • Relationship Management: Builds trust with stakeholders at all levels
  • Proactive: Takes initiative to surface issues before they escalate

What Success Looks Like:

  • Identifying systemic issues before clients raise concerns
  • Building trusted relationships with account managers and directors
  • Driving measurable improvements in quality outcomes through root cause work
  • Contributing strategic insights that inform operational decisions

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, and dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized
  • 100% remote (home-based) role designed to support your work-life balance
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

job.title: QA Engineer: AI-Assisted Testing
job.description:
Join ECFX, a company transforming how the legal industry works through technology. Every day our platform pulls court notices and legal documents from hundreds of court portals and e-filing systems, categorizes them with AI, and delivers them into our customers' document and case management systems. When something is late, dropped, or misfiled, a law firm can miss a deadline.

We're looking for a hands-on QA Engineer who loves finding what others miss, and who uses AI to do it faster and deeper. Our engineers build with AI coding agents, so changes arrive quickly and in volume. You'll be the person who works out what could break and tests it thoroughly by hand, using AI as your co-pilot for test design, test data, investigation, and reporting. This is a testing role first. If you also enjoy building automation, there's room to use AI to create targeted automated checks where they pay off. You will have a real say in how we build, test, and ship software.

What You'll Engage In

  • Test Smarter with AI: Use AI tools (such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, or ChatGPT) to read tickets, merge requests, and code diffs; map out risks and edge cases; draft test charters and checklists; and decide where to focus. You bring the judgment about what matters.
  • Explore and Uncover: Run risk-based exploratory, functional, and regression testing across our Vue dashboard, admin tools, email notifications, and integrations. Find defects before customers do.
  • Validate What Matters Most: Make sure documents are retrieved, parsed, categorized, stored, and delivered correctly across many external sources: court portals, 2FA/OTP logins, and integrations such as Clio, Filevine, iManage, and NetDocuments. Hunt for silent failures, where a document is dropped but the run reports success.
  • Test Below the UI: Much of our work has no screen to click. Verify backend and platform changes by hand, using API calls, SQL queries, logs, and dashboards (Grafana/Loki, Sentry), with AI helping you write the queries and make sense of the output.
  • Build Realistic Test Scenarios: Use AI to generate test data, sample court notice emails, and edge-case documents, and drive our simulators and test environments to reproduce hard-to-reach situations.
  • Test Our AI Features: Evaluate our AI document categorization and our LLM-facing tools (an MCP server used by AI assistants). Build sample sets, check accuracy and consistency, try to break them with unusual or hostile inputs, and flag when a model or prompt change makes results worse.
  • Guard Security and Access: Check logins (password, SAML SSO, OAuth), user roles and permissions, and that one firm can never see another firm's data. Verify security fixes without breaking what already works.
  • Reproduce and Triage: Investigate customer-reported and production issues, reproduce them reliably, and write bug reports clear enough that an engineer, or an AI agent, can act on them right away.
  • Automate Where It Pays Off (Optional): If automation is in your toolkit, use AI to create focused automated checks, such as Playwright scripts or API checks, for high-risk flows you find yourself retesting.
  • Agile Collaboration: Work with engineers and product managers in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives. Help write testable acceptance criteria and raise quality risks early

What You're Likely to Bring

Professional Experience: 3 to 7 years in software quality assurance for web or SaaS applications, with deep experience in exploratory and manual testing of complex, data-heavy systems.

AI Fluency

  • ·You use AI assistants in your testing every day and can give concrete examples: generating test ideas and edge cases, building test data, writing SQL or log queries, summarizing logs or diffs, reproducing bugs, and drafting clear reports.
  • Skill at prompting and giving context, such as feeding in the ticket, the diff, and the acceptance criteria to get useful output instead of generic answers.
  • Healthy skepticism. You verify what AI tells you, recognize when it is confidently wrong, and never let it replace your own judgment about risk.
  • An understanding of how to test systems that don't always give the same answer, such as AI features, by using repeated trials, sample sets, and "is this answer right?" checks rather than exact matches.
  • Careful handling of data. You use synthetic or masked data with AI tools and never paste customer or court data into unapproved services.

Technical Proficiency

· Comfort with the command line, Git, and reading logs. Some experience with Docker or Kubernetes (such as port-forwarding or checking pod logs) is a plus.

· Experience with defect tracking and test management in Jira.

How You Work

  • Analytical Mindset: Sharp attention to detail, curiosity, and a methodical approach to breaking software and finding root causes.
  • Communication Excellence: Strong written and verbal communication for bug reports, test notes, and status updates. Your reports are precise enough that another person, or an AI agent, can pick them up and act.
  • Ownership: When something seems "untestable," you find a way, whether that's a query, a log search, a simulator, or a question to the right engineer, rather than skipping it.

Requirements

  • Experience writing or maintaining automated tests (for example Playwright, Selenium, or API test scripts), including building them with AI and reviewing and fixing what it produces.
  • Experience testing AI or LLM features, such as checking classification accuracy, spotting hallucinations, or testing for prompt injection.
  • SQL skills for checking data in PostgreSQL.
  • Experience testing APIs directly with tools like Postman, curl, or Bruno, and an understanding of HTTP, REST, and JSON.
  • Experience with web security testing, including authentication and sessions, roles and permissions, OAuth2/SAML, CSRF, and XSS.
  • Experience using AI browser tools (for example Playwright MCP or browser agents) to speed up exploratory testing.
  • Experience testing integrations with third-party systems, email-driven workflows, or browser automation against external sites.
  • Experience with accessibility testing (WCAG 2.2 AA).
  • Knowledge of the legal domain, especially court e-filing, docketing, or legal document management.
  • ISTQB or a similar QA certification.
  • An understanding of or experience with the Lean Startup approach.

Why QA Engineers Like It Here

  • Modern Tooling: Company-provided AI tools, with clear guidelines for using them safely.
  • Real Impact: You'll shape how we test in an AI-assisted team, not follow a fixed script.
  • AI in Production: Hands-on work testing real AI features used by law firms every day.

Benefits

  • Remote Flexibility: A fully remote role open to every US time zone, Hawaii included.
  • Work-Life Harmony: Flexible working hours and a supportive approach to getting work done.
  • Comprehensive Coverage: A range of insurance options covering health, dental, vision, and life.
  • Discretionary Time Off: We know a healthy work-life balance matters. Our discretionary time off (DTO) policy means that, on top of scheduled vacations and holidays, employees can take unplanned time off when needed, with supervisor approval. Life happens, and we trust our team to manage their time well.
  • Employee Stock Options: The opportunity to participate in the company stock option plan.

job.title: ServiceNow Business Analyst & Quality Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

NetImpact Strategies is seeking a ServiceNow Business Analyst & Quality Engineer to provide independent analysis and release assurance for a Federal Agency's ServiceNow platform. This role owns requirements gathering, automated and regression testing, test evidence, defect analysis, release-readiness validation, and post-production verification so delivery speed can increase without weakening platform reliability, security, or upgradeability.

This position is requires U.S. citizenship and a post-award Government background investigation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Elicit, analyze, document, and validate business needs, process flows, data requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for ServiceNow enhancements, operational improvements, integrations, and data changes.
  • Maintain themes, epics, features, stories, dependencies, backlog, sprint/release artifacts, and planning data in ServiceNow SPM/Agile capabilities or the Agency-approved work-management structure.
  • Support prioritization using Agency-assigned business value, time criticality, risk reduction, dependencies, and effort/capacity; make tradeoffs visible rather than independently deciding Government priorities.
  • Facilitate requirements clarification among product owners, users, administrators, developers, implementation specialists, architects, testers, and external teams so work enters delivery ready and testable.
  • Own the platform test strategy, regression baseline, release-quality evidence, and repeatable testing standards used by the Platform Team.
  • Design, build, maintain, and execute ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF) suites covering critical platform forms, lists, ACLs, workflows/flows, notifications, catalog functions, integrations, and reusable capabilities.
  • Create and execute functional, integration, regression, exploratory, performance, and release-validation test scenarios proportionate to change risk.
  • Coordinate UAT with product owners, and stakeholders; ensure acceptance criteria, expected outcomes, defects, and approvals remain traceable to the release.
  • Analyze defects, establish severity and reproducibility, distinguish pre-release findings from production issues, track remediation/retest, and identify recurring escaped-defect patterns.
  • Prepare release evidence including test plans, cases, automated scripts, execution results, defect status, exceptions, and readiness recommendations for governance and go/no-go decisions.
  • Validate upgrade and patch readiness through regression packs, pre/post comparisons, and targeted testing of platform-level integrations and critical shared capabilities.
  • Perform post-production validation and rollback verification; ensure a change is not declared successful until agreed technical and user outcomes are demonstrated.
  • Measure automation coverage, regression effectiveness, escaped defects, test-cycle time, and repeat-failure trends; recommend improvements that increase confidence and reduce manual effort.
  • Maintain reusable testing guidance and coach implementation/product teams on approved ServiceNow testing practices without assuming ownership for product-team-specific application testing.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications and Certifications

  • Three or more years of business analysis and software quality engineering or test automation experience, including enterprise web/application testing.
  • Two or more years of hands-on ServiceNow testing experience, including Automated Test Framework (ATF), regression testing, and validation of platform configuration and integrations.
  • Experience designing risk-based test plans, test cases, traceability, defect workflows, release evidence, and post-production validation.
  • Experience testing REST/SOAP or IntegrationHub integrations, workflows/flows, security/ACL behavior, catalog capabilities, and cross-system transactions.
  • Working knowledge of ServiceNow release/change processes and the ability to evaluate readiness independently from the engineer who built the change.
  • ServiceNow CSA and ATF-related training/micro-certifications strongly preferred; additional testing certification such as ISTQB is a plus.
  • U.S. citizenship and ability to satisfy High Risk IT background-investigation and sensitive-information requirements.

Preferred Qualifications and Certifications

  • Federal consulting or financial-regulatory experience.
  • Experience with ServiceNow family-upgrade testing, Performance Analytics, performance testing, and CI/CD-triggered automated tests.
  • Experience building reusable enterprise regression suites and test-evidence dashboards.

About Us

At NetImpact Strategies, we post salary ranges in compliance with the specific labor laws and regulations of each county and state, ensuring transparency and fairness in our hiring practices. This approach reflects our commitment to adhering to legal requirements and promoting equitable pay standards across all regions where we operate. The posted salary range for this role is $90,000-105,000. The posted salary range is not an exact indication of the actual compensation offered and is instead a range of what NetImpact, in good faith, could compensate at the lowest and most high end of the salary market. In general, NetImpact may not pay the top of the salary range. Compensations are determined by several mitigating factors including skillset, experience, trainings, location, and other factors including benefits packages.Perks of working at NetImpact Strategies

  • Your health comes first – we offer comprehensive medical, dental, & vision insurance that starts the first of the month after you join the team
  • Invest in your future – 401(k) Plan – Immediately vested employer contributions; no matching required
  • Work hard, play hard – we offer a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) policy, one (1) additional day of paid wellness leave per calendar year, and observe ten (10) federal holidays
  • Pawsitively pawesome – Pet Insurance (because our little critters are part of our families, too!)
  • Invest in your education – Tuition reimbursement, internal training programs, & company-sponsored industry certifications!
  • Be part of a dynamic and collaborative work environment recently ranked by The Washington Post as a Top Work Place in 2019, 2021,2022, 2023, & 2024!
  • Have fun and celebrate and give back – Team building activities, community volunteering, quarterly HQ days, wellness events, happy hours, family fun events, and more!

ABOUT US

NetImpact Strategies Inc. (NetImpact) has been a Trusted Advisor driving impact through digital transformation for the Federal Government for over a decade. We solve complex problems with innovation and agility to create meaningful, transformative, and enduring change. As Trusted Advisors, NetImpact professionals partner with customer agencies to deliver solutions that empower them to not only meet their missions but also realize their strategic vision through agile, outcome-focused solutions addressing both strategic and tactical requirements. We design and implement comprehensive, tailored solutions that are both mindful of the client's culture and organizational dynamics. NetImpact’s core values and commitment to a customer and results-oriented delivery approach has propelled our growth and enabled us to deliver impactful value across Strategic Consulting, Process Automation, Cloud, DevSecOps, Data and Analytics, and Cyber Security for the Federal Government.

ACCESSIBILITY NOTE

NetImpact Strategies is committed to complying with all applicable provisions of the Americans with Disabilities Act, as amended (“ADA”), and applicable state and local laws. It is NetImpact’s policy not to discriminate against any qualified person or applicant with regard to any terms or conditions of employment on the basis of such individual’s disability. Consistent with this policy of non-discrimination, NetImpact will provide reasonable accommodations to an individual with a disability, as defined in the ADA or applicable law, who has made NetImpact aware of his/her disability, unless doing so would cause undue hardship to NetImpact. If you are an applicant and need reasonable accommodation when applying for job opportunities within NetImpact, or request reasonable accommodation to utilize NetImpact’s online employment application, please contact .

job.title: HTS Testing Engineer
job.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

TEAM & ROLE

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

  • Impact: Your work will directly shape the magnets that enable commercial fusion energy.

  • Ownership: As an early member of a growing team, you’ll help define how we test HTS at scale.

  • Development: Build specialist skills at the cutting edge of superconducting magnet technology.


    WHAT YOU WILL DO

1. Qualification at Scale

  • Test Planning: Define test strategies, sampling plans and pass/fail criteria for HTS tapes and cables, and help set up production testing at our Magnet Factory.

  • Measurement: Commission test systems and develop measurement processes that ensure reproducible, traceable measurements of critical current (Ic) and related properties, including the effects of manufacturing processes.

  • Data & Statistics: Help design our HTS test database, with traceability from supplier and reel through to cable, and turn results into statistical datasets for magnet modelling and design.

  • Supplier Selection: Compare supplier data with our own measurements and support decisions on which tapes to use in Alpha and future stellarators.

2. R&D

  • HTS Qualification: Run tape and cable qualification test campaigns, both in-house and at external facilities.

  • Analysis & Reporting: Compare results with models and give clear technical recommendations to the design, modelling and manufacturing teams.

  • Equipment Development: Support the development of new test equipment and methods with external partners.

3. Planning, Safety & Team

  • Planning: Plan test campaigns in line with tape deliveries and the Alpha build programme.

  • Technician Guidance: Write procedures and guide the technicians who run routine tests.

  • Safety: Ensure safe work with cryogens, high currents and high magnetic fields.

  • Quality: Ensure results are traceable, well documented and reproducible.

WHO YOU ARE

An engineer or scientist who enjoys careful, hands-on experimental work as much as planning how we test at scale.

  • You hold an MSc or PhD in Physics, Materials Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

  • You have hands-on experience characterising materials or devices, and are comfortable designing experiments.

  • You speak fluent English.

  • You have strong data analysis skills and a solid grasp of measurement uncertainty and statistics.

  • You are happy to travel for test campaigns at external facilities, including internationally.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with superconductors, cryogenics or high magnetic fields.

  • Experience with quality control or production testing at scale.

  • Experience designing cryogenic or automated test equipment.

  • Familiarity with HTS tape manufacturing processes and the supplier landscape.

  • German language skills.

This role will initially be based in our Zurich office. As the project develops, the position may move to Germany. If that happens, we’ll give you at least six months’ notice and support you through the move.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

Job Description:

Job Title: QA Automation Analyst

Location: Remote | USA, Canada
Reports to: Team Lead, Quality Assurance

Employment Type: Full-time

This is a new vacancy

About the Role:

As a QA Engineer, you will own quality for features and services end to end - designing test strategy, building automation, and validating behavior across web, API, and data layers. You will partner with engineers, product managers, and other QA engineers to deliver releases that meet JD Power's quality bar.

This is a fully independent delivery role: you will take features from requirements to release-ready with minimal supervision, make sound judgment calls about risk and coverage, and contribute meaningfully to the team's automation suite and quality practices.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the test approach for assigned features; decide what to automate, what to test manually, and what to defer
  • Translate requirements and acceptance criteria into complete, risk-based test coverage
  • Design tests across functional, regression, integration, API, and data validation layers
  • Identify gaps in requirements and edge cases during refinement, before code is written
  • Assess release risk for your features and communicate it clearly
  • Build and maintain automated tests independently in the team's frameworks (UI, API, and data)
  • Write maintainable, well-structured test code; apply the same engineering standards expected of product code
  • Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines; keep suites fast, stable, and trustworthy
  • Diagnose and fix flaky tests; drive down noise in the pipeline
  • Contribute reusable utilities, fixtures, and test data helpers to the shared framework
  • Investigate defects to a root-cause hypothesis before filing; include logs, traces, and reproduction steps
  • Triage and prioritize defects with engineering and product partners
  • Track defect trends in your area; surface patterns that point to systemic quality issues
  • Verify fixes and confirm regression coverage is added where appropriate
  • Partner with developers throughout the sprint; shift testing left rather than validating at the end
  • Participate in code reviews and design discussions from a testability and quality perspective
  • Support release activities, including smoke testing, validation, and post-release verification
  • Mentor QA engineers earlier in their career on test design and tooling
  • Track and report test coverage, pass rates, defect escape rate, and automation stability for your area
  • Use data to argue for where testing investment should go next
  • Report transparently on quality risks, blockers, and coverage gaps

Required Qualifications:

  • Post-secondary education in Computer Science or Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years developing automated tests with modern web and API frameworks such as Playwright, Pytest, Postman/Newman/Bruno/Insomnia, or REST client libraries, in TypeScript or JavaScript
  • 5+ years integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, with hands-on GitLab CI experience (pipeline configuration, stages, runners, artifacts, and quality gates on merge requests)
  • Experience testing cloud-native services and REST APIs built on Node.js/NestJS or equivalent, including contract testing and service virtualization or mocking
  • Experience validating data: writing SQL against relational databases (PostgreSQL) and cloud data platforms (Snowflake), and testing data pipelines for completeness, accuracy, and freshness
  • Experience testing React front ends, including component-level testing and accessibility validation
  • Experience with Git-based workflows, code review, and trunk-based or feature-branch delivery models in GitLab
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent), containerized environments, and API gateway patterns
  • Experience with observability and diagnostics tooling (Datadog, or equivalent logging, metrics, and tracing platforms) to investigate failures across application, data, and infrastructure boundaries
  • Detailed knowledge of all phases of the Software Testing Lifecycle, and of shift-left practices that move quality ownership into the development team
  • Experience designing and executing test suites across unit, integration, contract, end-to-end, and acceptance levels, including performance and resilience testing
  • Proven technical leadership of multidisciplinary teams, including distributed onshore and offshore partners
  • Familiarity with service-oriented and microservice architecture, API design principles, and relational and non-relational data modeling
  • Working knowledge of secure development and testing practices, including authentication and authorization flows and common application security risks

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Hands-on use of AI coding and testing assistants in daily work; experience applying LLMs to test generation, test data creation, or failure triage
  • Experience building or evaluating automated quality signals for AI-enabled features — evaluation harnesses, regression suites for non-deterministic outputs, and guardrail testing
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence for test management, traceability, and defect workflow
  • Experience with DORA metrics and using delivery data to target quality investment

Compensation and Benefits

This position has a starting salary range of $80,000 - $100,000 CAD / $100,000 - $120,000 USD per year. The range represents what we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.

Eligible employees may participate in medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, retirement savings programs, paid time off, wellness programs, and other company-sponsored benefits. Benefits vary by country and employment status.

Why Join JD Power

JD Power powers auto-related decisions through proprietary data, advanced analytics, deep industry expertise, and workflows that connect insight to action. Operating across North America, Europe, and Australia, we help customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

As a virtual-first company, we offer flexible work arrangements, opportunities for learning and development, and a culture centered on the Values that guide how we work every day.

job.title: QA Team Lead
job.description:
QA Team Lead — ProLender

About ProLender

ProLender is Covaleyo's loan origination system, used by about 30% of Canadian credit unions. Covaleyo builds loan origination and loan monitoring software for Canadian credit unions and banks, as part of the Constellation Software family.

Credit unions rely on ProLender to originate loans accurately and in line with their regulatory obligations. Quality isn't a nice-to-have here: it's what our clients, their regulators and our SOC 2 auditors expect.


The role

We're hiring a QA Team Lead to build a modern quality practice for ProLender and lead the team that runs it. Our testers bring deep product knowledge, and we're ready to invest in the next step: more test automation, testing earlier in the cycle, and catching more issues before they reach Production. We're looking for someone who has led that kind of change before.

You'll lead a team of testers, shape how engineering and product think about quality, and own the strategy, tooling and process that get defects caught earlier. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll set technical direction for test automation, but your biggest lever will be growing the people on your team and changing how the wider team works.

Test automation is central to this role: you'll own how we scale it, including AI-driven approaches.

You'll report to the Director of Technology and work closely with development leads, product owners and our infrastructure and compliance team.

This is a fully remote role. With one team member offshore, you'll lead across time zones and set up ways of working that keep the whole team connected.


What you'll do

Lead and grow the team

  • Manage a team of four testers, three onshore and one offshore: set goals, give regular feedback, run 1:1s and handle performance conversations.
  • Assess each person's strengths and build development plans, including moving manual testers into automation where it fits.
  • Bring the team through a significant change in how they work, while keeping the product knowledge they already have.
  • Share QA best practices, tooling and lessons learned with other product teams across Covaleyo and learn from what's working for them.

Set the quality strategy

  • Analyze Production incidents and escaped defects to find where quality is breaking down and fix the biggest leaks first.
  • Define a risk-based test strategy across unit, API, integration and end-to-end levels.
  • Choose which metrics we track (escaped defects, change failure rate, time to detect) and report on them to engineering leadership.

Build test automation that people trust

  • Set the technical direction for our automation framework and integrate it into our build and deploy process.
  • Establish standards for maintainable, reliable tests, and treat flaky tests as defects.
  • Build automated coverage for critical client workflows, calculations and data integrations.
  • Integrate AI into our QA process: use AI agents and agentic workflows to generate and maintain tests, triage failures and draft test evidence, with human review where it matters and guardrails that respect client data and our SOC 2 and PIPEDA obligations.

Make quality a whole-team responsibility

  • Work with development leads to strengthen unit and API testing and code-level quality practices.
  • Lead open, collaborative discussions with the development team about new processes and approaches, such as shift-left testing, test-first practices, code review standards, branching and release practices, and better environments. Build agreement on what changes and why, rather than imposing it.
  • Work with product owners on clear, testable acceptance criteria and a meaningful definition of done.
  • Make clear, well-reasoned release recommendations based on risk.

Advocate for your team and for product quality

  • Represent QA with Product Management, Client Services, Support, Sales and leadership, and make sure quality has a voice in decisions about scope, timelines and release dates.
  • Make the case for the time, tools, environments and headcount your team needs, backed by data on risk and escaped defects.
  • Translate quality risks into business terms (client impact, support load, contractual and regulatory exposure) so that trade-offs are made with eyes open.
  • Build working relationships with Client Services and Support so that client-reported issues feed back into test priorities.
  • Make your team's work and wins visible across the business and protect them from unrealistic expectations and last-minute pressure.

Support compliance and security

  • Maintain test evidence and traceability that support our SOC 2 Type II audit and change management controls.
  • Produce and retain the post-testing artifacts each release needs, such as test plans, execution results, test summary reports, defect status and sign-off records, so that audit and client requests can be answered quickly and completely.
  • Put in place test data practices that protect client data, using masked or synthetic data in line with PIPEDA and our financial institution clients' requirements.


What success looks like

In your first 90 days, you'll get to know the team, the product and our clients' critical workflows. You'll review recent Production incidents, identify the main sources of escaped defects, and agree a prioritized quality plan with engineering leadership. You'll also ship early wins, such as a smoke suite covering our most critical paths.

Within your first year, Production defects are measurably down, and automated regression gates our releases. Developers own more of the testing at the unit and API level. Your team has clear roles and growth paths, and our test evidence holds up to audit without a scramble.

What you bring

  • 7+ years in software quality, including 2+ years leading a QA team with direct reports.

job.title: Senior Specialist, QA (EU)
job.description:
About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

  • HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

  • HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

  • HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

  • HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Overview of Role:

The Senior Specialist, QA (EU) is responsible for supporting GMP Quality Assurance oversight of investigational medicinal product (IMP) manufacturing and batch certification activities performed on behalf of Summit Therapeutics across its global external manufacturing and supply network.

This role ensures that all products meet internal and external standards, comply with cGMP regulations, and fulfill regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensures each batch of medicinal product has been manufactured and tested in accordance with the requirements of its Marketing Authorisation / Clinical Trial Authorisation / Product Specification
  • Perform detailed batch record review and support the Qualified Person to fulfill requirements in accordance with EudraLex Volume 4, Annex 16, Directive 2001/83/EC and Clinical Trials Regulation (EU) No 536/2014 to support disposition of medicinal products.
  • Foster a culture of quality, compliance, continuous improvement, and patient safety while leading cross-functional collaboration across manufacturing, quality control, supply chain and technical operations.
  • Review Quality and manufacturing performance at external partners and escalate significant GMP, compliance, product-quality or supply risks through appropriate Summit Quality governance processes.
  • Support deviations, investigations, CAPAs, change controls and associated Quality Management System records in accordance with Summit procedures.
  • Support with routine Quality oversight and act as a Quality point of contact for assigned external manufacturing and testing partners.
  • Support qualification, onboarding and ongoing GMP oversight of CMOs, CPOs, CTLs and other external GxP service providers.
  • Support development, review and maintenance of Quality Agreements and Quality Technical Agreements with external manufacturing, testing and supply-chain partners.
  • Support continuous inspection readiness across Summit’s GMP Quality operations.
  • Participate in health authority inspections, supplier audits and internal audits, including preparation of supporting documentation, SME support and responses to observations.
  • Work closely with Quality, CMC, Technical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain and Clinical Supply to support clinical programs.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biology, Microbiology, Engineering, Life Sciences or another relevant scientific or technical discipline.
  • 5+ years in pharmaceutical quality roles within a GMP-regulated environment.
  • Experience supporting clinical and/or commercial pharmaceutical or biotechnology manufacturing.
  • Hands-on aseptic / sterile manufacturing experience and experience with biological drug product (DS&DP) manufacturing.
  • Experience reviewing GMP batch manufacturing documentation and supporting batch disposition or product release.
  • Experience with batch record review and certification process for IMP’s is desirable.
  • Strong QA/GMP technical knowledge, with demonstrated capabilities to guide and support a growing organisation.
  • Experience in hosting and supporting health authority inspections (such as by HPRA, FDA).
  • Demonstrated strong interpersonal skills, a flexible, collaborative and team-oriented approach to problem solving and an ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  • Detailed working knowledge of EudraLex Volume 4, Annex 16, Directive 2001/83/EC and Clinical Trials Regulation (EU) No 536/2014 to support disposition of medicinal products.

Travel Requirements

  • Up to 15-20% travel as required.
  • Travel may include participation in quality reviews, supplier visits, regulatory inspections, audit activities, training, benchmarking events, and support of strategic business initiatives.

job.title: Lead Test Automation Engineer
job.description:
We are looking for a visionary Lead Test Automation Engineer with strong technical leadership and communication skills to drive quality engineering across the software development lifecycle of high-impact products in diverse domains, built with Commencis’ expertise in a fast-paced agile environment.

In this role, you will take ownership of architecting scalable test automation frameworks, defining end-to-end test strategies, and embedding AI-driven testing practices into our workflows. Your deep technical expertise will be essential to balance project constraints, accelerate release cycles, and establish automated quality gates without compromising product excellence.

You will collaborate closely with developers, product owners, and designers to align quality objectives from early design stages through deployment—overseeing automated UI, API, and performance testing (while stepping into critical manual or exploratory testing when needed) to ensure every release is fit for purpose.

Beyond leading the quality and automation efforts of your core product, you will mentor QA and automation engineers, lead code and architecture reviews across multiple projects, and spearhead initiatives to continuously evolve Commencis’ test automation standards and AI-powered testing practices.

If you are curious by nature, adaptive, collaborative, and always one step ahead, then join us and be a Commencer!

Key Roles and Responsibilities

  • Architect, evolve, and maintain scalable, modular, and maintainable test automation frameworks across mobile, web, and API layers.

  • Define and enforce automation coding standards, review guidelines, and architectural best practices across squads.

  • Mentor and coach QA and test automation engineers, leading regular code reviews and technical knowledge-sharing sessions to elevate team capabilities.

  • Lead tool evaluations and Proof of Concept (PoC) initiatives to optimize test execution speed, stability, and overall automation ROI.

  • Architect Text-to-Test and agentic workflows that translate product requirements, user stories, or design specifications into executable automated test scenarios.

  • Establish AI governance, prompt/context standards, and quality guardrails for AI-assisted test generation across the QA and automation teams.

  • Implement intelligent failure analysis and reporting pipelines to accelerate root-cause identification and reduce triage effort.

  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to analyze project requirements and establish end-to-end test strategies aligned with business goals.

  • Design and oversee automated UI (mobile/web), API, and performance (load, stress) test suites, stepping in for critical manual, exploratory, or integration testing when needed.

  • Lead the integration of automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines, managing parallel execution infrastructures (e.g., cloud device farms) and enforcing release quality gates.

  • Track quality metrics, assess release risks, and deliver clear, actionable test progress reports to engineering and product leadership.

Requirements

  • BSc or MSc in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

  • 8+ years of experience in the software industry, with a strong focus on test automation, software development, and modern QA methodologies.

  • Proven leadership experience guiding QA/automation engineers, driving architectural decisions, and establishing engineering best practices.

  • Proven ability to work effectively within multinational, cross-functional teams.

  • Fluent in verbal and written English, paired with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Extensive hands-on experience designing and scaling mobile, web, and API test automation frameworks using tools such as Appium,WebDriverIO,Maestro and REST Assured ,KarateDsl

  • Proficiency in Java or other object-oriented programming (OOP) languages, along with deep expertise in software design patterns and clean code principles.

  • Hands-on experience with performance and load testing tools such as JMeter or Locust.

  • Strong command of version control systems (e.g., Git, Gerrit) and designing CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins) with parallel execution and automated quality gates.

  • Demonstrated experience authoring comprehensive test automation strategies, roadmaps, and test plans.

  • Proven hands-on experience integrating LLM-based coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) and AI agents into the test development lifecycle to accelerate script generation and maintenance.

  • Ability to design structured context files, prompts, and rulesets that enable AI tools to generate standardized, framework-compliant test automation code.

  • Experience evaluating and implementing AI-driven self-healing mechanisms or locator-independent testing approaches (e.g., vision-based or accessibility-tree driven tools) to minimize test flakiness.

  • Ability to evaluate and integrate emerging AI-driven testing technologies based on project requirements, technical constraints, and ROI.

  • Experience architecting sustainable, multi-platform test automation frameworks from scratch is a plus.

  • Familiarity with security testing practices and tools is a plus.

  • An ISTQB certification is nice to have.

  • Active contributions to the open-source community are a plus.

Why Commencis?

We want people to thrive at Commencis. Here’s what Commencers like about working here:

Competitive Compensation & Benefits: We offer a competitive salary, private health insurance, pension and retirement plans through a company-backed pension system, meal card, commute compensation, work-from home support and paid birthday off.

Happier Weekdays: We offer flexible working hours including remote working option. Online events, guest speakers, refreshments in the office, meeting-light culture, and many more to enjoy the weekdays.

Never Stop Learning: We support learning and development programs for almost anything. Additionally, we provide access to leading online e-learning platforms like Udemy and various libraries.

Community & Socials: We are a tight-knit community that loves gathering. Our social activities include happy hours, workshops, new year party, breakfast & lunch get-togethers, movie nights, and our Summer Festival.

Open Culture: We maintain a flat organizational structure with a culture of direct and open communication. We value Commencers’ voices and address any suggestions and questions you may have.

About Commencis

Join us in paving the way for a thriving digital society! 

Commencis has more than two decades of expertise in the world of experience design, software engineering and cloud technologies. Our products and solutions are used by leading brands in financial services, insurance, airlines and retail in more than 20 countries. 

We help our clients around the globe to commence their next evolution and pave the way for a thriving digital society. We love discovering what’s next. We value collaboration, curiosity, and an open mindset at work. 

If you share the same passion with our fellow Commencers, then let us unleash your world-class potential!

job.title: Quality Engineer - Automation
job.description:
InfoTrust is a global, privately-owned products and solutions company dedicated to unlocking the power of data to drive marketing performance and business growth. We specialize in digital analytics, media enablement, and privacy-centric solutions that help Fortune 100–500 companies and the world’s largest brands optimize their marketing strategies. Our culture is built on passion, ownership, diversity, trust, respect, and continuous growth—values that have earned us multiple “Best Places to Work” awards, including a Great Place to Work certification 7 years in a row.

About the role

InfoTrust is growing a portfolio of enterprise SaaS products, and we want quality built into how we develop them, not checked at the end. As a Quality Engineer – Automation, you’ll join our quality engineering team inside R&D. You’ll own test planning and automated testing for your assigned features, and you’ll help build the shared frameworks, standards and CI/CD integration the whole team uses to test our products across the UI, APIs, services and data.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role reporting to Engineering leadership. Leadership sets your main product focus when you’re hired. You’ll work closely with other quality engineers, engineering managers, developers, DevOps and product teams. The goal is simple: catch defects before they reach production, not after.

In your first 90 days you’ll learn our products, architecture and shared frameworks. Then you’ll start building automated tests for your features. By day 90, your releases will ship against a complete test plan, with your tests running in the pipeline.

What you'll do

  • Write the test plan for every feature you own before it ships. You’ll document and plan test cases with engineering managers and developers so each release is fully covered.
  • Design, build and maintain automated functional, regression, performance and API tests for your features, using the team’s shared frameworks.
  • Validate and query data in SQL and NoSQL databases to set up test data, check results and troubleshoot.
  • Monitor test results, analyze failures and report issues with diagnostics clear enough for the team to act on quickly.
  • Help extend the team’s test automation frameworks so they stay scalable and maintainable as our products grow.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines so every change is validated on its way to production.
  • Work with other quality engineers, developers, DevOps and product teams to cover microservices and cloud-based architectures without gaps or duplicated work.
  • Follow the team’s testing standards, propose improvements to them, and advocate for testability and engineering best practices across the development lifecycle.

Qualifications

  • 2-5 years of test automation experience on web, API or cloud-based systems
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field
  • Solid grounding in software testing principles, QA methodologies and the SDLC
  • Strong programming skills in JavaScript and Node.js
  • Experience with AWS or GCP
  • Strong knowledge of relational and NoSQL databases, including writing SQL
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD and version control, including Git
  • Experience with test automation frameworks such as Selenium, Mocha, Jest, Cypress or Playwright; API testing tools such as Postman or REST Assured; and CI/CD platforms such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps (equivalent tools are welcome)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a drive to keep improving
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills
  • Bonus: experience with Docker or Kubernetes, infrastructure as code and cloud test environments, performance testing tools (JMeter, Locust), or observability tools (Datadog, Prometheus)

You’ll love this role if you’d rather catch a bug before release than explain it after, you like turning repeatable checks into automation that scales, and you see quality as part of engineering, not a gate at the end.

It may not be the right fit if you expect testing to start only after development is done, you want to stay in one layer of the stack, or you’d rather build everything your own way than work within shared team frameworks.

About the Role

    As our Lead QA Engineer, you will own QA strategy and execution across Backcountry’s digital properties across web, API, and mobile with an AI-first approach.
    This is a high-ownership role built for someone who wants to lead with craft: raising automation coverage, strengthening release confidence, and influencing how quality is woven into every stage of the development lifecycle. In your first six months, you’ll establish Playwright as the primary automation framework and define repeatable release validation standards that support our weekly deployment cadence.
    By month twelve, the expectation is measurable improvement in regression stability, defect trends, and test coverage with targeted initiatives like Apple Pay automation moving from backlog to production.

  • Own the end-to-end testing lifecycle across Backcountry’s web, API, and mobile platforms.

    • Drive AI/Automation & CI/CD Excellence

  • Create re-usable agents that reduce overhead for your team.
