  • Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines and support release validation processes, including occasional after-hours deployments.
  • Lead targeted automation initiatives including Apple Pay automation and AI-assisted testing approaches.
  • Evaluate and adopt modern QA tooling (BrowserStack, Appium, Gatling) where they improve coverage or efficiency.

    • Collaborate Cross-Functionally

  • Partner with product managers, developers, and DevOps to embed QA into Agile delivery workflows.
  • Work within Jira and TestRail for defect management and test case organization.
  • Align stakeholders on quality signals and communicate release readiness with clarity.

    • Monitor & Optimize Quality Metrics

  • Define and track KPIs for product quality, defect density, test coverage, and release reliability.
  • Establish baseline performance and load testing checks integrated into the standard delivery workflow.
  • Surface quality trends proactively and drive resolution before they become release blockers.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in Quality Assurance and Testing, with at least 2+ years in a lead or senior individual contributor capacity.
  • Proven, hands-on experience with Playwright for web and API E2E automation.
  • Strong automation fundamentals across Cypress, Selenium, or comparable frameworks; ability to build and maintain scalable test suites.
  • Working proficiency in Python, JavaScript, or Java; operate effectively in test frameworks and validate or correct AI-generated code.
  • Solid experience with functional, regression, and performance/load testing (Postman, JMeter, or equivalent).
  • Demonstrated SDLC and Agile experience with strong defect lifecycle management using Jira and TestRail.
  • Ability to operate independently under a steady release cadence and manage competing priorities without close supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • E-commerce QA automation experience, particularly in environments shipping frequently with CI/CD integration.
  • Familiarity with BrowserStack, Appium, Gatling, or Argo CD.
  • Experience with observability tooling like Grafana or GCP-based infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with Apple Pay automation or similar payment flow testing.
  • Practical, responsible use of AI-assisted testing tools — including the ability to validate and correct AI-generated test code.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder alignment skills, including the ability to influence without authority.

Why Join Backcountry

    The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.
  • Adventure is Our Culture: We celebrate the lifestyle our products enable. Milestone moments, employee stories, and exclusive outdoor perks are part of how we work.
  • AI-First Skill Building: Get hands-on with advanced AI and automation tooling. You'll build a modern QA stack that puts you ahead in any engineering environment.
  • Accelerated Ownership: High performers are quickly trusted with greater scope, new challenges, and leadership opportunities.
  • Competitive Benefits: We offer an attractive benefits package including primarily remote work, private medical and life insurance, additional paid time off, monthly allowances and reimbursements, employee discounts, and opportunities for professional growth.

Interview Process

    1. Recruiter Intro: 30-minute video call to discuss your background, experience, and the role.
    2. Hiring Manager Screen: A fit and mutual interest conversation to explore alignment on the role, team, and working style.
    3. Technical & Behavioral Interviews: Two separate interviews: one with a senior engineer focused on your automation depth and technical approach, and one with a product stakeholder focused on cross-functional collaboration and quality advocacy.
    4. Leadership Interview: A conversation focused on how you lead, develop teams, and drive quality culture.
    5. Final Interview (On-Site): An in-person meeting with someone on the team in Costa Rica.
    6. Reference Checks: We will connect with a few professional references to round out our understanding of your work and impact.

Job Description Summary:

At Rocket Software, we power the world's most innovative businesses through modernization. Our mission is to help customers maximize the value of their existing technology investments while accelerating innovation through AI, automation, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure. Every Rocketeer contributes to helping customers solve complex challenges while preserving and extending the value of their mission-critical systems.

As a AI Test Automation Engineer, you will help build and run AI-enabled test automation across Rocket's mainframe and enterprise software portfolio. You will contribute to automated testing frameworks and validation methods for agentic AI systems, with a developing understanding of IBM z/OS environments. This is a hands-on growth role: you will work on well-defined test projects alongside experienced engineers and build the skills to take on broader scope over time.

The AI Test Automation Engineer is an intermediate-level technical contributor on a project or work team, using practical technical principles to build and maintain test automation for AI-powered and agentic applications. Working under moderate supervision, this role supports Engineering, Product Management, and Data Science teams in validating AI agents, large language model (LLM) integrations, retrieval systems, and AI-driven workflows operating in enterprise and mainframe environments.


The ideal candidate has foundational experience in software development or quality engineering and is building working knowledge of test automation and AI testing methods. They apply technical principles to somewhat complex problems on smaller, less complex projects and assignments, seek advice from senior engineers when needed, and have their work reviewed to ensure key objectives are met. They may provide guidance and assistance to less experienced team members within their job area.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities


Agentic AI Testing

  • Build and maintain automated evaluation tests for AI agents, LLM-powered applications, and orchestration workflows, following established frameworks and patterns.
  • Develop test cases for AI agent behavior, task completion accuracy, and tool use, using direction from senior engineers.
  • Assist in building and maintaining benchmark datasets and test environments for continuous AI performance validation.
  • Collect, measure, and report results such as hallucination rates, accuracy, robustness, and bias, and flag safety concerns to the team.
  • Support regression testing and the validation of AI guardrails and monitoring strategies.

Automation & Engineering Excellence

  • Implement and maintain automated tests integrated into product CI/CD pipelines.
  • Use AI-assisted and agent-driven testing tools in daily work, and share what works with the team.
  • Contribute data to quality metrics and operational dashboards.
  • Make minor improvements to test processes, tools, and systems to improve quality and cycle time within the job area.
  • Troubleshoot test failures and defects, escalating to senior personnel when issues extend beyond the immediate project.

job.title: QA Lead
job.description:
Who we are:

Mama Money is a growth-stage fintech on a mission to improve the financial lives of migrants and underserved communities across Africa and beyond. What started in 2015 as a cross-border payments service has grown into a multi-product financial platform, giving people the tools to send, save, and manage money on their own terms, at a socially fair price. Payments were just the beginning; today Mama Money is building the fuller financial toolkit our customers need, all under one roof.

Mama HQ is in beautiful Cape Town. We're 173 people strong (and counting), representing 19 countries across Africa, Asia, the UK, and Europe. Everything we build is in service of people who deserve better, and our culture reflects that same commitment. We've had good times and tough times, but the focus never shifts: people over profit, always.

The role, in short;

    As QA Lead, you’ll own quality across our product and engineering function, right at the heart of how we build and ship. You’ll set our QA strategy and be accountable for the quality of everything we ship. If a bug reaches production, you own understanding why and making sure it doesn’t happen again. Engineers still own the quality of their code. It’s hands-on leadership, balancing big-picture ownership with genuine day-to-day involvement.

    Three strengths will define how you do it:

  • Analytical mind: You’ll build a deep understanding of our product and tech ecosystem, and think critically about where our QA strategy goes next and how our processes add value.

  • Technical aptitude: You’ll build and maintain our test automation platforms, drive adoption of new QA tools, and design test scenarios and validation strategies grounded in how our systems work.

  • Mentorship mindset: You’ll communicate the QA vision at Mama Money to QA engineers and developers, and help our team-based QA engineers understand the systems context behind their work so they write effective test cases.

What you'll actually be doing:

  • Define and drive the overall QA strategy across product and engineering

  • Build, mentor, and lead a team of QA engineers, setting priorities and reviewing their work

  • Design and implement manual and automated testing frameworks across web, mobile, and API layers

  • Own test planning for new features and releases, ensuring adequate coverage before go-live

  • Own large release readiness, with authority to make the go/no-go call on quality grounds

  • Collaborate with engineering, product, and DevOps to embed quality throughout the development lifecycle

  • Identify, triage, and track defects, working with engineering to prioritise fixes

  • Lead root cause analysis on production bugs and drive fixes to process, coverage, or tooling

  • Establish and monitor QA metrics (production bugs, resolution time, test coverage, release quality) and report to stakeholders

  • Own the production bug rate as your primary measure of success

  • Continuously improve testing processes, tooling, and best practices as the team and product scale

  • Ensure compliance and regulatory requirements are reflected in test coverage, where relevant to fintech operations

What we’re looking for:

  • 6+ years' proven experience as a QA professional within an Agile software development environment including experience in a QA Lead, Senior QA Engineer, or similar quality-focused leadership role

  • Experience leading or managing QA engineers, setting priorities and developing their skills

  • Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle and Agile/Scrum methodologies

  • Demonstrable experience setting QA strategy for a team or product, as well as writing test cases

  • A track record of owning release quality and reducing production bugs

  • Strong background in both manual and automated testing (e.g. Selenium, Cypress, Postman, or similar tools)

  • Experience with mobile test automation (e.g. Appium, Detox, or similar)

  • Extensive experience testing back-end systems through a variety of methods (REST, SQS, database, and front-end interfaces), plus experience testing web and mobile applications

  • Strong SQL skills, with familiarity in relational database tools such as DBeaver, SQL Server, or MySQL Workbench

  • Proficiency with Git or other version control systems

  • Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP); familiarity with AWS services such as EKS, RDS, SQS, and API Gateway is a plus

  • Hands-on experience with API tools such as Swagger, Bruno, and Postman

  • Experience writing and updating scripts using JavaScript

  • Skilled in exploratory testing, with a sharp eye for bugs and UX issues

  • Strong troubleshooting skills, with the ability to trace and report bugs clearly and efficiently

  • Nice to have: fintech or payments experience, and performance or load testing experience

Your first 90 days:

  • In your first 90 days as QA Lead, you'll start by getting to grips with our product, codebase, and existing QA processes, reviewing current test coverage, tooling, and workflows while getting to know your team and how they work.

  • From there, you'll begin shaping the QA strategy, identifying gaps in coverage or process, and taking hands-on ownership of test planning for upcoming releases.

  • By the 90-day mark, you'll have baselined our production bug rate, put a clear release quality gate in place, and presented your QA strategy to engineering and product leadership. You should be leading with confidence: actively mentoring your team, driving improvements to QA tooling and process, and established as a trusted voice on quality across engineering and product.

Why Mama?

At Mama Money, we're not just a company, we're a movement. Everything we do is driven by one purpose: to make life better for our customers and the communities we serve. They're our heartbeat, and they inspire every step we take.
  • Making it easier for our customers. No red tape, no hassle, just simple, seamless experiences that put people first.
  • Give it a go. We're a team of doers, dreamers, and innovators who aren't afraid to break the mould. We take bold steps, experiment with fresh ideas, and never stop learning, and if it doesn't work the first time, we give it another go.
  • Just own it. We take responsibility for our actions, our results, and how we show up every day. No passing the buck. We approach every challenge with grit, passion, and determination

Job Title

QA Analyst-Ambulatory Operations

About the Department

Join the Customer Service department at Henry Ford Health, a leader in healthcare delivery. Our team is dedicated to providing exceptional support to our members and ensuring the highest standards of quality and professionalism. We work closely with various support departments to maintain seamless operations and uphold the Henry Ford Health commitment to excellence in patient care and service.

Role Overview

As a QA Analyst-Ambulatory Operations, you will play a crucial role in maintaining and improving the quality of customer service within our call center. You will monitor staff performance, conduct audits, and provide feedback to ensure member inquiries are handled professionally and efficiently. Your work will directly contribute to enhancing the overall customer experience and supporting the operational goals of Henry Ford Health.

Why Henry Ford Health

At Henry Ford Health, we are relentless advocates for exceptional care for our patients, communities, and each other. We come to do meaningful work and grow our careers, and we stay for the connection, support, and shared pride in making the impossible, possible.

What You Will Do

  • Monitor and assess processes and workflows to ensure staff maintain quality and production measures.
  • Conduct random audits and quality checks to evaluate the handling of member inquiries.
  • Compile monitored data and participate in coaching, training, and development of department agents.
  • Facilitate calibration sessions and training for new hires and current staff on audit processes and quality expectations.
  • Provide ongoing reporting and feedback to management regarding staff performance.
  • Implement efforts to maintain or increase the quality of work performed within Customer Service.

What You Will Need

Required Qualifications

  • Experience providing coaching, feedback, and facilitating training.
  • Experience implementing process change, data analysis, and trend reporting.

  • Self-directed and self-motivated with strong interpersonal, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

What We Offer

At Henry Ford Health, we offer opportunities for career growth, collaboration with dedicated professionals, and the chance to contribute to mission-driven work. You'll engage in continuous learning and development, working alongside a supportive team committed to making a difference in healthcare.

Join Our Team

job.description:
Why NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture:

At NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, we are redefining the future of business through the power of AI and groundbreaking technologies like Agentforce. As a trusted leader in AI, AWS, and Salesforce innovation, we craft intelligent solutions—integrating Salesforce Einstein, Service Cloud Voice, Amazon Connect, Agentforce and more—to revolutionize workflows, elevate customer experiences, and deliver tangible results. From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital landscape with cutting-edge, tailored strategies.

We are proud to be creating the future of generative AI and AI agents. Salesforce has launched Agentforce, and NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, was selected as the only partner for the private beta prior to launch. Post-launch, we’ve earned the distinction of being Salesforce’s #1 partner for Agentforce, reinforcing our role as pioneers in this transformative space.

Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI-powered transformation. Here, you’ll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes. Whether you're developing advanced AI-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you’re ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you.

NeuraFlash is a leading cloud consulting and AI solutions company specializing in Salesforce, AWS, and AI-powered customer experience solutions. Our Quality Assurance practice goes beyond traditional software testing—we combine quality engineering, automation, cloud technologies, and consulting expertise to help clients deliver reliable, scalable, and intelligent solutions.

We are looking for an AWS Amazon Connect QA Consultant / Sr. QA Consultant to support complex cloud contact center implementations involving Amazon Connect, IVR/self-service, omnichannel communications, Salesforce Service Cloud Voice, APIs, and conversational/Generative AI.

This role is ideal for a QA professional with strong hands-on contact center and telephony testing experience who can independently understand complex business flows, translate technical design artifacts into comprehensive test scenarios, coordinate across multiple stakeholders, and drive testing through release readiness.

Key Responsibilities

Amazon Connect, IVR & Telephony Testing

  • Design and execute functional, integration, regression and UAT test scenarios for Amazon Connect contact centers and complex IVRs.
  • Translate Lucidchart/Visio IVR flow diagrams and requirements into detailed test scripts, ensuring complete branch/path coverage.
  • Test DTMF, speech/ASR, Amazon Lex, self-service journeys, authentication, ANI lookup, error/timeout handling, transfer, escalation and callback scenarios.
  • Validate routing profiles, queues, skills, priorities, agent states, hold/transfer/whisper flows, quick connects and supervisor functionality.
  • Test telephony fundamentals including PSTN/DID/toll-free, IVR, ACD, WebRTC, SIP, call recording and transcription.
  • Validate Amazon Connect Agent and Supervisor workspaces and use the Amazon Connect Endpoint Test Utility where applicable.

AWS, API & Salesforce Integration Testing

  • Test integrations across AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, Amazon Lex, Contact Flows, Contact Lens and CloudWatch using the AWS Console and Amazon Connect Admin workspace.
  • Perform end-to-end API testing across Amazon Connect, Salesforce and third-party systems using Postman, SoapUI, REST-assured or similar tools.
  • Validate REST/SOAP requests and responses, schemas, data mapping, authentication, error handling, timeouts and fallback scenarios.
  • Test Salesforce Service Cloud Voice (SCV) integrations including CTI controls, Omni-Channel, screen pops, Voice Call records, agent states and real-time transcription.

Chat, AI & Omnichannel Testing

  • Test Amazon Connect Chat and omnichannel customer journeys.
  • Validate conversational and Generative AI experiences using Amazon Q in Connect, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Lex, Salesforce Agentforce or similar platforms.
  • Test intent recognition, conversational flows, context, knowledge grounding, agent assist, generated responses, escalation/handoff and fallback scenarios.
  • Evaluate AI responses for accuracy, relevance, hallucinations and appropriate guardrails.

Test Data, Coordination & Delivery

  • Source, prepare and map test data to individual test scenarios and maintain clear scenario-to-data traceability.
  • Coordinate with clients, business teams, developers, architects and multiple vendors to understand E2E business processes and dependencies.
  • Lead defect triage and track issues through closure with clear evidence, logs, recordings and reproduction steps.
  • Prepare test execution reports, quality metrics, test evidence and release/go-no-go recommendations.

Automation & Performance Testing

  • Experience with IVR automation tools such as Cyara, Empirix Hammer, Bespoken, Operata or similar.
  • Support API, voice and chat test automation and CI/CD-based continuous testing.
  • Experience planning and executing load/performance testing using JMeter, LoadRunner, NeoLoad or equivalent tools is desirable.

Must-Have Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of overall QA/testing experience, including 3+ years in contact center, CTI, IVR, telephony or cloud contact center platforms.
  • Strong hands-on Amazon Connect testing experience, preferably with complex IVR and self-service implementations.
  • Proven ability to read Lucidchart/Visio IVR designs and independently convert them into comprehensive functional test scripts.
  • Strong understanding of IVR, ACD/routing, DTMF, ASR, PSTN, DID/toll-free, call recording and transcription.
  • Hands-on experience with Amazon Connect Admin workspace and AWS Console, including Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, Lex and Contact Flows.
  • Experience testing Amazon Connect Agent/Supervisor workspace and Chat.
  • Experience with Amazon Q in Connect, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Lex or other conversational/Generative AI platforms.
  • Strong API and integration testing experience using Postman, SoapUI, REST-assured or equivalent.
  • Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud Voice / CTI / Omni-Channel is highly desirable.
  • Strong test planning, test case design, regression testing, defect management and release readiness experience.
  • Experience with Jira, qTest, QMetry, TestRail, Zephyr or equivalent test management tools.

Good-to-Have

  • Experience with Cyara, Empirix Hammer or other IVR automation tools.
  • Load, performance and/or security testing experience.
  • Experience validating Generative AI quality, hallucinations, grounding and guardrails.
  • Salesforce SOQL/reporting, Amazon Connect metrics, Contact Lens and CloudWatch experience.
  • Multi-language IVR/chat testing.
  • Experience with Genesys, Cisco, Avaya, Twilio or other contact center platforms.

What You'll Bring

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a quality engineering mindset.
  • Ability to work independently in complex, multi-vendor consulting environments.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to identify gaps in requirements, test data, integrations and E2E business processes.
  • Ability to clearly communicate quality risks and provide data-driven release readiness recommendations.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law.

What’s it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture?

  • Remote & In-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or you're one of over half of our NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we’re focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team.
  • Travel: Get ready to pack your bags and hit the road! For certain roles, travel is an exciting part of the job, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 25%. So, if you have a passion for adventure and don't mind a little jet-setting, this opportunity could be your ticket to exploring new places while making a positive impact on clients.
  • Flexibility: Do you have to take the dog to the vet, pick up the kids from school, or the in-laws from the airport? We know that a perfect 9-5 isn’t possible. So you have to jump out to do any of those, no problem! We build a culture of trust and understanding. We value good work not the hours in which you get it done
  • Collaboration: You have a voice here! If you work with a team of smart people like we do, it’s a no-brainer to take suggestions and feedback on how to keep NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture thriving. Our executive team holds town halls & company meetings where they address any suggestions or questions asked, no matter how big or small.
  • Celebrate Often: We take our work seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Whether it is an arm wrestling contest, costume party, or ugly holiday sweaters our teams love to have fun. And while we work hard, we don’t forget to slow down and celebrate the big things and the small things together.

job.title: Associate Director of CMC - Quality Assurance
job.description:
Life at BMS

At RayzeBio, every day is an opportunity to ignite meaningful change. As a wholly-owned subsidiary of Bristol Myers Squibb, RayzeBio blends the nimble, pioneering spirit of an emergent biotech with the global expertise and resources of a leading innovator in oncology. Our mission is to develop transformative radiopharmaceutical therapies that offer new hope for patients living with cancer. Here, you’ll join a multidisciplinary team where your ideas are valued, your expertise is amplified, and collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. From day one, expect to make an immediate impact—on our science, on our teams, and most importantly, on patients. Learn more about RayzeBio:


Summary

The Associate Director of Chemistry, Manufacturing & Controls (CMC) - Quality Assurance develops and drives Quality (manufacturing and analytical) strategies for CMC activities (drug substance, API, drug product, and analytics) for compounds in Development (radiopharmaceuticals). The incumbent will be responsible for multiple projects which may be at the Indianapolis site, San Diego, and/or CMOs.

Job Responsibilities

Essential duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  • Member of CMC Development Teams providing Quality (QA) input from pre-clinical to end of product life cycle including NDA filing, other market filings, and post approval changes. Partners with technical SMEs to develop and approve the CMC strategy (DS, DP, and analytical strategy) for new drug candidates.
  • Responsible for change control management, for compound/product specific changes, through the product lifecycle to include impact assessments, tracking, and implementation. Also, as appropriate and compound/product specific, responsible Quality member for oversight and QA approver of all key Quality System deliverables associated with the drug development candidate including proactive Initiatives, Deviations, Investigations, CAPAs, and Complaints.
  • Review and approve compound/product specific analytical method life cycle documents (e.g., API and bulk drug product specifications, analytical test methods (including micro), and protocols/reports); including stability.
  • Work with CMC Teams to conduct compound/product specific risk assessments, as required, for all aspects of the drug development process. Responsible for communicating Quality risks within the Quality organization.
  • Collaborate with Regulatory to track/own Quality input for ongoing regulatory filings and updates to Health Authorities (e.g. IND/IMPD/BLA/NDA) including specifications, shelf-life extensions, country specific trial approvals, etc.
  • Performs other tasks as assigned (e.g., final Quality reviewer/approver of Quality events and/or GMP documentation, actively contributes to ongoing investigations as required).

Education and Experience

  • Minimum of B.S. degree, preferably in Chemistry, Biochemistry, or a similar Scientific field.
  • Ten plus years of hands-on biologics/sterile experience within a development/operations facility (manufacturing and/or analytical).
  • Prior experience in Quality is preferred.
  • An equivalent combination of education and experience may be substituted

Skills and Qualifications

  • Thorough knowledge of the Pharmaceutical Development processes as evidenced by bringing multiple INDs through to successful BLA/NDA approval. Knowledge of bulk biologic drug substance (monoclonal antibody, bispecific, etc.), parenteral (cold chain liquid/lyophilized form) drug product, cell/gene therapy product process development/manufacturing, and/or development/manufacturing of radiopharmaceuticals is required.
  • Recognized as a CMC expert, radiopharmaceuticals and/or biologics, with an ability to introduce best practices into the quality management systems.
  • Thorough understanding of cGMPs and regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, EU, ICH).
  • Well-versed in relevant CMC area, with an ability to introduce Quality-relevant (phase appropriate) best practices into the CMC development processes.
  • Excellent investigational and QA problem-solving skills. Analytical mindset, with an ability to assess new situations to define and implement the appropriate QA action plan.
  • Ability to work independently, yet effectively in a team environment.
  • Superior attention to detail, excellent review skills and the ability to organize and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Teamwork oriented with the ability to work effectively across functional groups and teams to ensure requirements are met (e.g., early phase, late phase, regulatory).
  • Other proven competencies such as strategic thinker, influencer and negotiator are required.
  • Continuous improvement mindset is also required.
  • Applies AI to improve team execution and decision‑making

Physical Demands

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, reach with hands and arms, and talk or hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 30 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and distance vision.

This is a position that requires working in a GMP cleanroom environment, wearing protective clothing, and handling of radioactive materials.

Work Environment

The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. Work-related travel may be required up to 20% of working time (e.g., 10 weeks per year).



We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Remote - United States - US: $164,838 - $199,745

The starting pay range(s) listed above is for full-time employees (FTE). You may also be eligible for additional discretionary incentive cash and stock opportunities. Final compensation is guided by pay equity principles and applicable employment laws. Compensation programs are reviewed on an ongoing basis and may be adjusted over time to reflect evolving market factors, and individual, team or Company performance.


Benefits:


Subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans then in effect, you may be eligible to participate in our comprehensive benefit plans – including wellbeing support, retirement and financial protection benefits, and insurance offerings (medical, dental, vision, life and disability).


U.S.-based exempt employees are eligible for Flexible Time Off (FTO), which provides paid time off without a set accrual limit, subject to manager approval, along with 11 paid company holidays each year.

Depending on eligibility, employees may also have access to additional time-off benefits, including paid sick leave, up to two paid volunteer days per year, summer hours flexibility, and leaves of absence for medical, personal, parental, caregiver, bereavement, or military needs. Eligible employees also enjoy an annual Global Shutdown between Christmas Day and New Year's Day.

job.description:
Location: India (Remote)

Salary:2,000,000 - 2,500,000 INR/year (DOE)

About Cognisys

Cognisys is a global cybersecurity company specialising in Penetration Testing, GRC Consulting and Managed Security services. We work with organisations across more than 30 countries, helping them identify risk, strengthen their security posture and navigate an increasingly complex cybersecurity landscape.

We're a small but mighty team with ambitious plans for growth. We combine deep technical expertise with a strong focus on customer service, practical advice and delivering meaningful outcomes for our clients.

Our people are at the heart of what we do. We value Together, Ownership, Momentum and Excellence, and we're looking for people who are curious, collaborative and willing to take ownership of their work.

As we continue to grow, you'll have the opportunity to work alongside experienced cybersecurity professionals, contribute to challenging client engagements and help shape how we deliver our services. We believe in giving our people the opportunity to develop, share ideas and make a genuine impact.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Penetration Tester to join our growing team and help clients identify and address security weaknesses across a range of technical environments.

You'll deliver security assessments across networks, applications, APIs, mobile platforms and cloud infrastructure, using a combination of automated tools and manual testing techniques to simulate real-world attack scenarios and identify meaningful vulnerabilities.

This is a client-facing role, so technical ability is only part of the picture. You'll also need to produce high-quality reports, explain findings clearly and help clients understand the potential impact of vulnerabilities and the practical steps they can take to improve their security.

You'll work closely with the wider cybersecurity team, contribute to the quality of our penetration testing services and continue developing your technical expertise as the threat landscape evolves.

About You

We're looking for someone with a strong technical foundation in offensive security who enjoys investigating how systems can be compromised and helping organisations improve their security.

You'll be curious, methodical and comfortable working through technical challenges. You'll also understand that good penetration testing involves more than finding vulnerabilities: it means validating the risks, explaining their significance and giving clients recommendations they can act on.

You should be comfortable taking responsibility for your work, managing competing priorities and working collaboratively with colleagues and clients.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Hands-on experience conducting penetration tests or security assessments.

  • Experience using vulnerability scanning tools alongside manual testing and exploitation techniques.

  • A solid understanding of offensive security methodologies, tools and techniques.

  • Practical experience assessing technical security controls, identifying weaknesses and validating vulnerabilities.

  • Experience in one or more of the following areas:

    • Network penetration testing

    • Web application testing

    • API testing

    • Mobile application testing

    • Cloud security testing

  • Strong analytical, investigative and problem-solving skills.

  • The ability to document technical findings accurately and produce clear, actionable reports.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks to non-technical audiences.

  • A professional approach to client engagement and customer service.

  • The ability to manage workload, prioritise tasks and deliver work to agreed deadlines.

  • A proactive approach to learning and keeping up to date with developments in offensive security.

Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Experience working in a cybersecurity consultancy or professional services environment.

  • Exposure to a broad range of technologies, infrastructure and client environments.

  • Experience presenting findings and remediation recommendations directly to clients.

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.

  • Experience testing APIs and mobile applications.

  • An interest in emerging attack techniques, security research and the continued development of penetration testing tools and methodologies.

Certifications

The following certifications are highly regarded:

Industry-recognised penetration testing certifications are highly regarded and may include:

  • OSCP

  • CPSA

  • CRT

  • CREST-related certifications

  • Other relevant offensive security or penetration testing certifications

Certifications are valued, but practical experience and the ability to demonstrate hands-on technical capability are equally important.

What Success Looks Like

  • Success in this role means delivering technically sound penetration tests while building client confidence through clear communication, reliable delivery and practical recommendations.

  • You'll know you're succeeding when you:

  • Deliver thorough, accurate and professional penetration testing engagements across a variety of client environments.

  • Confidently combine automated scanning with manual testing and exploitation to identify and validate meaningful vulnerabilities.

  • Demonstrate a practical understanding of how security controls can be tested, bypassed and exploited in realistic attack scenarios.

  • Produce clear, well-evidenced reports that explain vulnerabilities, their potential impact and actionable remediation steps.

  • Communicate findings effectively to technical teams and non-technical stakeholders, helping clients understand and prioritise risk.

  • Take ownership of your engagements, managing testing, documentation, deadlines and deliverables effectively.

  • Build positive client relationships and contribute to a professional, helpful client experience throughout each engagement.

  • Keep your technical knowledge current by learning about emerging vulnerabilities, tools, attack techniques and industry developments.

  • Share knowledge with colleagues and contribute to improving Cognisys' penetration testing methodologies and ways of working.

Why Join Us?

At Cognisys, you will be part of a collaborative and innovative team that values your input and shares support. You'll have the opportunity to work on challenging projects that make a real impact for our clients. We'd love to hear from you if you want to challenge, lead and innovate! We're not just about the work; we're about the people. Join a team where innovation is celebrated, and your contributions are valued. We foster a collaborative environment where fresh ideas thrive, and professional growth is encouraged.

What we Offer:

  • Annual Leave: 23 days per year plus 10 Indian public holidays (5 national plus 5 state holidays of your choosing).

  • Additional Leave: 1 day of paid leave for your Birthday.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Individual healthcare insurance plan and access to an employee mental health and wellbeing platform.

  • Professional Development: £2,000 annual training budget to support your continued learning and career growth.

  • Referral Bonus: help to grow our team and earn up to £2,000 per successful referral.

Applications

We’re always happy to help with questions, but to keep our process fair for everyone, we’re unable to accept applications via email—please apply directly through the job advert page.

Please feel free to reach out to Andrea, our Talent Acquisition Lead, if you would like any further information, to discuss accessibility requirements, or if you require this information provided in an alternative format –

We welcome applications from candidates from a range of diverse backgrounds and can make various reasonable adjustments to consider individual needs.

Hello! We are GoFasti, a Talent-as-a-Service. GoFasti bridges the gap between world-class developers and designers from LatAm and first-class companies around the globe.

Note for Candidates Approached Directly:

Thank you!

job.title: Principal Software Engineer in Test
job.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Natera is seeking a highly technical, hands-on Principal Software Engineer in Test to define and own the end-to-end test automation strategy across all products in the Women's Health, Organ Health, and EB (WH/OH/EB) vertical. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain scalable backend automation suites to validate critical workflows across distributed microservice architectures, guaranteeing data integrity from order entry and lab processing to clinical reporting. You will drive innovation by leveraging AI-assisted practices and large language models to automate test case generation, streamline log analysis, and enhance CI/CD execution speed.

As a Principal level individual contributor, you will set technical direction for quality engineering across multiple teams. You will partner with engineering, bioinformatics, laboratory operations, and Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs (QA/RA) leaders, and mentor engineers to build quality into the development process instead of inspecting it at the end. As a principal-level individual contributor, you will set technical direction and serve as a key organizational voice across teams. You will leverage strong interpersonal skills, clear communication, and deep technical credibility to align engineering groups, establish architectural standards, and elevate quality practices through peer leadership and technical influence.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Architect, build, and maintain a shared, reusable end-to-end test automation framework covering UI, API, event-driven/messaging, data pipeline, and integration testing across complex distributed systems.
  • Integrate automated testing into the GitLab CI/CD pipelines so that tests run on every change, report clearly, and block releases on regression.
  • Design and stand up ephemeral and persistent test environments, along with service virtualization and mocking for upstream and downstream dependencies.
  • Implement tools and procedures to maintain persistent test environments including, but not limited to, configuration settings, infrastructure updates and removal of deprecated services or tools.
  • Establish test data management practices, including synthetic and de-identified data, version-controlled fixtures, and automated loading of golden datasets into pipelines under test.
  • Partner with bioinformatics scientists and verification and validation teams to automate execution of golden-dataset regression suites against bioinformatics pipelines and to track concordance over time.
  • Ensure automated testing produces objective evidence that satisfies design control and regulatory requirements, including requirements-to-test traceability, verification reports, and audit-ready records.
  • Drive non-functional testing strategy: performance, load, reliability, and security testing in collaboration with platform and security teams.
  • Set coding standards, review practices, and patterns for test code, and evaluate and introduce new tools where they materially improve speed or coverage.
  • Mentor Software Engineers in Test and developers; lead communities of practice and help teams adopt shift-left testing.
  • Analyze defect trends and escaped defects, lead root cause analysis, and drive systemic improvements.
  • Act as the senior technical voice for quality in planning, design reviews, and release decisions.
  • Perform debugging and root cause analysis of product issues or defects.
  • Perform system analysis, assess risk, and develop strong test strategies by analyzing product design and technical specifications, and by collaborating with product managers and developers.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience.
  • 15+ years of hands-on experience in software development or test automation, with a strong track record of building and scaling test frameworks for enterprise-grade distributed systems..
  • Demonstrated track record of designing and leading adoption of a test automation framework across multiple teams or products, not just contributing to one.
  • Experience testing complex, distributed, multi-service systems end to end, including asynchronous and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience working in a regulated environment (CLIA/CAP laboratory, medical device, pharma, or similar) is strongly preferred.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Expert-level programming skills in Java and/or Python, and the ability to write production-quality test code.
  • Deep hands-on experience with modern automation tools and libraries, such as Playwright, Selenium, JUnit/TestNG, pytest, REST Assured, and contract testing (for example, Pact).
  • Experience testing Kafka or other messaging systems, REST/gRPC APIs, and data pipelines.
  • Strong CI/CD experience (GitLab CI preferred), plus Docker and Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code for test environments.
  • Experience with AWS and cloud-native test environment design.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience validating data integrity across systems.
  • Strong knowledge of Linux and command-line scripting.
  • Familiarity with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and Part 820, and computer system validation concepts.
  • Experience with test management and traceability tools (for example, Jama, Jira/Xray, TestRail).
  • Exposure to bioinformatics pipelines, LIMS, or genomic data formats (FASTQ, BAM, VCF) is a plus; no biology background required.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence engineering leaders and explain quality risk to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Pragmatic judgment about where automation pays off and where it does not.
  • Solid understanding of QA methodologies, test planning, system dependencies, and product integration phases.
The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.
Remote USA
$124,800—$156,000 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit .

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents.

Link:

Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @ email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes.

job.title: Senior QA Engineer - Europe (m/w/d)
job.description:
Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

  • Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)
  • Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding
  • Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays
  • Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material
  • The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers
  • As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules
  • An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

JOB SUMMARY

We’re looking for a Senior QA Engineer who combines strong Playwright and TypeScript engineering skills with a proactive, collaborative mindset. You'll be a key contributor to how we deliver quality, raising the bar for our automation codebase and partnering closely with engineering to define how testing responsibility is shared across the team.

You’ll join our dynamic and growing Product Engineering team at Storyblok, playing an instrumental role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our flagship CMS platform. This platform empowers businesses to create and deliver seamless digital content experiences.

In this role, you'll work closely with product owners, designers, and developers to design and maintain clean, scalable, well-architected TypeScript automation, establish clear guidelines on which test level is right for a given change, and continuously refine QA strategies to maintain best-in-class software quality. Your work will directly contribute to delivering an exceptional user experience by ensuring flawless performance across every facet of our application.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

  • Own projects end-to-end with clarity, technical excellence, and accountability, ensuring high-quality standards across teams.
  • Champion strong TypeScript engineering practices and coding standards across the QA codebase, promoting engineering excellence and driving continuous improvement.
  • Design, implement, and maintain efficient, well-typed, and reliable automated tests across frontend and backend using Playwright.
  • Raise the team's TypeScript bar: introduce stronger typing patterns, reusable abstractions, linting/tooling standards, and code review practices that improve maintainability across the automation codebase.
  • Partner with engineering to define, implement, and enforce the test pyramid in practice, establishing clear guidelines on which test level (unit, integration, E2E) is appropriate for a given change, and driving adoption so both developers and QAs consistently write tests at the right level.
  • Perform manual and exploratory testing; document, track, and verify defects to ensure product excellence and analyze test results and monitor key testing metrics to identify patterns and opportunities for improvement.
  • Participate actively in project kick-offs to understand requirements, anticipate risks, and influence testability from the earliest stages.
  • Identify and communicate issues, risks, or dependencies early, escalating to product leadership when necessary.
  • Mentor and support teammates on TypeScript proficiency and Playwright best practices, fostering an open, empathetic environment that encourages learning and feedback.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • 7+ years of relevant experience as a QA Engineer or Software Engineer in Test.
  • Deep proficiency in TypeScript, including a strong command of advanced typing and code architecture, as well as Playwright.
  • Practical experience partnering with engineers to define and roll out test pyramid guidelines, including setting expectations for which test level is appropriate and holding both developers and QAs accountable for following them.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) and experience creating and maintaining containerized test environments.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence and align across technical and product teams.
  • High attention to detail, proven ability to deliver results, and a strong motivation to contribute to organizational growth in a high-performing environment.
  • Experience mentoring engineers, defining and driving TypeScript and test automation standards across teams.
  • Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience writing and maintaining Ruby on Rails code.
  • Experience with observability and error tracking tools (e.g., Grafana, Kibana, Sentry) and identifying errors, trends, and issues.
  • Experience with performance testing and best practices.

MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS

Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space

GENERAL TERMS

Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. You can find more information about our privacy policyhere.

All communications regarding job opportunities at Storyblok will come from an official Storyblok employee with an email address ending in @storyblok.com. We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain ().

job.description:
We are NeoPollard Interactive. Digitally born, player-focused, and proudly powering the most profitable iLottery programs in North America through our interactive games, powerful gaming systems, and comprehensive suite of player services.

We are innovative. From inception, innovation has been the core of NPi. As one of the first iLottery platform providers in North America, we laid the groundwork — helping pioneer the introduction and successful launch of some of the first iLottery programs in the U.S. We deliver innovative solutions and cutting-edge technology to our partners with an industry-proven track record of revenue growth.

We are one-of-a-kind. The only Lottery supplier in North America exclusively focused on iLottery. We have one central focus; creating the most intuitive and fun iLottery experiences for players. Our sole focus drives our innovation and success in the iLottery space.

We are industry experts. Serving the largest share of U.S. Lotteries that currently sell online with a track record of powering iLottery success through our state-of-the-art technology, top-performing game content, and innovative and comprehensive iLottery services.

We are NPi. Join us.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

We’re looking for a detail-driven and passionate iGaming QA Analyst - Games Tester to join our Games Portfolio Management team. You’ll play a vital role in ensuring our games are polished, functional, and fun — across every device and platform.

Location: This position is open to candidates residing in the following U.S. states: Colorado, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, North Carolina, New Jersey, New Mexico, Ohio, Rhode Island, and Virginia.

Position Duration: This is a temporary position anticipated to continue through June 2027, with the potential for extension based on business needs.

Duties:

  • Test and verify the functionality, usability and performance of casino and online games across desktop, mobile (iOS/Android). and tablet devices.
  • Identify bugs, glitches, or inconsistencies in gameplay, UI/UX, and game logic.
  • Create, execute, and maintain comprehensive test plans and test cases.
  • Provide detailed test documentation on UAT/Production
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including Product to define UAT scenarios and acceptance criteria
  • Validate fixes and game updates in both staging and production environments.
  • Write, maintain, and execute automated regression and functional test scripts using frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or Appium.
  • Identify high-yield manual test cases and convert them into stable, reusable automated tests for web, mobile, and desktop applications.
  • Support go-live activities and post-implementation testing (including game releases, platform releases and proper reporting)
  • Manage connection requests for UAT/Production and go-live logistics
  • Collect and manage all supporting documentation
  • Other duties as assigned

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

  • BA/BS in a quantitative discipline –Information Technology or Business degree preferred or years of experience in lieu of degree
  • 3+ years previous experience in game testing, ideally in the online gaming or iGaming space.
  • Strong understanding of QA processes, test case creation, and bug reporting.
  • Hands-on experience testing across multiple devices and platforms (desktop, mobile browsers, native apps).
  • An eye for detail and a passion for playing and analyzing games.
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Familiarity with casino games (e.g., slots, blackjack, roulette) is a strong plus.
  • Bonus: Knowledge of automation testing tools or scripting experience.

WHY WORK AT NPI?

We hire the best.

We prioritize innovation.

We support and empower our team.

Join us as we continue to shape the future of the iLottery industry by delivering players’ favorite games across all channels and driving outstanding returns for good causes.

Our team member benefits include…

•Comprehensive Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance

•Life Insurance & AD&D Insurance

•Generous RRSP Contribution

•Paid Vacation and Personal Time

•Wellness and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

•Company-Provided Laptop and Cellphone

•Career Development Opportunities including Ongoing Training and Professional Development Courses (Including the NPi Leadership Academy for Emerging Leaders)

•Quarterly Profit-Sharing Program for All Employees Who Have Completed Six Months of Continuous Service

•Paid Parental Leave Program

ABOUT NEOPOLLARD INTERACTIVE

Born in the digital domain, NeoPollard Interactive LLC (“NPi”) is an award-winning supplier of best-in-class iLottery solutions to the North American lottery market. Serving the largest share of U.S. lotteries that currently sell online, NPi helped pioneer the successful introduction of iLottery in the U.S. and is North America’s proven partner of choice to enable regulated lotteries to design and deploy complex gaming solutions in support of generating incremental revenue for good causes through the online channel. NPi offers cutting-edge technology, a full suite of managed services, and the industry’s top-performing game content as part of its innovative and comprehensive approach to partnering for iLottery success. job.title: Freelance Software Tester | Remote (Malaysia)
job.description:
Do you have a Bank Muamalat bank account? Would you like to earn extra income by helping improve digital payment experiences? We'd love to hear from you!

About Testlio

Hi there! We're Testlio, a global software testing company that has been helping businesses improve their digital products since 2012.
We work with companies around the world to test websites, mobile apps, and online payment systems. Our freelance community helps us identify issues and make sure these products work as expected for real customers.
Learn more about us at www.testlio.com.

We're looking for people in Malaysia to help test online payments for an international social media technology company.

Requirements

  • Location: Currently living in Malaysia
  • Payment method: Have an existing, active Bank Muamalat bank account.
  • Comfortable following written instructions and sharing feedback in English. 
  • Have access to a smartphone.
  • Work type: Remote, freelance, and flexible.

What You'll Do

  • Follow simple, step-by-step instructions from our testing team.
  • Complete small, authorized test purchases using your existing Bank Muamalat bank account.
  • Check whether payments are successful or if any errors appear.
  • Share your results, transaction confirmations and report any issues, including screenshots when needed. Guidance will be provided to protect your sensitive information.

Why do we need local testers?
Payment methods work differently from country to country. A transaction that works in one country might fail in another.
That's why we need people who live locally and have access to the payment methods customers actually use.
Your role is to help us check whether payments work correctly and report any issues you find.
No previous software testing experience is required.

Privacy & Security

We take the protection of personal and financial information seriously.
You'll only be asked to complete authorized testing activities. Never share passwords, full card numbers, or sensitive account information in your reports.

Interested in joining us?
Apply through our official Testlio Work Opportunities page. If your profile matches the project requirements, our team will reach out with the next steps.
All official email communications will come from a @testlio.com email address, so please keep an eye on your inbox!

job.title: Salesforce QA Analyst
job.description:
TriTech Enterprise Systems is seeking a 'Salesforce QA Analyst ' to a State of Maryland contract. This role is critical in ensuring the quality and reliability of Salesforce implementations across Salesforce Sales Cloud, Salesforce Service Cloud, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Contact Center solutions, Salesforce Education Cloud, and integrations with enterprise and third-party systems. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on QA experience, a deep understanding of Salesforce architecture, and the ability to independently lead testing efforts across multiple initiatives. This role operates within an agile, enterprise environment and partners closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, business-aligned solutions.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and execute comprehensive test strategies, test plans, and test cases aligned with business and technical requirements.
  • Perform functional testing across Salesforce modules, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and custom-built components.
  • Validate Salesforce configurations such as workflows, validation rules, reports, dashboards, profiles, roles, and security settings.
  • Conduct end-to-end integration testing between Salesforce and external systems (e.g., APIs, middleware platforms, data systems).
  • Lead and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by partnering with business stakeholders to ensure real-world scenario validation.
  • Execute regression testing for releases, patches, and enhancements to maintain system stability.
  • Ensure data integrity and accuracy across standard and custom objects through detailed validation and reconciliation.
  • Log, track, and validate defects using tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar platforms.
  • Maintain high-quality test documentation, including test plans, execution results, and defect reports.
  • Collaborate with QA leads, developers, business analysts, product owners, and platform teams to ensure alignment with quality standards and delivery timelines.
  • Manage and prioritize testing efforts across multiple concurrent projects and releases.
  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives, including test standardization, automation readiness, and QA best practices.
  • Develop subject matter expertise (SME) in assigned Salesforce modules and business domains.
Required Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of QA experience, with at least 5+ years focused on Salesforce testing.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Lightning Experience.
  • Strong understanding of the Salesforce data model, including standard and custom objects, relationships, and validation rules.
  • Ability to review and validate Apex, Visualforce, and Lightning components from a QA perspective.
  • Experience with integration testing involving APIs, middleware, and third-party platforms.
  • Proficiency in writing and executing SOQL queries for data validation and analysis.
  • Experience with test and defect management tools such as Azure DevOps.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills, with the ability to engage both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Salesforce-related certifications are preferred.
Notes:
  • 40 hours per week (no overtime)
  • 100% Remote
We are an equal opportunity employer. Candidate must be an employee of TriTech Enterprise Systems.

job.title: Staff Performance Engineer, JavaScript Engine (SpiderMonkey)
job.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About this team and role:

The JavaScript team at Mozilla works to make Firefox's industry-leading JavaScript engine SpiderMonkey even more performant. We push the boundaries of what the web is capable of, shaping the future of the JavaScript language through standardization at TC39, while keeping in mind the fundamental principle of “don’t break the web.”

As a Staff Software Engineer on the SpiderMonkey team, you'll be a domain expert who drives the engine's runtime performance forward, from the interpreter and JITs to the garbage collector, while also helping maintain and advance the health of a large, mature C++ codebase. You'll typically lead performance projects within the team, planning the work and mitigating the risk yourself, and you'll mentor other engineers as you take on increasingly ambiguous, high-impact problems.

What you’ll do: 

  • Lead runtime performance initiatives: Own projects to improve SpiderMonkey's runtime performance, from profiling and identifying bottlenecks to designing and landing optimizations across the interpreter, JITs, and garbage collector.
  • Provide technical leadership to the team: Mitigate risk for the performance projects you own, planning work that may start out ambiguous and require significant up-front design and prototyping.
  • Maintain and advance the codebase: Help preserve the correctness and stability of a large, mature C++ codebase while improving its architecture and maintainability as the JavaScript language and the engine continue to evolve.
  • Track and shape the JavaScript standard: Work with the JavaScript team to keep up with the evolving TC39 standard, and help evaluate proposals where performance or implementation tradeoffs are involved.
  • Strengthen engine security: Collaborate with the Fuzzing team to identify and close security issues in the JavaScript engine.
  • Mentor and elevate the team: Mentor other engineers by stewarding some of your existing responsibilities to more junior team members as you take on new, larger initiatives, and help the team build stronger performance-analysis and benchmarking practices.
  • Communicate clearly: Turn team strategy and goals into concrete action for the projects you lead, and communicate progress, tradeoffs, and technical decisions clearly to your team and to partner teams.
  • Use AI tools day to day: Incorporate AI-assisted tools into your workflow for debugging, prototyping, code analysis, and development.

What you’ll bring: 

  • 5+ years developing C++ applications
  • Demonstrated expertise in systems programming, including direct experience with one or more of: compilers, garbage collectors, interpreters, and virtual machines
  • Strong background in performance analysis, profiling, and benchmarking on large and complex software
  • Experience with general systems architecture (x86, x64, ARM, ARM64, etc.)
  • A track record of technical leadership: planning ambiguous projects, sequencing project work, and mitigating risk with minimal help
  • Experience mentoring other engineers and helping raise a team's technical standards
  • Creative problem solver with strong debugging skills and a detailed approach to code review
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable turning team strategy into action and communicating tradeoffs to peers
  • Comfortable incorporating AI assisted tools into your day-to-day engineering workflow

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days when everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla 

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission.  We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at hiringaccommodation@mozilla.com to request accommodation.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws.  Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.
