job.title: Lead QA Engineer
job.description:
About the Role

As a Lead QA Engineer, you'll own testing strategy and quality standards across our most important work; Deciding what should be automated, what needs a human eye, where the real risk is hiding, and acting on it. You'll work hands-on across both manual and automated testing, splitting your time based on what a given release actually needs, while mentoring other engineers and acting as the go-to voice on quality across projects. You've got the critical thinking skills to chase down a hard bug yourself, know when to ask for help and delegate, and the range to set direction for how the whole team approaches quality. You seek to help your coworkers and do so regularly.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead test strategy and quality standards across multiple projects, deciding what warrants automated coverage versus focused manual and exploratory testing.
  • Build and maintain automated test suites in Playwright, and use BrowserStack to validate compatibility across browsers, devices, and platforms.
  • Define and run deep manual and exploratory testing on new, ambiguous, or high-change-rate work where automation isn't the right investment yet.
  • Translate requirements into concrete test plans and acceptance criteria, catching gaps in the requirements themselves before they become gaps in the product.
  • Act as the technical point of contact for quality with stakeholders: communicate risk, resolve disagreements about scope, and negotiate realistic testing timelines.
  • Write clear, actionable defect reports in Jira, drive them to resolution, and verify fixes actually hold up under retest rather than just passing a second glance.
  • Use Jira's linking and epic structure to keep testing work traceable, and flag workflow friction in the board with the team before it slows down the SDLC.
  • Mentor other QA engineers in both manual technique and automation practice, including how to write tickets clearly and so well that they need no follow-up clarification, raising the bar on testing across the team, not just on your own projects.
  • Step into any project at any phase to assess its quality risk and recommend a concrete path forward.
  • Stay ahead of testing tools and practices worth adopting, and bring the right ones into real workflows deliberately.
  • Operate and champion the use of AI tooling with an understanding that its output is useful, but not infallible. You treat AI as a tool, not a coworker.

Craft & Leadership Balance

Estimated 60% leadership, 40% craft.

Qualifications

Required

  • 6-8 years of experience in software quality assurance or testing, ideally with exposure to consulting or multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Strong, hands-on experience with Playwright for building and maintaining automated test suites and frameworks.
  • Experience using BrowserStack (or a comparable cross-browser/device testing platform) to validate compatibility across platforms.
  • Deep grounding in manual, exploratory, and regression testing, with the judgment to know when automation is and isn't the right investment.
  • Proven ability to translate ambiguous requirements into concrete, actionable test plans and acceptance criteria.
  • Strong Jira practice: writing tickets so well that no follow-up or clarification is needed, using issue-linking for traceability, and spotting workflow friction before it becomes a team-wide problem.
  • Experience testing across a range of CMS or SaaS platforms rather than a single stack, since our client environments vary and this role needs to move between them.
  • Exceedingly strong communication skills, including presenting technical risk and testing tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. It cannot be stressed enough how important this item is: communication is the whole ballgame.
  • Prior experience as a technical or testing lead on large or multi-phase projects.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with performance testing (e.g. Lighthouse) and accessibility testing (e.g. Axe, WCAG guidelines).
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with structured test-case formats (e.g. Gherkin) and test case management tooling.
  • A track record of debugging and performance investigation at scale.
  • Creation and implementation of SDLC processes and norms at project and team scales.

Why Current

At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.

We’re a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex technical challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates.

You’ll have the opportunity to work across a variety of clients and technologies, contribute to meaningful digital experiences, and help shape the future of engineering within a growing agency environment.

The target range of base compensation for this role is $85,000 - $110,000 annually. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

job.title: QA Analyst
job.description:
Taking applications from CT, FL, GA, IL, IN, IA, MD, MA, MI, NH, NY, NC, OH, RI, SC, TN, TX, VA
We are seeking a Quality Assurance (QA) Analyst to lead testing across the websites, platforms, and campaigns we build for clients. You bring 3+ years of QA experience, expertise in WCAG 2.2 accessibility, and a modern automation toolkit.
You will own test strategy for complex Sitecore and Drupal builds, keep our clients ahead of ADA Title II, Section 508, and European Accessibility Act requirements, and use AI tools to make our QA practice faster and more thorough. You will also help us test the AI features our clients are now launching, from chatbots to AI powered search and personalization.

RESPONSIBLITIES:
  • Test strategy and leadership
    • Develop and manage test strategies, plans, and cases for websites, landing pages, emails, banners, and other digital products.
    • Lead QA across multiple concurrent client projects and own release readiness calls.
    • Partner with business analysts, developers, designers, and strategists early in each project to define acceptance criteria and shift testing left.
  • Functional and automated testing
    • Perform manual and automated testing, including functional, regression, integration, cross browser, and device testing.
    • Build and maintain automated test suites (Playwright preferred) and run them in CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
    • Lead regression testing for platform upgrades and migrations, including Drupal 10 to 11 upgrades and Sitecore XP to SitecoreAI (formerly XM Cloud) moves.
    • Run visual regression testing to catch layout and component issues across releases.
    • Validate integrations, forms, and APIs, including CRM connections such as Slate and Salesforce.
    • Verify analytics, tag management, and consent behavior (GA4, Google Tag Manager, cookie consent tools).
    • Monitor performance and Core Web Vitals and flag regressions before launch.
  • Accessibility
    • Conduct accessibility audits against WCAG 2.2 AA using automated tools, manual review, and screen reader testing.
    • Test documents and PDFs for accessibility, along with web pages and mobile experiences.
    • Author VPATs and Accessibility Conformance Reports (ACRs) for clients.
    • Advise teams on remediation and help clients meet ADA Title II, Section 508, and European Accessibility Act obligations.
    • Build automated accessibility checks into CI pipelines so issues are caught on every build.
  • AI in QA
    • Use AI tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar) to speed up test case design, script writing, and audit documentation, while validating all output.
    • Test client AI features such as chatbots, AI search, and personalization for accuracy, accessibility, and responsible behavior.
  • Reporting
    • Identify, document, and track defects, and work with development teams to resolve them.
    • Deliver clear test reports to internal and client stakeholders covering results, defect status, accessibility conformance, and release readiness.
QUALIFICATIONS:
  1. 1-3+ years in QA, with strong manual and automated testing experience.
  2. Knowledge of WCAG 2.2 and hands on experience finding and remediating accessibility issues.
  3. Working knowledge of ADA Title II, Section 508, and the European Accessibility Act.
  4. Experience testing Sitecore (XP, XM, or SitecoreAI) and Drupal (10 or 11) sites, including headless front ends.

This role will focus on ensuring the stability, quality and successful delivery of Microsoft Power Platform solutions across both client and internal environments.

You will act as a key bridge between users, developers and project teams, providing application support, coordinating testing activities, managing deployments and helping to maintain high-quality Power Platform solutions.

The ideal candidate will have strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with experience supporting business-critical applications built on the Microsoft Power Platform.

Job Details

Work set up: Work from home

Schedule: Monday to Friday | 8 AM to 5 PM | UK Time

Holiday: Will follow UK holidays

Key Responsibilities

Application Support & Incident Management

  • Provide 1st and 2nd line support for Power Apps, Power Automate and Power Pages solutions.
  • Investigate, troubleshoot and resolve application incidents, defects and user-reported issues.

Platform & Process Improvement

  • Analyse business processes and identify opportunities to improve reliability, efficiency and user experience.

  • Support governance, security and compliance activities across Power Platform environments.
  • Keep up to date with emerging Power Platform features, best practices and Microsoft's release roadmap.

Desirable Skills & Experience

Personal Attributes

job.title: Staff QE, Mobile
job.description:
About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit . Come join us.

About the Team:

Our diverse Product & Engineering team values innovation, collaboration, and the continuous improvement of our platform. We offer a dynamic work environment where employees can grow and thrive while working on cutting-edge technology that shapes the future of AI and search.

At AlphaSense, we believe that diverse experiences and perspectives are critical to our success. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered to be their authentic selves.

About the Role:

Investors and analysts open our app between meetings, on a train, before a call, and act on what they see. Mobile releases go through app stores and cannot be rolled back, so a problem can stay in customers' hands for days.

Our mobile product is growing fast, with new AI workflows arriving on iPhone, iPad and Android at the pace of the rest of the platform. Our quality practice has real foundations, including Appium and native UI test suites and real-device runs, but our newest features are ahead of our automated coverage, and release confidence still depends too much on individual effort.

As Staff Quality Engineer, you own one question: can we ship mobile with confidence, every release, on all platforms? You decide what we test and what we deliberately leave out, and you turn what you build into a way of working that Mobile Engineering owns with you.

You will report to the head of Quality Engineering and work day to day with the iOS and Android teams, alongside backend, web and platform QE.

What Makes this a Staff role:

  • You set direction, not a task list. Nobody hands you a test plan. You look at the product, the release risk and the team, and decide what matters most and why.
  • You own the outcome across platforms. Your scope is the quality of the product across clients, not one app or one team.
  • You work through influence. You are an individual contributor. Your standards stick because engineers see their value, and success means they write more testable code, make better release calls and need you less over time.

What You’ll Do:

  • Define mobile quality strategy. Set the long-term strategy built on "Quality by Design" and "Automation by Default": test layers, device and OS matrix, and release criteria for iOS and Android.
  • Set metrics the team can act on. Define quality metrics and coverage standards with Mobile Engineering and Product, so quality is measurable and sustainable without you.
  • Turn release day into a clear call. With no instant rollback, own the quality gates, staged rollouts and evidence behind every go or no-go decision.
  • Connect mobile to the rest of the platform. Mobile shares APIs and services with web, and customers update apps slowly, so changes elsewhere can break mobile after they have shipped. You are accountable for that risk.
  • Make the test platform dependable. Keep real-device and CI runs stable and fast (Bitrise, BrowserStack, GitLab, Allure), including test data and enterprise (Intune/MDM) builds.
  • Use AI where it earns its place. Use tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot yourself, and help the team decide where they help and where human judgment must lead.
  • Leave the team stronger. Coach engineers and QEs, review designs for testability, and leave behind standards other teams adopt.

What Success looks like:

  • First 90 days: You have audited current coverage, agreed a prioritized plan with Mobile Engineering and delivered your first measurable improvement.
  • By 6 months: Critical mobile journeys are covered in the right layers on both platforms, and release readiness is an evidence-based call.
  • By 12 months: Mobile quality is a practice the team owns, and other portfolios borrow your ideas.

Who You Are:

  • A quality engineer with 8+ years of experience, including 2+ at Staff or Lead level. You have connected quality strategy across web and mobile, not just worked on mobile alone, and set direction across several teams or apps as an individual contributor without people-management authority. You can show what changed because of it.
  • Strong hands-on experience testing native mobile apps on at least one platform (iOS or Android), with working knowledge of the other. You are comfortable with real-device cloud and CI/CD for mobile builds, can work with tools such as XCUITest, Espresso, Compose UI testing or Appium, and code in at least one language such as Kotlin, Java, Swift or Python.
  • Strong debugging skills across the mobile stack, from crash reports to network traces, and a good understanding of how mobile releases move through the app stores.
  • Excellent test design and API testing, and comfortable in the backend: you can read APIs, debug across the client and service boundary, and work with contracts.
  • Strong understanding of continuous delivery and release gating, with experience in test management systems such as Allure TestOps.
  • An active AI tool user, with examples of where it helped and where it fell short.
  • Practical about trade-offs, and able to explain a release call to engineers and to non-technical leaders.

Bonus points:

  • Enterprise mobile experience (MDM/MAM, Intune, SSO, mobile security standards such as OWASP MASVS).
  • Experience building a mobile quality practice from an early stage.
  • Mobile performance testing (app start time, memory, battery) and release monitoring (crash and performance signals, staged rollouts).
  • Experience across both iOS and Android.

What we offer:

  • Playing a part in the story of a fast-growing company
  • Competitive compensation package
  • Lunch and recreational benefits
  • Occupational health care

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @ email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

job.title: Senior QA Engineer I
job.description:
About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer I to join our team! You will be responsible for ensuring the quality of a suite of tools for providers, patient workflows, and diagnostic reporting. Successful candidates will be ambitious, self-driven, and organized, deeply invested in both the user experience and the real-world functionality of our products.

This role is fully remote; however, we have a preference for candidates able to work in the Pacific Time Zone (PST) hours to better align with team collaboration.

This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and developers to shape quality from the ground up.
  • Analyze and evaluate business requirements with product managers and translate them into test strategies.
  • Create, execute, and maintain test documentation and test plans.
  • Create and execute manual and automated testing of web applications: exploratory, functional, acceptance, regression, and UI testing.
  • Test APIs and backend services (REST, GraphQL) for robustness and correctness.
  • Ensure that quality issues and defects are appropriately identified, documented, prioritized, and tracked.
  • Lead root cause analysis with developers to accelerate defect resolution.
  • Mentor junior QA engineers and help instill best practices across the team.
  • Be an active voice in process improvements to raise product quality and engineering performance.
  • Integrate testing into CI/CD pipelines to enable continuous quality.
  • Ensure web applications meet accessibility standards (WCAG/ADA) through manual and automated testing.
  • Contribute to performance and security testing efforts where applicable..

What You’ll Bring

  • 4+ years of professional experience in software QA.
  • Strong knowledge of QA methodologies, tools, and processes.
  • Experience with test design techniques and practical implementation.
  • Strong knowledge of web technologies: HTML, CSS, client-server architecture, and APIs.
  • Experience testing RESTful and GraphQL APIs.
  • Awareness of accessibility standards (e.g., WCAG) and experience testing with tools like Axe, Lighthouse, or screen readers.
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks (Selenium, Cypress, Appium, Espresso, XCUITest).
  • Solid experience with bug tracking systems (e.g., JIRA).
  • Strong analytical and communication skills, with proven problem-solving abilities.
  • A collaborative mindset and a passion for delivering high-quality, user-centered products.
  • BS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.

Nice to Have

  • Experience testing native mobile applications (iOS and/or Android).
  • Familiarity with mobile app testing tools such as Xcode, Android Studio, Appium, Detox, or BrowserStack.
  • Understanding of mobile app distribution workflows (TestFlight, Google Play Console) and CI/CD integration.
  • Experience designing and executing accessibility test strategies to ensure inclusive user experiences.
  • Experience contributing to performance and security testing initiatives.
  • Experience testing healthcare applications, electronic health record (EHR) systems, or products handling sensitive health data (HIPAA, PHIPA, or similar compliance environments).

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

  • Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

  • We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

  • We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

What We Offer

  • An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
  • We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member
  • Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we’re doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way
  • Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize
  • Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it
  • Retirement made easy! Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre-tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions.
  • We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family
  • The base salary for this role ranges from $140,000-$153,000 in local currency, depending upon experience and geographic location

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

As part of the hiring process, successful candidates will undergo a background check in compliance to applicable federal, provincial, and state rules.

Please be advised that official communication from our recruitment team will only come from our authorized domain []. If you are contacted by a recruiter, please ensure their email address ends with @prenuvo.com. We do not use third-party recruitment services or any other email domains for hiring purposes. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented, and results-driven OSP Closeout Package Quality Assurance (COP QA) Manager to lead our team responsible for reviewing, validating, and approving Outside Plant (OSP) project closeout packages prior to customer delivery.


The ideal candidate will provide leadership, technical oversight, and operational direction to a team of QA specialists responsible for ensuring closeout packages are complete, accurate, and compliant with company specifications, customer requirements, and established quality standards.


This role requires a strong understanding of OSP fiber optic construction, fiber optic testing, construction documentation, quality assurance processes, and team leadership. The manager will be responsible for driving review consistency, maintaining productivity and quality standards, identifying recurring deficiencies, and implementing corrective actions to improve the overall closeout process.


A critical component of this position is collaboration with OSP Project Managers (PMs) to communicate quality deficiencies, provide training and guidance, and improve the accuracy and completeness of initial package submissions.


The manager will also be responsible for developing, maintaining, and delivering daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports to track team performance, package review progress, quality trends, and opportunities for continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Operational Management

  • Lead, manage, and develop the OSP Closeout Package Quality Assurance team responsible for reviewing and validating completed OSP project closeout packages prior to customer delivery.
  • Oversee daily QA operations, including workload distribution, review prioritization, resource allocation, and adherence to established turnaround times.
  • Establish clear performance expectations, productivity targets, and quality standards for QA team members.
  • Monitor individual and team performance to ensure consistent, accurate, and timely completion of closeout package reviews.
  • Provide technical leadership, coaching, mentoring, and ongoing training to QA specialists to promote accountability, consistency, and professional development.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex package deficiencies, technical discrepancies, and operational challenges.

Closeout Package Quality Assurance

  • Oversee the comprehensive review of OSP closeout packages to ensure all required documentation, testing results, construction records, and supporting materials meet company specifications and customer requirements.
  • Ensure the team validates the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of submitted documentation, including as-built drawings, fiber assignments, splice records, test results, network inventory records, and other required closeout deliverables.
  • Direct the review and validation of fiber optic test results, including OTDR, insertion loss, optical power meter, Fiber Inspection Probe (FIP), Chromatic Dispersion (CD), and Polarization Mode Dispersion (PMD) data, as applicable.
  • Ensure fiber optic testing documentation reflects appropriate testing methodologies, equipment settings, wavelengths, test durations, and acceptance criteria in accordance with engineering and contractual requirements.
  • Establish and maintain standardized QA checklists, review procedures, acceptance criteria, and documentation requirements.
  • Ensure package deficiencies are accurately documented, communicated, tracked, and resolved before final QA approval.
  • Maintain consistent quality standards across all reviewers to minimize discrepancies, rework, and customer rejections.
  • Ensure completed closeout packages meet internal acceptance requirements and are ready for customer submission.

Project Management Collaboration & Corrective Action

  • Partner closely with OSP Project Managers to identify, communicate, and resolve closeout package deficiencies and documentation discrepancies.
  • Provide clear, actionable feedback to Project Managers regarding rejected or incomplete submissions, including required corrections and expectations for resubmittal.
  • Identify recurring submission errors, documentation gaps, and process deficiencies across projects and individual Project Managers.
  • Develop and deliver targeted training, coaching, and corrective action initiatives to improve the quality and consistency of closeout package submissions.
  • Collaborate with OSP operations, engineering, construction, and project management leadership to address systemic quality issues and implement sustainable improvements.
  • Establish feedback mechanisms to reduce repeat deficiencies, improve first-pass acceptance rates, and minimize unnecessary review cycles.
  • Support Project Managers in understanding closeout requirements, internal specifications, and customer-specific acceptance criteria.
  • Escalate recurring or unresolved quality issues to appropriate leadership with recommended corrective actions.

Reporting, Metrics & Performance Management

  • Develop, maintain, and distribute daily, weekly, and monthly reports detailing QA team performance, closeout package review activity, quality metrics, and operational trends.
  • Track and report key performance indicators (KPIs), including:
  • Total closeout packages received, reviewed, approved, and rejected.
  • First-pass acceptance and rejection rates.
  • Package review turnaround times and aging.
  • Outstanding packages, backlog volume, and review status.
  • Rejection reasons, deficiency categories, and recurring quality issues.
  • Individual reviewer productivity and quality performance.
  • Project Manager submission quality and resubmittal trends.
  • Rework volume and repeat rejection rates.
  • Analyze performance data to identify bottlenecks, productivity challenges, and opportunities for operational improvement.
  • Develop and maintain reporting dashboards and tracking tools to provide leadership with visibility into QA operations and overall closeout package readiness.
  • Provide regular performance summaries to management, highlighting trends, risks, corrective actions, and improvement initiatives.
  • Utilize reporting data to establish performance benchmarks, measure process effectiveness, and support resource planning.
  • Process Improvement & Quality Compliance
  • Develop, document, and continuously improve QA processes, standard operating procedures (SOPs), review checklists, and acceptance workflows.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline the closeout review process, reduce manual effort, and improve operational efficiency without compromising quality.
  • Implement quality control measures to ensure consistent application of internal specifications and customer requirements.
  • Perform periodic audits of completed QA reviews to verify reviewer accuracy, process compliance, and documentation quality.
  • Analyze rejection trends and root causes to develop corrective and preventive action plans.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve documentation standards, submission processes, and overall closeout package quality.
  • Ensure QA records, review histories, and supporting documentation are maintained in accordance with company standards and audit requirements.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on increasing first-pass acceptance rates, reducing review cycle times, and improving customer delivery readiness.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience in the telecommunications industry, with a strong background in Outside Plant (OSP) fiber optic construction, network documentation, quality assurance, or project management.
  • Demonstrated experience leading teams, managing operational workflows, or supervising quality assurance activities.
  • Strong understanding of OSP fiber optic construction processes, including fiber placement, splicing, testing, network documentation, and project closeout requirements.
  • Minimum of four (4) years of experience reviewing or analyzing fiber optic test results, including OTDR, OLTS, FIP, CD, and PMD, or equivalent relevant technical experience.
  • Ability to read, interpret, and validate OSP construction drawings, as-built documentation, splice diagrams, fiber assignments, and network records.
  • Experience reviewing technical documentation for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with established specifications.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify recurring quality issues, determine root causes, and implement corrective actions.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain operational reports, performance metrics, and KPI tracking.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, and other business reporting and documentation tools.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to provide constructive feedback, facilitate training, and collaborate effectively with Project Managers and cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage competing priorities in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Ability to hold team members accountable for performance, quality standards, and established procedures.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Telecommunications, Construction Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Previous experience managing OSP closeout package reviews, construction documentation QA, or fiber optic test acceptance teams.
  • Familiarity with EXFO FastReporter, EXFO ConnectorMax, Viavi FiberCable2 Suite, Viavi FiberChekPRO, Anritsu NetWorks, and similar fiber optic test analysis platforms.
  • Experience with Google Earth, GIS-based mapping tools, network inventory systems, and OSP construction documentation platforms.
  • Experience developing dashboards, automated reports, or performance tracking tools using advanced Microsoft Excel, Power BI, or similar reporting applications.
  • Familiarity with structured cabling, optical transport systems, telecommunications network architectures, and applicable industry standards.
  • Experience developing training programs, standard operating procedures, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Working knowledge of customer-specific OSP closeout requirements, contractual acceptance standards, and construction quality processes.

Key Performance Expectations

  • Success in this position will be measured by the manager's ability to:
  • Maintain consistent, accurate, and timely QA reviews of OSP closeout packages.
  • Improve first-pass acceptance rates and reduce recurring deficiencies in Project Manager submissions.
  • Minimize QA backlog and maintain established package review turnaround times.
  • Improve team productivity, review consistency, and individual reviewer performance.
  • Deliver accurate, actionable daily, weekly, and monthly performance reporting.
  • Reduce customer rejections resulting from incomplete or inaccurate closeout documentation.
  • Implement effective training and corrective action programs that produce measurable improvements in submission quality.
  • Continuously improve QA workflows, operational efficiency, and overall closeout package readiness.

QA & Data Validation Engineer

Optiveum is looking for a hands-on QA & Data Validation Engineer for a long-term, engaging project. The cooperation is based on a B2B contract directly with Optiveum.

The Client You will be working for a US-based technology company that builds a live consumer platform connecting communities through video, audio, text, and photos. Alongside this, they are developing an emerging AI business that helps brands understand public conversations through transcription, media analysis, topic and entity detection, and sentiment analysis.

The Role This is a hands-on quality role combining strong manual testing with data investigation. Your main focus will be the accuracy of the AI media-analysis product: its processing, enrichment and outputs. You will also do functional testing across the company's products, including the consumer platform. You will work closely with founders, product and engineering to find problems early, make useful checks repeatable, and support informed release decisions. We are looking for someone comfortable in a dynamic startup environment who can turn an unclear issue into evidence and a recommended next step.

What you will do

  • Test complete user journeys across mobile, web and APIs. Use exploratory and structured manual testing to uncover broken flows, edge cases, confusing states and regression risks.

  • Trace data from source media through processing and APIs to customer-facing results. Check completeness, accuracy, consistency, freshness and duplicates, and confirm records belong to the correct user or workspace.

  • Validate transcripts, extracted topics and entities, sentiment and other AI-assisted outputs against source material and agreed evaluation criteria. Separate clear defects from subjective judgments and record uncertainty.

  • Verify enrichment accuracy: confirm that added attributes and external data match the correct person, organization or source record. Investigate ambiguous matches, stale values, missing fields and conflicting sources.

  • Validate timestamps across the workflow (publication times, processing times, transcript and media offsets), including units, time zones, ordering and alignment with the original content.

  • Use SQL, API responses, logs and small scripts to investigate mismatches. Help engineering tell input issues, processing failures, model limitations and display defects apart.

  • Build and maintain reliable automated checks for repeatable functional and data risks, choosing the right layer: UI, API, integration or data.

  • Write actionable defect reports with expected vs. actual behavior, reproduction steps, affected records and evidence. Verify fixes and explain release risks clearly.

  • Develop reusable test data, reference examples and regression checks. Help define acceptance criteria early and decide what to test first when time is limited.

Expectations

  • Ideally 4–6 years of experience in software QA, including at least 2 years of hands-on data validation using SQL (comparing source and target data, investigating missing, duplicated or incorrect records).

  • Strong manual functional and exploratory testing experience on software used by real customers. You can build a focused test approach from incomplete requirements and explain which risks matter most.

  • Hands-on data validation skills. You can query records, compare source and destination data, check enrichment matches and timestamps, and investigate missing, duplicated or incorrect outputs.

  • Working familiarity with test automation or scripting, and an interest in developing it further. Experience debugging API tests, browser tests or validation scripts is valuable.

  • Comfort with APIs, JSON, browser developer tools, logs and basic software delivery workflows. You can read enough code to investigate a failure and work effectively with engineers.

  • Thoughtful use of AI to expand test ideas, generate synthetic data and draft checks. You verify AI-generated assertions against source evidence and know where human review is needed.

  • A curious, methodical approach, ownership and the ability to prioritize with limited time.

  • Ability to collaborate across time zones and communicate clearly in English, both in writing and in live conversations.

  • Nice to have: experience with media processing, consumer social or creator products, analytics, data pipelines or AI evaluation. Familiarity with Playwright, Cypress, pytest or API testing tools (equivalent practical experience counts).

What is offered

  • Salary: 25–28 USD net/h.

  • Contract: B2B directly with Optiveum.

  • Start: ASAP, long-term project.

  • Type of work: 100% Remote (Candidates must be based in Poland).

  • Working hours: Full-time, with dependable overlap for collaboration with the US East Coast team.

Recruitment Process Our recruitment process is straightforward and consists of two stages:

  1. A take-home assignment to showcase your testing approach and data investigation skills.

  2. A final interview with the CEO.

Description

Keeper is hiring a talented Senior QA Analyst to join our Privileged Access Management (PAM) team, working closely with platform-level integrations that span Keeper Secrets Manager (KSM). This is a 100% remote position from select locations, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the El Dorado Hills, CA or Chicago, IL metro areas.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of users and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help ensure the quality, reliability, and security of Keeper’s enterprise access management platform.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is transforming cybersecurity for organizations globally with zero-trust privileged access management built with end-to-end encryption. Keeper’s cybersecurity solutions are FedRAMP and StateRAMP Authorized, SOC 2 compliant, FIPS 140-2 validated, as well as ISO 27001, 27017 and 27018 certified. Keeper deploys in minutes, not months, and seamlessly integrates with any tech stack to prevent breaches, reduce help desk costs and ensure compliance. Trusted by millions of individuals and thousands of organizations, Keeper is the leader for password, passkey and secrets management, privileged access, secure remote access and encrypted messaging. Learn how our zero-trust and zero-knowledge solutions defend against cyber threats at .

About the Role

As a Senior QA Analyst focused on Privileged Access Management, you will validate complex workflows that span cloud infrastructure, identity providers, CI/CD systems, and enterprise operating environments. This role emphasizes integration testing, security-focused validation, and system-level quality across PAM and KSM capabilities, rather than isolated feature testing. You will design and execute comprehensive test strategies, analyze system behavior across environments, and collaborate closely with engineering, product, and security teams to ensure Keeper’s PAM platform meets high standards for reliability, interoperability, and security.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, execute, and maintain comprehensive test plans and test cases for PAM and platform-level KSM integrations
  • Perform integration testing across cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), IAM platforms (Okta, Ping Identity, Active Directory), and CI/CD systems (Jenkins, GitLab, Azure DevOps)
  • Validate PAM functionality across Windows, Linux, databases, and hybrid infrastructure environments
  • Identify, document, and validate defects, collaborating with engineering and product teams to drive resolution
  • Execute security-focused validation workflows to ensure expected access controls, policy enforcement, and audit behaviors
  • Perform reliability, stress, and fault-tolerance testing for PAM services and workflows
  • Analyze logs, errors, and system behavior to diagnose failures and identify root causes
  • Contribute to automated test coverage in collaboration with engineering teams
  • Recommend improvements to enhance product usability, resilience, and security
  • Maintain clear documentation of testing procedures, results, and reproducible steps
  • Stay current with industry trends and best practices in privileged access and secrets management

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in QA or software testing, including at least 2 years focused on security, PAM, or infrastructure-oriented products
  • Strong understanding of PAM concepts, secrets management, and enterprise security practices
  • Experience testing integrations with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and CI/CD systems
  • Familiarity with IAM solutions such as Okta, Ping Identity, or Active Directory
  • Working knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems
  • Ability to read and reason about code in languages such as Java, JavaScript, Python, Go, or .NET for validation purposes
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, QA, product, and security teams
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with cloud-native or serverless environments
  • Familiarity with secure software development and data protection practices
  • Experience with scripting languages or test automation frameworks
  • Experience working in Agile development environments

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental & Vision (inclusive of domestic partnerships)
  • Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life
  • Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance
  • 401K (Roth/Traditional)
  • A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)
  • Above market annual bonuses

Keeper Security, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and participant in the U.S. Federal E-Verify program. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Keeper Candidate Privacy Notice

This notice explains how Keeper Security processes your personal data during recruitment. (US), Keeper Security EMEA Ltd. (Ireland), or Keeper Security APAC K.K (Japan).

This role focuses on automation framework design, CI/CD integration, and system-level quality, not manual testing or security engineering. You will partner closely with software engineers, product teams, and security stakeholders to ensure PAM features are reliable, scalable, and automation-ready from the ground up.

Responsibilities

  • Architect, design, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for PAM workflows

  • Develop automation for privileged access workflows including credential rotation, access provisioning, and session management
  • Automate authentication and identity flows such as OAuth, SAML, and SSO

  • Build and maintain automation for backend services, APIs, and cloud-hosted systems
  • Integrate automated test execution into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or similar tools
  • Manage containerized test environments using Docker and Kubernetes
  • Investigate automation failures, perform root-cause analysis, and improve long-term stability
  • Collaborate with Engineering, QA, Security, and Product teams to embed testability into system design
  • Contribute to quality engineering standards and automation best practices across the organization

job.title: Penetration Tester
job.description:
Penetration Tester

Location: Remote - North America

Company Mission – Our mission is to help secure as many companies as possible, by using the best way of doing so: penetration testing. Sprocket Security prioritizes offensive security for enterprises, empowering them to build robust defense strategies based on individual business risk.

How – At Sprocket Security, we've built an expert-driven Continuous Penetration Testing platform that blends cutting-edge automated and manual testing methods.

Your Mission – The easy work is disappearing, and we built it that way on purpose. Our platform now owns the recon, the scanning, the first pass anyone could run, so you start each day with leads already surfaced instead of a blank terminal. Your job is everything the tooling can't do: chasing a lead into a critical finding, going back into the same network a third time because you know there's more in it, and being the human a client trusts when the report lands.

Responsibilities:

  • Own continuous testing across your clients' full attack surfaces (network, web app, cloud, social engineering) by conducting manual penetration testing and directing automation and agents rather than running one-off scoped projects.
  • Take raw leads the platform surfaces and push them into deep, chained, business-level impact, including post-exploitation, lateral movement, and privilege escalation.
  • Validate whether activity was detected and acted on, not just whether you got in, and call out where a client's defenses held.
  • Write clear, business-relevant attack narratives that explain impact to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Run debriefs and client conversations that build trust and position Sprocket as a partner, not a vendor.
  • Feed repeatable techniques and automation candidates back to R&D so a one-off discovery becomes a capability the whole team runs continuously.
  • Mentor junior testers and interns, stay reachable, and think out loud with your team rather than working in silence.
  • Build scripts and tooling to improve your own efficiency and the team's.

Requirements:
Minimum

  • Web application testing beyond OWASP Top 10 basics: auth flaws, business logic, injection at depth.
  • Network and Active Directory testing: lateral movement, privilege escalation, not just scan-and-report.
  • Comfort directing, supervising, and validating AI and automation tooling across the full autonomy spectrum, and pushing well past what it surfaces on its own.
  • Post-exploitation and impact demonstration, with the ability to translate a technical finding into what it means for a specific client's business.
  • Scripting ability (Python, Bash, or equivalent) with a track record of building tools to improve efficiency.
  • Client-facing experience delivering findings and handling technical and non-technical conversations.
  • Genuine comfort with ambiguity and a role whose center of gravity keeps shifting toward harder, less routine work.
  • A collaborative approach: you ask early, share often, and invest in the people around you.

Preferred

  • OSCP or equivalent hands-on certification.
  • OSWE, CRTO, GPEN, GWAPT, or cloud security certifications (AWS Security Specialty, AZ-500).
  • Published research, disclosed CVEs, or an active bug bounty profile.

Certifications & Education: No specific degree or certification required. Equivalent hands-on experience is valued equally or more. If OSCP or equivalent isn't already held, we expect it within roughly 12 months, and we support that with a training budget.

This Role Might Not Be For You If:

  • You want a role built around one-time scoped engagements rather than continuous testing across a client's full surface.
  • You see AI and automation tooling as a threat to the craft rather than something that multiplies your reach.
  • You'd rather work heads-down than think out loud, ask for help, or hand off what you find to teammates and R&D.
  • You want the day-to-day to stay the same over time. This role's center of gravity keeps moving toward harder, stranger, more interesting ground, and that's the deal, not a catch.

Benefits:

  • Unlimited and mandatory PTO for healthy work/life balance.
  • Company matched 401k (immediate eligibility, no one should have to wait to start saving).
  • 75% company contribution for health insurance for employees and 50% for dependants.
  • 100% company contribution for dental and vision.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • Hardware and tools of your choice
  • Support for your career development with paid training, conferences, certifications, etc.

Location: Remote

Ready to Trailblaze the Cybersecurity Frontier? If you're passionate about cybersecurity and eager to make an impact in the industry, we want you on our team. Apply now at Sprocket Security and join the revolution of safeguarding businesses from cyber threats!

job.title: Junior QA Engineer
job.description:
This is a remote position.

About Snef

AtSnef, we’re redefining how creators transform passion into prosperity. Our platform is built for those who dream big and think differently:

  • Earn More, Connect Better:Collaborate with sought-after brands, open new revenue streams, and expand your influence.

  • Find Your Creative Community:Engage with fellow creators, exchange fresh ideas, and gain inspiration from a thriving network.

  • Leverage AI & Automation:Streamline your entire content-to-commerce journey, so you can spend more time doing what you do best—creating.

This isn’t just another platform. It’s a dynamic ecosystem designed to empower your creativity, fuel your growth, and help you thrive.

The Opportunity

As a Junior QA Engineer at Snef, you will ensure that our cutting-edge web applications—built with Next.js, Node.js, and TypeScript—deliver seamless, engaging experiences for our creator community. You’ll be at the forefront of ensuring platform quality, helping creators monetize their work, access premium brand opportunities, and harness powerful AI-driven automation. This is your chance to grow, innovate, and directly impact how creators succeed online.

What You’ll Do

  • Manual & Functional Testing:

    • Perform functional, integration, regression, and UAT testing across our web applications.

    • Validate new features and enhancements, ensuring a frictionless user experience for creators.

  • Test Automation & CI/CD Integration:

    • Develop, maintain, and optimize automated test scripts using TypeScript-based frameworks (e.g., Cypress, Selenium WebDriver).

    • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions) to ensure continuous, reliable quality checks.

  • API & Performance Testing:

    • Test RESTful services using Postman or similar tools, guaranteeing reliable, scalable API endpoints.

    • (Nice to have) Support performance testing using JMeter to ensure our platform scales with our creators’ growth.

  • Defect Management & Collaboration:

    • Log, track, and manage defects using tools like JIRA or TestRail.

    • Work closely with developers, product managers, and UX designers to refine requirements, address issues, and deliver elegant solutions that meet our creators’ needs.

  • Agile & Continuous Improvement:

    • Participate in Agile ceremonies—daily stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives—to ensure transparent communication and iterative progress.

    • Stay updated with industry trends, AI-driven testing methods, and emerging best practices, continually seeking ways to enhance our testing processes.


Requirements

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience & Skills:

    • 2+ years of combined manual and automation testing experience.

    • Proven expertise in testing web applications built with Next.js, Node.js, and TypeScript.

    • Proficiency in TypeScript-based automation tools (Cypress or similar) and integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines.

    • Experience with bug tracking/test management tools (JIRA, TestRail).

  • Technical Knowledge:

    • Solid understanding of SDLC, STLC, and Agile methodologies.

    • Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions).

  • Soft Skills:

    • Detail-oriented mindset and a passion for quality.

    • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

    • Collaborative spirit and adaptability in a fast-paced startup environment.

  • Nice-to-Haves:

    • Performance testing (JMeter) experience.

    • An interest in the creator economy, social commerce, or AI-driven solutions.


Benefits

Why Join Snef?

  • Empower Creators:Your work supports an ecosystem where creators monetize their passions, connect with premium brands, and scale their businesses.

  • Cutting-Edge Technology:Embrace modern frameworks, AI-driven automation, and continuous innovation.

  • Professional Growth:Access opportunities for learning, experimentation, and career advancement in a rapidly evolving startup.

  • Collaborative Culture:Join a diverse, inclusive team that values open communication, shared knowledge, and mutual success.

Ready to Apply?

If you’re excited about delivering high-quality digital experiences, enabling creators to thrive, and working with forward-thinking technology, we want to hear from you. Join Snef in Jakarta and shape the future of social commerce.Send us your resumeand let’s build something extraordinary together!

job.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
job.description:
About Accelerant

Accelerant is a data-driven risk exchange connecting underwriters of specialty insurance risk with risk capital providers. Accelerant was founded in 2018 by a group of longtime insurance industry executives and technology experts who shared a vision of rebuilding the way risk is exchanged – so that it works better, for everyone. The Accelerant risk exchange does business across more than 20 different countries and 250 specialty products, and we are proud that our insurers have been awarded an AM Best A- (Excellent) rating. For more information, please visit .

Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)

Location: Remote (flexible within U.S.)

The Role

We're building business solutions across the enterprise at Accelerant, and we need quality engineering to scale and keep up. You'll help drive the test automation strategy and implementation across our enterprise stack: Salesforce, MuleSoft, D365 and Reporting. You are a key decider about what gets automated, how it gets covered, and what gets pushed back on engineering.

We need someone who can scale it, harden it, expand its reach into systems that have never had real QA coverage, and build modern, AI-assisted QA tooling that lets our team expand its impact.

You'll partner closely with engineering, product, and business teams to identify where quality is leaking, expand automation breadth and depth, and build specialized QA agents that reduce the manual toil. You own end-to-end delivery of the test automation function.

This Is a High-Autonomy, High-Impact Role for Someone Who:

  • Sees a flaky test or a coverage gap and cannot leave it alone. Excels at iterating and shipping the right framework, not the perfect one.
  • Has scaled a real test automation framework in production — not just written tests against one.
  • Has built with Playwright, modern CI, and AI coding assistants long enough to have strong opinions about what fits our needs.
  • Can prototype a QA agent in Cursor and iterate as they go.
  • Operates with autonomy, and can carry a technical discussion on framework design, test architecture, and tradeoffs.
  • Is genuinely curious about applying emerging AI to QA.

What You'll Do

Drive the test automation initiative

  • Own the test automation roadmap end to end. Set the strategy, prioritize the work, and drive execution across the team. You'll partner with QA and engineering on what we automate, how, and when.

Scale the foundational framework

  • A Playwright/JavaScript framework is already built. Take it from foundational to enterprise-grade, with a focus on performance, stability, and reusability.

Expand coverage breadth and depth

  • Push automation into areas that may not have any QA support today, and deepen regression coverage on core systems: Salesforce, MuleSoft, D365 Power Apps, D365 F&O, DCR, and Tagetik.

Implement a scalable design and review process

  • Help build the design and review process that keeps automation quality high as the suite and the team grow - test design standards, code review norms, framework contribution guidelines.

Scale test execution and reporting

  • Build the infrastructure that runs tests fast, reports results clearly, and surfaces signal over noise. Parallel execution, smart retries, actionable dashboards.

Build specialized QA agents using Cursor AI

  • Design and ship AI agents for performance testing, regression analysis, and defect triage (to name a few). Use Cursor as your build environment. Treat the agents as products solving specific problems.

Host QA agents on the AI fabric

  • Partner with the AI platform team to deploy your agents on the org's AI fabric. Make them discoverable, governed, and reusable across functions.

What You'll Bring

Must-Haves

  • Proven experience designing and scaling test automation frameworks in production.
  • Deep hands-on expertise with Playwright and modern JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Experience automating against complex enterprise SaaS - ideally Salesforce, MuleSoft, D365 (Power Apps and/or F&O).
  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs and AI coding assistants - Cursor in particular. Bonus if you've built and deployed agents.
  • Solid grasp of API testing, contract testing, and integration testing patterns - especially across layers like MuleSoft.
  • Ability to define test strategy, coverage targets, and quality metrics - and defend them to engineering leadership and the business.
  • Strong communication skills - you can explain a flaky-test root cause to a junior engineer and a coverage gap to a product lead.
  • Demonstrated bias for action and ability to operate autonomously in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in insurance, fintech, or other regulated financial services industries.
  • Familiarity with insurance concepts (underwriting, claims, actuarial workflows) or willingness to learn them deeply.
  • Strong working knowledge of CI/CD, and reporting/observability for test suites.
  • Experience deploying AI agents on an internal AI platform or fabric (governance, eval harnesses, prompt/version management).

·Performance testing background.

Why This Role

You won't be buried in a QA backlog writing yet another regression script. You'll set the automation strategy, scale the framework, and build the QA tooling that defines how this company ships and tests business solutions for the next decade. You'll have direct access to engineering and business leadership, a mandate to move fast, and the autonomy to choose your own tools and approach. If you've been waiting for a role where you can prove what modern AI-enabled QA can actually do inside a real company, this is it.
