job.title: Principal Quality Engineer
job.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Principal Quality Engineer carries out procedures to ensure that all information systems products and services meet organization standards and end-user requirements. The Principal Quality Engineer provides strategic advice and guidance to functional team(s). Highly skilled with broad, advanced technical experience.

Humana is committed to helping people achieve their best health by delivering innovative technology solutions that power exceptional member, provider, and associate experiences.


The Principal, Quality Engineering is a senior individual contributor and hands-on technical leader responsible for advancing modern, AI-focused quality engineering practices across Humana’s software delivery ecosystem. This role defines, demonstrates, and scales what good looks like for enterprise quality engineering across the SDLC through technical expertise, reference patterns, automation frameworks, quality intelligence, and practical implementation guidance.


This role serves as a deeply technical expert in AI-enabled quality engineering, test automation, quality architecture, engineering excellence, and continuous quality practices. The Principal partners closely with the core EQE Platform team, Quality Engineering Segements, Product, Engineering, Architecture, Enterprise Engineering Enablement, Agile teams, DevOps, Cybersecurity, Risk, Compliance, Audit, and Data/AI teams to embed scalable, secure, measurable quality practices into delivery workflows, release processes, engineering platforms, and operational support models.


This is a hands-on principal role, not a people management role. The Principal will accelerate Humana’s enterprise quality engineering transformation by building reusable solutions, creating technical standards and exemplars, coaching teams directly, and ensuring responsible use of AI across quality engineering processes. This role is also responsible for defining and operationalizing what good looks like for EQE across the SDLC, including test strategies and approaches, release management, incident tracking, production validation, and continuous improvement.


Key Responsibilities

Enterprise Quality Engineering Strategy, Standards, and Technical Leadership

  • Define, refine, and operationalize enterprise quality engineering standards, patterns, reference architectures, and technical guidance across software delivery teams.
  • Define and continuously evolve what good looks like for Enterprise Quality Engineering across the full SDLC, including planning, development, testing, release, deployment, production validation, support, and continuous improvement.
  • Establish practical, reusable best practices for embedding quality engineering into each SDLC phase, including requirements quality, test planning, test design, automation strategy, validation, release readiness, production verification, and supportability.
  • Create and maintain reusable frameworks, starter kits, accelerators, example implementations, and practical guidance for quality planning, test automation, regression strategy, API and UI testing, service virtualization, code quality, deployment validation, performance and resilience testing, release readiness, observability-driven quality, production validation, and AI-assisted quality engineering.
  • Define enterprise quality expectations, guardrails, and example patterns that help teams consistently apply EQE best practices within Agile, DevOps, and platform-based delivery models.
  • Create technical guidance for quality-related Definition of Done expectations and quality checkpoints across delivery workflows to improve consistency, traceability, and readiness.
  • Provide deep technical consultation to engineering teams on implementing modern quality engineering practices aligned with enterprise delivery models, DevOps controls, and platform standards.
  • Partner with engineering enablement and platform teams to ensure quality practices are reflected in enterprise tooling, templates, reusable workflows, and CI/CD pipeline patterns.

Hands-On AI-Focused Quality Engineering

  • Lead the practical application of AI-enabled quality engineering capabilities across the SDLC through hands-on experimentation, prototyping, implementation, and refinement.
  • Design and implement patterns for responsible use of AI in quality engineering, including test case generation, test data analysis, requirements analysis, defect clustering and triage, risk-based testing, code review support, automation acceleration, quality intelligence, and production issue analysis.
  • Evaluate and pilot generative AI, machine learning, intelligent automation, and analytics solutions that improve test effectiveness, speed, coverage, defect prevention, and engineering productivity.
  • Develop guardrails, technical recommendations, and implementation patterns for safe and responsible use of AI-enabled engineering tools in partnership with Data/AI, Cybersecurity, Risk, Compliance, and Legal stakeholders.
  • Build proof of concepts, reference implementations, and engineering patterns that demonstrate measurable value from AI-enabled quality practices.
  • Help teams integrate AI-assisted workflows into daily engineering practices while preserving human oversight, traceability, quality, and compliance expectations.

Test Automation, Quality Architecture, and Engineering Excellence

  • Define what good looks like for test strategies and test approaches across product, platform, integration, API, UI, data, performance, resilience, security-aligned, and operational validation scenarios.
  • Establish enterprise guidance for selecting appropriate test levels, test types, coverage models, and automation approaches based on risk, architecture, criticality, and delivery context.
  • Create patterns for modern test strategy development that incorporate risk-based testing, non-functional validation, test data management, and environment strategy.
  • Standardize quality engineering approaches for unit, integration, system, acceptance, migration, infrastructure, data, and deployment validation testing to improve consistency and delivery confidence.
  • Define measurable expectations for automation maintainability, reliability, execution efficiency, evidence quality, and test coverage effectiveness.
  • Design scalable approaches for validating APIs, services, event-driven systems, data workflows, web applications, and platform integrations.
  • Establish automation patterns that support shift-left and shift-right quality practices, including pre-merge validation, deployment validation, synthetic testing, and production verification.
  • Promote engineering practices that strengthen quality outcomes, including clean code practices, atomic commits, meaningful pull requests, code quality controls, and automated quality gates.

Governance, Risk, Compliance, and Quality Maturity

  • Contribute deep technical expertise to enterprise Quality Engineering governance frameworks, standards adoption models, and maturity assessments.
  • Define what good looks like for EQE controls and evidence across SDLC governance requirements, including traceability, standards adherence, test management, quality metrics, release readiness, and production validation support.
  • Translate enterprise SDLC standards and governance expectations into actionable quality engineering practices that teams can implement consistently and with minimal friction.
  • Help define maturity criteria for SDLC quality adoption, release quality discipline, incident learning integration, and test strategy effectiveness across teams.
  • Define measurable quality criteria, engineering controls, and evidence expectations aligned with SDLC governance and regulatory requirements.
  • Partner with Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity, Audit, and AI governance stakeholders to ensure quality engineering practices align with enterprise policies, control expectations, and responsible AI principles.
  • Identify quality, control, and process risks in software delivery workflows and recommend pragmatic improvements that reduce friction while strengthening compliance.

Quality Intelligence, Metrics, and Insight

  • Define and implement actionable quality metrics and telemetry that help teams improve engineering quality, delivery confidence, release readiness, and production outcomes.
  • Define measurable indicators for what good looks like across SDLC quality adoption, release quality, incident quality signals, defect escape trends, and test strategy effectiveness.
  • Establish dashboards and scorecards that help teams assess adherence to EQE best practices in areas such as test planning, release readiness, incident learning, automation effectiveness, and quality outcomes.
  • Partner with platform, DevOps, engineering, and data teams to create dashboards and scorecards for automation coverage, defect trends, test reliability, release quality, deployment validation, code quality, pipeline health, DORA-aligned indicators, and AI-enabled quality outcomes.
  • Use quality, release, and incident data to identify systemic issues, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities across teams and platforms.
  • Translate engineering and quality signals into recommendations that improve reliability, maintainability, speed, and production performance.

Enablement, Coaching, and Enterprise Influence

  • Provide expert-level coaching and hands-on guidance to engineering and quality teams adopting modern and AI-enabled quality engineering practices.
  • Create technical playbooks, exemplars, implementation guides, workshops, and enablement content to improve enterprise quality capability.
  • Lead or contribute to Communities of Practice, architecture reviews, innovation forums, and technical learning sessions focused on quality engineering, SDLC excellence, release quality, and AI fluency.
  • Influence senior engineers, architects, and delivery teams across a matrixed environment through technical credibility, practical delivery experience, and clear demonstrations of value.
  • Help teams reduce developer overhead by simplifying quality workflows, improving developer experience, and increasing automation effectiveness.

Platform and Tooling Alignment

  • Guide quality engineering implementation across enterprise platforms and tools used for source control, CI/CD, code quality, release orchestration, feature management, and test automation.
  • Support adoption of pipeline-as-code, reusable workflows, and automation patterns aligned with enterprise platform standards.
  • Advise teams on quality-related usage of tools such as Azure DevOps Services, GitHub Enterprise, SonarQube, and LaunchDarkly, and other approved engineering tools.
  • Ensure quality engineering practices align with enterprise tool strategy and help reduce unnecessary tool sprawl, platform debt, and delivery friction.
  • Partner with platform teams to support scalable onboarding, standardization, and developer self-service.

Audit and Control Support

  • Provide technical support for internal and external audits related to SDLC, quality engineering controls, automation, traceability, release evidence, and AI-enabled engineering practices.
  • Help define repeatable evidence approaches for quality-related controls, including automated evidence collection where appropriate.
  • Partner with Audit, Risk, Compliance, Cybersecurity, and platform teams to improve audit readiness and sustainable control adoption.
  • Identify recurring evidence gaps, control weaknesses, quality risks, and AI-related considerations, then recommend practical remediation patterns.

Required Qualifications

  • 10 or more years of experience in quality engineering, software engineering, SDET, test automation, DevOps, software delivery, or related technical disciplines.
  • Deep technical hands-on expertise in quality engineering practices, including test automation, quality architecture, regression strategy, API testing, code quality, deployment validation, performance testing, defect prevention, release validation, incident-informed quality improvement, and production quality verification.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, building, and improving scalable automation frameworks, test tooling, quality accelerators, or reusable engineering solutions.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience applying AI-enabled capabilities in software engineering or quality engineering, such as test generation, defect analysis, requirements analysis, quality intelligence, or engineering productivity improvement.
  • Experience defining what good looks like for quality engineering practices across the SDLC, including test strategy, release management, incident tracking, and production quality feedback loops.
  • Experience integrating quality practices into Agile delivery models, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps workflows.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, clean code practices, source control hygiene, pull request quality, and automation-first delivery practices.
  • Experience defining or influencing technical standards, engineering best practices, or SDLC quality patterns across multiple teams.
  • Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders including Engineering, Product, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Risk, Compliance, Audit, DevOps, and Data/AI teams.
  • Ability to evaluate technical tradeoffs and translate complex quality engineering concepts into pragmatic implementation guidance.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, insurance, financial services, or another highly regulated environment.
  • Experience serving in a principal, architect, staff, or senior lead-level technical role in quality engineering or software engineering.
  • Experience with generative AI, machine learning, LLM-assisted engineering tools, or intelligent automation applied to testing and quality workflows.
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps Services, GitHub Enterprise, SonarQube, LaunchDarkly, pipeline-as-code patterns, reusable CI/CD workflows, feature flags, and code quality tooling.
  • Experience improving quality through engineering metrics such as DORA, pipeline health, release quality, defect escape trends, incident patterns, test reliability, and AI productivity indicators.
  • Experience implementing or advising on SDLC governance, evidence collection, audit support, control mapping, and responsible AI considerations.
  • Experience creating reference architectures, proof of concepts, technical playbooks, Communities of Practice content, or engineering enablement materials.
  • Experience using platform and workflow standards to reduce developer overhead and improve delivery consistency at enterprise scale.


Use your skills to make an impact

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$170,800 - $234,800 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.


About Us

job.title: Senior QA Engineer (Manual + Automation)
job.description:
This is a remote position.

Role Title:Senior QA Engineer (Manual + Automation)
Employment Status:Full-Time Contractual
Engagement:Initial 6-month contract (with potential to extend with the right fit)
Work Roster:9AM-5PM Brisbane Time
Location:Remote

Role Summary
We are looking for aSenior QA Engineerwith strong hands-on experience across bothManual and Automated Testingto help ensure the quality and reliability of web and SaaS products.
You will be involved throughout the SDLC, covering test planning, functional and regression testing, API validation, automation, accessibility, cross-browser/device testing, and defect management.
The ideal candidate is technically strong, detail-oriented, and confident communicating QA findings and testing approaches with developers, stakeholders, and other QA team members.

Key Responsibilities
Test Planning & Manual Testing
  • Review requirements, user stories, and designs to understand testing requirements.
  • Create test plans, test cases, and acceptance criteria.
  • Perform functional, exploratory, regression, and end-to-end testing.
  • Identify, document, and track defects through to resolution.
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum sprints and QA planning.
  • Clearly communicate testing findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
API & Data Testing
  • Test REST APIs and webhooks using tools such as Postman or Insomnia.
  • Test complex workflows including authentication, checkout, search, dashboards, and CMS functionality.
  • Validate data, content updates, and database changes.
  • Test edge cases, error handling, and integration scenarios.
  • Conduct regression testing before releases.
Automation Testing
  • Create, maintain, and execute automated UI and API tests.
  • Build reusable automated regression tests for critical workflows.
  • Apply automation where it provides meaningful testing value.
  • Work with developers to support testing within CI/CD workflows.
  • Use automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Jest, or Vitest.
Cross-Platform & Accessibility Testing
  • Test responsive web applications across Chrome, Safari, Firefox, and Edge.
  • Test across desktop, tablet, iOS, and Android devices.
  • Perform accessibility checks including keyboard navigation, screen readers, and colour contrast.
  • Identify UI, UX, performance, and visual issues.

Requirements
  • 5+ years of professional QA experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience in Manual Testing and test case management.
  • Solid understanding of Automated Testing and automation frameworks.
  • Strong experience in functional, regression, exploratory, integration, and API testing.
  • Practical experience withPostman, Insomnia, or similar API testing tools.
  • Experience withPlaywright, Cypress, Selenium, Jest, or Vitest.
  • Experience working with Agile/Scrum teams and tools such as Jira, Trello, or GitHub.
  • Good understanding of web applications, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript behaviour.
  • Experience testing across browsers and multiple devices.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills.
  • Ability to clearly explain testing decisions, findings, and technical issues.

Nice to Have
  • Experience with React, Next.js, Node.js, or Headless CMS.
  • Knowledge of WCAG and accessibility testing.
  • Basic SQL/database knowledge.
  • Experience with CI/CD and GitHub Actions.
  • Experience working with e-commerce or SaaS products.
  • Experience mentoring or supporting other QA team members.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  • Critical and high-priority bugs are identified before reaching production.
  • Testing is completed within agreed sprint and release timelines.
  • Test documentation remains clear, accurate, and reliable.
  • Automated test coverage is improved for critical workflows where appropriate.
  • Production issues are reduced through effective manual and automated regression testing.
  • Bugs are reported clearly with accurate steps to reproduce and supporting information.
  • QA findings and risks are communicated clearly to the wider team.

job.title: Senior Software Quality Engineer
job.description:
Location: Remote

Work anywhere in the US, must live in the US

Level: Senior

ABOUT CONTINUED

A leader in EdTech, Continued is a team of passionate individuals dedicated to empowering professionals and enhancing careers. We are fast-paced, nimble, and we laugh a lot. We are proud to be certified as a great workplace, ranked #4 in Fortune’s 2026 Best Workplaces in Education & Training, ranked #23 in Fortune's 2026 Best Workplaces for Women, and ranked #27 in Fortune's 2026 Best Workplaces for Parents by the independent analysts at Great Place to Work®. We are 100% virtual, scattered across the country, but we maintain a tight-knit culture driven by curiosity, a love of learning, and a desire to solve complex problems. Learn more about us at continued.com.

THE MISSION: Quality Engineering in the AI Era

We are seeking a Senior Software Quality Engineer to drive quality practices in an AI-native engineering environment.This role goes beyond traditional test automation. You will help design and build quality intelligence frameworks and testing agents, validate AI-powered features, and help embed continuous quality practices across the SDLC.

You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Data, and TechOps teams to ensure our systems are reliable, scalable, observable, and responsible.

WHAT YOU’LL DO (The Impact)

  • Release Quality: Drive end-to-end quality assurance for web and mobile releases, partnering with engineering and product teams to define acceptance criteria and release readiness.
  • AI-Assisted Test Automation: Build and maintain Cypress and Playwright test suites for application teams, using AI tools like Claude and Cursor to speed up test creation and maintenance, and evaluate emerging tools worth adopting. Pair with frontend developers and complement automation with exploratory testing.
  • Own API Quality: Design and build test architecture for microservices and AI-integrated platforms, with a focus on GraphQL and Apollo Studio.
  • Agentic Testing: Design, build, and refine AI agents that automate testing work such as test generation, regression analysis, failure triage, and defect investigation. Keep humans in the loop on the output, and share what works with the team.
  • Continuous Quality (CI/CD): Establish and maintain quality gates within CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions).
  • Observability & Telemetry: Leverage tools like Honeycomb and defect trend analysis to identify systemic risks and contribute to predictive incident feedback loops.
  • Engineering Partnership: Author pull requests for bug fixes and participate in architecture reviews to advocate for testability and reliability at the design phase.
  • Mentorship: Mentor Quality Engineering team members on modern, AI-driven, and agentic quality practices.
  • Security: Incorporate security and performance testing into the development lifecycle.
  • Test Planning & Regression Strategy: As needed, define and maintain comprehensive test plans for feature releases and platform changes. Own regression strategy for your product area, recommending what to automate vs. test manually and keeping suites lean.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Automation Engineer: You have strong hands-on experience building UI and API test automation frameworks, whether from scratch or by significantly extending existing ones. You’re proficient in Cypress and Playwright, and have integrated suites into CI/CD pipelines.
  • GraphQL Proficiency: You have strong hands-on experience with schema validation and query/mutation testing, ideally in Apollo Studio.
  • AI & Agentic Testing: You’ve used or built AI agents and workflows to automate testing tasks, or you’re eager to learn, and you review AI output with a critical eye.
  • Coder & Debugger: You are comfortable reading, debugging, and writing code (PHP/Laravel and JavaScript) to contribute to platform stability.
  • Systems Thinker: You connect defects and test signals to underlying risks, and you’re comfortable with ambiguity and driven by data.
  • Security & Accessibility: You are passionate about system security and accessibility.
  • Culture Fit: You are reliable, trustworthy, and a genuine team player. You must be able to comprehend (and contribute to) highly advanced forms of sarcasm.
  • Coach and Mentor: You enjoy teaching other team members about the latest tools and practices.
  • Ethics: You believe in responsible and ethical AI practices.

With the additional requirements of:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
  • Excellent communication skills — able to clearly explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders and do so in a way that builds confidence rather than confusion (we live in Slack).
  • Reliable, trustworthy, and consistent — the team will depend on you.
  • There is direct oversight, but you are expected to take ownership of your work, to establish deadlines, and to communicate progress proactively.
  • Must have the ability to fulfill the job requirements with or without reasonable accommodations.
  • Must be located in the United States and be legally eligible to work for us.

job.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer - Yang Models
job.description:
Get to know us better

CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms. We create proofs-of-concept, help our clients build new products, nurture existing ones and provide services in production environments. Our clients include both tech startups and big players in various industries and geographic locations (US, Japan, Israel, Europe).

While no longer a startup - we have 250+ people on board and have been operating since 2011 we’ve kept our people-oriented culture. Our values are simple:

  • Act to deliver.

  • Disrupt to grow.

  • Team up to win.

The project and the team

We develop software for modern platforms and operating systems for leading networking equipment manufacturers, as well as various other cloud-native, containerized services and solutions. In this project, you will join a 3-person team (consisting of 1 C Developer and 2 QA Engineers) responsible for migrating the support of dozens of OpenConfig (OC) data models in an enterprise network operating system. We are moving from a legacy C-based mapping engine to a new proprietary declarative mapping DSL.

What else you should know:

  • The client is a global company with employees based in Europe, the US, and Asia.

  • The project will be managed by the client, but the Codilime Engineering Manager will be assisting in the project management and coordination.

  • Frequent collaboration with a US-based team will be required.

  • Periodical sync calls with the customer may be required in the US-friendly hours (17:00 - 20:00)

Your role

As the Senior QA Automation Engineer, you will provide crucial technical support in Python, data models, and consistency verification between the old and new mapping mechanisms. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Running, maintaining, and handling existing Python-based regression tests that configure the system via OpenConfig models.

  • Debugging test failures and analyzing test logs to ensure stability.

  • Verifying the correctness of mappings and diagnosing validation errors on the device side.

  • Collaborating with the C Developer to look into the removed legacy module to catch hidden logic or corner cases and ensure full test coverage.

  • Working directly with feature teams and infrastructure creators

Do we have a match?

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer, you must meet the following criteria:

  • Python Proficiency (Must-have): Excellent Python programming skills to efficiently run tests, debug failures, and analyze logs.

  • YANG / OpenConfig & Networking (Must-have): Practical ability to read YANG (OpenConfig) schemas and solid grasp of essential networking concepts (L2/L3, Interfaces, Routing, ACLs) to verify schema translation mappings.

  • Environment & Independence (Must-have): Comfort working independently in Linux-based development environments, including Git, CI/CD pipelines, and lab environments.

  • Communication Skills: Strong communicativeness enabling direct collaboration with cross-functional technical teams.

A perfect match candidate will also possess the following experience (Nice-to-have):

  • C Proficiency (Strong asset): Ability to read and understand existing C code. You will not write production C code, but this skill will help you analyze legacy codebases alongside the development team to catch edge cases.

  • Experience with Network Operating Systems (NOS): Prior exposure to enterprise or service-provider platforms (e.g., SONIC, Arista EOS, Cisco IOS-XR, Nokia SR OS, Junos) or CPE systems (e.g., prpIOS, OpenWrt).

  • Automated testing workflows: Experience with automated validation pipelines and network test frameworks in enterprise environments.

More reasons to join us

  • Flexible working hours and approach to work: fully remotely, in the office or hybrid

  • Professional growth supported by internal training sessions and a training budget

  • Solid onboarding with a hands-on approach to give you an easy start

  • A great atmosphere among professionals who are passionate about their work

  • The ability to change the project you work on

Our Why At Dotmatics

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

What do we need

As a Manual Exploratory Tester (User Testing) , you will play a critical role in validating the quality of our Luma platform. You will focus on exploratory/user testing—investigating new features, workflows, and edge cases to uncover unexpected behaviours and usability issues. You’ll work closely with developers, product owners, and automation engineers to ensure defects are caught early, well-documented, and resolved quickly.

A background in science (chemistry, biology, or related field) is required as you will understand the scientific workflows and real-world use cases of our customers.

In this role you will get to:

  • Conduct exploratory and manual testing (UAT) across web-based applications within the Luma platform.
  • Develop tests/exploratory test guides to ensure business requirements are met and provide detailed feedback to design/product.
  • Validate new features, integrations, and scientific workflows, ensuring functionality aligns with product requirements and user expectations.
  • Log clear, reproducible bug reports and collaborate with developers for quick resolution.
  • Provide critical feedback on usability, scientific workflow efficiency, and overall user experience.
  • Collaborate with automation engineers to identify areas suitable for automated coverage and review assertions.
  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release readiness activities.
  • Advocate for quality throughout the software development lifecycle.

We are looking for people who have an education in, or significant work experience in Biology, Chemistry, Bioinformatics, Life Sciences or similar scientific field and can demonstrate experience as a User Tester, Scientific Application administrator/owner, Software Tester, QA Analyst/User Testing, with a strong focus on exploratory testing

The key skills we are looking for

  • Extensive knowledge of biology or chemistry, with the ability to understand and test scientific user experiences and workflows.
  • Experience using or testing scientific/informatics software, ideally within a scientific environment.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with curiosity to probe beyond obvious test cases.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to spot inconsistencies, edge cases and usability issues.
  • Personal experience using AI-driven tools and workflows to support day-to-day work.
  • Understanding of SaaS architecture, integrations and security.

You may also have:

  • Experience testing SaaS or complex web applications
  • Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Zephyr Scale, or similar test management/bug tracking systems
  • Hands-on experience with backend validation, including API testing and database checks
  • Calling APIs with tools like Postman/Bruno
  • Practical knowledge of GraphQL, including querying, mutations, and schema validation
  • experience with backend validation of APIs, services, and database interactions to ensure data integrity and system reliability.
  • Tools like Postman/Bruno for RESTful API testing and validate GraphQL queries/mutations against backend services.

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information.

job.title: Senior QA Engineer, Runtime
job.description:
Job Title: Senior QA Engineer, Runtime

By governing the use of AI across the development lifecycle, Unqork empowers enterprises with a new way to leverage AI to build, run, and evolve complex, mission-critical software without creating unvetted, unsecured code. Unqork helps enterprises, like Goldman Sachs, Marsh, and BlackRock accelerate digital transformation while reducing risk and total cost of ownership across their application portfolio.

At Unqork, we value inclusive and innovative thinkers who boldly challenge the status quo. We encourage you to apply!

The Team:

The Runtime team owns the programming model and engine that runs every application built on Unqork. We keep today's runtime stable, fast, and secure for enterprise customers, and we are actively building the next generation. We ship fast, and we hold the highest bar for quality and security while we do it.

What U’ll Do:

  • Own test automation for the Runtime team. Design, write, and maintain Playwright test suites that cover critical runtime flows and run on every pull request and release. Keep them fast, deterministic, and trusted. A flaky test is a bug to fix, not a test to rerun.
  • Review automation as code. Review the tests engineers write with their features, hold them to the same standard as production code, and coach the team on writing tests that catch real regressions.
  • Gate releases with automation. Wire suites into CI/CD (GitHub Actions) as quality gates, track pass rate, flakiness, and run time, and decide when a release is ready to ship.
  • Test proactively. Join feature refinement early, define testability requirements and acceptance criteria, and have tests ready as features land, not after.
  • Raise the security bar. Build checks for authentication, authorization, input handling, and data exposure into the suite, and partner with Security to turn findings into regression tests.
  • Build and run performance tests. Write k6 load and stress tests for runtime APIs and rendering paths, set baselines, and catch regressions in CI before customers do.
  • Use AI to scale coverage. Use Claude Code, Gemini, and similar tools to generate test scaffolding, triage failures, and grow regression coverage faster. Review their output with the rigor you'd apply to a teammate's code.
  • Modernize legacy coverage. Migrate historical CodeceptJS and Selenium tests to Playwright, and retire tests that no longer earn their run time.
  • Close the loop on escaped bugs. Reproduce and isolate customer-reported issues, file clear bugs with evidence and severity, and turn every escape into an automated test so it can't come back.
  • Explore where automation can't. Do focused exploratory testing in the browser with DevTools, and build complex, nested applications that act like real customer use cases and push the runtime to its limits.

The Impact U will make:

  • Deliver a regression suite the team trusts enough to ship on.
  • Find and close gaps in our test suites using client use cases, past bug patterns, and customer feedback.
  • Raise the quality and security bar while increasing how fast we ship.
  • Become the Runtime team's trusted voice on whether something is ready to ship.

What U bring:

  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Engineering or Software Engineering, with at least 3 focused on test automation.
  • Strong JavaScript/TypeScript experience required. Your test code reads like production code.
  • Deep, hands-on experience building and maintaining E2E suites with Playwright.
  • A track record of building a stable regression suite from scratch, or turning a flaky one around, with the metrics to show it.
  • Experience reviewing other engineers' test code and setting automation standards for a team.
  • A solid grasp of web development: HTML, CSS, the DOM, HTTP and REST APIs, browser DevTools, and how modern front-end apps render and manage state.
  • Working knowledge of web application security testing, such as the OWASP Top 10 and authentication and authorization checks.
  • Experience writing performance or load tests, ideally with k6.
  • Proven fluency with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Gemini, Copilot, or Cursor, and the judgment to know when their output needs a second look.
  • The ability to work autonomously as the only QA on a fast-moving team: you set priorities, make the call, and communicate risk clearly.
  • The confidence to push back on a release, and the communication skills to explain why.
  • Nice to have: API contract testing, visual regression testing, and testing low-code or codeless platforms.
  • An AI-forward mindset: You are an avid user of AI tools and are passionate about exploring how AI can automate workflows, enhance creativity, and increase your personal impact.

Compensation, Benefits, & Perks

💻 Work from home with a remote-first community

🏝 Unlimited PTO (and the encouragement to use it)

📝 Student loan payback program

🏥 100% employer-covered medical, dental, and vision options available to you and your dependents

💸 Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

🏠 Monthly stipend toward your WFH setup, vacation, development and more

💰 Employer-sponsored 401(k) with contribution match

🏋🏻‍♀️ Subsidized ClassPass Membership

🍼 Generous Paid Parental Leave

💲 Hiring Ranges:

  • Tier 1: $109,600.00 - $137,000.00
  • Tier 2: $100,000.00 - $125,000.00

Unqork employs a market-driven approach to establish compensation ranges. In addition to a base salary, employees may also be eligible to receive a target incentive and company equity in the form of stock options.

An employee’s compensation within the range provided above depends on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, their location, role, skillset, level of experience, and similar peer salaries. As a remote-first company, Unqork incorporates a geographic differential into our compensation structure, depending on the candidate’s location. We utilize a tiered system—Tier 1 and Tier 2—to accurately reflect local market rates and ensure our compensation packages are both fair and competitive.

Our geographic tiers are defined as follows:

  • Tier 1: New York Metro, Seattle Metro, San Francisco Bay Area
  • Tier 2: All other US and US territory locations

Unqork embraces a culture of security and privacy awareness by consistently safeguarding sensitive information, adhering to company policies, and actively participating in training and initiatives to protect our data and the privacy of our stakeholders.

Unqork is an equal opportunity employer. We will consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability or age.

job.title: QA Automation Engineer, Mobile Games - Freelance
job.description:
Empire: Four Kingdoms launched in January 2013 and is the world’s all-time highest-grossing app produced by a German company. It is part of our Empire brand, which has passed €1 billion in revenue and 220 million registered players. Now we are moving the game from Adobe AIR to Unity. Quality is the heart of that move: the Unity client has to behave exactly like today’s client, 1:1, including its known quirks, while the live team keeps shipping new content every month.

We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer, Mobile Games - Freelance who builds that proof as an automated, AI-assisted test setup: automation first, AI agents for the legwork, people for the judgement calls, and no endless manual passes.

This is a senior freelance role where you work autonomously, full-time from February 2027 until the end of 2027 including handover. It is fully remote within ±3 hours of CET, with the option to meet as a team in one of our Hamburg offices.

YOUR MISSION

  • Design the test strategy and test plans for the port based on the live game, game design documents and the list of features to migrate. Prioritise by risk and agree the standards with the game’s QA lead.

  • Build automated tests that run the AIR client and the Unity client side by side: same input, same result. Think replayed server traffic, state comparison and pixel diffs, where pass or fail is deterministic, not a judgement call.

  • Use AI tools like Claude as a real part of your work: to generate and maintain test scripts, explore the game, cluster crashes and draft bug reports, with a human checking the result. Build tooling where it pays off, and measure whether it does.

  • Perform smoke tests, sanity checks and full regression testing for every port build, and turn each new live feature and content release into regression cases for the Unity client.

  • Test what players feel: payments and in-app purchases, store builds, login, push notifications, localisation, and the analytics events the business relies on, checked event by event with the data team.

  • Run a device matrix on real devices, including low-end Android phones and older iPhones, and track load time, memory, frame rate, heat and battery against the live client.

  • Identify, document and report defects in Jira, manage tickets and coordinate with the port team so that release deadlines are met.

  • Support the release in a first market and then on all stores: release candidates, store certification, a tested rollback path and clear go or no-go input.

  • Hand over a test suite and documentation that the live QA team can run and extend after the port.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You join the port team of Empire: Four Kingdoms and report to the project lead.

  • Project lead: the owner of the port, who sets priorities and is your day-to-day contact.

  • The game’s QA lead: reviews your test approach and signs off quality for the Empire team.

  • The port team: the Lead Unity Engineer, the Unity developers and a second QA Engineer joining later. You share test plans, review each other’s work and keep one testing standard.

  • The Empire team: producers, game designers, client and server developers who know the game inside out. You involve them early and learn from them.

  • Data team: to check that the tracking events from the Unity client mean the same as today.

  • External QA partners: where we use them, you help coordinate their testing.

YOUR BACKSTORY

  • 6+ years of hands-on QA experience in games, with a focus on test automation and a solid understanding of the bug life cycle and testing methodologies.

  • You have tested at least one live mobile game with a significant user base, through store release and live updates. This is a hard requirement.

  • Hands-on mobile and game test automation, for example Appium, AltTester, GameDriver, Unity Test Framework or comparable tools, and scripting in Python, C# or a similar language, including running tests in CI.

  • You work autonomously: you own your test approach, set priorities with the project lead and raise risks early, without needing day-to-day direction.

  • Practical experience using AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot or similar) in QA: generating and maintaining tests, triaging failures, writing tooling. You know where they help and where they don’t.

  • Understanding of client-server games: you can read network traffic and tell a client bug from a server bug.

  • Experience testing payments and in-app purchases on iOS and Android.

  • Fluent English; you can explain complex technical issues to cross-functional teams.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience testing a port, migration or major rewrite against the original

  • Automated visual regression testing or replay-based testing

  • Building agentic tooling for QA teams. This is a real differentiator for us.

  • Adobe AIR, Flash or Unity client testing

  • Live mobile F2P and strategy games (live ops cadence, events, A/B tests)

  • Analytics and tracking validation

  • German

WHY JOIN US?

  • A classic at a turning point. You work on one of Europe’s most successful mobile strategy games at the moment it moves to a modern engine, and millions of players will feel the result.

  • Work your way. Fully remote within ±3 hours of CET, with the option to meet the team in our Hamburg offices for kick-offs and key milestones.

  • AI in daily work. We use AI tools like Claude every day and give you room to build the QA tooling you always wanted, judged by results.

  • A team that knows the game. You build on more than a decade of knowledge in the Empire team and leave behind a test setup that lasts.

HOW WE WILL INTERVIEW

Heads up: we will ask you to show your AI testing workflow live in the interview. Bring your real setup, your real prompts, your real failures. We care more about how you actually work than about a polished demo.

ABOUT GOODGAME STUDIOS

Goodgame Studios is known for data-driven game development and successful live-service strategy titles. We self-publish our games in-house with all relevant disciplines under one roof. Our studio is based in Hamburg, Germany, and we welcome applications from international candidates. English is our working language. As part of Stillfront Group, one of Europe’s leading game publishers, we work on long-term IP growth with a strong focus on execution.

job.title: QA Engineer
job.description:
Allego is a rapidly growing SaaS technology company in the Boston area and creator of the market-leading Revenue Enablement Platform. Our technology helps Go-To-Market teams build the skills and access the knowledge they need to succeed in every selling situation.

Allego is the only revenue enablement platform to be named a Leader in both the Forrester Wave™ and the inaugural Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Revenue Enablement Platforms.

Not only are we growing quickly, but we’ve also been recognized as a top place to work by The Boston Business Journal, The Boston Globe, and Inc. Magazine. In addition, Selling Power named Allego one of the 50 Best Companies to Sell For in both 2025 and 2026.

What You'll Do at Allego:

We are seeking a Quality Assurance Engineer to join our growing Development team, offering the chance to work in a collaborative environment as well as the opportunity to work with colleagues across the Atlantic and around the world.

You will be responsible for testing new features, product enhancements and fixes relating to the Allego platform and all associated products.

Our ambitious roadmap is leveraging some of the latest technologies in order to create exciting new features. As part of an Agile team, from sprint kickoff through to reporting bugs (and everything in between) you will be fully engaged in the development process and be able to make a real difference to the ongoing success of the team.

  • Work with a distributed Engineering team including development of web applications, server components, integrations and native iOS and Android mobile applications.
  • Actively participate in team standups, refining, estimating and retrospective sessions.
  • Create well structured test cases which comprehensively cover specification and ensure high quality outcomes.
  • Test complex distributed systems across microservices, web applications, mobile platforms, and third-party integrations.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts to continuously expand test coverage and streamline regression testing.
  • Raise and report quality issues clearly and concisely.
  • Follow through with Development and Product to ensure timely and accurate bug fixes.
  • Ensure quality of cross-browser, non-functional and accessibility requirements.
  • Ensure quality of existing features and help maintain and execute regression pack.
  • Support and undertake tasks delegated by the QA Lead or QA Manager.
  • Delegate tasks to other team members as needed to ensure testing is completed within defined timelines.

About You

You're curious and proactive - when something looks off, you dig in rather than wait to be told. You design test strategies independently, pick up new tools and frameworks quickly, and know when to collaborate versus driving technical solutions autonomously.

You take ownership: complex edge cases and escaped bugs get thoroughly analyzed and resolved, not left behind. You manage your workload efficiently, champion quality best practices, and assist in mentoring team members, and view every feature as an opportunity to raise the bar for platform reliability.

Experience You'll Bring to Allego:

    • 3+ years of Quality Assurance experience testing complex distributed systems, preferably in a SaaS environment.
    • Ability to create and manage all testware (test cases, cycles, data).
    • Familiarity with Agile frameworks (SCRUM, Kanban).
    • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
    • Ability to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical teams.
    • Experience with Jira / Test Management Systems / Google Workspace.
    • Experience with manual testing web and mobile applications preferred.
    • Solid understanding of security best practices, secure coding principles, and non-functional testing for SaaS applications.
    • Knowledge of CRM systems (Salesforce / MS Dynamics) is beneficial.
    • Hands-on experience building, executing, and maintaining automated test scripts using frameworks such as WebdriverIO, Cypress, or Selenium is beneficial.
    • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions) and using tools like BrowserStack is beneficial.
    • Motivation and confidence to suggest improvements to strengthen test effectiveness.
    • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, related field, or related experience required.

Compensation & Benefits:

£40,000 - £51,000 + equity

  • Private Healthcare Plan
  • Holiday & Sick Time
  • Pension Scheme

Operating Principles

Allego’s Operating Principles are at the heart of our business. They are the fabric of our culture and central to our approach to work, our customers and each other. Interested in learning more? Read more here!

Allego collects and processes personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws. If you are a European Job Applicant see the privacy notice for further details.

Allego does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other reason prohibited by law in provision of employment opportunities and benefits. It is unlawful in MA to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Job Description:

GDIT is seeking an Oracle EBS Functional Tester for our Healthcare General Ledger Accounting System (HIGLAS) program at the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services. GDIT is looking for business subject matter expert who understands the CMS – HIGLAS system and provide functional expertise/support to the project.


This initiative entails HIGLAS interfacing all the Medicare Claims data with an external system, while keeping the current state of interface with the Shared Services. The ideal candidate will have a solid understanding of Medicare Claim processing, HIGLAS business processes and major extensions in the Oracle EBS to support the HIGLAS business processes. The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing and owning test cases/requirements for HIGLAS EBS Application.


The Oracle EBS Functional Tester will work on Test Planning, Preparing, Execution, and Close-out. Must be well versed in all aspects of testing (e.g., analysis, planning, performance, automation, user acceptance) and able to speak to the needs for each. The tester must have broad expertise in the field’s concepts, practices, and procedures, and expertly performs a variety of complex tasks with minimal guidance.

Job Responsibilities

  • Review the documentation on all HIGLAS X12 interfaces (HIPAA compliant interfaces) on the Benefits lien of business to understand the logistics of the project.
  • Closely work with functional and development team to understand the test requirements upfront in the project.
  • Ability to understand the existing integration and translating them into interface testing needs.
  • Participate in work group sessions, design review sessions to ensure all the requirements are translated into test scripts and cases.
  • Document the test scripts and scenarios to test the end-to-end solution of the HIGLAS integration with an external Claims Processing system.
  • Execute the end-to-end testing of the integration and ensure all defects are logged and followed up for timely resolution.
  • Capture the evidence of end-to-end testing as per CMMI level IV standards.
  • Work with the customer (CMS) and end users to ensure comments on test cases, test results, UAT test plans, etc. are addressed timely.

job.title: Process Quality Engineer
job.description:
Join EarthOptics as a Process Quality Engineer!

At EarthOptics, we are combining cutting-edge genomic analysis, data science, microbiology, and remote sensing to revolutionize agriculture. We are creating a future where traditional sampling methods are obsolete. Our mission is to be the leading soil information company, delivering maps that growers, farmers, ranchers, and other stakeholders use to cost-effectively increase yields, improve soil health and the climate and feed the growing world through all things soil.

We are a growing company with a passion for soil health, innovative technologies, and supporting all within the food value chain. We currently have ~100 individuals spread across 20 states and 2 countries, and they come from all walks of life, industries, and experiences. We are deeply focused on building the future of AgTech and sustainability and helping the world see soil differently.

Our Process Quality Engineer will join our Data Science & Data Engineering team as an individual contributor reporting to the Chief Technology Officer. You will own quality controls across the journey from field sample collection and laboratory processing through data pipelines and customer delivery. You will investigate problems, build reliable checks, and work across disciplines to make quality part of everyday operations.

The digs:

  • Job Type: Full-time, salaried, exempt (not eligible for overtime)
  • Work Location: This is a remote position open to candidates who are authorized to work in the US and reside in the contiguous 48 states.
  • Travel: Up to 25% of the time, including visits to our Emeryville and Raleigh laboratories and field operations.
  • Compensation: $100,000-$125,000 annual base salary, plus eligibility for our bonus program and an equity option grant (see below).

*This range covers all US locations where this remote role can be performed. The low end reflects our geographic pay adjustment for lower-cost labor markets (75% of the market rate), and the high end reflects our highest-cost markets, such as the San Francisco Bay Area and New York City (100% of the market rate). Your offer will reflect the pay zone for your location and your job-related skills and experience, assessed consistently for every candidate. We do not ask about current or past pay.

What you’ll cultivate as a Process Quality Engineer:

  • Own quality controls across the sample lifecycle. Identify gaps in field soil sampling, hardware, sample shipping and intake, laboratory processing, data pipelines, and customer delivery. Maintain an inventory of QC checks and their coverage across products and workflows. While this is not a software role, the candidate is expected to be code-competent.
  • Build quality controls that work consistently. Translate gaps into clear requirements and tickets for the software engineering team, such as automated ingest gates, acceptance thresholds, chain-of-custody and completeness checks, and delivery holds when checks fail. Use AI tools, along with working knowledge of Python and SQL, to analyze data, prototype checks, and document them so they’re reproducible, logged, and auditable.
  • Investigate failures and prevent recurrence. Trace field and laboratory QC flags and customer-reported issues to their causes, then implement process changes, SOP updates, or tooling. Review gate performance monthly, documenting false positives, missed issues, and problems that reached customers.
  • Partner across disciplines. Work directly with field crews, laboratory operations, software engineering, and data science. Contribute to sampling protocols, SOPs, and field tool and hardware selection; translate observations into concrete requirements; and track the quality initiatives you own through completion.
  • Support traceability and accreditation readiness. Contribute to the data-integrity workstream supporting the ISO 17025 accreditation effort, led by laboratory and Technology leadership, including audit trails, chain of custody, and traceability. Report quality metrics to the CTO.

Within your first 90 days, you can expect to:

  • Visit at least one laboratory and one field sampling operation, document the highest quality risks by customer impact, and take ownership of the existing QC inventory, including automatic, manual, and missing checks.
  • Ship or strengthen at least two automated pipeline QC gates with logging and a delivery hold on failure.
  • Lead the first monthly QC gate review and manage the quality issue queue using the AI program manager.
  • Identify the data-integrity gaps most relevant to ISO 17025 and share them with laboratory leadership.

Are you our soil-mate? You’ll bloom in this role if you have experience in:

  • A quantitative or applied science discipline through a bachelor’s or master’s degree - or equivalent experience - in engineering, soil or environmental science, chemistry, statistics, data science, or a related field.
  • Typically five or more years in quality and process engineering roles with ownership of quality outcomes for a physical or laboratory process.
  • Investigating unfamiliar processes independently: forming hypotheses, testing them against data, and identifying root causes.
  • Using Python and SQL at a working level to retrieve and analyze production data, prototype simple checks, and read pipeline code well enough to write clear requirements for software engineers.
  • Applying statistical and data analysis methods to measurement quality, including control charts or equivalent methods, replicates, reference materials, acceptance criteria, and drift detection.
  • Using AI coding assistants, agents, or analysis tools proactively while independently verifying their outputs.
  • Working in or alongside an analytical laboratory, field sampling operation, or another regulated measurement environment.
  • Working directly with sampling crews and laboratory technicians, observing processes firsthand, and translating findings into practical improvements.
  • Communicating clearly across disciplines and levels of technical expertise. You can write useful SOPs and root-cause reports, explain risks to leadership, listen to operational concerns, and resolve disagreements constructively.
  • Driving initiatives across teams without direct authority, setting clear expectations, following up, and prioritizing issues by customer and business impact.
  • This role requires willingness to travel up to 25% of the time and participate directly in field and laboratory observations.

We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor or transfer visas at this time.

Although not required, we’d love to see roots in:

  • Agricultural, soil, or environmental testing.
  • ISO 17025 or similar accreditation efforts.
  • Cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery and pipeline orchestration.
  • AI-assisted program management or issue-tracking systems.
  • Running cross-functional programs without direct reports.
  • A fast-paced, start-up environment.

Aside from “the green”, we can offer you:

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance - 90% funded by EarthOptics for benefit-eligible employees and 55% for dependents
  • Company-paid LTD, STD, and Life Insurance
  • Meaningful equity option grants
  • 401k Plan + Employer Match up to 4%
  • 17 days of paid time off, plus 11 additional company holidays
  • Dependent Care FSA
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Professional Development Stipend
  • Employee Referral Bonus Program
  • Above and Beyond Bonus Program
  • Flexible Schedule
  • Regular opportunities to give feedback on our benefits offerings

How we stay grounded:

Although we have teammates working in the field, in-office, and at home, we aim to create a cohesive, diverse, and enriching environment for all of our employees. We embrace different tools to enhance our workflows and communicate intentionally, both live and asynchronously. A few quick facts you should know:

  • We rely on Slack to communicate. Although there are a variety of team-specific systems to facilitate your work, this is our primary!
  • We love both food and emojis at EarthOptics. If hired, you’ll come to love (and use many) taco and donut emojis. 🌮🍩
  • Our core business hours are Monday through Friday, 11am–4pm ET. We have teammates in every time zone, and some teams operate outside of that timeframe. As a remote employee, you are asked to honor those hours to ensure enough time to overlap with key cross-functional teams.
  • In order to maximize our remote culture, we host company-wide opportunities to connect (virtually and in-person) and create space for focus work. For example, we have a weekly all-hands stand-up meeting on Monday and reserve Fridays as a regular “No Meeting” day.
  • Instead of values, we believe in actionable “cultural concepts”. Collectively, we hold one another to act and give feedback with these concepts in mind. Ours are autonomy, accountability, collaboration, customer centricity, grit and grace.

As Localization QA Game Tester, you will work within our Localization Quality Assurance team and be the very first person to see the localized game in its entirety – translated text, images and the rest of the user interface collectively. You’ll get to experience the project in the way it will be consumed by the end users. You will work in a multilingual project team ensuring that the game is free from grammatical errors, cultural inconsistencies and ultimately ensuring that the game is accurately localized into the target language.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with a global project team.
  • Identify and correct spelling, grammar, punctuation, and other language errors.

  • Identify missing or incorrect content and ensure proper display/format of dates, calendars, and characters.
  • Write reports on errors and bugs found and perform ad hoc translation.

job.title: QA Engineer
job.description:
We’re looking for a nimble QA engineer who wants to see their work used by millions of people around the world. This is an opportunity to work on fast-growing products with a large user base that is frequently among the Top 10 most downloaded Health and Fitness apps that makes real change in people's lives. Joining us means you’ll be working with our mobile teams and cooperating with an experienced CTO, an award-winning designer, and a team of researchers in one of the most advanced behavioral economics centers.

Do you have great expertise in mobile app testing? Do you like to push the technology forward? Do you feel that helping people around the world achieve healthy habits is an important and meaningful mission for you? Then you should join the Fabulous mobile team.

Responsibilities

  • Execute manual and write automated tests, and identify actionable bugs quickly.
  • Manage QA coverage of mobile based projects.
  • Planning/organizing necessary test passes, staying on top of all important issues, help triaging bugs and driving issues to resolutions and keeping everyone aware of QA status.
  • Work with different teams (Engineering/PM/Operation) to collect necessary information to assure the QA coverage, and also provide feedback on quality issues.
  • Work with the dev team to set their priorities and remove their roadblocks to make sure sufficient coverage is done for the release.
  • Assess the status of the release, and help make sure that the release goes out on time with high-quality level.
  • Create and support test dashboards/reports.

Requirements

  • BS degree in Engineering
  • Ability to construct test cases and get them prioritized based on changes.
  • Knowledge of test and tool development methodology.
  • Communication skills, including the development of presentations

Preferred Qualifications

  • BS degree in Computer Science

Benefits

About Us

An award-winning health, wellness, & coaching company that creates apps which fall the top ten internationally. Our science-based approach sits squarely in the tech-for-good lane, helping people live their best lives. Everyone who has joined this company is committed to using evidence-based research to find the absolute best ways to change lives for the better.

Our History

Three co-founders created the Fabulous app: Sami, Amine, and Taylor. Growing up in Tunisia, Sami and Amine were only 16 when they met. With their early iteration, they reached out to Taylor, an award-winning designer in Malaysia. Their vision was welcomed into an incubation lab for startups at Duke University led by world-renowned Behavioral Economics Professor Dan Ariely. Our Chief Storyteller Jaz co-founded the Introductory Psychology program at Stanford University.

Our Approach

We use a behavioral economics lens to help individuals find that 'on switch' inside them to achieve their fullest potential. What has emerged is a system that transforms tiny habits into profound long-term changes. A world in which people with ADHD thrive. A method for gratitude to reach through difficulty. A sanctuary to seek out your true purpose. A fountain of knowledge. A space for rest and self compassion.

Our Mission

Help every individual discover the wonderful person inside themselves by creating: beautiful, evidence-based, life-changing products.

Our Environment

The first thing that sets us apart is that we’re not a place at all. While we’re a remote company, it’s not unusual to feel you know your teammates better than those you’ve shared an office with in the past. Ours is a professionally nourishing environment that is flexible and fully remote. Team members enjoy in house challenges and Slack event and work across a variety of tools. Meetings are kept to a minimum and deep work is encouraged.

Our Awards

  • Apple Best Apps of 2018
  • Editor’s app choice in more than 30 countries
  • Winner of Google’s Material Design Award
  • Best App Finalist in Google Play Awards
  • Consistently ranking in the top ten Health & Fitness apps across platforms
  • Backed by Facebook Startup Lab and Microsoft Venture

Our Norms

Ownership: Be the CEO of your tasks. No one is watching over your shoulder. Be the proof.

job.title: Lead, Quality Assurance
job.description:
Ready to accelerate your career?

Cardata is where driven people make an outsized impact. We’re a small but mighty team transforming how businesses manage vehicle reimbursement — replacing outdated programs with smart, automated solutions.

Our vision is bold: to provide the most comprehensive, intelligent, and automated software and services for creating ideal vehicle programs. And we’re building toward that vision every single day.

Join us and you’ll find challenge, growth, and the chance to deliver real impact — helping hundreds of companies and thousands of drivers across North America focus on the work that matters most to them.

We’re searching for a Lead, Quality Assurance to own quality strategy, automation, and release standards across Engineering. Accuracy matters: our platform calculates reimbursement rates, generates payment notices, and pays drivers through Direct Pay. When something goes wrong, customers, drivers, and our Finance team feel the impact.

Reporting to the VP of Engineering, you’ll set the quality bar, make quality visible across the organization, and partner with Product and Engineering to build it into every stage of development. You’ll also have the authority to hold a release that doesn’t meet agreed standards.

This is a hands-on leadership role where you’ll build on existing quality practices, bring structure as we scale, and take ownership from strategy through execution. We’re particularly interested in candidates with experience in a SaaS, scale-up, or startup environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the quality strategy across our web applications, APIs, and data, with particular focus on reimbursement and payment flows. The Web Portal will be your initial priority, with the mobile app following as quality practices mature.
  • Assess existing products and features, identify quality gaps, and prioritize test plans based on risk and business impact.
  • Define quality standards, release criteria, and testing expectations as part of the definition of done. Hold releases that don’t meet the bar and work with Product and Engineering leadership on go/no-go decisions.
  • Guide the choice of testing approaches, tools, and frameworks within the team’s platform and budget, balancing quality, speed, and practical trade-offs.
  • Build, scale, and maintain automation frameworks and shared testing tools across teams, with reliable coverage of critical flows.
  • Embed automated quality gates into CI/CD, including required tests, branch protections, and coverage thresholds. Improve pipeline health and reduce flaky tests.
  • Partner with DevOps/Platform to maintain stable, fast test environments that reflect production.
  • Define and review a focused set of quality metrics and dashboards, including escaped defects, release failures, hotfixes, and rework. Use the results to guide decisions and drive improvement.
  • Work with Engineering, Product, and Design to build testability into requirements and design. Coach engineers to test their own work and meet quality standards independently.
  • Partner with Product on stakeholder testing and release readiness, and turn incident reviews and recurring quality gaps into lasting changes.
  • Apply AI tools to improve testing efficiency and coverage, help the team strengthen its AI-assisted QA practices, and adapt the testing strategy as AI-assisted development evolves.

In your first 30 days, you’ll establish a quality baseline, starting with money flows, and agree on measures and targets with the VP of Engineering. Within three months, you’ll have a release bar in use. Within six months, you’ll be working toward agreed quality targets, with measurable improvement in money flows and teams taking greater ownership of testing.

What You Bring

  • 7+ years in software quality with a focus on senior ownership of quality strategy or architecture. Prior experience as a Lead, QA or QA Manager is highly relevant.
  • Experience in a SaaS, scale-up, startup, or other scaling product environment is strongly preferred.
  • A record of measurably reducing production defects or improving release reliability, and using quality metrics to guide decisions.
  • Experience ensuring the quality of systems that calculate or move money, with an understanding of how financial flows can fail.
  • A track record of building and scaling test automation frameworks.
  • Experience building and improving quality practices in a growing or evolving environment.
  • A hands-on, high-ownership approach: you can set the direction, do the work, and help others adopt it.
  • The ability to influence engineers and product leaders, explain testing trade-offs, and uphold quality standards without becoming a bottleneck.
  • Hands-on experience with TypeScript/JavaScript testing and tools such as Playwright, Vitest, or similar.
  • Experience testing REST APIs and validating data in relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
  • Experience integrating automated tests and quality gates into CI/CD, particularly GitHub Actions or a similar platform.
  • A strong understanding of web application architecture and modern quality engineering practices. Our current stack also includes Flagsmith feature flags.
  • Experience using AI development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, or Copilot to improve testing and automation.
  • Experience with performance or load testing tools such as k6, Locust, or JMeter is a plus.

Compensation

In line with Ontario’s Pay Transparency legislation, the salary range for this role is $145,000 – $160,000 CAD annually, based on experience, skills, and alignment with the role requirements. This is a vacant position, and we are hiring with intention and seeking someone who will bring new perspective, contribute meaningfully to the team, and grow with the organization.

Why you’ll love working at Cardata:

We’ll be honest — Cardata isn’t for everyone. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take extreme ownership, and constantly push yourself (and your work) to be the best, you’ll fit right in.

You’ll be surrounded by driven teammates who genuinely care — about the work, about our customers, and about helping each other succeed. Together, we take on ambitious goals and celebrate the wins along the way.

What we offer in return for you bringing your best:

  • Remote work and flexible working hours
  • Mentorship and development opportunities (to help you achieve your career goals!)
  • Extended medical & dental benefits
  • Healthcare spending account
  • $3,000 annual Health and Wellness Spending Account to support your overall wellbeing
  • Employee assistance program (EAP)
  • Flexible (Unlimited) Time Off: No annual cap on vacation, supported by a trust-based, flexible approach to time away.
