job.title: Senior Supplier Development, Industrialization & Quality Engineer - Seats & Safe
job.description:
Role Summary

The Rivian Supply Chain team is looking for highly motivated technical professionals to ensure the stability and performance of our global supply chain. As a Senior Supplier Development, Industrialization & Quality Engineer, you will serve as a key individual contributor responsible for the quality performance and continuous improvement of an assigned commodity or group of suppliers. You will work with moderate autonomy to ensure that supplier manufacturing capabilities meet design requirements and that quality expectations are strictly followed.

In this role, you will drive results by proactively identifying challenges at the supplier level and proposing actionable solutions to remove risks before they impact production. You are expected to lead the APQP/PPAP process for your assigned area and maintain strong relationships with direct counterparts to resolve recurring issues. This role offers the opportunity to influence sourcing decisions through expert analysis and data-driven insights.

This position is based remotely in Mexico with a 50–75% primarily domestic travel requirement and reports to the Supplier Development Manager.

El equipo de Cadena de Suministro (Supply Chain) de Rivian está en búsqueda de profesionales técnicos altamente motivados para garantizar la estabilidad y el desempeño de nuestra cadena de suministro global. Como Ingeniero Senior de Desarrollo, Industrialización y Calidad de Proveedores (Senior Supplier Development, Industrialization & Quality Engineer), fungirás como un contribuyente individual clave, responsable del desempeño de calidad y la mejora continua de una categoría (commodity) o grupo de proveedores asignado. Trabajarás con autonomía moderada para asegurar que las capacidades de manufactura de los proveedores cumplan con los requisitos de diseño y que las expectativas de calidad se sigan estrictamente.

En este puesto, impulsarás resultados mediante la identificación proactiva de desafíos a nivel proveedor y la propuesta de soluciones viables para mitigar riesgos antes de que impacten la producción. Se espera que lideres el proceso APQP/PPAP para tu área asignada y mantengas relaciones sólidas con tus contrapartes directas para resolver problemas recurrentes. Este rol ofrece la oportunidad de influir en las decisiones de abastecimiento (sourcing) a través de análisis especializados y perspectivas basadas en datos (data-driven insights).

Esta posición es de modalidad remota con base en México, requiere una disponibilidad para viajar del 50 al 75 % (principalmente a nivel nacional) y reporta al Gerente de Desarrollo de Proveedores (Supplier Development Manager).

Responsibilities

  • Supplier Management: Own the quality performance for a Seats and Safety, focusing on maintaining "Low-to-No Risk" (CL3) status. Directly oversee action plans for CL2 suppliers to prevent regression into higher-risk categories.
  • Problem-Solving and Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify challenges and propose specific solutions to remove risks before they impact production. Demonstrate proficiency in robust problem-solving tools (e.g., 5-Why, Fishbone, Is/Isn't) to resolve recurring issues.
  • Technical Skills: Own and lead the APQP/PPAP process for assigned parts, ensuring suppliers meet all technical and documentation standards. Define clear expectations and monitor timelines with suppliers to ensure on-time delivery of quality milestones.
  • Organizational Influence & Outreach: Act as the technical owner for the industrialization of assigned suppliers and manage the final quality sign-off process. Use data-driven insights to directly influence the work of peers.
  • Direction: Operate with moderate autonomy to drive improvements and results within an assigned scope or commodity. Proactively identify challenges and use data-driven logic to propose solutions that remove risk.
  • Development & Industrialization: Work through pre and post launch to develop and industrialize suppliers to ensure they meet Rivian capacity needs.

Responsabilidades:

  • Gestión de Proveedores: Ser el responsable directo del desempeño de calidad para el área de Asientos y Seguridad (Seats and Safety), enfocándose en mantener el estatus de «Riesgo Bajo o Nulo» (CL3). Supervisar directamente los planes de acción para proveedores en categoría CL2 a fin de evitar el retroceso hacia categorías de mayor riesgo.

  • Resolución de Problemas y Mitigación de Riesgos: Identificar desafíos de manera proactiva y proponer soluciones específicas para eliminar riesgos antes de que impacten la producción. Demostrar dominio en herramientas sólidas de resolución de problemas (p. ej., 5 Porqués, diagrama de Ishikawa/espina de pescado, análisis Es/No es) para resolver problemas recurrentes.

  • Habilidades Técnicas: Liderar y gestionar de principio a fin el proceso APQP/PPAP para los componentes asignados, asegurando que los proveedores cumplan con todos los estándares técnicos y de documentación. Definir expectativas claras y dar seguimiento a los cronogramas con los proveedores para garantizar la entrega puntual de los hitos de calidad (quality milestones).

  • Influencia Organizacional y Vinculación: Fungir como el responsable técnico de la industrialización de los proveedores asignados y gestionar el proceso de aprobación final de calidad (quality sign-off). Utilizar análisis basados en datos (data-driven insights) para influir directamente en el trabajo de los colegas.

  • Dirección: Operar con autonomía moderada para impulsar mejoras y resultados dentro de un alcance o categoría (commodity) asignada. Identificar desafíos de forma proactiva y aplicar una lógica basada en datos para proponer soluciones que eliminen riesgos.

  • Desarrollo e Industrialización: Colaborar durante las etapas de prelanzamiento y poslanzamiento para desarrollar e industrializar a los proveedores, asegurando que cumplan con las necesidades de capacidad de Rivian.

Qualifications

  • Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field and a minimum of 3 years of relevant supplier development experience.
  • Domain Expertise: Experience managing commodities and understanding the various factors of impact including economic and technology landscapes.
  • Commodity-Specific Experience: Appearance Level (A-Surface) details, welding, and comfort systems experience.
  • Technical Skills: Advanced knowledge of manufacturing techniques and supplier performance ownership.
  • Communication: Strong distributor of information, capable of aligning larger working groups and defusing conflicts.
  • Execution: Measured by the effective management of KPIs and the number of quality risks successfully mitigated.
  • Operational Style: Responsible for identifying and managing personal priorities to ensure all area-specific milestones are met on time.
  • Travel Requirements: Regular primarily domestic travel is a core part of this role, expected to average between 50–75%.

Requisitos y Calificaciones:

  • Educación y Experiencia: Licenciatura/Ingeniería en Ingeniería o un campo técnico afín, y un mínimo de 3 años de experiencia relevante en desarrollo de proveedores (supplier development).

  • Experiencia en el Área: Experiencia en la gestión de categorías (commodities) y comprensión de los diversos factores de impacto, incluidos los panoramas económicos y tecnológicos.

  • Experiencia Específica por Categoría (Commodity): Experiencia en detalles de nivel de apariencia (superficies Clase A / A-Surface), soldadura y sistemas de confort.

  • Habilidades Técnicas: Conocimiento avanzado de técnicas de manufactura y gestión integral del desempeño de proveedores (supplier performance ownership).

  • Comunicación: Sólida capacidad para difundir información, con habilidad para alinear grupos de trabajo amplios y resolver conflictos.

  • Ejecución: Se evaluará mediante la gestión eficaz de indicadores clave de desempeño (KPI) y el número de riesgos de calidad mitigados con éxito.

  • Estilo Operativo: Responsable de identificar y gestionar las prioridades personales para garantizar que todos los hitos específicos del área se cumplan en tiempo y forma.

  • Requisitos de Viaje: Los viajes frecuentes (principalmente a nivel nacional) son una parte fundamental de este puesto, con un promedio estimado de entre el 50 % y el 75 %.

Pay Disclosure

Pay Disclosure: The salary range for this role is 592,100 MXN - 784,565 MXN annually. This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, shift, and organizational needs. The successful candidate may be eligible for annual performance bonus and equity awards. job.title: QA Engineer
job.description:
Real people. Real service.

At SupplyHouse.com, we value every individual team member and cultivate a community where people come first. As an industry-leading e-commerce company specializing in HVAC, plumbing, heating, and electrical supplies since 2004, we strive to foster growth while providing the best possible experience for our customers.

Through an Employer of Record (EOR), we are looking for a new, remote QA Engineer in India to join our growing IT Team. Role Type: Full-Time

Location: Remote from India

Schedule: Monday through Friday, 4:00 a.m. – 1:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time / 12:00 p.m. – 9:00 p.m. Indian Standard Time to ensure effective collaboration

Base Salary: The expected starting salary for the position is $18,482 to $23,103USD within a full position range of $18,482 to $27,723 USD annually. This range reflects the long-term earning potential for the role. Our starting pay practice is the minimum to middle portion of the range, depending on experience, qualifications, and internal equity, consistent with applicable law and it is rare for a new hire to start above the midpoint.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop, verify, and validate system test cases for web-based and mobile applications
  • Create and execute test plans, set up test environments, and understand + execute test scripts for database execution
  • Validate end-to-end functionality and enhancement requests
  • Resolve technical and business issues using strong analytical, troubleshooting, and debugging skills

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field with 3+ years of QA engineering experience or no degree with 6+ years of equivalent experience
  • 3+ years of programming experience in Java, JavaScript, and SQL
  • 2+ years of web automation experience utilizing page object modeling (POM) including proficiency with Cypress
  • Experience in API testing, both automated and manual, for web, backend, and mobile applications using REST/RestAssured and Micro services
  • Familiarity with test automation tools such as MySQL, Postman, and Eclipse IDE
  • High-level proficiency of written and verbal communication in English

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working in an e-commerce environment
  • 2+ years of mobile automation experience using Appium
    • Additional experience using WebDriver IO + Mocha + Chai is a plus
  • Web automation experience with Selenium and Cucumber
  • Experience using AI platforms to increase productivity (ex: Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, etc.)

Why work with us:

  • We have awesome benefits – We offer a wide variety of benefits to help support you and your loved ones. These include:
    • Comprehensive and affordable medical, dental, vision, and life insurance options
    • Competitive Provident Fund contributions
    • Paid casual and sick leave, plus country-specific holidays
    • Mental health support and wellbeing program
    • Company-provided equipment and one-time $250 USD work from home stipend
    • $750 USD annual professional development budget
    • Company rewards and recognition program
    • And more!
  • We empower ownership – We all contribute to our success and we all share in it. Our Ownership for All program ensures each SupplyHouse team member will benefit financially from the company’s growth and accomplishments.
  • We promote work-life balance – We value your time and encourage a healthy separation between your professional and personal life to feel refreshed and recharged. Look out for our 100% remote schedule and wellness initiatives!
  • We support growth – We strive to innovate every day. In an exciting and evolving industry, we provide potential for career growth through our hands-on training, access to the latest technologies and tools, diversity and inclusion initiatives, opportunities for internal mobility, and professional development budget.
  • We give back – We live and breathe our core value, Generosity, by giving back to the trades and organizations around the world. We make a difference through donation drives, employee-nominated contributions, support for DE&I organizations, and more.
  • We listen – We value hearing from our employees. Everyone has a voice, and we encourage you to use it! We actively elicit feedback through our monthly town halls, regular 1:1 check-ins, and company-wide ideas form to incorporate suggestions and ensure our team enjoys coming to work every day.

Check us out and learn more at !

Additional Details:

  • Remote employees are expected to work in a distraction-free environment. Personal devices, background noise, and other distractions should be kept to a minimum to avoid disrupting virtual meetings or business operations.
  • SupplyHouse.com is an Equal Opportunity Employer, strongly values inclusion, and encourages individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position.
  • To ensure fairness and trust in our hiring process, we ask that all application materials, assessments, and interview responses reflect your own thinking and perspective. You may use AI tools to assist in preparing your responses, as long as this use is clearly disclosed and you can speak authentically to your ideas and work. Our focus is on honesty, judgment, and how you approach problem-solving. We appreciate your transparency and look forward to learning more about your skills.
  • We are committed to providing a safe and secure work environment and conduct thorough background checks on all potential employees in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
  • All emails from the SupplyHouse team will only be sent from an @supplyhouse.com email address. Please exercise caution if you receive an email from an alternate domain.

What is an Employer of Record (EOR)?

Through our partnership with Remote.com, a global Employer of Record (EOR), you can join SupplyHouse from home, while knowing your employment is handled compliantly and securely. Remote takes care of the behind-the-scenes details – like payroll, benefits, taxes, and local compliance – so you can focus on your work and career growth. Even though Remote manages these administrative functions, you’ll be a part of the SupplyHouse team: connected to our culture, collaborating with colleagues, and contributing to our shared success. This partnership allows us to welcome talented team members worldwide while ensuring you receive a best-in-class employee experience.

job.title: Senior Automated QA Engineer (LATAM, Remote)
job.description:
We're hiring a Senior Automated QA Engineer for a US B2B SaaS company in fintech. You'll own automated test coverage across the product: design and build the test framework, run it on every build, and turn the results into clear evidence that a release is safe to ship. This is an engineering seat, so the output is maintainable test code and a regression suite the team trusts, not manual test passes. It's a senior individual contributor role, fully remote from Latin America, with at least 4 hours of overlap with US Pacific time.

What you'll do

  • Design, build and maintain the automated UI, API and integration test framework, so engineers can add coverage without QA becoming a bottleneck
  • Prioritize coverage by customer impact, starting with the workflows users depend on most
  • Run suites in CI/CD on every build and pull request, keep them fast, and fix flaky tests at root cause
  • Build automated checks that catch wrong numbers, not only broken screens: expected-value, reconciliation and plausibility checks for calculated output
  • Own release regression and give a clear go/no-go recommendation with the evidence behind it
  • Reproduce and document defects, verify fixes, and add the test that would have caught every defect that reaches production
  • Automate QA reporting (coverage, pass rates, escaped defects) so it is generated, not assembled by hand

You may be a fit if

  • You have 5+ years of hands-on test automation, writing tests in Python or JavaScript with Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, pytest or similar
  • You've designed or owned a test automation framework (page objects, fixtures, test data), not only added tests to an existing one
  • You build API-level tests that validate business logic below the UI
  • You've run automated suites in CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI or similar)
  • You write Python for test infrastructure and reporting, and you're fluent with Git and pull requests
  • You write clear bug reports engineers can act on without back-and-forth
  • Your written and spoken English is strong, and you're comfortable making a hard go/no-go call
  • You can work at least 4 hours overlapping with US Pacific time

Nice to have

  • Financial, wealth management, risk analytics or compliance domain experience
  • SQL for test data setup and data validation
  • Experience testing Django applications
  • Experience testing AI/LLM features or using AI-assisted test generation
  • Visual regression or self-healing locator tooling

What we offer

  • Fully remote, full-time role
  • Freedom to choose the tooling, design the framework and set testing standards
  • Room to grow into leading quality engineering as the company scales

job.title: Quality Engineering Manager
job.description:
Overview

World Travel Holdings is seeking an experienced Quality Engineering & Test Automation Manager to lead a blended Quality Engineering team and build an AI-enabled, automation-first quality capability for World Travel Holdings (WTH). In this role, you will modernize testing tools and processes, design scalable automation and agentic quality workflows, mentor engineers across manual, exploratory, and automated testing disciplines, and partner closely with Product Management, Business Analysis, Engineering, Architecture, and DevOps teams to improve requirement quality, developer feedback cycles, release readiness, platform resiliency, and business outcomes across the software development lifecycle.

About the Company

World Travel Holdings, headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, FL, is the nation’s largest cruise agency and an award‑winning leisure travel company with nearly 40 travel brands. Through owned brands and private‑label partnerships, we sell cruises, villas, resort day passes, and luxury travel services. With a top-rated franchise, a UK cruise division, and a strong commitment to employee engagement and remote work, World Travel Holdings offers a people-focused culture. Learn more: WorldTravelHoldings.com

Responsibilities

Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a blended Quality Engineering team spanning manual, exploratory, regression, API, performance, accessibility, and automated testing.
  • Manage Quality Engineering team capacity, priorities, and delivery across active initiatives while simplifying, standardizing, and modernizing team processes.
  • Establish an onboarding process that helps Quality Engineering team members ramp quickly and consistently.
  • Build strong working partnerships across Product Management, Business Analysis, Engineering, Architecture, DevOps, and Quality Engineering to establish shared ownership of quality throughout planning, design, development, delivery, and operation.

Automation Framework Strategy

  • Own the design, implementation, and ongoing evolution of a modern, scalable automation framework supporting web, mobile, accessibility, API, integration, performance, and regression testing.
  • Define the automation framework architecture, technical standards, tool selection criteria, coding patterns, and governance practices needed to create a consistent enterprise Quality Engineering approach.
  • Assess existing Quality Engineering tools, test suites, environments, and processes to identify modernization, consolidation, and automation opportunities.
  • Build a roadmap for migrating current testing practices into the future-state automation framework, balancing near-term delivery needs with long-term scalability and maintainability.
  • Partner with Engineering and Architecture teams to ensure Quality Engineering strategies, automation frameworks, test environments, and quality controls support modernization initiatives, cloud readiness, platform resiliency, and long-term technical health.

AI-Enabled Quality Engineering Transformation

  • Develop responsible adoption standards, measurement practices, and team skills for applying AI across Quality Engineering.
  • Design and evolve agentic Quality Engineering workflows that improve consistency, accelerate feedback, and reduce repetitive work while maintaining appropriate engineering oversight.
  • Lead adoption of AI-assisted test generation, execution, maintenance, optimization, coverage analysis, and quality insight capabilities.
  • Establish and communicate an AI-first Quality Engineering vision aligned with the broader Software Engineering transformation strategy.

Delivery Integration and Shift-Left Quality

  • Partner with Product Management and Business Analysts to improve requirement quality, acceptance criteria, maturity, testability, and shared understanding of business risk before development begins.
  • Advance shift-left quality practices by involving Quality Engineering earlier in discovery, refinement, solution design, and delivery planning.
  • Work across Product Management, Business Analysis, Engineering, Architecture, and DevOps to define risk-based quality strategies that connect business expectations, technical design, test coverage, operational readiness, and release decisions.
  • Partner with Engineering and DevOps teams to embed reliable automated test execution, quality gates, environment readiness checks, and actionable reporting into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Ensure appropriate test coverage across functional, regression, performance, load, accessibility, API, and integration testing.
  • Drive adoption of automation-first quality practices that reduce reliance on repetitive manual regression testing while preserving the value of exploratory, risk-based, and customer-focused testing.

Engineering Productivity and Business Outcomes

  • Connect Quality Engineering priorities and reporting to customer experience, franchise experience, agent productivity, release confidence, and platform stability and reliability.
  • Partner with engineering leaders to identify quality improvements that increase development throughput and support faster, more confident release cycles.
  • Reduce developer feedback cycles by improving quality visibility earlier in the software development lifecycle and making results timely, reliable, and actionable.

Quality Metrics and Continuous Improvement

  • Establish quality metrics and framework health reporting to track automation coverage, test effectiveness, execution reliability, defect trends, and release readiness.
  • Develop quality insights that help teams evaluate requirement readiness, acceptance criteria for maturity, automation effectiveness, release confidence, platform resiliency, and recurring indicators of technical health.
  • Evaluate emerging Quality Engineering and AI technologies to improve test creation, execution, maintenance, coverage analysis, developer experience, and quality reporting.
  • Manage resource allocation, planning, and delivery of automation framework initiatives, test modernization, and Quality Engineering improvements.
  • Advocate for modern, AI-first Quality Engineering practices across every stage of the software development lifecycle, and help engineering teams build the skills and operating practices needed to adopt them responsibly.
  • Use quality, productivity, and technical-health insights to identify improvement opportunities, communicate progress, and guide investment decisions across Product and Software Engineering.
  • Define transformation-oriented measures, including manual testing effort, automation adoption, AI testing adoption, engineering throughput, defect escape trends, release cycle speed, and deployment confidence.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in Quality Engineering, software testing, or test automation, including 2+ years in a leadership or management role.
  • Deep hands-on experience designing, implementing, maintaining, and scaling test automation frameworks, including framework architecture, reusable components, coding standards, governance practices, and the practical application of AI-assisted Quality Engineering capabilities.
  • Proficiency in Java, Python, JavaScript, or a similar programming language, with the ability to guide automation of code quality, maintainability, and reusable framework design.
  • Experience integrating automated tests, quality gates, framework health checks, and reporting into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Demonstrated ability to modernize legacy Quality Engineering tools, consolidate fragmented testing approaches, and guide teams toward a future-state automation framework.
  • Demonstrated experience advancing shift-left quality practices through early collaboration on requirements, acceptance criteria, solution design, testability, and delivery risk.
  • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery, the software testing lifecycle, and how Quality Engineering practices support product delivery and release readiness.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and leadership skills, with the ability to influence technical direction, explain framework and quality tradeoffs, and align Product Management, Business Analysis, Engineering, Architecture, DevOps, and Quality Engineering stakeholders around modernization priorities, business risk, and quality outcomes.
  • Experience evaluating or implementing AI-assisted software engineering or Quality Engineering capabilities, including test generation, test maintenance, coverage analysis, release readiness, or agentic workflows preferred.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and containerization technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes a plus.
  • Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, or Locust; security testing practices; test management platforms such as TestRail or Zephyr; API mocking; service-level API testing; SQL queries; and database testing across SQL and NoSQL databases preferred.
  • Travel industry experience ideal.

Compensation & Benefits Estimated Pay Range: $135,000 - $150,000Benefits Overview:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Company-paid life and disability insurance
  • 401(k) with discretionary company match
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Travel discounts and employee perks
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Professional development and learning opportunities

job.title: Senior Product Quality Engineer
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Product Quality Engineer at Peloton, you will be responsible for ensuring our hardware products are designed, manufactured, and tested to a high quality standard so that our members can continue to access Peloton’s fitness experiences throughout the life of their products. You will need to identify major risks starting from the earliest project stages and define quality plans to mitigate and control these risks prior to launch. You will also be responsible for leading investigations of top issues from root cause analysis through to corrective action, and documenting learnings to prevent recurrence of similar issues in the future. This role will work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Service and Repair, and other teams starting from concept through to mass production and sustaining. 

YOUR DAILY IMPACT AT PELOTON

  • Partner with multi-functional teams through early risk assessments (using FMEA/NUD processes and past lessons learned). Implement mitigation strategies and test plans to address and close potential risks
  • Drive alignment across the various Quality functions, including Supplier Quality, Field Quality, Reliability, Failure Analysis, and Safety
  • Lead cross-functional response to critical quality escalations and drive complex issues to closure using methodical 8D/RCCA approaches
  • Define, implement, and audit quality processes at our FATP sites to ensure final products meet quality targets
  • Develop predictive models to estimate warranty rates from available field test and reliability data
  • Communicate Quality risks, mitigations, and next steps to the leadership team and other key stakeholders
  • Influence partners to implement quality improvements for field performance
  • This role requires domestic and international travel up to 30%

YOU BRING TO PELOTON

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science, or other technical discipline
  • 6+ years of experience in product development with 3+ years specifically in a Quality role for complex electro-mechanical products (e.g., Fitness Equipment, Medical Devices, Automotive, or Consumer Electronics)
  • Demonstrated understanding of NPI (New Product Introduction) cycles and how to successfully drive quality improvements during development
  • Track record of leading cross-functional technical teams through the resolution of business-critical quality issues
  • Ability to develop specifications and test plans, and translate test results into field predictions
  • Proficiency in statistical data analysis and related software tools (e.g., Minitab, JMP)
  • Deep technical knowledge of advanced quality tools and methodologies (eg., DOE, MSA, Hypothesis testing, GR&R, CpK)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to build consensus and influence decisions at all levels of an organization

BONUS

  • Advanced Degree in Science or Engineering
  • Six-Sigma Greenbelt training or certification

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including H-1B transfers.

#LI-KN1
#LI-Hybrid

 

The base salary range represents the low and high end of the anticipated salary range for this position based at our Woodinville, WA headquarters. The actual base salary offered for this position will depend on numerous factors including, without limitation, experience and business objectives and if the location for the job changes. Our base salary is just one component of Peloton’s competitive total rewards strategy that also includes annual equity awards and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan as well as other region-specific health and welfare benefits.

As an organization, one of our top priorities is to maintain the health and wellbeing for our employees and their family. To achieve this goal, we offer robust and comprehensive benefits including:

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance 
  • Generous paid time off policy
  • Short-term and long-term disability
  • Access to mental health services
  • 401k, tuition reimbursement and student loan paydown plans
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Fertility and adoption support and up to 18 weeks of paid parental leave 
  • Child care and family care discounts
  • Free access to Peloton Digital App and apparel and product discounts
  • Commuter benefits and Citi Bike Discount
  • Pet insurance and so much more!
Base Salary Range
$125,915—$154,715 USD

 

ABOUT PELOTON:

Peloton (NASDAQ: PTON) provides Members with expert instruction, and world class content to create impactful and entertaining workout experiences for anyone, anywhere and at any stage in their fitness journey. At home, outdoors, traveling, or at the gym, Peloton brings together innovative hardware, distinctive software, and exclusive content. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in New York City, Peloton has millions of Members across the US, UK, Canada, Germany, Australia, and Austria. For more information, visit www.onepeloton.com.

Peloton is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. Equal employment opportunity has been, and will continue to be, a fundamental principle at Peloton, where all team members, applicants, and other covered persons are considered on the basis of their personal capabilities and qualifications without discrimination because of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital and civil partnership/union status, alienage or citizenship status, creed, genetic predisposition or carrier status, unemployment status, familial status, domestic violence, sexual violence or stalking victim status, caregiver status, or any other protected characteristic as established by applicable law. This policy of equal employment opportunity applies to all practices and procedures relating to recruitment and hiring, compensation, benefits, termination, and all other terms and conditions of employment.  If you would like to request any accommodations from application through to interview, please email: applicantaccommodations@onepeloton.com.

At Peloton, we embrace technology, including AI, to enhance productivity and accelerate innovation in the work we do for our members. job.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
job.description:
Senior QA Automation Engineer

Local Now | Remote (United States)

About Local Now

Local Now is a free, ad-supported streaming service delivering local news, weather, sports, and lifestyle programming to viewers across virtually every connected device. As part of Allen Media Group, we operate at meaningful scale across mobile, smart TVs, streaming sticks, set-top boxes, and the web. We are now investing in a ground-up rebuild of our streaming platform with a privacy-first architecture, modern shared-code strategy, and the engineering rigor needed to grow sustainably.

We build for audiences who expect frictionless playback on any device, and for advertisers who depend on us to deliver reliable, high-quality monetization. The work is tangible: every improvement we make is felt by millions of viewers.

The Role

We are hiring aSenior QA Automation Engineerto lead the design, implementation, and scaling of our automated testing strategy as our LN 2.0 streaming platform launches and stays exceptional across every device family we ship on. You will work closely with our QA Manager and the engineering team to architect test frameworks, design test coverage, and drive end-to-end automation for a product where playback quality and ad reliability directly affect business outcomes.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with high technical ownership. You will be the foundational automation lead in the new QA practice we are building, establishing the tools, standards, and pipelines that will scale with our platform.

What You Will Do

  • Architect, build, and scale maintainable test automation frameworks across mobile, connected TV (CTV) platforms, and web.

  • Drive the test automation roadmap, establishing automation best practices, framework architecture, page-object models, and test data strategies.

  • Integrate automated test suites directly into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Jenkins) for continuous regression, deployment health checks, and release gating.

  • Test video playback (live and VOD), ad insertion (client-side and server-side), and quality-of-experience (QoE) scenarios.

  • Test and debug API/microservice integrations for data integrity, performance, and contract validation.

  • Validate privacy and consent flows: CMP behavior, preference persistence, DSAR-affected paths, and PII boundaries.

  • Report bugs with the rigor that engineers actually want to read — clean repro steps, environments, logs, and severity assessment.

  • Partner with engineering leads on triage, regression coverage, architecture reviews, and quality metrics.

  • Contribute to a device lab strategy and solve the practical realities of automating and testing across many CTV platforms.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of QA experience on consumer software, with at least 3 years leading automation efforts on multi-platform mobile and/or CTV products.

  • Proven track record of architecting automated test frameworks from scratch for web, mobile, or CTV using modern tools (e.g., Playwright, Appium, Detox, XCUITest, Espresso, or Robot Framework).

  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining automated CI/CD test pipelines.

  • Streaming video QA experience — playback, manifests, ad pods, DRM, QoE.

  • Hands-on testing and automation familiarity on Roku, Fire TV, Apple TV, Android TV, Tizen, or Vizio platforms.

  • Strong analytical and bug-investigation skills; able to isolate environmental, timing, and platform-specific issues.

  • Clear written communication; excellent at writing reproducible bug reports and concise automation docs and test plans.

  • Self-directed technical leader who thrives in a remote, distributed engineering culture.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with consent / privacy testing or compliance-driven regression suites.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools like Cursor and Claude to accelerate test authoring, triage, and analysis.

  • Experience setting up physical or cloud-based device farms (e.g., AWS Device Farm, Sauce Labs, HeadSpin) for automated CTV/mobile testing.

job.description:

Job Summary

The Team Leader, Quality is responsible for supervising a team of Quality Analysts and overseeing transaction monitoring, quality audits, and performance feedback to ensure quality standards meet or exceed client goals. This role coaches and develops Quality Analysts, drives process improvement initiatives, and serves as a liaison between Quality, Operations, and clients to resolve issues and support business needs.

  • Oversee transaction monitoring of new trainees and production employees to ensure quality meets or exceeds client goals and objectives.
  • Perform regular audits on assigned Quality Analysts to ensure consistency of methods, quality of evaluation, and accuracy of scoring, providing documented feedback on strengths and opportunities.

  • Ensure effective training is conducted for all positions within the assigned area of responsibility, and monitor staffing levels and turnover to recommend retention strategies.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition to develop hiring strategies for current and future open positions.

  • Review quality reports and analysis used by both clients and operations, and identify and recommend improvements to client policies and procedures that benefit the business.
  • Set SMART goals for department processes, and review and revise existing processes and procedures to align with those goals.
  • Create customized monitoring forms to fit client business needs, and lead the creation of responses to priority or highly complex client requests within given deadlines.
  • Serve as liaison with clients to review and resolve issues, including rebuttals, claims appeals, end-of-shift reports, and other QA-Operations reports.
  • Lead team meetings and operational-level client calls, and conduct sessions to guide employees across departments on process updates and execution.
  • Establish and maintain professional relationships with team members and stakeholders, escalating workflow or communication issues to the direct supervisor as needed.

What Does a Day of a Quality Assurance Team Lead Look Like?

  • Quality Oversight & Auditing: Overseeing transaction monitoring of new trainees and production employees to ensure quality meets or exceeds client goals and objectives. Performing regular audits on assigned Quality Analysts to guarantee evaluation consistency, method quality, and scoring accuracy.

  • Team Leadership & Development: Supervising a team of Quality Analysts by organizing schedules, delegating work, and providing developmental feedback to support team and process growth. Coaching, mentoring, and conducting formal performance appraisals for assigned analysts while assisting with career development goals.

Leading team meetings and operational-level client calls to guide employees across departments on process updates and execution.

  • Data & Process Analysis: Reviewing transaction and data trends in functional databases to identify the need to revise existing methods and procedures. Analyzing monitoring and feedback methods to determine effectiveness and developing action plans to resolve issues in a timely manner.

  • Strategy & Cross-Functional Support: Partnering with Talent Acquisition to develop hiring strategies for current and future open positions. Setting SMART goals for department processes, creating customized monitoring forms, and reviewing quality reports to recommend business improvements.

What Does a Qualified Candidate Look Like?

  • Education & Foundational Experience: A Bachelor's degree in Business or a related field, or an equivalent trade qualification, where equivalent work experience may substitute for the educational requirement. A minimum of one to two (1-2) years of experience on a Quality Assurance team within an outsourced services environment.

  • Core Competencies & Soft Skills: Excellent organizational, planning, time management, and analytical skills, backed by strong team-building, interpersonal, and communication abilities. The ability to lead and supervise effectively in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment while managing multiple priorities. Strong commercial understanding, with prior accountability for profit or performance targets, alongside a high level of integrity, honesty, and sound judgment.

Testing software products as early and often as possible is proven to improve the resolution of the quality picture and thus enable the software development team to objectively improve the quality of the software. The test cases for our software products are developed by the people with the most knowledge of the product. The output of the effort is a list of procedure-based test cases encompassing the desired test coverage. This position is intended to execute the test cases daily and at release milestones.

Major Responsibilities:

  • Manually execute scheduled tests as written, on time

  • Participate in reviews for new test cases developed

  • Report status at team standups

  • Manually perform Ad-Hoc testing

  • Work with Software Test Manager to collaborate, review, and deliver high quality software testing

  • Identify and correct spelling, grammar, punctuation, and other language errors.

Job Description: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our engineering team. The ideal candidate is a software engineer with a passion for quality who can design, develop, and maintain scalable test automation solutions while collaborating closely with software developers, DevOps engineers, product managers, and QA professionals.

The SDET will play a key role in ensuring software quality throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) by building robust automation frameworks, developing testing tools, integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines, and promoting quality engineering best practices.

Key Responsibilities

Test Automation & Framework Development

Design, develop, and maintain scalable, reusable, and maintainable automation frameworks.

Develop automated test scripts for Web, Mobile, Desktop, API, and Microservices applications.

Create data-driven, keyword-driven, hybrid, and behavior-driven (BDD) automation frameworks.

Continuously improve automation coverage and execution efficiency.

Software Development

Refactor automation code to improve maintainability and scalability.

API & Backend Testing

Validate request/response payloads, authentication, authorization, and business logic.

Develop reusable API testing libraries.

Continuous Integration & DevOps

Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.

Configure and maintain automated test execution in Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar platforms.

Analyze pipeline failures and improve test reliability.

Support shift-left testing practices.

Quality Engineering

Identify quality risks early in the SDLC.

Develop comprehensive test strategies and test plans.

Improve application testability through collaboration with developers.

Drive quality metrics and automation adoption.

Performance & Security Testing

Test Data & Environment Management

Create and maintain reusable test data.

Agile Collaboration

This is a hands-on technical role where you’ll build the QA program that safeguards conversion, data integrity, accessibility, and performance. You’ll work cross-functionally with Engineering, Growth, Lifecycle, Design, and CX to help Dose ship fast without breaking checkout, analytics, or the customer experience.

You’ll be accountable for:

  • Zero critical conversion defects reaching production.

  • Analytics event accuracy and data integrity (≥ 99%).

  • Performance and accessibility SLAs (Core Web Vitals “Good” rates; WCAG 2.2 AA compliance).

  • Reliable, on-time releases with automated regression coverage.

  • Rapid incident detection, clear communication, and closed-loop corrective action.

What You’ll Do

Quality Systems & Release Management

  • Define and run the end-to-end QA lifecycle — requirements → test plans → automation → UAT → production verification.

  • Establish go/no-go criteria for every release and maintain a stable staging environment.

  • Own regression suites for storefront, checkout, account, subscription, and CMS flows.

Test Engineering & Automation

  • Build and maintain automated tests (Playwright, Cypress) across critical paths and devices; integrate with CI/CD pipelines.

  • Create synthetic test data (users, orders, subscriptions) and mock external services as needed.

Analytics, Tagging & Experiment QA

  • Govern the data layer spec and validate events across GA4, server-side tagging, and consent states.

  • Manage pixels and tags (Klaviyo, Braze, Meta, Google, RMNs) for accuracy and privacy compliance (CMP, TCPA, GDPR/CCPA).

  • QA A/B tests and feature flags (Eppo, Optimizely) for bucketing, exposures, and conversions.

Content, Merchandising & SEO QA

  • Pre-flight new products, promotions, and campaigns for pricing, tax, shipping, and inventory accuracy.

  • Validate structured data, canonicalization, and sitemap health to maintain SEO integrity.

Performance, Accessibility & Security

  • Monitor Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) and enforce Lighthouse and performance budgets.

  • Ensure WCAG 2.2 AA compliance (keyboard navigation, color contrast, alt text).

  • Validate payment flows (Shop Pay, Apple Pay, Google Pay, credit cards) and maintain PCI awareness.

Monitoring, Incidents & Continuous Improvement

  • Implement real-time monitoring (Sentry, uptime, log alerts) and post-release verifications.

  • Lead incident triage and root-cause analyses; drive corrective/preventive actions.

  • Maintain QA dashboards tracking defects, MTTR, and test coverage.

Integrations & Ecosystem QA

  • QA integrations across Shopify Plus, subscriptions (Recharge or similar), reviews (Okendo), search/recommendations, ESP/SMS, and reverse-ETL pipelines.

  • Validate ERP/3PL hooks that impact inventory, pricing, and delivery promises.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5–8 years in e-commerce QA or QA leadership, including automation for high-traffic storefronts.

  • Hands-on experience with Shopify Plus (or similar), checkout/payment stacks, and subscription platforms.

  • Deep knowledge of GA4, server-side tagging, data layers, and pixels.

  • Proficiency with Playwright/Cypress, CI/CD pipelines, and defect tracking (Jira, Linear).

  • Familiarity with Core Web Vitals, WCAG 2.2 AA, technical SEO, and performance tuning.

  • Clear, concise communicator who can translate defects into business impact and drive prioritization.

  • Bonus: SQL, API testing (Postman), schema/contract testing, and retail media network experience.

Team & Growth

You’ll start as an individual contributor with dotted-line leadership over agency and contract QA partners — and the opportunity to hire a QA Engineer (automation) and Content QA Coordinator as scope scales.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

At Dose, you’ll set the quality bar for one of the fastest-growing wellness brands in the U.S. You’ll protect what matters most — the customer experience — while building a modern, scalable QA program from the ground up.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $150,000 – $165,000 USD (depending on experience, location, and skills)

  • Performance Bonus: Based on company and individual goals

  • Benefits: Comprehensive health coverage, 401(k), and flexible PTO

Final pay will depend on your background, expertise, and where you live.

Equal Opportunity

Dose is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in all its forms and make all employment decisions based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, in line with applicable laws. If you need an accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know.

job.title: Quality Engineer II
job.description:
Why Merit?

At Merit Medical, our mission is to create innovative medical devices that improve lives. Our goal is to hire and develop people who want to build something special through hard work, team effort, and commitment. Together, we are making a difference in the lives of patients around the world.

WORK SHIFT

DAY (United States of America)

SUMMARY OF DUTIES

Provides routine and complex quality engineering work for specific product lines under broad supervision and guidelines. Responsibilities include: failure investigation, oversight/ determination of disposition of nonconforming materials, conducting and updating risk analysis documentation and processes, defining/refining quality inspection plans, performing data collection and trending for presentation of key metrics, identifying and addressing supplier quality issues, reviewing and generating validation/protocol data, and optimizing and improving quality systems and documentation.

This position can be fully remote and may be based anywhere. Candidates must be able and willing to travel approximately 20% of the time to company sites in various countries.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS PERFORMED


1. Independently evaluates, selects, and applies standard engineering techniques, procedures, and criteria, using judgment in making minor adaptations and modifications.
2. Works independently on standard projects while assistance is furnished on unusual problems.
3. Receives instructions on specific assignment objectives, complex features and possible solutions.
4. Responsible for risk management documentation for assigned product line(s) or processes; and identifying and updating failure modes and related process/product improvements by facilitating teams and implementing required changes.
5. Reviews, approves and generates Engineering Change Notifications (ECNs) to update or generate: verification, validation, monitoring and inspection methods, procedures, and test protocols; specific to assigned product line(s) and processes and production control(s).
6. Evaluates and participates in the selection of suppliers by monitoring supplier performance, through collection and trending of data and performing supplier quality audits, as required.
7. Reviews nonconformance records (internal/external) to determine: disposition, root cause and need for corrective and preventive actions.
8. Ensures containment (identification, segregation and reconciliation) of nonconforming product has been performed, to prevent unintended use.
9. Identifies and implements any changes necessary to ensure and maintain the continued suitability and effectiveness of the quality management system through the use of: quality policy, quality objectives, audit results, analysis of data, etc.
10. Evaluates the work environment, in which product is manufactured, is adequately environmentally controlled and monitored, with sufficient personnel and safety production controls.
11. May participate in design and development activities.
12. Performs other related duties and tasks as required.

ESSENTIAL PHYSICAL/ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS


  • Lifting -- Not to exceed 50 lbs. – local practice may apply.

• Writing

• Sitting

  • Standing

• Bending

  • Vision

• Color perception

• Depth perception

  • Reading
    • Field of vision/peripheral
    • Fine motor skills
    • Noise

• Chemical vapors


SUMMARY OF MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS


  • Education and/or experience equivalent to a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or related field with three years quality engineering experience

job.title: Director, Engineering - Quality Assurance
job.description:
Job title:Director, Engineering - Quality Assurance

Reports to:Chief Information Officer

Division:Central Services

Location:US or Waterloo

Grade:23

About Priority Commerce:

Priority Commerce is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy-to-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. Our vision is to eliminate the barriers to unlocking revenue - empowering businesses to grow faster and operate smarter.

We achieve this through the Priority Commerce Engine, an innovative platform that combines payables, acquiring, and banking and treasury solutions. This unified approach allows businesses to streamline financial operations, reduce unnecessary costs, and uncover new revenue opportunities.

At Priority Commerce, we're driven by results. We expect our people tobe known for results- bringing expertise, momentum, and relentless focus to every challenge, helping our clients and each other thrive.

About the Role:

The Director of QA plays a key role in protecting the reliability and integrity of Priority’s commerce platform by owning the strategy, people, and practices that ensure software is tested thoroughly before it reaches our clients. This leader builds and scales a high-performing quality organization,

modernizes test automation, and embeds quality into every stage of the software development lifecycle, from requirements through production release. The position requires deep expertise in QA leadership, test automation, and CI/CD, along with the ability to drive measurable quality outcomes in a regulated payments environment. You’ll collaborate with Engineering, Product, DevOps/SRE, Security, Compliance, and Application Support to reduce production defects and customer-impacting incidents, and to accelerate safe, predictable delivery across Priority’s products.

Responsibilities:

  • Defines and owns the enterprise QA strategy, roadmap, standards, and quality governance across all engineering teams and products.

  • Builds, leads, and develops a high-performing QA organization of managers, QA engineers, and automation (SDET) engineers, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and succession planning.

  • Directs the design, implementation, and maintenance of scalable test automation frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) covering UI, API, integration, and regression testing.

  • Partners with Engineering and DevOps to integrate automated testing and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines, enabling shift-left testing and fast, reliable release cycles.

  • Oversees performance, load, and capacity testing, and partners with Security to incorporate security testing (SAST/DAST, vulnerability validation) into the release process.

  • Establishes and reports QA metrics and KPIs (e.g., defect escape rate, defect density, automation coverage, test pass rate, mean time to detect/resolve, release quality) to engineering and executive leadership.

  • Owns defect management and triage processes, including severity/priority standards, root cause analysis, and closing the loop on production incidents with targeted regression coverage.

  • Embeds QA practices within Agile/Scrum teams and the SDLC, ensuring testability, clear acceptance criteria, and test planning from requirements through production.

  • Ensures testing practices, test data management, and release evidence support PCI-DSS, SOC 2, and other applicable regulatory and audit requirements.

  • Manages QA tooling, test environments, budget, and any outsourced or partner QA resources to deliver quality at scale and at an appropriate cost.

  • Collaborates cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, SRE, Application Support, Security, and Compliance to align quality goals with business priorities and customer outcomes.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Customer-impacting incidents and production defects attributable to escaped defects are measurably and consistently reduced.

  • Releases ship on a predictable cadence with automated quality gates in CI/CD, and teams trust the test suite to tell them when something is wrong.

  • Automation coverage of critical payment, funding, and user journeys grows steadily, while manual regression effort and cycle time decline.

  • Performance and load testing identify capacity and scalability risks before they reach production.

  • QA metrics and KPIs are visible, trusted, and used by engineering and executive leadership to make release and investment decisions.

  • Audits and customer assessments find well-evidenced testing and change controls with no surprises.

  • The QA organization is viewed as a trusted partner that accelerates delivery rather than a bottleneck, with strong talent retention and a clear growth path for team members.

Candidate Requirements:

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • 10+ years of experience in software quality assurance and testing, including 5+ years in QA leadership roles managing managers and/or multiple teams.

  • Proven track record of building and scaling QA organizations and establishing QA strategy, standards, and processes across multiple products or teams.

  • Hands-on expertise with modern test automation frameworks and tools (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) and API testing tools (e.g., Postman, REST Assured).

  • Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps).

  • Experience leading performance/load testing (e.g., JMeter, k6, Gatling, LoadRunner) and partnering on security testing practices.

  • Strong working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies, the SDLC, and defect management tools (e.g., Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, Xray).

  • Demonstrated ability to define, track, and report QA metrics and KPIs to drive continuous improvement.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business audiences.

Preferred

  • Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or other regulated financial services environments.

  • Working awareness of PCI-DSS, SOC 2 Type II, and related compliance requirements as they apply to testing, test data, and change management.

  • Experience testing cloud-native and distributed architectures (AWS preferred), microservices, and high-volume transaction systems.

  • Experience managing offshore, nearshore, or outsourced QA partners.

  • Proficiency in one or more programming languages (e.g., Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, C#) used for test automation.

  • Certifications such as ISTQB Advanced/Expert Level, CSTE, or Certified Scrum Master (CSM).

Work Environment & Culture:

We believe that performance and experience go hand in hand -an exceptional employee experience is earned through contribution. We are a results-driven team, grounded in our core values: ownership, authenticity, service, trust, innovation, and camaraderie.

Our culture is built for those who want to make an impact. We challenge each other to grow, celebrate progress, and support one another through shared goals and real connection. Whether you're building technology, serving clients, or supporting internal teams, you’ll be part of a company that empowers you to perform at your best and be known for results.

Compensation and Benefits:

Compensation range:$233K-$291K USD, $190K-$257K CAD
We invest in the whole employee - personally and professionally. Our benefits package is designed to support your well-being, growth, and success - both inside and outside of work.

Financial Wellness

  • HSA and FSA options

  • Financial wellness resources and employee discount programs

Health & Well-being

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Mental health support for employees and dependents through Lyra Health

  • Family planning and women’s health benefits through Carrot

  • Gym membership reimbursement and virtual wellness programs (including yoga)

Time Off

  • 3 weeks PTO to start, with unlimited PTO after year one

Growth & Development

  • Education expense reimbursement

  • Leadership development programs

  • Certified Payments Professional (CPP) certification support

We believe great performance starts with feeling supported - and we’ve built our benefits with that in mind.

Traditional Physical Requirements:

  • Requires prolonged sitting, standing, bending, stooping and stretching.

  • Requires the ability to lift 10 pounds.

  • Requires eye-hand coordination, manual dexterity and a normal range of hearing and vision (with or without correction).

Join our team at Priority Commerce and be part of a dynamic and innovative company that is transforming the financial technology landscape. Together, we can shape the future of payments and banking solutions while providing unmatched value to our clients.

job.title: Data Test Engineer
job.description:
Job Title: Data Test EngineerJob Category: Information TechnologyTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: SecretEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Continental US* * *

The Opportunity:
Join our team supporting USTRANSCOM's Joint Transportation Management System (JTMS), a mission-critical enterprise platform that modernizes transportation, logistics, and financial operations through SAP S/4HANA ERP integration. We're looking for an accomplished Data Tester to validate data quality, transformation, migration, interfaces, and reconciliation across this large-scale SAP implementation. Your expertise in database validation, SQL, source-to-target testing, and enterprise data flows will be essential to ensuring JTMS data is accurate, complete, consistent, and reliable. In this role, you'll partner with developers, data engineers, business analysts, functional teams, and product owners within a SAFe Agile environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Requirements and Data Analysis: Review user stories, interface requirements, data mappings, transformation rules, business rules, and source-to-target specifications to identify data test conditions and acceptance criteria
  • Data Test Development: Design, build, and maintain data test cases, SQL queries, reconciliation checks, test data sets, and expected results for SAP S/4HANA and other integrated applications
  • Data Validation: Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, integrity, referential relationships, formats, transformations, and business-rule compliance across source and target systems
  • Migration and Conversion Testing: Test data extraction, cleansing, transformation, loading, conversion, and reconciliation activities and verify migrated data against approved source-to-target rules
  • Interface and Integration Testing: Validate inbound and outbound data exchanged among SAP S/4HANA, SAP Fiori, Mendix applications, interfaces, and external systems, including error handling and exception processing
  • Defect Management: Document data defects with queries, evidence, expected/actual results, and reproducible conditions; track issues through resolution and retest
  • Test Documentation: Create and maintain data test plans, test cases, test evidence, traceability, reconciliation results, and data-quality reports aligned with SAFe Agile practices
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with data engineers, developers, functional analysts, business stakeholders, and integration teams to resolve data issues and maximize test coverage
  • Agile Participation: Actively engage in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve data-testing methods, reusable SQL validation, automation, reporting, and data-quality controls

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Security Clearance: Active Secret clearance (required)
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent professional experience)
  • Experience: Minimum 5 years in software testing with a minimum of 2 years dedicated data testing for large-scale enterprise or ERP systems
  • Data Testing Expertise: Hands-on experience with data validation, ETL/ELT testing, source-to-target reconciliation, data migration/conversion testing, and data-quality testing
  • SQL Skills: Strong SQL skills for querying, comparing, aggregating, reconciling, and troubleshooting data across relational databases
  • Agile Methodology: Strong working knowledge of SAFe Framework, SDLC, and Agile development practices
  • Core Competencies: Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, strong written and verbal communication skills, and ability to work independently and collaboratively

Desired:

  • Technical Skills: Experience with data profiling, ETL tools, APIs, flat files, XML/JSON, and data comparison or reconciliation utilities
  • SAP / ERP Experience: Experience testing SAP S/4HANA or comparable ERP data, workflows, integrations, interfaces, or migration activities
  • Test Management: Experience with ServiceNow CWM (Collaborative Work Management) or comparable
-

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The proposed salary range for this position is:

$98,500-$206,800

CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

job.title: QA Engineer
job.description:
About Aras

Backed by top-tier investors, Aras is the fastest-growing Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) company, reinventing engineering and manufacturing software to empower our customers with the flexibility to overcome tomorrow's challenges. From our technology to our community to the way we do business, we are transforming the way the world makes products.

Our open, low-code technology enables greater scalability, flexibility, and security for the world's largest enterprises. Airbus, General Electric (GE), Hitachi, Honda, Kawasaki, and Microsoft are just a few of the organizations using our software. Aras serves a variety of industries including automotive, aerospace and defense, high-tech electronics, medical devices, and industrial manufacturing.

About the Role

We are looking for a QA Engineer to join our team working on cloud services and developer-focused products.

Innovator Edge, which our team works on, is a cloud extension layer for Innovator that exposes data and business processes through modern APIs, lightweight web applications, and an event-driven integration model. One of its key components, Edge Builder, is a platform for building lightweight, task-focused web applications. It provides a CLI, templates, automated deployment, and integration with GitHub and Azure, allowing developers to focus on application logic rather than infrastructure.

In this role, you will focus primarily on manual and exploratory testing of complex cloud services, many of which do not have a traditional UI and are primarily used by developers. Some services do have a UI, but the main focus is on service-level, API, and integration testing. You will be responsible for designing test scenarios, maintaining test documentation, and supporting quality across the product. Test automation is not the main focus of the role, but you will be expected to contribute to automation where it makes sense and to collaborate with developers on automated testing efforts.

Responsibilities

  • Perform manual and exploratory testing of cloud services and developer-facing products
  • Design, write, and maintain test scenarios, test cases, and test documentation
  • Test APIs, CLI tools, and service integrations
  • Test web-based UIs where applicable
  • Participate in requirements and design discussions to identify risks and improve testability
  • Work closely with developers to investigate issues and improve product quality
  • Validate fixes, reproduce issues, and help drive them to resolution
  • Contribute to testing strategies and overall quality improvements
  • Participate in and support test automation efforts when appropriate

Requirements

  • Experience as a QA Engineer / Software Tester
  • Proven experience in test design and maintaining test documentation
  • Experience in testing APIs and service-based systems
  • Experience in CLI testing or working with command-line tools
  • Basic development skills: ability to create simple applications or tools in Visual Studio (e.g., for testing, debugging, or repro scenarios)
  • Good understanding of software development and testing principles
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work closely with developers
  • Proactive, comfortable with complex tasks, and a strong team player
  • English level: Intermediate or higher (all the communication in English)

Nice to Have

  • Experience with test automation or automated test frameworks
  • Experience in testing cloud-based systems
  • Experience with Azure DevOps or CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience in testing web UIs for non-developer end users
  • Experience with custom npm package testing


    The position is open to candidates currently based in Poland

job.title: Salesforce QA Engineer
job.description:
About FUNDINGO

FUNDINGO is a cloud-based loan management solution designed to automate the day-to-day tasks of loan origination, underwriting, and loan servicing. By using FUNDINGO, our clients eliminate most manual activities and make their lending process efficient and transparent to all stakeholders. We are one of the fastest growing loan management solutions and a Salesforce innovation award winner.

FUNDINGO is a leader in the world of cloud-based technology solutions for alternative lenders. Founded and staffed by experts in FinTech, Lending and Salesforce, FUNDINGO develops technology solutions, built on the Salesforce platform, for companies across North America.

Role Overview

As a Salesforce QA Engineer, you are the quality gatekeeper for the FUNDINGO platform and the client implementations built on it. Our clients rely on FUNDINGO to run their lending operations, so what you catch before go-live directly protects their business and ours. Because each implementation is configured to an individual client’s lending process, no two testing cycles look quite the same.

Responsibilities

  • Design test processes and procedures that ensure software operates within defined requirements.

  • Create detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured test plans and test cases.

  • Implement test plans, automation, and validation strategies.

  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts to reduce repetitive manual testing.

  • Perform in-depth functional testing, evaluating functional stability to confirm business requirements are met and solutions are “fit for purpose” through end-to-end functional and automation testing.

  • Work closely with developers and business analysts to resolve issues.

  • Clearly communicate obstacles early to raise awareness and avoid project impediments or timeline disruptions.

  • Collaborate with the Product Owner, Business Analysts, and Developers on planning, testing, and coordinating release activities.

  • Participate in user story creation by breaking down high-level requirements during team review sessions.

  • Own quality control for package implementations in each client’s Salesforce org, verifying every deployment meets requirements before it goes live.

  • Maintain a registry of issues found during implementation, documenting each one clearly and tracking it through to resolution.

  • Partner closely with the Implementation team so testing stays in step with implementation progress.

Technical Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance roles, including automation testing.

  • Expert-level QA experience on the Salesforce platform.

  • Experience writing clear, concise, and comprehensive test plans and test cases.

  • Knowledge of testing integrations and end-to-end system processes.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a demonstrated ability to think outside the box.

job.title: Quality Engineer
job.description:
Quartermaster is building the world's most comprehensive maritime intelligence platform. Our SmartMast™ system transforms commercial and civilian vessels into a persistent, distributed sensing network—combining HD video, AI, radar, RF sensing, and AIS to deliver real-time maritime domain awareness at global scale. With 600+ sensors deployed across 25+ countries and more than 400,000 vessels identified outside of AIS, we are setting a new standard for what ocean surveillance and safety can look like. We are a mission-driven, high-velocity team building dual-use technology for defense agencies, coast guards, and commercial maritime operators.

Job Description:

We are seeking a Quality Engineer to strengthen our quality systems and support rising production volumes across Quartermaster’s SmartMast™ systems and related marine products. This role will help us reduce defects and field returns, lead structured root-cause investigations, and keep our hardware manufacturing and deployment operations audit-ready as we scale globally. The right candidate has strong hands-on experience building practical quality management processes for electromechanical hardware in demanding environments, and can partner effectively across engineering, supply chain, and contract manufacturers to catch issues early and drive continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain, and scale our Quality Management System (QMS), standard operating procedures, and inspection protocols to ensure continuous audit readiness (e.g., ISO 9001 / AS9100 standards).

  • Lead structured root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) investigations (8D, 5-Whys, Fishbone) for manufacturing non-conformances, test failures, and field/customer returns.

  • Partner with mechanical, electrical, and manufacturing engineers during New Product Introduction (NPI) to establish Design for Quality (DFQ), PFMEA, control plans, and incoming/in-process/final acceptance test criteria.

  • Track, analyze, and report key quality metrics (yield, defect rates, RMA/field return trends, supplier performance) to drive measurable reductions in defects and hardware rework.

  • Collaborate with contract manufacturers and component suppliers on First Article Inspections (FAI), supplier audits, non-conforming material review (MRB), and corrective action follow-through.

Qualifications (Preferred):

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Quality Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3–5+ years of experience in quality engineering for electromechanical hardware, marine electronics, aerospace/defense, or ruggedized outdoor systems.

  • Strong command of root-cause analysis and quality tools (CAPA, 8D, FMEA, Control Plans, SPC, and First Article Inspection).

  • Experience working directly with contract manufacturers and suppliers to qualify parts, resolve production defects, and enforce quality standards.

  • Familiarity with ISO 9001 or AS9100 quality frameworks and maintaining audit-ready documentation.

  • Ability to work independently and communicate clearly across remote engineering teams, field operations, and manufacturing partners.

  • ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or Six Sigma certification is a plus.

Work Environment:

  • Flexible working hours, with occasional intensive sprints aligned to production milestones and audits.

  • Occasional travel to contract manufacturers, suppliers, or field deployment sites.

  • Opportunity to work on innovative projects with a global impact.
