job.title: Quality Assurance Manager, International
job.description:
We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

About the role

We are hiring for our first dedicated international quality hire at Grüns. You'll own the quality system for every market outside the US: product release, specifications, complaints and adverse events, incident management, contract manufacturer oversight, stability, and transit qualification. For products sold in the EU, you'll build and run the Quality Management System processes that keep us compliant with EU and local market requirements across the product lifecycle.

Today these responsibilities sit informally with the US QA team. The job is to figure out where they should live, build the processes, and then run them. You'll work across Regulatory, Supply Chain, Operations, and our external manufacturing and 3PL partners, and you'll be the escalation point when something goes wrong in an international market.

Location:

While this role is part of our global remote HQ, we feel a candidate based in or around Germany or the United Kingdom will be most successful in this role.

The team members you’ll be working with most are in multiple countries and time zones, so we ask that you are comfortable working a way that allows for some overlap in working hours to collaborate.

More generally, we operate in a fully remote, high trust environment with teammates across multiple countries and time zones. While we work async by default, we come together in person twice a year for offsites that help us connect, align, and build real relationships IRL.

In this role, you will:

  • Release finished products only after verifying specs, COAs, manufacturing docs, deviations, and market-specific requirements
  • Own consumer complaint intake and triage across level 1, 2, and 3
  • Build and run traceability, recall/withdrawal, mock recall, complaint, adverse-event, and food safety incident processes for EU products
  • Own supplier and contract manufacturer qualification: Quality Agreements, audits, CAPAs/SCARs, deviations, change controls, investigations, ongoing performance monitoring
  • Run BMT testing and oversee microbiological, chemical, allergen, contaminant, nutritional, and stability testing, including OOS/OOT investigations and third-party labs
  • Assess quality and regulatory risk on any formulation, ingredient, supplier, process, spec, packaging, or labeling change before it ships. Even a packaging color update can get held at customs in markets like China without sign-off
  • Partner with Regulatory Affairs to keep formulations, specs, labels, claims, and packaging compliant by market
  • Own quality oversight of international manufacturing, packaging, warehousing, and distribution partners, including 3PLs
  • Set and monitor international quality KPIs and keep us audit-ready

We're looking for someone who:

  • Has a minimum of 5 years of quality assurance experience in food, beverage, dietary supplement, or consumer health, with meaningful time spent on products sold outside the US
  • Has hands-on EU and international quality experience. You've managed quality processes for food, dietary supplement, or consumer health products sold in the EU and across multiple regulatory jurisdictions, and you understand how quality and regulatory requirements differ by market
  • Has working knowledge of EU food and food supplement quality requirements, including GMP and food safety requirements, HACCP, traceability and recall, allergen management, specifications, supplier and contract manufacturer controls, analytical testing, stability, change control, product release, and labeling and claims oversight. Experience across multiple EU member states is a strong plus
  • Has real depth in core quality systems: you've owned CAPAs, investigations, root cause analysis, specification creation, document control, and change control, not just participated in them
  • Has qualified, audited, and managed external manufacturers and co-packers, and held them to account
  • Has owned or contributed materially to a recall, withdrawal, or market action, and knows what good looks like under pressure
  • Is comfortable owning stability protocols and managing third-party labs
  • Can work across US, UK/EU, and Asia time zones with a distributed team and external partners

Approach to the role:

  • You treat documentation as protection, not paperwork
  • You catch the small stuff, like a packaging color change, before it turns into a blocked shipment
  • You build with scale in mind, since we're small today and growing internationally fast
  • You bring high ownership and don't need to be micromanaged to move fast

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we are committed to offering a competitive total compensation package grounded in market data and aligned to our size, stage, industry, and geographic location. Compensation for this role will be benchmarked to the local market and may vary based on experience and country of hire. In addition to base compensation roles include a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

job.title: QA Engineer — Web & Mobile
job.description:
QA Engineer, Web and Mobile

Individual contributor. Reports to the Director of QA. No direct reports.

Salary: €5000 per month

Location: Poland (Fully Remote)

The role

You test the web application, frontend and backend, and the mobile applications on iOS and Android. That is the surface of the job.

Underneath it, the point of this role is to understand how the product actually works: the data flow, the API contracts, the places where two systems meet and produce behaviour nobody specified. That understanding is what lets you improve a specification before code is written, catch the gap nobody else noticed, and give Support, Sales, Product and Engineering an answer they can rely on.

We are looking for extreme ownership, the person who picks up the task nobody else wants because it needs doing and they can see why it matters.

What you will do

Test the product properly. Web end to end, frontend behaviour and backend responses, not just the UI layer. Mobile on iOS and Android against an agreed device and OS matrix, with a real understanding of platform conventions and where the two diverge.

Own our automated coverage on web. Extend and maintain the Playwright suite and write new tests for the features you take through. Investigate failures and fix flakiness rather than muting it, and be honest about what automation is and is not covering.

Verify at the API and data layer. Requests, responses, payloads, status codes, backward compatibility for older clients. Query the database directly to confirm what actually happened, rather than what the screen says happened.

Prevent bugs, not just report them. Pressure-test specifications with Product, Design and engineers before development starts: happy paths, edge cases, error states, empty states. Point out the platform that was forgotten, the API version that will break, the migration nobody planned. Asking the awkward question early is part of the job.

Debug to root cause. "It doesn't work" is not a bug report. Narrow down where it breaks and what the system is actually doing, and hand the developer something they can act on.

Support the wider business. Reproduce and triage customer issues that reach engineering, and keep test plans and known-issue lists current so release decisions rest on evidence.

Use AI every day. Reduce your own repetitive work with it, build reusable AI skills the wider team can benefit from, make small fixes in the code yourself where that is reasonable, and bring ideas about where AI can raise our quality bar.

What we are looking for

  • Three to five years of hands-on testing of web applications, with a demonstrated ability to find root causes rather than symptoms.

  • Practical test automation experience. You have written and maintained UI or API tests in Playwright, or a comparable framework, and can work in a test codebase without hand-holding.

  • You can read and reason about API contracts and payloads, query a database in SQL to verify data, and are comfortable with traffic and API inspection tooling, or quick to pick it up.

  • Mobile testing in practice. You can tell a platform convention apart from a defect, and reason about the device and OS coverage a given change actually needs.

  • Proven collaboration with Design and Product. You have been in the room during specification work and made it better without owning it, with examples you can talk us through.

  • Excellent written and spoken communication, in Polish and English, both at C2 or native level.

Nice to have

  • Testing in a regulated or healthcare-adjacent domain.

  • Device farms or cloud device labs, such as BrowserStack or Firebase Test Lab.

  • Triaging from crash and error monitoring, such as Sentry or Crashlytics.

  • Accessibility testing (WCAG).

job.title: QA- Test Engineer
job.description:
Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Software QA & Testing Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will play a crucial part in ensuring the delivery of high-quality software through robust manual and automated testing processes, as well as adopting modern testing tools including Artificial Intelligence (AI) for enhanced efficiency and accuracy. You will lead the testing efforts to identify and resolve issues, optimize performance, ensure cross-browser compatibility, and verify the scalability and resiliency of software capabilities under load.

As part of our commitment to innovation, your role will involve implementing AI-powered testing methodologies to improve coverage and identify issues proactively. If you have hands-on experience with automation, cross-browser testing, performance testing, and industry-leading tools (including AI-based solutions), this is the perfect opportunity for your career growth.

Key Responsibilities

1. Test Planning & Strategy

  • Collaborate with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and define test objectives.
  • Develop and document comprehensive and efficient test plans, strategies, and exit criteria.
  • Ensure alignment with Agile frameworks for CI/CD processes to maintain quality standards throughout the software development lifecycle.

2. Manual Testing

  • Perform detailed manual testing on new features, functional flows, and regression cases.
  • Conduct comprehensive exploratory testing for edge-case scenarios to uncover potential issues early.
  • Ensure test data coverage for all features, workflows, integrations, and edge cases.

3. Automation Testing

  • Design, build, and maintain automation frameworks for both web and mobile applications using leading tools like Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, and/or similar.
  • Write efficient and reusable automated test scripts to conduct functional and end-to-end testing.
  • Work on integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline).

4. Cross-Browser & Device Testing

  • Perform cross-browser testing on modern browsers such as Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge using tools like BrowserStack, Lambdatest, or CrossBrowserTesting.
  • Validate software compatibility across various operating systems and devices (desktop and mobile).

5. Performance Testing

  • Design and execute performance, scalability, and stress tests for high-traffic systems using tools like JMeter, LoadRunner, or Gatling.
  • Monitor application response time, throughput, and behavior under heavy load scenarios.
  • Analyze performance bottlenecks and provide optimization recommendations to development teams.

6. AI-Driven Testing

  • Utilize AI-powered test case generation tools like Testim, Applitools, or Tricentis Tosca to design smarter and faster test cases.
  • Work with AI-based tools for visual regression testing and intelligent defect identification.
  • Stay up to date on emerging trends in AI-driven QA solutions to enhance testing strategies.

7. Defect Reporting & Debugging

  • Identify, document, and track bugs and defects found during testing using bug-tracking tools such as JIRA, Trello, and Azure DevOps.
  • Actively collaborate with development teams to troubleshoot and resolve defects, ensuring software efficiency and stability.

8. Documentation & Reporting

  • Create and maintain a repository of detailed test plans, test cases, and test execution reports.
  • Generate test metrics and quality reports to update stakeholders regarding system quality and testing progress.

Requirements

1. Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4–6 years of experience in a Software QA role, with a proven track record of delivering high-quality software products.

2. Technical Skills

  • Strong understanding of software QA methodologies, manual and automation testing standards, and testing tools.
  • Hands-on experience with manual and automation testing of workflows and UI components.
  • Proficiency with key automation testing frameworks (e.g., Selenium, TestNG, Playwright, Cypress, etc.).
  • Demonstrated expertise in cross-browser testing tools (e.g., BrowserStack, LambdaTest, Sauce Labs).
  • Advanced knowledge of performance and stress testing tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner, Gatling, or k6).
  • Experience with API testing tools such as Postman, Rest Assured, or Karate.
  • Proficiency with test management tools (e.g., Jira, TestRail) and version control systems like Git.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines).

3. AI Testing Tools

  • Hands-on experience with AI-enhanced testing tools such as:
    • Testim, Tricentis Tosca, Katalon AI, Applitools, and Mabl
    • AI-powered visual testing and smart test case generation
  • Understanding of AI-driven methodologies for predictive testing, defect prioritization, and anomaly detection.

4. Additional Skills

  • Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills with an eye for detail.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex issues to technical and business stakeholders clearly.
  • Demonstrated ability to work in Agile environments and with techniques such as regression testing, exploratory testing, and smoke/sanity testing.
  • Knowledge of scripting languages such as Python, JavaScript, or Java is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications:
    • ISTQB Foundation Level or Advanced Level certification
    • Certified Selenium Professional, Appium Certification, or equivalent
  • Experience in Performance & Load Testing: Hands-on knowledge with tools like JMeter or LoadRunner.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML Testing: Experience testing machine-learning models or data-driven AI applications.
  • Cloud Testing: Familiarity with testing APIs and services hosted on AWS, Azure, or GCP.

job.title: Senior Performance Engineer
job.description:
Who we are

We're Redis. We built the product that runs the fast apps our world runs on. (If you checked the weather, used your credit card, or looked at your flight status online today, you’re welcome.) At Redis, you’ll work with the fastest, simplest technology in the business—whether you’re building it, telling its story, or selling it to our 10,000+ worldwide customers. We’re creating a faster world with simpler experiences. You in?

The team

Why would you love this job?

As a Senior Performance Engineer you join the team that owns the performance of Redis: the open source server, Redis Software and Redis Cloud, Search, Flex and our newest AI products. The benchmark results go into release decisions, into customer deals and into comparisons against Competition, so they have to be precise and reproducible, but must importantly explainable and actionable.

This is an AI-native performance role. Our agents amplify your impact - triaging PRs, tracking competitors, and running autonomous optimization loops. This helps us explore new things, experiment more, and improve ourselves in the process. Less manual work, more breakthroughs.

You will design, develop, execute and direct those agents. What stays with you is what an agent cannot do: design a new experiment based upon AI research, run a benchmark side by side with a customer, own a latency escalation until it is fixed, and sign off a number that a partner will rely on.

We are a small team where everyone can push any project. You will lead work from day one, and have a high impact across our products, from a performance perspective. You will deeply influence the core of Redis.

The role

What type of work will you be doing

  • Build and run AI agent workspaces. Write the skills, benchmarks and review gates that let agents propose, measure and filter optimizations on a benchmark fleet. Make the same tooling self-serve for other R&D groups to interact with it.

  • Own performance end to end as an individual contributor. Plan, reproduce and close regression and optimization investigations on the Redis data path, control plane, Search, Flex and new products, and land the fixes with the owning teams.

  • Work with customers. Design and run benchmarks and proofs of concept that support enterprise deals, and own latency escalations after upgrades, on site when needed (international travel to customers).

  • Keep regression coverage ahead of the product. Maintain nightly and weekly performance gates for throughput, latency, cluster operations, APIs, scale and stress, including the commitments we validate for internal and external stakeholders.

  • Produce competitive data. Run same-price cloud comparisons against other engines and managed services, and track what competitors merge. Work on the AI native transformation of this topic as well.

  • Develop the open source tools Redis and its competitors depend on. We maintain several benchmarks tools and specs, and multiple famous libraries used across the industry (like hdrhistogram, t-dgest, fast_float, ffc, and more). Several of those libraries and tools are used by Redis deeply and by competitors (Valkey, Dragonfly, others). You will have the opportunity to positively impact a large number of widely used components.

  • Publish. Write blogs and benchmark papers, and speak for Redis at conferences.

High proficiency in performance topics is a must; we will help you grow in the programming languages and AI domains as well.

 

What You'll Bring to Redis

Your experience and strengths:

  • Experience benchmarking and tuning mission-critical storage or distributed systems, at the levels of code, node and cluster.

  • Experience planning, reproducing and pursuing a performance regression or improvement, and quantifying it with statistics, profiling and tracing data from tools such as perf, pprof, VTune and eBPF.

  • Demonstrated use of AI coding agents on real engineering work: you can show something you built, debugged or optimized with them, and how you verified the result.

  • The judgment to distrust a number: you check the load generator, the noise, the baseline and the methodology before you believe a gain, whether a person or an agent produced it.

  • High proficiency in at least one of C, Go or Rust.

  • Ability to work directly with customers and field teams, and to explain a result to engineers and to executives.

  • Excellent communication skills in written and spoken English, and the ability to work well within and across teams.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Extra great

  • Experience building agent harnesses, skills or evaluation loops, for example for profiling, hypothesis testing or benchmarking.

  • Contributions to Redis or to other open source projects, especially performance tools or libraries.

  • Experience developing or operating Redis or other databases, search engines or vector databases.

  • Low-level optimization experience: CPU microarchitecture, memory prefetching, SIMD, ARM and x86 differences.

  • Published benchmarks, papers or conference talks.

What are the benefits and perks of working at Redis Bulgaria:

 

  • Competitive compensation package formed by salary and equity grants

  • 25 days of vacation time

  • Hybrid working options from both home and the office

  • Home internet & phone monthly allowance

  • One-time home-office setup allowance

  • Health and dental insurance for you

  • Personal life insurance

  • Critical Illness Cover

  • Lunch and snacks in the office

  • Multisport/CoolFit card

 

As a global company, we value a culture of curiosity, diversity of thought, and innovation from our employees, customers, and partners. Redis is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment where all employees’ differences are celebrated and supported, and everyone feels safe to bring their authentic selves to work. Redis is dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, Veteran status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law. We strive to create a workplace where every voice is heard, and every idea is respected.

Redis is committed to working with and providing access and reasonable accommodation to applicants with mental and/or physical disabilities. If you think you may require accommodations for any part of the recruitment process, please send a request to recruiting@redis.com. All requests for accommodations are treated discreetly and confidentially, as practical and permitted by law.

Any offer of employment at Redis is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, consistent with applicable laws.

Redis reserves the right to retain data longer than stated in the privacy policy in order to evaluate candidates.

job.title: Senior QA Engineer
job.description:
About Us:

Steer Health helps healthcare organizations improve patient access, reduce operational burden, and recover revenue through AI-native workflow automation. Our lead product, Luna AI, acts as a voice-based digital workforce, handling patient access workflows such as scheduling, intake, and follow-up. We sit on top of existing EHR infrastructure and focus on measurable operational outcomes.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer who thrives at the intersection of AI, voice automation, and cloud-native systems. You will own quality across our platform — from testing LLM-powered features and voice pipelines to ensuring robust end-to-end coverage on GCP infrastructure. You will work closely with product, engineering, and AI teams to embed quality from the ground up.

Requirements

  • Design, build, and maintain automated test suites using Playwright for web and API surfaces, including AI-generated content flows.
  • Lead QA strategy for voice automation pipelines built on ElevenLabs — developing test cases for synthesis quality, latency, and failure modes.
  • Validate Claude (Anthropic) integrations: prompt-response accuracy, edge case handling, safety behaviors, and output consistency across builds.
  • Build and maintain Node.js-based test tooling, harnesses, and custom reporters for CI/CD pipelines.
  • Deploy, monitor, and triage test infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform — leveraging Cloud Run, GCS, and Pub/Sub for scalable test execution.
  • Define and track quality metrics: test coverage, flakiness rates, mean-time-to-detect, and regression velocity.
  • Collaborate with engineers during design reviews to surface testability gaps and advocate for observable, fault-tolerant system design.
  • Mentor junior QA engineers and establish team-wide standards for test authoring, review, and maintenance.

    Required Qualifications
  • 5+ years of QA engineering experience, with at least 2 years on systems that include LLMs, AI APIs, or speech/audio pipelines.
  • Expert-level Playwright skills — authoring resilient selectors, managing parallel workers, and debugging flaky tests at scale.
  • Proficient Node.js developer — comfortable writing custom test runners, CLI tooling, and service mocks in TypeScript/JavaScript.
  • Hands-on GCP experience: deploying workloads to Cloud Run or GKE, querying logs in Cloud Logging, configuring artifact storage in GCS.
  • Familiarity with ElevenLabs or comparable TTS/voice APIs — understanding synthesis parameters, webhook flows, and audio quality evaluation.
  • Practical experience testing Claude or other LLMs — designing determinism-aware test strategies, evaluating prompt regressions, and building evals.
  • Strong understanding of REST, WebSocket, and gRPC protocols for API-level testing.
  • Experience integrating test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Cloud Build, or similar).
  • Nice to Have
  • Experience writing custom LLM evals or using evaluation frameworks such as PromptFoo or Braintrust.
  • Background in audio signal quality assessment or speech intelligibility testing.
  • Familiarity with observability tooling: OpenTelemetry, Datadog, or GCP Cloud Monitoring.
  • Knowledge of accessibility testing standards (WCAG 2.1) and assistive technology compatibility.

    Core Technology Stack:

    Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • Cloud Run, GCS, Pub/Sub, Cloud Logging, GKE for scalable test infrastructure

    ElevenLabs     — Voice Automation TTS pipeline testing, synthesis quality evaluation, webhook and latency validation
  • Node.js / TypeScript Custom test runners, service mocks, CLI tooling, and CI/CD integration
  • Playwright End-to-end and API-level browser automation with parallel execution
  • Claude (Anthropic) LLM integration QA, prompt regression testing, and output evaluation

Benefits

● Competitive base salary commensurate with experience

● High-autonomy environment with direct access to executive leadership

● Structured operating cadence with clear goals, metrics, and career growth targets

● Work that touches 19M+ patients — the mission is real

Flexible PTOs policy

job.title: QA Engineer
job.description:
About Halborn Inc

Our mission is to provide value-add security services and products to the world’s most cutting edge technology firms and that starts with blockchain tech. Founded in 2019, Halborn is an elite cyber security company focused on solving complex adversarial problems unique to the cryptocurrency and fintech industries. From breaches and social engineering to stolen private keys and economic hacks, Halborn solves it. Our clientele are the exclusive blockchain companies as well as new startups with high growth trajectories.

Our Culture

Halborn is a globally distributed team of 100+, looking to grow our elite team of white hat hackers, sales professionals, security engineers and DevSecOps specialists who value independence, want to make their own hours, work for themselves and have a passion for the ever evolving cryptocurrency industry.

Our Commitment to Diversity

Halborn Inc is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, education, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics and celebrates the diversity of its growing team.

We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment Visas at this time.

Recruitment agencies and consultants may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Halborn does not accept unsolicited agency resumes, and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Halborn Inc.

We are looking for a QA Engineer who treats manual testing as a temporary condition. You will own quality across the internal platforms our security researchers depend on and the client-facing products that deliver our findings — and you will build the automation, tooling, and AI-assisted workflows that make that coverage possible without a headcount-shaped bottleneck. If your instinct when you see a repetitive process is to write the thing that replaces it, you will fit here.

Responsibilities

  • Own the test strategy for Halborn's internal engineering platforms and client-facing products, from unit and integration coverage through end-to-end and regression suites.
  • Design, build and maintain automated test suites in code — UI, API, and data-layer — and keep them fast, deterministic, and trusted by the engineers who depend on them.
  • Use LLM-assisted tooling to accelerate test authoring, generate edge cases from specs and diffs, triage failing runs, and summarize regressions for the team.
  • Build and tune quality gates in CI/CD so that broken builds never reach a client environment, and so that the feedback loop stays measured in minutes.
  • Identify manual QA processes and automate them out of existence — release checklists, environment setup, test data generation, smoke verification, reporting.
  • Reproduce, isolate, and file defects with unambiguous repro steps, expected versus actual behavior, and enough context for an engineer to fix it without a follow-up conversation.
  • Partner with security engineers to fold security regression checks — authentication, authorization, input handling, secrets exposure — into the standard pipeline.
  • Run performance, load, and reliability testing against services handling sensitive audit and engagement data.
  • Define and report the quality metrics that matter: escaped defect rate, flake rate, coverage of critical paths, and time to detection.
  • Contribute to release readiness decisions and act as an informed voice on whether something ships.

Qualifications

  • 3 to 5 years in QA engineering, SDET, or test automation, with a demonstrated shift from manual execution toward automated coverage.
  • Strong programming ability in at least one of TypeScript, JavaScript, or Python — you write test code that other engineers are willing to read and maintain.
  • Hands-on experience with modern automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, pytest, or equivalent.
  • Practical API testing experience, including contract, integration, and negative-path testing against REST or GraphQL services.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar) and comfort owning pipeline configuration yourself.
  • Daily, deliberate use of AI coding assistants and LLM tooling in your own workflow, with a clear point of view on where they help and where they must be verified.
  • Comfort with Git, containerized local environments, and reading application code to understand what you are testing rather than testing blind.
  • Excellent written communication — in a distributed, asynchronous team, a well-written bug report or test plan is the deliverable.
  • High autonomy and strong self-direction in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift.
  • Willingness to learn the technical aspects of blockchain, smart contracts, and cybersecurity.

Bonus Points

  • Experience testing Web3 applications — wallet flows, testnets, RPC interactions, or smart contract tooling such as Foundry or Hardhat.
  • Experience building evaluation harnesses for LLM-powered features, including regression testing of non-deterministic output.
  • Background in security testing, OWASP methodology, or hands-on time with tools like Burp Suite.
  • Performance and load testing with k6, Locust, JMeter, or similar.
  • Experience with observability tooling and using production telemetry to find gaps in test coverage.
  • Open source contributions to testing frameworks or developer tooling.
  • Knowledgeable of the latest trends in Blockchain and DeFi.

Recruitment agencies and consultants may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Halborn does not accept unsolicited agency resumes, and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Halborn Inc.

Responsibilities

  • Own the test strategy for Halborn's internal engineering platforms and client-facing products, from unit and integration coverage through end-to-end and regression suites.
  • Design, build and maintain automated test suites in code — UI, API, and data-layer — and keep them fast, deterministic, and trusted by the engineers who depend on them.
  • Use LLM-assisted tooling to accelerate test authoring, generate edge cases from specs and diffs, triage failing runs, and summarize regressions for the team.
  • Build and tune quality gates in CI/CD so that broken builds never reach a client environment, and so that the feedback loop stays measured in minutes.
  • Identify manual QA processes and automate them out of existence — release checklists, environment setup, test data generation, smoke verification, reporting.
  • Reproduce, isolate, and file defects with unambiguous repro steps, expected versus actual behavior, and enough context for an engineer to fix it without a follow-up conversation.
  • Partner with security engineers to fold security regression checks — authentication, authorization, input handling, secrets exposure — into the standard pipeline.
  • Run performance, load, and reliability testing against services handling sensitive audit and engagement data.
  • Define and report the quality metrics that matter: escaped defect rate, flake rate, coverage of critical paths, and time to detection.
  • Contribute to release readiness decisions and act as an informed voice on whether something ships.

Qualifications

  • 3 to 5 years in QA engineering, SDET, or test automation, with a demonstrated shift from manual execution toward automated coverage.
  • Strong programming ability in at least one of TypeScript, JavaScript, or Python — you write test code that other engineers are willing to read and maintain.
  • Hands-on experience with modern automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, pytest, or equivalent.
  • Practical API testing experience, including contract, integration, and negative-path testing against REST or GraphQL services.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar) and comfort owning pipeline configuration yourself.
  • Daily, deliberate use of AI coding assistants and LLM tooling in your own workflow, with a clear point of view on where they help and where they must be verified.
  • Comfort with Git, containerized local environments, and reading application code to understand what you are testing rather than testing blind.
  • Excellent written communication — in a distributed, asynchronous team, a well-written bug report or test plan is the deliverable.
  • High autonomy and strong self-direction in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift.
  • Willingness to learn the technical aspects of blockchain, smart contracts, and cybersecurity.

Bonus Points

  • Experience testing Web3 applications — wallet flows, testnets, RPC interactions, or smart contract tooling such as Foundry or Hardhat.
  • Experience building evaluation harnesses for LLM-powered features, including regression testing of non-deterministic output.
  • Background in security testing, OWASP methodology, or hands-on time with tools like Burp Suite.
  • Performance and load testing with k6, Locust, JMeter, or similar.
  • Experience with observability tooling and using production telemetry to find gaps in test coverage.
  • Open source contributions to testing frameworks or developer tooling.
  • Knowledgeable of the latest trends in Blockchain and DeFi.

job.title: QA Engineer
job.description:
QA Engineer

Pixery is a global tech. company building innovative apps for next generation mobile creatives. Our video apps reach more than 100 million people, consistently top-ranked and featured by Apple and Google. Pixery has been consistently ranked within the fastest growing tech companies in Turkey and became one of the fastest growing tech companies in the EMEA region reported by Deloitte. For more information about our products visit our website

We are building a culture with hard work and humility at its core. We inspire one another by sharing information, knowledge, and ideas that create a transparent environment where everyone's voice is heard. Our culture attracts passionate hearts and minds who always demonstrate originality, courage, curiosity, inclusion.

What you will be working on:

  • Test our mobile apps (iOS and Android) and web applications before every release, following the release checklist and exploring beyond it
  • Try to break things: go through the app the way a real user would, then the way a user never would, and find what does not work
  • Report bugs clearly, with steps to reproduce, screenshots or screen recordings, and the device and OS you saw them on
  • Verify fixes once the team ships them and make sure nothing else broke along the way
  • Test on different devices, OS versions and screen sizes, with extra attention to onboarding, purchases and subscription flows
  • Keep an eye on store reviews and user feedback to catch issues we have not noticed yet
  • Use AI tools to make your own work faster and share what works with the rest of the team
  • Proactive mindset with strong problem-solving initiative; capable of taking full ownership and driving results

Essential Skills and Experience:

  • Experience testing mobile apps and/or web applications, or a strong interest in QA with the attention to detail to back it up
  • Fluency in English (both written and spoken), strong communication skills are a must
  • Strong attention to detail and the patience to reproduce a bug that only happens once in ten tries
  • Comfortable with issue tracking tools (Jira, Linear or similar)
  • Curiosity about AI tools and a habit of asking 'can I get the machine to do this part for me?' rather than repeating the same steps by hand
  • Comfortable with context switching: our apps and projects move at different speeds, and you will often work on more than one at a time
  • Eagerness to learn and to take feedback

Nice to have:

  • Using AI tools in your testing workflow: generating test data, triaging crash reports, drafting bug reports, automating repetitive checks
  • Basic scripting ability (Python, JavaScript) or experience with any test automation tool
  • Familiarity with API testing (Postman or similar)
  • Experience testing in-app purchases and subscriptions
  • Familiarity with crash reporting and analytics tools (Firebase, Sentry, Mixpanel or similar)

What we offer?

  • Competitive salary adjusted to currency (usd) fluctuations.
  • Remote & Flexible work environment.
  • Latest technology devices to boost your productivity.
  • Regular hackathon days, online/ offline workshops and games where we build fun stuff together.
  • Pet friendly office
  • Access to various learning & development opportunities: regular participation in international conferences, events, seminars and access to all learning materials requested.
  • Wellness reimbursement: to help you live your healthiest life, we reimburse eligible wellness expenses such as subscriptions wellness apps, gym memberships, diet counseling and much more
  • Annual bonus based on company profit: when we have a good year, eligible employees receive a yearly bonus from the profit we made together

What it's like to work at Pixery?

  • Be part of a passionate and driven team where everyone's ideas are valued: a team starts every day with the courage to experiment with new things.
  • Access to the worldwide community: working on products -you can be genuinely proud of- used by millions of people around the world.
  • Make a difference in the mobile video creativity market: At the intersection of innovation and technology, we are building something that inspires the mobile creativity market.

job.title: HCM Test Automation & Quality Engineer
job.description:
Job Title: HCM Test Automation & Quality EngineerJob Category: EngineeringTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: Public TrustEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Continental US* * *

The Opportunity:
CACI is seeking a HCM Test Automation & Quality Engineer to ensure the quality, reliability, and compliance of the Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM platform being deployed across the federal government as part of the HCM modernization program. With federal civilian employees depending on this system for their pay, benefits, and career management across multiple federal agencies, there is no room for defects in production. You will design and execute comprehensive test strategies covering functional, integration, regression, performance, security, accessibility, and user acceptance testing. Working within a SAFe Agile continuous testing framework, you will build automated test suites, execute parallel payroll validation, ensure Section 508 accessibility compliance, and coordinate UAT with agency stakeholders. Every Oracle quarterly update, every agency migration wave, and every integration endpoint must be validated before it touches the production environment. If you are passionate about quality at scale and thrive in high-stakes testing environments, this role is for you.

This role is remote, but with a preference to individuals in the DMV area.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test strategies and plans covering functional, SIT, regression, performance, security, data migration, and UAT for Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM.

  • Build and maintain automated test suites using OATS, Selenium, or equivalent tools to support continuous regression testing within the SAFe Agile delivery framework.

  • Execute parallel payroll validation testing by comparing Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM payroll results with legacy system outputs for each agency migration wave; document and resolve variances before production cutover.

  • Perform Section 508 accessibility testing to ensure the user interface meets WCAG 2.1 AA standards and is accessible to federal employees using assistive technologies.

  • Coordinate UAT with agency stakeholders, including test scenario development, tester training, defect triage, and sign-off tracking for each agency transition wave.

  • Design and execute performance and load testing to verify the platform meets required response time and throughput thresholds under peak federal workforce transaction volumes.

  • Implement defect management processes using JIRA or equivalent tools, tracking defects from discovery through resolution with severity classification, root cause analysis, and trend reporting.

  • Test integration interfaces with EHRI, eOPF, USA Staffing, payroll providers, Employee Express, MyPay, and other federal systems to validate end-to-end data flow accuracy and error handling.

  • Validate Oracle quarterly update deployments by executing targeted regression suites to ensure existing configurations and integrations remain functional.

  • Participate in SAFe Agile ceremonies, contributing to sprint planning, definition of done criteria, and continuous testing process improvements.

  • Develop and maintain test documentation including test plans, test cases, traceability matrices, and test execution summary reports.

  • Apply established methods and standards to independently resolve moderate functional and technical issues, contribute to team knowledge bases, and consult with senior staff on complex or unfamiliar problems.

  • Communicate effectively with project team members and stakeholders to report progress, explain technical approaches, and support collaborative problem‑solving within workstreams and Agile Release Train ceremonies.

Qualifications:
Required:

  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance (US citizenship required).

  • Bachelor’s degree and 5 years of relevant experience; additional experience may substitute for the degree.

  • 5+ years of professional experience in software QA, test engineering, or test automation for enterprise applications.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with automation tools such as Selenium, OATS, Tricentis Tosca, or equivalent.

  • Experience with functional, integration, regression, and performance testing for cloud‑based enterprise applications, preferably Oracle Fusion Cloud or Oracle ERP Cloud.

  • Proficiency with defect and test management tools such as JIRA, HP ALM, or Azure DevOps Test Plans.

  • Strong understanding of SAFe Agile continuous testing practices, including TDD and shift‑left strategies.

  • Experience coordinating UAT activities with business stakeholders, including planning, execution, and defect triage.

  • Excellent analytical and communication skills, with the ability to document results and communicate quality status clearly.

Desired:

  • 6+ years of testing experience with at least one large‑scale Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM or Oracle ERP Cloud implementation.

  • ISTQB Foundation or Advanced Level certification.

  • Experience using performance testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, or Oracle Load Testing.

  • Experience performing Section 508 accessibility testing using tools such as ANDI, axe, or JAWS.

  • Knowledge of federal HR business processes including payroll, benefits administration, and personnel action workflows.

  • Experience with parallel payroll validation methodologies and automated payroll comparison testing.

  • Scripting skills in Python, JavaScript, or Groovy for automation and data generation.

  • Experience with Oracle Cloud technologies including OIC or OCI in enterprise HCM or ERP environments.

This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI.

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The proposed salary range for this position is:

$75,200-$158,100

CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

job.title: Quality Assurance & Advocacy Lead Analyst
job.description:
Company Introduction:

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that’s redefining how the world’s most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.

Airspace has been rated one of America’s best Startup Employers and listed as one of CNBC’s Disruptor 50 companies. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m.

The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics.

Job Overview

The Quality Assurance & Advocacy Lead Analyst investigates customer escalations, analyzes operational data to spot trends, and drives corrective and preventive action across Operations to protect the reliability Airspace’s clients depend on for their most time-critical shipments. This role is a fit for someone who’s analytical and detail-driven, comfortable turning data into root-cause findings and clear documentation, and confident delivering feedback and performance reviews to Operations Leadership and Account Managers — someone who wants to build a quality-first culture, not just enforce one.

What You'll Do

Including but not limited to:

  • Support CAPA/shipment investigations — root cause analysis and corrective action implementation, and help review and report on trends.
  • Investigate and resolve complex escalations; identify customer trends, quality concerns, and operational gaps to drive continuous improvement and risk mitigation.
  • Provide recommendations to continuously improve procedures and policies throughout the organization.
  • Analyze calls and provide feedback to ensure Operations Specialists are delivering the best communication to Airspace clients.
  • Research customer satisfaction issues, develop corrective action plans, and monitor results through to closure.
  • Onboard new hires into ZenQMS under the QMS function, including setting up their reporting lines, and assist the QMS Manager with other tasks as needed.
  • Assist with customer error codes.
  • Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned by the Director of QA&A, Sr. Manager of QMS, and/or Chief Business Officer.
  • Maintain expertise across all Airspace Sectors and Subsectors:

Industrials

  • Aerospace & Defense
  • High Tech
  • Manufacturing & Industrials
  • 3PL & Other

Healthcare

  • Lifesciences
  • Health Systems & Labs
  • Medical Devices

Requirements

  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience in a QA&A Analyst, Customer Advocate, Lead, or Sr. QA&A department position, or any of the following:
    • 5+ years of experience in Airspace Operations, with at least 2 years’ experience in an Operations Management role.
    • 7+ years’ experience in the Industry with a competitor, with at least 4 years’ experience in an Operations Management, Quality Assurance role, or Customer Advocate position.

Technical skills/knowledge:

Mastery of 5-Why Principles and Analysis, most critically identifying root causes and the development and implementation of solutions (corrective actions & preventative actions).

  • ZenQMS for documenting audits, findings, and corrective/preventive action plans.
  • Zendesk for ticket management and escalations, especially for analysts with a Primary Sector assignment.
  • WorkRamp for completing the required Guide/Pathway training for Quality Assurance Management & Advocacy.
  • Working knowledge of the live order/shipment tracking system needed to conduct real-time order analysis.
  • Familiarity with the call monitoring/recording system used to review Operations Specialist client communication.

Non-technical skills/qualities:

  • Delivers clear feedback via ZenQMS on call quality (Twilio calls), customer complaints, coaching
  • Juggles live order monitoring, call reviews, open investigations, and cross-sector requests without letting slower-burning work (like corrective action follow-through) fall through the cracks.
  • Spots when a customer satisfaction issue points to a broader process gap and recommends policy or procedure changes company-wide.
  • Understands Airspace's products, services, mission, and strategic goals well enough to judge whether a recommendation actually serves the business, not just the individual ticket.
  • Drives corrective actions across Operations and other teams QA&A doesn't directly manage.
  • Comfortable being assigned to a Primary Sector while remaining flexible to jump into any sector as operational needs shift, including extended hours, evenings, and weekends.

Role Details

Department: Quality Assurance & Advocacy (QA&A)

Reports to: Director of QA&A

Location: Remote

Schedule: Monday-Friday, with flexibility for weekends if required due to business needs

Success Metrics

This year:

  • Salesforce, Zendesk, and Slack access provisioned and used independently (no walkthroughs needed) by day 30
  • 100% of required ZenQMS and WorkRamp training modules completed by day 30, with passing scores on any built-in assessments
  • Can independently pull a record/case in Salesforce and Zendesk without assistance by end of month 1
  • Manager sign-off that the person can take on a full independent caseload of lower/moderate escalations without required review
  • Has met 1:1 or in small group with key stakeholders across Operations, Quality, and relevant account teams by day 30-45
  • Has observed the full error code process for specific customer accounts by day 30

Next year:

  • Recognized as the go-to escalation owner for the most complex or highest-risk accounts
  • CAPA and root-cause work shows measurable downstream impact — fewer repeat escalations, reduced cycle time to resolution
  • Trend analysis becomes proactive rather than reactive: issues are flagged and addressed before they become customer-facing escalations
  • Consistently and independently investigates and resolves complex customer escalations with minimal need for manager intervention
  • Leads CAPA investigations end-to-end — identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions
  • Builds strong working relationships across Ops Leadership, Account Management, Operations, and Quality — seen as a reliable cross-functional partner.
  • Identifies at least one or two recurring customer/quality trends and drives a continuous improvement initiative in response

Your First 90 Days

  • Successfully complete onboarding by gaining proficiency in core operational platforms (Salesforce, Zendesk, Slack) and completing all required training modules in ZenQMS and WorkRamp.
  • Shadow escalation handling and CAPA investigations to learn Airspace QA&A documentation standards
  • Learn the escalation workflow across Operations, Quality — know who to go to for what
  • Observe specific customer error code process, compile data, and present key findings to leadership.
  • Begin independently handling lower-to-moderate complexity escalations with manager review
  • Sit in on customer meetings/CAPA discussions (Teams/Zoom) to understand tone, structure, and expectations
  • Build initial relationships with key cross-functional stakeholders

Your First 180 Days

  • Complete CAPA investigations from root-cause analysis through corrective action implementation
  • Develop expertise in specific customer error codes, analyzing system data to help leadership identify failure trends and drive continuous process improvements.
  • Identify a customer or quality trend from the data and propose a continuous improvement or risk mitigation action
  • Investigate and resolve complex escalations; identify customer trends, quality concerns, and operational gaps to drive continuous improvement and risk mitigation.
  • Be seen as a trusted, self-sufficient point of contact by internal teams

Compensation & Benefits

Salary range: $75,000.00 to $80,000.00 annually

  • High-quality health, dental, and vision plan options
  • Open PTO
  • 401K with company match
  • Professional learning and training reimbursements

Core Values:

  • We are One Team. We believe we all accomplish more when we are working together.
  • We make an Impact. We are determined to have a positive influence on our environment, our customers, our industry, and our world.
  • We are Passionate. We care deeply about our mission and are not afraid to raise the bar.
  • We are Transparent. We pride ourselves on having open, honest, and sincere communication with our team and customers.
  • We are Innovative. We never settle and are always striving to improve our product, service, and ourselves.

Airspace is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Additionally, Airspace participates in the E-Verify program for all locations.

A friendly reminder: Airspace will only contact candidates from an @airspace.com email, a no-reply notification from , or a verified LinkedIn profile. We never request fees or sensitive personal/financial information during recruiting. If something seems suspicious or feels off, please reach out to us at before responding.

job.title: Quality Assurance Analyst - OneStream Implementation
job.description:
Job Description

CSCI Consulting is seeking a Quality Assurance (QA) Analyst to support its Department of War (DoW / DoD) client. This role is responsible for validating that configured functionality, integrations, calculations, workflows, and reporting capabilities operate as intended before release and deployment.

The QA Analyst will work closely with functional consultants, developers, business stakeholders, finance users, and project leadership to support test planning, test execution, defect management, regression testing, and deployment readiness activities. This position plays a critical role throughout System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), agency certification, validation, deployment, and post-production stabilization efforts in a highly controlled federal program environment.

Responsibilities

  • Support planning and execution of System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), regression testing, and production readiness activities
  • Develop test cases, test scripts, and validation scenarios based on approved business requirements, process designs, controls, and expected system behavior
  • Verify configuration and system functionality trace to approved functional and technical requirements
  • Execute test scripts and document results across financial processes, workflows, calculations, reports, dashboards, and system interfaces
  • Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects through resolution and retesting
  • Coordinate with developers, functional analysts, and stakeholders to investigate issues and validate corrective actions
  • Perform regression testing to ensure existing functionality remains stable following enhancements or defect remediation
  • Validate test data quality, completeness, and suitability for business scenarios and reporting requirements
  • Confirm end-to-end processing from source data through calculations, reconciliations, reporting outputs, and downstream system integrations
  • Maintain test evidence, execution logs, defect records, traceability documentation, and sign-off support materials
  • Support business user readiness activities and help track critical issues affecting deployment decisions
  • Participate in go-live support, hypercare, and post-production validation to ensure operational stability

Minimum Requirements

  • Active Secret Clearance required
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Computer Science, or related field
  • 5-10+ years of experience supporting quality assurance, testing, validation, or system certification activities for enterprise applications
  • Experience supporting OneStream, ERP, EPM, financial management, or enterprise business system implementations
  • Strong understanding of testing methodologies, including test planning, script development, execution, defect management, regression testing, and sign-off processes
  • Ability to translate business requirements, process flows, controls, and reporting needs into structured test scenarios and validation procedures
  • Experience validating end-to-end business processes, system calculations, interfaces, workflows, and reporting outputs
  • Experience supporting SIT, UAT, deployment readiness reviews, and post-go-live stabilization efforts
  • Creativity and adaptability in problem-solving
  • Ability to work with clients to understand their needs
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Professional presence

Preferred Skills

  • Experience supporting federal financial management, budgeting, accounting, reporting, or performance management systems
  • Familiarity with federal financial controls, reconciliation requirements, and reporting validation processes
  • Experience working within compliance-driven environments requiring traceability, approval workflows, and formal testing governance
  • Knowledge of testing tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, HP ALM, TestRail, or similar platforms
  • Experience supporting agency certification, validation activities, and production readiness reviews
  • Familiarity with data validation, interface testing, reconciliation testing, and reporting certification processes
  • Experience supporting Agile, hybrid Agile, or waterfall implementation methodologies
  • Ability to work in a team environment, as well as independently
  • Strong customer and vendor relationship skills
  • Demonstrated ability to comply with data standards and policies
  • Motivation to learn new technologies and methodologies that demonstrate value
  • Past experience working with a Federal agency
  • Department of War experience is a plus!

About CSCI

CSCI is an award-winning information technology and financial management consulting firm founded on one simple philosophy: “Do what is right, always.” We apply this philosophy across all elements of our growing business, from delivering world-class services for customers to providing an environment where associates thrive both personally and professionally. At CSCI, work and fun aren’t diametrically opposed!

At CSCI, our goal is to hire people with proven track records and retain them with an energizing, diverse company culture. We value each associate’s natural drive to excel, and we provide them with the freedom to do things their way. CSCI seeks the best and brightest in the industry—those who are ready to move their lives and career forward. Join us today and get excited about Mondays again!

Benefits of Working at CSCI

  • Competitive salaries
  • Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) package
  • Paid holidays aligned to the Federal calendar
  • Full health benefits including medical, dental, vision, and life insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Team building events
  • Professional development support


Legal

CSCI complies with all applicable Federal, state, and local employment regulations. Please reach out to with any questions.


Equal Employment Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. CSCI provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.

If you require an accommodation, please contact CSCI Human Resources for further assistance. For questions regarding the qualifications listed above, please contact the CSCI Recruiting Team.


E-Verify

CSCI participates in E-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. For more information, please visit .


California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Notice

As part of the application and recruitment process, CSCI Consulting, Inc. may collect personal information as described under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA).

This information is collected solely for employment-related purposes, including evaluating your qualifications, processing your application, and complying with legal obligations.

By applying to this position, you acknowledge that you have read and understand the following notice regarding the collection of your personal information as a job applicant:

  • Categories of Information Collected: Personal identifiers, employment history, educational information, and any other information provided in your application or as part of the interview process.
  • Purposes for Collecting Information: To review your application, assess your qualifications, and manage the hiring process.
  • Retention and Security: Information collected will be retained indefinitely and will be securely stored and handled in accordance with CCPA guidelines and CSCI Consulting, Inc. policies.
  • Rights of Applicants: Under CCPA, California residents have the right to request information about the personal data we collect, delete it, and request restrictions on certain uses. However, some information may be retained as required by law.

For further information, or to exercise your rights under the CCPA, please contact CSCI’s HR team.


Disclaimer

The above declarations are not intended to be an all-inclusive list of the duties and responsibilities of the job described, nor are they intended to be such a listing of the skills and abilities required to do the job. Rather, they are intended only to describe the general nature of the job.

WILL BE A PLUS

Are you passionate about building reliable automation solutions for products that make an impact in healthcare? We are seeking a Senior Test Automation Engineer with extensive experience in designing and implementing automated quality assurance strategies across desktop, web, and backend systems. This role focuses on developing scalable automation frameworks, validating application performance, integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines, and driving continuous quality improvement.

At Sigma Software, we offer the flexibility of working in a collaborative international environment, access to challenging technical projects, and opportunities for continuous professional growth. Why join us? You will help improve the quality and reliability of healthcare solutions, where stability and precision truly matter.

You will design and implement robust test plans, develop and maintain automated test scripts, and drive continuous improvement in testing processes and maximizing testing efficiency through automation. $94,458 to $179,048 (CA, NJ, NY, WA, HI, AK, MD, CT, RI, MA)

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

  • Develop Test Plans and Strategies: With the goal of minimizing production defects, lead the creation and execution of high-level test strategies for complex projects. Ensure that all test plans align with business objectives and deliver comprehensive test coverage. Drive the adoption of an automation-first approach for large sized feature and integrate testing into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Design and Execute Test Cases: Take ownership of designing and executing high-complexity cross-functional test cases that cover a range of testing types. Develop and manage comprehensive testing strategies across large-scale projects, ensuring alignment with overall development and business goals.
  • Perform Manual and Automated Testing: With the goal of minimizing production defects, lead both manual and automated testing efforts in a medium sized functional area, focusing on improving automation coverage. Take ownership of automation strategy and ensure automation components are scalable and maintainable.
  • Documentations for Process and Bug Report: Identify complex defects and provide detailed analysis in bug report. Enforce defect tracking, progress updates, timely resolution and effective communication across teams. Implement defect management best practices and ensure overall quality. Lead quality initiatives to ensure defects are minimized in future releases. Establish and lead best practices for maintaining test documentation across upstream and downstream functional areas.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration and Communication: Collaborate cross-functionally with engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to ensure complex requirement's clarity including upstream and downstream functional areas, accountable for all features meeting quality standards and ensure software meets requirements across the product.
  • Continuous Improvement: Implement and Drive Continuous Improvement Practices. Lead small process improvement initiatives across medium sized features . Champion best practices for leveraging test automation, continuous integration, and continuous delivery. Use quantitative metrics to demonstrate the impact of improvements on software quality and testing efficiency.
  • Continuous Learning: Establish yourself as an expert in emerging testing technologies and methodologies. Evaluate, propose, and integrate industry-leading tools and practices into the team’s workflow. Influence the strategic direction of the testing function within the organization.
  • Mentor TE Team Members on Product knowledge: Provide mentorship and leadership to less experienced engineers. Lead knowledge-sharing sessions, help team members troubleshoot complex issues, and guide product knowledge development for junior engineers.
  • Critical Thinking and Problem-Solving Skills: Proactively identify and address obstacles or bottlenecks across multiple projects or teams. Take ownership of complex issues and guide the team in overcoming challenges, ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality software focus on task level, but not limited to project level.
  • Test Strategy Review: Develop and review comprehensive test strategies, ensuring alignment with business and technical goals. Take responsibility for the overall direction of test strategies across projects, aligning with organizational objectives.
  • Test Case Review: Review and approve test cases for multiple teams, ensuring thoroughness and accuracy. Provide feedback on test case design and coverage, driving improvements across the organization.
  • Monitor and Analyze Testing Metrics: Continuously track, analyze, and interpret testing metrics to assess effectiveness and quality. Make data-driven recommendations to enhance testing processes, test coverage, and defect management.
  • Drive and Develop Test Engineering Strategies and Policies: Drive and define the strategic direction for test engineering across the project. Develop policies, standards, and best practices to ensure testing quality, consistency, and alignment with business goals.
  • Test Automation Effectiveness and Coverage: Collaborate with SET team to define and implement automation priorities for large, complex projects or across multiple teams. Ensure the team is leveraging automation to maximize testing efficiency. Improving automation coverage.
