job.title: Quality Assurance Engineer - India Remote
job.description:
ABOUT QUANTUMLOOPAI

QuantumLoopAI is one of the UK's fastest-growing healthtech companies. Our AI-powered platform, EMMA, is used by hundreds of organisations across the UK to manage communications, automate workflows and deliver better outcomes through intelligent automation. Backed by leading investors and scaling rapidly ahead of our Series A, we are building the infrastructure that will define the next generation of AI-driven service delivery.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our platform handles real, live conversations — and because those conversations matter, quality is critical. Small errors have real consequences. We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer to own and grow the automated testing that keeps our voice AI platform reliable.

You will build and maintain automated test coverage across backend and frontend, create automation that places and validates real test calls end to end, and measure the accuracy of the speech-to-text (STT) and text-to-speech (TTS) layers that make the platform work. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role where your testing directly protects real users.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Backend and Frontend Test Automation

  • Build and maintain automated test coverage across backend services and the frontend, ensuring new features ship without breaking existing behaviour.
  • Integrate tests into CI pipelines so quality checks run automatically on every change.
  • Work with engineers to turn real-world failures into permanent regression tests.

Voice Pipeline and Call Automation

  • Build and run outbound-call automation that places test calls through the live voice pipeline, simulates realistic caller scenarios, and validates the platform's behaviour from start to finish.
  • Test the speech-to-text (STT) layer — measuring transcription accuracy and how reliably the platform understands callers.
  • Test the text-to-speech (TTS) layer — validating pronunciation, naturalness, and that the voice output behaves correctly.
  • Run regression testing across multiple conversation flows and catch behavioural drift after changes.

Quality Evaluation and Defect Management

  • Evaluate calls against conversational quality dimensions — accuracy, tone, flow adherence, understanding, hand-off between stages, summaries, outcome handling, call control, and avoiding unnecessary repetition.
  • Reproduce, document, and track defects through to resolution, writing clear reproduction steps from real call examples.
  • Work with engineers, prompt authors, and the operations team to identify quality issues and build permanent test coverage around them.

Requirements

ESSENTIAL

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in QA automation or software testing with a strong automation focus.
  • Strong hands-on Python — you write, debug and maintain test scripts daily, not occasionally.
  • Experience writing and maintaining automated test suites across both API and UI layers.
  • Comfortable testing REST APIs and working with structured data (JSON).
  • Experience with automated web and UI testing frameworks.
  • Familiarity with version-control workflows (Git) and continuous-integration pipelines — you have integrated automated tests into CI/CD.
  • Solid grasp of QA methodology — test design, regression strategy, and the defect lifecycle.
  • Excellent attention to detail and clear written communication.
  • Comfortable working remotely and aligning to UK business hours (9:00 AM to 6:00 PM GMT/BST).

DESIRABLE

  • Exposure to voice or conversational AI testing — metrics such as transcription accuracy (WER), naturalness scoring, or response latency.
  • Experience with automated or AI-assisted response evaluation.
  • Telephony or real-time audio and voice testing experience.
  • Experience working with data to gather and verify test evidence programmatically.
  • Experience in regulated software environments where quality assurance and compliance processes are important.
  • Experience working with distributed or remote teams across multiple time zones.

LOGISTICS

  1. Education: We value skills and experience over formal qualifications.
  2. Working arrangements: Fully remote from India, aligned to UK business hours (9:00 AM to 6:00 PM GMT/BST).
  3. Start date: Flexible.

Benefits

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive package depending on experience
  • Potential share options
  • Professional development including conference attendance and CPD support
  • The opportunity to own test automation for a live voice AI platform at one of the UK's fastest-growing healthtech companies
  • Remote working with a collaborative, high-ownership engineering culture
  • Direct collaboration with engineering, AI/ML and product teams

HOW WE ARE DIFFERENT

At QuantumLoopAI, you will join a team that is building AI-powered products used by hundreds of organisations across the UK. We move fast, take ownership, and celebrate wins together. Our culture values:

  • Impact over optics. We measure success by real outcomes, not busy work
  • Transparency. Open communication, honest feedback, shared context
  • Ownership. You will have real autonomy to shape your work and our platform
  • Learning. We are building something new, and we learn from every experiment

This is a QA role where your work has direct, visible impact. Every test you build protects real users in real conversations. You will not be writing test scripts in isolation — you will be listening to real calls, diagnosing real failures, and building the automation that prevents them from happening again.

DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

We believe diverse teams build better products. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. If you are excited about this role but do not meet every requirement, we would still love to hear from you.

RECRUITMENT SAFETY NOTICE

QuantumLoopAI will never ask candidates for payment or sensitive financial information during the recruitment process. All official communications come from @quantumloopai.com email addresses.

COME WORK WITH US

Ready to own quality for a live voice AI platform? We would love to hear from you. Questions about this role? Contact

job.description:
About Gray Media:

Today, we are a growing multimedia company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. We are the nation's largest owner of top-rated local television stations and digital assets serving 117 full-power television markets that collectively reach approximately 37% of US television households. The portfolio includes 80 markets with the top-rated television station and 100 markets with the first and/or second highest rated television station in average all-day ratings across 116 of such markets that were measured by Nielsen in 2025. We also own the largest Telemundo Affiliate group, with 47 markets, and Gray Digital Media, a full-service digital agency offering national and local clients digital marketing strategies and the most advanced digital products and services. Our additional media properties include video production companies Raycom Sports, Tupelo Media Group, and PowerNation Studios, and studio production facilities Assembly Atlanta and Third Rail Studios.

We understand that life needs balance. That is why we offer our employees and eligible family members a comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • Comprehensive Medical(Rx), Dental, and Vision Coverage
  • Health Savings Account with Company contributions
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • Employer-paid life and disability benefits
  • Paid parental leave benefits
  • Adoption and Surrogacy Benefits
  • 401(k) Plan, including matching and profit-sharing contributions
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Voluntary benefits, including Hospital Indemnity, Critical Illness, Accident Insurance, and supplemental life insurance coverage
  • Paid Time Off, including Relocation PTO
  • Focus on Caring

Salary/Wage:

$70,000 - $80,000/yr.

Shift and Schedule:

Mon. - Fri. (or at Manager's discretion)

Job Type:

Full-Time

About GDM (Gray Media Group):

Gray’s Digital Technology group builds and operates the products that bring local news, sports, and live programming to audiences across 100+ television stations – on the web, on mobile, and on connected TV platforms. Quality is critical to ensure viewers are focused on journalism, not the technology that delivers it. You will help make sure that what we ship is reliable, accessible, and ready when it counts – election night, severe weather, breaking news.

Job Summary/Description:

The Digital QA Analyst validates the quality, functionality, accessibility, and reliability of digital products across web, mobile, connected TV, APIs, data feeds, and internal systems. You’ll partner closely with Product Owners, developers, and business stakeholders to confirm that what we build meets requirements, holds up under real-world use, and is genuinely ready for release. The right person combines strong testing fundamentals, critical thinking, technical curiosity, and a sharp eye for detail to catch problems early and promote quality at every stage of the development lifecycle, not just at the end.

Duties/Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

• Design, plan, and execute testing activities across web, mobile, connected TV (CTV), APIs, data feeds, and internal platforms to ensure products meet quality and business expectations.
• Collaborate with Product Owners, developers, and stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle to clarify requirements, identify risks, and improve overall product quality.
• Create and maintain test strategies, test cases, regression suites, and documentation while prioritizing testing efforts based on risk, complexity, user impact, and release timelines.
• Identify, document, and validate defects through resolution, providing clear communication on testing status, release readiness, and potential risks.
• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing quality trends, supporting efficient QA processes, and helping expand test automation coverage where it provides the greatest value.

Test design and planning:
• Build test strategies, cases, and validation approaches from requirements, Jira tickets, stakeholder input, and product knowledge.
• Partner with Product Owners and developers early in the software lifecycle to surface risks, clarify requirements, and improve testability before development starts.
• Prioritize coverage by risk, complexity, business, and user impact, and release timelines.

Test execution across platforms:
• Run functional, regression, integration, exploratory, accessibility, and user acceptance testing across web, mobile, CTV, and internal platforms.
• Execute cross-browser, cross-device, and mobile testing.
• Test connected-TV apps (Roku, Apple TV, Fire TV, Android TV) for playback, captions, ad behavior, and live-versus-VOD scenarios.
• Validate APIs, data feeds, AI-generated outputs, JSON/XML payloads, and downstream integrations.

Defect lifecycle:
• Identify defects, usability issues, edge cases, and unexpected behavior.
• Write clear defect reports with reproduction steps, expected-versus-actual results, and supporting evidence.
• Re-test fixes and confirm resolution before release.

Collaboration and process:
• Take part in sprint planning, backlog refinement, standups, and retrospectives.
• Work alongside developers to isolate issues and support root-cause analysis.
• Maintain regression suites, test documentation, and repeatable QA processes.
• Validate release readiness and communicate status, risks, and recommendations clearly.

Continuous improvement:
• Track quality trends, recurring defects, and areas of technical debt that affect product

stability.

• Help identify where automated testing would add the most value, and partner with
engineering to grow coverage and efficiency.
• Contribute to initiatives that raise product quality and team effectiveness.

Qualifications/Requirements:

• A minimum of 3 years of experience in software quality assurance, digital product testing, or a related field, with hands-on experience testing web applications, mobile applications, internal systems, or other digital products.
• Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, including functional, regression, integration, exploratory, accessibility, and user acceptance testing, with the ability to identify issues and validate solutions across multiple platforms.
• 3+ years of experience in software QA, digital product testing, or a closely related field.
• Hands-on experience testing web applications, mobile applications, internal systems, or other digital products.
• Strong grasp of functional, regression, integration, exploratory, accessibility, and acceptance testing.
• Ability to turn requirements and user workflows into effective test cases and scenarios.
• Experience validating APIs, structured data, and system integrations.
• Strong defect documentation and the collaboration skills to work across the full SDLC.
• Working understanding of accessibility principles, and willingness to build accessibility checks into everyday testing.
• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving instincts.
• Excellent written and verbal communication

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience testing media, broadcast, publishing, CMS, or other content-driven platforms.
• Experience testing connected-TV/OTT apps and validating video playback, closed captions, and ad insertion (SSAI/DAI).
• Experience validating JSON/XML/API responses and integration workflows.
• Basic SQL for validation and troubleshooting.
• Experience testing iOS and Android applications.
• Familiarity with browser developer tools and network inspection.
• Exposure to test automation and an interest in growing automated coverage.
• Accessibility testing against WCAG guidelines.
• Experience supporting release validation and production readiness.

What Success Looks Like:

• Requirements are validated thoroughly before release.
• Critical workflows perform reliably across every supported platform – including playback and ad delivery.
• Defects are identified early and communicated clearly enough to influence product and development decisions.
• Releases ship with predictable quality and few production-impacting issues, which means less rework afterward.
• Test coverage and regression confidence improve over time.
• Stakeholders have clear visibility into QA status, risks, and release readiness.
• Engineering trusts the quality bar on every release.

If you feel you’re qualified and want to work with a great group of people, go to , you may type in the job title, station call letters, or click on "apply now", upload your resume, cover letter, and references

(Current employees who are interested in this position can apply through the Gray-TV UltiPro self-service portal)

GDM (Gray Media Group)-TV/Gray Media is a drug-free company

In addition to federal law requirements, Gray Media complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment at every location where the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Gray Media expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. Role summary

We are looking for a Performance Engineer to design and execute performance testing across web applications, BI workloads, and ETL/data models in a SAFe environment. The role requires strong hands-on experience with Apache JMeter, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, and Playwright for custom web, BI, and ETL performance scripting. Azure DevOps pipeline experience is required. Ability to learn quickly is essential. Hands-on use of GitHub Copilot is needed; familiarity with MCP is a plus.

Responsibilities

  • Design, execute, and analyze performance tests for web apps, BI reports/dashboards, and ETL/data models — JMeter (load, stress, soak, spike) for web, and custom Playwright/Python scripts for BI and ETL — and convert SLAs into measurable thresholds.
  • Validate ETL pipeline and data-model performance — job runtime, data volume handling, transformation throughput, and downstream reporting impact.
  • Assess BI performance — report/dashboard load times, query response, concurrent user load, and refresh/batch windows.

  • Playwright + JavaScript/TypeScript and Python for custom client-side, BI, and ETL performance scripting.

  • Azure DevOps experience: pipelines, CI/CD, test execution, and reporting.
  • Working knowledge of SAFe and ability to operate in Agile Release Trains.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

job.title: Assistant Vice President–Lead QA & Proofing Unit
job.description:
Mashreq Bank

JOB DESCRIPTION

1

Job Title

AVP – Lead, QA & Proofing Unit

Department

Operations GRC

Direct Supervisor

Head – Internal Controls, Operations GRC

Job Number

2

Job Purpose

To lead the Quality Assurance and Proofing Unit under the Enterprise Reconciliation Framework (ERF), ensuring robust control oversight and assurance over reconciliation lifecycle activities across Operations and Business units. This role will provide independent validation, exception monitoring, and follow-up closure of outstanding reconciliation items. It will serve as the 1.5 Line of Defense, with an enterprise-wide mandate covering all reconciliation types (manual, semi-automated, automated) and platforms including TLM. The role ensures that reconciliation quality and closure processes are consistently applied and monitored, with clear escalation mechanisms.

3

Dimensions

Scope of work

  • Oversight of enterprise-wide reconciliation proofing, covering:

  • Nostro/Vostro

  • Inter-branch accounts

  • Sundry & suspense GLs

  • Internal accounts

  • VAT reconciliation

  • Independent review of reconciliation breaks across all platforms (automated/manual

  • Escalation and closure follow-up of breaks beyond T+3 days (auto) / agreed timelines (manual)

  • Thematic reviews, exception trend reporting, and root cause analysis

Service Level Management

  • Track adherence to reconciliation closure timelines (T+3, etc.)

  • Maintain performance dashboards with metrics across divisions and platforms

  • Set up QA KPIs aligned with ERF and Group Operations KRIs

  • Establish early warning triggers for high-risk or aging items

Quality Review

  • Monthly quality assurance sampling of reconciled items

  • Tracking accuracy, timeliness, and completeness of proofing controls

  • Raising exceptions to the CRU head and relevant BU operations for resolution

  • Conducting periodic health-checks aligned with audit and GRC guidelines

Key Interfaces

  • Internal: CRU head, Ops unit heads, Finance (CAD), Technology, Risk, Compliance

  • External: Audit (Internal & External), Regulators (for proofing expectations), IBG Ops Heads

  • Represent in Operations GRC Risk Councils, FROC and other governance forums

4

Key Result Areas

  • % of reconciliations reviewed as part of QA plan per quarter across all account categories
  • Reduction in aged unreconciled items (>180 and >360 days).
  • Reduction in outstanding >T+3 items across platforms
  • % adherence to reconciliation policy and internal controls.
  • No. of thematic issues identified and resolved via QA testing
  • Timely and accurate reconciliation attestation and proofing validations.
  • Platform enhancements delivered and automated rules adoption.
  • SLA adherence across business units and international/overseas branches.
  • Successful internal audit and risk reviews with minimal or no observations.
  • Quality of audit feedback for proofing-related controls
  • No overdue proofing validations.

5

Operating Environment, Framework and Boundaries, Working Relationships

  • Operates independently from the CRU but in close coordination
  • Enterprise-wide scope across Group Operations and Business Units
  • Covers both UAE and international operations including Egypt, Pakistan, India, and IBG branches
  • Maintains reporting line into GRC – not embedded within the CRU to preserve independent assurance role
  • Aligned with ERF governance manual, APPM, ORM Guidelines and reporting templates.
  • Works within a cross-functional, multi-country environment.
  • Expected to define and enforce centralized standards and controls while balancing local branch needs.
  • Works with constrained resources in a transformation phase and must effectively build team capacity.

Working Relationships

Directly interfaces with:

  • Head of CRU and his leadership team
  • Matrix relationships with - Audit, Risk, Compliance, CAD & Tax teams
  • Operations GRC leads in Egypt, India, Pakistan

6

Problem Solving

  • Recommend remediation plans for recurring proofing issues.

  • Diagnose systemic control weaknesses across reconciliation processes and recommend design enhancements.

  • Address recurring break trends and implement data-driven remediation plans across business and product lines.

  • Resolve conflicts or accountability gaps between Operations, Finance, and Technology teams on account ownership and reconciliation execution.

  • Mitigate regulatory and audit risks related to unreconciled balances by ensuring preventive and detective controls are in place.

  • Identify pattern-based failures or non-adherence to reconciliation SLAs

  • Drive cross-functional resolution forums for persistent items

  • Challenge ownership decisions or business rationales where reconciliation breaks are not justified

7

Decision Making Authority & Responsibility

  • Escalate aging/unjustified open items directly to Head of OpEx & GRC or Head of Central Accounts.

  • Recommend suspension of automated recon processes if persistent QA failures occur

  • Approve monthly QA plans and thematic review scope

  • Raise and track Corrective Action Plans (CAPs) jointly with Operations heads.

  • Approve or Reject proofing certifications.

8

Knowledge, Skills and Experience

Knowledge:

  • Reconciliation platforms: Smart Stream / TLM, and other tools.
  • Operations risk, controls, and audit methodology

  • Regulatory reporting and reconciliation governance

Skills:

  • Strong analytical and root cause analysis capabilities
  • Excellent stakeholder communication and escalation skills
  • Proficiency in dashboarding tools (Power BI/Tableau/Excel)
  • Team leadership and QA framework design

Experience:

  • 10+ years in operations/internal controls/reconciliation/assurance roles within banking

job.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
job.description:
About ThriveCart

ThriveCart is a powerful platform used by over 50,000 people worldwide to generate over $5B in sales. Included within the ThriveCart platform is a learning management system (LMS), affiliate management, cart and checkout functionality, making it a top solution for creators, coaches, consultants, and other businesses.

We integrate with everything you use and have a simple, clean UI with numerous features that allow customers to build income from existing traffic and we are the highest-converting cart for online businesses. Our business is growing, profitable, and backed by LTV SaaS Growth Funds, and we are looking to expand our footprint amongst online businesses.

Location

Remote (Latin America)

Job Overview:

You'll own quality end-to-end for ThriveCart's e-commerce platform — test strategy, automation, defect prevention, and production health monitoring. This isn't a click-through-test-cases role: you own quality for your domain.

AI is a core part of the workflow here, not a bonus skill — for generating test cases, creating test data, drafting test plans, and accelerating automation. What we're hiring for is judgment: knowing which tests actually matter, understanding risk, and thinking critically about AI-generated output.

This description spans L1–L4. Interview depth and expectations scale with level — see Qualifications & Expectations by Level below.

What You'll Own:

Test Strategy & Planning

  • Own the quality strategy for your features and domain: test plans, risk assessment, coverage decisions
  • Flag ambiguities and testability gaps during requirements review, before code is written — shift-left quality
  • Define acceptance criteria in partnership with Product
  • Balance manual exploration with automated regression coverage
  • Document test plans, coverage decisions, and known risk areas for async visibility across the team

Test Automation

  • Write and maintain automated tests (API, integration, end-to-end) using the team's frameworks
  • Keep automation suites fast, reliable, and maintainable — flaky tests are yours to fix, not ignore
  • Maintain CI/CD integration for test execution
  • L3+: Design and evolve the overall test automation architecture

Production Quality & Incident Response

  • Monitor features in production using observability tools — quality doesn't end at release
  • Respond to dev-escalations and incidents with urgency: assess blast radius, run targeted regression testing, help isolate root cause, communicate findings clearly
  • L3+: Own incident response from the quality side — lead triage, coordinate regression testing, write post-mortems with defect analysis, drive preventive fixes
  • L4+: Coordinate all QA activity during major incidents, communicate to stakeholders, ensure systemic fixes are validated before release

AI-Augmented QA (Expected, Not Optional)

  • Use AI tools daily: generating test cases and data, drafting test plans, analyzing bug patterns, accelerating automation writing
  • AI will generate more test cases than you need — prioritize ruthlessly based on risk
  • Review all AI-generated test output critically: AI has no product context, you do
  • L3+: Teach junior QAs effective AI workflows for testing; establish team AI quality standards
  • L4+: Set team standards for AI tool usage — evaluate tools, measure impact on coverage and velocity

Defect Advocacy & Communication

  • Write clear, reproducible bug reports that developers can act on immediately
  • Advocate for quality: flag risks before release, document known issues, be explicit about what is and isn't tested
  • L3+: Partner with Product and Engineering on quality metrics, track trends

Collaboration

  • Work closely with developers to improve testability at the code level
  • Help developers write better unit tests by identifying untested scenarios
  • L3+: Mentor L1/L2 QAs on testing mindset, automation skills, and risk thinking

What You Bring To This Role:

Technical Environment

  • Testing: API testing (Postman/REST clients), browser automation (Playwright), unit/integration test frameworks
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions (tests run on every PR)
  • Observability: AWS CloudWatch, application logs, metrics dashboards
  • Platform stack: PHP/TypeScript, Ruby/TypeScript, MariaDB, Redis, AWS
  • Playwright is our standard framework for browser automation — what matters most is strong testing fundamentals

Must-haves:

  • Strong testing fundamentals — test strategy, test case design, risk-based prioritization
  • Hands-on automation experience with Playwright
  • Comfortable with API testing (Postman/REST clients) and reading application logs
  • Already using — or genuinely motivated to use — AI tools in a QA workflow
  • Clear written communication: bug reports and test plans others can act on without a meeting

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience testing an e-commerce, payments, or subscription platform
  • Familiarity with PHP, TypeScript, or Ruby codebases
  • AWS/CloudWatch or similar observability tooling
  • GitHub Actions or another CI/CD pipeline

Qualifications & Expectations by Level

  • L1 (Junior QA) — 0–1 yrs: Executes test plans, writes simple automation with guidance, reports bugs clearly. Bootcamp, internship, or early professional QA experience is fine — we're hiring for rigor and curiosity over tenure. Uses AI to learn faster and generate test cases; validates all AI output.
  • L2 (QA Engineer 1) — 1–3 yrs: Has independently owned quality for a feature or product area — not just extended someone else's test plan or suite, but built one. Writes comprehensive test plans and automation, and responds to incidents with targeted testing.
  • L3 (Senior QA) — 3–6 yrs: Has led incident response from the QA side and mentored other QAs. Owns quality strategy for complex projects, improves automation architecture and infrastructure, and uses AI to multiply output rather than just speed up individual tasks.
  • L4 (Lead QA) — 6+ yrs: Has set QA standards or practices for a team, not just followed them. Serves as the quality authority for a domain, drives major incident response, and partners with leadership on quality metrics and AI tooling strategy.

Success Metrics

  • 30 days: First test plan written and approved, first automated tests in CI pipeline, understands the most critical user journeys
  • 60 days: Independently owning quality for a feature, automation suite stable, first incident response contribution
  • 90 days: Contributing to test strategy discussions, handling dev-escalations independently in your area

On-Call

Shared rotation with engineering (~1 week/month after ramp-up). QA on-call focuses on blast radius assessment and regression testing during incidents.

Career Path

Junior QA → QA Engineer 1 → Senior QA → Lead QA → Head of Quality

Learn More About ThriveCart:

Our team thrives on collaboration, innovation, and continuous growth. We foster an open environment with regular knowledge-sharing sessions and encourage active participation in shaping the platform. Our values include:

  • Commit to Excellence – We believe in delivering high-quality work and continuous improvement.
  • User-Focused Problem Solving – Every design should contribute to solving a real problem for our users.
  • Team Collaboration – We work better together, valuing input from every team member.
  • Growth Mindset – We embrace challenges as opportunities to learn and grow.

Our team and product are growing rapidly- we achieved YoY growth of 64% from 2022-2023, and we’re just getting started. We believe in open communication, clear goal setting, and that people do best when they have a growth mindset and want to get things done. job.description:
Intetics Inc., a global technology company providing custom software application development, distributed professional teams, software product quality assessment, and “all-things-digital” solutions, is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior QA Automation Engineer to join our dynamic team.

The project focuses on developing a digital platform for environmental compliance and emissions reporting in the maritime industry.

The platform enables shipowners and vessel operators to submit emissions-related data and supporting documentation in accordance with regulatory requirements. The system is designed to streamline the reporting process by collecting and managing the necessary information and transmitting it to relevant government and regulatory authorities through integrations.

The main goal is to simplify periodic emissions reporting, reduce manual administrative work, improve data accuracy, and help maritime companies meet their environmental compliance obligations.

Responsibilities

  • Take end-to-end ownership of QA for a new product as the sole QA engineer.
  • Define and implement the testing strategy, test plans, quality standards, and release readiness criteria.
  • Select appropriate automation tools and build a maintainable test automation framework from scratch.
  • Design, implement, and maintain automated tests covering critical functionality, integrations, and end-to-end workflows.
  • Perform manual and exploratory testing to validate new features and identify issues beyond automated coverage.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and ensure reliable, actionable test results.
  • Collaborate with developers and product stakeholders to clarify requirements, identify edge cases, and improve testability early in development.
  • Investigate defects, document reproducible findings, and verify fixes.
  • Drive release quality by assessing test coverage, communicating risks, and providing clear release readiness recommendations.

Requirements

  • Proven experience in a Senior QA or QA Automation role, with the ability to independently own the full QA lifecycle.
  • Experience establishing QA processes and building test automation frameworks from scratch.
  • Strong hands-on programming skills in at least one language used for test automation; no specific language is required.
  • Solid understanding of test design techniques, risk-based testing, and selecting appropriate levels of test coverage.
  • Experience testing APIs, backend services, and integrations.
  • Ability to combine automated, manual, and exploratory testing effectively.
  • Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and working with Git.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills, including working with logs, test data, and databases.
  • Ability to select tools pragmatically, prioritize testing activities, and work independently in a new project with evolving requirements.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with containerized test environments and Docker.

job.title: Software Development Test Engineer (SDET), IOS
job.description:
Description

Keeper Security is hiring a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to design, build and maintain mobile automation solutions for our native iOS and Android applications. This is a 100% remote position, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the El Dorado Hills, CA or Chicago, IL metro areas.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help ensure the quality, reliability and stability of Keeper’s mobile applications.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.

About the Job

As a SDET focused on mobile automation, you will build and maintain automated test frameworks for Keeper’s native iOS and Android applications. This role emphasizes automation development, CI/CD integration and mobile-specific testing infrastructure rather than primarily manual testing.

You will work closely with Mobile Engineering, QA and Product teams to improve testability, expand automation coverage and ensure mobile features are reliable and release-ready throughout the development lifecycle.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain automated test frameworks for native iOS and Android applications
  • Build and extend automated test suites for functional, regression and integration coverage
  • Integrate mobile test automation into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Bitrise, GitHub Actions or similar platforms
  • Execute automated tests across simulators, emulators and physical devices
  • Partner with mobile engineers to improve application testability and automation coverage
  • Investigate test failures, identify root causes and improve automation stability and reliability
  • Contribute to mobile automation architecture, tooling standards and testing best practices
  • Identify gaps in automated coverage and prioritize high-value test scenarios
  • Evaluate and adopt new mobile automation tools and technologies where appropriate
  • Use AI-assisted tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot or similar platforms to improve test development, debugging, root-cause analysis, documentation and workflow efficiency

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in software testing, SDET or test automation roles, including significant mobile automation experience
  • Hands-on experience with mobile automation frameworks such as Appium, XCUITest, Espresso or similar tools
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Swift, Kotlin, Java, JavaScript or TypeScript
  • Experience designing and maintaining scalable automated test frameworks
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience testing native applications across simulators, emulators and physical devices
  • Strong debugging, analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience working closely with software engineers to improve testability and resolve complex defects
  • Strong understanding of mobile application lifecycles, release processes and platform-specific behavior
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across Engineering, Product and QA teams
  • Ability and willingness to use AI-assisted tools effectively to improve automation development, debugging, analysis and documentation
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent practical experience
  • Due to this role’s involvement in FedRAMP environments, qualified candidates must be a U.S. Person, defined as a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with cloud-based mobile device testing platforms such as BrowserStack, Sauce Labs or Firebase Test Lab
  • Experience with mobile performance, reliability or network-condition testing
  • Familiarity with mobile accessibility and UX testing best practices
  • Experience testing security-sensitive, identity or cybersecurity applications
  • Familiarity with App Store and Google Play release workflows

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental & Vision (inclusive of domestic partnerships
  • Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life
  • Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance
  • 401K (Roth/Traditional)
  • A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)

Keeper Security, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and participant in the U.S. Federal E-Verify program. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Classification: Exempt

This notice explains how Keeper Security processes your personal data during recruitment. Depending on the role and location, the Controller of personal data (the organization responsible for determining why and how personal data is processed) will be Keeper Security Inc.   • Application responses and uploaded documents

Information We generate:

  • Interview notes, assessments, communications
  • Scheduling information

Information From Others:

  • Comply with employment law obligations

job.title: Quality Engineer (Automation & AI) - Remote
job.description:
About the Role

Zyte is looking for a Quality Engineer to join our unified Quality Engineering function. This is an automation-first, AI-native role embedded directly within our engineering squads.

You will be responsible for designing risk-based test strategies, rapidly converting them into automated checks using AI-assisted development workflows, and continuously improving the quality, speed, and reliability of software delivery. Quality at Zyte is not a gatekeeping function. It is an engineering discipline focused on preventing defects, accelerating delivery, and increasing confidence in every release.

AI coding agents are a core part of how we work. You will be expected to use Claude Code or equivalent AI-assisted development environments as your primary development partner for generating, reviewing, debugging, refactoring, and maintaining automation code.

What You Will Do

  • Design risk-based test strategies for new features and releases, then rapidly convert those strategies into automated coverage using AI-assisted development workflows
  • Use Claude Code within VS Code or equivalent AI coding agents as your primary development environment to generate, scale, and maintain automated test coverage
  • Build and maintain automated test suites using Playwright, integrated within GitHub CI/CD pipelines, ensuring quality gates are embedded throughout the software development lifecycle
  • Design and implement agentic testing workflows that generate, adapt, and maintain automated tests using AI models and APIs
  • Build reusable frameworks, utilities, shared libraries, and AI-powered tools that increase test authoring velocity across engineering teams
  • Partner closely with engineers, product managers, and designers to shift quality left, influencing requirements, design decisions, observability, and deployment strategies
  • Continuously improve test suite health by reducing flakiness, increasing execution speed, and ensuring reliable quality signals for every release
  • Drive quality upstream by identifying risks early and implementing preventative quality practices
  • Own and improve quality metrics including automated coverage growth, escaped defects, test execution performance, flakiness rates, and release confidence
  • Enable developers to write, execute, and maintain automated tests as part of their daily workflow

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, with the ability to review, validate and debug code across any modern programming language
  • Strong experience with modern test automation frameworks, preferably Playwright
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI coding agents as a primary development partner for generating, reviewing, debugging, refactoring, and maintaining code
  • Comfortable delegating significant portions of implementation work to AI agents while maintaining high engineering and quality standards
  • Experience building and maintaining scalable automation frameworks
  • Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or similar platforms
  • Experience with agentic testing frameworks, AI-powered testing tools, or LLM API integrations within engineering workflows
  • Proven track record of increasing automation coverage, reducing manual effort, and improving software quality outcomes
  • Strong understanding of quality engineering principles, test strategy, risk analysis, and defect prevention
  • Comfortable working as an embedded engineer within cross-functional product squads
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to provide concise, actionable updates and collaborate effectively across teams
  • Curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset toward emerging AI technologies and engineering practices

Nice to Have

  • Experience testing AI-powered products, agents, or LLM-based applications
  • Experience designing evaluation frameworks for AI-generated outputs
  • Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI quality assessment, and AI observability
  • Experience with performance, load, or resilience testing
  • Experience with test management platforms integrated with Jira
  • Experience building internal developer platforms, testing tools, or engineering productivity solutions

Success in This Role

Within your first six months, you will:

  • Increase automated regression coverage for your squad
  • Reduce manual testing effort sprint over sprint
  • Build reusable automation components adopted by multiple teams
  • Demonstrate effective use of AI agents to accelerate automation development and maintenance
  • Improve release confidence while supporting fast, reliable software delivery
  • Contribute to a culture where quality is owned by the entire engineering team

job.title: Quality Assurance Analyst I
job.description:
Job Summary

The individual in this role will create test documentation, perform end-to-end testing, and build and execute automated test cases for our payments platform, including web-based applications, APIs, and physical payment terminals. Competitive candidates have 2+ years of experience in a QA function, including executing test scenarios for transaction-processing systems and providing comprehensive results. We have an opening for an on-site QA in Ft Wayne, In and an opening for a remote position.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Translate business requirements and payment processes (authorization, capture, void, refund, settlement, reconciliation) into test requirements and configuration settings for web, API, and terminal solutions.
  • Identify and assess risks to programs or projects, especially those affecting transaction accuracy, funds movement, and data security, and recommend and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Create test strategies that ensure solutions meet standards of functionality, performance, reliability, and payment industry requirements.
  • Collaborate with team leads and engineering resources to plan the testing approach across web, API, and terminal layers.
  • Execute end-to-end testing of the full transaction lifecycle, from card presentment at the terminal through processor response, settlement, reporting, and reconciliation, according to set deadlines.
  • Test terminal behavior across entry methods (chip, contactless/NFC, swipe, manual entry), PIN entry, receipt generation, and error handling.
  • Test device-specific scenarios such as connectivity loss, offline or store-and-forward modes, power interruption, and firmware and application updates.
  • Perform API testing of payment, webhook, and reporting endpoints, validating request/response accuracy, error codes, and idempotency.
  • Verify web components, including merchant portal, hosted checkout, and admin tools, across browsers and devices.
  • Support and complete test orchestration across environments, test cards, sandbox and processor simulators, and device fleets, using analysis, experience, and sound decision-making.
  • Record, log, and track defects with clear reproduction steps, logs, and transaction IDs, and coordinate resolutions with the development team and functional leads.
  • Assess test results to quickly identify and document defects, including discrepancies in transaction amounts, statuses, fees, or settlement data.
  • Support certification and compliance testing, such as card brand, EMV, acquirer/processor, and PCI-related requirements.
  • Direct projects from a quality assurance perspective, keeping both the merchant and the cardholder experience in mind.
  • Independently own a workstream or product line (for example, terminal software, merchant portal, or payment APIs), covering review and testing activities throughout the project life cycle.
  • Maintain the device test lab, including terminals, peripherals, test cards, and firmware versions.
  • Participate in daily engineering meetings to update teammates and management on status.
  • Assist the in-house support team with product defect exploration, as needed, including:
    • High-level technical assistance and escalations for merchants, partners, and internal staff.
    • Troubleshooting and analyzing issues related to transactions, terminals, reports, and data.
  • Present product expertise in training and implementation environments.
  • Build and execute automated test cases for web and API layers and identify opportunities to automate terminal testing.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Education and Experience

  • 2-5 years of experience in a QA role, including:
    • System, integration, and user acceptance testing
    • Test plans, documentation, and execution across multiple development deliverables
    • Testing web applications and REST APIs (e.g., Postman or similar tools)
  • At least 2 years of Azure Table or relevant database experience, including querying transaction data to validate results
  • Preferred: experience in payments, fintech, or financial services
  • Preferred: experience testing POS terminals or other physical devices (e.g., Verifone, Ingenico, PAX)
  • Preferred: familiarity with EMV, contactless standards, card brand certification, ISO 8583, or payment gateway and processor integrations

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong understanding of end-to-end payment flows, including authorization, settlement, chargebacks, refunds, and reconciliation.
  • Working knowledge of payment concepts such as tokenization, encryption, and PCI DSS, along with secure testing practices for sensitive cardholder data.
  • Knowledge of the technical aspects of business systems and infrastructure, including networks, terminal connectivity, and device management.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with particular care where money movement is involved.
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Well-versed in test automation, end-user desktop tools, and information security.
  • Ability to maintain a positive and professional attitude in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to take initiative in prioritizing, coordinating, and multitasking with composure.
  • Ability to work independently and as a contributing member of a team.

Work Environment

The noise level is usually moderate. The employee works in an office setting at an individual workstation using a telephone and computer, and may spend time in a device test lab handling payment terminals and peripherals.

Physical Demands

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position for most of the day.
  • Constantly operates a computer and other office productivity machinery.
  • Occasionally handles, sets up, and moves payment terminals and related hardware.

Neumo Summary:

With the backing of four decades of public sector expertise and corporate capability, Neumo has successfully supported government services. Neumo was honored and recognized for four (4) consecutive years as a GovTech 100 Company representing the top 100 companies focused on making a difference in and selling to state and local government agencies across the United States.

Neumo is committed to helping communities thrive and brings a wealth of experience combined with innovation. Today, Neumo offers more administrative and financial support to government officials than any other organization. And with a responsive, client-focused approach, we foster partnerships that give our customers the certainty they need to accomplish more.

Neumo offers a competitive benefits and compensation package and are looking for team members who will thrive in our dynamic environment.

Neumo is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Selection for a position will be made without regard to race, religion, national origin, sex, political affiliation, marital status, non-disqualifying physical handicap, and age.

job.description:
ACU-Serve delivers billing solutions to DME, (Durable Medical Equipment) HME (Home Medical Equipment) and Home Infusion providers, giving them the freedom to grow their business while collecting more, faster. ACU-Serve has helped many businesses cut through the complexity of an ever-transitioning billing process while becoming a trusted partner for continued growth. Clients routinely show faster collections, higher revenue and dramatically reduced management and staffing problems. ACU-Serve incorporates HME workflow, Medicare, Medicaid and Private Payer knowledge, and billing and collections experts into a single service on an Internet-based technology platform. The result is faster payments, higher revenue collection rates, and less management and staffing headaches, results matter! Unlike traditional billing service models, ACU-Serve provides our clients with a new level of control, flexibility, information access, and billing expertise. ACU-Serve functions as an integral part of the HME office staff, not a remote third party billing vendor.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Claims Analyst is responsible to perform quality reviews for both pre-pay and post-pay audits as well as Quality Assurance reviews of orders prior to delivery and/or confirmation according to established guidelines that assist management in monitoring the quality, consistency, and effectiveness of business processes, procedures and related SOP’s. Address ongoing questions, issues and escalations from both ACU-Serve employees as well as our clients and provide clear answers and easy access to training and other resources and educational material that can answer these issues. Help to develop and organize a database of information and resources to ensure ease of navigation and interpretation and maximum clarity for both ACU-Serve employees and our clients.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Perform quality reviews for both Pre-Pay and Post-Pay audits as well as the client’s orders prior to and/or confirmation, according to established guidelines, that assist management in monitoring the quality, consistency and effectiveness of business processes, procedures and related tools.

Specifically:

  • Follow defined audit processes in conducting quality reviews;
  • Keep current on new coding and billing guidelines, federal and state initiatives.
  • Ensure the consistent use of current codes, correct information, documentation and departmental procedures by monitoring their use and identifying any deficiencies;
  • Prepare summaries for management of quality review results, including basic analysis of identified deficiencies.
  • Reduce quality related errors by making recommendations to increase the efficiency of operations.

Assist with policy, procedure development and implementation as it relates to the claim review processes.

Review coding variances including supporting documentation, review of old and new procedure codes, consult and collaborate Director of Compliance as necessary.

Prepare supporting documentation as necessary.

Based on audits and claims reviews, prepare supporting documentation requests for configuration changes to ensure that configuration mirrors provider contract.

Keep current on new coding and billing guidelines, federal and state initiatives. Educate other departments on new/changes to regulations as necessary.

Coordinate recoupment efforts with Director of Compliance due to billing errors and over payments.

Respond to provider inquiries regarding recoupments in writing and/or verbally when necessary.

Perform departmental quality audits.

Produce and deliver monthly a summary report of changes to the Director of Compliance; include relevant source documents.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE:

  • Durable Medical Equipment experience is required
  • Must have knowledge of payor requirements for billing, auditing, and/or contracting with a strong background of Medicare LCD requirements; and
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; and
  • Must have knowledge of word, excel, and power point; and
  • Demonstrated ability to develop strong business partnerships and relationships with payors; and
  • Work closely with other internal customers.

PHYSICAL EFFORT:

Work time will be spent sitting approximately 90% of the time, standing and walking approximately 10% of work time. PC Keyboarding will constitute approximately 80% of work time. May require some travel.

job.description:
Keeper Security is hiring an experienced QA Analyst to join our Console team and help ensure the quality, reliability and usability of Keeper’s enterprise Admin Console applications. This is a 100% remote position, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the El Dorado Hills, CA or Chicago, IL metro areas.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help deliver secure, reliable administrative experiences to enterprise customers worldwide.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.

About the Role

As a QA Analyst on the Admin Console team, you will test Keeper’s web-based administrative experiences and the backend APIs that support our enterprise solutions. You will work closely with Engineering, Product and other QA professionals to validate new features, identify defects and ensure console functionality remains secure, reliable and intuitive.

This role requires strong attention to detail, experience testing enterprise web applications and familiarity with modern web and API testing practices. You will help maintain comprehensive test coverage across frontend functionality, administrative workflows, access controls and backend integrations.

Responsibilities

  • Test Keeper’s web-based Admin Console applications for functionality, reliability, usability and regression issues
  • Validate backend APIs that support console functionality using tools such as Postman or similar platforms
  • Create, execute and maintain test cases based on product requirements, technical specifications and user stories
  • Test enterprise administrative workflows including authentication, authorization, permissions and role-based access controls
  • Perform cross-browser testing to ensure consistent behavior across supported desktop browsers
  • Reproduce, document and track defects with clear technical detail and steps to reproduce
  • Maintain test coverage and execution results using tools such as TestRail, Jira and Confluence
  • Collaborate closely with developers, Product and other QA team members to identify issues and validate fixes
  • Participate in requirement reviews, release validation and regression testing activities
  • Identify gaps in test coverage and recommend improvements to QA processes and test strategy
  • Use AI-assisted tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or similar platforms to support test design, defect analysis, troubleshooting and documentation

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in software quality assurance, web application testing or a related QA role
  • Hands-on experience testing enterprise web applications, administrative consoles or SaaS platforms
  • Familiarity with web technologies including HTML, CSS, JavaScript and modern browser behavior
  • Experience validating backend APIs using Postman or similar API testing tools
  • Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, permissions and role-based access control concepts
  • Ability to create clear, detailed and reproducible test cases and defect reports
  • Experience with Jira, TestRail, Confluence or similar test and defect management platforms
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to collaborate across Engineering, Product and QA teams
  • Familiarity with enterprise identity technologies such as Active Directory, LDAP or similar platforms
  • Ability and willingness to use AI-assisted tools effectively to improve testing, troubleshooting, analysis and documentation
  • Due to this role’s involvement in GovCloud environments, qualified candidates must be a U.S. Person, defined as a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident

Preferred Requirements

  • Experience testing identity, cybersecurity or other security-sensitive enterprise applications
  • Familiarity with cloud environments such as AWS or Azure
  • Exposure to identity and access management protocols such as SAML, SCIM or SSO
  • Familiarity with virtualization or containerization tools such as Docker or VMware
  • Experience with automated web or API testing tools

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental & Vision (inclusive of domestic partnerships)
  • Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life
  • Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance
  • 401K (Roth/Traditional)
  • A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)
  • Above market annual bonuses

job.title: QA Engineer | Remote - Contract
job.description:
Role Title: QA Engineer

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

We are engaging QA Engineers to contribute expertise in software quality evaluation for a customer's high-volume project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity is open to specialists who have both strong QA backgrounds and prior paid experience with human data annotation, RLHF, model output evaluation, or rubric-based grading for AI training. Software QA experience alone, without a human-in-the-loop AI evaluation component, does not count toward this requirement.

Required Skills

  • Quality Assurance

  • Software Testing

  • Test Case Design

  • Automation Testing

  • Regression Testing

  • Bug Tracking

  • Test Management Tools

  • Selenium

  • Manual & Automated Testing

  • Bug Reporting

  • Quality Evaluation

  • Human Data

Scope of Work

  • Evaluate and rate AI-generated technical outputs against defined quality criteria and rubrics, identifying answers that may appear correct but are actually inaccurate or incomplete.

  • Design and assess comprehensive test cases for functional, regression, and edge-case scenarios, including negative and boundary tests.

  • Review bug reports and test documentation to ensure issues are reproducible, documentation is complete, and severity is properly assessed.

  • Identify, isolate, and document defects with precise reproduction steps and utilize structured tracking mechanisms.

  • Provide detailed, actionable written feedback and annotations to support efficient resolution by developers without the need for clarification.

  • Collaborate with project teams to refine evaluation guidelines and ensure continuous improvement of testing standards and methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven professional experience as a QA Engineer, SDET, Test Engineer, QA Analyst, or similar role in software quality assurance.

  • Strong command of QA fundamentals, including test case design, bug tracking, regression testing, and both manual and automated testing strategies.

  • Hands-on experience with automation frameworks and test management tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, Postman, Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, or BrowserStack (or similar tools).

  • Prior paid human data experience supporting AI training—such as annotation, labeling, RLHF, AI response evaluation, model evaluation, or rubric-based grading—is a firm project requirement.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.

  • Ability to communicate complex findings clearly in written English, providing specific, actionable feedback (B2 level or above).

  • No formal degree required—practical, demonstrable testing experience takes precedence.

  • Reliable internet connection and readiness to begin promptly.

job.description:
TransPerfect Games is a leading provider of bespoke and flexible videogame services, offering a wide range of solutions including translation, functional and localization game testing, certification testing, focus group and playtesting, player support and community management, cybersecurity and penetration testing, tool development, art design, game writing, GDPR consultancy, and voice-over recording.

With over 1000 well-known global game developers and publishers as our clients, we are looking for Game Localization QA Testers with native language skills in Malay & English to join us to provide client support on test problems in a dynamic and exciting environment. You will be testing the next big hit game from small independent development teams all the way to AAA game titles from industry heavyweights!

If you…

  • are someone who is passionate about games;

  • are detail-oriented;

  • are highly proficient and can spot errors in terminology, grammar, punctuation, and linguistic style in your mother tongue;

  • are willing to learn and take constructive feedback;

  • can deliver high-quality and timely testing to help make our clients’ games great;

  • have a passion for excellence, are an experienced gamer, and want to contribute to making better games,

come speak with us! This is your opportunity to make your hobby into work and start a brand-new career in the games industry!

Important information:

  • This position is on a freelance contract.

  • This is a remote work.

  • Immediate availability is preferred.

Position overview:

The Game Localization QA Tester will work as part of a game testing team to identify and fix issues affecting the localization of the game by making text changes, writing detailed bug reports, performing regression testing, etc. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and linguistic quality of localized content by performing manual testing across various gaming platforms.

Position responsibilities:

  • Identify, isolate, document, and fix any localization / linguistic issues and verify fixes by using test tools or databases.

  • Follow and complete Test Cases / Checklists to perform targeted testing and execute relevant testing processes and procedures.

  • Write bug descriptions based on company standards and client specifications.

  • Apply knowledge of user preferences in Target Market to influence the client’s product.

  • Proactively look for gaps in test coverage.

  • Collaborate with partner teams in testing the product.

  • Offer constructive feedback on gameplay, fun factor, and game balance based on knowledge of target market.

  • Complete all other tasks that are deemed appropriate for the role.

Requirements

Essential skills and experience:

  • A regular game player and passion for the video games industry.

  • Native level of Malay (testing language), including excellent spelling and grammar.

  • Good command of the Simplified Chinese and English language (instructions, testing documentation, team communications will all be in English)

  • Gaming LQA experience.

  • A high school diploma or equivalent is required (a degree in computer science, game design, or a related field is a strong plus).

  • Excellent attention to detail, “can-do” attitude, as well as great work ethic.

  • Excellent interpersonal and written communication skills

  • Ability to multitask, prioritize to meet deadlines.

  • Basic knowledge of the Microsoft Office suite.

  • Understanding of digital technologies (mobile, tablets, browser tools, etc.).

  • The ability to work well in a team environment.

  • The drive, positive attitude, and ability to thrive and deliver in a fast-paced, innovative, and creative environment.

Bonus if you have:

  • Availability to start immediately.

  • Game Testing experience.

  • Experience with software localization or quality assurance, or in a similar role in the Video Games or related industry, will be an advantage.

  • Familiarity with different testing methodologies.

  • Experience with game localization.

  • Familiarity with bug tracking systems (e.g., JIRA, Mantis, ADO, Bugzilla, etc.) or CAT tools (e.g., SDL Trados, MemoQ, etc.).

job.title: Associate Technical Lead, QA
job.description:
About Integrate

Integrate is a leading B2B SaaS platform that helps enterprise marketing teams drive pipeline and revenue by generating and governing high-quality, compliant leads across channels.

About the Role

As an Associate Tech Lead, QA, you will take end-to-end ownership of quality for one or more products or modules, with a primary focus on manual testing and strong involvement in test strategy, planning, execution, and stakeholder communication. You will be expected to independently run QA for your area—from understanding requirements and designing test approaches, to executing tests, coordinating with global engineering teams, and providing clear, timely updates to management.

This is a highly visible role where you will directly influence release quality and confidence for a platform used by some of the world’s largest companies. The role is based in India (remote), with a primary location of Chennai, India (Remote). You will also partner closely with automation engineers, bringing working knowledge of UI and API automation to keep regression suites effective and up to date.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end QA for one or more modules/projects, from understanding requirements and defining test strategy through to final sign-off on release readiness.
  • Design, review, and execute high-quality manual tests (functional, integration, regression, exploratory) to ensure releases are stable and user-ready.
  • Identify high-value areas for automation and partner with automation engineers to keep UI and API regression suites effective and current.
  • When required, contribute to and extend existing automated tests at UI and API layers using frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Rest Assured, or similar tools.
  • Plan and track test activities, maintain test plans and reports, and provide clear, regular updates on progress, risks, and release readiness to management.
  • Collaborate closely with product, engineering, and support teams on grooming, sprint planning, issue triage, and root cause analysis.
  • Guide and mentor junior QA engineers on test design, execution best practices, and basic automation concepts.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • 5–8 years of experience in software QA with a strong focus on manual testing.
  • Demonstrated experience owning QA for a module or project independently (planning, execution, and reporting) in an Agile/Scrum environment.
  • Strong skills in designing and executing: functional and integration tests, regression and smoke tests, and exploratory and scenario-based testing.
  • Hands-on experience with test management and defect tracking tools (e.g., Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, or similar).
  • Working knowledge of UI and API automation (e.g., Selenium/Playwright/Cypress, Postman/Rest Assured) and at least one scripting language.
  • Experience working with relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) for test data setup and validation.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to clearly articulate status, risks, and technical details to both engineering and management stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter or LoadRunner.
  • Experience with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience in MarTech or AdTech domains.
  • Experience coaching or leading a small QA group within a squad or module.

job.title: Quality Assurance Engineer (m/w/d) - remote DE
job.description:
kurzbeschreibung

Als Quality Assurance Engineer (m/w/d) bist Du ein zentraler Bestandteil unseres SAP-Entwicklungsteams und stellst sicher, dass unsere Softwarelösungen entlang des gesamten Entwicklungszyklus höchsten Qualitätsstandards entsprechen. Dabei liegt Dein Fokus auf technischer Qualitätssicherung und Testautomatisierung. Du gestaltest Qualität aktiv mit, identifizierst Risiken frühzeitig und entwickelst unsere QA-Strategie und Qualitätsprozesse kontinuierlich weiter.

deine aufgaben

Du entwickelst und verantwortest ganzheitliche Teststrategien - von automatisierten Tests über exploratives Testen bis hin zu UI-, API- und Integrationstests. Dabei stellst Du sicher, dass Qualität von Anfang an mitgedacht wird, indem Du nach dem Shift-Left-Prinzip arbeitest und dieses durch gezielte Shift-Right-Ansätze wie Monitoring und Observability ergänzt.

Ein wesentlicher Schwerpunkt Deiner Rolle ist die Testautomatisierung. Du entwickelst, erweiterst und wartest automatisierte Tests und Testautomatisierungs-Frameworks und setzt dabei gängige Automatisierungsframeworks für UI- und API-Tests ein.

Du bewegst Dich sicher in technischen Testumgebungen und führst Tests nicht ausschließlich über die Benutzeroberfläche durch. Dazu gehören beispielsweise der Umgang mit Konsole und Developer Tools, das Erstellen und Manipulieren von technischen Testdaten und Stammdaten sowie die technische Eingrenzung und Analyse von Fehlern. Auch API- und Schnittstellentests gehören zu Deinem Aufgabenbereich.

Im Austausch mit Anforderungsstellern und der Entwicklung begleitest Du den gesamten agilen Entwicklungsprozess - von Refinements bis hin zu Abnahmetests. Dabei bringst Du deine QA-Perspektive frühzeitig ein, hinterfragst Anforderungen hinsichtlich Testbarkeit und Vollständigkeit und identifizierst selbstständig Risiken und Edge Cases.

Darüber hinaus bist Du verantwortlich für den Aufbau und die Pflege von Testrepositories und Testdaten und führst regelmäßig Regressionstests durch. Du treibst die Weiterentwicklung unserer QA-Prozesse aktiv voran und stellst sicher, dass technische Qualitätsanforderungen nachhaltig berücksichtigt werden.

Du bringst Dich auch über klassische funktionale Tests hinaus in moderne QA-Themen ein. Dazu gehören ein grundlegendes Verständnis für Performance- und Security-Tests sowie moderne Security-Ansätze wie Threat Modelling.

Als Qualitätsbotschafter innerhalb des Teams teilst Du Best Practices und förderst aktiv eine nachhaltige Qualitätskultur. KI-gestützte Ansätze wie automatisierte Testfallgenerierung oder Self-Healing-Tests behältst Du dabei als mögliche Weiterentwicklung unserer QA-Landschaft im Blick.

Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und mindestens Englisch Kenntnisse auf B2 Niveau runden dein Profil ab und machen dich zur idealen Verstärkung für unser Team.

dein profil

Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Quality Assurance Engineer (m/w/d) oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle und bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in modernen Testmethoden und Softwareentwicklungsprozessen mit. Eine ISTQB-Zertifizierung (mindestens Foundation Level) ist für diese Position erforderlich, weiterführende Zertifizierungen sind ein Plus.

Praktische Erfahrung mit Testautomatisierung ist eine zentrale Voraussetzung für diese Position. Du hast Erfahrung mit gängigen Automatisierungsframeworks und kannst automatisierte Tests für UI und APIs eigenständig erstellen, weiterentwickeln und warten.

Du verfügst über ein gutes technisches Verständnis und kannst Dich selbstständig in technischen Umgebungen bewegen. Der Umgang mit Konsole und Developer Tools, das Erstellen und Manipulieren technischer Test- und Stammdaten sowie die technische Fehleranalyse und -eingrenzung sind für Dich selbstverständlich. Auch mit API- und Schnittstellentests bist Du vertraut.

Du verstehst QA nicht als reine Testausführung, sondern als aktive Mitgestaltung von Qualität. Du hinterfragst Anforderungen, erkennst selbstständig Risiken und Edge Cases und bringst Dich bereits in Refinements ein, um Testbarkeit, Vollständigkeit und Qualitätsrisiken frühzeitig zu berücksichtigen.

Du bist mit agilen Arbeitsweisen wie Scrum oder Kanban vertraut und hast ein gutes Verständnis für Softwareentwicklungsprozesse. Deine Arbeitsweise ist analytisch, strukturiert und eigenständig und Du kommunizierst sicher mit unterschiedlichen Anforderungsstellern und der Entwicklung.

Idealerweise bringst Du zusätzlich grundlegende SAP-Kenntnisse, Erfahrung mit Performance- oder Security-Tests sowie mit Monitoring- und Observability-Ansätzen mit. Ein grundlegendes Verständnis moderner Security-Ansätze, beispielsweise Threat Modelling, ist ein Plus.

Du interessierst Dich für die Weiterentwicklung moderner QA-Methoden und hast ein Interesse daran, KI-gestützte Testansätze perspektivisch weiterzuentwickeln.

warum wir?

Warum wir?
Gemeinsam Zukunft gestalten: sicher, nachhaltig und voller Möglichkeiten!
Was PROLOGIANER ausmacht?

Teamgeist, Gestaltungsspielraum und der Wille, mit Technologie echte Veränderungen zu schaffen. Wir brennen für smarte Lösungen mit echtem Umweltnutzen und jede Menge Begeisterung gehört für uns einfach dazu.

Wir sind seit über 20 Jahren erfolgreich am Markt, SAP-Partner – und weiter auf Wachstumskurs. Das heißt für dich:Gestaltungsfreiheit, spannende Perspektiven und jede Menge Raum, um gemeinsam zu wachsen und deine Stärken einzubringen.

🌱 Humildade para aprender — reconhecemos que nunca partimos do zero, aprendemos uns com os outros e sabemos que grandes conquistas não são construídas sozinhas.

Mais do que competências técnicas, buscamos pessoas que se identifiquem com esse jeito de fazer acontecer. Pessoas que tenham vontade de aprender, coragem para inovar, respeito para construir junto e atitude para transformar.

Ser a principal referência técnica e de pessoas em Qualidade e Testes, garantindo o desenvolvimento dos profissionais, a evolução das competências e a excelência das práticas de QA.

A posição também terá papel importante na definição de estratégias, governança e alocação dos profissionais de acordo com as necessidades de cada projeto e cliente.

  • Domínio de testes funcionais, regressão, integração e End-to-End (E2E);

  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação como Selenium, Cypress, Playwright e/ou RestAssured;
  • Experiência com automação e testes de APIs;
  • Conhecimentos em testes de performance e carga, utilizando ferramentas como JMeter e/ou k6;

  • Capacidade para definir padrões, frameworks e conduzir governança técnica de qualidade;

Buscamos uma liderança que combine profundidade técnica em QA, visão estratégica e gestão de pessoas, com capacidade para desenvolver talentos e elevar a maturidade de qualidade dos projetos.

Monday – Friday 8:00 am – 5:00 pm
