job.title: Senior Software Developer in Test (SDET)
job.description:
Hey there! We're AKKO!

Our mission is to protect the devices the world relies on by relentlessly innovating to deliver an unparalleled digital insurance experience. AKKO enables partners and their end-users with modern and seamless protection solutions. We've become the #1 ranked provider in our space with industry- leading reviews and NPS scores.

With rapid growth and a fully remote team fueled by passion, innovation, and collaboration, we’re just getting started. Our investors—led by Mundi, Fika, and Pear—bring the same conviction that helped power companies like Doordash, Gusto, wefox, and Pipe.

We are seeking a Senior Software Developer in Test (SDET) to focus on our automation and manual testing of the suite of software products that we offer to customers. The candidate will be required to carry out tests to ensure the software we’re building addresses the business requirements and provides user friendly experience to our customers. The primary role is heavy on writing automated tests, maintaining them and triaging failures. This role will also include manual testing work for newer initiatives.

THE DAY-TO-DAY

  • Define risk-based test plans and acceptance criteria in partnership with Product/Engineering; translate user stories into clear test cases.
  • Build and maintain automated tests (Cypress/TypeScript preferred) across E2E, integration, and API layers; create reusable utilities/page objects and stabilize flaky tests.
  • Implement and own CI/CD test gates (smoke/regression) with parallelization and clear pass/fail signals; track coverage and test health metrics.
  • Perform targeted manual/exploratory testing for new features, edge cases, and UX flows; drive regression for critical paths.
  • Create and manage test data, mocks/fixtures, and environment configurations to keep tests deterministic and fast.
  • Coordinate with engineers to reproduce, triage, and debug issues using logs/metrics/trace tools; verify fixes and prevent regressions.
  • Own post-deploy smoke testing and release sign-off for web apps and mobile apps; document results and risks.
  • Continuously improve the QA/SDET toolchain and practices (coding standards, coverage goals, flake budgets, reporting dashboards).

WHAT MAKES YOU QUALIFIED

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Software or related field (advanced degrees a plus).
  • 5+ years in software testing with strong grounding in functional/regression and modern test design techniques (BC, EP, pairwise, etc.).
  • Hands-on experience testing web applications and mobile apps end-to-end, including UX/UAT and bug verification across browsers/devices.
  • 3+ years focused on test automation, including designing scalable frameworks and CI integration.
  • Proficiency with Cypress (preferred) and JavaScript/TypeScript; experience with API testing (Postman/Newman, supertest, REST/GraphQL) and at least one additional tool (Playwright/WebdriverIO/Jest/Mocha).
  • Comfortable with CI/CD (GitHub Actions/CircleCI/GitLab), Git, and basic Docker; familiarity with env management and secrets.
  • Strong analytical skills; fluency with SDLC/Agile and tooling (Atlassian suite or similar).
  • Ability to produce clear documentation (test plans, traceability, results) and communicate risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests (unit/integration/E2E) with a focus on reliability and maintainability.
  • Experience with Cypress specifically (selectors, fixtures, commands, intercepts, parallelization).

The position disclosed is a contract position looking to be filled immediately. The contractor will be expected to work during EST hours 9 AM - 5 PM EST (New York, USA).

This position is open to international applicants.

WHAT ELSE ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

Our team is fostered around our core values:

  • Embrace Relentless Ownership
  • Move Fast, Build Smart
  • Win Together
  • Focus On Outcomes, Not Activity
  • Earn Trust Every Day

job.title: Sr Manager, QA Engineering
job.description:
Company Description

At Amwell, we’re transforming healthcare for all—powered by technology and inspired by people. Here, your ideas don’t just matter—they drive real change, improving lives on a global scale.

We marry technology and innovation with clinical excellence to provide trusted solutions that solve the healthcare industry’s biggest pain points and are on a mission to enable greater access to more convenient, affordable, and effective care.

We do this through our technology-enabled care platform that is designed to help our clients achieve their digital care ambitions – today and in the future. We offer programs spanning the full care continuum, including urgent, acute and specialty care, behavioral health, and services for the treatment of chronic conditions such as heart and cardiometabolic diseases. Programs are powered by Amwell as well as our growing partner network.

For almost two decades, Amwell has proudly served some of the largest and most sophisticated healthcare organizations in the U.S. and worldwide. Our team is passionate about technology’s role in transforming care delivery and making it more equitable, accessible, efficient, cost-effective and navigable for all.

Brief Overview

The Senior Manager, QA Engineering is a Quality Engineering leader responsible for developing people, advancing engineering quality practices, and driving scalable quality capabilities across the organization. This leader owns the strategy, roadmap, and outcomes of the QA Tools practice, including automation frameworks, CI/CD quality enablement, and quality insights, while leading and developing Quality Engineers supporting product teams.

Through strong technical leadership, data-driven decision making, and cross-functional partnership, this role helps build shared ownership of quality and enables teams to deliver reliable, high-quality experiences for our customers.

You are a strategic, proactive leader who creates clarity from ambiguity and takes ownership of outcomes. You understand technology deeply enough to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, and guide experienced engineers without needing to be the person writing the code.

You build strong relationships and know how to garner buy-in without requiring consensus. You communicate the “why,” listen to different perspectives, make thoughtful trade-offs, and move teams toward clear decisions.

You are pragmatic and adaptable. You favor simple, scalable, and standardized solutions over unnecessary complexity while recognizing where innovation, including AI, can meaningfully improve how teams work.

Core Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop Quality Engineers, building an empowered and accountable team through clear expectations, feedback, recognition, career development, and performance management.
  • Own the QA Tools strategy, roadmap, and priorities in alignment with broader Quality Engineering and Engineering goals.
  • Drive the technical direction of Quality Engineering capabilities, including scalable automation frameworks, CI/CD quality practices, and quality gates...
  • Provide technical leadership across automation, CI/CD, and AI-enabled engineering by setting direction, evaluating approaches, challenging assumptions, and guiding experienced technical engineers without being the primary hands-on implementer.
  • Evolve quality metrics and reporting to provide actionable insights, connect quality practices to key outcomes, identify risk, and enable data-driven decisions.
  • Build trusted relationships across Engineering, Product, and QA leadership; engage stakeholders early, communicate the “why,” and build buy-in for quality practices and organizational change.
  • Partner with QA leadership to define and evolve Quality Engineering standards, driving adoption and measurable outcomes across Engineering teams.
  • Develop a strong working understanding of the product, customer workflows, and team ownership to effectively lead team members, identify quality risks, and reinforce shared ownership of quality.
  • Translate organizational direction into clear priorities and trade-offs, independently managing execution, risks, dependencies, and change while favoring pragmatic, scalable solutions and adapting as needs evolve.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • Proven track record of leading, developing, and empowering Quality Engineering or software engineering teams, including experienced technical contributors.
  • Strong foundation in modern Quality Engineering, including test automation best practices, CI/CD pipelines, automated quality gates, and scalable testing approaches.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, cross-team initiatives from strategy through adoption and measurable outcomes.
  • Strategic and data-driven problem solver who can establish priorities, navigate ambiguity, evaluate outcomes, and adapt direction when needed.
  • Strong communicator and influencer who builds trusted relationships, explains complex concepts clearly, and creates buy-in across teams and levels.
  • Experience in healthcare technology or another regulated software environment is a plus.

Do Well. Live Well. At Amwell.

Driven by our mission and values, we foster a workplace where Delivering Awesome, being Customer First and operating as One Team aren’t just aspirations – they are how we work, every day.

Our people are our greatest asset. We strive to empower their growth and development not only as Amwellians but as individuals, through generous total rewards packages, a virtual-first work environment, work-life flexibility, including Summer Fridays and designated Mental Health Days, as well as opportunities to stretch and learn – to name a few. It’s our people who truly differentiate us. Ask anyone and they’ll tell you – you’ll never work with more passionate, more driven and more caring team members.

We champion a culture of respect and inclusion, accountability and integrity, innovation and collaboration. At Amwell, you’ll do the most meaningful work of your career—improving healthcare for millions, growing alongside incredible teammates, and being valued for who you are.

Benefits

  • Flexible Personal Time Off (Vacation time)
  • 401K match
  • Competitive healthcare, dental and vision insurance plans
  • Paid Parental Leave (Maternity and Paternity leave)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Program
  • Free access to Amwell’s Telehealth Services, SilverCloud and The Clinic by Cleveland Clinic’s second opinion program
  • Free Subscription to the Calm App
  • Tuition Assistance Program
  • Pet Insurance

job.title: Senior QA Engineer - AI
job.description:
About the Company

At Delta, we are reimagining and rebuilding the financial system. Join our team to make a positive impact on the future of finance.

🎯 Mission Driven: Re-imagine and rebuild the future of finance.

💡 Most innovative cryptocurrency derivatives exchange. With a daily traded volume of ~$ 10 billion, and increasing. Delta is bigger than all the Indian crypto exchanges combined.

📈 Offer the widest range of derivative products and have been serving traders all over the globe since 2018 and growing fast.

💪🏻 The founding team is comprised of IIT and ISB graduates. Business co-founders have previously worked with Citibank, UBS and GIC; and our tech co-founder is a serial entrepreneur who previously co-founded TinyOwl andHousing.com.

💰 Funded by top crypto funds (Sino Global Capital, CoinFund, Gumi Cryptos) and crypto projects (Aave and Kyber Network).

Senior QA Engineer - AI

🎯 Role Overview

Delta operates three AI products used by live traders: a customer support chatbot, an API Copilot that generates and executes trading scripts, and an MCP server. This role owns the quality of those products and is responsible for measuring it objectively.

Testing probabilistic systems differs fundamentally from testing deterministic ones. The same input produces different output on every run, an incorrect answer can be entirely fluent, and a prompt change in one flow can degrade another without any visible signal. The core of this role is establishing what correct means for these systems, building the datasets and scoring that measure it, and operating the release gate that prevents a regression from reaching customers.

This is an emerging discipline with no established playbook. We are defining the methodology as we build it, and the role carries a high degree of autonomy and ownership.

🔬 What Sets This Role Apart

Most QA roles that mention AI mean using AI to do testing faster: generating test cases from a PRD, healing flaky selectors, exploring an app with an agent. Those are useful and we do them.

This role is the other thing. The system under test is itself an AI, and the hard problem is deciding whether its output is correct when the same question produces a different answer every time and a wrong answer reads as convincingly as a right one. That means building evaluation datasets, defining what correct looks like, scoring against it, and defending a number that decides whether a release ships.

If you have spent time on the second problem, this role is built for you.

🛠 Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain golden datasets for our AI products, trace mined from production or generated, and verified against a documented source of truth.
  • Design layered scoring for AI outputs: deterministic rules where behaviour can be asserted, and model-graded evaluation where it cannot.
  • Manage evaluation runs end to end: schedule and execute them against release candidates, compare results against prior baselines, and triage failures into product defects, incorrect expectations, and platform issues.
  • Own and operate the release gate that determines whether a prompt or model change is approved for production.
  • Identify failure modes ahead of customers, including hallucination, incorrect tool selection, loss of context across conversation turns, and PII exposure.
  • Investigate production traces to distinguish retrieval failures from generation failures from tool failures.
  • Convert findings into actionable engineering evidence and into permanent regression coverage.
  • Define and report quality metrics for AI surfaces, and drive improvement against them.

✅ Requirements

Non-negotiable

  • At least 1 year owning quality for AI products in a lead or primary-owner capacity. This includes chatbots and conversational assistants, code or content generation products, and agentic systems. You should have worked directly with prompts, tool and function schemas, and model behaviour, rather than testing around them.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience building or operating an evaluation harness for an AI system, whether in-house or using a framework such as DeepEval, RAGAS or Promptfoo. You should be able to describe what the harness measured, the results it produced, and the decisions those results informed.

Also required

  • 4-6 years of QA / SDET experience.
  • Working proficiency in Python. Our evaluation platform, trace analysis and internal tooling are Python-based.
  • Ability to analyse traces and tool calls, using observability tooling such as Opik, Langfuse or LangSmith or an equivalent, to determine root cause rather than reporting the symptom.
  • Strong API testing experience. The majority of the surface under test is API-level.
  • Sufficient engineering ability to build your own tooling and automation.
  • Clear written communication. Findings must be documented in a form engineering can act on directly.

Bonus

  • Experience with trading or exchange platforms, including familiarity with futures and options, crypto derivatives, margin, or settlement flows. Domain knowledge can be picked up on the job, but arriving with it shortens the ramp considerably.

🚀 Why Join Us?

  • Play a pivotal role in shaping the regulatory landscape for digital assets and Web3 in India.
  • Work directly with founders and senior leadership on high-impact strategic initiatives.
  • Be part of a mission-driven, fast-growing organisation at the forefront of financial innovation.
  • Competitive compensation, leadership exposure, and significant growth opportunities.

job.title: Software Quality Assurance Manager
job.description:
Overview

World Travel Holdings is seeking an experienced Quality Engineering & Test Automation Manager to lead a blended Quality Engineering team and build an AI-enabled, automation-first quality capability for World Travel Holdings (WTH). In this role, you will modernize testing tools and processes, design scalable automation and agentic quality workflows, mentor engineers across manual, exploratory, and automated testing disciplines, and partner closely with Product Management, Business Analysis, Engineering, Architecture, and DevOps teams to improve requirement quality, developer feedback cycles, release readiness, platform resiliency, and business outcomes across the software development lifecycle.

About the Company

World Travel Holdings, headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, FL, is the nation’s largest cruise agency and an award‑winning leisure travel company with nearly 40 travel brands. Through owned brands and private‑label partnerships, we sell cruises, villas, resort day passes, and luxury travel services. With a top-rated franchise, a UK cruise division, and a strong commitment to employee engagement and remote work, World Travel Holdings offers a people-focused culture. Learn more: WorldTravelHoldings.com

Responsibilities

Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a blended Quality Engineering team spanning manual, exploratory, regression, API, performance, accessibility, and automated testing.
  • Manage Quality Engineering team capacity, priorities, and delivery across active initiatives while simplifying, standardizing, and modernizing team processes.
  • Establish an onboarding process that helps Quality Engineering team members ramp quickly and consistently.
  • Build strong working partnerships across Product Management, Business Analysis, Engineering, Architecture, DevOps, and Quality Engineering to establish shared ownership of quality throughout planning, design, development, delivery, and operation.

Automation Framework Strategy

  • Own the design, implementation, and ongoing evolution of a modern, scalable automation framework supporting web, mobile, accessibility, API, integration, performance, and regression testing.
  • Define the automation framework architecture, technical standards, tool selection criteria, coding patterns, and governance practices needed to create a consistent enterprise Quality Engineering approach.
  • Assess existing Quality Engineering tools, test suites, environments, and processes to identify modernization, consolidation, and automation opportunities.
  • Build a roadmap for migrating current testing practices into the future-state automation framework, balancing near-term delivery needs with long-term scalability and maintainability.
  • Partner with Engineering and Architecture teams to ensure Quality Engineering strategies, automation frameworks, test environments, and quality controls support modernization initiatives, cloud readiness, platform resiliency, and long-term technical health.

AI-Enabled Quality Engineering Transformation

  • Develop responsible adoption standards, measurement practices, and team skills for applying AI across Quality Engineering.
  • Design and evolve agentic Quality Engineering workflows that improve consistency, accelerate feedback, and reduce repetitive work while maintaining appropriate engineering oversight.
  • Lead adoption of AI-assisted test generation, execution, maintenance, optimization, coverage analysis, and quality insight capabilities.
  • Establish and communicate an AI-first Quality Engineering vision aligned with the broader Software Engineering transformation strategy.

Delivery Integration and Shift-Left Quality

  • Partner with Product Management and Business Analysts to improve requirement quality, acceptance criteria, maturity, testability, and shared understanding of business risk before development begins.
  • Advance shift-left quality practices by involving Quality Engineering earlier in discovery, refinement, solution design, and delivery planning.
  • Work across Product Management, Business Analysis, Engineering, Architecture, and DevOps to define risk-based quality strategies that connect business expectations, technical design, test coverage, operational readiness, and release decisions.
  • Partner with Engineering and DevOps teams to embed reliable automated test execution, quality gates, environment readiness checks, and actionable reporting into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Ensure appropriate test coverage across functional, regression, performance, load, accessibility, API, and integration testing.
  • Drive adoption of automation-first quality practices that reduce reliance on repetitive manual regression testing while preserving the value of exploratory, risk-based, and customer-focused testing.

Engineering Productivity and Business Outcomes

  • Connect Quality Engineering priorities and reporting to customer experience, franchise experience, agent productivity, release confidence, and platform stability and reliability.
  • Partner with engineering leaders to identify quality improvements that increase development throughput and support faster, more confident release cycles.
  • Reduce developer feedback cycles by improving quality visibility earlier in the software development lifecycle and making results timely, reliable, and actionable.

Quality Metrics and Continuous Improvement

  • Establish quality metrics and framework health reporting to track automation coverage, test effectiveness, execution reliability, defect trends, and release readiness.
  • Develop quality insights that help teams evaluate requirement readiness, acceptance criteria for maturity, automation effectiveness, release confidence, platform resiliency, and recurring indicators of technical health.
  • Evaluate emerging Quality Engineering and AI technologies to improve test creation, execution, maintenance, coverage analysis, developer experience, and quality reporting.
  • Manage resource allocation, planning, and delivery of automation framework initiatives, test modernization, and Quality Engineering improvements.
  • Advocate for modern, AI-first Quality Engineering practices across every stage of the software development lifecycle, and help engineering teams build the skills and operating practices needed to adopt them responsibly.
  • Use quality, productivity, and technical-health insights to identify improvement opportunities, communicate progress, and guide investment decisions across Product and Software Engineering.
  • Define transformation-oriented measures, including manual testing effort, automation adoption, AI testing adoption, engineering throughput, defect escape trends, release cycle speed, and deployment confidence.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in Quality Engineering, software testing, or test automation, including 2+ years in a leadership or management role.
  • Deep hands-on experience designing, implementing, maintaining, and scaling test automation frameworks, including framework architecture, reusable components, coding standards, governance practices, and the practical application of AI-assisted Quality Engineering capabilities.
  • Proficiency in Java, Python, JavaScript, or a similar programming language, with the ability to guide automation of code quality, maintainability, and reusable framework design.
  • Experience integrating automated tests, quality gates, framework health checks, and reporting into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Demonstrated ability to modernize legacy Quality Engineering tools, consolidate fragmented testing approaches, and guide teams toward a future-state automation framework.
  • Demonstrated experience advancing shift-left quality practices through early collaboration on requirements, acceptance criteria, solution design, testability, and delivery risk.
  • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery, the software testing lifecycle, and how Quality Engineering practices support product delivery and release readiness.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and leadership skills, with the ability to influence technical direction, explain framework and quality tradeoffs, and align Product Management, Business Analysis, Engineering, Architecture, DevOps, and Quality Engineering stakeholders around modernization priorities, business risk, and quality outcomes.
  • Experience evaluating or implementing AI-assisted software engineering or Quality Engineering capabilities, including test generation, test maintenance, coverage analysis, release readiness, or agentic workflows preferred.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and containerization technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes a plus.
  • Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, or Locust; security testing practices; test management platforms such as TestRail or Zephyr; API mocking; service-level API testing; SQL queries; and database testing across SQL and NoSQL databases preferred.
  • Travel industry experience ideal.

job.title: Senior QA Engineer (Manual & Automation)
job.description:
Salla is looking for a Senior QA Engineer to take ownership of product quality across our platform. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring that every release meets our quality standards, and you will be accountable for making informed go/no-go release decisions based on risk and test results.

You will be expected to define the most suitable QA approach for our product and teams, including the testing strategy, tools, standards, and workflows. This approach should be flexible, not rigid: you will adapt the depth, type, and process of testing to fit each situation, whether it's an urgent hotfix, a major feature launch, or a high-risk change.

This is a hands-on role covering both manual and automated testing. You will work closely with engineering, product, and DevOps teams to review requirements, define test strategies, perform manual and exploratory testing, and build reliable test automation using Playwright.

Beyond identifying and resolving defects, you will analyze their root causes and implement preventive measures to reduce recurring issues.

Responsibilities

  • Own quality end to end, building it in early through requirement reviews, design discussions, and test strategy, through to the final go/no-go call on releases
  • Define and continuously refine the QA approach, including testing standards, workflows, tools, and quality metrics. Adapt testing depth, process, and priorities to risk, timeline, and context rather than applying a one-size-fits-all process
  • Decide what needs testing, how deeply, and with which approach (functional, regression, API, UI, performance, security, usability). Decide what stays manual and what gets automated, and know when enough is enough
  • Perform thorough manual and exploratory testing on new features, finding what scripts miss: edge cases, unexpected user behavior, UX problems, and the UI details users notice (layout, states, responsiveness)
  • Build and maintain Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript) automation that runs in CI, catches real issues instead of just adding to a test count, and gives the team fast, trustworthy feedback
  • Review code and pull requests properly: read them, question them, and push back when something isn't right
  • Triage defects and investigate them in depth using browser DevTools (network, console, performance, storage) to find root causes, not just symptoms, and help the team prioritize what matters most
  • Prevent recurring issues by identifying the pattern behind bugs, analyzing defect trends, and putting safeguards in place (tests, checks, process changes). Think ahead about how new features, scale, and changes will affect quality
  • Use AI tools thoughtfully to speed up test creation, analysis, and debugging, and build AI-assisted workflows where they add value, while always validating the output
  • Communicate risks clearly to developers, product managers, and leadership, with a recommendation rather than just a report
  • Take initiative to spot gaps in our processes, tools, or product and drive improvements, while mentoring other QA engineers and raising the quality mindset across the team

Requirements

  • 5+ years of QA experience with real ownership of releases and quality decisions
  • Strong experience in both manual and automated testing, and the judgment to balance the two
  • Solid JavaScript and TypeScript skills, enough to write clean, maintainable Playwright automation and read application code with confidence
  • Hands-on experience with Playwright (or strong experience with a similar framework plus a willingness to go deep on Playwright)
  • Strong command of Git and GitHub: branching, pull requests, code reviews, and working within CI pipelines
  • Deep understanding of testing types, techniques, and test design, and the judgment to choose the right one
  • Flexibility to adjust your approach to different situations, avoiding rigid processes while keeping quality standards high
  • Experience testing web, mobile, and APIs
  • Comfort with browser DevTools for debugging and investigation
  • Practical experience using AI in your work, and the critical thinking to know when to trust it and when not to
  • A preventive mindset: you've fixed problems at their root, not just patched symptoms, and can give examples

Join our award-winning team in transforming an essential industry that powers communities across the Americas.

We are looking for a Senior SDET to help build our test automation from the ground up. You will design the framework, write the automated tests that give us confidence to ship, and bring modern AI-assisted tooling into how we work. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who codes like a developer but is driven by quality.

You will be one of the first engineers on a new team, so the patterns you set will shape how the whole organization tests. You will work closely with the QA Engineering Manager and with developers across product squads.

In your first 90 days, the automation framework will be in place, with a proof-of-concept suite running in CI on our highest-risk flows. By six months, you'll have meaningful automated coverage of critical user journeys, a low flaky-test rate, and faster feedback on every change. Ongoing, you'll maintain a trusted, maintainable suite: applying AI tooling where it genuinely saves time, with other engineers picking up the patterns you set.

What You Will Do

  • Design and build the test automation framework and the standards other engineers will follow.
  • Write and maintain automated tests across the stack: API, integration, and end-to-end UI.
  • Prioritize automation by risk and value, favoring fast, reliable API-level tests over brittle UI tests where possible.
  • Integrate tests into CI/CD so they run automatically on every change and give fast feedback.
  • Drive down flakiness and keep the suite trustworthy, so failures mean something.
  • Evaluate and apply AI-assisted testing tools (test generation, self-healing tests, failure triage), and use AI and prompt engineering to accelerate test creation and edge-case discovery.
  • Review AI-generated tests and code with a critical eye (you are the human-in-the-loop, not a rubber stamp).
  • Mentor other engineers on automation practices and help raise testing quality across squads

What You Bring

  • 5+ years in software test automation or software engineering with a strong testing focus.
  • Strong coding skills in at least one of: Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript.
  • Deep experience with a modern automation framework (Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium) including building or owning a framework, not just writing tests inside one.
  • Solid API testing experience (Postman, REST Assured, or similar) and comfort with SQL and database validation.
  • Hands-on experience integrating tests into CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Working knowledge of cloud (AWS) and containers (Docker).
  • A pragmatic, risk-based mindset and the judgement to know what's worth automating.
  • Experience using AI coding assistants or AI test-generation tools in real work (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar), with a clear view of their strengths and limits.
  • Comfort writing effective prompts to generate test ideas, edge cases, and to analyze failures.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Claude and Claude Code.
  • Experience setting up test automation from scratch on a team that had little automation before.
  • Performance testing (k6 / JMeter) or security testing exposure.
  • Experience in a regulated or high-reliability domain (utilities, fintech, healthcare, or similar.

At Enverus, we're committed to empowering the global quality of life by helping our customers make energy affordable and accessible to the world.

Of course, this wouldn't be possible without our people, which is why we have built a team of individuals from a diverse range of backgrounds.

Are you ready to help power the global quality of life? Join Enverus, and be a part of creating a brighter, more sustainable tomorrow.

SBS, an Enverus company, is seeking a Test Automation Engineer to join the Distribution Tools team, reporting to Matthew Rickard, Director of Software Development. This is a dedicated, 100%-automation-focused role: your mandate is to convert our existing manual regression coverage into reliable automated tests, building on our existing investment in T-Plan Robot for image-based desktop and CAD GUI automation.

A core part of this role is applying AI tools to the hardest part of test automation — writing and maintaining the tests themselves — while building in the validation steps needed to keep AI-assisted tests repeatable and trustworthy, not just fast to produce.

This role starts embedded in Distribution Tools, but it is designed to grow: the frameworks, practices, and tooling you build are expected to extend across SBS's broader desktop application portfolio (AUD, ABD, DDS, P4A/P4I, and the SDS suite) as the practice matures, and your remit will expand accordingly over time.

What you will do

Test Automation & Coverage

  • Own automation of existing manual regression test suites for Distribution Tools products, using T-Plan Robot as the primary automation engine for CAD-based desktop GUI testing.
  • Design and implement automated test frameworks and reusable patterns for desktop and Revit-integrated applications.
  • Execute automated test suites, analyze failures, and document defects with clear reproduction steps.
  • Maintain and continuously improve test automation infrastructure and its integration with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps).

AI-Assisted Test

  • Authoring Evaluate and apply AI/LLM tools to accelerate the authoring and maintenance of GUI test scripts.
  • Build generate-then-validate workflows so AI-assisted test creation produces repeatable, trustworthy regression coverage rather than brittle, one-off scripts.
  • Document what works, and what doesn't, so the approach can be adopted by other teams.
  • Collaboration & Process Partner with developers and product owners across Distribution Tools to prioritize the highest-value regression scenarios to automate first.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives) as an embedded member of the Distribution Tools team.
  • Provide feedback on code quality and testability during code reviews.

Reporting & Growth

  • Track and report on automation coverage, defect trends, and time saved to build the business case for expanding the practice.
  • As the practice matures, extend frameworks and mentorship to test engineers on other desktop product teams (Substation Tools, GTI).

What skills you should have

  • 5+ years of combined experience in manual and automated testing of desktop or engineering software
  • Hands-on experience with T-Plan Robot or a comparable image/OCR-based GUI automation tool for desktop applications
  • Practical, applied experience using AI and LLM tools in a development or QA workflow, able to speak to both productivity gains and repeatability risks
  • Proficiency in at least one general-purpose test automation framework, such as NUnit, Selenium, or WinAppDriver
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, such as GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps

Skills that stand out

  • Familiarity with Autodesk Revit, AutoCAD, or Inventor and their automation APIs
  • Experience standing up a test automation practice from a limited existing base, rather than extending a mature one
  • Background in utility, energy, or infrastructure engineering software

Our Technology Stack

T-Plan Robot, NUnit, Selenium, WinAppDriver, SQL, Postman, Swagger, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Autodesk Revit, AutoCAD, Inventor

job.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
job.description:
At BusRight, we're transforming an industry that has relied on outdated systems for far too long. School transportation is a critical part of everyday life for millions of students and families, yet much of the industry still depends on fragmented, manual processes.

We’re building a modern transportation platform that makes school buses safer, smarter, and more efficient for students, families, schools, and communities nationwide.

Our product ecosystem spans web, mobile, backend, mapping, real-time systems, and integrations. As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer, you’ll take a leading role in ensuring the reliability, performance, and overall quality of that ecosystem.

This role goes beyond executing test cases. You’ll help define how we approach quality, identify risks before they become customer problems, investigate complex production issues, improve automation and tooling, and influence engineering practices across teams.

Why This Role Matters

You’ll join an established QA function and help take it to the next level.

We’re looking for someone who can operate independently, make sound quality and risk decisions, and act as a trusted technical partner to engineering and product teams.

You’ll work across the entire development lifecycle—from requirements and technical design through implementation, release, production monitoring, and incident investigation.

You’ll be expected to question assumptions, uncover difficult edge cases, identify systemic quality risks, and improve how we test and ship software.

This is a hands-on senior role. You’ll still test products directly, but you’ll also help shape test strategy, automation, tooling, processes, and quality standards across the organization.

What You’ll Do

Own Quality Across Complex Product Areas

  • Take ownership of quality for complex features and product areas across Web, Android, and Flutter applications.
  • Define appropriate test strategies based on technical complexity, customer impact, risk, and system architecture.
  • Perform exploratory, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing across interconnected systems.
  • Identify edge cases, failure modes, and risks that may not be obvious from product requirements alone.
  • Help teams determine appropriate release confidence and identify gaps before changes reach production.

Investigate Complex Problems

  • Lead investigation of difficult bugs and production issues across frontend, mobile, backend, infrastructure, and third-party integrations.
  • Analyze application logs, network traffic, API requests, database data, monitoring signals, and source code to isolate root causes.
  • Reproduce complex or intermittent issues and provide engineers with clear technical findings.
  • Distinguish symptoms from underlying causes and identify patterns across seemingly unrelated incidents.
  • Build scripts, utilities, or debugging tools when they can accelerate investigation or improve future troubleshooting.

Drive Test Automation and Engineering Quality

  • Design, build, and maintain E2E and integration automation using tools such as Playwright/Maestro/Appium.
  • Identify where automation provides meaningful value and where manual or exploratory testing is more appropriate.
  • Improve automation architecture, reliability, maintainability, and execution speed.
  • Work with engineers to improve testability at the application and system level.
  • Improve automated quality checks on CI/CD workflows.

Influence Engineering and Product Decisions

  • Partner with engineers and product managers during planning and technical design to identify risks early.
  • Challenge unclear requirements, assumptions, and implementation decisions when they introduce unnecessary quality risk.
  • Communicate tradeoffs clearly and help teams make informed release decisions.
  • Represent the customer and operational perspective during technical discussions.
  • Collaborate closely with Support and other customer-facing teams when investigating reported issues.

Improve QA Processes and Quality Culture

  • Identify weaknesses in existing QA processes and propose practical improvements.
  • Improve test documentation, defect reporting, release validation, incident analysis, and quality metrics.
  • Help establish scalable testing practices as the product and engineering organization grow.
  • Share knowledge, provide technical guidance, and help less-experienced QA engineers develop stronger testing and debugging skills.
  • Promote the idea that quality is a shared engineering responsibility rather than something owned only by QA.

Who We’re Looking For

Core Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, Software Engineering in Test, or another strongly technical software quality role.
  • Significant experience testing complex web and mobile applications involving multiple interconnected services.
  • Advanced exploratory testing and risk-analysis skills.
  • Strong experience investigating production issues using logs, APIs, databases, monitoring tools, and other technical signals.
  • Hands-on experience with automated testing frameworks and methodologies.
  • Strong programming and debugging skills—you should be comfortable reading, understanding, and navigating production codebases.
  • Ability to write automation, debugging utilities, scripts, data-analysis tools, or other engineering support tooling when needed.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, client-server architecture, and data flows between services.
  • Strong understanding of the full Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), from requirements analysis and test design through execution, release validation, and production monitoring.
  • Experience working with defect tracking systems and test management practices.
  • Understanding of software security and privacy considerations, including authentication, authorization, data handling, access control, and common OWASP risks.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Experience with mapping, GPS/location systems, real-time applications, or transportation technology is a strong plus.

Technical Background

Experience with some of the following technologies is useful, but expertise in every technology listed is not required. We value strong fundamentals and the ability to quickly understand unfamiliar systems.

  • Web: React, TypeScript
  • APIs & Backend: REST APIs, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Firebase
  • Mobile: Android, Flutter
  • Automation: Playwright, Maestro, Appium
  • Observability & Debugging: Datadog, Sentry, Google Cloud Platform, Proxyman
  • Data & Infrastructure: PostgreSQL, Redis, Firebase Firestore, Google Cloud Platform
  • API tooling: Postman or similar tools
  • Security: OWASP, authentication/authorization concepts, privacy and data-handling practices
  • Delivery: CI/CD pipelines, Agile software development practices
  • Mapping / Location: GPS, geospatial systems, mapping SDKs, routing, or other location-based technologies

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

  • You naturally think in terms of risk, failure modes, and customer impact, not just expected behavior.
  • You are comfortable investigating problems across multiple layers of a system.
  • You can work independently when requirements are incomplete or the problem is poorly understood.
  • You know when deeper investigation is necessary and when additional testing provides diminishing returns.
  • You communicate quality concerns clearly without becoming a bottleneck for delivery.
  • You are comfortable challenging assumptions and advocating for technical improvements.
  • You look for opportunities to eliminate recurring problems rather than repeatedly testing around them.
  • You enjoy building tools and processes that make engineering teams more effective.
  • You balance attention to detail with pragmatic decision-making.

job.title: Senior Test Engineer
job.description:
Why join Upscale, Inc.

Upscale, Inc., is building the high-performance infrastructure powering the next generation of artificial intelligence. Backed by over $300M in funding and rapid global adoption, we are scaling systems designed for the world’s most demanding AI workloads.

We focus on first-principles engineering across silicon, systems, and networking—where performance, scale, and execution are critical. Our team is talent-dense and high-performing. We value ownership, technical rigor, and speed, and we offer the opportunity to work on foundational problems with immediate, real-world impact.

If you’re looking to do high-impact work, move fast, and help define the infrastructure behind the future of AI—Upscale is where you can produce meaningful work at the frontier—and operate at a high standard.

About the job

Be part of a team that pushes boundaries, developing custom silicon solutions that power the future of Upscale AI's direct-to-consumer products. You'll contribute to the innovation behind products loved by millions worldwide. Your expertise will shape the next generation of hardware experiences, delivering unparalleled performance, efficiency, and integration.

Upscale AI’s SOCs are the most advanced in the world. In this role, you will help to manufacture the SoC’s that power these data centers by developing and deploying comprehensive manufacturing test and data analytics solutions for high-volume manufacturing at wafer fabrications and Outsourced Semiconductor Assembly and Tests (OSAT’s). You will have an opportunity to create silicon in the most advanced technologies and follow it into the field to close the loop back to design and test for the next-generation of chips. You will help to integrate SoC technologies into devices and drive manufacturing test flows to assure performance and screen devices. You will drive yield improvement, cost optimization and work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the optimal test coverage in production to ensure high quality SoCs. You will need to have a strong understanding of Integrated Circuit (IC) flows, wafer processing, testing, qualification, diagnostics, and failure analysis. You will work with various groups to deploy screening methodologies and flows for data processing, analytics and diagnostics. You will drive the release of cost-effective production test solutions into mass production to hit yield and quality goals.

Responsibilities

    • Develop and implement high-volume manufacturing strategies for SoC products, optimize ATE/SLT test coverage, reduce Defective parts per million (DPPM) and test costs, and manage product data integration.
    • Accelerate mass production via test program releases, data analytics, lot disposition, test time reduction, yield improvement, and return merchandise authorization (RMA) handling.
    • Partner with cross-functional teams (Test, Quality, Packaging, Operations) to deploy and maintain high-volume manufacturing (HVM) screening solutions.
    • Manage database integration for wafer sort (CP), final test, and SLT, while overseeing test program integration, production release, binning, manufacturing flow definition, NPI material handling, and foundry process optimization.

Qualifications

    • Experience with industry standards, design tools, and design for testing (DFT) best practices, including at-speed transition delay fault (TDF), automatic test pattern generation (ATPG), memory built-in self-test (MBIST), memory repair, diagnostic tools, and yield improvement.
    • Experience with product engineering, supply chain data analytics and diagnostics for High Volume Manufacturing and NPI.
    • Experience evaluating customer returns with ATE and SLT, identifying coverage gaps, developing incremental structural and functional patterns to address quality issues, Statistical analysis (e.g., JMP), Yield Management Systems (e.g., Exensio, YieldExplorer, JMP), and Python for data analytics.
    • Understanding of skew lot definition, data collection, characterization, data analysis and report.
    • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
    • 8 years of experience in product engineering or test engineering.
    • 1 year of experience in people management, developing employees.
    • Experience with product engineering, supply chain data analytics or diagnostics for manufacturing or New Product Introduction (NPI).

Where you fall within that range depends on your experience, skills, and impact—we benchmark against internal levels to keep things fair and consistent.

job.title: Manual QA Engineer
job.description:
Who we are

At Fluxon, we believe that how you build matters as much as what you build. We help businesses navigate their most important technology decisions with confidence, and take responsibility for seeing them through. Founded by ex-Googlers and startup veterans, we’re proud to partner with teams behind some of the most ambitious products, including Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, Walmart and Stripe.

Our work spans strategy, design, and engineering — often in complex, AI-driven environments — where clarity, speed and quality are the standard. We use AI intentionally, applying it only where it adds real value and expands what’s possible. Care shapes everything we do.

Inside Fluxon, you’ll find a global, remote-first team of experienced builders, who are curious, kind and serious about their craft. We’re building a place where people can take ownership, solve problems that matter and do work they’re proud to stand behind. If you want to do your best work alongside people who care as much as you do, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

You are an architect for quality with the vision to define and build QA processes for any sort of app. You can work at any company in the world, but you choose us because you want to use your versatility and "nose for bugs" to solve new and interesting challenges. You are a champion of quality on multi-disciplined teams, blending a deep understanding of user experience with a technical approach to breaking systems.

You are a thought partner to developers and product managers — someone who doesn't just find bugs but identifies systematic gaps. You are brilliant yet humble; a doer with high integrity who takes ownership of quality and enjoys a full life outside of work.

If this sounds like you, we would love to chat!

Note: This position is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in Poland or Portugal.

Key responsibilities

  • Define and evolve the end-to-end QA strategy and processes for entire products, determining the most effective manual techniques to ensure "world-class" standards of quality
  • Plan and perform exploratory and manual testing for complex features, going beyond specifications to ensure the user experience is intuitive and seamless
  • Be the champion and source-of-truth for quality, helping both internal teams and clients identify systematic quality gaps while building processes to close them. Evangelize "quality at the source" across the development lifecycle
  • Own the documentation and reporting of quality metrics and bug tracking, ensuring the product team, engineers, and clients have clear visibility into project health
  • Partner with the PMs and TPMs to define acceptance criteria and manage release approvals
  • Lead cross-functional investigations into complex quality issues, driving them through to resolution with engineering and product teams

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in testing complex web, mobile, and API-based applications
  • 2+ years of experience acting as a sole QA leading a project, with the ability to build a testing strategy from a blank slate
  • A "nose for bugs" and the manual testing skills to break an app in ways a script might miss. You understand user experience as much as code
  • Strong understanding of client-server architecture, modern engineering stacks, and the ability to use DevTools and API clients (like Postman) to perform deep technical audits
  • Practical understanding of how manual testing fits into a modern CI/CD pipeline and the ability to collaborate on release cycles
  • Proficiency at maintaining test documentation and communicating test results to key stakeholders
  • A mindset for risk-based testing, with the ability to clearly articulate technical risks and quality tradeoffs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders
  • A proactive personality who learns quickly while working independently and is always looking for ways to improve the "how" of building software
  • Upper-Intermediate level of written and spoken English

What we offer

  • Remote-first, flexible work with a budget to set up a work space that works for you
  • Localized healthcare coverage to support you and your family’s wellbeing
  • Flexible paid time off with a minimum of 3 weeks per year (plus holidays)
  • "No internal meetings" Fridays, so you can focus on deep, uninterrupted work
  • A professional growth budget for learning that matters to you – whether it’s developing your technical skills or learning a new language
  • A monthly wellness allowance to support your physical and mental health
  • Annual company offsites, where we gather in person to build meaningful connections
  • A competitive salary that reflects your expertise, impact and experience
  • Profit-sharing, so you can benefit directly from the value we build together
  • A paid sabbatical program, designed for rest, renewal and fresh perspective

job.title: Quality Assurance Analyst FTC
job.description:
Flexigrant is one of the specialist software businesses within a portfolio of Fluent Software Group, which is an operating group under Valsoft Corporation, an acquirer of specialist vertical-market software businesses with a long-term, buy-and-hold approach.

Being part of the wider group provides additional stability, expertise and opportunities to collaborate with other specialist software businesses, while allowing Flexigrant to retain its own culture and market focus/ specialist market position.

You will be joining a focused business with its own identity, goals and ambitions, while benefiting from the long-term backing, shared expertise and international network of Fluent Software Group and Valsoft.

Flexigrant is cloud-based grant management software built for organisations that award funding, from community foundations to central government. It replaces spreadsheets and email with a single system covering applications, eligibility, assessment, awards, monitoring, and reporting, with a full audit trail throughout.

The platform replaces disconnected spreadsheets, emails and paper-based processes with one secure, configurable system, giving grant managers a complete and up-to-date view of every programme, application and award. Flexigrant also creates a clear audit trail of actions and decisions, helping organisations maintain transparency and meet their governance and reporting responsibilities.

Trusted by more than 100 organisations worldwide, the platform supports grant programmes of varying sizes and complexity. In the last 12 months alone, more than £6.4 billion in new grant funding was awarded through Flexigrant, demonstrating the important role its technology plays in helping funding reach research, communities and worthwhile causes efficiently.

The Role

As QA Analyst, you will own the quality of what we ship. You will plan and run testing across Flexigrant, from exploratory, functional and regression testing through to building automated tests, working closely with our developers and Product Manager to catch issues early.

This is a hands-on role for a fast learner who enjoys getting to know a complex product in depth. Much of that product knowledge is built on the job, alongside the development team, so a real appetite to learn is essential.

It is also an AI-native role. You will use AI tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot every day to plan, create and maintain tests, grow our automation and help build quality in as Flexigrant modernises. AI fluency will be explored at interview, so be ready to show how you work.

We are remote-first: you will work with colleagues across locations and are trusted to work wherever you are based.

Key Responsibilities

  • You will plan, design and run manual testing across Flexigrant, including exploratory, functional, regression and edge-case testing.
  • You will build and maintain automated tests and help grow our automated test coverage.
  • You will work with developers and the Product Manager to refine requirements and turn them into clear, testable acceptance criteria.
  • You will reproduce and document issues clearly, giving developers concise, actionable feedback so they can resolve them quickly.
  • You will carry out API testing and use SQL to validate data and investigate issues.
  • You will support releases each sprint, balancing planned testing with reactive support, and take part in refinement, sprint planning, stand-ups and retrospectives.
  • You will use AI tooling as a core part of your daily workflow to improve testing processes and speed up delivery.
  • You will share product knowledge across the team and help improve our QA processes and practices.

Key Skills, Knowledge and Abilities

  • 4+ years in a software QA or testing role, ideally within an Agile team.
  • Strong manual testing skills (exploratory, functional, regression and edge-case), including web applications across devices and browsers.
  • Experience with automated testing tools such as Selenium or Cypress.
  • API testing experience (for example Postman) and working knowledge of SQL for data validation.
  • The ability to turn requirements from meetings and conversations into test cases and testable acceptance criteria.
  • Experience with version control and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Daily use of AI tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot, with the judgement to prompt, steer and critically review their output.
  • Excellent attention to detail and time management, with the ability to prioritise several test items at once.
  • A collaborative, patient communicator who builds trusted relationships with developers and product colleagues.
  • Interest or experience in AI-assisted and agentic testing workflows (desirable).
  • ISTQB Foundation (CTFL) or BCS Foundation Certificate in Software Testing, or a further ISTQB, test automation, API testing or Agile certification (desirable).
  • Familiarity with accessibility testing and WCAG (desirable).

No degree or formal qualification is required. Demonstrable QA experience matters most.

job.title: QA Engineer
job.description:
Decile Group ( is transforming venture capital into a force for good in the world. We are working to launch 10,000 next-generation venture capital firms by 2030, fundamentally changing the face of venture capital.

We operate an integrated platform for modern venture capital, spanning education, software, and fund operations. VC Lab trains the next generation of fund managers. Decile Hub provides AI-enabled tools for fund operations. Start Fund enables managers to launch institutional-grade funds in under 24 hours. Decile Capital deploys capital into emerging managers. Together, these offerings make venture capital more accessible to anyone with world-class ideas and execution.

We're looking for a QA Engineer to join the Decile Group product team and own quality across Decile Hub and Start Fund. Read more about how Decile Group builds here:

This is not a role where someone hands you a test script and you follow it. Your job is to anticipate issues before they come up. You will build the QA system: the agents, the test plans, the release checks, and the habits that catch problems before a fund manager or LP ever sees them.

The ideal candidate is agentic from day one. You set up cutting-edge AI agents that test, monitor, and flag problems on their own. You understand our customers well enough to predict where they will get stuck, from a fund manager launching a fund to an LP logging in for the first time to sign documents or wire capital. You still bring the discipline of a classic QA: organized, thorough, and relentless about follow-through.

You don't need to come from a big company. You need to show us that you can catch what others miss.

Basic requirements:

  • You must live and work within a few time zones of Pacific (California) time.
  • You must be actively building with AI agents, not just using chat tools.
  • You must be able to own quality end to end without waiting for instructions.
  • You must be willing to get close to customers (calls, tickets, onboarding sessions) and turn what you learn into tests.

If you want to build the quality system for a platform that thousands of investors use to run their firms, you belong at Decile Group.

And we want to work with you too.

What You'll Do

  • Anticipate issues before release. Study each feature, the customer using it, and the flows around it, and find the problems before they ship. You are measured by what never reaches customers.
  • Build an agentic QA system. Set up and maintain AI agents that run regression tests, explore new features, check customer flows, and flag risks automatically. Keep improving them as the tools get better.
  • Know the customer. Learn how fund managers, LPs, and our internal teams actually use Decile Hub and Start Fund. Read support tickets, shadow onboarding calls, and turn real customer confusion into test cases.
  • Own the onboarding and login flows. Make sure every step a new LP or fund manager takes (invites, login, verification, documents, capital calls) works the first time, every time.
  • Run classic QA with discipline. Write test plans, maintain regression suites, track and triage bugs, and run release checks. Keep it all organized so anyone on the team can see what was tested and what is at risk.
  • Partner across Decile Group teams. Work closely with engineering, product, and customer success. When something breaks or looks risky, escalate early and clearly.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years in QA, test engineering, or a related role on a SaaS product
  • Hands-on experience building with AI agents and automation tools
  • A track record of catching issues before release, not just logging them after
  • Experience with test automation for web applications
  • Strong organization: test plans, bug tracking, and release checklists that other people can follow
  • Clear written communication. Your bug reports tell an engineer exactly what happened and how to reproduce it
  • Customer empathy. You can put yourself in the shoes of a first-time user and see where they will get lost

Nice to Have

  • Experience with venture capital, fund administration, or financial compliance workflows
  • Experience with Ruby on Rails applications
  • Experience testing onboarding, identity verification, or payment flows

How to Apply:

If you don't tick every box above, we'd still encourage you to apply. We're building a diverse team whose skills balance and complement one another.
Please describe why you are uniquely qualified for this position in the competitive field of Venture Capital, including an example of an issue you anticipated and caught before it reached customers, as well as submitting your resume.
Salary and benefits are commensurate with experience.

Scam Warning

VC Lab and Decile Group never conduct hiring interviews via chat, and we will never ask candidates to send money, purchase equipment, or share financial information. Scammers may impersonate real employee names. If you are contacted about a role outside our official channels, do not engage.

job.title: Customer Quality Engineer
job.description:
About MISUMI Americas

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

The Customer Quality Engineer communicates with customers on quality-related issues and coordinates with regional Quality Teams to efficiently and effectively resolve concerns and to drive continual improvements to proactively avoid issues from arising. This is a technical role.

Impact for the Role

As the Customer Quality Engineer you will have a significant impact on maintaining and improving customer satisfaction on our major programs. You will ensure that Quality is recognized as an order-winning proposition by our customers, with early engagement to ensure that their requirements are fully understood, our manufacturing partner capabilities are aligned, and our execution is optimized. Post sale, you will coordinate with the customers on any quality issues, acting as the subject matter expert supporting Program Managers and coordinating with Quality Team members in the regions where parts are being manufactured to ensure quick resolution of problems without unnecessary back and forth with delays resulting from time differences across our regional offices.

What You Will Be Doing

You will report to the Head of Global Quality and will assist from time to time with various duties as needed and assigned.

  • Review customers’ quality requirements, whether formalized through supplier quality manuals, for instance, or by interviews with customers. Integrate these requirements into MISUMI Americas Quality Management System
  • Support APQP and PPAP activities as required by customers, including the implementation of optimized measurement plans for mechanical parts
  • Ensure analytical and manufacturing techniques are consistent from manufacturing partner to manufacturing partner and meet agreed customer specifications through alignment with regional Supplier Quality Engineers
  • Provide subject matter expertise to program managers to both solve problems but also to develop the structured problem solving capabilities within the Program Management team and other MISUMI Americas functional groups
  • Act as the bridge between customers and regional Quality Teams
  • Identify opportunities for improvement in MISUMI Americas Quality Management System and manufacturing partner network, based on observations and involvement with customers
  • Implement performance indicators which tell MISUMI Americas how well we are doing with customer quality
  • Ensure customer-initiated supplier corrective action requests (SCARs) are responded to correctly, completely and in a timely manner
  • Establish a compelling story for MISUMI Americas Quality to be an order-winning proposition not merely an order-qualifying one
  • Serve as a customer advocate for quality issues, but tactfully pushing back when customer demands are unreasonable
  • All employees are expected to maintain and contribute to the QMS.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree in a technical subject (Masters preferred)

  • Experience working in a global organization and influencing colleagues in different timezones

  • Strong Understanding of Injection Molding, 3D printing, or Sheet Metal preferred
  • Strong understanding of quality principles and manufacturing processes (metrology expertise is preferred)
  • Strong foundational mindset in risk identification and mitigation
  • Data-driven, detail-oriented, and pragmatic
  • Structured problem solving with a multi-strategy approach
  • Six Sigma certification preferred
  • Ability to evaluate customer requirements and standards and convert them into executables

Desired Traits

You’re Collaborative – It is expected that you will partner with various functional groups within MISUMI Americas, in all regions, as well as collaborating with customers and manufacturing partners

  • Excellent collaboration skills and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks
  • Ability to build strong trust-based relationships internally and externally
  • Subject Matter Expert for resolving quality issues identified by customers
  • Ability to influence without having direct authority

You will serve as an Advocate – In the role, you will solicit and listen to customer requirements and concerns, and take an active role in avoiding problems wherever possible, but resolving them when they do occur.

  • Strong in identifying customer requirements
  • Adept at shifting priorities while maintaining a strong sense of urgency
  • Good listener who’s comfortable with ambiguity, asking questions, and providing clarity
  • Strong customer service skills with demonstrated service mentality
  • Build and maintain credibility with customers and within MISUMI Americas

You’re Passionate and Empathetic - You have a passionate commitment to people and deep empathy for how supporting individuals leads to a stronger company culture.

  • Exhibit a high level of initiative and integrity
  • Empathetic to the needs of customers, manufacturing partners, and MISUMI Americas. Able to balance the different perspectives
  • Able to make decisions without all the available information and being able to course correct when new information becomes available
  • Learn from situations and drive improvements as a result of thorough lessons learned analysis
  • Able to exercise good judgment within broadly defined practices and policies and work in a self-directed manner

Physical Demands

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee routinely is required to sit; walk; talk and hear; use hands to keyboard, fingers, handle, and feel; stoop, kneel, crouch, twist, crawl, reach, and stretch.

Travel: Ability to travel up to 50% annually in the US and/or other regions globally

We’re actively seeking teammates who:

job.description:
ABOUT BETTER IMPACT

Our mission is simple: better volunteerism, stronger communities. Better Impact provides software that helps nonprofits, government agencies, healthcare organizations, and companies recruit, schedule, communicate with, and track volunteers and their impact.We advance volunteerism by equipping the professionals who make it happen with the technology, benchmarks, and community they need to run effective volunteer programs.

Today, our products support more than 85,000 organizations, millions of volunteers, and over 600 million volunteer hours across the nonprofit, public, healthcare, and corporate sectors. Our vision is a world where volunteerism is recognized, resourced, and respected in every community.

We are a growing, private-equity-backed business focused on meaningful work

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Design a quality strategy that works across .NET, PHP, and Node and TypeScript. You're not bringing a single-stack playbook. You're defining an approach to quality that holds up across a portfolio of different systems.

Build the automation layer. API and end-to-end test coverage, integrated into each platform's delivery pipeline, with agentic and AI-driven tooling brought in deliberately so coverage scales without adding headcount for every new surface.

Define and own the quality gates across all products. No ticket exits development without a clear testing designation. Nothing ships to production without documented evidence that tests passed on an environment that genuinely mirrors production, same stack and same configuration. You own the standard, and you own sign-off on environment parity.

Own regression protection through various legacy technology modernization eforts. Build the safety net that lets engineering re-platform aggressively without silently breaking customer-facing behavior. This is the difference between a modernization that ships and one that stalls under fear of breaking things.

Embed quality into each development teams delivery cycle rather than bolting it on at the end. You'll partner with engineering leadership across platforms and with product owners, and make quality a discipline teams rely on rather than a checkpoint they route around.

Requirements

WHO YOU ARE

You have deep experience in software quality, with real depth in test automation. You are not a manual-QA manager looking to direct a team of testers. You've built systems, architected automated suites, and made hard calls about what to test and how.

You have built or substantially rebuilt a quality function before, ideally across more than one stack or product. You know what it takes to create standards where none exist and to get engineering to adopt them without resentment.

You are fluent in modern automation and comfortable that the stacks differ. You can reason about quality in a .NET system, a PHP system, and a Node and TypeScript system, and design an approach that generalizes rather than one that only fits what you already know.

You treat AI and agentic tooling as the force multiplier that makes cross-stack quality possible for a small team.

You have protected a product through a major migration, re-platform, or rewrite, where regression was the central risk and the cost of getting it wrong was customer trust.

You understand that a multi-region SaaS product carries uptime and SLA obligations, and you build quality processes with that reality in mind.

Government, healthcare, or compliance experience is a plus but not required.
