job.title: QA Tech Lead
job.description:
WHY XOGENE?

At Xogene, we’re revolutionizing the future of clinical trial transparency through AI-powered solutions. Join our team of experts who are transforming how leading pharmaceutical and life sciences companies navigate regulatory compliance. If you're driven by solving complex problems in a professional environment focused on meaningful and rewarding work, we want to hear from you.

POSITION OVERVIEW

Xogene combines regulatory expertise with advanced technology to automate complex processes in clinical trial transparency. Our software streamlines workflows through AI and agentic networking capabilities, improving data transformation and regulatory compliance for leading pharmaceutical and life sciences companies. We're committed to advancing technological solutions in clinical trial transparency. 

As we continue to expand, we are seeking an experienced QA Tech Lead to drive our test automation initiatives and strengthen our testing strategy. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, the QA Tech Lead will own test automation strategy and execution.

This is a hands-on technical role: you will write and maintain automated tests while guiding the team's automation direction.

KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and mentor automation engineers, provide technical guidance to the wider testing team, and foster a culture of quality excellence and continuous improvement.

  • Support skill development across the team, including cross-training manual testers in automation (e.g., Playwright Codegen, low-code contributions, and AI-assisted scripting with tools such as Claude) and ensuring automation engineers understand product domain and end-user workflows.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Development, Customer Success, Product Management, Design and Product Support across multiple time zones.

  • Define the overall risk-based test strategy, focusing testing effort where regulatory and customer risk is highest, with clear criteria for which tests are automated, which remain manual, and what doesn't need a test at all. Own automation test plans and standards across all Xogene product releases.

  • Create and maintain quality metrics, KPIs, and dashboards on testing progress and potential blockers, and provide regular updates to the Director of Engineering.

  • Define test scope, objectives, success criteria, and time and resource estimates with stakeholders, and ensure comprehensive coverage through effective test case design and review.

  • Identify, assess, and mitigate quality risks throughout each sprint cycle, including during pre-release dry runs.

  • Architect, build, and maintain scalable automation testing frameworks, including our custom-built Playwright framework, enforcing code standards, and maximizing test reusability through the Page Object Model (POM).

  • Develop and execute automated test scenarios, scripts, and procedures for system, integration, regression, and API testing, growing automated test coverage across all Xogene software products.

  • Act as the technical point of contact and subject matter expert on the code and system architecture, diagnosing complex technical problems and designing solutions that reflect lessons learned.

  • Identify manual test cases suitable for automation and work with the Test Lead to prioritize and transition them.

  • Move automated suites from manual triggers to a tiered CI/CD strategy in GitHub Actions (Smoke, Sanity, and Nightly Regression) that serves as quality gates for developers, and maintain suite health, including resolving flaky tests and tracking automation coverage.

  • Oversee the integration between Playwright and Zephyr Scale, reporting test results directly into Zephyr Scale through automated JUnit XML reporting pipelines and maintaining a single source of truth for QA metrics.

  • Oversee test environments and test data management, ensuring realistic, compliant test data is available for both manual and automated testing.

  • Perform manual testing where automation is impractical, defect triage and resolution, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT), contributing automated regression coverage where practical.

  • Contribute automation coverage and results to validation documentation, including the Test Plan, Test Summary Report, Traceability Matrix, and UAT Scripts.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

  • Minimum 7 years of experience in software testing or QA engineering, including at least 2 years in a technical or automation lead role

  • Hands-on experience testing large-scale enterprise SaaS web applications and complex software systems, including role-based access controls (RBAC), multi-tenant data isolation, and API integration layers

  • Experience leading automation engineers and working closely with manual testers

  • Solid understanding of manual testing, including test case design techniques (e.g., boundary value analysis, equivalence partitioning), exploratory testing, and regression planning

  • Ability to assess automation ROI and recommend the right balance of manual and automated testing effort based on risk, release cadence, and product maturity

  • Expert-level proficiency in Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript or Python), including building frameworks from the ground up using design patterns such as the Page Object Model (POM), plus experience with other automation tools (e.g., Selenium, REST Assured)

  • Strong hands-on programming skills (TypeScript, Python, JavaScript) and working knowledge of database technologies

  • Proficiency in performance testing tools (JMeter, LoadRunner) and API testing frameworks

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and test integration strategies

  • Expertise in the SDLC and test management tools (e.g., Jira, Zephyr Scale), including hands-on experience automating test execution uploads to Zephyr Scale via APIs

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical team members

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Ability to balance long-term automation architecture with immediate release needs

  • Team leadership skills, including delegating and prioritizing work, giving constructive feedback, and supporting the growth of team members

  • Commitment to staying current with industry trends and emerging testing technologies

  • Experience working in fast-paced, innovative technology environments

  • Experience in collaborative, agile teams that regularly deploy high-quality software to production

  • Strong business acumen and understanding of how quality impacts customer success and business outcomes

  • Experience testing in regulated environments (e.g., GxP, computer system validation, 21 CFR Part 11)

  • Experience testing AI/LLM-powered features, including strategies for validating non-deterministic outputs

  • Experience configuring AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude) to accelerate QA scripting workflows

  • Background in lightweight DevOps tasks, such as Docker and managing staging/test environments

Highlights

Mentorship from AI and business strategy experts

Clear career progression

Exposure to LLMs and conversational AI

Competitive pay and benefits

Results-driven, innovative culture

job.title: Senior QA Engineer
job.description:
This is a remote position.

Embrace Healthcare Group powers some of the most innovative healthcare technology solutions in North America, with a focus on enhancing clinical efficiency and compliance across emergency care settings.

EPOWERdoc, a leading SaaS platform within the Embrace Healthcare Group portfolio, specializes in Emergency Department Information Systems (EDIS) tailored for hospitals of all sizes. Designed by clinicians for clinicians, EPOWERdoc streamlines emergency room documentation with intuitive workflows, customizable templates, peer-reviewed clinical content, and real-time coding assistance—helping providers reduce documentation time and focus more on patient care.

We’re looking for a Senior QA Engineer to build EPOWERdoc’s next-generation quality engineering practice, AI-native from day one. This is a hands-on builder role: you’ll choose and architect our test automation stack, write much of the code yourself, and use AI coding agents every day to design, generate, maintain, and triage tests.

You’ll also own how we test AI itself. You’ll design the evaluation harnesses and guardrails that show EPOWERdoc’s AI-powered capabilities are accurate, safe, and dependable enough for an emergency department. You’ll partner closely with developers, product managers, designers, and clinical content experts.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead QA strategy: Own the end-to-end quality strategy for EPOWERdoc, defining test plans, risk-based coverage goals, and quality gates for every release.
  • Architect the QA tech stack: Evaluate, select, and document the tooling for UI, API, performance, accessibility, and security testing, recording each decision and its trade-offs in architecture decision records.
  • Build automation and expand coverage: Design and maintain scalable test frameworks for web applications, APIs, and integrations. Set standards clear enough that engineers and AI agents can extend them reliably. Use these frameworks to replace manual regression with automated coverage of critical clinical workflows such as triage, documentation, orders, and discharge.
  • Performance and reliability: Build load, stress, and soak tests that model real emergency department peak volumes, establish performance baselines, and catch regressions before they reach production.
  • Own CI/CD quality: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines so every pull request and build is validated quickly. Use parallel execution and AI-assisted test impact analysis to keep feedback loops short as the suite grows.
  • Defect management: Work with engineering teams to identify, document, prioritise, and resolve defects early in the development lifecycle, and drive root-cause analysis.
  • Exploratory testing: Lead exploratory testing of new features and complex clinical user flows, combining human judgement with AI-driven exploration where automation alone adds less value.
  • Agile partnership: Bring a quality perspective to sprint planning, refinement, and retrospectives, including estimates, acceptance criteria, and release readiness.
  • Quality advocacy: Champion a quality-first culture from code reviews to release management. Report on quality metrics and trends such as escaped defects, flakiness, and test cycle time.
  • Security and compliance: Ensure testing practices, test data, and the use of AI tools meet HIPAA and healthcare data security standards, with no real PHI in test environments or AI prompts.
AI-NATIVE QUALITY ENGINEERING
AI is part of how this team works every day. In this role you will:
  • AI-assisted test design: Use LLMs to turn user stories, acceptance criteria, and clinical specifications into test scenarios, edge cases, and boundary conditions, then review and sharpen them with sound test-design judgement.
  • Agentic test authoring: Use AI coding agents and Playwright’s MCP server and test agents (planner, generator, and healer) to create and maintain automated tests. Hold generated code to the same review and quality bar as production code.
  • Self-healing and failure triage: Apply AI to locator healing, flaky-test detection, and automated failure analysis: clustering failures, summarising likely root causes, and routing defects to the right owner.
  • Synthetic test data: Make realistic, PHI-free synthetic patient records and clinical scenarios the default for functional, performance, and AI evaluation testing, using tools such as Synthea or LLM-driven generators.
  • Testing AI features: Design evaluation frameworks for AI-powered EPOWERdoc capabilities. These include golden datasets, scoring rubrics, LLM-as-judge grading calibrated against human review, and regression gates that run whenever a model, prompt, or knowledge source changes.
  • AI safety and guardrails: Test AI features for hallucination, clinical and coding accuracy, bias, PHI leakage, prompt injection, and graceful failure. Work with clinical experts to define what “good enough for the ED” means in measurable terms.
  • Measure and share impact: Track how AI changes test authoring time and maintenance effort, and share what works with other Embrace engineering teams.
THE STACK YOU’LL SHAPE
This is our starting point, not a mandate. You’ll own the final decisions and the reasoning behind them.
  • UI and end-to-end: Playwright with TypeScript, including visual regression and automated accessibility checks (axe-core).
  • API and integration: Playwright API testing, contract testing (for example Pact), and validation of HL7 and FHIR interfaces.
  • Performance: Locust or k6 for load, stress, and soak testing.
  • Security: OWASP ZAP and dependency scanning in CI, plus the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications as the baseline for AI features.
  • AI tooling: AI coding agents (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor), Playwright MCP and test agents, and LLM evaluation frameworks such as Promptfoo, DeepEval, or Ragas, with tracing through Langfuse or LangSmith.
  • CI/CD and reporting: Tests running on every pull request, with Allure or a similar dashboard for trends, flakiness, and release readiness.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • First 30 days: You understand EPOWERdoc’s clinical workflows, existing test assets, and release process. You’ve proposed the target QA stack and AI-native approach as written architecture decision records.
  • By 90 days: Playwright smoke and regression suites cover the most critical clinical workflows and run on every pull request. A performance baseline exists for peak load. AI-assisted test authoring is in daily use with measured results.
  • By 6 months: Manual regression effort is a small fraction of today’s. Flaky tests are tracked and trending down. An evaluation harness gates every release of AI-powered features.

Requirements

  • Experience: 5+ years of professional QA or software testing experience, including at least 3 years building test automation, ideally in a SaaS or web application environment.
  • QA foundations: Solid understanding of QA methodologies, risk-based testing, test design techniques, and software development life cycles.
  • Programming: Strong coding skills in TypeScript or JavaScript and working proficiency in Python. You write test code with the same care as production code.
  • Test automation: Hands-on experience with modern automation tools, with Playwright strongly preferred (Cypress or Selenium also considered). This includes building scalable frameworks from the ground up, managing test data, keeping suites stable and fast, and a record of well-reasoned tooling decisions.
  • AI-native practice: Daily use of AI coding agents in test engineering, with examples you can walk us through, and the judgement to spot when AI output is wrong or shallow.
  • Testing AI systems: Understanding of how LLM features fail and how to test non-deterministic outputs with eval datasets, rubric or model-based grading, and pass thresholds.
  • Performance testing: Hands-on experience with Locust, k6, JMeter, or similar tools, including designing realistic workload models and interpreting the results.
  • API and CI/CD: Solid experience with API testing, CI/CD tools, and Git, and with running automated suites within build pipelines.
  • Communication and ownership: Ability to explain quality risks clearly to engineers, product managers, and leadership, with strong analytical skills and a proactive, self-starter attitude.
  • Ways of working: Experience working in a highly remote, fast-paced, and agile environment across time zones.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Nice to have

  • Healthcare experience: Work in healthcare or health tech, especially EHR, EDIS, or other regulated clinical software (for example, ONC Health IT certification testing). This includes familiarity with HL7 v2, FHIR, and HIPAA requirements for test data and environments.
  • AI tooling experience: Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation and observability tools, or building MCP servers and custom AI agents for engineering teams.
  • Security and accessibility testing: Experience testing web and AI applications, including prompt-injection testing, red-teaming, and WCAG.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary aligned with UK working hours, ensuring fair and transparent compensation.
  • Global Team Collaboration—work alongside extremely talented professionals from around the world.
  • Professional Growth Support with access to training programs designed to enhance your skills and expand your knowledge.
  • Clear Career Progression and excellent opportunities for long-term advancement within the organization.
  • Comprehensive Health Benefits to support your wellbeing and peace of mind.
  • Flexible Remote Work Options that empower you to balance work and life effectively.

Job Title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer – DO178

Location: Remote - Canada

Pay Range: $90,000 - $110,000 CAD, plus bonus eligible

Who we are: Lynx delivers modular, open standards–based software that transforms how high-assurance, mission-critical edge systems are built, deployed, and maintained. Our secure edge computing solutions enable innovation and operational excellence in the world’s most demanding environments, from aerospace and defense to commercial and industrial systems. We partner across industries including automotive, medical, and critical infrastructure to deliver tailored solutions aligned with each customer’s mission and operational requirements. Our key products and services are:

  • MOSA.ic: LYNX MOSA.ic™ is a modular software framework and architecture purpose-built for mission-critical edge computing. Based on the Modular Open Systems Approach (MOSA), it provides a flexible foundation for building secure, scalable, and certifiable edge systems.
  • LYNX MOSA.ic.AI: LYNX MOSA.ic.AI is a unified CPU and GPU software platform that enables deterministic, certifiable deployment of AI and advanced workloads in mission-critical edge systems. It brings control, performance, and lifecycle governance together, allowing AI to operate predictably within safety-critical environments without compromising certification or system integrity.
  • CoreSuite 2.0: CoreSuite 2.0 is Lynx’s safety-critical GPU for graphics enablement framework designed for mission-critical edge computing systems. It provides hardware-accelerated graphics, visualization, and video processing capabilities that can be certified for high-assurance systems.
  • Services: Lynx Services is Lynx’s professional services organization that helps customers design, integrate, certify, deploy, and maintain safety- and security-critical systems. It supports industries like aerospace, defense, automotive, and industrial computing through consulting, engineering, integration, and lifecycle support, reducing development risk and accelerating certification in standards-driven, mission-critical environment.

Role Overview

As a DO-178/DO-254 Software Quality Assurance (SQA) Engineer at Lynx, you will be responsible for ensuring that our software development processes and deliverables meet DO-178 and DO-254certification standards. You will work closely with software engineers, certification authorities, and project leads to plan, execute, and audit quality activities across the software development lifecycle. You’ll help shape Lynx’s software quality processes, tools, and culture to scale reliably, safely, and efficiently.

In addition, you will provide focused support for safety relevant verification activities, including tracing safety mechanisms, identifying gaps in safety critical requirements, and coordinating with Engineering to ensure that verification evidence adequately covers safety impacting functionality for CoreSuite and related product components.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support DO-178C and DO-254 certification activities (SOI-1 through SOI-4) across multiple programs, working closely with senior SQA engineers
  • Assist in preparation, review, and refinement of certification artifacts (PSAC, SDP, SVP, SCMP, etc.) to ensure consistency and quality
  • Perform SQA audits, compliance checks, and support gap tracking between planned processes and actual execution
  • Support day-to-day certification execution, including:
  • o Organizing deliverables
  • o Tracking review comments and closures
  • o Maintaining certification evidence packages
  • Participate in configuration management and change control activities (e.g., CCB, baseline tracking)
  • Assist in preparing for customer, Safety Manager/DER, and internal audits
  • Work closely with engineering teams to ensure certification requirements are properly implemented and understood
  • Learn and support traceability activities (SLR/HLR/LLR/test/evidence)
  • Contribute to improving internal SQA processes, templates, and workflows to enable repeatable certification execution
  • Shadow and learn from senior SQA engineers to build deep knowledge of CoreSuite certification approach and tools

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Software, Systems, Electrical, or related field)
  • 2–5+ years of experience in hardware/software engineering or systems engineering
  • 2+ years in software quality,
  • Basic understanding of software and hardware development lifecycle and documentation practices
  • Strong organizational skills with attention to detail
  • Ability to learn quickly in a structured, process-driven environment
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work across engineering and program teams
  • Willingness to grow into a long-term certification and SQA role

Preferred / Desirable Qualifications

  • Exposure to DO-178C, DO-254 or similar safety-critical standards (ISO 26262, IEC 61508, etc.)
  • Experience supporting certification, audit, or compliance activities
  • Familiarity with configuration management and collaboration tools (e.g., Git, Jira, Confluence)
  • Basic understanding of embedded systems, operating systems, or hypervisors
  • Experience working in aerospace, defense, or safety-critical domains

  • RRSP with employer match
  • Responsible Paid Time Off + Paid Holidays
  • Remote work opportunitiesCareer growth and professional development opportunities

Join our mission to provide governments with exceptional experiences so they can do the same for their communities!

Clariti is building a new product with a team that uses agentic development to move quickly. As a QA Engineer, you will help define how quality works across that process. You will work closely with developers, product, and AI-assisted tooling to keep quality high without slowing delivery.

Responsibilities

job.description:
About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit . Come join us.

About the team

Every insight on AlphaSense is tied to a company. Reference Entity Data Services (REDS) owns the data that makes that possible: one trusted record for every company, connected across all the sources we bring in.

REDS turns records from many providers into one authoritative view, keeps it current, and supplies it to every part of the platform that depends on it, from search to company profiles. When that foundation is right, customers find the right company and trust what they see.

About the Role

As the Staff Quality Engineer dedicated to REDS, you will define how we prove our data is correct before it reaches customers. You will set the strategy, build the practice from the ground up, and work closely with engineering and product leadership to make quality a measurable part of how the team ships.

What You'll Do

  • Own the quality strategy for AlphaSense's company reference data, built on quality by design and automation by default.
  • Close test coverage gaps on our critical workflows: ingesting provider data, matching records, keeping identifiers stable over time, and delivering entity data and change events to the product teams that rely on them.
  • Define what "correct" means for company data, and build the golden datasets, labeled samples, and automated checks that prove it, including measuring match precision and recall and the tradeoff between false merges and false splits.
  • Set the quality measures and release standards the team uses to ship with confidence.
  • Build and grow scalable automation across our data, API, and event-driven interfaces, and decide what belongs at the unit, component, API, and E2E layers.
  • Anticipate data lifecycle risks such as provider data drift, schema changes, and late or conflicting records, and build regression coverage for them.
  • Partner with developers on test planning for new features, so automation is ready as the code is.
  • Use production signals to focus effort where it reduces the most risk to customers.
  • Bring AI into how the team designs, maintains, and triages tests.
  • Coach engineers and influence across teams to raise the quality bar.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in quality engineering, including setting strategy for complex backend or data platforms.
  • Hands-on experience designing and automating tests for backend and data systems, including API and contract testing, data pipeline validation, and event-driven or streaming interfaces (e.g., Kafka).
  • Strong skills in at least one programming language (such as Python, Kotlin/Java, TypeScript/JavaScript, or Ruby), and comfort working in unfamiliar codebases.
  • Deep expertise in test design across unit, API, and end-to-end layers, and judgment about where each belongs.
  • Experience validating data correctness at scale, ideally in matching, identity, or pipeline-driven systems.
  • A strong grasp of continuous delivery, CI/CD, and release quality gates.
  • A track record of using AI to speed up engineering and testing.
  • Proven ability to set direction on your own and influence without authority.
  • Clear, confident communication with technical and business stakeholders.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with data pipelines or data-operations tooling.
  • Hands-on E2E automation experience with Playwright
  • Experience with financial, company, or reference data.
  • Experience evaluating AI or LLM output.
  • BS/MS in a relevant technical field.

What we offer

  • Playing a part in the story of a fast-growing company
  • Competitive compensation package
  • Lunch and recreational benefits
  • Occupational health care

For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. job.description:
Join the ASI Partners family as a legacy person you can come back to or refer others to as a government career source and interview for a direct-hire REMOTE opportunity with a major subcontractor on a long-term contract (potential to 2029) serving a massive IT modernization effort at the Internal Revenue Service (IRS).

We are looking for a fully-certified Salesforce Quality Assurance guru with at least 7 years ideally doing QA with the government Cloud working on Salesforce/Mulesoft, Agile CI/CD, Security model, Apex, LWC, etc.

Having a Public Trust clearance, a SECRET level government clearance, or having a higher-level clearance would expedite your start date on the contract, but we will also consider strong candidates interested in government service that can stay in place for 4-8 weeks while the clearance process finalizes. WE CAN ONLY ACCEPT U.S. CITIZENS and will verify personal information after the initial interview was successful to move forward.

So, what is the major modernization effort?

Older modernization roadmaps lacked long-term retirement strategies for core mainframes so IRS leadership rolled out a new technical framework stretching through 2029 with heavy emphasis on building a Unified API Layer to unlock legacy data. The IRS plans to wrap up its move toward a single, unified Enterprise Case Management (ECM) system. This platform will consolidate siloed databases and allow employees to support taxpayers from a single interface.

Fiscal Year 2028 Target: This is the projected completion window for updating the critical Individual Master File (IMF). The IMF has processed individual taxpayer data since 1970 using outdated COBOL and Assembly Language Code. The IRS aims to fully convert this core code into modern, developer-friendly Java.

By establishing a solid data structure and robust DevOps pipeline (using tools like SFDX and Git), the subcontractor we are hiring for helps create the stable infrastructure required for the IRS Office of Chief Counsel, the Taxpayer Advocate Service, and the Office of Appeals to safely adopt these modern AI systems.

Tech contests and other perks in addition to great HR benefits

Among great benefits like three weeks PTO, parental leave, and top of the line options for medical/dental/vision benefits and 401K, our subcontractor holds AI application contests that can land you an additional $10K for a good concept, and sets KPI metrics which awards up to $20K additional for meeting those metrics. They will certify you for free including also Agentforce certification. There are other great perks such as optional trips for people interested in cross-project management and discount programs. The company is stable, growing, and has been around for 20 years.

They are looking for a number of people, including the below position, so if you do not meet the criteria for this one, ASI Partners will interview you and we can offer other options if you meet the qualifications for those. Please read the below for the job requirements and qualifications needed for this exciting multi-year project for the IRS and apply immediately if you are interested. We will be choosing our team in the next 20 days already so go ahead and apply now with a solid resume if interested.

Key Duties & Responsibilities
•Test Strategy & Planning: Design and execute detailed test plans, including functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing.
•Automation & CI/CD: Own and maintain automated test suites (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines.
•Requirements Analysis: Translate business, user, and technical requirements into comprehensive test cases, covering both positive and negative scenarios.
•Defect Management: Identify, document, and track defects in tools like Jira or ALM; participate in root cause analysis and triage sessions.

•Performance & Security Testing: Validate system performance, security controls, accessibility, and governance compliance.
•Process Improvement: Contribute to refining testing procedures, automation frameworks, and QA standards.
•Agile Participation: Engage in Agile/Scrum ceremonies such as backlog refinement and sprint planning.

Qualifications

job.title: AI-Native Software Engineer, QA Automation
job.description:
AI-Native Software Engineer, QA Automation — Mid to Senior | Zenara Health

Location: Remote - India

Type: Full-time

Working Hours: All meetings and live collaboration happen between approximately 6:00 PM and 12:00 AM IST, overlapping US Pacific Time. Attendance in that window is required. Your remaining work is yours to schedule.

Commitment: Approximately 50 hours per week

Industry: Healthcare technology experience is preferred but not mandatory

About the Company

Zenara Health is a technology-oriented mental healthcare organization building clinical software for behavioral-health clinics. Our products include Assess and Zenflow, which support assessments, care management, clinical workflows, and operational delivery .

We are a startup, not a department. We are building an AI-native engineering team where quality must scale at the same speed as development.

About the Role

We are looking for an AI-Native Software Engineer focused on QA Automation.

This is not a manual testing role.

This is not a role for someone who simply clicks through test cases.

This is a software engineering role for someone who builds systems that prove whether the product works.

Our developers build with AI agents. That means code can arrive faster than traditional QA can review it by hand. We need a QA automation engineer who can build the testing harness, automated checks, synthetic data, test environments, and agent-driven QA workflows that keep up with agent-speed development .

Here is the test: can you build a test system, seed a real bug, prove the test catches it, and explain what is still unverified?

We are not looking for someone who signs off work because it “looks fine.” We are looking for someone who demands evidence.

Our AI-Native QA Vision

QA at Zenara is not a downstream gate. It is an engineering platform.

We are building toward a system where product requirements can become test plans, test data, automated browser and API checks, evidence reports, failure routing, and release confidence — with agents helping create and run the work, and engineers governing the quality.

You will help design and operate this QA system, including:

  • Browser and API test runners
  • Synthetic test data
  • Isolated test environments
  • Requirement-to-test workflows
  • Automated checks on every change
  • Agent-driven QA workflows
  • Evidence generation for releases
  • Flaky-test reduction
  • Failure routing and debugging
  • Quality metrics and release confidence

The goal is not to automate bad testing. The goal is to build a system that catches real defects before customers do.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain the QA automation harness across browser, API, data, and workflow layers.
  • Create automated checks that run on every meaningful change.
  • Build synthetic test data and isolated test environments.
  • Own the UAT/QA automation pipeline from requirement to test plan to run to evidence.
  • Use AI agents to help generate, execute, improve, and debug tests.
  • Build independent agent-driven QA workflows that test the work of code-writing agents.
  • Prove tests work by reintroducing known bugs and showing they fail correctly.
  • Reduce flaky tests and distinguish real product failures from environment noise.
  • Produce reliable QA evidence for releases.
  • Work with engineering and product to define quality gates for critical user journeys.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong software engineering ability: you can design, write, debug, and maintain code.
  • Experience with test automation using Playwright, Cypress, API testing frameworks, or similar tools.
  • CI/CD experience and comfort wiring tests into build and release workflows.
  • Practical experience using AI agents to create or improve tests.
  • Strong judgment about whether a test actually proves anything.
  • Ability to seed a bug, run a test, and demonstrate that the test catches the failure.
  • Comfort debugging flaky tests, environment issues, and test data problems.
  • Skeptical, evidence-driven thinking.
  • Clear communication around risk, coverage, and release confidence.

Our Current Stack

  • TypeScript
  • Node.js, Hono
  • React
  • Prisma, PostgreSQL
  • Redis, BullMQ
  • Playwright
  • Azure AKS, Blob Storage, Azure Monitor / OpenTelemetry
  • Terraform, Helm, CI pipelines
  • Medplum / FHIR
  • Flowable
  • Claude Code, Codex
  • Dify-based AI workflows

What “AI-Native QA” Means for This Role

For this role, being AI-native means you can:

  • Use agents to generate test ideas, test code, and edge cases.
  • Review agent-created tests critically.
  • Build workflows where agents test independently from the agents that wrote the code.
  • Use AI to analyze failures and propose debugging paths.
  • Create repeatable quality gates that scale with development speed.
  • Measure whether AI-generated tests are actually useful.
  • Avoid false confidence from tests that pass without proving behavior.

The point is not to have more tests. The point is to have trustworthy evidence.

Nice to Have

  • Healthcare or regulated-software experience.
  • Experience testing AI-powered features, including output quality.
  • Experience building test environments and synthetic data.
  • Performance or load testing experience.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days, you will map the current QA setup, agree the highest-risk user journeys, and deliver one automated end-to-end QA lane that runs on every change and catches a known bug .

Within your first 90 days, key journeys for Assess and Zenflow will be covered automatically, every release will have QA evidence, and flaky-test rate and run time will be measured and improving .

Over time, success means building a mature agentic QA platform where escaped defects are low and QA throughput keeps pace with agent-speed development .

Outside required collaboration, we care about output, reliability, and quality.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, based on demonstrated ability and experience
  • Fully remote work
  • Equipment allowance
  • Direct access to the founder and Head of Engineering
  • The opportunity to build the QA function as an engineering platform from the ground up

Who Will Thrive in This Role

This role is well suited to someone who:

  • Thinks like an engineer, not a manual checklist executor.
  • Enjoys building tools, systems, and automation.
  • Is naturally skeptical and evidence-driven.
  • Cares about proving behavior, not just producing green checkmarks.
  • Wants to make QA scale with AI-native development.
  • Likes working in fast-moving, ambiguous startup environments.

You may struggle if you only have manual testing experience, cannot code, sign off work without evidence, or write tests that pass regardless of whether the product is correct .

If you want to build the quality system for an AI-native software team, we would love to hear from you.

You’ll join a fast-moving product team on a complex platform with lots of workflows, and your main focus will be exploratory and user-centric testing rather than running test cases.

Your role will be dynamic and impactful. You’ll dig deep into the product, think like a user and an admin, and give the team clear, actionable insights that directly shape the product experience. This is not a test automation role. We’re looking for someone with critical thinking, depth and their own point of view.

We’re searching for #curious and #proactive minds to help us #continue building world-class digital experiences with innovative and modern technologies.

  • Run deep exploratory testing: take an area and go all the way into it, covering edge cases, friction points and inconsistencies.

  • Learn complex workflows and business rules well enough to think like an end user and like an admin.

  • Flag issues even when something “technically works” but the experience falls short, and defend your view with evidence.

  • Decide what to test in a product that changes all the time, focusing on the highest-impact areas instead of trying to cover everything.

  • Deliver actionable findings that state the problem, the impact on users, the evidence and a recommended priority, putting quality ahead of the number of bugs.

  • Mix exploratory testing, continuous validation and light regression as the product evolves.

  • Work directly with the client: ask questions, share progress, ask for feedback and be open about doubts or risks.

Our Perfect Match:

  • Solid senior-level experience in QA, with a strong focus on exploratory and user-centric testing.

  • Strong product sense and the ability to understand complex workflows, business rules and user goals.

job.description:
Quem somos

A Smarthis é uma empresa de tecnologia que desenvolve soluções feitas de humanos para humanos! Acreditamos que boas soluções surgem de fortes conexões entre pessoas, conhecimentos, ideias e ideais. Por isso, ser Smarther é mais do que fazer parte de uma empresa, é viver verdadeiramente a cultura da colaboração e inovação que pulsa em nosso DNA.

Com um time formado por diferentes gêneros, cores, crenças, culturas e orientações afetivas, que estão espalhados por todo o Brasil (e mundo!), nosso objetivo é auxiliar nossos clientes em seus desafios para a transformação digital. Desenvolvendo produtos e serviços tecnológicos para seus negócios, combinando o melhor do RPA (Robotic Process Automation), Data Analytics e Inteligência Artificial, por um time que tem paixão por inovação, desafios e aprendizado.

Nossos Diferenciais:

Somos Great Place to Work – O respeito e o cuidado com o nosso time foram fundamentais para conquistarmos a premiação: desde 2021, somos reconhecidos anualmente como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil. Isso é resultado da união de um time com uma cultura alinhada com a nossa visão de crescimento para o futuro.

100 Startups to Watch – Estamos na lista das startups mais promissoras e inovadoras do ecossistema do Brasil, segundo a Pequenas Empresas e Grandes Negócios. O desenvolvimento das equipes e a maturidade para encontrar soluções nos trouxeram essa premiação importante.

UiPath Professional Services & Diamond Partner – Somos a primeira empresa da América Latina a alcançar as principais certificações da empresa líder mundial em RPA.

One Hundred Startups – Somos reconhecidos como uma das 100 startups mais relevantes em ecossistemas corporativos de inovação, pela 100 Open Startups, a plataforma pioneira e líder de Open Innovation.

Scale-Up Endeavor – Acelerados pela Endeavor, a comunidade global líder de empreendedores de alto impacto, fazemos parte do programa de aceleração das empresas que mais crescem no Brasil, levando a transformação digital para o mercado

Onde Estamos:

Atualmente, temos escritórios no Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Miami, Buenos Aires, Madrid e Perth. Mas não se preocupe! Para os que estiverem trabalhando remotamente, nossa cultura permanece a mesma: Integração total com happy hour online, noite de jogos, lives e outras programações legais! 😉

Seu trabalho será

  • Analisar requisitos do sistema e desenvolver casos de testes para sua validação;
  • Planejar e desenvolver testes de aceitação, integração e sistema;
  • Fazer documentação do sistema e dimensionamento das especificações;
  • Avaliar a infraestrutura e elaborar testes de stress, carga e manutenibilidade do sistema;
  • Automatizar testes de integração e aceitação;
  • Administrar o ambiente de testes e garantir a execução de testes automatizados;
  • Executar testes manuais e exploratórios;
  • Difundir a cultura da qualidade e apontar melhorias no processo de desenvolvimento;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com outros desenvolvedores, Design e Produto na definição do produto (requisitos, funcionalidades e execução) e sua melhoria contínua;

O que você precisa ter

  • Desenvolvimento de softwarecom alguma linguagem de programação (ex.: Python, Ruby, Go);
  • Sistema de Gerenciamento de Banco de dados (PostgreSQL);
  • Versionamento de código (GIT);
  • Design de casos de teste;
  • Gestão de planos de testes;
  • Manutenção de ambientes de teste;
  • Automação de testes de aplicações web com Selenium;
  • Automação de testes de integração;
  • Planejamento de teste em sprint com análise de risco;
  • Integração contínua;

O processo seletivo

job.title: CDD/Freelance QA Engineer
job.description:
About

Swan is the leading European fintech specialized in embedded banking. A laureate of the French government’s selective year list of tech champions, “French Tech Next 120,” we are quickly expanding across Europe.

Over 100 European companies have already seamlessly integrated banking services such as accounts, cards, and payments into their products through our Banking-as-a-Service platform. This approach, known as “embedded finance”, empowers businesses to elevate their offerings and create new revenue streams — often times tripling their revenue!

Our founders’ vision from the beginning was Simplicity: that anyone with a fintech idea at 2 am can visit our website, start building, and buy themselves a coffee with a self-issued card the very next day. That vision has taken us far.

Following a 38M€ Series B round last September, we have been doubling our headcount and already have over 230 Swanees across offices in Paris, Bordeaux, Berlin, Barcelona, Amsterdam, and Milan! If you’re excited about joining a European fintech adventure, Swan is the way!

To learn more about us:About Swan;Our story.

Job description

In this role, you will be the QA reference for two product squads at Swan: KYC/Onboarding (how individuals and companies open an account and get verified) and Capital Deposit (how entrepreneurs deposit share capital to incorporate their company). You will join the QA team, which works with every product squad so that Swan ships reliable banking features to its partners. The QA team is small, experienced and close-knit: we share practices and back each other up.

✨ Your mission

Your main mission is to ensure the quality of everything the KYC/Onboarding and Capital Deposit squads release for the duration of the contract, while reducing the automated-test debt on these flows and making good use of AI to test faster and better.

✨ Main Tasks

  • Get up to speed quickly on the onboarding and capital deposit flows, their business rules and their regulatory constraints, and take over QA activities in both squads.

  • Analyze specifications and user stories with Product Managers and engineers, raising ambiguities, missing rules and risks early (shift left).

  • Design risk-based test strategies and functional test cases (ISTQB techniques: equivalence partitioning, boundary values, decision tables, state transitions…) for new features.

  • Execute functional, exploratory and regression testing (UI and API), and validate releases.

  • Automate E2E scenarios with Cucumber (Gherkin) and Playwright (TypeScript) to cover new features and close the existing automation gap, and maintain the existing test suites.

  • Maintain the test repository (Qase) and the requirements repository so that requirements, test cases and coverage stay accurate and traceable.

  • Report bugs clearly, qualify bugs reported by others, follow them up to resolution, and take part in root-cause analyses and post-mortems.

  • Prioritize your work across two squads, and keep both teams informed of test status, risks and blockers.

  • Use AI tools (Claude) to speed up test analysis, test design and test automation, critically review what the AI produces, and share good practices with the QA team.

✨ Curious about your future team?

In this part please provide a short 3 to 4 line paragraph that gives us the scoop on the team such as the composition, internal structure, operational approach, key stakeholders, and any other detail of the team.

You will join a QA team of 4 QA engineers and a QA Platform Engineer led by the QA Manager, inside an Engineering organization of [X]+ people. Each QA engineer is embedded in one or more product squads (4 to 8 engineers with a dedicated Product Manager) that plan their roadmap quarterly and deploy as they go. Day to day, you will work closely with the engineers, Engineering Managers and Product Managers of the KYC/Onboarding and Capital Deposit squads, and with other QA team members.
Within the QA team, we share a common automation framework, common tools (Qase, Linear, Notion, GitHub, home-made requirement repository tool) and an AI-assisted QA pipeline that we keep improving together.

Our technical environment:

  • E2E test automation: Cucumber (Gherkin) + Playwright (TypeScript)

  • Test management: Qase; requirements repository linked to test cases

  • Project management & documentation: Linear, Notion; code & CI: GitHub

  • AI: Claude / Claude Code, used across the QA team to support test analysis, test design and automation

  • Swan's public API is GraphQL

Preferred experience

✨ You’re a great match if:

  • You are a confirmed QA Engineer / software tester (around 4+ years of experience), ideally in an agile product team

  • You can work with several teams at once: you prioritize, you say what will and won't be done, and you keep everyone informed.

  • You are comfortable testing APIs (GraphQL or REST) as well as web interfaces.

  • You have hands-on experience with test automation, ideally Playwright and/or Cucumber/Gherkin, and you are comfortable reading and writing TypeScript (or a similar language).

  • You build good relationships easily, you communicate clearly in writing and out loud, and you can explain a risk or a bug to an engineer, a PM or a business stakeholder alike.

  • You already use AI tools (Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT…) in your testing work, or you are keen to, and you keep a critical eye on what they produce.

  • Experience in banking, fintech or another regulated industry is a strong plus.

  • You know the ISTQB concepts and vocabulary (test levels, test techniques, risk-based testing, defect lifecycle) and apply them pragmatically. An ISTQB certification is a plus.

  • Languages: you are fluent in English and French.

  • Our ideal teammate: Sociable. Skilled. Empathetic. Frank. We love to challenge each other, and we leave our egos at the door 🙂

It’s okay if you don’t tick all the boxes — don’t let imposter syndrome prevent you from applying! 🙌

Swan is committed to providing a caring work environment for all employees, regardless of age, sex, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion, or belief.

When it comes to recruitment, we’re interested in your work experience, skills, and overall personality. Because diversity makes the workplace stronger and is necessary for Swan’s success, we are intensifying efforts to incorporate concrete actions to help us improve in this area.

About Swan

✨ Our values:

Swan’s core values guide our actions daily. Individually, they may seem obvious, but together, they form a unique culture.

Simplicity: Leonardo Da Vinci said: “simplicity is the ultimate sophistication.” If something's convoluted or confusing, we work extra hard to break it down. - Making complex things simple is what we do.

Long Term: We always play the long game, whether it's to support our partners in their growth journey, or make tangible commitments to climate action.

Excellence: We are a team of experts who consistently go all out to create pixel-perfect banking services and exceed our partners' expectations— whatever it takes.

Be Human: We believe in the power of kindness and the importance of acting with integrity. But embracing our humanity extends beyond interpersonal interactions, it means caring about greater issues that affect our planet.

You can find out more about our culture.

Recruitment process

  • A 30-min video call with our Talent Acquisition Manager, to get to know you, understand your career expectations and answer your questions

  • Hiring Manager interview

  • Case study

  • Peer Interview automation, test execution, collaboration

  • Last interview with our CTO

About the Role

Adobe Workflows, API Integration and Digital Media

AllShore Tallent is seeking a mid-to-senior QA Engineer specializing in creative automation to validate end-to-end creative automation and digital media production workflows. The role spans Airtable intake and status control, AWS orchestration, Adobe Photoshop APIs, and review and approval. The current use case focuses on static banners and Photoshop outputs, with motion graphics and video workflows in the pipeline, including one moving into implementation.

The ideal candidate brings a methodical approach to tracing distributed workflows, finding edge cases, maintaining state integrity, and verifying data isolation, with a background in digital media workflow engineering, ad-tech production pipelines, creative automation, or cloud-native integration QA.

Key responsibilities

· Validate asynchronous, event-driven pipelines in which intake actions trigger background state machines and webhooks. Trace the complete flow from Airtable through AWS and Photoshop APIs to Frame.io.

· Verify idempotency, de-duplication, race-condition handling, and queue throttling, including duplicate Frame.io Approved webhooks.

· Test recovery from network interruptions, expired tokens, corrupt or oversized source media, missing manifest keys, and simulated API service limits. Verify circuit breaker thresholds, queue pausing, slot release, and manual or administrator recovery.

· Design deterministic cache lifecycle tests that distinguish reusable asset-level caches (Creative/DMC) from isolated template-level manifests. Confirm that template timestamp changes and asset re-uploads invalidate caches correctly and prevent stale file delivery.

· Reconcile assets, folders, and version stacks. Test URL-encoded filenames, duplicate same-name folder structures, version stack collisions, and protection of active in-progress uploads from deletion.

· Validate AI cropping and graphical transformations across human and non-human subjects in landscape and portrait source files. Assess bounding-box and focal-point detection, identify unnecessary Firefly Generative Expand versus appropriate native cropping, and verify masks preserve native boundaries.

· Inspect typography, font substitutions, leading, multi-line wrapping, bold ranges, safe-zone margins, CTA button bounds, disclaimer visibility, and ratings bug placement across aspect ratios.

· Document reproducible, step-level defects in Jira Cloud with complete asset and log context, and evaluate results against acceptance criteria associated with Epics, Stories, and Bugs.

Requirements

Required qualifications and technical skills

  • QA experience: Mid-to-senior QA engineering experience aligned with digital media workflow engineering, ad-tech production pipelines, creative automation, or cloud-native integration QA. Strong end-to-end troubleshooting, edge-case testing, state integrity, and data isolation skills.

  • Airtable: Practical understanding of field types, formulas, automations, and trigger actions. Ability to validate Action = Execute and Automation Status transitions from Pending to Queued to In Progress to Review, Approved, or Finalizing. Experience checking field hygiene, null and fallback values such as NA, Automation Version Stack ID tracking, and Invalidate Asset Cache and Creative Allocation overrides

  • : Strong practical knowledge of as an automated review and approval surface, including version stacking, Approved asset status hooks, share-link generation, and structural validation. Experience with API authentication nuances, including server-to-server (S2S) authentication and workarounds, custom headers, and rate-limiting behavior.

  • Adobe Photoshop and imaging APIs: Solid conceptual understanding of artboards, smart objects, layer hierarchies and masks, text layers, typography leading and sizing, and bounds calculation. Familiarity with Adobe Photoshop APIs and smart-object replacement mechanics. Ability to inspect and validate PSD/PSB, JPG, PNG, and GIF outputs, including raster and animated renditions as applicable.

  • AWS orchestration and observability: Comfort navigating SQS queues, DynamoDB locking and slot tracking, Step Functions / state machines, Lambda, and S3 asset storage and overwrite behavior. Ability to trace execution logs, correlation IDs, and failure payloads to distinguish upstream intake errors, service timeouts, and circuit breaker trip states.

  • Workflow reliability: Experience testing asynchronous and event-driven systems, webhook de-duplication, idempotency, concurrency, throttling, resilience, circuit breakers, layered caching and invalidation, and asset and folder synchronization edge cases.

  • Visual quality assurance: Understanding of bounding-box and focal-point detection, native cropping, Firefly Generative Expand, and mask boundaries. A keen eye for digital display production and design standards across multiple output formats and aspect ratios.

  • Jira Cloud: Deep comfort working with Epics, Stories, Bugs, acceptance criteria, and detailed, reproducible defect reports supported by assets and logs.

Preferred skills

  • Familiarity with Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Motion Graphics templates (MoGRTs), Adobe Media Encoder with particular emphasis on presets, and video codecs, output formats, and resolutions to support upcoming motion graphics and video use cases.

job.title: Automation QA Engineer Internship
job.description:
Overview: Quality and Test Automation

The Automation QA Engineer is vital for ensuring the reliability, performance, and correctness of our entire supply chain e-commerce platform. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining comprehensive automated test suites across the e-commerce user interface, complex internal business workflows (MES, WMS, OMS), and the logic governing our next-generation AI agents.

Internship Details

Duration: 3 months

Start Date: Immediate

Location: Remote

Stipend: None initially. Based on your first-quarter performance, you may be offered a paid full-time opportunity, or even be absorbed directly by the client as an FTE.

Key Responsibilities & Core Projects

You will embed quality assurance directly into the development and deployment lifecycle, serving as the gatekeeper for production releases.

  • Test Suite Development: Develop and maintain robust, end-to-end automated test suites covering critical e-commerce flows (catalog navigation, checkout, payments, invoicing) and complex internal tool workflows (OMS/WMS operations).

  • Quality Gates (CI/CD): Integrate automated test suites into the CI/CD pipeline (managed via Makefile) to enforce quality gates, ensuring no regressions are introduced and the platform adheres to performance standards before deployment.

  • Performance & Load Testing: Implement and execute performance testing and load testing protocols to validate the scalability and resilience of the NestJS modular monolith, especially for high-traffic scenarios and intensive SCM transactions.

  • API Integration Testing: Design and execute automated tests for API integrations between the core supply chain modules (e.g., testing the data contract integrity between WMS and OMS) and external payment services.

  • Test Data Management: Create and maintain reliable test data factories to simulate complex multi-tenant and domain-specific scenarios (e.g., various HS codes, tenant feature flags).

  • Regression Management: Continuously maintain and optimize the regression test suite to provide fast, reliable feedback to development teams operating within the Monorepo structure.

Required Technologies & Tools

Candidates must possess strong expertise in automated testing frameworks, CI/CD integration, and performance validation:

  • Automation Frameworks: Experience selecting, building, and maintaining E2E (e.g., Playwright, Cypress) and API testing frameworks.

  • Programming: Strong proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js for writing high-quality, maintainable test code.

  • Performance/Load: Experience with tools for performance and load testing (e.g., JMeter, K6).

  • CI/CD: Practical experience integrating tests into automated pipelines and working within a Monorepo environment.

  • Data & Database: Ability to query PostgreSQL 15 directly to validate data integrity.

AI Agent Focus

You will be responsible for validating the behavior and accuracy of our AI systems.

  • Agent Behavior Testing: Develop tests to validate the deterministic and non-deterministic behaviors of AI agents, ensuring they accurately process inputs, access data securely, and perform their intended functions (e.g., workflow optimization, customer support responses).

  • Integration Validation: Verify the quality of data retrieval and the security of the API layers connecting AI agents (using LangChain/LlamaIndex) to the core WMS/OMS data.

Success Metrics & Career Path

Performance will be measured by:

  • Test Coverage: Measurable increase in automated functional and regression test coverage across critical application paths.

  • Defect Escape Rate: Reduction in the number of critical and high-severity defects escaping to production.

  • Pipeline Reliability: Maintenance of stable, non-flaky test runs within the CI/CD pipeline.

Mentorship Structure: Reports to the Technical Architect or Engineering Lead, working directly with development teams across the Catalog, OMS, and WMS modules.

job.title: Performance Tester Internship

Overview: Scalability and Speed Optimization

The Performance Tester is dedicated to ensuring the speed, stability, and scalability of our entire supply chain e-commerce platform. You will plan, design, and execute rigorous load, stress, and endurance tests on the core e-commerce storefront, the performance-critical internal SaaS tools (OMS, WMS, MES), and the emerging AI agent services to identify and eliminate performance bottlenecks.

Internship Details

Duration: 3 months

Start Date: Immediate

Location: Remote

Stipend: None initially. Based on your first-quarter performance, you may be offered a paid full-time opportunity, or even be absorbed directly by the client as an FTE.

Key Responsibilities & Core Projects

You will be the expert in pushing the platform to its limits, guaranteeing optimal user experience even under peak load.

  • Test Strategy & Design: Design comprehensive load, stress, and endurance testing strategies for critical systems, focusing on the high-volume e-commerce checkout funnels, payment gateway integrations, and API responsiveness across the modular monolith.

  • Execution & Analysis: Execute tests using industry-standard tools (e.g., JMeter, Gatling) and cloud-based load testing services. Analyze results to accurately identify performance bottlenecks in the Node.js/NestJS services, database queries (PostgreSQL/Redis), and infrastructure components.

  • Critical Flow Testing: Specifically test the performance and throughput of key supply chain APIs and user flows, including real-time inventory checks (WMS integration), order placement (OMS), and search functionality (Meilisearch).

  • Optimization Recommendations: Collaborate closely with the SRE and development teams to translate performance data into clear, actionable optimization strategies for code, database indices, caching (Redis), and infrastructure (auto-scaling).

  • CI/CD Integration: Work with the DevSecOps team to integrate performance testing as a mandatory quality gate within the CI/CD pipeline to prevent performance regressions in new deployments.

Required Technologies & Tools

Candidates must possess deep experience in performance testing methodology, execution, and analysis:

  • Testing Tools: Expert proficiency in JMeter, Gatling, or similar high-scale load generation tools.

  • Monitoring & Analysis: Hands-on experience using the observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) to monitor system metrics, latency, and resource utilization during test execution.

  • Programming/Scripting: Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., JavaScript/Python) for test scenario creation and data generation.

  • Backend Knowledge: Strong understanding of database performance tuning (PostgreSQL), caching, and API behavior (REST/JSON).

  • Cloud/Infra: Familiarity with cloud-based load testing services and containerized environments (Docker).

AI Agent Focus

You will validate the capacity and latency of our AI services.

  • Load Testing AI: Conduct stress and load tests on the AI agent systems, measuring latency and throughput under concurrent user requests, especially concerning the processing power required for LLM interactions (e.g., prompt processing, RAG retrieval).

  • Resource Impact: Analyze the impact of AI compute demands on shared infrastructure resources, providing data for cloud capacity planning.

Success Metrics & Career Path

Performance will be measured by:

  • Latency Reduction: Measurable improvements in API response times (e.g., 95th percentile latency) for critical services.

  • Throughput: Successful validation of system throughput capabilities against business-defined peak load targets.

  • Bottleneck Identification: Accuracy and impact of identified performance bottlenecks and recommended solutions.

Mentorship Structure: Reports to the Automation QA Lead or Technical Architect, working directly with the SRE and Backend Engineering teams to ensure performance is a core product feature.

The SDET II owns the automated testing of features within their squad, end to end. They are a full participant in the Central Quality Engineering function — partnering with product teams to embed quality into every phase of development through tooling, automation, infrastructure and reporting. This is also the level at which the person starts moving coverage down the test pyramid, away from purely UI-based validation toward API, contract and integration testing, because that is where reliability comes from. The SDET II contributes to Caseware’s move toward agentic development and testing, working with AI test harnesses applied within the quality engineering space.

What you will do:

    • Designs, implements and executes automated tests across the platform, and owns the automated testing of new features developed within the squad.

    • Contributes to quality releases and reduced time to market by adding meaningful automation coverage and by converting manual tests to automated ones.

    • Contributes to improvements within the test pyramid — shifting away from sole reliance on UI validation toward lower levels of testing to increase reliability.

    • Improves the stability and speed of E2E tests through better test data setup, test isolation and execution reliability; champions practices that reduce flaky tests and noisy signals.

    • Performs root-cause analysis of defects using logs, browser dev tools, API calls and data inspection.

    • Collaborates with squad Development, Product, UX and Documentation members, and presents sprint demos to the squad and team.

Overview

Join an amazing team that is consistently recognized for our achievements and culture, including our most recent Forbes award of being one of America's Best Midsize Employers for 2026!

Position Summary:

As a Senior Software Engineer in Test, you will be designing, developing, and maintaining complex software testing framework and tools. This position involves leading project, mentoring junior team members, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality software solutions.

Geo-Salary Information

An in-person interview may be required during the hiring process

State specific pay scales for this role are as follows:

$94,458 to $179,048 (CA, NJ, NY, WA, HI, AK, MD, CT, RI, MA)

$85,871 to $162,771 (NV, OR, AZ, CO, WY, TX, ND, MN, MO, IL, WI, FL, GA, MI, OH, VA, PA, DE, VT, NH, ME)

$77,283 to $146,494 (UT, ID, MT, NM, SD, NE, KS, OK, IA, AR, LA, MS, AL, TN, KY, IN, SC, NC, WV)

The expected base salary for this position will vary depending on a number of factors, including relevant experience, skills and location.

In CA: Typical hiring range is $123,078 to $170,941

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

  • Design, Develop and Maintain Test Automation Frameworks, Tools and Libraries: Develop a strong understanding of relevant product areas, independently implementing and maintaining complex automated tests and medium complex framework features.

  • Implement/Enhance Continuous Integration Continuous Deployment (CI / CD): Understanding of automation framework with CI/CD pipelines to facilitate automated testing during the build and deployment processes.
  • Performance Testing Support: Design and implement complex performance test script based on existing automation framework and tools to execute performance tests. Provide analytical and provide feedback for the releases in the test result report.
  • Define and Enforce Automation Standards and Best Practices: Enforcing coding standards, best practices, and guidelines for writing and maintaining automated scripts and framework. Review code written by team members to ensure adherence to standards and provide constructive feedback.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration and Communication: Work closely with cross functional teams and stakeholders to gather requirements and provide simple solutions in framework to meet medium-complex testing needs in small-medium sized team.

  • Training and Mentorship: Train and mentor TE and SETs on using the automation framework to start writing medium automation tests. Training others to diagnose, resolve mid-complex issues and prepare proper documentation to ensure smooth operation.

Qualifications

Education:

Minimum:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems or other related fields Or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Experience:

Minimum:

  • 5+ yrs industry experience, independently implementing medium sized automation framework/tools

Preferred:

  • 3 or more years of development experience with Java and/or Python
  • 3 or more years of experience creating automation frameworks
  • 3 or more years of experience developing testing tools

Knowledge and Skills:

Minimum:

  • Familiar with the following:
    • Training, Leading, and Mentorship - Capability to train, lead and mentor junior team members in automation best practices and framework usage.
  • Knowledgeable of the following:
    • Framework Design and Development - Develop a strong understanding of relevant product areas, proficiency in designing and implementing high quality framework, that are modular, configurable, maximize reuse, are fast, effective, user friendly, secure, compliant, stable and maintainable.
    • Develop Testing Tools, Utilities - Develop a strong understanding of relevant product areas, integrate innovative tools, libraries, and technologies into the automation framework to enhance testing capabilities.
    • Create and Maintain Libraries - Proficiency in creating and maintain automated reusable libraries/components to enhance automated capabilities
    • Technologies - Experienced in containerization technologies. Experienced in cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure. Experienced in Leveraging DevSecOps to Improve Engineering Efficiency
    • Release Process and Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) - Agile software development release process, CI/CD practices and tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub) to integrate automated tests into the build process.
    • Performance Testing - Familiarity with performance testing concepts and tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner) to assess system behavior under load.
    • Documentation Skills - Proficiency in documenting framework architecture, components, usage instructions, presentation, and bug report, etc...
    • Requirements Analysis - Analyze [simple/complex] system requirements and design to determine the best approach for testing of the change/implementation.
    • Critical Thinking and Problem-Solving Skills – Debugging and resolving blocking issues, especially in automation scripts, frameworks and tools. Applies analytical and creative approaches to tackle complex quality challenges with innovative solutions.
    • Collaboration and Communication - verbal and written communication skills on executing task-specific collaboration, conveying precise technical details, responding to immediate issues, and ensure clarity in resolving project-level technical challenges
    • Multi-Tasking Skill with Positive Attitude - Multi-Tasking skill with willingness and positive attitude to do whatever it takes to complete tasks on time or as quickly as possible.
    • Product Knowledge - Acquire and apply domain-specific knowledge to ensure that testing efforts align with business objectives and real-world use cases.
    • Test Automation Tools - Experience coding with popular test automation tools and frameworks (e.g., Selenium, TestNG, JUnit, Appium, IDE, Metrics etc.). Knowledge of containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.
    • Debugging and Troubleshooting - Strong skills in diagnosing issues within the automation execution and scripts to ensure smooth operation.
    • Best Coding Practices - Ability to conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to ensure quality and adherence to standards and best practice.
  • Experienced with the following:
    • Coding Skills - Strong knowledge of programming languages commonly used in automation, such as Java, Python, or JavaScript.
    • Time Management - Excellent organizational skills to manage multiple testing projects, prioritize tasks to meet deadlines.
    • Adaptability and Flexibility - adapt to changing requirements, code designs and implementation changes, new technologies, methods to solve problems, shift priorities, workstyle and responsibilities.
    • API Testing - Knowledge of API testing methodologies and tools (e.g., Postman, SoapUI, Curl, Insomnia) for validating RESTful and SOAP APIs.
    • Continuous Learning - Commitment to staying updated with the latest trends, tools, and technologies in test automation and quality assurance.
    • Attention to Detail - Meticulous attention to detail to ensure high-quality automated tests and reliable framework performance.

Why choose a career at Mercury?

At Mercury, we have been guided by our purpose to help people reduce risk and overcome unexpected events for more than 60 years. We are one team with a common goal to help others. Everyone needs insurance and we can’t imagine a world without it.

Our team will encourage you to grow, make time to have fun, and work together to make great things happen. We embrace the strengths and values of each team member. We believe in having diverse perspectives where everyone is included, to serve customers from all walks of life.
