job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Quality Engineering
job.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Platform team, you will build and own the frameworks, tooling, and CI/CD infrastructure that let Alpaca’s engineers ship new features quickly and reliably. This is a software engineering role at its core: you will spend most of your time writing Go, designing automated test frameworks, and digging into application code and Kubernetes when needed. Just as importantly, you will help redefine how we use AI to raise the bar on quality - leveraging LLMs and AI-driven tooling to generate tests, catch regressions before they ship, and turn every incident into durable, automated coverage. We are looking for engineers who treat quality as an engineering discipline and see AI as a force multiplier for it - people who build the systems that make testing fast, reliable, and effortless for the teams that depend on them.

Things You Get To Do

  • Design and build automated test frameworks across our REST and gRPC API surface.
  • Leverage AI and LLM-based tooling to accelerate test generation, harden regression coverage, and turn production incidents into automated tests - embedding these practices into the frameworks the whole engineering org relies on.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines - we use a mix of GitHub Actions and Google Cloud Build.
  • Design and execute load, stress, and scalability tests to ensure our platform can handle growing demand.
  • Introduce chaos engineering practices - designing fault-injection and resilience experiments that surface failure modes before our customers do.
  • Standardize tooling and infrastructure to improve the day-to-day developer experience.
  • Partner with other teams to raise test coverage, reliability, and speed across services.
  • Dig into application code to root-cause failures and drive fixes to completion.
  • Mentor and guide product engineers, fostering a culture of quality and continuous improvement.

Who You Are (Must-Haves)

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a software engineer building and maintaining production systems.
  • You have written code in strongly typed languages and have at least 1 year of experience with Go.
  • You are fluent with AI-assisted engineering - you actively use LLM-based tools in your workflow and have a clear point of view on where they elevate quality (and where they don’t).
  • You have built and maintained CI pipelines before - ideally with GitHub Actions or Google Cloud Build.
  • You have designed and built automated test frameworks, and you understand the challenges microservices pose for reliable integration and end-to-end testing.
  • You are familiar with Kubernetes beyond the basics - you can write a Helm chart for a new service with relative ease, you understand best practices around security, and you have prior job experience or certifications to prove this.
  • You have worked at a startup before - you understand that things don’t always go according to plan, that there is significant technical debt, that some tasks just need to be done, and that sometimes there are no processes or documentation to guide your hand.
  • You are not afraid of taking a task from start to finish - gathering requirements, figuring out and implementing the best technical solution, then deploying and monitoring the results.

Who You Might Be (Bonus Points)

  • You have used AI/LLM tooling to build QA automation - test generation, flaky-test triage, or incident-to-regression pipelines - and can speak to what worked and what didn’t.
  • You have written code in Python or TypeScript, and can build efficient Dockerfiles and secure container images.
  • You have implemented load tests with k6 (REST) and ghz (gRPC) and have experience analyzing pprof/trace output.
  • You have done IaC deployments with Argo CD or Terraform, or have used Google Cloud Platform and Google Kubernetes Engine before. You are familiar with Tilt and have written a Kubernetes Operator before.
  • You have practiced chaos engineering - running fault-injection or resilience experiments with tools like Chaos Mesh, LitmusChaos, or Gremlin.
  • You are familiar with testing event-driven systems using Kafka (or even better, Redpanda).

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

Recruitment Privacy Policy

job.title: Quality Engineer (SDET)
job.description:
About StarCompliance

StarCompliance is on a mission to make compliance simple and easy. Trusted globally by enterprise financial institutions, the user-friendly STAR platform empowers organizations to achieve regulatory compliance while safeguarding their integrity and business reputations. Through a customizable, 360-degree view of employee activity, the STAR software enables firms to automate the detection and resolution of potential areas of conflict while streamlining daily workflows and increasing efficiency.

Role

The Platform Quality Engineer is a hands-on engineering role within StarCompliance’s centralised Platform Quality Engineering function, responsible for ensuring platform-level quality assurance across the enterprise SaaS platform.
Reporting to the Lead Quality Architect, the Platform Quality Engineer contributes directly to the design, implementation, and maintenance of automated quality controls that validate cross-service integration, core enterprise user journeys, and non-functional platform characteristics. The role is focused primarily on integration and API-level testing across a distributed, cloud-native system, including asynchronous and event-driven workflows.
StarCompliance’s enterprise platform is built on distributed services and cloud infrastructure, including messaging and integration components such as Azure Service Bus. The Platform Quality Engineer is expected to understand how these systems behave under load, failure, and recovery conditions, and how to test them to ensure reliability, resilience, and performance at scale.
The role places strong emphasis on validating failure modes, resilience, and recovery behaviour across distributed services, diagnosing complex system failures using logs, telemetry, and test data, and contributing to enterprise performance testing.
The Platform Quality Engineer works closely with Product Owners and engineering teams to understand upcoming platform changes and integrations, ensuring the enterprise platform is validated under realistic functional and load scenarios ahead of release

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain automated tests primarily at the integration and API layers to validate behaviour across distributed services.
  • Develop tests that validate asynchronous and event-driven workflows, including messaging, retries, ordering, and failure scenarios (e.g. Azure Service Bus–based integrations).
  • Contribute production-quality code to shared automation frameworks and quality tooling used across the enterprise platform.
  • Design and execute performance and scalability tests for the enterprise SaaS platform
  • Build and maintain performance test data, scenarios, and workloads that reflect real-world usage patterns, including message throughput and concurrency.
  • Integrate automated functional and performance tests into CI/CD pipelines, contributing to reliable, high-signal quality gates.
  • Support validation activities within the Staging environment as the primary platform integration and quality assurance layer
  • Analyse functional, integration, and performance test results to identify systemic platform risks and improvement opportunities.
  • Partner with Product Owners to understand upcoming platform changes and integrations, preparing targeted integration and performance tests in advance.
  • Collaborate with architecture, platform, and engineering teams to improve system testability, reliability, and observability.
  • Apply AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate test creation, improve coverage, analyse failures, and reduce test flakiness.
  • Adhere to and contribute to quality standards, patterns, and engineering practices defined by the centralised Platform Quality Engineering function

Skills and Experience

  • Demonstrable experience in platform- or enterprise-scale SaaS application quality assurance, with a focus on validating integration, non-functional characteristics, and release readiness across distributed systems.
  • Strong coding skills in one or more of C#, TypeScript, or Python, with the ability to write clean, maintainable, production-quality code.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and maintaining automated tests at the integration and API layers for distributed, cloud-native systems.
  • Solid understanding of cloud-native architectures and how to test them, including messaging, asynchronous processing, retries, ordering, and failure handling
  • Hands-on experience testing event-driven systems using cloud messaging or integration technologies (e.g. Azure Service Bus, Kafka, SNS/SQS, or similar).
  • Strong hands-on experience with performance testing tools and approaches (e.g. k6, JMeter, Gatling, or similar).
  • Experience designing realistic performance test scenarios and generating representative test data, including load, concurrency, and message-driven workloads.
  • Practical experience integrating functional and performance testing into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred).
  • Experience diagnosing complex system failures using logs, telemetry, and test data.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve productivity, test quality, or failure analysis.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to reason about system behaviour and failure modes in distributed environment

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Relevant certifications in cloud platforms (Azure preferred), performance testing, or quality engineering are beneficial but not required.

AI

  • At StarCompliance, we’re dedicated to leading the way in innovation by seamlessly integrating AI into our offerings. We encourage our team to fully embrace these advanced tools, empowering us to work more efficiently, create with greater precision, and deliver exceptional value to our clients.

    • Integrity and Ethics

  • All StarCompliance employees are expected to commit to a high standard of personal integrity and carry out their responsibilities in an ethical manner

job.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer | Remote LATAM Only
job.description:
We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer to strengthen our quality assurance process. Although the platform has existing automation in place, recurring bugs and unstable releases reveal structural gaps in quality coverage.

This role requires a highly skilled engineer capable of auditing the current automation, rebuilding unstable areas, improving test strategy, and ensuring reliable, defect-free releases.

You will collaborate closely with Development, DevOps, and Product teams to implement best practices, optimize testing workflows, and elevate overall product quality.

Key Responsibilities

1. Automation Quality & Test Architecture

  • Audit existing automation to identify false positives, flakiness, outdated libraries, missing regression coverage, and low-value tests.
  • Refactor or rebuild automation for stability, maintainability, and scalability.
  • Define the automation scope for the upcoming delivery cycle (new features, high-risk areas, historical bugs).
  • Implement best-practice patterns: Page Object Model, reusable fixtures, API abstraction, stable waits.

2. Functional & Regression Testing

  • Perform manual testing for new features with unclear or incomplete acceptance criteria.
  • Build/improve a complete regression suite integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Validate bug fixes and ensure test coverage prevents reoccurrence.
  • Report defect patterns and risk areas to leadership.

3. Testing Process & Standards

  • Create/update test strategy, test cases (manual + automated), test data plans, and acceptance criteria.
  • Document all test results clearly, ensuring traceability and reproducibility.
  • Enhance collaboration between QA, Dev, and Product to reduce defect leakage.

4. Environment & CI/CD

  • Work with DevOps to stabilize QA/UAT environments.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines with reliable pass/fail signals.
  • Reduce test flakiness and ensure poor-quality builds are blocked.

5. Release Quality Ownership

  • Validate release candidates end-to-end.
  • Execute smoke, sanity, exploratory, and performance testing when needed.
  • Provide clear go/no-go indicators based on quality KPIs.

Requirements

Technical Skills

  • Strong experience with automation frameworks: Cypress, Playwright, Selenium, WebdriverIO (depending on the stack).
  • API automation using Postman, REST Assured, or Playwright API.
  • Deep knowledge of waits, DOM handling, test data mocking/stubbing, and browser drivers.
  • Solid SQL knowledge for data validation.
  • Experience testing distributed systems, microservices, caching layers, and cloud environments.
  • Hands-on experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Jenkins, Azure DevOps).
  • Strong Git branching, PR review, and version-control best practices.

Quality Engineering Expertise

  • Ability to reverse-engineer unclear or undocumented features.
  • Strong root-cause analysis skills — understanding not only what fails, but why.
  • Ability to validate and correct inaccurate automation coverage claims.
  • Solid regression testing strategy.
  • Experience with performance/load testing tools (JMeter, k6) is a plus.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication with the ability to challenge assumptions diplomatically.
  • High sense of ownership — proactive, autonomous, and structured.
  • Transparent risk communication with PM/CTO and cross-functional teams.

Language Requirement

  • English: C1 required

job.title: Senior SDET, Agentic Quality
job.description:
About Onfleet

Onfleet’s mission is to power the future of commerce by enabling businesses of all sizes to move goods more efficiently and delightfully. Our product includes intuitive smartphone apps for drivers, a powerful modern web dashboard for logistics teams, and automatic notifications and real-time tracking for recipients. Onfleet powers millions of deliveries every week for thousands of businesses around the world across a range of industries, from grocery and prepared meals to pharmacy, flowers, and furniture.

About the role

Onfleet is hiring two senior SDETs to shape how our engineering teams build and trust automated quality. At Onfleet, the team that builds a feature owns its quality. Developers write and maintain their own tests. Your job is to make those teams better at it: you pair with them, teach, review, and find the cases they missed. You will not be the person who tests everyone else's work.

Together with our quality leads, you’ll own our test frameworks and the shared quality tooling every team depends on. You’ll also do feature development in production code and internal tooling. You’ll be part of our core quality engineering group, sometimes embedded on one team and sometimes working across several.

You’ll start by taking ownership of our existing automation and making it more reliable and complete, alongside greenfield work on new platform services. We measure this role by what the teams can do because you were there.

How We Work

We code using agents, and nearly 100% of our code is written this way. Generating code is the easy part. Knowing what good looks like, and holding the bar, is the job. The engineers who thrive here are scrutinizing and questioning: they reject AI slop and catch the wrong call before it ships.

Every engineer helps improve how we work instead of only following it. For this role that means building and improving the agentic tooling itself: test generation, review, verification, and the workflows around them.

We are candid and have a low ego. Challenge us on tooling direction, and expect to be challenged back.

What You’ll Do:

  • Strengthen the current suite. Improve reliability, extend coverage, and modernize patterns. A flaky test is a failing test.
  • Own the test frameworks. Unit, integration, and end-to-end, treated with the same care as production code.
  • Own the quality gates in CI/CD (continuous integration and continuous delivery). Pipelines, checks, and gates, so standards are enforced by the system and not by people.
  • Build agentic quality tooling. Extend the agents and workflows we use for test design, review, and verification.
  • Raise the bar through teams. Pair on test design, review code, help make hard-to-reach code testable, and write things down so the practice outlives any one person.
  • Ask the testability question early. In planning, ask how we'll test it and how we'll know it broke in production.
  • Know when a release is healthy. Metrics, dashboards and alerts that tell us something is wrong before a customer does, and that tell a team whether a release is safe to keep rolling out.
  • Ship features. Full-stack work in production code and internal tooling, alongside the teams you support.

What You'll Bring (required):

  • 8 or more years of professional software development experience, in any role.
  • 5 or more years where building and maintaining test automation was a core part of your job, as an SDET, test automation engineer, or software engineer who owned test infrastructure. Your title matters less than the work.
  • You build software, not just tests: test frameworks, internal tools, CI tooling, or product features. You want feature development in production code and internal tooling to be part of your job here.
  • Depth across unit, integration, and end-to-end testing, including hands-on work with a browser framework such as Playwright or Cypress.
  • Hands-on CI ownership: you have created, configured, or fixed a CI pipeline (GitHub Actions or equivalent), not just used one.
  • A track record of being the person who drove automated test coverage on a team, whatever your role was.
  • Working knowledge of DevOps practice: how code is built, deployed and monitored in production. You have added metrics, dashboards or alerts so a team knew when something broke.
  • Daily professional use of AI coding agents, and experience building or improving agentic tooling, not just using it.
  • A multiplier mindset: you get your satisfaction from the team shipping safer and faster, not from your own test count.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, roughly C1 level, and experience working day to day on an international team.

Nice To Have:

  • Mobile development (Android or iOS) and mobile test automation, using native frameworks such as Espresso or XCUITest, or cross-platform tools such as Appium or Maestro.
  • TypeScript, Node.js, and React.
  • Rust, or another statically typed language.
  • Clear evidence of driving CI/CD practice for a whole team or company.
  • Production canaries and progressive delivery: you have used production signals (error rates, latency, business metrics) to decide whether a release continues or rolls back, through canaries, feature flags or automated rollback.
  • Test data and environment management: getting a realistic system into a known state quickly and repeatably.
  • Test-driven development (TDD).
  • AWS and cloud-native services.

Location and Benefits:

  • Remote, open to candidates based in Canada or Latin America.
  • The team works on US Pacific Time. You'll need to reliably work a schedule that frequently matches US Pacific business hours (9am to 5pm PT).
  • Flexible PTO.
  • Laptop and work-from-home setup stipend.
  • Monthly technology stipends (internet and AI tooling).

Onfleet is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Onfleet's culture is one that strongly values diversity in its workplace and we are committed to working with potential team members who can bring diverse perspectives and experience to our company and culture.

We do not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state or federal law.

We highly encourage members of underrepresented groups to apply and we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $70,000 to $95,000 USD per year for candidates in both Canada and Latin America, depending on experience, skills, and background. Where an offer lands within that range reflects the depth and experience a candidate brings to the role.

How We Hire

You need an identity-verified LinkedIn profile to apply. That's the free "Verified" badge, the shield icon next to your name. We check for it, and applications without it don't move forward.

Before any offer, we verify your identity and work history. That includes a live video ID check and reference calls. We use AI, automated systems, and a person to review applications: every application that meets the requirements is also read by an engineering leader or a recruiter. If you misrepresent your identity or experience, the process ends.

job.title: QA Engineer — CTRM Platform
job.description:
About the role

A hands-on QA engineer owning the quality of our CTRM platform end to end: deciding what has to be tested, building the automation, finding the defects that matter and making sure they stay fixed. You work directly with backend engineers, the product manager, the data team, and the traders and finance users who will run their business on the system — no account manager in between.

Agents write most of the code here. That makes testing more important, not less: the team ships quickly, and a large part of quality now depends on independent verification that the system does what the business needs, not what the code happens to do.

What the work looks like

The system we are building exists so that anyone involved in a deal can reconstruct the P&L between any two points of the chain, at any moment, on an agreed and versioned allocation basis. A defect here is rarely a broken button. It is a pricing formula averaged over the wrong period, a provisional cost that is never replaced by the actual, a figure that changes when someone reruns last month, or an FX rate applied on the wrong date. Numbers from this system feed invoices, hedges and shareholder reporting.

Scope

  • Test strategy and test plans for the platform: deal capture, pricing and pricing periods, provisional and final invoicing, costs, demurrage and claims, P&L and margin, reporting
  • Automated tests at API, data and UI level, integrated into CI so every change runs against them
  • Realistic test data and scenarios — term contracts, multi-lot cargoes, price-formula deals, FX, late invoices, cost reallocation — and expected results someone in the business has signed off
  • Regression testing of calculations: the same deal must produce the same P&L, and a past date must reproduce the P&L as it stood then
  • Data and integration testing — market data feeds, imports from accounting and operations systems, reconciliation between the platform and the source it came from
  • Reviewing agent-written code and agent-written tests critically: a test that always passes is worse than no test
  • Working with users on acceptance testing and turning their “this number looks wrong” into a reproducible defect
  • Release quality: what is safe to ship, what is not, and why

Requirements

  • 4+ years in QA or software testing, with ownership of test strategy and automation on a business-critical product
  • Strong test automation in Python (pytest or similar) or another mainstream language; API testing; UI automation with Playwright, Cypress or similar
  • Good SQL and the ability to test data directly: write queries to check a calculation, find a population mismatch, prove a number wrong
  • Experience testing calculation-heavy or financial systems — trading, banking, payments, billing, ERP or accounting. You think in edge cases: rounding, dates and time zones, currencies, partial quantities, reversals and corrections
  • Understanding of CI/CD and of where tests belong in it
  • Working with coding agents, seriously. You use agents to write tests and tooling, and you know how they fail: tests that assert what the code does rather than what it should do, mocks that hide the real behaviour, coverage that looks high and checks nothing. We hire for verification habits, not speed
  • Precise written communication: defect reports a developer can reproduce on the first attempt, and test results a manager can act on
  • English sufficient to present findings and defend a release decision
  • Professional proficiency in Russian

Nice to have

  • Experience with CTRM/ETRM systems or energy or commodity trading — deal lifecycle, pricing formulas, invoicing, P&L
  • Performance and load testing
  • Property-based or data-driven testing for financial calculations
  • Experience setting up a QA function or test framework from scratch in a growing team

What we offer

  • Ownership of quality on the platform, and room to shape how testing is done
  • Direct access to founders, engineers and business users; short feedback loops
  • Generous AI tooling budget — frontier models are a working expense, not a perk
  • Competitive compensation, discussed individually

How to apply

Share your CV and an answer to any of the questions below, at your choice. Applications without answers are not reviewed.

  1. A cargo is priced on an average of five quotation days after the bill of lading, in USD, with costs invoiced in EUR. The P&L for this deal shown last month differs from what the system shows today for the same date, and nobody changed the deal. How would you test for this, what would you look at first, and what tests would you add so it cannot happen silently again?
  2. Give a real case where a defect reached production in a system where numbers mattered — money, quantities, prices. What was wrong, why did the tests miss it, how was it found, and what did you change?
  3. Show a real prompt or task brief you gave an agent to write tests, and what it produced. Then one case where agent-written tests looked good and did not actually protect anything: what was wrong, how you noticed, what you did instead.
  4. Which systems have you personally tested — trading, banking, payments, billing, ERP or accounting? Pick one and tell us about a defect class specific to that kind of system that someone without that experience would miss.

About the Opportunity

Ellucian is seeking a strategic and technically accomplished Senior Manager, Test & Quality Assurance to lead our global Quality Engineering organization within Professional Services. This highly visible leadership role is responsible for defining and executing our enterprise test and quality assurance strategy, ensuring consistent, scalable, and high-quality customer implementations across our global delivery organization.

Reporting into Professional Services, you will lead a distributed team of Quality Engineers across the United States and Latin America, while partnering closely with our India Center of Excellence (CoE) through a dotted-line leadership model to deliver a unified global quality strategy. In addition to leading a lean core team, you will oversee a scalable contractor workforce that supports implementations worldwide, ensuring consistent execution, governance, and quality standards regardless of delivery location.

This is more than a people leadership role. You will establish the vision, operating model, and quality engineering practices that enable Professional Services to deliver reliable, repeatable, and efficient customer implementations. Working closely with Services Delivery, Product Engineering, Cloud Operations, Customer Success, and our India CoE, you'll champion an automation-first mindset, modern testing practices, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance customer outcomes while improving delivery efficiency across the organization.

If you're passionate about building global teams, driving organizational transformation, and modernizing quality engineering at scale, this is an opportunity to shape how Ellucian delivers technology to higher education institutions around the world.

Where You Will Make an Impact

Global Quality Strategy & Leadership

  • Define and execute the global Test & Quality Assurance strategy for Professional Services, aligning quality initiatives with organizational priorities and customer delivery goals.
  • Lead and develop a distributed team of Quality Engineers across the United States and Latin America, while providing functional leadership and strategic direction to quality resources within our India Center of Excellence.
  • Build a cohesive global quality organization that operates consistently across multiple regions, balancing centralized governance with regional execution.
  • Manage and coordinate a flexible workforce that includes full-time employees and a global network of implementation partners and contractors supporting customer deployments.
  • Establish governance, standards, KPIs, and quality metrics that drive consistency, accountability, and continuous improvement across all delivery teams.
  • Foster a high-performing culture focused on collaboration, innovation, operational excellence, and customer success.

Quality Engineering & Automation

  • Drive the evolution of our Quality Engineering practice by championing automation-first testing strategies across the implementation lifecycle.
  • Define and implement enterprise testing frameworks utilizing technologies such as:
    • UI Automation (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium)
    • API Testing (Postman, REST Assured, SoapUI)
    • Performance Testing (JMeter, K6, Gatling)
    • Security Testing (OWASP ZAP or equivalent)
  • Develop reusable testing frameworks, accelerators, and best practices that improve delivery quality and implementation efficiency across global teams.
  • Partner with Engineering and DevOps teams to integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and modern delivery practices.
  • Establish scalable approaches for test data management, environment strategy, and quality governance across multiple implementation programs.

Delivery Excellence

  • Embed quality throughout the customer implementation lifecycle, ensuring testing is an integral part of delivery rather than a final validation step.
  • Partner with Professional Services leaders to standardize implementation quality across regions while maintaining flexibility to support customer-specific requirements.
  • Define operational dashboards and executive reporting that measure quality, automation maturity, implementation readiness, and customer delivery health.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives using customer feedback, delivery metrics, root cause analysis, and lessons learned.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate closely with Professional Services Delivery, Product Engineering, Cloud Operations, Customer Success, Product Management, and the India CoE to align quality objectives across the organization.
  • Influence cross-functional leaders to adopt modern quality engineering practices and automation strategies.
  • Serve as the executive point of contact for testing and quality assurance, providing strategic guidance on delivery risk, quality improvements, and operational readiness.
  • Build strong partnerships across global regions to ensure consistent execution, knowledge sharing, and continuous innovation.

What You Will Bring

  • 5+ years leading geographically distributed engineering or quality teams.
  • Experience managing teams across multiple regions, including North America, Latin America, and/or India.

Technical Expertise

job.title: Quality Assurance Specialist
job.description:
Position Summary

The Quality Assurance Specialist helps protect the integrity, quality, and reliability of the Maxsold marketplace.

This role reviews and executes refund requests, investigates suspicious bidding/selling activity, evaluates higher-risk transactions, identifies catalog quality concerns, and works across departments to address issues that may create customer, financial, operational, or reputational risk.

The Quality Assurance Specialist is expected to assess the available evidence, apply marketplace policies consistently, and make clear, well-supported decisions. This requires strong judgment, attention to detail, curiosity, and the ability to remain objective.

Success in this role is not simply identifying that something may be wrong. It requires determining what can be established, identifying what information is still needed, recommending or executing the appropriate action, and documenting the reasoning clearly.

What You Will Own

Refund Review and Resolution

  • Review refund requests submitted by buyers.
  • Assess buyer claims against listing information, photographs, communications, pickup reports from sellers, marketplace policies, and other available evidence.
  • Identify gaps, inconsistencies, or unsupported claims within the information provided and work to clarify them.
  • Request or coordinate the collection of additional evidence when required.
  • Determine whether refund requests should be approved, denied, or escalated for further review.
  • Execute approved refunds and ensure the appropriate internal or seller-funded treatment is applied.
  • Communicate refund decisions and supporting rationale clearly to the appropriate internal teams.
  • Identify repeated refund patterns involving buyers, sellers, listings, auction practices, or specific items.
  • Maintain accurate and complete records of decisions, evidence, and outcomes.

High-Risk Transaction Review

  • Review flagged first purchases and other transactions identified as presenting elevated risk.
  • Assess available account, payment, bidding, purchase, and behavioural information.
  • Determine whether activity can proceed, requires additional verification, or should be restricted or escalated.
  • Identify patterns that may indicate account misuse, payment risk, fraud, or coordinated activity.
  • Balance risk prevention with the need to avoid unnecessarily disrupting legitimate customers.
  • Document findings and decisions in a clear and reviewable manner.

Suspicious Bidding and Marketplace Conduct

  • Investigate reports or system flags involving suspicious bidding activity.
  • Review account connections, bidding patterns, payment information, refund behaviour, auction participation, and other relevant facts.
  • Distinguish between confirmed facts, risk indicators, and unproven assumptions.
  • Determine whether activity requires monitoring, education, restrictions, suspension, or leadership review.
  • Coordinate with Support, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, or Operations leadership where seller or buyer action may be required.
  • Maintain confidentiality and avoid disclosing sensitive investigation methods or account information unnecessarily.

Catalog and Auction Quality

  • Review auction catalogs before launch for prohibited items and marketplace risk.
  • Work with Seller Support, partners, and other internal teams to correct issues before launch.
  • Apply quality standards consistently while recognizing differences in auction type, category, and risk.
  • Identify repeated quality concerns and recommend education, process changes, or additional review.
  • Help improve catalog standards, review criteria, and preventive quality controls.

Fraud and Chargeback Risk Support

  • Identify transactions, accounts, or operational practices that may create fraud or chargeback exposure.
  • Gather and organize evidence required for internal review or chargeback response.
  • Work with Finance and Support to ensure relevant account, payment, communication, and pickup information is available.
  • Identify recurring causes of chargebacks and recommend preventive actions.
  • Escalate material financial or marketplace risk promptly.

Cross-Departmental Collaboration

  • Work closely with Buyer Support, Seller Support, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Operations leadership.
  • Provide clear, evidence-based guidance when other teams flag refund, fraud, bidding, catalog, or marketplace concerns.
  • Ask focused questions that help teams gather the information required for a decision.
  • Explain decisions and policy applications clearly.
  • Escalate complex or high-impact matters with complete context, supporting evidence, and a recommended next step.

Policy and Process Improvement

  • Surface emerging risk patterns and marketplace behaviours.
  • Recommend improvements to refund processes, catalog review, fraud controls, escalation standards, and internal documentation.
  • Participate in audits and targeted reviews of buyers, sellers, partners, auctions, or internal processes.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years experience in quality assurance, fraud prevention, dispute resolution, refunds, risk operations, marketplace operations, investigations, or a related field.
  • Strong critical-thinking and analytical skills.
  • Sound judgment when working with incomplete, conflicting, or emotionally presented information.
  • The ability to assess evidence objectively and separate facts from assumptions.
  • Strong written communication and documentation skills.
  • The confidence to make and explain decisions based on policy and available evidence.
  • A high level of attention to detail.
  • Curiosity and persistence when investigating unfamiliar or complex issues.
  • The ability to recognize patterns across accounts, transactions, auctions, and customer behaviour.
  • Strong organization and case-management habits.
  • The ability to manage competing priorities and time-sensitive reviews.
  • Comfort collaborating with multiple departments and challenging conclusions respectfully.
  • Discretion when handling confidential, sensitive, or potentially fraudulent activity.
  • The ability to remain calm and objective when decisions may be disputed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • A degree in a technical, analytical, or STEM-related field is strongly preferred, including Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Economics, Operations, or another related discipline.
  • Candidates without a traditional STEM degree may be considered if they can demonstrate strong analytical ability, technical aptitude, structured problem-solving, and experience learning complex systems.
  • 4+ years of experience in customer support, quality assurance, fraud or risk operations, dispute resolution, investigations, marketplace operations, or another role where you were responsible for reviewing information and making customer-impacting decision
  • Experience reviewing refund, fraud, payment, chargeback, or account-risk cases.
  • Familiarity with ticketing, CRM, payment-processing, or case-management systems.
  • Experience interpreting and applying customer-facing policies.
  • Experience reviewing product listings, catalogs, claims, or marketplace content.
  • Experience conducting audits or pattern-based investigations.
  • Familiarity with payment disputes, account verification, or transaction-risk indicators.
  • A track record of identifying process gaps and recommending practical improvements.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Quality Assurance Specialist:

  • Makes timely, consistent, and evidence-based decisions.
  • Applies policy accurately while recognizing when a matter requires additional judgment.
  • Approves valid refund requests and confidently denies unsupported requests.
  • Produces clear documentation that explains what happened, what evidence was reviewed, and why a decision was made.
  • Recognizes suspicious patterns and escalates them at the appropriate level.
  • Balances thoroughness with the need to make timely decisions.
  • Focuses effort on material customer, financial, operational, and reputational risk.
  • Contributes to stronger policies, processes, and preventive controls.
  • Earns trust through consistency, objectivity, discretion, and sound judgment.

Why This Role Matters

Quality Assurance protects the marketplace from preventable loss and harmful activity while ensuring suspicious behaviour, policy enforcement, and quality concerns are reviewed appropriately.

The work performed by this team affects buyer confidence, end-user accountability, auction quality, refund exposure, fraud prevention, chargeback risk, and Maxsold’s broader reputation.

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys investigating complex situations, weighing evidence, making defensible decisions, and improving the systems that protect a marketplace.

job.title: QA Engineer
job.description:
About the Role

High 5 Games is seeking a dedicated QA Engineer to help us build the next generation of land-based, online, mobile, and social games. We are looking for an outstanding software tester who thrives on hunting down bugs, has a keen eye for a flawless user experience, and possesses a genuine passion for the gaming industry.

As our QA Engineer, you will act as the final gatekeeper for our releases, going beyond surface-level checks to deeply analyze game logic, mechanics, and client/server backend systems. Collaborating directly with developers and designers in an Agile environment, you will be trusted with sensitive, pre-release game data—making absolute integrity, discretion, and reliability essential to your success.

Responsibilities

  • Game Analysis & Test Execution: Deeply analyze slot game mechanics and features to identify potential flaws. Write and execute thorough test plans and creative test cases, ensuring coverage of complex scenarios and edge cases that standard testing might miss.
  • Root Cause Analysis & Debugging: Analyze historical data, crash logs, and backtraces using basic debugging techniques to help engineers categorize and identify the root causes of issues.
  • Cross-Platform UI/UX QA: Ensure the user interface is top-notch by performing rigorous mobile (iOS/Android) and cross-browser testing for a seamless player experience.
  • Backend Verification: Conduct robust API and Database (DB) testing to ensure secure, accurate data flow, wallet transactions, and seamless server integrations.
  • Agile Collaboration: Participate actively in our Agile development cycle and stand-ups, working proactively with cross-functional teams to resolve issues early in the process.
  • Bug Tracking & Adaptability: Identify, isolate, and document complex bugs clearly in a fast-paced environment that often requires frequent shifts in focus. Manage your workflow to meet strict production deadlines without compromising quality.

Requirements

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent experience) with a minimum of 5 years of hands-on QA testing experience in the software or gaming industry.
  • Slot Game Expertise: Proven experience testing slot games (understanding RNG, paylines, bonus features) and a passion for casino and social/mobile gaming.
  • Core Technical QA: Demonstrable experience in API testing (e.g., Postman, REST Assured), Database testing (e.g., SQL queries), and working with command-line tools for debugging.
  • Platform Knowledge: Strong background testing native and web-based mobile applications, with a solid working knowledge of iOS, Android, Windows, and Linux operating systems.
  • Certifications: Must hold a recognized Software Testing Certificate (such as ISTQB or equivalent) to demonstrate a solid foundational understanding of formal software testing methodologies.
  • Tools: Familiarity with bug tracking software, specifically JIRA.

job.title: Staff Software Engineer, QE
job.description:
About AlphaSense:

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Role:

As a Staff Quality Engineer on the Content Portfolio team, you will own and drive test strategy, build automation frameworks, and embed a culture of quality ownership across the engineering organization. Your deep expertise in automation, cloud services, Kubernetes, and modern programming languages will directly shape how we test, release, and deliver reliable software at scale. You will partner closely with developers, product managers, and platform teams to define test requirements, architect quality infrastructure, and ensure AlphaSense ships with confidence at velocity.

You will:

  • Lead the development of test automation frameworks across UI, API, and GraphQL layers, focusing on reliability, maintainability, and speed

  • Design and integrate AI evaluation frameworks to assess accuracy, consistency, and reliability of LLM-powered features

  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and Claude to accelerate test creation, debugging, and code generation

  • Lead technical implementation of performance testing and monitoring solutions

  • Develop custom reporting and analytics tools to provide insights into test coverage, flaky test rates, and quality metrics

  • Drive adoption of newer testing technologies and approaches

  • Optimize test execution pipelines for faster feedback in CI/CD environments

  • Partner with development teams to implement shift-left testing practices and embed quality ownership within teams

  • Lead root cause analysis for critical issues and drive systematic improvements to prevent recurrence

  • Participate in code reviews to ensure testability and quality considerations are addressed early

  • Provide technical mentorship to QE engineers on automation best practices, framework usage, and AI tooling

Desired Skills:

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in software quality engineering roles with at least 2 years operating at a Staff/Lead level.

  • Deep proficiency in testing TypeScript/JavaScript and modern frontend ecosystems (React, Webpack, or similar).

  • Expert-level experience with Playwright or comparable browser automation frameworks (Cypress, Selenium WebDriver) for end-to-end testing.

  • Strong experience with unit and component testing frameworks such as Vitest, Jest, or React Testing Library.

  • Proven track record of designing and building test automation frameworks from scratch or significantly evolving existing ones at scale.

  • Solid understanding of CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Buildkite, Gitlab or similar) and how to integrate and optimize test suites within them.

  • Experience with GraphQL APIs - Writing integration tests, mocking schemas, and validating query/mutation contracts.

  • Familiarity with performance and load testing tools (k6, Lighthouse, Artillery).

  • Experience with visual regression testing (Percy, Chromatic, Playwright visual comparisons).

  • Hands-on experience with Allure or similar test reporting/analytics platforms.

  • Understanding of AI/ML-powered products and the unique testing challenges they present (non-deterministic outputs, data quality, model evaluation).

  • Experience in SaaS, fintech, or market intelligence domains.

  • Track record of contributing to developer experience improvements like test tooling plugins, custom ESLint rules for test quality, documentation-as-code practices.

  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP).

  • Familiarity with AI/LLM evaluation frameworks

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Claude for accelerating test authoring, code review, and debugging.

  • Experience building or configuring MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers

job.title: Lead Software Test Engineer, Safety Critical Embedded Systems
job.description:
About Forterra

At Forterra, we are unleashing autonomy at scale to transform the battlefield. Our mission is to build the foundational platforms that enable an intelligent ecosystem to coordinate, adapt, and execute with speed and precision even in the uncertainty and disruption of modern conflict. In an era marked by rapid technological change and evolving threats, we design for flexibility, survivability, and operational dominance.

Forterra delivers weapons, sensors, and battlefield effects through integrated autonomous networks reaching operational areas faster, safer, and without placing human lives at risk. Our systems operate with distributed control, dynamic routing, and real-time responsiveness, enabling sustained advantage across complex mission environments.

About the role

Forterra is looking for a Lead Software Test Engineer to establish and run verification and validation for the safety critical embedded software used on our autonomous ground vehicles. This is initially an individual contributor role. You will set the software test approach, build the automation and test environments, execute the work, and maintain the evidence needed for customer and safety reviews. You will work closely with software, systems, and safety engineers to find problems early and make sure the software behaves correctly when things go wrong. As the capability grows, the role may develop into a technical lead for a small test team

Someone who can build a practical software test capability from the ground up and is comfortable working directly in the code, test environments, and evidence. This person should be able to work across software, systems, and safety engineering while staying focused on finding meaningful failures and making the product more dependable

What you'll do

  • Set the verification and validation approach for safety critical embedded software from kickoff through qualification, including the test plan, test procedures, results, and reports.
  • Turn system, software, and safety related requirements into practical tests with objective pass or fail criteria.
  • Maintain traceability between requirements, tests, results, and anomalies.
  • Build and maintain automated test frameworks for embedded software, including software in the loop and hardware in the loop environments.
  • Exercise failure behavior through fault injection, timing and jitter tests, communications failures, memory faults, power and clock faults, negative tests, boundary tests, and stress tests.
  • Use static analysis, dynamic analysis, and coverage results to find gaps and help the team close them.
  • Prepare and maintain test evidence, including plans, procedures, results, V&V matrices, compliance matrices, anomaly records, tool qualification records, and contributions to the safety case.
  • Work with software, systems, and safety engineers to review designs for testability, improve requirements, and support technical reviews and assessments.
  • Provide technical guidance through test plan reviews, design reviews, pairing, and mentoring.
  • Help establish the practices and infrastructure needed to grow a small software test capability.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent experience may be considered.
  • Five or more years of experience testing embedded systems or safety critical software.
  • Strong working knowledge of C or C++ and Python for test automation.
  • Experience working with requirements management and requirements traceability using tools such as Jama or DOORS.
  • Familiarity with MISRA C or MISRA C++, static analysis, and structural coverage methods such as branch coverage and MC/DC.
  • Experience testing software on an RTOS such as QNX, including work with embedded targets, debuggers, and instrumentation.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to separate hardware, software, and firmware problems in a complex system.
  • A practical, organized approach to managing several priorities and producing clear technical documentation.
  • Ability to work remotely with up to 25% travel

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience applying safety critical development and assurance standards such as ISO 26262, IEC 61508,
  • DO-178C, MIL-STD-882E, JSSSEH, or JS-SSA-IG.
  • Experience with QNX, Linux, NXP S32G, or similar embedded platforms.
  • Experience with CAN, CAN-FD, Ethernet, UDS, J1939, or other vehicle networks and diagnostic protocols.
  • Understanding of robotics domains such as motion control, planning, perception, fault management, and vehicle interfaces.
  • Experience integrating electromechanical systems in automotive, aerospace, medical, industrial, defense, or similar environments.
  • Experience providing technical leadership through design reviews, mentoring, or improvements to shared test and development practices.

US Salary Range

$125,000.00.—$150,000.00 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate and is based on a wide variety of compensation factors. The salary offered to candidates will vary based on a variety of factors including (but not limited to) relevant work experience, education, specialized training, critical expertise, training, and more. Equity in Forterra is included in most of our full-time, high-demand roles and is therefore considered part of Forterra’s overall compensation package. In addition to base salary and equity, Forterra offers competitive benefits for full-time employees including:

  • Premium Healthcare Benefits: Three plan options, including an HSA-eligible plan, with Forterra covering 80% of the plan premium for you and your dependents.
  • Basic Life/AD&D, short and long-term disability insurance plans 100% covered by Forterra, plus the option to purchase additional life insurance for you and your dependents.
  • Extremely generous company holiday calendar including a winter break in December.
  • Competitive paid time off (PTO) offering 20 days accrued per year.
  • A minimum of 7 weeks fully paid parental leave for birth/adoption.
  • A $9k annual tuition reimbursement or professional development stipend.
  • Fully stocked beverage refrigerators with all the Celsius your little heart desires.
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan, including traditional, Roth 401(k), and after-tax deferral with company match up to 4%.

Your recruiter will be able to share more information about our salary and benefits offering during the hiring process.

CLEARANCE ELIGIBILITY - This position may require eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance. For more information about U.S. Security Clearances: click here. 

Forterra is an equal-opportunity employer, providing and promoting equal employment opportunity in all personnel practices. Forterrans are unique, talented individuals who are united through a shared passion to deliver autonomous systems that enable national resilience and a robust supply chain.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any factor, including veteran and disability status, and criminal history, in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws.

Forterra is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

AdvantixxRCM is a healthcare revenue-cycle management company supporting medical practices and healthcare organizations with accurate, compliant, and service-focused billing operations. RCM Quality Assurance & Compliance Specialist

This role audits revenue-cycle work, identifies operational and compliance risk, and helps teams prevent errors before they affect patients, clients, payers, or collections.

Responsibilities

  • Audit claims, account notes, coding-related workflows, eligibility, authorization, payment posting, A/R, denials, and client reports against approved standards.
  • Track error rates, root causes, corrective actions, and repeat findings; maintain defensible audit documentation.
  • Review adherence to payer, client, HIPAA, privacy, security, minimum-necessary, ethical-billing, and company requirements.

Performance

Your Role

This is not a “run the test plan someone else wrote” role. Until now, engineers have checked their own releases. The product has grown into a web app, connections to outside systems and AI chat features, so each release now needs someone who can say whether it’s ready, with evidence. New federal Medicaid rules start January 1, 2027, and the team is building tools that help states keep eligible people covered through them. You’ll start by building the automated tests and the ready-to-ship check for the releases closest to that date. It’s a hands-on, senior seat with no direct reports. You decide where the risk is, which team needs you most, and what “done” means.

You’ll:

  • Test strategy and automation

    • Decide where the product is most likely to break and what gets tested first

    • Pick the tools and run everything in GitHub Actions

  • Release verdicts

    • Give engineers a “ready / not ready” note before each release: what passed, what failed, what nobody checked

You Bring:

  • 5+ years in quality, test or software engineering, with automation you wrote yourself, running in CI and kept by other engineers

This new platform will serve as the foundation for all clinical data and operations across every line of business. By creating a robust and innovative solution, this leader will enable enhanced care management, utilization management, and data-driven decision-making—ultimately working to improve healthcare outcomes for millions of Americans.

Role & responsibilities

The Senior QA on this transformative project is responsible for building and leading a team of collaborative
In this role, you'll be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive data validation strategies, investigating discrepancies, and ensuring that reports and data extracts accurately reflect underlying business data and requirements. You'll work closely with technical and business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into effective testing approaches.
  • Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans to validate reporting systems, data extracts, and business intelligence outputs.
  • Write, optimize, and peer-review complex SQL queries to verify data accuracy, transformations, and reporting logic.
  • Trace data lineage across source systems, ETL processes, and reporting layers to identify inconsistencies and ensure data integrity.
  • Validate calculations, aggregations, formatting, and business metrics against backend data and established requirements.
  • Investigate data discrepancies by analyzing raw datasets, SQL logic, and ETL pipelines to identify root causes.
  • Identify edge cases, unexpected data patterns, and potential risks that could affect reporting quality.
  • Document and track defects, providing clear reproduction steps, technical findings, and recommendations for resolution.
  • Collaborate with data engineers, reporting teams, and business stakeholders to clarify requirements and establish effective validation criteria.
  • Maintain SQL scripts, test cases, and technical documentation using Git and established version control practices.
  • Develop and maintain documentation covering test scenarios, QA procedures, validation results, and data definitions.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve data quality, testing efficiency, and overall QA processes.
  • Take ownership of assigned testing activities, ensuring accurate and reliable reporting deliverables.

You’re a Perfect Match If You Have:

  • Advanced SQL & Code Review: Strong experience writing, optimizing, and reviewing complex SQL queries to ensure data accuracy, logical correctness, and performance.
  • Data Lineage Analysis: Proven ability to trace data from source systems through transformation processes to reporting layers, ensuring consistency and integrity.
  • Test Design & Execution: Hands-on experience designing, documenting, and executing comprehensive test plans and test cases from scratch.
  • Data Validation: Strong experience validating data extracts, aggregations, calculations, and formatting against backend data sources.
  • Root Cause Analysis: Ability to investigate raw data, ETL pipelines, and SQL queries to identify the underlying causes of data discrepancies and recommend effective solutions.
  • Complex Query Debugging: Experience isolating issues in complex SQL queries by breaking down logic and identifying inconsistencies.
  • Edge Case Testing: Ability to identify non-obvious scenarios, data anomalies, and potential failures that may affect reporting accuracy.
  • Version Control: Experience using Git to manage SQL scripts, test code, and technical documentation, including branching and pull requests.
  • Defect Management: Experience documenting, tracking, and reporting defects with clear reproduction steps, supporting evidence, and root cause findings.
  • Business Requirements & Metrics: Ability to translate business requirements into actionable testing criteria and validate reporting logic against established business definitions and KPIs.
  • Technical Documentation: Strong ability to document test cases, QA processes, validation results, and data dictionaries for technical and business stakeholders.
  • Ownership & Problem-Solving: Proactive approach to identifying data quality risks, improving QA processes, and independently investigating complex issues.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with data engineering, reporting, and business teams.

The Offer

Newfire Global is committed to consistent compensation practices across our organization. Total compensation for this role is market driven, with a salary of $103,853 - $145.650. Base pay is ultimately determined based on a candidate's skills, expertise, and experience.

job.title: Senior Manager, Software Quality Engineering (V&V)
job.description:
Join Clario, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, as a Senior Manager, Software Quality Engineering, leading the development and execution of strategic initiatives within eCOA Service Delivery Quality Engineering.

This includes establishing and implementing process and technology standards for all eCOA projects to ensure quality and timeliness for all deliverables.

This role is accountable for the delivery of accurate and dependable products that meet customer needs with the overarching goals of increased customer satisfaction, reduced cycle times, increased efficiency and completeness of testing coverage at all stages of testing.


What We Offer


  • Competitive compensation and incentives.
  • Private health, pension, and life insurance.
  • Engaging employee programs.
  • Modern technology for remote collaboration.

What You'll Be Doing


  • Establishes and implements process and technology standards for all eCOA projects to ensure quality and timeliness for all deliverables (Initial Release, Reports, Translations, and Change Control).
  • Works with SQE V&V Department Leader on management of offshore testing vendors, including resource management and capacity planning
  • Redefines processes and procedures related to system validation by leveraging industry best practices and stronger alignment to technology advancements such as test automation and AI.
  • Drive improvements in validation capabilities by applying test automation and AI concepts and tools.
  • Establishes software quality standards for study configuration life cycle, documentation, development methods, testing and maintenance.
  • Manages the day-to-day operations within the QA testing department, including direct reports and offshore team. This includes approving timesheets, reviewing training records to ensure all staff members are in compliance, as well as resolving issues and conflicts regarding project progress.
  • Works with Managers to improve department efficiency without sacrificing quality by introducing best practices, test automation etc. through collection and analysis of software quality metrics.
  • Partners with HR on hiring, development, and performance management of team members.
  • Resource reallocation: Works with managers and team leads to rearrange SQE resource as needed within the squad teams
  • Builds departmental strategies aligned to support Corporate Goals and positions tactical plans to ensure delivery excellence.
  • Develops, maintains & reports key performance Indicators within department and with technology and service partners to ensure quality, timeliness and productivity goals are met.
  • Directly supervises the performance of the Project SQE Managers, providing leadership and solving technical challenges as necessary. Hires, trains and manages SQE Managers/ personnel.

Other responsibilities:


  • Writes, maintains and contributes to all Service Delivery QA standard operating procedures as needed.
  • Attends all Project review meeting (DSE, Ops review etc.,)
  • Ensures the quality and timely delivery of all software validation efforts. Provides insight and guidance to the project team management on testing approach, best practices, scheduling, effort estimations, regulatory expectations, etc. Ensures that validation efforts are completed in accordance to Clario SOPs.
  • Monitors project testing progress daily, reviews issues and develops mitigation plans for projects that are at risk of not completing on time, or do not complete on time. Follows up with appropriate staff to communicate risks and plan to move forward.
  • Manages and administers the systems and tools used in the department (JIRA, GIT, Jama)
  • Responds to audit observations and ensures implementation of any CAPAs.
  • Reviews all projects status with team and resolves any risks with a goal of meeting all target dates without fail.
  • Implements new tools and process as necessary
  • Works with managers to provide guidance on individual development and growth plans
  • Manages strategic services and technology business partnerships including Offshore Quality Assurance/Validation resources

What We Look For


  • BS, BA or equivalent in an Information Technology or related field required.
  • Minimum 12 years Global Clinical Operations experience with a focus on the clinical trial phases and associated lifecycles OR Minimum 12 years' experience in Software Delivery Operation (Client Operations)
  • Minimum 10 years of software validation experience, preferably in a regulated environment.
  • Proven experience in Test Automation and AI a strong plus.

At Clario, a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, our purpose is to transform lives by unlocking better evidence. It’s a cause that unites and inspires us. It’s why we come to work and how we empower our people to make a positive impact every day. Whether you're advancing clinical science, building innovative technology, or supporting our global teams, your work helps bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.
