job.title: Software Verification & Test Engineer
job.description:
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Software Verification & Test Engineer

Remote | East Coast Hours | Up to 10% Travel | Full Time

Position Overview

Crown Innovations is seeking an experienced Aviation Software Verification & Test Engineer to support the development, verification, and certification of advanced aviation navigation systems.

This position will support functional, system, performance, and hardware/software integration testing for safety critical avionics applications. The selected engineer will develop and execute test cases, test scripts, procedures, and verification activities designed to evaluate system performance against defined technical and certification requirements.

The role requires deep experience with DO-178C software verification and certification, avionics software and hardware testing, requirements-based verification, and safety critical aviation systems. The successful candidate must be capable of independently analyzing requirements, developing verification approaches, executing tests, evaluating results, documenting anomalies, and producing high-quality verification evidence.

This position also requires hands on experience with SCADE, strong Java development experience, and familiarity with avionics certification and aircraft safety analysis.

The ideal candidate is an experienced verification engineer who combines strong software development knowledge with rigorous testing discipline, exceptional attention to detail, and a thorough understanding of safety critical aviation software development and certification.

Key Responsibilities

Software Verification & Testing

  • Develop, review, and execute software and system test cases, test scripts, and test procedures.
  • Perform requirements-based verification of safety critical avionics software.
  • Conduct functional, system, integration, and performance testing.
  • Verify software behavior against system and software requirements.
  • Analyze test results and identify, document, and investigate anomalies.
  • Perform regression testing following software or requirements changes.
  • Support software verification activities throughout the avionics development lifecycle.
  • Ensure test artifacts are complete, traceable, repeatable, and suitable for certification evidence.

Avionics Hardware & Software Integration

  • Perform software testing on avionics hardware platforms and integrated hardware/software environments.
  • Support hardware/software integration testing associated with navigation avionics.
  • Evaluate system behavior under normal, abnormal, and boundary conditions.
  • Troubleshoot software, hardware, interface, and integration issues.
  • Support simulation, bench testing, and hardware in the loop testing environments when applicable.
  • Collaborate with software, systems, hardware, and test engineers to isolate and resolve technical issues.

DO-178C Certification & Compliance

  • Perform verification activities in accordance with DO-178C objectives.
  • Support preparation and maintenance of verification evidence required for avionics certification.
  • Ensure traceability between system requirements, software requirements, test procedures, test results, and identified anomalies.
  • Participate in requirements reviews, test reviews, peer reviews, and certification related activities.
  • Support development and review of verification documentation and certification artifacts.
  • Assist with identifying and resolving verification gaps or compliance issues.

Requirements Analysis & Traceability

  • Review system and software requirements for clarity, completeness, consistency, and testability.
  • Develop test cases and procedures directly from approved requirements.
  • Maintain bidirectional traceability between requirements and verification artifacts.
  • Support requirements management and analysis using IBM DOORS or comparable requirements management tools.
  • Identify ambiguous, incomplete, or conflicting requirements and coordinate resolution with engineering stakeholders.

SCADE & Software Development Support

  • Utilize SCADE within model-based software development and verification environments.
  • Support verification of SCADE generated or model-based avionics software.
  • Apply Java development experience to support software development, testing, automation, troubleshooting, or verification activities.
  • Review software behavior and implementation as necessary to support test development and anomaly investigation.
  • Collaborate with development engineers throughout verification and certification activities.

Safety Critical Aviation Systems

  • Support verification and certification activities for navigation avionics and related aircraft systems.
  • Apply understanding of aircraft safety, system safety, and certification considerations when developing verification approaches.
  • Support analysis of system performance and navigation related functionality.
  • Participate in technical reviews involving software, hardware, systems engineering, and certification stakeholders.
  • Maintain rigorous quality standards consistent with safety critical aviation development.

Documentation & Technical Collaboration

  • Develop clear and complete test procedures, test reports, verification records, and technical documentation.
  • Document defects, anomalies, corrective actions, and test results.
  • Communicate technical findings clearly to engineering teams and program stakeholders.
  • Participate in peer reviews of requirements, test cases, procedures, results, and verification artifacts.
  • Support reporting program and technical status activities as required.

Minimum Required Qualifications

  • Minimum eight years of professional software development, software verification, software testing, or related engineering experience.
  • Minimum five years of Java development experience.
  • Direct professional experience using SCADE.
  • Direct experience supporting DO-178C software development, verification, testing, or certification activities.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing requirements-based software test cases and procedures.
  • Experience performing functional, system, integration, or performance testing of avionics systems.
  • Experience testing software in conjunction with avionics hardware.
  • Experience supporting avionics certification and testing activities.
  • Experience with navigation avionics, aircraft navigation systems, inertial navigation systems, or closely related aviation systems.
  • Experience with FAA certification activities, aircraft safety analysis, or other safety critical aviation development processes.
  • Ability to analyze software and system requirements and translate requirements into executable verification activities.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to software quality.
  • Strong written and verbal technical communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently within a remote engineering environment.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with IBM DOORS or comparable requirements management and traceability tools.
  • Experience performing detailed requirements analysis.
  • Experience with inertial navigation, GPS aided navigation, guidance, or control systems.
  • Experience with test automation.
  • Experience developing or maintaining automated test frameworks.
  • Experience with hardware in the loop, simulation, or laboratory test environments.
  • Experience with structural coverage analysis tools such as VectorCAST, LDRA, or comparable tools.
  • Familiarity with static analysis tools.
  • Experience with Python, C, C++, or other languages commonly used in embedded avionics verification.
  • Familiarity with DO-254, ARP4754A, ARP4761, or related aviation development and certification standards.
  • Experience supporting FAA or military airworthiness certification activities.

Work Environment & Schedule

This position is remote and requires availability during Eastern Time business hours.

Travel of up to 10% may be required to support program activities, technical reviews, integration, testing, or customer needs.

The position requires close collaboration with software, systems, hardware, certification, and program engineering teams.

Compensation

Aviation Software Verification & Test Engineer: $100,000 to $150,000 annually

Compensation is determined based on experience, technical expertise, certifications, education, internal equity, and business needs.

Crown complies with all applicable state and local pay transparency laws. The listed compensation range represents the good faith salary range for this position at the time of posting. Final compensation will be based on job-related factors.

Benefits

• Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)

• Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

• Health Savings Account (HSA)

• Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

• 401(k) with Company Match

• Company Paid Life Insurance

• Tuition Reimbursement

• Employee Assistance Program

• Professional Development Opportunities

About Crown

Crown Innovations is a recognized leader in research, development, engineering, advanced integration, analytics, software, and strategic planning, with deep expertise supporting the modernization and continued evolution of the National Airspace System.

For more than 30 years, Crown has supported a diverse portfolio of government and commercial clients, including the Federal Aviation Administration, NASA, the U.S. Energy Information Administration, state and local governments, and commercial organizations.

As a prime contractor supporting high impact federal programs, Crown provides comprehensive capabilities across engineering, infrastructure modernization, lifecycle data management, modeling and simulation, software development, regulatory compliance, and emerging technologies.

Our employees play a direct role in advancing aviation safety, improving operational performance, modernizing critical infrastructure, and supporting nationally significant programs.

Crown has consistently been recognized as one of the best places to work in the Washington, DC metropolitan area and is committed to providing employees with opportunities to grow professionally while contributing to meaningful, mission driven work.

Compliance & Equal Opportunity

Persons unable to complete an online application should contact Crown HR for assistance at (703) 650 0663 ext. 3068.

job.title: Senior Auditor, Quality Assurance
job.description:
Job Description

The Senior Auditor, Quality Assurance role is a senior role that effectively manages and conducts internal and contracted audits for the Company and for Company’s Clients. The role provides input into audit strategy and risk-based audit planning and leads process and complex audits, as well as providing QA consultancy activities within their area of GxP expertise.

Core responsibilities of the Senior Auditor are:

  • Auditing
  • Within area of their GxP expertise, conduct audits initiated by the Company, or contracted by small to mid-size Clients, according to the agreed Audit Program including effective management of pre-audit activities.

Audit types may include:

    • Audits of Company Partners and Vendors/Service Providers
    • Internal System Audits
    • Study audits (e.g. of study files, investigational sites)
    • Audits of Third Parties on behalf of Clients (e.g. including MAH PV System, Vendors, MAH Affiliate/ Partner Audits).
      • Reviews and approves all final CAPA plans from contracted audits within timelines mandated by Company/ Client procedures
    • Consultancies e.g. Client PV / QMS system gap analysis, SOP development, etc.
  • Main QA contact for designated Clients and plans, conducts and reports on audits requested by Clients
  • Quality as a Service
    • Attend commercial meetings related to Quality as a Service
    • Supports Clients with a wide variety of Quality as a Service activities, including
      • Mock inspections
      • Training
      • Gap analysis
      • Procedure drafting and revision
  • Other
    • Supports audits and inspections of the Company performed by Clients/third parties and regulatory authorities
    • Works with the Quality leadership to develop and train Auditors and other quality employees
    • Assists in the development of strategic internal audit program
    • Maintain an up-to-date knowledge of international regulatory requirements, guidelines and best practices and actively participate in knowledge-sharing and learning process to ensure personal and team continuous learning and development
    • Participate in preparation (authoring or QC) of audit strategy, SOPs, guidelines and other documented procedures required for auditing activity of the Company and/or Client as per operational needs
  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific discipline required; Master’s degree preferred, or equivalent relevant industry experience.

Experience

  • Strong previous pharmaceutical and/or biotech pharmacovigilance experience, including strong understanding of GVP & GCP related Quality Management and Assurance, with previous experience of GVP and GCP auditing experience in an Audit Lead role.
  • Analytical, written and oral communication skills
  • Ability to manage all tasks assigned and effectively deliver all expected deliverables in an organized and a timely manner
  • Proactively communicate changes in pre-established goals and deadlines
  • Ability to think strategically and to work collaboratively using risk-based, proactive approaches to problem-solving
  • Strong team player
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional/ local languages a plus, but not required

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.

People first. Ownership always.

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.

At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.

At Peregrine Advisors, you will make sure the application a federal agency relies on to process its filer applications works for the people who use it, testing it end to end, by hand and in code. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are.

This is a remote position. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination.

Your first project

Your first project will likely have you testing the application that carries a federal agency's filer applications from submission to decision, built in Python on Amazon Web Services (AWS). Depending on the assignment, you may:

  • Test the application end to end, following each submission from intake through document processing, review, approval, and audit history, across the user interface, the application programming interfaces (APIs) behind it, and the database.
  • Test user functionality by hand before each release: write test cases from requirements and user stories, work through every screen, user permission, and exception path a reviewer will meet, and report defects a developer can act on at first read.
  • Automate the checks worth repeating: build and maintain end-to-end, API, and regression suites that run in the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline on every build.
  • Validate the data and the controls around it: confirm with SQL that what a user sees matches the source document and the database, and test role-based access, permissions, and integrations such as identity verification and notifications.

You help prove that the system works for its users from submission to decision, in a regulated federal environment where accuracy and auditability are not optional.

This is where you start, not the shape of your career here.

  • Functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing (UAT)
  • Test automation in at least one framework, such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or pytest

  • Testing applications deployed on AWS, such as Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, and S3
  • Running automated suites in CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions
  • Section 508 accessibility testing
  • International Software Testing Qualifications Board (ISTQB) certification or comparable
  • Federal information technology experience
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted testing tooling

Who you are

You test what the user actually experiences, not only whether a screen loads. You follow a submission through every step to the decision at the end and ask whether the system read the document correctly, applied the right rule, and showed the reviewer the right information, and you know which checks belong in code and which need a person's judgment. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.

What you bring

  • End-to-end testing craft: following a business process through every screen, service, and record it touches, and finding where it breaks.
  • User functionality testing that turns a requirement into the cases that would expose it if it were wrong, and explores past the script when something looks off.
  • Automation that earns its keep: end-to-end, API, and regression suites that run on every build and that the team trusts.
  • Data validation across the user interface, API responses, database records, and source documents.
  • Defect reports with steps to reproduce, expected and actual results, evidence, and severity, and clear communication with developers, product owners, and client stakeholders about what they mean for the release.

You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver.

When we talk

Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned.

Benefits

This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $100,000 to $140,000 per year.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

What we offer

You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.

What we commit to

As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.

We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer.

Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.

job.title: Sr Software QA Engineer
job.description:
The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Meet the team:

At Dexcom, the Postmarket Investigations team serves as a critical link between real-world product performance and continuous product improvement. As part of the Customer Advocacy organization, we assess postmarket feedback and product data to ensure learnings are integrated into future product enhancements. This role has a direct impact on patient safety, product reliability, and regulatory compliance through partnership with teams across R&D, Quality, and Commercial Operations. Our team values technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning, while fostering a collaborative and supportive environment. Team members have the unique opportunity to drive quality improvements, influence key business processes, and contribute to technologies that empower people to take control of their health.

Where you come in:

  • You will collaborate with cross-functional partners including Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, R&D, Clinical, and Process Engineering to support the investigation, documentation, and resolution of software- and device-related postmarket issues.

  • You will drive the development and continuous improvement of complaint investigation processes, ensuring alignment with software risk management activities such as hazard analysis, DFMEA, PFMEA, and product risk assessments.

  • You will develop and maintain a deep understanding of Dexcom’s software ecosystem and technical architecture to effectively evaluate product performance, investigate anomalies, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

  • You will apply structured problem-solving methodologies and data-driven approaches to conduct investigations, lead engineering studies, and identify root causes using statistical analysis and industry-standard tools.

  • You will analyze, synthesize, and communicate investigation outcomes to technical and non-technical stakeholders, providing clear recommendations and supporting informed decision-making across the organization.

  • You will contribute to postmarket quality processes, including CAPA, Health Hazard Evaluations (HHEs), and other quality system activities, ensuring thorough assessment of product performance and risk.

  • You will perform software-focused risk assessments related to product anomalies, cybersecurity vulnerabilities, emerging technologies, and postmarket trends, helping to ensure product safety, reliability, and regulatory compliance.

  • You will partner with product development and quality teams to translate postmarket insights into actionable improvements, driving enhancements to product performance, user experience, and patient safety.

What makes you successful:

  • You have demonstrated knowledge of medical device quality systems and regulatory requirements, including FDA 21 CFR Part 820, IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 82304, EU MDR, and other applicable global regulations.

  • You have experience supporting software quality engineering activities throughout the product lifecycle, including requirements, architecture, design, development, verification, validation, release, and postmarket surveillance.

  • You have strong understanding of software risk management principles and methodologies, with the ability to apply risk-based decision-making in alignment with regulatory expectations and industry best practices.

  • You have excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively convey complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders across the organization.

  • You have working knowledge of modern software technologies, including cloud-based platforms, distributed systems, cybersecurity fundamentals, software architectures, and data-driven applications.

  • You have proven ability to apply engineering fundamentals and structured problem-solving techniques to investigate complex issues, determine root causes, and drive effective corrective actions.

  • You have strong analytical mindset with experience interpreting data, identifying trends, and translating findings into actionable recommendations.

  • You have the ability to balance technical depth with business impact, driving decisions that support product quality, patient safety, compliance, and customer experience.

What you’ll get:

  • A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community.

  • A full and comprehensive benefits program.

  • Growth opportunities on a global scale.

  • Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.

  • An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.

job.title: QA Engineer (Remote Poland)
job.description:
This is a remote position.

Responsibilities:
  • Device & Hardware Testing: Conduct rigorous testing across multiple physical devices (iOS, Android tablets/phones, desktops, and Smart Home and Health Devices) to verify functionality, responsiveness, and UI layouts.
  • Test Execution & Coverage: Develop, update, and execute comprehensive test plans, functional test cases, and exploratory test scenarios for new features and bug fixes.
  • Compatibility Testing: Test applications across varying system versions, screen resolutions and hardware specs to identify device-specific issues.
  • Defect Management: Identify, reproduce, and document detailed bug reports using tracking tools (Jira, Azure DevOps, Buganizer), including logs, steps to reproduce, screenshots, and video recordings.
  • Regression & Sanity Testing: Perform thorough regression cycles before production releases to ensure core functionality remains stable.
  • Internationalization Testing: Validate that application architecture supports multi-locale enablement without code modification (e.g., Unicode/UTF-8 support, string externalization, hard coded string detection, bi- directional text like RTL, variable expansion, and locale-aware sorting/filtering)
  • Localization Testing: Verify translated UI elements across multiple languages for accuracy, context, and formatting compliance (e.g., date/time formats, currency symbols, address layouts, dynamic pluralization, and text truncation/wrap issues).
  • Pseudo-Localization: Conduct pseudo-localization builds during early development cycles to catch hard coded strings, layout clipping, and character rendering errors early in the SDLC.
  • Linguistic & UI Quality Verification: Review UI for visual integrity across different screen sizes when localized strings expand or shrink; coordinate linguistic reviews with native-speaking linguists or translation agencies.
  • TMS & Localization Tooling: Manage translation asset workflows using Translation Management Systems (TMS) such as Smartling, Phrase, Transifex, or Lokalise, integrating them with code repositories and build pipeline

Requirements

  • Internationalization and Localization Experience
  • Device Testing: Smart Home and Health including smartwatches, health trackers, smart displays, speakers, home security cameras, and camera doorbells.
  • Hands-on experience in localization and Internationalization testing with a primary focus on mobile and physical device testing.
  • Strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), and QA best practices.
  • Ability to think & execute testing from a user’s perspective
  • Technical i18n Knowledge: Strong understanding of character encoding (UTF-8, UTF-16), ICU standards, CLDR data, resource file formats (JSON, XML, .po, .strings, XLIFF), and Bidirectional (BiDi / RTL) layout handling.
  • L10n Testing Best Practices: Hands-on experience identifying truncation, text overlap, line wrapping, and font rendering issues across various localized builds.
  • Device Lab Familiarity: Hands-on experience testing on actual physical devices as well as cloud-based device testing platforms (e.g., BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, Kobiton).
  • OS & Tool Knowledge: Solid understanding of iOS (TestFlight, Xcode logs) and Android (ADB, Logcat, APK installation) ecosystems and debugging utilities.
  • API Tools: Basic familiarity with tools like Charles Proxy, Fiddler, Postman to inspect and debug device issues.
  • Core QA Skills: Strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), and QA best practices.
  • Basic understanding of test automation concepts or scripting to partner with automation engineers.
  • Experience testing IoT devices, wearables, or specialized embedded systems.
  • Familiarity with accessibility testing standards (WCAG, VoiceOver, TalkBack).
  • Tooling Proficiency: Experience with Translation Management Systems (e.g., Smartling, Phrase, Crowdin, Transifex) and defect management platforms (Jira).
  • Language Skills: Professional proficiency in English; fluency or native-level proficiency in additional languages is a strong plus.
  • Core QA Expertise: Solid understanding of software testing methodologies, test planning, and manual/exploratory testing techniques.
  • Methodologies: Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum development cycles and QA methodologies.
  • Familiarity with regional regulatory, privacy, or cultural standards in key international markets (e.g., EMEA, APAC, LATAM).

Atualmente, temos escritórios no Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Miami, Buenos Aires, Madrid e Perth. Mas não se preocupe! Para os que estiverem trabalhando remotamente, nossa cultura permanece a mesma: Integração total com happy hour online, noite de jogos, lives e outras programações legais! 😉

Quality Assurance Lead, US Remote Based


Join Fortrea and make an impact on quality across our clinical research operations. With the support of a collaborative team, the Quality Assurance Lead helps progress quality issues, support CAPA activities, and leverage QMS data and trends to help strengthen consistent, effective quality processes.


Location: Remote, United States


Key / Core Responsibilities

  • Serve as a quality partner to operational teams by providing guidance on quality issue management, quality risk identification, escalation requirements, and continuous improvement opportunities.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to facilitate the progression and resolution of quality issues within the Quality Management System (QMS).
  • Monitor and drive timely progression of quality issues while identifying and escalating risks that may impact compliance, quality, or client commitments.
  • Collaborate with functional teams to develop, implement, and monitor Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs) to support sustainable issue resolution.
  • Maintain a strong working knowledge of quality systems, processes, and regulatory requirements to support effective quality issue management.
  • Partner with Quality Lead Managers and senior quality leadership to support quality issue progression, escalation activities, and client communications as required.
  • Analyze quality metrics and trends to identify systemic quality concerns, emerging risks, and opportunities for continuous improvement, supporting risk-based decision making.
  • Support preparation of quality summaries, trend analyses, and quality-related communications for internal stakeholders and clients, where applicable.
  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives that strengthen compliance, quality oversight, and operational effectiveness.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • 5 years of experience in a regulatory environment, including experience in GxP roles.
  • Strong understanding of QMS and the CAPA process.
  • Knowledge of GCP and GxP requirements.
  • Ability to convey key details of quality issues internally.
  • Ability to communicate quality issue summaries to clients, where applicable.
  • A bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences preferred, or equivalent Life Science experience.
  • Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience in lieu of educational requirements.

Fortrea is unable to provide employment sponsorship for this position, now or in the future. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.


Work Environment

  • Work is performed in an office environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.
  • Occasional drives to site locations with occasional travel both domestic and international.

Physical Requirements:

  • Frequently stationary for 6-8 hours per day.
  • Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists.
  • Occasional crouching, stooping, with frequent bending and twisting of upper body and neck.
  • Ability to access and use a variety of computer software developed both in-house and off-the-shelf.
  • Light to moderate lifting and carrying (or otherwise moves) objects including luggage and laptop computer with a maximum lift of 15-20 lbs.
  • Regular and consistent attendance.
  • Varied hours may be required.

Pay Range: USD $70,000-$125,000

Benefits: All job offers will be based on a candidate’s skills and prior relevant experience, applicable degrees/certifications, as well as internal equity and market data. Regular, full-time or part-time employees working 20 or more hours per week are eligible for comprehensive benefits including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, STD/LTD, 401(K), Paid time off (PTO) or Flexible time off (FTO), Company bonus where applicable.

job.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.



About the Role:

CrowdStrike is looking for a Mobile QA Analyst to join our IT Go-to-Market team. In this role, you will help the team deliver high quality mobile apps through the execution of QA processes and development standards you operate. You will contribute your expertise with QA automation and the SDLC to deliver first-class applications and features that meet evolving business requirements. And, you will be working alongside a supportive and fast-paced team with numerous opportunities to increase your professional knowledge and expertise. Bring your passion for developing creative and elegant solutions to CrowdStrike.


What You’ll Do:


  • Able to effectively write test cases and test steps that demonstrate an understanding of requirements and visual designs using Jira
  • Responsible for designing and executing automated and manual test strategies. Leverage expertise with mobile application testing procedures, techniques, and tools, including test planning and case writing.
  • Coordinate with the IT Go-to-Market team for the daily operation of applications and with regard to the deployment process from development area to pre-production to staging to production, validating development artifacts as they’re promoted.
  • Responsible for system, integration, regression, end-to-end and cross-browser, cross-device testing including all appropriate documentation. .
  • Communicates results and coordinates logistics to the business analyst, developers, and other key IT staff and leadership as appropriate.
  • Certifies application for release to the next testing stage or to the production environment. Generates and distributes periodic status reports for testing.
  • Participates in facilitation and coordination of user acceptance testing, work with business analysts and business stakeholders to undertake exploratory testing.
  • Knowledge of performance, accessibility (ADA) and security vulnerability testing is a plus.

What You’ll Need:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or similar work experience
  • A minimum of 5+ years of progressively responsible experience in a directly related area, during which both technical and professional capabilities have been clearly demonstrated.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience as a QA (Web Application Testing) Automation Engineer (Java, Selenium, Cypress, BDD framework), ideally with experience testing a mobile application built on native iOS and native Android.
  • Experience with Salesforce concepts such as Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce platform capabilities and integration patterns and the ability to create responsive and accessible UI components highly preferred
  • Minimum 3-5 years of technical project experience, testing through a full system development life cycle.
  • Ability to work independently, and as a team player, while using discretion in decision making and sound judgment in problem solving.
  • Must have excellent analytics, organizations, problem-solving, interpersonal and communication skills, both written and oral, possess the ability and desire to quickly learn new skills and technologies.
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.


Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:

  • Market leader in compensation and equity awards
  • Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs
  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge
  • Paid parental and adoption leaves
  • Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role
  • Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections
  • Vibrant office culture with world class amenities
  • Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

job.title: Test Engineer III
job.description:
Start Date: Immediate

JHNA, CTSi, and EXPANSIA have come together to form a Defense Technology platform named Aether Aerospace focused on delivering high-impact technologies, technology-enabled services and advanced manufacturing solutions to the U.S. Department of Defense and related national security customers. Backed by Falfurrias Management Partners, the platform brings together deep domain expertise across Army, Navy, and Air Force and Space Force programs, digital engineering, systems integration, and specialized manufacturing capabilities.

The combined organization operates as a multi-entity aerospace and defense technology and tech-enabled services and manufacturing enterprise positioned for scalable growth, operational excellence, and long-term value creation

OVERVIEW

Full-time/Permanent Employee

Location: Remote

Aether Aerospace is seeking a Test Engineer to support the development, integration, and maturation of complex digital engineering solutions from requirements and conceptual design through prototype development and transition. The Test Engineer will plan, execute, and document verification and validation activities across cloud platforms, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), application functionality and user experience, cybersecurity controls, system integrations, and end-to-end engineering workflows.

The initial prototype environment may be implemented in Azure Government, with the longer-term objective of supporting cloud-agnostic architectures capable of operating across additional commercial or government cloud environments. The Test Engineer will help ensure testing approaches, automation, and validation methods are adaptable, scalable, and not unnecessarily dependent on a single cloud provider.

This role will work closely with cloud, software, cybersecurity, systems engineering, Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), data, and program teams to ensure capabilities meet approved requirements and are ready for iterative reviews, stakeholder showcases, formal demonstrations, and future transition activities.

RESPONSIBILTIES

    • Develop and execute test plans, test cases, test procedures, and test scripts based on approved requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical design documentation.

    • Perform functional, integration, regression, system, user acceptance, performance, load, recovery, and end-to-end workflow testing across the prototype environment.

    • Validate cloud platform services, initially within Microsoft Azure, including networking, identity and access management, role-based access control (RBAC), logging, monitoring, configuration, and environment provisioning.

    • Develop testing approaches that support future cloud-agnostic and multi-cloud deployment models.

    • Support STIG evidence collection using tools using tools such as Selenium, Robot Framework, or similar tools.

    • Test Infrastructure as Code deployments using Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, OpenTofu, Gitlab CI/CD, AKS or similar technologies to confirm repeatability, configuration accuracy, portability, and deployment integrity.

job.description:
Why AIS?

When you join AIS, you’re joining a mission-driven team that’s passionate about making a difference. You’ll work on projects that matter, alongside industry-leading experts, in an environment that fosters innovation, driving client success, and empowering our team to make a lasting impact. As an employee-owned company, we value collaboration, inclusivity, continuous growth, and shared success.

  • Employee Ownership: Your contributions directly impact the company’s success, and you share in its achievements.

  • Continuous Learning: Access to resources, training, and mentorship to support your professional growth.

  • Inclusive Culture: A workplace where diversity is celebrated, and everyone’s voice is valued.

  • Mission-Driven Work: Engage in projects that make a meaningful difference for our clients and communities.

What are we looking for?

At AIS, we're looking for more than just skills - we're looking for driven individuals who are passionate about making a difference, eager to grow, and aligned with our core principles.

What you will be doing?

This position is contingent upon contract award. We are currently pursuing a proposal and are seeking qualified candidates to include in our submission and identify candidates for future hiring needs on the program once awarded.

At AIS, we are dedicated to providing our employees with diverse opportunities to grow their careers while supporting a variety of impactful projects. For this position, we are seeking a talented individual to join AIS as a Lead QA Engineer.

  • Core Knowledge & Skills: Develops strategic test plans, risk-based testing, advanced automation, compliance audits, and innovative testing solutions.

  • Work & Complexity: Leads complex projects, creates test strategies, performs risk assessments, and mentors team members.

  • Quality & Independence: Optimizes processes, defines quality metrics, ensures stakeholder satisfaction, and makes high-level decisions.

  • Teamwork & Communication: Leads and mentors teams, aligns efforts with organizational goals, manages performance, and collaborates with stakeholders.

  • Consulting & Engagement: Provides strategic guidance, consults on automation strategies, advises on metrics, and communicates with senior stakeholders.

As your initial project assignment, you will support the unique needs of our client as a Technical QA and Automation Lead.

Project Summary


The Technical QA and Automation Lead leads quality and technical acceptance for a large-scale enterprise cloud migration program, moving a complex application portfolio from on-premises data centers to Azure and AWS. The role establishes the program's test strategy, automation framework, and quality gates, and guides the QA engineers in the migration teams. The role is hands-on, building the initial automation framework rather than serving solely as an administrative test manager. The role is remote.


Key Responsibilities

  • Defines the enterprise test strategy, quality gates, and technical acceptance criteria for migrated applications.
  • Designs and establishes the initial automation framework and reusable test utilities used across the migration teams.
  • Guides and coaches the Cloud Migration Test Automation Engineers, reviewing their test plans, results, and acceptance evidence and assessing their readiness.
  • Oversees requirements traceability, test cases, and acceptance evidence in the program's test management tools, including Jama Connect where applicable.
  • Integrates automated testing and reporting into CI/CD pipelines to support repeatable execution.
  • Oversees technical validation of migrated applications, including Azure and AWS configuration, connectivity, identity, APIs, databases, performance, and reliability.
  • Reviews technical acceptance packages and provides Go/No-Go recommendations.
  • Reports quality metrics, risks, and trends to program leadership.

Required For This Opportunity

  • US Citizen
  • Minimum eight years of quality engineering or software testing experience, including automation framework design
  • Experience developing enterprise test strategies, quality gates, and technical acceptance criteria

· Experience with cloud testing, including validating migrated or cloud-hosted applications

· Strong experience with enterprise test management, requirements traceability, and automated test reporting

· Hands-on ability to build an automation framework and guide other QA engineers

· Works on increasingly complex problems, exercises independent judgment, and provides direction and coordination for a multi-disciplinary team


Nice to Have Skills

  • Please list the key responsibilities (2-3 bullets)

job.title: Oracle Fusion Test Manager
job.description:
Job Description:

Security Requirements


Due to the nature of the work and the customers we support, the successful candidate must be eligible to meet UK Government and customer security requirements, including applicable residency requirements, and have the right to work in the UK. Some opportunities may also be subject to nationality requirements where these are necessary to satisfy UK Government or contractual security obligations.


We’re looking for an experienced Oracle Fusion Test Manager to lead testing across a complex Oracle Fusion Cloud environment.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone with strong Oracle Fusion HCM and ERP experience who can take ownership of test preparation and execution across multiple workstreams. You’ll work closely with technical and functional teams, Oracle specialists and delivery partners to ensure solutions and integrations are fully tested and ready for deployment.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead the test strategy, planning, preparation and execution for Oracle Fusion Cloud.
  • Manage System Integration Testing (SIT), end-to-end business process testing and regression testing.
  • Develop and manage test plans, scenarios, scripts, schedules and reporting.
  • Coordinate testing across Oracle Fusion HCM, ERP and integrations.
  • Lead testing of inbound and outbound integrations, including REST APIs, web services, SFTP and file-based interfaces.
  • Own the defect management lifecycle, including triage, prioritisation, tracking, retesting and resolution.
  • Coordinate testing activities across internal teams, Oracle and third-party delivery partners.
  • Manage test environments, test data, dependencies and test readiness.
  • Monitor and report on test progress, coverage, defects, risks and overall readiness.
  • Support and develop test automation, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and repeatability.
  • Work closely with functional and technical teams to ensure appropriate end-to-end test coverage.
  • Provide leadership and guidance to testing resources and promote consistent testing standards and best practice.
  • Support UAT, regression, release and deployment activities where required.

What we’re looking for

Essential

  • Strong hands-on experience of Oracle Fusion Cloud.
  • Proven experience as a Test Manager or Test Lead within an Oracle Fusion implementation, transformation or delivery programme.
  • Strong functional and technical knowledge of Oracle Fusion HCM and ERP.
  • Strong understanding of Oracle Fusion configuration and end-to-end business processes.
  • Significant experience of System Integration Testing (SIT) and end-to-end testing within Oracle Fusion.
  • Experience testing Oracle Fusion inbound and outbound integrations.
  • Hands-on experience testing REST APIs, web services, SFTP and file-based integrations.
  • Strong experience across test strategy, planning, preparation, execution and reporting.
  • Proven experience managing defects from identification and triage through to resolution and retesting.
  • Experience coordinating testing across multiple functional, technical and integration workstreams.
  • Experience managing test environments, test data and test readiness.
  • Experience with test automation within a complex enterprise environment.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, particularly across applications and integrations.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, risks and dependencies within a complex delivery programme.
  • Strong leadership skills with experience coordinating and supporting test teams.

Desirable

  • Experience with Oracle Fusion EPM.
  • Experience delivering large-scale Oracle Fusion implementation, migration, upgrade or transformation programmes.
  • Experience of data migration, reconciliation and validation testing.
  • Relevant Oracle Fusion or software testing certifications.
  • Experience working within large, multi-team or multi-supplier delivery environments.

About you

You’ll be comfortable taking ownership of testing rather than simply executing test scripts. You’ll be able to bring structure to complex test activity, work effectively across technical and business teams, challenge where appropriate and maintain a clear view of risks, defects and overall readiness.

You’ll combine strong Oracle Fusion knowledge with hands-on test leadership, and be confident communicating with stakeholders at different levels.

job.title: Principal Quality Engineer
job.description:
We are seeking a Principal Quality Engineer to design and lead automated testing efforts for the products FreedomPay offers. This is a full-time salaried position. You will join a team of world-class engineers solving complex problems, building new product lines, and expanding existing products and services. You will be expected to bring creativity, innovation, and technical leadership to the role.

The primary objective of this position is to evolve the test automation strategy, architecture, and tooling for the platforms, SDKs, APIs, and applications that power millions, and potentially billions, of payment transactions. You will work across multiple products, including mobile applications, payment terminal hardware, and middleware, while mentoring engineers and championing quality practices across the organization.

Essential Functions

  • Design, architect, and build scalable automated test frameworks and suites (unit, integration, API, UI, end-to-end, and regression) for FreedomPay products.
  • Define and drive the test automation strategy, standards, and roadmap across engineering teams.
  • Leverage AI-enabled tools to accelerate testing and reduce time-to-market.
  • Analyze product requirements and designs to create test plans, test cases, and automation coverage that reflect risk, particularly for payment, security, and compliance workflows.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines with quality gates, reporting, and code coverage metrics.
  • Develop test tooling, simulators, and test data strategies for integrations with third-party services and payment terminal hardware.
  • Improve the performance, reliability, and maintainability of existing automation by reducing flaky tests and decreasing execution time.
  • Participate in and lead code reviews, design reviews, and technical discussions, influencing project teams to deliver high-quality software.
  • Mentor and coach quality engineers and software developers on test design, automation best practices, and testability.
  • Recommend and evaluate new technologies, including AI-assisted testing tools, to improve quality and productivity.
  • Contribute to project planning, estimation, and technical decision-making.
  • Protect company proprietary and confidential information.
  • Regularly attend team meetings to discuss projects, brainstorm ideas, and propose solutions to technical challenges.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Skills and Experience

  • BS/BA degree in Management Information Systems (MIS), Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in software quality engineering or software development, with a strong focus on test automation.
  • 3+ years of experience in a senior, lead, or principal-level role responsible for automation strategy and architecture.
  • Strong programming experience in at least one object-oriented language, such as Java, C#, or Python.
  • Hands-on experience designing and building test automation frameworks from the ground up, not just maintaining existing frameworks.
  • Experience with UI and mobile test automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Appium, and Espresso.
  • Strong experience testing RESTful APIs that consume or provide JSON or XML.
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Demonstrated commitment to industry best practices in source control, software architecture, coding standards, and unit/system testing.
  • Familiarity with source control tools such as Git.
  • Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills, including root-cause analysis of complex distributed systems.
  • Ability to design, plan, and implement comprehensive test strategies based on product requirements.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Excellent multitasking skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

Desired Skills and Experience

  • Experience testing payment systems, including EMV, point-to-point encryption (P2PE), POS/payment terminal hardware, printers, and other peripheral devices, including unattended or kiosk-mode solutions.
  • Experience communicating with external devices over socket or serial protocols (TCP/IP, USB, Bluetooth) for automated testing purposes.
  • Understanding of data security, encryption, PCI/EMV compliance, data privacy, and related regulations, including methods for validating compliance through testing.
  • Experience with performance, load, and security testing tools such as JMeter, k6, or Gatling.
  • Experience with Android and/or iOS mobile test automation.
  • Experience building test simulators, mocks, and service virtualization solutions for third-party and vendor integrations.
  • Experience with Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) and tools such as Cucumber.
  • Experience working in Agile, Scrum, and Kanban environments.
  • Strong interest in engineering tooling and development processes, including continuous integration platforms such as Azure Pipelines, SonarQube, and code coverage tools.
  • Experience with test management and defect-tracking tools such as Azure DevOps and Jira.
  • Proficiency with AI-assisted development and testing tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate coding, debugging, code reviews, and test authoring.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and influencing quality culture across multiple teams and disciplines.

job.title: Quality Engineer – QA Control Account Manager
job.description:
***Active DoD Security Clearance Preferred***

***US Citizenship Required***

***NO VISA SUPPORT or C2C***

Primary Function

Long Wave Inc. is seeking a Quality Engineer – QA Control Account Manager (CAM) to support program quality assurance, Control Account Management, Quality Management System (QMS) execution, and departmental budget and resource planning within an aerospace and defense environment.

The position serves as the designated QA CAM for assigned programs, managing cost account performance, forecasts, budgets, and associated EVMS responsibilities. In addition, the position supports program QA execution, internal auditing, corrective action activities, and QMS implementation and sustainment.

This is a hands-on individual contributor position requiring coordination with Program Management, Finance, Quality leadership, and other functional organizations.

Essential Responsibilities

QA Control Account Management

  • Serve as QA CAM for assigned control accounts, managing scope, schedule, budget, and resource requirements.
  • Develop and maintain ETCs, EACs, and forecasts; support development and maintenance of control account baselines.
  • Monitor cost and schedule performance, prepare variance analyses, and identify execution risks and corrective actions.
  • Maintain CAM records and objective evidence supporting internal, customer, government, and DCMA EVMS reviews.
  • Support BCRs, IBRs, program reviews, and recurring EVMS reporting activities.
  • Coordinate with Program Management, Finance, and functional leads to ensure QA work is properly planned, budgeted, and executed.

QA Budget & Resource Planning

  • Support QA annual operating plans (AOPs), budgets, staffing, and resource forecasts across assigned programs and departmental activities.
  • Monitor planned versus actual QA labor and budget performance, identifying resource gaps and providing recurring status to QA leadership.
  • Develop and support QA BOEs, proposal estimates, resource planning, and program changes involving QA labor and resource requirements.

Additional QA & QMS Support

  • Support program QA execution activities, including quality planning, requirements compliance, documentation reviews, and program quality reporting.
  • Conduct or support AS9100/ISO 9001 internal audits, including audit planning, objective evidence review, reporting, and follow-up.
  • Support nonconformance management, root cause analysis, corrective action implementation, and effectiveness verification.
  • Assist with customer and certification audits, QMS implementation, sustainment, and continual improvement activities as assigned.

Work Conditions

  • Remote or on-site work arrangement based on business needs and position requirements.
  • Remote employees must be able to perform assigned duties and access authorized company systems in accordance with company and contractual requirements.
  • Occasional travel may be required in support of program, customer, or QMS activities.

Minimum Qualifications

  • U.S. Citizenship required.
  • Bachelor's degree and a minimum of four (4) years of relevant experience; or a graduate degree and a minimum of two (2) years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a minimum of eight (8) years of relevant experience.
  • Proficient knowledge of program controls, cost account management, quality assurance, or related disciplines, with practical knowledge of project management.
  • Experience performing or directly supporting Control Account Management, program controls, budgeting, forecasting, or comparable cost and schedule management activities.
  • Working knowledge of EVM/EVMS principles, including cost and schedule performance, variance analysis, and resource planning.
  • Strong analytical and organizational skills with proficiency in Excel and related reporting or data analysis tools.
  • Ability to independently execute assigned responsibilities under general supervision and coordinate effectively with Program Management, Finance, Quality, and other functional organizations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience serving as a designated Control Account Manager in a DoD or Government program environment.
  • Experience developing ETCs/EACs, preparing monthly variance analyses, maintaining control account baselines, and supporting BCRs and IBRs.
  • Experience using EVMS cost and scheduling tools, including Deltek Cobra and Microsoft Project.
  • Experience conducting internal audits or supporting QMS implementation and compliance with AS9100 and ISO 9001.
  • ASQ or other relevant Quality, audit, or program management certification.
  • Active or previously held Secret security clearance.

Position Benefits:

As a full-time employee of Long Wave, you are eligible for our benefits package including:

  • Competitive Salary
  • Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • 401k
  • Educational Assistance
  • Life Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Programs & Work/Life Solutions
  • Paid Time Off
  • This position’s standard work schedule is a 9/80. The 9/80 schedule allows employees who work a nine-hour day Monday through Thursday to take every other Friday off.

As a Salesforce Tester, you will be an integral team member who assists the team in ensuring high quality code is delivered to our client.  Responsibilities will include testing and verification of code, reporting and recording defects, coordination with architects, functional analysts, and developers on testing and testing results, documenting test scripts, participating in design reviews, user acceptance testing, and deployment activities. This individual will also work in an Agile environment and participate in scrum ceremonies and product planning activities. 

Contributions

As a Salesforce Tester, you will work with our growing DevSecOps & Salesforce practices delivering quality assurance services to support application, cloud and data systems development. We are looking for candidates with minimum 5 years experience with experience in quality assurance and test automation practices in an Agile/DevSecOps work environment. Responsibilities include:

  • Meet with product design team to determine testing parameters
  • Write test plans, create test cases, test procedures, bug reports, final QA reports for products
  • Manage test data architecture with the Tech Lead

    • Functional testing

  • 5 years of related experience in software/IT/cloud consulting
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, interpersonal and collaborative skills

Preferred:

job.title: QA Engineer - Manual & Automation
job.description:
THIS OPENING IS AVAILABLE FOR CANDIDATES IN LATIN AMERICA, NOT LIMITED TO ONLY COLOMBIA.

Sonatafy Technology, headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, is an award-winning nearshore software development company with a strong reputation. They have a dedicated in-house team of engineers, offering end-to-end software solutions and supporting client development staff augmentation. Catering to companies of all sizes and industries, including some of the world's largest brands, Sonatafy Technology is a trusted provider of nearshore enterprise-level cloud and mobile application software development services.

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented QA Engineer with extensive manual and Automation experience using Playwright. You will be part of a collaborative engineering team focused on ensuring product quality through robust test automation and efficient QA practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive automated testing efforts across the platform (50%–50% manual).
  • Contribute to social media reporting initiatives.
  • Conduct thorough automation code reviews to maintain high engineering standards.

Manual Testing (≈50%)

  • Review requirements, user stories, and designs to identify gaps, edge cases, and testability concerns early in the sprint.
  • Write and maintain clear test plans, test cases, and checklists in BrowserStack Test Management.
  • Perform functional, exploratory, regression, smoke, and UAT-support testing across web and mobile.
  • Execute cross-browser and cross-device testing, including responsive layouts and real-device checks.
  • Validate APIs and back-end behavior manually (e.g., Postman) to support UI findings.
  • Reproduce, document, and triage defects with clear steps, evidence (screenshots, videos, logs), severity, and priority.
  • Partner with Product and Development during sprint ceremonies to clarify acceptance criteria and sign off on releases.

Test Automation with Playwright (≈50%)

  • Design, build, and maintain end-to-end and API automated tests using Playwright with TypeScript.
  • Apply maintainable framework patterns (Page Object Model, fixtures, reusable helpers, test data management).
  • Identify which manual test cases should be automated and convert stable, high-value scenarios into automated regression coverage.
  • Investigate and fix flaky tests using Playwright Trace Viewer, logs, screenshots, and video.
  • Integrate test suites into CI/CD pipelines with parallel execution and run cross-browser tests on BrowserStack Automate.
  • Report automation results and quality metrics (coverage, pass rate, defect trends) to the team and stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience with Playwright using TypeScript
  • Proficiency in Playwright Trace Debugging
  • Experience with BrowserStack Test Management
  • Experience with BrowserStack Automate
  • Proven ability to scope and implement automation requirements for new features
  • Strong Computer Science fundamentals
  • Experience setting up and maintaining Continuous Integration systems
  • Skilled in reporting, tracking, and triaging bugs, and solving complex technical problems
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with meticulous attention to detail
  • Solid experience in manual testing: test case design, exploratory testing, regression, and smoke testing
  • Strong knowledge of QA methodologies and test design techniques (boundary value analysis, equivalence partitioning, risk-based testing)
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams and with defect tracking tools (e.g., Jira)
  • Hands-on experience with API testing, both manual (Postman or similar) and automated (Playwright API testing)
  • Comfortable with Git, code reviews, and pull request workflows
  • Advanced English, written and spoken

Nice to Haves

  • Hands-on experience with native mobile and web QA automation (Appium, WDIO)
  • Familiarity with GitLab CI/CD
  • Experience with GitHub Actions or other CI tools
  • Basic SQL for data validation
  • Exposure to accessibility testing (WCAG) and visual regression testing
  • Familiarity with performance testing tools (k6, JMeter)
  • ISTQB or similar QA certification

Why Work with Sonatafy?

At Sonatafy, you'll join a community of highly skilled engineers across Latin America supporting innovative U.S.-based teams. You'll be part of a fast-moving, client-first culture where your code has real-world impact. We offer competitive compensation, a remote-first lifestyle, and career growth opportunities across industries and technologies.

If you have reached this point and believe you are our ideal candidate, it's time to apply! To apply, please submit your resume in English.

Sonatafy recruitment communications will only come from @sonatafy.com email addresses. We do not request fees or sensitive financial information, nor do we conduct hiring solely through online forms without interviews. If you happen to receive a suspicious message, please contact us at .

job.description:
Get to know us better

CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms. The scale is significant: the platform executes hundreds of test suites and roughly a thousand test runs a day across pre-commit, nightly, and weekly pipelines. To keep triage fast at this scale, the workflow is supported by modern AI tooling - an AI-powered root cause analysis agent that turns hours of log digging into minutes, and collaboration bots that automatically pull the right people into dedicated spaces when a suite fails.

  • Automating environment provisioning, traffic generation, network diagnostics, and continuous regression testing across virtual and physical testbeds

  • Collaborating closely with development teams to understand the features they deliver and designing test coverage for those use cases

About Cognisys

Cognisys is a global cybersecurity company specialising in Penetration Testing, GRC Consulting and Managed Security services. We work with organisations across more than 30 countries, helping them identify risk, strengthen their security posture and navigate an increasingly complex cybersecurity landscape.

We're a small but mighty team with ambitious plans for growth. We combine deep technical expertise with a strong focus on customer service, practical advice and delivering meaningful outcomes for our clients.

Our people are at the heart of what we do. We value Together, Ownership, Momentum and Excellence,and we want people who are curious, collaborative and willing to take ownership of their work.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to make an impact in the fast-paced world of cybersecurity?

Cognisys is growing rapidly, and we're looking for a Pen Tester to join our team during an exciting period of innovation and expansion.

As a Pen Tester, you'll be responsible for delivering and supporting security assessments across a range of client environments, including networks, applications and cloud infrastructure.

You'll use a combination of automated tools and manual techniques to simulate real-world attack scenarios, identify meaningful vulnerabilities and help clients understand and address their security risks.

This is a client-facing role where technical expertise is only part of the job. You'll also need to communicate your findings clearly, produce high-quality reports and help both technical and non-technical stakeholders understand the risks and practical steps they can take to improve their security posture.

What You'll Be Doing

Penetration Testing & Security Assessments

  • Apply appropriate offensive security methodologies, tools and techniques throughout engagements.

  • Stay up to date with emerging vulnerabilities, attack techniques and industry developments.

Client Delivery & Communication

  • Work directly with clients throughout penetration testing engagements.

  • Communicate complex technical concepts in a way that is accessible to non-technical stakeholders.

Reporting & Quality

  • Produce high-quality technical reports following each engagement.

  • Ensure technical findings are accurate, well-evidenced and easy for clients to understand.

  • Translate technical detail into clear, practical recommendations for both technical and executive audiences.

  • Maintain Cognisys' high standards for quality, consistency and client service.

Team Contribution & Development

  • Work collaboratively with the wider cybersecurity team.

  • Share knowledge, techniques and lessons learned with colleagues.

  • Contribute to the continued development of Cognisys' penetration testing methodologies and ways of working.

  • Take ownership of your continued technical and professional development.

  • Support a culture of learning, collaboration and continuous improvement.

About You

We're looking for someone with a strong technical foundation in offensive security who is equally comfortable working with clients and communicating technical findings.

You'll ideally have:

  • Hands-on experience conducting penetration testing and security assessments.

  • Experience using vulnerability scanning tools alongside manual testing and exploitation techniques.

  • A strong understanding of offensive security methodologies, tools and techniques.

  • A strong grasp of how to assess and break technical controls, with the ability to explain the findings clearly to clients.

  • Experience across one or more of the following areas:

    • Network penetration testing

    • Web application testing

    • API testing

    • Mobile application testing

    • Cloud security testing

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • The ability to communicate technical vulnerabilities and risks in a clear, non-technical format.

  • Strong client engagement skills and a professional approach to customer service.

  • The ability to manage your workload effectively and deliver work to agreed deadlines.

  • A proactive approach to learning and keeping up to date with developments in offensive security.

Certifications

The following certifications are highly regarded:

Industry-recognised certifications are preferred and may include:

  • OSCP

  • CPSA

  • CRT

  • CREST-related certifications

  • Other relevant penetration testing or offensive security certifications

Relevant practical experience will also be considered alongside formal certifications.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means becoming a trusted technical consultant who can independently deliver high-quality penetration testing engagements while providing an excellent client experience.

For Example:

  • Deliver thorough, accurate and professional penetration testing engagements across a variety of client environments.

  • Confidently assess and exploit vulnerabilities using a combination of automated tools and manual testing techniques.

  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of how technical controls can be assessed, bypassed and exploited in realistic attack scenarios.

  • Produce clear, detailed and actionable technical reports that help clients understand their vulnerabilities and how to remediate them.

  • Communicate technical findings effectively to both technical teams and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Present findings and recommendations confidently to clients and support them in prioritising remediation.

  • Take ownership of your engagements, managing your testing, documentation and deliverables effectively.

  • Continue to develop your technical knowledge and stay current with evolving offensive security techniques, tools and threats.

Why Join Us?

At Cognisys, you will be part of a collaborative and innovative team that values your input and shares support. You'll have the opportunity to work on challenging projects that make a real impact for our clients. We'd love to hear from you if you want to challenge, lead and innovate! We're not just about the work; we're about the people. Join a team where innovation is celebrated, and your contributions are valued. Testing Strategy & Collaboration

  • Testing strategy: Define a risk-based testing approach, set coverage targets, identify gaps, and provide evidence-based recommendations on release readiness.

  • Medical-device verification: Verify functionality against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria, maintaining clear verification evidence.

  • Traceability & test management: Maintain a practical test case management system that keeps test cases current and links requirements, tests, results, defects, and verification evidence.

Requierements:

  • Strong hands-on experience in manual testing and test automation, including ownership of testing for a product or major product area and maintaining reliable automated test suites.

  • Sound judgment in defining risk-based testing approaches and deciding what to test, at which level, and why.

Nice to have:

  • Experience using AI in your testing or engineering work, for example to generate or prioritize test cases, analyze failures, or build test tooling, with a clear view of its limits and of the verification needed for medical-device software.

  • Experience testing products in healthcare or other environments with demanding privacy, security, or quality requirements.

  • Experience designing test data and environments for complex integrations or sensitive information.

  • Experience coaching engineers on testability and contributing to a broader quality culture.

What success looks like:

Within your first 6–12 months, you will have:

  • Established a risk-based testing approach, identified coverage gaps, and prioritized improvements based on critical user journeys, edge cases, and product risks.
