This network will service tens of thousands of enterprise, data center, and government users who require reliable connectivity for critical operations.

Job Description

Blue Origin is seeking a Principal ASIC Test Engineer to lead production test strategy for RF, mmWave, and mixed-signal integrated circuits within Silicon Systems.

This individual contributor role serves as the technical lead for final test of mmWave front-end ICs and converter-intensive ASICs, with focus on RF/mmWave performance, high-speed ADC and DAC testing, manufacturability, and cost of test.

The role leads test engagement with manufacturing and OSAT partners and mentors internal test engineers supporting front-end IC and digital beamformer programs.

- Relocation provided

  • Experience resolving yield and test correlation issues with foundry and OSAT manufacturing partners.

job.title: Tax Software QA & Support Analyst
job.description:
This role is fully remote, open to candidates based anywhere in the United States outside New York, with a preference for the Pacific or Mountain time zones. Based in New York? Apply to the New York posting of this role instead.

A Different Kind Of Job Description

At Filed, we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job. So instead of a list of perks, we'll start with what's genuinely hard about it, then tell you why it might be the best move you'll make.

What's hard about this job

Bugs don't arrive with instructions. A customer tells you "it didn't work." Your job is to work out exactly what they did, with which return, in which tax software, and make it happen again on your own screen. If you can't reproduce it, engineering can't fix it.

Your ticket is the fix's starting point. Engineers will build from what you write. Vague steps mean days of back and forth while a firm waits. You'll need to be precise every time.

The pace is fast. Our customers are tax firms in their busiest weeks. When something breaks, they need an answer today, and a workaround while the real fix is built.

It isn't fixed until you've checked. You'll retest every fix before telling a customer it's resolved, and you'll recheck after releases that nothing else broke.

Why it might be the best career move you'll make

You'll sit between customers and engineering. Few roles see both sides this clearly. You'll learn how real firms use tax software, and how software actually gets built.

Your work ships. A bug you reproduce on Monday becomes a fix every firm on Filed benefits from. A workaround you find saves a firm hours the same day.

You'll grow as fast as we do. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, and the support and QA function is still small. People who start here move into QA, product and engineering-adjacent roles.

We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and we work with tax firms across the country, from regional practices to some of the biggest names in the profession.

What You'll Own

  • Reproducing customer-reported issues step by step, inside Filed and the tax software firms already use

  • Writing clear, complete Linear tickets with exact steps, expected versus actual results, screenshots and sample data, so engineers can act straight away

  • Answering customer tickets quickly and clearly in our support inbox

  • Troubleshooting technical issues and finding workarounds that keep firms moving

  • Verifying fixes before they go back to the customer, and regression testing after releases

job.description:
This role is fully remote, open to candidates based anywhere in the United States outside New York, with a preference for the Pacific or Mountain time zones. Based in New York? Apply to the New York posting of this role instead.

A Different Kind Of Job Description

At Filed, we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job. So instead of a list of perks, we'll start with what's genuinely hard about it, then tell you why it might be the best move you'll make.

What's hard about this job

Bugs don't arrive with instructions. A customer tells you "it didn't work." Your job is to work out exactly what they did, with which return, in which tax software, and make it happen again on your own screen. If you can't reproduce it, engineering can't fix it.

Your ticket is the fix's starting point. Engineers will build from what you write. Vague steps mean days of back and forth while a firm waits. You'll need to be precise every time.

The pace is fast. Our customers are tax firms in their busiest weeks. When something breaks, they need an answer today, and a workaround while the real fix is built.

It isn't fixed until you've checked. You'll retest every fix before telling a customer it's resolved, and you'll recheck after releases that nothing else broke.

Why it might be the best career move you'll make

You'll sit between customers and engineering. Few roles see both sides this clearly. You'll learn how real firms use tax software, and how software actually gets built.

Your work ships. A bug you reproduce on Monday becomes a fix every firm on Filed benefits from. A workaround you find saves a firm hours the same day.

You'll grow as fast as we do. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, and the support and QA function is still small. People who start here move into QA, product and engineering-adjacent roles.

We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and we work with tax firms across the country, from regional practices to some of the biggest names in the profession.

job.title: Senior SDET - Framework Team
job.description:
Senior SDET

Are you looking to impact and be part of something special, such as shaping the future of healthcare? Do you take pride in building and maintaining robust test automation frameworks? Are you passionate about improving deployment processes for high-impact products?

Boxes ticked? If so, read on.

At Semble, we are on a mission to enable health professionals to amplify their impact. We improve the way healthcare is delivered to millions of people by providing doctors and their teams with powerful, innovative, intuitive, and secure software. Our cloud-based clinical system is already used by thousands of clinicians, making their lives easier and saving them money, while structuring their health data to help research.

We are a passionate and driven team, lucky to unite under strong cultural drivers:

  • Impact - We do work that matters.
  • Collaboration – We are in it together.
  • Human touch – We care deeply.

This role can be fully remote in the UK and EU (with occasional travel to our London office) within +/- 2 hours of the GMT time zone. We are unfortunately not able to consider candidates located outside these locations and time zones at this stage.

What you will be doing

The Senior SDET, Frameworks role will lead the evolution of Semble’s test automation capability and help make quality a shared engineering discipline. You will:

  • Lead the transformation towards a Quality Agent System, using AI agents and deterministic automation to continuously identify coverage gaps, generate and maintain tests, detect flaky tests, support exploratory testing, and surface reproducible defects.
  • Design safe, maintainable agent workflows with clear responsibilities, isolated execution, human review, and appropriate controls. Agents should assist engineers and SDETs, not replace human judgement or merge their own changes.
  • Establish the foundations required for this system, including a stable Playwright framework, reliable CI integration, ephemeral test environments, test data management, quality observability, and structured test knowledge.
  • Set up meaningful quality gates in CI and PR workflows, including coverage validation, framework conventions, high-risk code checks, and actionable failure reporting.
  • Rationalise our overcrowded E2E suite by identifying tests that belong at unit, API, or integration level, keeping E2E focused on critical user journeys.
  • Build and maintain a cross-layer coverage map and risk-based defect view, helping teams understand where quality gaps exist and where automation investment will have the greatest impact.
  • Expand test coverage and surface quality gaps earlier in the development lifecycle, including through test scenario generation, mutation testing, and AI-assisted exploratory testing.
  • Conduct proof-of-concepts for non-functional testing, including performance, accessibility, security, and reliability testing.
  • Contribute to company-wide quality strategy, tooling decisions, quality metrics, and shift-left adoption alongside the wider SDET and Engineering teams.
  • Coach engineers and SDETs on effective test design, the testing pyramid, Playwright, and contributing to the shared framework.

What we are looking for

At a Senior level at Semble, we will expect you to be mostly autonomous in your scope and to own and solve complex tasks or lead projects independently. You will work with peers from different functions and have an impact across department. You may be in a mentoring role for more junior team members and should be able to influence effectively and lead by example throughout the company.

  • 5+ years of professional experience as SDET or Test Automation Engineer
  • A strong track record of designing, building, and evolving automation frameworks that are reliable, maintainable, and easy for engineers to adopt.
  • Hands-on experience building AI-augmented or agentic quality workflows, not only using tools such as Cursor or Claude to generate test code.
  • A pragmatic approach to AI adoption, with awareness of data privacy, security, clinical safety, cost, and false-positive risks.
  • Strong commercial experience with TypeScript-based automation frameworks. Playwright experience is highly desirable.
  • Experience with test coverage strategy and applying the testing pyramid to reduce unnecessary E2E testing.
  • Experience with write unit, component, API and integration tests.
  • Experience with performance testing tools, such as k6, is desirable.
  • Knowledge of non-functional testing, including performance, accessibility, security, and reliability.
  • Exposure to DevOps tools and cloud infrastructure, including Jenkins, Bitbucket, Datadog, and AWS.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to represent the SDET function, challenge assumptions, and defend quality in release discussions.

What you’ll get in return

  • The great feeling coming with knowing you do something that matters: shaping the future of healthcare!
  • £65-75k package (based on your experience and the value you can bring)
  • Autonomy and ownership – we’ll set the vision and share the context, then we trust you to run with things – that’s the reason we hire you!
  • 36 days off: 25 holidays +bank holidays +3 extra days (birthday and ‘feel good’ days) - that we will expect you to actually take so you can recharge and rest.
  • Private Health Insurance – covering physical and mental health, as well as dental and optical!
  • Get the tech you need - You will get the latest MacBook (unless you prefer Windows) and take your pick across a wide range of equipment to set up your home office ergonomically.
  • Work alongside an inspiring team – our two founders have started Semble after a successful startup exit, and your future colleagues are all knowledgeable and innovators in their field.
  • Fantastic office space in Central London, right outside Monument - with a roof terrace, weekly animations, loads of natural light, and cute doggies!
  • The usual free bits coming with nice offices (barista coffee, tea, fruits, happy hours and activities.
Salary: £75,000

PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue.

  1. In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader.

At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place!

PerfectServe is seeking a Senior QA Engineer to ensure the quality, reliability, and safety of PerfectServe’s products through rigorous manual and automated testing. As a senior individual contributor, you will own complex work end-to-end, raise the quality bar, and mentor those around you.

The QA team is 100% manual today. This hire will build the test automation capability from the ground up and, over time, will be the sole QA engineer on the team, owning quality independently while working closely with developers.

In a healthcare SaaS environment where reliability and security affect patient care, this role is held to a high standard. Success means consistently demonstrating the responsibilities below, combining technical depth with collaboration, communication, and sound judgment, rather than excelling in any one area alone.

Core Responsibilities

Technical

job.title: Sr SDET - Performance Testing
job.description:
About HighLevel:
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts.

About the Role:

    HighLevel is looking for a Sr. SDET with 5+ years of experience to play a crucial role in ensuring the quality, performance, and scalability of our products. We are seeking engineers who thrive in a fast-paced startup environment, enjoy problem-solving, and stay updated with the latest models and solutions. This is a great opportunity to work on cutting-edge performance testing strategies and contribute to the success of our products.

Responsibilities:

  • Performance baselines for critical services: SLIs, SLOs, and latency, throughput, and error-rate targets, plus workload models built from production traffic and real customer behaviour
  • A shared performance testing framework and production-like environments (Kubernetes and cloud, test data included) that product-team SDETs can use without starting from scratch, and the evaluation of new tools through PoCs
  • Automated performance regression checks in CI/CD, with trend reports that catch regressions before release
  • Load, stress, soak, and spike testing, and capacity planning ahead of peak events
  • Root cause analysis of bottlenecks across API, database, queue, and frontend layers, using traces, metrics, logs, and profiling, in partnership with development, DevOps, and infrastructure teams
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices architecture, concurrency, rate limiting and common performance bottlenecks
  • Ability to interpret performance metrics, translate findings into actionable engineering recommendations, and influence technical decisions across engineering teams
  • Supervise and mentor junior team members and contribute to capability building initiatives to raise the performance bar across the team

Requirements:

  • 5+ years in performance, scalability, or reliability engineering or testing, with examples of finding and fixing bottlenecks in production-scale systems
  • Hands-on experience with at least one modern load-testing tool (k6, Gatling, or Locust), including realistic workload modeling and distributed load generation, and strong programming skills in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java
  • Experience using observability tooling (for example New Relic, Prometheus/Grafana, OpenTelemetry) to isolate root cause across API, database, and queue layers, with a solid grasp of REST service performance, concurrency, and caching
  • Experience integrating performance tests into CI/CD pipelines with pass/fail thresholds
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes and at least one major cloud (GCP, AWS, or Azure) to deploy and debug test environments

Nice to Have:

  • Runtime profiling and thread or heap analysis on the JVM or Node.js (GC behavior, event-loop lag)
  • Frontend performance experience: Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse, real user monitoring
  • Experience applying AI-assisted tooling to test design or result analysis
  • Experience with NoSQL or search datastores and message brokers at scale
  • Chaos or resilience testing, and safe testing in production (canaries, shadow traffic)

Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. job.title: Senior Salesforce QA Analyst
job.company: Blue Cross & Blue Shield of Rhode Island
job.description:
Pay Range:

$93,600.00 - $140,400.00

Please email if you are a candidate seeking a reasonable accommodation for the application and/or interview process.

At BCBSRI, our greatest resource is our people.

We come from varying backgrounds, different cultures, and unique experiences. We are hard-working, caring, and creative individuals who collaborate, support one another, and grow together. Passion, empathy, and understanding are at the forefront of everything we do—not just for our members, but for our employees as well.

We recognize that to do your best work, you have to be your best self.
It’s why we offer flexible work arrangements that include remote and hybrid opportunities and paid time off. We provide tuition reimbursement and assist with student-loan repayment. We offer health, dental, and vision insurance as well as programs that support your mental health and well-being. We pay competitively, offer bonuses and investment plans, and are committed to growing and developing our employees.

Our culture is one of belonging.
We strive to be transparent and accountable. We believe in equipping our associates with the knowledge and resources they need to be successful. No matter where you’re at in the organization, you’re an integral part of our team and your input, thoughts, and ideas are valued.

Join others who value a workplace for all.
We appreciate and celebrate everything that makes us unique, from personal characteristics to past experiences. Our different perspectives strengthen us as an organization and help us better serve all Rhode Islanders.

We’re dedicated to serving Rhode Islanders.
Our focus extends beyond providing access to high-quality, affordable, and equitable care. To further improve the health and well-being of our fellow Rhode Islanders, we regularly roll up our sleeves and get to work (literally) in communities all across the state—building homes, working in food pantries, revitalizing community centers, and transforming outdoor spaces for children and adults. Because we believe it is our collective responsibility to uplift our fellow Rhode Islanders when and where we can, our associates receive additional paid time to volunteer.

Why this job matters:

Working closely with product owners, scrum masters, developers, analysts, configuration admins, technical leads, architects, release management, integration, security, and data teams, this role directs the quality assurance strategy and execution for a Salesforce delivery pod supporting Sales, Service, and Configuration workstreams. Responsible for organizing all testing activities across day-to-day support and project delivery, defining test approach and coverage, coordinating QA work across agile/scrum ceremonies, validating Salesforce configuration and custom development, ensuring regression readiness, and driving quality practices that improve release confidence, production stability, and user outcomes.

Platform scope: Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Financial Services Cloud where applicable, Data Cloud integrations, Salesforce platform configuration, Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, APIs, integration touchpoints, test data, automation frameworks, CI/CD validation, and connected enterprise systems.

What you will do:

  • Lead and coordinate all QA activities for a Salesforce pod that includes developers, QA analysts, business analysts, and configuration admins, ensuring testing work is organized, estimated, sequenced, reviewed, and completed within agile/scrum delivery cycles.
  • Define and maintain the Salesforce QA strategy for Sales, Service, and Configuration workstreams, including functional testing, regression testing, integration testing, user acceptance testing support, data validation, smoke testing, and release readiness validation.
  • Partner with product owners, scrum masters, analysts, technical leads, and developers to refine user stories, acceptance criteria, test scenarios, test data needs, dependencies, and definition of done expectations before sprint commitment.
  • Develop, maintain, and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, traceability, regression suites, and quality metrics for both project delivery and day-to-day enhancement and support work.
  • Lead QA planning and execution across agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily standups, defect triage, sprint reviews, retrospectives, release planning, and post-release validation.
  • Coordinate with developers and configuration admins to validate Salesforce configuration, automation, Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, APIs, security, integrations, reporting, and user experience changes against business and technical requirements.
  • Direct end-to-end testing across Salesforce and connected enterprise systems, including API, middleware, data synchronization, event-driven, batch, contact center, document management, identity, reporting, and downstream integration scenarios where applicable.
  • Establish and maintain regression testing practices that support reliable Salesforce releases, including core business process coverage, high-risk process coverage, automation candidates, release impact analysis, and reusable test assets.
  • Lead defect management activities, including defect logging, prioritization, triage, root cause analysis, retest coordination, closure validation, trend analysis, and communication of quality risks and release impacts.
  • Define and monitor quality metrics such as test coverage, defect leakage, escaped defects, regression pass rate, automation coverage, test execution progress, test data readiness, and release quality indicators.
  • Partner with release management and DevOps teams to support CI/CD validation, deployment verification, smoke testing, change control, rollback planning, environment readiness, and release signoff activities.
  • Coordinate test data management for Salesforce initiatives, including data setup, masking or privacy considerations, migration validation, reconciliation, data quality checks, and repeatable test data preparation.
  • Support compliance, privacy, security, accessibility, and auditability expectations by ensuring test coverage includes role-based access, field-level security, sharing, least-privilege access, data protection, reporting accuracy, and regulatory considerations.
  • Lead production validation and support root cause analysis for quality-related incidents, defects, integration failures, data issues, access issues, automation errors, regression gaps, and user-reported Salesforce issues.
  • Coach and mentor QA team members, analysts, developers, and configuration admins on quality practices, test case design, acceptance criteria, test automation opportunities, defect quality, risk-based testing, and agile QA discipline.
  • Maintain and improve QA documentation, including test strategy, test plans, test cases, automation notes, traceability, release validation checklists, defect reports, QA standards, and support handoff materials.
  • Continuously assess Salesforce platform releases, AppExchange changes, testing tools, automation frameworks, and QA practices to recommend improvements that increase test reliability, reduce manual effort, and improve delivery velocity.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What you need to succeed:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Five to seven years of quality assurance, quality engineering, or software testing experience with significant experience testing Salesforce platform solutions in enterprise environments.
  • Demonstrated experience leading QA execution for agile/scrum teams or pods supporting a mix of project delivery, enhancements, configuration, integration testing, regression testing, and operational support work.
  • Experience testing Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud capabilities, including business process validation, configuration validation, integration validation, security/access testing, reporting validation, and release readiness testing.
  • Strong knowledge of Salesforce platform testing practices, including functional testing, regression testing, integration testing, end-to-end testing, user acceptance testing support, production smoke testing, and release validation.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce configuration and administration concepts, including objects, fields, page layouts, Lightning record pages, flows, validation rules, approval processes, profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing rules, reports, and dashboards.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce development and technical capabilities, including Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, Salesforce Flow, APIs, platform events, and integration patterns, with the ability to design appropriate test coverage for technical changes.
  • Ability to direct QA work across QA analysts, developers, analysts, and configuration admins, ensuring clear test planning, work breakdown, sequencing, estimation, dependency management, and delivery accountability.
  • Strong understanding of agile/scrum delivery practices, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily standups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, definition of ready, definition of done, and test execution management.
  • Ability to interpret business requirements, technical designs, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, data mappings, and integration specifications and translate them into effective test scenarios and test cases.
  • Experience with test management, defect management, traceability, test evidence, test reporting, QA metrics, and quality risk communication to technical and business stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of risk-based testing and the ability to prioritize test coverage based on business impact, technical complexity, user impact, integration risk, production defect history, and release scope.
  • Experience validating Salesforce security and access models, including profiles, permission sets, role hierarchy, sharing rules, field-level security, object permissions, auditability, and least-privilege access expectations.
  • Experience testing integrations between Salesforce and internal or external systems using secure and governed approaches, including data synchronization, API-led, event-driven, batch, and middleware-based patterns.
  • Experience with test automation concepts and the ability to identify automation candidates, collaborate on automation frameworks, review automated test coverage, and balance automated and manual testing approaches.
  • Experience supporting CI/CD and release management practices, including deployment validation, environment readiness, source control awareness, build verification, change control, release signoff, and post-deployment verification.
  • Knowledge of Salesforce data concepts, including standard and custom objects, relationships, data quality, test data management, data migration validation, data reconciliation, and reporting accuracy.
  • Experience troubleshooting Salesforce defects and quality issues, including automation errors, integration failures, configuration defects, user access issues, data problems, regression gaps, and environment-related concerns.
  • Ability to develop and maintain QA documentation such as test strategies, test plans, test cases, regression suites, defect reports, traceability matrices, release validation checklists, and support handoff materials.
  • Ability to mentor and coach QA team members and cross-functional delivery team members on testing discipline, acceptance criteria quality, defect quality, regression practices, and continuous quality improvement.
  • Ability to partner effectively with product owners, business stakeholders, scrum masters, analysts, architects, technical leads, developers, configuration admins, security, integration, data, release management, and operations teams.
  • Knowledge of regulated environment expectations, including privacy, auditability, data protection, accessibility, retention, secure access, protected information handling, and evidence-based validation practices.
  • Proficient communication and presentation skills for technical and non-technical audiences, including the ability to explain quality risks, test progress, release readiness, defect trends, and delivery impacts clearly.
  • Comfortable working in agile/scrum delivery models and able to operate within waterfall, hybrid, or governance-driven processes when required.

The extras:

  • Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Business Information Systems, Quality Engineering, or a related field.
  • Salesforce certifications such as Administrator, Platform App Builder, Sales Cloud Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant, Experience Cloud Consultant, Platform Developer I, or other Salesforce certifications that demonstrate platform knowledge.
  • Quality or agile certifications such as ISTQB, Certified ScrumMaster, Professional Scrum Master, SAFe, Agile Tester, or similar certification.
  • Experience supporting Salesforce in a regulated enterprise environment, preferably healthcare, insurance, financial services, or another environment with strong privacy, auditability, accessibility, and data protection requirements.
  • Experience with Experience Cloud, Financial Services Cloud, Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Agentforce/Einstein capabilities, OmniStudio, or other Salesforce cloud capabilities relevant to customer/member-facing and internal service workflows.
  • Experience with Salesforce test automation, regression automation, API testing tools, CI/CD pipeline validation, test management tools, defect management tools, and reusable test asset management.
  • Experience testing data migrations, ETL processes, data quality remediation, integration workflows, and reconciliation across Salesforce and enterprise systems.
  • Experience working in a global delivery model or with blended internal, vendor, and offshore QA and development teams.

Location:
BCBSRI is headquartered in downtown Providence, conveniently located near the train station and bus terminal. We actively support associate well-being and work/life balance and offer the following schedules, based on role:

  • In-office: onsite 5 days per week
  • Hybrid: onsite 2-4 days per week
  • Remote: onsite 0-1 days per week. Permitted to reside in the following states, pending approval from the Human Resources Department: Arizona, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, Massachusetts, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Texas, Virginia

Our culture of belonging at Blue Cross & Blue Shield of Rhode Island (BCBSRI) is at the core of all we do, and it strengthens our ability to meet the challenges of today’s healthcare industry. BCBSRI is an equal opportunity employer.

job.description:
About BTSE:

BTSE Group is a global leader in fintech and blockchain technology, anchored by three core business pillars: Exchange, Payments, and Infrastructure Development. Serving over 100 corporate clients worldwide, we provide white-label exchange and payment solutions. Our offerings encompass everything from exchange infrastructure hosting and development to custody, wallets, payments, blockchain integration, trading, and more. We are looking for talented professionals in marketing, operations, customer support, and other departments. The roles offered may be on-site, remote, or hybrid, in collaboration with our local partner.

About the Opportunity:
As Principal QA Engineer, you will own automated and performance testing for your product area(s) and set the technical standard for testing across them. You will develop test automation, design and execute stress and performance tests against high-volume trading systems, and apply AI tools to improve the speed and depth of testing, working with engineering, product, and DevOps to ensure that every release performs reliably.

Responsibilities

  • Own the testing lifecycle for new features and changes, including scoping, risk assessment, test depth, and release readiness.

  • Build and maintain automated tests covering API, UI, integration, and regression, and reduce flaky tests.

  • Design and run load, stress, and performance tests on high-risk areas (order flow, matching and settlement, balances, deposits/withdrawals), analyze results, and report bottlenecks to engineering.

  • Use AI tools to speed up test generation, analysis, and triage, and share what works with the team.

  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines with reliable quality gates.

  • Lead testing on complex or high-severity changes and make release sign-off recommendations.

  • Own the test automation architecture (frameworks, test data, environments) in line with QA standards set by the Director.

  • Mentor QA engineers through code reviews and pairing.

  • Report quality metrics (defect escape rate, critical-path coverage, release stability) to the Director and stakeholders, and raise quality and release risks early, backed by data.

Requirement

job.title: Automation Test Engineer
job.description:
We are Skyward.

That is, a love for people, for improvement, for human advancement through information technology. We are a people-centered business with a desire to serve others. We are diverse and unified; creative and collaborative; a collection of complementary, not competing talents. And though on the surface we remain relaxed, beneath, a torrent of energy links us to our civic tech mission.
We stand by our values, and we won’t compromise on any of them.
Integrity: We’re conscientious, intentional, and empathetic. Our words and actions align. That’s our character. Please don’t ask us to play another part, we’re poor actors.
Compassionate: If we may borrow a quote from Theodore Roosevelt: “No one cares how much you know until they know how much you care.” Because our team is thoughtful and supportive, caring deeply for each other, our clients, and our work, this comes naturally.
Inquisitive: We remain students by failing openly and turning lessons into solutions.
Unconventional: For us, life isn’t what happens outside of work. Work happens inside of life and our culture erases the line often dividing the two.
Authentic: Made possible only because we embody the values listed above. We’re relaxed and fun yet intensely curious and driven. Team members are placed with thought, care, and precision to ensure that Trust, Truth, and Transparency continue to represent our brand.
Because of that, we continue Onward, Upward, and Skyward.

We need an Automation Test Engineer.Are you the kind of person who can’t look at a machine learning model without wanting to test it six different ways (and then automate all six)? Do your friends sigh when you bring up responsible AI? Maybe they’ve stopped asking what you do for work because the last time you went on a 20-minute tangent about bias in training data and flaky CI pipelines for neural nets.

If that sounds familiar, you might be exactly who we’re looking for.

Come join us if you're motivated to learn from others, to learn from mistakes, to be part of a future-looking and growth-oriented team.

Let's go Skyward together.

What you’ll do:

  • Be part of a team supporting the development of an AI/ML platform that will leverage generative AI to relieve user burden across the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS).
  • Design and maintain robust, scalable automated test frameworks for web apps, APIs, and AI-driven features.
  • Develop automated pipelines for model validation, bias detection, and drift monitoring in ML-based systems.
  • Define and execute test plans that include functional, regression, performance, and AI-specific testing strategies.
  • Partner with AI/ML engineers to create test datasets and simulate real-world user behavior and edge cases.
  • Implement CI/CD-integrated quality gates to ensure AI releases meet defined reliability and fairness metrics.
  • Mentor junior engineers and help establish best practices in intelligent automation and AI testing.
  • Advocate for ethical AI standards and contribute to cross-functional discussions about responsible AI.

What we'd like you to have:

  • 5+ years of experience in software QA/automation engineering, with at least 1 year focused on AI/ML product testing.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one automation framework (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) and scripting language (Python preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with testing AI models, including validation metrics, dataset versioning, and model explainability.
  • Familiarity with tools like MLflow, TensorBoard, or similar for AI observability.
  • Understanding of model bias, fairness audits, and compliance considerations in government or regulated environments.
  • Experience working in Agile DevSecOps environments with modern CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab, etc.).
  • Strong collaboration skills with a knack for clear communication across engineering, data science, and product teams.

What would blow us away:

    • You’ve previously supported the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS).
      • Even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications, we encourage you to apply. At Skyward, we’re focused on hiring individuals with the right skills and passion to grow, not just checking off every box.

And now the important part. What we offer you:

  • Medical, dental, vision insurance
  • 15 days of paid leave
  • 7 days of sick leave
  • 2 days bereavement leave
  • 11 paid Federal holidays
  • Up to 40 hours for jury duty
  • 401K with 4% employer contribution (and no vesting period)
  • Up to 4 weeks of paid paternity and maternity leave
  • Company provided laptop
  • $5,000 per year for professional development
  • $600 per year for technical supplies and equipment
  • $2,000 referral bonus
  • Life and disability insurance
  • HSA and FSA
  • Legal Shield and ID Shield Voluntary Benefits
  • Opportunity to work in a collaborative, motivated team focused on modernizing government services with cutting-edge technology and innovative solutions. Who says government work can't be exciting!
At Skyward, we support flexible working hours and remote opportunities to help maintain a healthy work-life balance for all employees.
Offers of employment with Skyward are contingent upon acceptable results of a background investigation.

job.description:
About Care Access

Care Access is working to make the future of health better for all. With hundreds of research locations, mobile clinics, and clinicians across the globe, we bring world-class research and health services directly to communities that often face barriers to care. We are dedicated to ensuring that every person has the opportunity to understand their health, access the care they need, and contribute to the medical breakthroughs of tomorrow.

With programs like Future of Medicine, which makes advanced health screenings and research opportunities accessible to communities worldwide, and Difference Makers, which supports local leaders to expand their community health and wellbeing efforts, we put people at the heart of medical progress. Through partnerships, technology, and perseverance, we are reimagining how clinical research and health services reach the world. Together, we are building a future of health that is better and more accessible for all.

To learn more about Care Access, visit .

How This Role Makes a Difference

The Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of software applications that support clinical research and participant pre-screening operations. This position collaborates with cross-functional product development teams to develop, execute, and maintain comprehensive manual and automated testing strategies, with a strong emphasis on end-to-end test automation using Playwright. The QA Engineer identifies, documents, and helps resolve software defects throughout the development lifecycle, contributing to the delivery of high-quality, compliant, and reliable software solutions that support organizational objectives and enhance the user experience.

How You'll Make An Impact

  • Design, build, and maintain automated end-to-end test suites using Playwright across web and API surfaces.
  • Perform exploratory and structured manual testing on complex user flows, edge cases, and regression scenarios.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable fast, reliable feedback on every pull request.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers and designers during development to shift quality left, writing tests alongside features, not after.
  • Triage, reproduce, and document bugs with clear steps and context that accelerate resolution.
  • Contribute to and improve QA processes, standards, and tooling across the engineering organization.
  • Participate in test planning, sprint ceremonies, and release readiness reviews.

The Expertise Required

  • Strong proficiency with Playwright (or a comparable framework like Cypress or Puppeteer) and the ability to write maintainable, reliable tests.
  • Solid manual testing instincts: you know when to automate and when hands-on exploration surfaces more value.
  • Experience integrating test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, CircleCI, or similar).
  • Familiarity with testing APIs alongside UI flows, including REST and GraphQL endpoints.
  • Strong communication skills: you can write a clear bug report, explain a test strategy, and advocate for quality with engineers and PMs alike.
  • Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift and judgment matters.

Certifications/Licenses, Education, and Experience

  • Minimum Education:
    • Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent experience
  • Minimum Experience:
    • 3+ years of experience in software QA, with meaningful time spent in test automation.

How We Work Together

job.title: QA Manager
job.description:
About Knotch

Knotch is redefining the future of websites in the age of AI.

The way people discover, engage with, and consume content is fundamentally changing. Customers now find information and make decisions through AI, increasingly with an agent acting on their behalf. Most brand digital presences were never built for this journey. Knotch is the AI-native infrastructure that closes that gap, giving brands the ability to meet every customer, and every agent, with the right experience at the right moment, and to adapt as fast as AI and consumer behavior keep changing.

Our platform combines content intelligence, measurement, and agentic AI to show enterprises what content works, continuously optimize their sites, and deliver measurable business outcomes. At the center is ACE (Agentic Content Engine), which moves brands beyond static websites toward intelligent, adaptive ones that keep improving.

We work with some of the world’s most recognizable companies. Our culture is fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and highly adaptable. We move quickly, test ideas, and evolve with our customers. We’re looking for exceptional people who want to help shape how leading brands show up in an AI world.

About the role

We are looking for an exceptionally skilled hands-on QA Manager to join our engineering team. This person will be responsible for managing the automation suites across all products in a fast-paced environment. Creating, maintaining, executing scripts during regression, smoke, and sanity in various environments. In your first year, you will have built out our testing frameworks from scratch and have hired a QA team to help us in those efforts!

Responsibilities

  • Hands-on automation development that is AI native
  • Managing an offshore QA team and building out a US team as needed
  • Creating automated test and validation processes of APIs on cloud services
  • Building comprehensive test suites that will be utilized by overall engineering and product organizations
  • Recommending and maintaining appropriate frameworks to automate test scenarios
  • Define testing and evaluation strategies for AI-powered features, including regression testing, output quality, reliability, edge cases, and non-deterministic behavior
  • Analyzing and reporting on test automation progress
  • Performing manual, exploratory and performance testing
  • Analyzing test results, performing RCAs and file tickets as necessary in JIRA
  • Establishing test automation code coverage metrics
  • Collaborating closely with our product manager, project manager (agile), and software engineers to define best practices for testing our applications (both internal and external facing)

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of QA engineering experience, including 2+ years leading or managing a test automation team
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools and agents for test automation
  • Strong expertise in automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Watir, HeadSpin or similar
  • Proven ability to define tool strategy and build scalable test automation frameworks from the ground up
  • Experience writing scalable, reusable test scripts and running them in an Agile/Scrum environment
  • Solid experience with manual and automated API testing, including Postman
  • Experience setting up CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated tests into them
  • Practical experience with source control systems (e.g., Git)
  • Familiarity with AWS, GCP or similar cloud platforms, and working knowledge of SQL
  • Excellent communication and mentorship skills, with experience leading distributed teams

How to be Successful

  • Builder mentality: you’re energized by starting from zero. You can stand up frameworks, processes and a team from scratch without waiting for a playbook.
  • Hands-on and leading at the same time: you’re as comfortable writing and debugging automation scripts as you are mentoring engineers and setting direction for the team.
  • AI-native problem solving: you reach for AI tools and agents first to speed up test creation and maintenance, and you know how to test AI features whose outputs can change from run to run.
  • Quality as a mindset, not a phase: you push testing earlier in the development cycle and help engineering and product teams own quality alongside you.
  • Root-cause curiosity: you don’t stop at “it’s broken.” You dig into the “why,” run thorough RCAs and turn what you learn into lasting process fixes.
  • Data-driven reporting: you track coverage, defect trends and automation progress, and you use those numbers to show impact and guide decisions.
  • Pragmatic prioritization: in a fast-paced environment, you balance coverage, speed and risk. You know what to automate, what to test by hand and what can wait.
  • Precision and attention to detail: you catch the edge cases others miss and won’t sign off on a release until you trust the results.
  • Clear communication across time zones: you keep an offshore team aligned and productive, and you explain quality risks so non-technical stakeholders understand them.
  • Voice your opinions: how can we make our products, releases and engineering practices better based on what testing shows you?

Nice to Have

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • QA or testing certifications (e.g., ISTQB) or cloud certifications (AWS/GCP)
  • Experience with performance and load testing tools (e.g., JMeter, k6, Locust)
  • Eastern Time Zone location for easier collaboration with the team and offshore partners

Why Join Knotch

You will be the founding leader of quality at Knotch, building our testing frameworks, automation suites and QA team from the ground up. Your work will shape how every product is built, tested and released, so our engineering and product teams can ship faster and with confidence. You’ll work with AI-native tools, cloud-based products and a talented team that values ownership, precision and impact.

The expected salary range for this opportunity is $136,000-163,000 CAD depending on skills and experience.

Our Benefits and Perks

Knotch is a fully remote company. Candidates may work from anywhere within Canada, with Eastern time zone preferred, through our employer of record. Some of our other great benefits include:

  • Comprehensive health benefits through our employer of record (EOR) relationship with Globalization Partners
  • Unlimited PTO
  • 10+ company-paid holidays
  • Wellness and work-from-home perks
  • Company and team offsites

job.description:
About the Role

We’re looking for a detail-oriented and professional Healthcare Quality Assurance & Onboarding Coordinator to support quality assurance, documentation compliance, and onboarding within a healthcare services environment.

The ideal candidate is organised, communicates confidently, and enjoys working with detailed processes that require accuracy and consistency. You’ll play an important role in ensuring that Registered Behavior Technicians (RBTs) submit accurate and complete session notes, follow the required documentation standards, and understand how to use the relevant software and systems.

While the primary focus will be quality assurance and onboarding, the role may also involve occasional HR and administrative support as needed. We’re looking for someone who is adaptable, takes initiative, and is comfortable stepping in to assist outside their core responsibilities when required.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Quality Assurance & Documentation

  • Review session notes and clinical documentation to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with established standards.
  • Monitor documentation submissions and follow up with RBTs to ensure outstanding or incorrect session notes are addressed promptly.
  • Identify missing information, inconsistencies, and recurring documentation issues, escalating concerns where necessary.
  • Maintain accurate records and trackers to monitor documentation quality, outstanding items, and compliance deadlines.
  • Support the implementation and maintenance of quality assurance processes and procedures.

Onboarding & Software Training

  • Assist with onboarding new RBTs, ensuring they understand documentation requirements, internal processes, and relevant procedures.
  • Train new team members on how to navigate and use the relevant software and systems.
  • Provide guidance and ongoing support to RBTs who need assistance with documentation or system-related queries.
  • Follow up with new starters to ensure they are comfortable with the systems and are meeting the required standards.

Communication & Team Support

  • Communicate professionally with RBTs and internal team members regarding documentation requirements, outstanding tasks, and areas for improvement.
  • Provide clear instructions and constructive feedback to help maintain high standards of documentation.
  • Work collaboratively with relevant teams to resolve documentation issues and support smooth day-to-day operations.
  • Assist with occasional HR-related tasks and general administrative duties when needed.

Requirements

  • Previous experience in quality assurance, compliance, documentation review, onboarding, training, or a similar coordination role.
  • Experience in a healthcare environment is preferred, with healthcare quality assurance experience considered a strong advantage.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify errors, inconsistencies, and missing information.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • A professional, patient, and organised approach to following up with team members.
  • Comfortable with repetitive, detail-heavy tasks that require accuracy and consistency.
  • Confident using computer systems and learning new software platforms.
  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple follow-ups and deadlines.
  • Flexible and willing to assist with responsibilities outside the primary scope of the role when needed.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is someone who takes pride in getting the details right. They are comfortable reviewing documentation, following up on outstanding tasks, and ensuring processes are completed correctly rather than simply ticking boxes.

They communicate professionally, can confidently hold team members accountable for completing required documentation, and enjoy helping others learn new systems and processes.

Someone with experience in healthcare administration, clinical documentation, quality assurance, compliance, or training and onboarding would be well suited to this role.

What Success Looks Like

  • Session notes are submitted accurately, completely, and on time.
  • Documentation errors and outstanding submissions are followed up on consistently.
  • New RBTs are onboarded effectively and can confidently use the required software.

The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Job Description

The Senior Software Design Assurance (Sr Software Design Quality) Engineer provides technical support and guidance to Software teams to ensure conformance to software development process and other applicable safety and quality system regulation and standards (e.g. IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971).


This role will be responsible for various aspects of Software Design Assurance with a focus on product improvement, new product development, and defect prevention. This position will interface with different cross functional groups (Software Engineering, Software Test, Regulatory Affairs, Marketing, Project

managers, Systems Engineering, Cybersecurity, and others). A positive attitude is important while working in a fast-paced environment and dealing with shifting priorities.


Where you come in:

  • You will actively participate as a core member of the R&D Quality Assurance Engineering team, supporting software design assurance for cloud‑based, data platform, and AI/ML‑enabled systems.

  • You will author, review, and maintain technical documentation including Design History Files, SOPs, protocols, and reports for cloud‑based and AI/ML‑enabled systems.

What makes you successful:

  • • Nice to have: AI/ML experience or ASQ CSQE certification.

job.title: QA Engineer - Backend & Frontend
job.description:
At Qu you’ll find a fun, dynamic, and diverse culture that celebrates team and individual success. Our people are down to earth, trail blazin’ folks who value innovation.

While mostly virtual, we collaborate closely to produce leading-edge software solutions much needed in the restaurant industry.

Our technology team is a rapidly growing group of talented and experienced engineers building the leading enterprise software company focused on restaurant technology. We use modern technologies, automation, and AI-assisted engineering practices to build products that power restaurant operations at scale.

We are looking for a hands-on QA Engineer who is strong in both manual and automated testing, across backend APIs and frontend UIs. You'll test end-to-end flows that cross several Qu products, such as an order that starts in POS or web ordering and ends on the kitchen display. You'll make sure every case is tested at the right level, from API checks to end-to-end and manual tests.

You'll work inside QuDLC, Qu's AI-first delivery lifecycle. AI agents refine each story, propose its test cases, and write the tests before the code; people decide at review gates, on evidence. As the team's quality engineer, you own two of those gates: you approve the test cases before development starts, and you sign off the story when the test results are in.

What You'll Do Here

  • Review the test cases AI agents propose from each story's acceptance criteria: tighten vague steps, add missing negative and edge cases, and approve them in AIO Tests.
  • Review each story's test plan before development starts: the right test level for every case (unit, API, end-to-end or manual), and which existing tests to reuse, update or retire.
  • Review, debug and fix the backend API and frontend UI tests that agents write in TypeScript and Playwright. Keep the shared fixtures, page objects and API clients healthy, and the smoke suite focused on critical paths.
  • Run exploratory testing and the cases that stay manual, then sign off each story using the pipeline's results: smoke tests, the story's own tests and the AIO Tests run.
  • Test end-to-end flows across services, such as POS, web ordering, the in-store server and the kitchen display, including scheduled and multi-channel orders.
  • Investigate failing, flaky and blocked tests: read the pipeline's diagnosis, separate environment, test data and product issues, and fix the test plan or cases when they are the cause.
  • Give feedback that improves how the AI agents write test cases and tests.
  • Answer testing questions during story refinement, and partner with developers and product managers on release validation.

Experience We're Looking For

  • 4+ years in QA or Quality Engineering, with hands-on experience in both manual testing and test automation.
  • Strong test design and exploratory testing: turning acceptance criteria into clear test cases, finding edge and negative cases, and writing defect reports with precise repro steps.
  • Knowledge of test levels (unit, integration, API, end-to-end) and when to use each.
  • Hands-on UI and API automation with Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, including the Page Object Model, REST APIs and JSON payloads.
  • Programming skills in TypeScript or JavaScript, or in another language such as Java or Python with readiness to work in TypeScript; strong enough to review and fix test code you didn't write.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (ideally Azure DevOps), Git and pull request reviews, and with debugging flaky tests and environment issues.
  • Hands-on experience reviewing AI-generated test cases, tests or code, and deciding on evidence whether to trust them.
  • Clear written and spoken English, and experience working in Agile/Scrum teams.

Bonus Experience

  • Experience with agentic development tools such as Kiro, or with AI-first delivery workflows where agents generate tests and code.
  • Experience with test-first development (TDD), where tests fail before the code exists and pass after.
  • Experience with restaurant technology, POS, kitchen display systems or online ordering.
  • Experience testing systems where on-premise components sync with cloud services.
  • Experience with test management and traceability tools such as AIO Tests or TestRail.
  • PowerShell or other scripting to set up Windows test environments.
  • Experience with code-quality tooling: ESLint, Prettier and pre-commit hooks.

Technology Environment

  • TypeScript / Node.js
  • Playwright (UI and API tests)
  • REST API testing
  • Azure DevOps (Repos and Pipelines)
  • Git
  • Jira
  • AIO Tests (test case management)
  • ESLint, Prettier and pre-commit hooks
  • PowerShell (Windows test setup)
  • QuDLC (Qu's AI-first delivery lifecycle): Kiro agents in Azure Pipelines, human review gates, and an AI pull request reviewer

The Type of Team Player We Need

  • Proactive mindset with a high degree of ownership and accountability.
  • Passion for quality, automation, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong analytical thinker and creative problem-solver.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities.
  • Curious about AI-assisted software development, and careful to verify what AI produces.
  • Team-oriented professional who enjoys partnering across Engineering, Product, and QA disciplines.

  • Collaborate with engineering to implement enhancements and prevent regression issues.

Monitoring & Analytics:

  • Use monitoring tools such as Datadog to analyze system logs, track recurring errors, and identify performance bottlenecks.
  • Detect patterns in system failures or automation issues and propose preventive solutions.
  • Collaborate with engineering on data-driven troubleshooting and debugging initiatives.

Documentation & Knowledge Sharing:

  • Create clear, detailed technical documentation for workflows, API usage, automation scripts, and troubleshooting procedures.
  • Maintain internal cheat sheets, guides, and best practices for the support team.
  • Share insights and lessons learned from ticket resolutions to improve team knowledge and operational efficiency.

  • Provide support and guidance to other teams implementing integrations, automation, or advanced workflows.
  • Assist in evaluating new features and identifying potential support challenges before release.

Customer Communication & Escalations:

  • Provide clear, professional, and technical communication to customers regarding system issues, workarounds, and resolutions.
  • Track critical escalations and ensure engineering and leadership are updated on progress.
  • Maintain high customer satisfaction by balancing technical detail with actionable guidance.

What are the required qualifications for a Technical Support Engineer?

  • 3+ years of experience in SaaS software support and troubleshooting or solution architecture/implementation of SaaS software solutions.
  • Proficiency in SQL, GraphQL, APIs, JSON, and Excel/Google sheet functions
  • Familiarity with Snowflake and API tools like Postman or Insomnia
  • Familiarity with developer tools on the browser (e.g. console errors and network requests)
  • Familiarity with Python and Playwright for testing
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Datadog or similar to analyze system logs
  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science or computer engineering is plus
  • B2B SaaS startup experience is a strong plus
  • Motivated, high energy, self starter that works well independently and as part of a team of company leaders, engineers, customer support analysts, and account managers

job.title: Senior Reporting QA & Data Validation Analyst (RCM)
job.description:
About The Auctus Group LLC

Who we are: We’re big on people and culture at the Auctus Group. Our most important role as a company is to provide an amazing working environment for our team. We’ve been work-from-home-warriors since before it was cool. We support (like encourage and fund) continuing education. We match charitable donations. Our whole goal is: work to live not live to work. Oh and we’re weirdos too…we do remote happy hours and have a book club and goofy stuff like that.

Who we’re looking for: Smart, talented, tech-savvy, experienced, go-getter types. You’ll do well if:

  • you like a fast-paced environment,
  • you thrive with change and development,
  • you like giving feedback,
  • you’re a team player,
  • you love learning/sleuthing,
  • you’re big on accountability.

About The Role

The Senior Reporting Quality Assurance & Data Validation Analyst is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of reports across healthcare practice management systems, electronic health records (EHRs), billing platforms, and internal reporting solutions.

This role works closely with the Reporting & Business Intelligence team, operations, and technical teams to validate reporting outputs, reconcile data across systems, investigate discrepancies, and strengthen reporting quality controls. Success requires strong SQL and Excel skills, sound analytical judgment, and the ability to trace reporting issues to their source and help drive them to resolution.

What You'll Do

  • Independently validate reports, dashboards, and datasets before they are shared with clients, leadership, or operational stakeholders.
  • Reconcile reported figures against source systems, including EHRs, practice management platforms, billing applications, internal databases, and automated extracts.
  • Perform record-level and aggregate-level checks to identify missing, duplicate, inaccurate, or inconsistent data.
  • Verify calculations, business rules, filters, date ranges, and metric definitions across financial, operational, productivity, and revenue cycle reports.
  • Investigate differences involving posting dates, transaction dates, adjustments, voids, refunds, and reporting cutoffs, distinguishing legitimate reporting differences from actual errors.
  • Trace discrepancies through data extraction, transformation, and reporting processes, working with analysts, developers, and data engineers to identify root causes and resolve issues.
  • Conduct regression testing when reporting logic, data pipelines, or source systems change.
  • Develop repeatable testing procedures, reconciliation templates, and validation checklists for recurring reports.
  • Create exception reports and identify opportunities to automate repetitive validation activities.
  • Document testing results, supporting evidence, business impact, recommended corrections, and resolutions to maintain clear records and support audit readiness.
  • Partner with operational stakeholders to clarify reporting requirements and expected results, and promptly escalate material inaccuracies.
  • Track recurring reporting defects and recommend improvements that strengthen data quality and reporting reliability.
  • Follow company policies for patient confidentiality, HIPAA compliance, and the secure handling of sensitive healthcare information.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in data analysis, reporting quality assurance, data validation, reconciliation, or a related analytical role.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, conditional formulas, and comparisons of large datasets.
  • Strong SQL skills for querying, comparing, aggregating, reconciling, and validating data.
  • Demonstrated experience investigating discrepancies across reports, databases, or business systems and identifying their underlying causes.
  • Ability to interpret complex business rules and translate them into practical validation scenarios.
  • Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with consistent attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to independently investigate issues, follow through on findings, and manage multiple reporting validation assignments.
  • Strong written communication and documentation skills, including the ability to explain findings and business impact clearly.
  • Reliable computer access and a stable, high-speed internet connection suitable for remote work.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM), medical billing, or healthcare reporting, with an understanding of accounts receivable, charges, payments, adjustments, denials, collections, and financial reconciliation.
  • Familiarity with EHR or practice management platforms such as ModMed, Tebra, Nextech, DrChrono, AdvancedMD, athenahealth, or OpenPM.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence platforms.
  • Familiarity with Python, Power Query, automated data validation tools, or data quality monitoring and exception reporting.
  • Experience validating ETL/ELT pipelines, APIs, or database integrations.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA requirements and handling sensitive healthcare information.

Who We Are

At The Auctus Group, we help healthcare providers focus on patient care by supporting the revenue cycle operations behind their practices. We bring care, dependable service, and thoughtful problem-solving to our relationships with clients and teammates.

Our culture puts people first. We have long embraced remote work and make a deliberate effort to keep our team connected. We encourage continued learning, support community giving, and value a healthy balance between professional and personal life.

Who We’re Looking For

We’re looking for curious, dependable people who take ownership of their work and care about its impact on clients and colleagues. You’ll be a strong fit if you:

  • Ask thoughtful questions and verify assumptions.
  • Enjoy investigating complex problems and following the evidence.
  • Take responsibility for issues and help bring them to resolution.
  • Communicate openly and welcome constructive feedback.
  • Collaborate well with others and adapt as systems and priorities evolve.
  • Look for practical ways to improve accuracy, consistency, and efficiency.

If you enjoy finding the explanation behind the numbers and helping others make decisions with confidence, we’d like to hear from you.

job.title: Power Platform Tester
job.description:
Description

About Our Team

Our employees thrive in a culture that's fast-paced and ego-free, where innovation and collaboration are encouraged at every turn. We are an organization that provides federal agencies instant access to experienced and talented professionals who understand their unique challenges and know the most efficient ways to address them. We are continually investing in resources and talent, so we stay prepared with specialized teams in place who are experts in creating tailored technologies. Our solutions empower Federal organizations to grow, modernize, and succeed in a rapidly evolving landscape.

We value all voices and want to attract talent from all backgrounds. We're on the lookout for individuals who are passionate about technology and thrive in environments where problem-solving is approached with creativity and enthusiasm. If you're someone who enjoys continuously expanding your skill set while tackling real-world business problems, you'll feel right at home with us. Veterans and military spouses are especially encouraged to bring your unique and valuable experience to our team.

About the Role

Our team is seeking a Power Platform Tester to join our fast-growing IT-project based consulting business. We need a team member who is ready to plan, execute, and automate testing of Microsoft Power Platform solutions that support the missions of our federal customers. This is a specialized role for a tester who knows the Power Platform inside and out — from canvas and model-driven apps to Power Automate flows, Dataverse, custom connectors, and the APIs that tie them together.

The successful candidate will be a detail-oriented, inquisitive problem solver who can quickly understand business requirements and translate them into thorough, repeatable test coverage. In this fully remote role, you will validate workflows and functionality across Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and Azure Government; build automated tests with Power Apps Test Studio, Power Apps Test Engine, and Playwright; and verify that every user persona sees and does exactly what their security role allows. Your work will give product owners clear, actionable reporting on quality and readiness for release.

You will work and collaborate on a team of project managers, business analysts, developers/engineers, and QA staff within an Agile environment. As a crucial member of our team, you will also be expected to interface with client representatives, including product owners, business owners, technical leads, and solution architects.

Responsibilities

•Validate requirements by testing workflows and functionality using Power Apps (canvas and model-driven), Power Automate, Azure Government, APIs, and Dataverse.

•Develop and execute test plans, test cases, scripts, and test results that provide actionable reporting to product owners and stakeholders.

•Execute testing activities for functionality, integrations, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT).

•Record, build, and run UI tests for canvas apps using Power Apps Test Studio and Power Fx expressions.

•Create and maintain automated test plans using Power Apps Test Engine (YAML/Power Fx test plans, connector mocking) with Playwright and the Power Platform CLI.

•Use Playwright and/or Selenium for deeper UI, browser-based, and model-driven app regression testing.

•Test custom connectors and validate Dataverse Web API endpoints using Postman or other REST clients.

•Use Power Platform Monitor to debug apps in real time and inspect network calls, formula errors, and data flow behavior.

•Test Power Automate cloud flows, including triggers, conditions, approvals, error handling, and connection behavior.

•Perform role-based persona testing to validate security roles, business units, team and field-level security, and access requirements.

•Validate functionality and data integrity during migrations from on-premises systems to cloud services.

•Document, track, prioritize, and drive resolution of defects in partnership with developers and product owners.

•Validate solution deployments across development, test, and production environments.

•Verify that applications meet Section 508 accessibility requirements.

•Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and sprint reviews.

•Develop and maintain test documentation throughout the software development life cycle (SDLC).

TAG:

TAG: INDMJC

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related technical field, or four (4) years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree
  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience in software quality assurance and testing
  • Minimum of three (3) years of on-the-job experience testing Microsoft Power Platform solutions, including Power Apps (canvas and model-driven), Power Automate, and Dataverse
  • Hands-on experience with Power Apps Test Studio and/or Power Apps Test Engine
  • Experience with Playwright or Selenium for browser-based test automation
  • Experience testing REST APIs, custom connectors, and Dataverse Web API endpoints using Postman or similar tools
  • Experience using Power Platform Monitor to troubleshoot app behavior, network calls, and formula errors
  • Experience with role-based persona testing and security access requirements
  • Experience developing and executing test plans for functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing
  • Experience documenting, tracking, and managing defects in tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps
  • Familiarity with migration from on-premises to cloud services
  • Minimum two (2) years of experience working in an Agile framework
  • Ability to communicate complex concepts effectively to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Military experienced candidates are encouraged
  • Candidates will need to obtain Security Clearance of Public Trust once hired
  • Work is full-time 100% remote

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience testing in Microsoft Azure Government cloud environments
  • Proficiency with Power Fx and the Power Platform CLI (pac)
  • Experience writing Playwright tests in JavaScript or TypeScript
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions)
  • Experience with Power Platform ALM, including managed solutions and environment strategy
  • Experience with Section 508 accessibility testing tools (e.g., ANDI, axe)
  • Microsoft certifications such as PL-200, PL-400, or PL-900; ISTQB certification
  • Experience with Federal government agencies
