job.title: Global Head of Testing Center of Excellence
job.description:
Job Purpose

Job Purpose

We're looking for a leader to build and scale our Global Readiness Assurance Center of Excellence, extending RWS's proven testing capabilities into a broader, higher-value assurance offering. You will take an established strategic direction, shape it into a differentiated market proposition, and orchestrate the people, partners and delivery models needed to make it real. This is a role for someone who is energized by adapting a vision to make it a reality. They will also be leading some of the key strategic opportunities as a subject matter expert with a commercial hat. This is a dual-mandate role: half the job is building the internal engine (solution design, value optimization, market positioning, orchestrating sales to delivery working with partners etc.,), and half is being the face of the practice to clients — winning trust, consulting, sharing thought leadership, and turning pilots into repeatable revenue. Reporting to the Global Head of Testing, this position is an anchor role in designing the DNA and identity of RWS in global markets.

About RWS

The NASA Transform unit is part of the RWS Group, a unique, world-leading provider of technology-enabled language, content, data and intellectual property solutions. Through content transformation and multilingual data analysis, our unique combination of technology and cultural expertise helps our clients to grow by ensuring they are understood anywhere, in any language.

Our purpose is unlocking global understanding. We work with over 80% of the world’s top 100 brands, more than three-quarters of Fortune’s 20 ‘Most Admired Companies’ and almost all of the top pharmaceutical companies, investment banks, law firms and patent filers. Our client base spans Europe, Asia Pacific and North and South America. Our 65+ global locations across five continents service clients in the automotive, chemical, financial, legal, medical, pharmaceutical, technology and telecommunications sectors.

Founded in 1958, RWS is headquartered in the UK and publicly listed on AIM, the London Stock Exchange regulated market (RWS.L).

For further information, please visit: RWS

Job Overview

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and execute the CoE strategy, roadmap, and operating model for the testing offering
  • Build and maintain testing methodology, automation frameworks, accelerators, and reference architectures — with particular attention to Global Readiness given RWS's brand and offering
  • Own the tool stack point of view (build vs. buy vs. partner) and manage vendor/alliance relationships
  • Establish estimation models, staffing pyramids, and quality benchmarks (defect leakage, coverage, cycle time)
  • Partner with pre-sales/solutioning on RFP responses, effort estimation, and proposal development for GRA/testing engagements
  • Convert pilot engagements into referenceable case studies and expand relationships into recurring revenue
  • Develop case studies derived from exciting and ongoing client engagements
  • Drive the shift from traditional QA toward modern quality engineering practices, including AI-enabled testing where relevant
  • Own certification and career-path frameworks for the practice's talent pool
  • Engage in client facing sales activities to secure new business wins and coordinate with Marketing as appropriate.
  • Positively promote RWS services and products at all times.
  • Work with RWS marketing to inform and steer appropriate campaigns.
  • Adhere to corporate branding guidelines in all proposals, emails and general communications.

Objectives

  • Establish CoE: Build off of existing knowledge, capabilities and offerings to establish a GRA/Testing offering for RWS.
  • Thought leadership: Develop and deliver new innovative solutions and market-leading offerings for clients.
  • Expand Solution Offerings: Identify opportunities to introduce new services or products that address evolving client needs and bring ideas to reality through innovation & entrepreneurial approach.
  • Innovation in value proposition: Connects dots across disciplines (localization, AI, QA, compliance, CX) to create propositions competitors can't easily copy.
  • Develop pipeline working with GTM teams: Partner with sales leaders and account managers to develop market-ready solutions in the evolving world of requirements
  • Ensure Client Satisfaction: In complex engagements, develop and deliver solutions that deliver expected business outcome to clients.
  • Collaborate Across Departments: Work closely with sales, marketing, and product teams to align efforts and deliver integrated solutions to clients.
  • Stay Informed on Industry Trends: Keep abreast of market developments, competitor activities, and emerging opportunities to provide strategic value to clients.
  • Represent RWS in public forums: Be the expert in the room and deliver RWS’ vision, capabilities and value proposition with conviction and clarity.

Skills & Experience

  • 12+ years in product/software/globalization testing, with 3+ years in a practice-building, CoE, or client-facing leadership role
  • Proven track record standing up or scaling a Testing CoE or similar capability function
  • Experience with Globalization/localization/linguistic QA or content-heavy testing domains
  • Entrepreneurial spirit in taking idea to outcomes
  • Exposure to AI/ML-driven testing tools and quality engineering transformation
  • Experience with test automation frameworks and modern QA tooling (Selenium, Tricentis, Applitools, or equivalent)
  • Strong client relationship management experience — comfortable in front of senior stakeholders
  • Ability to present in public forums and large internal groups about GRA
  • Ability to develop proposals and business case for clients/internal needs
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (or equivalent experience)
  • Must value the customers success as much as your own.
  • Willingness to travel as needed to meet objectives.

Benefits

At RWS, we believe great people do their best work when they feel supported, empowered, and able to thrive both professionally and personally. That's why we offer:

    • Generous time away from work – Start with 25 days of paid time off (15 vacation days and 10 sick days), plus company holidays, a birthday day off, and paid time for volunteering in your community.
    • Comprehensive parental leave – Enjoy 100% paid parental leave, giving you the time and support you need during life's most important moments.
    • Retirement savings support – Plan for your future with our 401(k) retirement plan and company match.
    • Flexible ways of working – Benefit from our company-wide agile work policy, designed to support flexibility, trust, and work-life balance.
    • Growth and development opportunities – Access ongoing learning, professional development programs, and opportunities to expand your skills and career.
    • A collaborative and inclusive culture – Join a team of talented, supportive colleagues in a global environment that values diverse perspectives, innovation, and continuous learning.

Base Pay

$160,000 - $225,000 / year

Actual rate of pay may vary based on factors including, but not limited to: position offered, location, education, training, and/or experience. Total compensation may also include variable incentives, bonuses, benefits, and/or other perks, as outlined in any formal offer made.

*Candidates must reside in State advertised to be considered

Life at RWS

Life at RWS - If you like the idea of working with smart people who are passionate about growing the value of ideas, data and content by making sure organizations are understood, then you’ll love life at RWS.

Our purpose is to unlock global understanding. This means our work fundamentally recognizes the value of every language and culture. So, we celebrate difference, we are inclusive and believe that diversity makes us strong. We want every employee to grow as an individual and excel in their career.

In return, we expect all our people to live by the values that unite us: to partner, putting clients fist and winning together, to pioneer, innovating fearlessly and leading with vision and courage, to progress, aiming high and growing through actions and to deliver, owning the outcome and building trust with our colleagues and clients.

RWS embraces DEI and promotes equal opportunity, we are an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. RWS is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at RWS are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, religion, nationality, ethnicity, sex, age, disability, or sexual orientation. RWS will not tolerate discrimination based on any of these characteristics.

RWS Values

Get the 3Ps right – Partner, Pioneer, Progress – and we´ll Deliver together as RWS.

Covid Vaccination - All RWS employees hired for positions that require working on-site at RWS offices, customer offices, travel on behalf of RWS, and/or in-person meetings will be required to comply with the RWS USA COVID-19 Vaccination and Testing Policy. RWS complies with federal, state, and local laws regarding accommodations related to this policy.

Recruitment Agencies: RWS Holdings PLC does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward any unsolicited resumes to any RWS employees. Any unsolicited resume received will be treated as the property of RWS and Terms & Conditions associated with the use of such resume will be considered null and void.

job.title: QA & Verifications Specialist
job.description:
QA & Verifications Specialist

Are you a skilled QA & Verification Specialist ready for a challenging and rewarding next step? Do you combine strong technical expertise with sharp analytical thinking and a genuine passion for delivering high-quality software? If so, Codekeeper invites you to join our team.

We are searching for a detail-oriented professional with a passion for problem-solving and a commitment to excellence. In this role, you will help ensure the reliability, accuracy, and performance of our systems while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. Your work will directly contribute to maintaining the high standards our clients expect. If you thrive in a dynamic environment that values creativity, teamwork, and continuous improvement, this opportunity is for you.

We’re accepting applications over the next two months and will close the position as soon as we find the right fit - so we encourage early applications.

About the Role

The primary focus of this role is to ensure the integrity and reliability of our customers' software through verification processes. This role involves analyzing technical documentation, executing successful software builds in various programming languages, and validating software functionality against specified requirements. Additionally, you will be involved in conducting thorough testing of various scenarios, employing both manual and automated testing approaches. Your meticulous attention to detail will enable you to identify and report any bugs or glitches discovered during testing.

What You’ll Be Doing

Software Verification

  • Conduct verification of customer software using provided technical documentation

  • Achieve software builds across various programming languages

  • Identify, diagnose, and resolve build issues, ensuring software meets quality standards

Quality Assurance & Testing

  • Conduct end-to-end testing of application features across multiple scenarios

  • Use both manual and automated testing methods to validate functionality

  • Identify, document, and report bugs or inconsistencies to ensure a high-quality user experience

Technical Analysis and Problem Solving

  • Analyze software requirements and technical documentation to understand build processes and dependencies

Collaboration and Communication

  • Communicate effectively with team members and clients to understand requirements and provide updates

Continuous Learning and Improvement

  • Stay updated with emerging technologies and programming languages relevant to software verification

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of verification processes and practices

Why Codekeeper?

We were founded by tech industry professionals to revolutionize software escrow for the cloud era. We offer state-of-the-art software escrow solutions that mitigate third-party risks in business operations. As a remote-first company with a central office in The Hague, we prioritize a healthy, resilient organization to support the development of our robust app.

What You Can Expect

  • Passionate and fun-loving colleagues

  • Startup mindset with ample opportunities for growth

  • Regular team activities and gatherings

  • Comprehensive onboarding process with a dedicated ramp-up period

  • A supportive team that values open communication and direct feedback

  • A chance to excel in your career and make a difference

About You

  • 3+ years development / DevOps experience (beneficial)

  • 2+ years of experience with Linux, Windows and Mac environment fundamentals

  • Basic understanding of popular backend languages (Python, Java, NodeJS and PHP)

  • Prior experience or understanding of database- and server configuration (MongoDB, SQL, MySQL)

  • Prior experience or understanding of Git

  • Basic knowledge of front-end languages HTML, CSS, and JavaScript beneficial

  • Basic knowledge of AWS technologies beneficial

  • Basic knowledge of API configuration beneficial

  • Experience with various build tools, like (but not specifically) msbuild, webpack, maven, and others of the type beneficial

Additional Requirements

  • Technical Expertise: Proficiency in multiple programming languages and software development tools

  • Analytical Skills: Strong ability to analyze technical documentation and identify key requirements

  • Problem-Solving: Excellent problem-solving abilities to diagnose and resolve complex software issues

  • Communication: Effective communication skills, both verbal and written, for collaborating with teams and clients

  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to various programming environments and quickly learn new technologies

  • Teamwork: Strong team player with the ability to work in cross-functional teams

  • Time Management: Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously

Additional Info

Job Location: Remote (
Join us to shape the future of software escrow!

How To Apply

To apply, use the Apply button on this listing. In your application, tell us how you would like to fill this position. There are no right answers or expectations. Show us your role in our company’s future and our role in yours, address some of the work we do, and introduce yourself as a colleague.

Please note: Applications and follow-ups sent through any other channel, such as our customer website chat, support email or direct messages to team members, won’t be considered. Need an accessibility adjustment to apply? Visit Our Careers Page for how to reach us.

job.title: Test Engineer (Clearance Required) - Remote US
job.description:
The Work: We are seeking a detail-oriented Test Engineer to support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), automated and regression testing efforts across application releases. This role partners closely with developers, product owners, and business stakeholders to ensure solutions meet functional requirements and are release-ready.


Job Location: This is a fully remote role which may require occasional travel to the DC Metro area as needed for onsite client meetings. Preference to candidates located within the Washington, DC Metro area.


If you accept this position, you should note that ICF does monitor employee work locations and blocks access from foreign locations/foreign IP addresses, and also prohibits personal VPN connections.


Our core work hours are 8am - 5pm Eastern Time with the option to start earlier or work later depending on your time zone.


What You Will Do:

  • Provide User Acceptance Testing (UAT) support, validating that system requirements are met prior to release
  • Execute manual and automated test cases, including functional, regression, and release validation testing
  • Develop, maintain, and execute automated testing scripts using established testing frameworks
  • Support release validation by verifying defect fixes and confirming readiness for production deployment
  • Identify, document, and track defects using Jira, partnering with development teams through resolution
  • Create and maintain test artifacts, including test plans, test cases, execution results, and release sign-offs
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies and collaborate within CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing
  • Analyze test results and provide clear status reporting to stakeholders

What You Will Bring With You:

  • Active Top Secret clearance (interim ok)
  • 5+ years of experience in QA, UAT, and/or software testing roles
  • Must be a US Citizen due to federal contract requirements.
  • Candidate must reside in the U.S., be authorized to work in the U.S., and all work must be performed in the U.S.

What We Would Like You To Bring With You:

  • Hands-on experience with UAT support, test case execution, and regression testing
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks
  • Proficiency with Jira or similar defect tracking tools
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools and pipelines in Agile environments
  • Strong experience creating and maintaining test documentation and artifacts
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and collaboration skills

job.title: Senior QA Engineer (OTE $50,000/year USD), Sparkrock
job.description:
Are you a senior QA engineer who writes the test automation that keeps enterprise ERP software reliable?

At Sparkrock, we help social benefit organizations, such as nonprofits, school boards, and government agencies, reach their full potential through technology. Every day, over 150,000 people use our ERP and product platforms to work more efficiently, freeing up time and resources to focus on the good they want to achieve. When our software works reliably, those people spend their time on their mission instead of on workarounds.

We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer to strengthen how we test our ERP products. You will own quality from business requirements to release: planning test cycles, designing and writing test cases, building and maintaining automated tests and frameworks, and tracking defects to resolution. You will work closely with development, product management, and operations.

Reporting to the Director of Platform Development, you will shape how QA works across our products and be measured on what you deliver: complete, relevant test coverage, clear test cases, and automated tests that run reliably and are easy to maintain.

If you enjoy complex enterprise systems and keep improving your work through metrics and new tools, we would love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

  • Analyse business requirements to understand the testing needs and keep testing aligned with business goals.
  • Design test cases and strategies that cover all functionality and scenarios.
  • Plan test cycles and schedule them around development phases and project timelines.
  • Write clear, concise test cases and scripts.
  • Run tests manually and with automation to find issues and bugs.
  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts and frameworks to make testing more efficient.
  • Report test results, give a clear view of software quality, and recommend improvements.
  • Track defects from identification to resolution and make sure they are fixed on time.
  • Maintain the QA testing environment and tools that keep testing efficient.

Requirements

  • 5 years or more of experience in QA automation.
  • Hands-on experience writing and maintaining automated test code and frameworks.
  • Experience testing ERP or other enterprise SaaS products in production.
  • Experience turning business requirements into test plans and test cases.
  • Experience managing defects from identification to resolution.

*Experience working in Agile teams.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field, and an ISTQB, CSTE, or similar testing certification.
  • Fluent, professional English, spoken and written

Nice to have

  • Experience with Microsoft Business Central is a huge advantage
  • Experience with writing AL-based tests for Microsoft Business Central is an even greater advantage
  • Daily use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Claude Code.

Benefits

We don’t call them perks; they’re just part of what makes working at Sparkrock great.
  • We are 100% remote and global. Live your best life, wherever that may be, and never lose out on career opportunities because of it.
  • Flexible work hours. We work asynchronously and don’t care when you’re online, just that you deliver great results.
  • Dedication to development. We focus on career paths for each and every one of our employees and help provide training to advance at every stage of their careers.
  • Introductions to thought leaders in the space and webinars on cutting-edge tech hot topics
  • Stipend to help set up your ideal home office
  • Focus on culture. Coffee chats, happy hours, cooking classes, book clubs, and more!
Sparkrock is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applications from traditionally underrepresented groups. This is a fully remote independent contractor engagement and is not eligible for company-sponsored employee benefit programs. We welcome applications from any country where we can lawfully engage you. If you need an accommodation during the application process, you can request it once you apply.
All open roles are for existing vacancies unless otherwise communicated. We notify all interviewed applicants of our hiring decision within 45 days of their interview and retain job postings and related recruitment information for at least three years.

job.description:
Your role

Salesforce QA Analyst

What you'll be doing

What We Need

Corpay is currently looking to hire a Salesforce QA Analyst within our Fuel division. This position falls under our Vehicle Payments line of business and is located in Poland. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality and functionality of software products of company. This involves the development of test cases, execution of manual, and the identification and documentation of defects. The Tester works closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure the delivery of high-quality software solutions. You will report directly into the QA Lead in this role.

How We Work

As a Salesforce QA Analyst, Corpay will set you up for success by providing:

  • Company issued equipment
  • Formal, hands-on training

Role Responsibilities

The responsibilities of the role will include:

  • Analyzing business and technical requirements to develop test plans and test cases.
  • Identifying testing objectives and ensure adequate test coverage.
  • Performing manual testing for functional, regression, and integration scenarios.
  • Analyzing results of automated tests.
  • Identifying, documenting, and reporting defects with detailed steps to reproduce.
  • Working closely with developers to verify fixes and resolve issues.
  • Contributing to the creation and maintenance of automated test scripts.
  • Using testing frameworks and tools to enhance efficiency.
  • Working with the development team to understand system functionality.
  • Participating in Agile ceremonies, such as daily stand-ups and sprint reviews.
  • Maintaining test documentation, including test cases, test plans, and results.

  • Strong experience with manual functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing, with the judgment to prioritize risk and release readiness.
  • Experience reviewing automated test results and contributing to automated test scripts using QA tools, frameworks, or CI/CD pipelines.
  • Proficient in defect lifecycle management and Agile delivery practices, with strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business team

job.title: Quality Engineer
job.description:
You’re more valuable than ever – And that’s just how we’ll make you feel.

Job Summary

The Quality Engineer plays a key role in the Company’s transition from traditional quality assurance

to a modern Quality Engineering model while retaining a strong foundation in hands-on manual

testing. The Quality Engineer will help build quality into the software development lifecycle by

partnering early with product, engineering, operations, clinical, and support stakeholders to

identify risk, clarify requirements, shape testability, execute thoughtful manual validation, expand

automation where appropriate, and improve release confidence before changes reach production.

Success in this role requires the ability to learn quickly, think critically, communicate clearly, speak

up when something does not make sense, connect details across systems and processes, become a

trusted expert on how the solution works, advocate for the end user, and validate whether software

truly supports the intended business outcome, not only whether it satisfies the written acceptance

criteria. The Quality Engineer must be technically capable, quality-driven, collaborative, and

committed to understanding the business, the workflows, and the purpose behind the applications

they support.

Qualifications

Education Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Healthcare

Informatics, or a related field.

  • Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.

Work Experience Required:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience performing manual, exploratory, regression, integration,

API, web-based, mobile, or enterprise application testing, or equivalent demonstrated

ability through software quality, engineering, automation, support, or technical product

work.

  • Demonstrated ability to create thoughtful test plans, execute detailed manual validation, ask

strong questions, connect business context to technical behavior, identify risk early, validate

end-to-end workflows, and explain defects clearly to technical and non-technical partners.

  • Experience with, or strong interest in growing into, quality engineering practices such as

test case management, test automation, API validation, CI/CD quality gates, accessibility and

ADA-informed testing, cross-browser validation, regression strategy, observability, and

production defect prevention.

  • Experience partnering throughout the full software development lifecycle to influence

quality up front, clarify requirements, assess testability, surface risks before development is

complete, and support informed go/no-go production readiness decisions.

  • Experience working within agile delivery teams using common planning, sprint, test

management, pipeline, and cross-browser testing tools to support story refinement, sprint

execution, test coverage, release readiness, and continuous delivery practices

Preferred Qualifications, Education, Licenses, Certifications, Experience, etc.:

  • Healthcare technology experience preferred, including familiarity with urgent care

workflows, patient registration, electronic medical records, HL7 integrations, Epic,

eClinicalWorks, payment workflows, or revenue cycle processes.

  • Familiarity with tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, QMetry, BrowserStack, or comparable

platforms is preferred, with emphasis on applying the right quality practices rather than

relying on a specific toolset.

  • Familiarity with accessibility standards, ADA considerations, inclusive design principles,

and practical validation of accessible user experiences across web and mobile applications

preferred.

  • Quality engineering, automation, accessibility, cloud, healthcare technology, or securityrelated certifications.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • This role involves interaction and collaboration with other departments and requires

excellent judgment and interpersonal skills.

  • Professional Judgment and Quality Advocacy: Uses sound judgment, curiosity, and

critical thinking to understand system behavior, assess business impact, identify risks early,

and promote high-quality outcomes across cross-functional teams.

  • Business Process Understanding: Quickly develops an understanding of complex business

processes, recognizes workflow impacts, and explains expected system behavior in

practical, real-world terms.

  • Professional Communication: Asks thoughtful questions, raises concerns constructively,

challenges assumptions respectfully, and builds productive partnerships to support qualityfocused decision-making.

  • Business and Systems Understanding: Develops working knowledge of GoHealth’s

business model, operational workflows, product behavior, integrations, and user needs to

validate the purpose and impact of application changes.

  • End-User Advocacy: Evaluates software against practical workflows and use cases for

patients, providers, center staff, operations, and support teams.

  • Quality Engineering Mindset: Improves testability and validates beyond the happy path

across edge cases, exceptions, integrations, and operational scenarios.

  • Technical and Automation Capability: Applies automation, API testing, test data analysis,

logs, repeatable checks, test management practices, pipeline quality gates, and crossbrowser validation to improve speed, coverage, and confidence.

  • Accessibility Awareness: Applies ADA-informed and accessibility testing practices to

support usable, inclusive digital experiences.

  • Team-Oriented Quality Ownership: Treats quality as a shared responsibility by

partnering to prevent defects, resolve issues, improve processes, and support successful

delivery.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Supports scalable quality practices across product engineering delivery teams by improving

validation methods, identifying risks early, strengthening supporting release readiness, and

building practical understanding of the products and workflows they support.

  • Design, document, execute, and maintain manual, exploratory, regression, integration, endto-end, and risk-based test cases for web, mobile, API, integration, and back-end services.
  • Develop and maintain repeatable testing approaches, including automation where

appropriate, to support sprint delivery, regression coverage, release readiness, and

production quality.

  • Partner with product owners, software engineers, operations, clinical stakeholders, and

support teams to clarify requirements, assess risk, improve testability, investigate defects,

validate fixes, and strengthen quality controls before release.

  • Validate key urgent care workflows, including patient registration, insurance capture,

payments, EMR integration, messaging, operational tools, and related digital products.

  • Evaluate product changes against real operational workflows, end-user needs, and business

outcomes, identifying gaps where functionality may satisfy written requirements but not

practical use.

  • Build solution expertise to explain how features, data, integrations, and workflows operate

and where defects, design gaps, or missed edge cases may create downstream impact.

  • Perform API, accessibility, ADA-informed, cross-browser, integration, regression, smoke,

exploratory, and end-to-end testing using appropriate tools and techniques.

  • Use agile planning, sprint management, test case management, pipeline, and cross-browser

testing platforms to organize work, maintain traceability, monitor coverage, and support

release decisions.

  • Contribute to quality gates, release validation, defect trend analysis, root cause analysis, test

coverage reporting, and other metrics that support continuous improvement.

  • Support production readiness by validating critical workflows, communicating risk clearly,

confirming defects are resolved as intended, and helping teams determine deployment

readiness.

  • Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive manual validation, improve test coverage,

strengthen documentation, and make quality practices easier for engineering teams to

adopt.

  • Manage the support ticket queue by analyzing issues that arise, providing clear support to

end users, and participating in on-call and off-hours coverage as needed to support releases,

production validation, and critical quality support needs.


Base Salary Range: $83,500/year to $114,858/year

The range above reflects the good-faith compensation range the Company reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of posting.

Actual compensation will depend on experience, skills, education, geographic location, and other business-related factors.It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role.

GoHealth Core Values

GoHealth’s Core Values, listed below, are essential functions of this position:

  • Collaboration: Takes ownership for collectively establishing productive partnerships and

relationships and seek to gain joint understanding of priorities and objectives so that the

greater good of the organization and those we serve is always at the forefront.

  • Innovation: Consistently uses good judgment, applying creativity to overcome obstacles

and increasing effectiveness and efficiency through process and other forms of innovation.

  • Diversity & Inclusion: Fosters diversity and inclusion, to be able to better understand

team members, our customers and partners. Engages the strengths and talents of each

GoHealth team member, creating an environment of involvement, respect and connection

where the richness of ideas, backgrounds and perspectives are harnessed.

  • Courage & Integrity: Models and practices the highest ethical and professional standards;

demonstrates pride and personal interest in our patients, partners and fellow team

members, deeply engaging in the business. Makes decisions, with a focus on doing the right

thing; treats team members, our customers, partners and vendors with dignity,

consideration, open-mindedness and respect.

  • Accountability: Always shows initiative, demonstrates a bias to action and gets things

done. Actively accepts responsibility for diverse roles, obligations and actions that

positively influence patient and customer outcomes, our partnerships and the healthcare

needs of our communities.

Additional Requirements

  • Office Environment: Tasks may be conducted within a climate-controlled office setting.
  • Physical Activity: The role may require the ability to lift, carry, push, or pull materials,

supplies, and equipment up to 25 lbs. Duties typically involve a combination of sitting,

standing, and walking, with frequent changes in position.

  • Travel: Travel may be required on an occasional basis for team meetings, market launches,

site visits, training, or other business needs, typically once or twice per year, up to 5%.

  • Safety Equipment: May require the use of safety equipment for infection prevention.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

The Company and its affiliates, joint venture partners and entities under common management are

Equal Opportunity Employers. They do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national

origin, age, sex, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected

status under federal, state, or local law.

ADA Accommodation Statement

Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities upon request.

This role defines success by achieving essential function outcomes, not by the method of

completion.

Compliance Statement

This job will be performed consistent with ADA, FMLA, FLSA, and other applicable federal, state,

and local laws regulating employment


Set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

All qualified persons are granted an equal opportunity for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation and gender identity or expression, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability, genetic information, medical condition, family care leave status, pregnancy or pregnancy-related condition, otherwise qualified disabled or veteran status. The company will comply with all fair employment laws in each of the jurisdictions where we conduct business.

job.title: Workday Test Manager
job.description:
Job Description:

The Groove is seeking an experienced Test Manager to support clients through Workday implementations. This individual will serve as a key member of the client-side project team, responsible for leading testing activities, coordinating business stakeholders, and ensuring business requirements are thoroughly validated prior to deployment.


The Test Manager will work closely with client leadership, business process owners, functional and technical teams, and implementation partners to develop and execute a comprehensive testing strategy. This role requires strong Workday implementation experience, excellent organizational and communication skills, and the ability to drive accountability across multiple workstreams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and manage the overall client-side testing strategy, plan, schedule, and deliverables for Workday implementations.
  • Coordinate client participation in system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), regression testing, and end-to-end business process testing.
  • Partner with business process owners and subject matter experts to develop, review, and validate test scenarios and scripts.
  • Ensure test scenarios accurately reflect business processes, requirements, integrations, and expected outcomes.
  • Coordinate testing resources, assignments, timelines, and execution across functional and technical workstreams.
  • Collaborate with implementation partners to align testing activities with overall project milestones and deliverables.
  • Manage defect tracking, prioritization, escalation, and resolution in partnership with project teams.
  • Facilitate testing status meetings, defect triage sessions, and readiness reviews.
  • Monitor testing progress, completion rates, defect trends, and overall testing readiness.
  • Communicate testing status, risks, issues, and dependencies to project leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Validate that critical business processes, integrations, security requirements, reporting, and data scenarios have been appropriately tested.
  • Coordinate UAT sign-off with business process owners and project leadership.
  • Support go-live readiness assessments, cutover activities, and post-production stabilization.
  • Identify opportunities to improve testing processes, documentation, and overall project execution.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in enterprise technology implementations, software testing, or quality assurance.
  • 3+ years of experience managing testing activities for large-scale ERP or HCM implementations.
  • Experience supporting Workday implementations, including testing coordination and execution.
  • Strong understanding of SIT, UAT, regression testing, end-to-end testing, and defect management.
  • Experience developing and managing test plans, test scenarios, scripts, defect logs, and testing status reports.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional business stakeholders, technical teams, and implementation partners.
  • Strong project management, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage stakeholders at all levels.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, identify risks, and drive accountability in a fast-paced consulting environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience serving as a client-side Test Manager for Workday implementations.
  • Experience with Workday HCM, Financial Management, Payroll, or related functional areas.
  • Understanding of Workday business processes, integrations, security, reporting, and data conversion.
  • Experience working directly with system integrators and third-party implementation partners.
  • Familiarity with testing and defect management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
  • Experience supporting large-scale business transformation initiatives or enterprise system deployments.

EEO Policy:

The Groove is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, ethnicity, sexual orientation, ancestry, genetics, gender identity or expression, disability, protected veteran or marital status.

Ready to embark on an exhilarating journey of innovation and collaboration? Apply nowand be part of our exciting team at The Groove!

job.description:
Company Description:Trust Payments is an MFSA-regulated in Malta; and an FCA-regulated company in the UK. We provide a range of payments and commerce solutions, with market-leading technology and data insights.

We offer innovative payment methods and cutting-edge technologies, with a truly global presence. Our global offices cater to the most demanding business sectors, including retail, travel, hospitality, forex, and financial services.

Driving value for our clients and demonstrating genuine carefor their success, is a core value of ours. We also believe in striving to build a better, more sustainabletomorrow and believe in conducting our business ethically, driving social and environmental change.

We have a passionate, collaborative, and diverse culture that recognizes that every employee contributes to our business success.


Find out more at.


Trust Payments has an exciting opportunity for a QA Engineer to join their team.

Location: Remote: Bangor, UK
Salary:Competitive + Benefits

**This role is predominantly remote, however occasional travel to our technology headquarters in Bangor, UK will be required

How will you make an impact in this role?
The Role:

In this role, you will develop and maintain automated tests for both services and UI using tools such as Selenium and Cucumber, following a BDD framework. You will apply a solid understanding of design principles to write clean, maintainable test code in Java or Python, whilst contributing to a CI/CD pipeline environment. Working closely with the test manager and project teams, you will develop and maintain automated functional and regression tests in line with defined scripting standards. You will apply a thorough understanding of testing concepts, methodologies, and processes across the full software product development lifecycle, whilst raising and managing defects clearly and efficiently using tools such as Jirato ensure quality is maintained throughout delivery.

What We Expect of You, Day To Day:
  • Maintaining and improving the automated test framework
  • Creating new automated tests and investigating test failures
  • Writing automated tests following the BDD framework and contributing input to developers for unit-level tests
  • Investigating defects reported by stakeholders and end users, supporting the team to identify root causes and appropriate fixes
  • Performing manual and exploratory testing against new features
  • Attending team retrospectives and workshops to support continual improvement
  • Defining and adding new test cases into different automated test packs, capturing test results and defects
  • Understanding requirements and testing processes to define test plans with continuous review of scope
  • Providing test estimations and a clear testing approach to the Product Owner and team

Qualifications
  • A positive, enthusiastic approach with a genuine interest in quality engineering
  • Comfortable working both autonomously and as part of a team, with a willingness to share knowledge and support colleagues' growth
  • 5 or more years of overall testing experience

job.title: QA Automation Engineer (AI-First)
job.description:
QA Automation Engineer (AI-First)

Location: Bengaluru, India (remote), with daily overlap with our UK team

Engagement Type: Full-time contract, 3 months then ongoing

Experience: 2–4 years

Reports to: Technical Project Manager

Compensation: India-based, aligned to experience and location

About MarcoPolo Learning

MarcoPolo Learning is a leading provider of innovative content, technology, and instructional support for early childhood education. Since 2013, we’ve impacted thousands of classrooms and hundreds of thousands of families across North America. Our Emmy-nominated MarcoPolo World School app and The Polos TV series bring STEM and global discovery to life for young learners.

Backed by top-tier investors, we’re on a mission to transform early learning at scale. At the center of that mission is Audrey, our AI Teaching Companion & Coach for early-learning educators.

Role Overview

We ship fast. AI helps our engineers write code quicker than ever, and we’re about to launch two major web platforms used by thousands of educators. Speed only counts if what reaches teachers works beautifully, every time.

We’re looking for a QA Automation Engineer who wants to own that quality. You’ll learn our products inside out, help us move from manual checks to smart, AI-assisted automated testing, and become the person the team trusts to say “this is ready.”

You’ll work directly with our technical project manager and engineers, get hands-on with the latest AI testing and agent tools, and have room to grow into a broader engineering role as you prove yourself.

Key Responsibilities

Quality and testing

  • Test new features end to end across our web platforms and mobile apps, thinking like a teacher, a director and an admin, and catch issues before they reach customers.
  • Write clear test cases and acceptance criteria, using AI to generate and expand them quickly.
  • Build and maintain automated regression suites (e.g. Playwright, Cypress or similar) so every release is checked consistently without repetitive manual work.
  • Evaluate and pilot new AI-forward QA testing platforms (self-healing, agent-driven and visual AI testing tools), measure what actually saves time, and help us adopt the ones that work.
  • Verify that reports, dashboards and data exports reflect real user activity accurately.
  • Test user journeys that span systems, such as course completion, certificates and automated customer emails.
  • Log bugs clearly in Jira, reproduce them reliably, and work with engineers until they’re fixed and verified.

Release and production support

  • Run pre-release and post-release checks, and help verify hotfixes quickly when something needs attention.
  • Be the first technical line for product questions from our customer-facing team: investigate, resolve what you can, and route the rest with the right detail.
  • Turn recurring questions into simple guides and self-serve answers, so the team can find solutions without waiting.

AI and automation

  • Work alongside our automation specialist to test and refine the AI agents and workflows we’re rolling out across the company.
  • Document how our products work, building shared knowledge that helps the whole team and our AI tools.

What We’re Looking For

  • A degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related engineering field (B.E./B.Tech, BCA/MCA or equivalent), or equivalent hands-on experience.
  • 2–4 years of experience in QA, test automation or software development on web applications.
  • Hands-on experience testing mobile apps on iOS, Android and Amazon (Fire OS) devices, including app store builds and testing across devices and screen sizes.
  • Experience building automated tests with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium or similar.
  • Working knowledge of at least one programming language (JavaScript/TypeScript or Python preferred) and comfort reading code.
  • An AI-native way of working: you use tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor or Copilot daily, and you’re curious about AI agents and AI testing tools.
  • Openness to new AI-forward QA testing platforms (e.g. Mabl, Testim, testRigor, Applitools, or AI agents working with Playwright), and the curiosity to try them, compare them and bring the best into our workflow.
  • A sharp eye for detail: you notice when a number, a layout or a flow isn’t quite right, and you can explain exactly why.
  • Clear, structured bug reporting and documentation.
  • Comfort with web fundamentals: browser dev tools, APIs and testing across devices and screen sizes.
  • Ownership and follow-through: you see an issue through to resolution and speak up early when something is off.
  • Clear written and spoken English; comfortable working with technical and non-technical colleagues in the UK time zone.

Bonus points

  • Jira or Asana experience in an agile sprint setup.
  • Exposure to a headless CMS (e.g. Strapi), SQL, or tools like Postman.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions) or AWS.
  • Experience with no-code automation tools (Zapier, n8n, Make) or email platforms like Customer.io.
  • An ISTQB Foundation certification or similar.
  • Interest in education, ed-tech or early childhood learning.

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

  • First 30 days: learn our products and users, take on release checks, and log your first well-documented bugs.
  • By 60 days: own testing for a product area and ship your first automated regression tests.
  • By 90 days: run release QA independently, with automated coverage on our key user journeys and a recommendation on which AI testing tools we should adopt.

What to Be Ready to Demonstrate

Be ready to walk us through test automation you’ve built: what you chose to automate, how you structured it, and what you’d do differently. The process includes a short, paid practical exercise (AI tools encouraged). Sanitized examples are welcome; please don’t share confidential employer or customer information.

What We Offer

  • Experience with a growing international education company, working closely with our UK-based team.
  • Real ownership: what you test and automate goes straight to thousands of educators.
  • Daily exposure to AI agents, AI testing tools and modern engineering practices.
  • Mentorship and a clear path to grow into a broader engineering role.
  • Compensation benchmarked to the Bengaluru/India market, based on your experience and location.
  • Remote working, plus 15 days paid annual leave and Indian public holidays.
  • A collaborative, mission-driven team at the intersection of education, media and technology.

Why Join Us

If you’re curious about AI and want your work to matter, this is the role. You’ll help shape how a growing global education company builds and tests its products in the AI era, and grow your skills faster than you would almost anywhere else.

Note: This is an India-based engagement. Applicants must have the right to work in India; visa sponsorship is not available at this time.

MarcoPolo Learning is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

job.title: Quality Assurance Specialist - Clearance Required
job.description:
Overview

LMI is seeking a Quality Assurance Specialist to support Army Acquisition, Training, and Readiness (AT&R) and provide advanced technical support for the Army Contract Writing System (ACWS). ACWS is built on the Appian Platform. The Quality Assurance Specialist will plan, design, execute, and document software testing activities across the ACWS software development lifecycle.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work closely with end users, functional SMEs, developers, Appian specialists, database administrators, DevSecOps engineers, cybersecurity personnel, and other technical teams to maintain ACWS availability, reliability, and user support quality.

  • Develop formal test plans, test procedures, test reports, and other QA deliverables required by project and contract requirements.
  • Review business, functional, and technical requirements to ensure adequate test coverage and clear acceptance criteria.
  • Develop and execute test cases for functional, regression, integration, system, and user acceptance testing.
  • Validate ACWS sprint user stories against acceptance criteria and support Agile testing throughout iterative delivery cycles.
  • Log, document, and track defects with clear reproduction steps, expected-versus-actual results, screenshots, logs, and other supporting evidence.
  • Maintain traceability among requirements, test cases, defects, and test results and ensure QA documentation is complete and audit-ready.
  • Participate in defect triage activities and assist development teams with root cause analysis and defect resolution.
  • Communicate testing progress, risks, quality metrics, defect trends, and recommendations to project leadership, stakeholders, and government customers.
  • Support the development and continuous improvement of test strategies, procedures, tools, and QA processes.
  • Collaborate with Appian developers, Java developers, database administrators, DevSecOps engineers, functional SMEs, and stakeholders on requirements clarification and defect resolution.
  • Support release testing, regression testing, implementation activities, and release readiness or sign-off processes.
  • Participate in Scrum and other Agile ceremonies and provide QA input to sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and delivery planning.
  • Support manual testing and the transition toward automated testing where practical and appropriate.

Qualifications

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • 5+ years of professional software QA or testing experience.
  • Experience with Jira test management or an equivalent test management tool.
  • Experience working in Agile environments; Scrum or SAFe experience preferred.
  • Experience developing formal test plans, test procedures, test reports, status reports, and other project documentation.
  • Experience preparing professional contract deliverables and supporting documentation.
  • Experience developing requirements traceability matrices (RTMs) and ensuring end-to-end test coverage of business and functional requirements.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and government customers.
  • Experience presenting testing results, risks, and recommendations to management, customers, and project stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Active Secret clearance required.
  • U.S. citizenship required.

DESIRED SKILLS

  • Experience testing applications built on the Appian Platform, including Appian-based enterprise or contract writing applications.
  • Experience testing government procurement and acquisition systems, including data exchanges, interfaces, and business processes involving contract writing, financial, or related federal enterprise applications.
  • Familiarity with federal acquisition regulations and processes, including FAR and DFARS.
  • DAWIA T&E Level 2 or higher, ISTQB Advanced, or equivalent testing certification.
  • Familiarity with automated testing tools and frameworks and experience supporting the transition from manual to automated testing.
  • Experience supporting Army, DoD, Federal Government, or other regulated software programs.
  • Experience with Appian application testing, functional configuration, or Appian release validation.
  • Experience with defect tracking and collaboration tools such as Jira, GitLab, or comparable platforms.

The target salary range for this position goes up to $130,000.

The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

job.title: QA Analyst, Credit Risk- Analyste AQ, risque de crédit
job.description:
*La version anglaise suivra // The english version will follow

Le côté brillant de l'hypothèque

nesto est le chef de file du financement hypothécaire résidentiel numérique au Canada. Nous offrons aux Canadiens les taux les plus bas dès le départ, en toute transparence et sans négociation.

À propos de nous

Pionnier du financement hypothécaire en ligne au Canada, nesto transforme la façon dont les Canadiens financent leur propriété. Notre mission est d'offrir une expérience de financement immobilier positive, valorisante et transparente, simplifiée du début à la fin.

Les emprunteurs profitent de taux souvent plus avantageux que ceux offerts par les grandes banques, ainsi que d'une expérience hypothécaire exceptionnelle, simple et fluide, du début à la fin. Le tout est propulsé par une technologie d'intelligence artificielle de pointe.

Rapide, simple et entièrement numérique, nesto a été nommé Prêteur hypothécaire de l'année par la CLA pendant trois années consécutives. Voilà le côté brillant de l'hypothèque.

Groupe Nesto

Le Groupe Nesto est le principal fournisseur de technologies hypothécaires et de solutions de financement au Canada, avec plus de 80 milliards de dollars canadiens en prêts hypothécaires résidentiels et commerciaux sous administration. Fort de la confiance de plusieurs des principales institutions financières du pays, le Groupe Nesto combine plus de 50 ans d'expertise hypothécaire à ses technologies infonuagiques et d'intelligence artificielle exclusives pour transformer l'avenir du financement.

Grâce à ses technologies infonuagiques et d'intelligence artificielle exclusives, nesto est devenu l'un des prêteurs hypothécaires à la croissance la plus rapide au Canada, gagnant des parts de marché dans le financement résidentiel direct aux consommateurs (D2C), le réseau des courtiers hypothécaires et le financement commercial multirésidentiel. Reconnue au palmarès Fast 50 de Deloitte pendant trois années consécutives, l'entreprise continue de faire progresser le secteur grâce à l'innovation, à la technologie et à des solutions axées sur les clients.

Grâce à sa famille de marques — CMLS, nesto et Nesto Cloud —, le Groupe Nesto a pour mission de bâtir l'écosystème hypothécaire canadien de demain et de devenir un véritable chef de file canadien en technologies de financement et en services financiers.

Pour en savoir plus :

La vie chez nesto

Chez nesto, nous avons à cœur de remettre en question le statu quo, d'offrir une meilleure expérience hypothécaire et d'aider les Canadiens à économiser sur leur hypothèque. Nous cultivons une culture de collaboration, de transparence et de créativité, où chaque membre de l'équipe est encouragé à prendre ses projets en main, à avoir un impact concret et à évoluer.

Si vous souhaitez relever des défis stimulants et trouver des solutions à des enjeux importants aux côtés de collègues ambitieux, passionnés et toujours prêts à s'entraider, vous vous sentirez chez vous chez nesto.

Votre rôle

  • Effectuer quotidiennement l'examen d'un échantillon de demandes hypothécaires (avant et après déboursement) pour assurer la conformité aux normes de souscription, aux politiques du Groupe nesto et aux exigences réglementaires.
  • Évaluer l'ensemble des éléments de données, documents financiers, renseignements clients, transmissions des courtiers et assureurs, et documents juridiques afin de noter tout écart par rapport aux politiques.
  • Repérer les tendances de comportement inhabituel, les transactions suspectes et la légitimité des documents via les « dossiers à surveiller » des assureurs et les références internes.
  • Effectuer des enquêtes préliminaires et prendre les mesures nécessaires sur les dossiers suspects afin de réduire le risque de perte et de fausse représentation.
  • Préparer des rapports d'assurance qualité détaillant les constatations et recommandations, et mener des analyses approfondies à la demande de la gestion des risques ou de l'AQ.
  • Soutenir les audits avec les partenaires, investisseurs et assureurs, de la préparation initiale jusqu'à la résolution des items problématiques.
  • Aider à la gestion, au contrôle périodique et à l'examen des listes approuvées (évaluateurs, notaires/avocats, courtiers, fournisseurs) et des listes de lutte contre le blanchiment d'argent (LBA).
  • Exécuter les examens d'assurance et de contrôle de la qualité de façon régulière, rapide, efficace et objective.
  • Fournir des conseils, opinions et recommandations au personnel de souscription et aux parties prenantes concernant les risques de crédit, la mitigation des pertes, les risques d'inondation/propriété et les opportunités de formation.

Qui nous recherchons

  • Expérience : Minimum de 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en approbation/adjudication de prêts hypothécaires. Expérience dans le canal des courtiers hypothécaires, un atout.
  • Outils & Maîtrise technique : Maîtrise des applications Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, SharePoint), Google Workspace (GDrive, Sheets, Docs), des CRM et outils de flux de travail (Salesforce).
  • Connaissances du domaine : Solide compréhension des directives des assureurs, internes et externes, ainsi qu'une bonne connaissance des implications, méthodes de détection et de prévention de la fraude.
  • Compétences clés : Pensée analytique et compétences bien développées en négociation et résolution de problèmes pour repérer les tendances et anomalies dans les pratiques de souscription.
  • Autonomie & Prise de décision : Capacité à travailler de façon autonome avec une supervision limitée, à gérer et prioriser les demandes urgentes, et à formuler des recommandations impopulaires lorsque requis.
  • Langue & Communication : Bilinguisme fluide (français et anglais) requis pour soutenir les clients à l'échelle nationale, avec une excellente capacité à communiquer les constatations à la direction et aux souscripteurs.

Pourquoi vous aimeriez travailler ici

Nous croyons que les personnes de talent donnent le meilleur d'elles-mêmes lorsqu'elles sont soutenues sur les plans professionnel, personnel et financier. C'est pourquoi nous offrons un programme de rémunération globale complet, conçu pour vous aider à vous épanouir à chaque étape de votre carrière.

  • Rémunération concurrentielle — Salaire compétitif, primes de rendement (le cas échéant) et reconnaissance de vos contributions.
  • Santé et bien-être — Couverture complète pour les soins médicaux, dentaires et de la vue, comptes de gestion des dépenses santé et bien-être (le cas échéant), télémédecine, programme d'aide aux employés (PAE) et soutien en santé mentale pour vous et votre famille.
  • Du temps pour refaire le plein — Vacances généreuses (4 semaines), congés mobiles et jours fériés pour vous permettre de vous ressourcer.
  • Planification de l'avenir — Cotisation de contrepartie au REER pour soutenir votre bien-être financier à long terme.
  • Soutien aux familles — Prestations complémentaires bonifiées pour les congés de maternité et parentaux.
  • Apprentissage et perfectionnement — Aide financière aux études, mentorat, formations et occasions de faire progresser votre carrière au sein du Groupe Nesto.
  • Des outils pour réussir — Technologies modernes, équipes collaboratives et toutes les ressources nécessaires pour vous dépasser.

Diversité, équité et inclusion

Au sein du Groupe Nesto, nous croyons que la diversité des points de vue fait notre force. Nous nous engageons à favoriser un milieu de travail inclusif où chacun se sent respecté, soutenu et habilité à réussir.

Nous accueillons les candidatures de personnes de tous horizons, y compris les membres des Premiers Peuples (Premières Nations, Inuit et Métis), les personnes en situation de handicap, les membres des communautés racisées, les femmes et les personnes de la communauté 2ELGBTQIA+.

Si vous avez besoin de mesures d'adaptation à n'importe quelle étape du processus de recrutement, nous nous engageons à collaborer avec vous pour répondre à vos besoins.

The bright side of mortgages

nestois Canada’s leading digital residential mortgage lender, offering Canadians the lowest rates from the get-go — with total transparency and no haggling.

About Us

As Canada's pioneer in online mortgage lending, nesto is transforming the way Canadians finance their homes. Our mission is to offer a positive, empowering, and transparent property financing experience, simplified from start to finish.

Borrowers benefit from rates that are often lower than those offered by the big banks, along with an exceptional end-to-end mortgage experience powered by best-in-class AI technology. Fast, simple, and fully digital, nesto has been recognized as CLA Lender of the Year for three consecutive years. That's the bright side of mortgages.

Nesto Group

Nesto Group is Canada's leading provider of mortgage technology and financing solutions, with more than CAD $80 billion in residential and commercial mortgages under administration. Trusted by many of the country's leading financial institutions, we combine over 50 years of mortgage expertise with proprietary cloud and AI technology to transform the future of lending.

Powered by our proprietary cloud and AI technology, nesto has become one of Canada's fastest-growing mortgage lenders, gaining market share across direct-to-consumer (D2C) residential lending, the broker channel, and multi-family commercial lending. Recognized as one of Deloitte's Fast 50 companies for three consecutive years, we continue to push the industry forward through innovation, technology, and customer-focused solutions.

Operating through our family of brands—CMLS,nesto, andNesto Cloud—our mission is to build Canada's mortgage ecosystem of the future and create a true Canadian champion in lending technology and financial services.

Learn more at:

Life at nesto

At nesto, we're passionate about challenging the status quo and building a better mortgage experience and saving money on their mortgages for Canadians. We foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and creativity where every team member is empowered to take ownership, make an impact, and grow. If you're looking to solve meaningful problems alongside ambitious, supportive teammates, you'll feel right at home here.

About the Role

  • Review an adequate daily sampling of mortgage applications post-funding and pre-funding to ensure compliance with nesto Group policies, underwriting standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Assess file data elements, financial documents, client information, broker file transmissions, insurer transmissions, and miscellaneous legal documentation to identify policy deviations.
  • Identify patterns of unusual behavior, suspicious transactions, and documentation validity via "Heads up Files" from external insurers and internal referrals.
  • Conduct preliminary investigations and necessary actions on suspect files to mitigate misrepresentation risk and loss.
  • Prepare QA reports with findings and recommendations on suspicious or irregular activity files, as well as execute further analysis as directed by Risk or QA Management.
  • Support audits with partners, investors, and insurers, spanning from preparation to audit finding resolution.
  • Assist in the management, periodic control, and review of approved lists for Appraisers, Solicitors, Brokers, Vendors, and AML lists.
  • Execute QA/QC reviews regularly on a timely, efficient, and objective basis.
  • Provide guidance, opinions, and recommendations to underwriting staff and stakeholders on credit issues, loss mitigation, flood/property risk, and training opportunities.

Who we are looking for

  • Experience: Minimum 3–5 years of Mortgage/Lending Adjudication experience. Experience in the mortgage broker channel is preferred.
  • Technical Proficiency: Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, SharePoint), Google Workspace (GDrive, Sheets, Docs), CRMs, and workflow tools (Salesforce).
  • Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of insurer, internal, and external guidelines, alongside working knowledge of fraud implications, detection methodologies, and risk mitigation.
  • Core Competencies: Analytical thinker with well-developed negotiation and problem-solving skills to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies in mortgage underwriting.
  • Autonomy & Decision-Making: Ability to operate independently with limited supervision, prioritize urgent applications, and make unpopular recommendations when required.
  • Language & Communication: Bilingual fluency (English and French) is required to support nationwide clients, with an ability to effectively communicate findings to management and underwriting teams.

Why You'll Love Working Here

We believe great people do their best work when they're supported professionally, personally, and financially. That's why we offer a comprehensive rewards package designed to help you thrive at every stage of your career.

Competitive Rewards — Competitive compensation, performance incentives (where applicable), and recognition for your contributions.

Health & Wellness — Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, Health & Wellness Spending Accounts (where applicable), telemedicine, Employee Assistance Programs, and mental health support for you and your family.

Time to Recharge — Generous vacation (4 weeks), floater days, and statutory holidays to help you recharge.

Planning for the Future — RRSP matching to support your long-term financial wellbeing.

Family Support — Enhanced maternity and parental leave top-up programs.

Learning & Growth — Education assistance, mentorship, training, and opportunities to build your career across Nesto Group.

Tools for Success — Modern technology, collaborative teams, and the resources you need to do your best work.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At Nesto Group, we believe diverse perspectives make us stronger. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to succeed.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, including Indigenous Peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis), persons with disabilities, members of racialized communities, women, and members of the 2SLGBTQIA+ community.

If you require accommodation during any stage of the recruitment process, we are committed to working with you to meet your needs.

job.title: Software Quality Engineer
job.description:
Who we are:

Quavo is the industry leader in fraud and disputes management technology, offering the world’s only E2E cloud-based Disputes as a Service solution for issuing financial services organizations. Quavo is an organization of tenacious experts who are innovative and challenge complacency to continuously deliver cutting edge technology and AI. Our experts are passionate about delivering value in our solutions and empowering our client community to enhance and evolve industry standards in fraud and disputes management.

Who you are:

Quavo is looking for authentic and courageous professionals to join our team. If you are a driven, accountable, and innovative problem solver searching for a collaborative environment of like-minded teammates dedicated to improving the client experience…. Then you are going to love working at Quavo!

About the role:

As a Software QA Engineer at Quavo, you’ll ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of our products across the full development lifecycle. You’ll go beyond Acceptance Criteria, thinking like an end user to uncover issues in functionality, security, and UX, and catching problems early by reviewing requirements in refinement.

You’ll work AI-first with Quavo’s Claude Code QA skills for test planning, execution, and bug filing, while remaining accountable for every output you approve. You’ll test Pega/QFD workflows, validate data with read-only Snowflake SQL, and publish traceable evidence to Jira and BrowserStack. You’ll also verify regulatory coverage (Reg E, Reg Z, NACHA, PCI, UDAAP) and maintain audit-ready evidence for SOC2 and PCI-DSS.

Partnering with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, Onboarding, Services, and Client Experience, you’ll be an active voice in Agile ceremonies, investigate customer issues, and contribute to Confluence. Over time, you’ll become a subject-matter expert on Quavo’s products, supporting release readiness and guiding clients with confidence.

This role is not sponsorship eligible. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer visa sponsorship, now or in the future.

Responsibilities include:

AI-Assisted Testing

  • Operate the QA skills framework. Use Quavo's Claude Code QA skills for board sync, test planning, execution, sign-off, kickbacks, and bug filing.
  • Own every AI-generated output.Review, correct, and approve all drafts before they post to Jira or BrowserStack. You are accountable for the result, not the tool.
  • Contribute product context, compliance dimensions, and reusable test procedures into skills to improve future performance.

Test Planning and Execution

  • Develop and execute test plans to Quavo's ten-point standard covering acceptance criteria mapping, traceability, compliance applicability, and known-gap disclosure that go beyond defined Acceptance Criteria.
  • Test Pega/QFD case lifecycles, flows, decision rules, and data transforms; inspect and compare branches and trace each branch to its Jira ticket.
  • Validate data with read-only SQL against QFD in Snowflake, following PII masking and tenant isolation rules.
  • Ensure product quality in all areas: functionality, reliability, performance, security, and UX. Think like an end user.
  • Publish test cases, runs, and evidence to BrowserStack Test Management to maintain full traceability.

Compliance and Release Readiness

  • Tag and verify regulatory coverage across Reg E, Reg Z, NACHA, PCI, and UDAAP.
  • Maintain test evidence that supports SOC2 and PCI-DSS audits; use synthetic or masked data and never commit secrets or PII.

Collaboration and Shift-Left

  • Participate in sprint ceremonies: standups, refinement, pointing, and retrospectives.
  • Find defects early by reviewing requirements in refinement and applying Quavo's Definition of Ready.
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, Onboarding, Services, Infrastructure, and Client Experience to drive quality.
  • Investigate customer complaints and product issues.
  • Contribute regularly to Confluence and become a Subject Matter Expert on Quavo's products.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent industry experience with a proven track record.
  • ISTQB or other quality/testing certification.
  • 2+ years testing a low-code BPM platform.
  • Hands-on experience using generative AI tools in daily work, with the judgment to spot and challenge incorrect or unsupported results.
  • Basic SQL, Git, and command-line proficiency.
  • Understanding of the disputes and fraud domain (Reg E and Reg Z disputes, chargebacks, card network rules), or a demonstrated ability to learn it quickly.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication. Not afraid to ask questions; communicates with tact.
  • Works well on a team in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment and asks for help early.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Working knowledge of Pega (case types, flows, Tracer, Clipboard)
  • Pega CSA or CSSA certification.
  • Test automation experience, especially Playwright with TypeScript.
  • API testing experience (e.g., Postman).
  • Familiarity with AWS services such as CloudWatch, Lambda, and SQS.
  • Experience in FinTech or another regulated industry.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, BrowserStack, and SharePoint.

Essa pessoa atuará junto à coordenação e às squads, definindo padrões, fortalecendo a automação e contribuindo para que a qualidade seja considerada desde as etapas iniciais de desenvolvimento.

A posição combina direcionamento técnico e atuação prática na criação de frameworks, ferramentas e melhorias no código e nas esteiras de desenvolvimento. A atuação é híbrida e consultiva, em parceria com diferentes especialidades.
