job.title: QA Team Lead
job.description:
QA Team Lead

Position Overview

Centrilogic is seeking to strengthen its quality assurance (QA) practice, which places testing professionals on client projects. To do that, we are looking for a QA Team Lead to run the QA workstream on those engagements. You will set the test approach, lead a team of QA Practitioners, and answer for the results of functional, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT).

Our projects center on custom applications built on Azure and .NET, hosted in the cloud, on premises, or both. You will work alongside CentriLogic developers, business analysts, and project managers. Unit testing belongs to the development team and is outside the scope of this role.

We want thinkers as well as doers. You will question assumptions, look for better ways to test, and bring innovation to the work, including practical use of AI. You will also write automation and review AI-produced test assets yourself, while managing stakeholders, plans, and the performance of your team.

Key Responsibilities

Test strategy and delivery

  • Define the test strategy, scope, entry and exit criteria, and release readiness measures for each engagement, based on business requirements and risk.
  • Plan testing across environments hosted in Azure or on premises, including environment readiness, configuration, and test data.
  • Estimate and plan QA effort, assign work to Practitioners, and track progress against the project plan.
  • Oversee the design of functional and regression test suites, and decide which scenarios to automate and which to keep manual.
  • Plan and coordinate UAT with business users: prepare scripts and test data, run sessions, collect feedback, track defects to closure, and report readiness for acceptance.
  • Lead defect triage with developers, business analysts, and project managers.
  • Maintain traceability from requirements and user stories to test cases and defects.
  • Report status, risks, and quality metrics to stakeholders and to the engagement lead.

Test automation

  • Build and maintain an automation framework for web UI, API, and integration regression testing, using a modern framework such as Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress, in a language that suits the project such as C#. Set coding standards and reusable components.
  • Design API and integration tests for .NET services and the systems they connect to.
  • Integrate automated regression into continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, using tools such as Azure Pipelines, GitHub Actions, or similar. Where it helps, run suites in parallel on a cloud browser service.
  • Track flaky tests, find the cause, and keep the regression suite fast and trustworthy.

AI enabled QA

  • Set how the team uses AI in testing, and require human review of everything AI produces before it enters a test suite or a report.
  • Use AI assistants and agents, such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and the Playwright Test Agents, or other similar tools, to draft test plans, test cases, test data, and automation code from requirements and user stories.
  • Use AI to find gaps and ambiguity in requirements, summarize failed runs and defect patterns, and rank regression tests by the risk of each change.
  • Test AI features in the applications we build, and plan for answers that vary from run to run.
  • Check tests written by AI for accuracy, maintainability, and security. Keep confidential data, credentials, and personal information out of prompts and test files, and use only approved tools.

Innovation and leadership

  • Challenge the usual way of testing. Pilot new tools and AI techniques, measure whether they help, and share what works across the practice.
  • Coach and review the work of QA Practitioners, set goals, and give regular feedback.
  • Report on defect leakage, regression automation coverage, test stability, UAT completion, and release readiness.
  • Contribute to the CentriLogic QA practice with reusable templates, accelerators, estimating guidance, and QA input to proposals and statements of work.

Example Tools

The tools below are examples, not requirements. We welcome candidates with equivalent experience in other tools, and we choose tools engagement by engagement.

Area

Examples, or other similar tools

Test management and UAT

Azure DevOps Boards and Test Plans (cloud or Server), Jira with a test management add on, or other similar tools. Browser extensions for exploratory testing, such as Test & Feedback.

UI, API, and integration automation

Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or other similar frameworks, in C#, TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, or Python. Postman, REST Assured, or other similar tools for API testing.

Pipelines and execution

Azure Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or other similar tools, with cloud browser services such as Playwright Workspaces in Azure App Testing where parallel runs help.

AI support

GitHub Copilot, Microsoft 365 Copilot, AI test agents such as the Playwright Test Agents, Model Context Protocol servers that connect assistants to a browser, or other similar tools.

Accessibility

Accessibility Insights for Web or other similar tools, checking against the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 level AA.

Reporting

Azure DevOps dashboards, Power BI, Excel, or other similar tools.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in software QA, including at least 2 years leading a QA team or workstream.
  • Proven delivery of functional, regression, and UAT testing on custom enterprise applications, including web, API, and integration layers.
  • Experience testing applications built on Azure and .NET, hosted in the cloud, on premises, or both.
  • Hands on experience building test automation with a framework such as Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress, or a similar tool, in a language such as C#, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python.
  • Experience managing test cases, defects, and requirement traceability in a tool such as Azure DevOps Test Plans or Jira.
  • Experience running automated tests in CI/CD pipelines.
  • Has used generative AI in testing work, such as test design, test data, automation code, or defect analysis, and has sound judgment in reviewing its output.
  • A record of thinking differently: you have introduced a new tool, technique, or AI approach that improved how testing was done.
  • Clear written and spoken communication with executives, business users, and technical teams, including setting expectations and raising risks early.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with C# and the .NET ecosystem.
  • Experience testing applications that include AI features, such as chatbots or AI agents.
  • Accessibility testing experience.
  • International Software Testing Qualifications Board (ISTQB) certification, or a Microsoft certification relevant to Azure or DevOps.
  • Exposure to Microsoft Power Platform is an asset.
  • Experience at a consulting or professional services firm, and experience delivering work remotely across time zones.

What We're Looking For

We want a lead who thinks. You see a testing problem and ask whether there is a better way to solve it. You try new ideas, including AI, and you can show what worked and what did not. You can join a project, put a workable test approach in place quickly, and report results people trust. You will also help Practitioners build the same habits of curiosity and careful checking.

job.description:
About Tilda Research, Inc.

About Tilda

Tilda Research is reimagining how clinical trials are run by bringing AI-native tools and AI teammates into clinical research operations. Our technology works alongside sponsor, CRO, and research teams to simplify study management, improve data quality, support real-time oversight, and help accelerate trial timelines.

We are building the future of clinical trial execution: one where research teams can spend less time on administrative bottlenecks and more time focused on patients, sites, and the work that moves new treatments forward. Tilda’s mission is rooted in the belief that clinical research should be faster, more efficient, more scalable, and more accessible — without losing the human judgment and care that patients and research teams deserve.

At Tilda, we are a team of builders, operators, researchers, and problem-solvers working at the intersection of healthcare, technology, and AI. We move quickly, think deeply, and care about building products and systems that create meaningful impact in the clinical research industry.

About the Role

Tilda Research is looking for an experienced Automation Engineer / SDET with 4–10 years of experience to help improve the quality, reliability, and speed of our software delivery.

We’re looking for someone who is highly technical, hands-on, and experienced in building automation frameworks—not simply using existing ones. This person will also actively use AI-assisted engineering and testing tools to improve automation, test coverage, troubleshooting, and overall QA efficiency.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable automation frameworks for web applications, APIs, and backend services.
  • Develop automated functional, integration, regression, API, and end-to-end testing using tools such as WebdriverIO, Playwright, and Pytest.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines, improving test coverage, release quality, and deployment confidence.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate test creation, identify edge cases, analyze failures, debug automation, and reduce repetitive QA work.
  • Partner closely with Engineering and Product to identify quality risks, troubleshoot complex issues, and ensure quality throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Continuously improve test reliability, execution speed, automation coverage, and engineering productivity.

What We're Looking For

  • 4–10 years of experience as an Automation Engineer, SDET, QA Automation Engineer, or similar role.
  • Strong programming skills in JavaScript/TypeScript and/or Python.
  • Hands-on experience with WebdriverIO, Playwright, Pytest, or similar modern automation frameworks.
  • Proven experience designing and building automation frameworks from the ground up.
  • Strong experience with API testing and automation.
  • Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar tools.
  • Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development/testing tools to improve automation, testing, debugging, or engineering productivity.
  • Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, debugging, and root-cause analysis.

AI & Automation

We expect our engineers to actively use AI as part of their day-to-day work. Experience with tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar AI development tools is highly valued.

You should be comfortable using AI to:

  • Create and improve automated tests.
  • Generate test scenarios and identify edge cases.
  • Analyze logs and troubleshoot failures.
  • Debug and maintain automation.
  • Generate test data.
  • Identify gaps in test coverage.
  • Automate repetitive QA workflows.

We are looking for someone who goes beyond simply using AI as a chatbot and can demonstrate how they use it to engineer, test, and ship better software faster.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience testing modern SaaS applications.
  • Experience with AWS or other cloud environments.
  • Exposure to Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with performance, security, or reliability testing.
  • Experience testing AI-powered applications, LLM features, or agentic workflows.
  • Experience with healthcare, clinical research, life sciences, or another regulated industry.
  • Experience in a startup or high-growth technology environment.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive at Tilda if you enjoy building automation rather than performing repetitive manual testing, can write production-quality code, actively use AI to improve your work, and enjoy solving complex technical problems in a fast-moving environment.

Along with other testing professionals, you will be testing features in the ClickHouse server, client interfaces, and related services around ClickHouse. We verify SQL, REST, native client APIs, authentication, authorization, RBAC, OAuth integrations, FIPS compatibility, and Linux, filesystem, networking, and process-level interfaces in the stack. You will be writing automated tests, running AI-assisted security scans, helping with scheduled CVE scans, and turning validated findings into reliable regression tests. Much of our software is open source and our tests make heavy use of open source software and development techniques. Your test code may be publicly visible, so it has to be great. You will be using AI daily but able to show your core technical skills without it.

Here is how to tell if you fit:
- You are able to pass a technical interview without using AI and are open to in-person interviews
- You have security-focused testing experience or are willing to learn fast and make it your new passion
- You have an unmatched motivation and are fascinated by software quality

- You are an outstanding coder

  • You know or want to learn how to develop and run tests at every level of the stack
    - You can communicate and work well with a remote team

Candidates need to meet the following qualifications:
- 3+ years of hands-on testing experience in DBMS, cloud services, storage, or operating systems
- Strong working knowledge of Docker, Linux, and network security fundamentals
- Experience with or strong interest in security testing, including CVE triage, dependency scanning, Docker image scanning with tools such as Grype or Trivy, authentication, authorization, RBAC, OAuth, TLS, FIPS, secrets handling, and security-hardened systems
- Excellent knowledge of Python, C++ and bash scripting
- Excellent coding skills and ability to write clean, efficient test code
- Expert at designing enterprise-level functional tests for cloud services, client libraries, or service APIs
- Experienced in using modern CI/CD systems like GitHub Actions
- Tenacious at figuring out ways to break software and systematic in documenting bugs
- Excellent discipline to follow test processes
- Capable of working independently with minimal supervision

Our Benefits:
- Work from Anywhere, Anytime: We are not your typical nine-to-five shop! Enjoy the flexibility of working from literally wherever and whenever. Create a schedule that works for you and your family or lifestyle. Recharge your batteries with our open vacation policies.
- Cultural Diversity: We love that we get to work with passionate people from around the world. Currently, our team is made of professionals from 25 different countries!
- Career Development: We provide opportunities to learn new technologies as well as try out new roles. We also offer access to training on leading-edge technologies, plus flexible work schedules for external education.
- USA Employees Benefits: We offer comprehensive PPO health care plans for our US-based employees that are incredibly flexible to meet the needs of individuals or families. 401K with company match also available.
- Company Travel: We come together in person two to three times per year in locations across the globe.
We also fund travel to conferences and encourage presentations as well as contributions to open-source communities.

This is a full-time position and includes equity in the company.
Altinity is venture-funded and financially stable.
We are 100% remote. You may work anywhere you have work permits.

Check out our many other benefits including flexible work hours, career development, and open vacation policies.

We are eager to meet you!

job.title: Senior QA Engineer - Platform
job.description:
What are we building?

Hard Rock Digital is a fiercely focused team working to become the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We're building a deeply curious team with a passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We're customer-obsessed — we care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight, and strive to ensure we're always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We're taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us? What’s the position?

What’s the position?

We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer to join the Platform team. Unlike a traditional feature-team QA role, you will own quality across the entire platform rather than a single feature area, acting as a key safeguard before our releases reach millions of customers. As a Sr QA Engineer, you will lead manual regression testing during our regression windows, shift that regression earlier into our integration environments, uncover device, OS and hardware specific issues, and partner with feature teams to strengthen their test coverage. The role requires an individual who’s dedicated to the customer’s experience, able to clearly voice and document issues and concerns within their testing focus and who is a self-starter with a strong sense of ownership. You will be responsible for the quality, scope and timeliness of all your deliverables. We will be reliant on your skills and your passion and accountability for all aspects of your work.

As a Senior QA Engineer, your responsibilities will include:

  • Plan and execute manual regression testing of our web and mobile applications during scheduled regression windows, ensuring the quality and stability of every platform release.

  • Uncover defects specific to devices, device types, operating systems and hardware across iOS, Android and web, including testing against OS betas and newly released devices.

  • Test real-world conditions such as poor or switching networks, interruptions, app backgrounding, permission changes and biometric login edge cases.

  • Perform usability and accessibility testing to ensure an intuitive and inclusive customer experience.

  • Validate jurisdiction-specific and regulated functionality, including geolocation, KYC and age verification, responsible gaming controls, and payments and wallet flows.

  • Partner with feature teams by facilitating and participating in Bug Bashes and Feature Testing Sessions

  • Retroactively analyze work delivered by feature teams to identify gaps in test specifications and test cases and drive those gaps to closure.

  • Own the health of the manual regression suite by pruning obsolete cases, consolidating duplicates and keeping coverage risk prioritized.

  • Shift testing left by running regression and structured exploratory testing charters against high-risk areas of the platform in our integration test environments, continuing that coverage during regression windows.

  • Perform post-release production verification, including validation of app store builds, upgrade paths and phased rollouts.

  • Perform readiness testing ahead of high-traffic sporting events across live betting, odds updates, cashout and bet slip functionality.

  • Help curate our device lab and device coverage matrix, using customer usage data to prioritize devices, OS versions, and form factors.

  • Report, triage, and manage defects, providing clear reproduction steps supported by logs, video and device details.

  • Perform root cause and escaped defect analysis on production issues and feed findings back into regression coverage.

  • Reproduce customer-reported issues escalated from app store reviews or Player Support, turning vague reports into actionable defects.

  • Work closely with QA Automation Engineers to identify and prioritize stable, repetitive, high-value regression cases for automation.

  • Use AI tools to speed up your understanding of our platform and to accelerate test case design, gap analysis and defect reporting.

  • Track and report quality KPIs such as defects found per regression window, escaped defects and regression cycle time.

  • Mentor and provide guidance to members of the QA team.

  • Collaborate with developers, product owners and other stakeholders to understand requirements and provide input on testability and quality aspects.

  • Stay updated on industry best practices, emerging technologies and testing tools to continuously improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the QA process.

  • Learn our applications inside and out and become a subject matter expert.

Requirements

What are we looking for?

We are looking for someone who is extremely well organized and willing to tackle problems with innovative ideas and solutions. We believe the perfect candidate isn’t interested in just what we’re building right now but wants to understand where we’re going and how it impacts the customer to ensure everything we create moves us closer to our goal: delivering the best customer experience.

Key skills required for this position:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in QA testing for web and mobile applications

  • A knack for finding bugs others miss, driven by a natural curiosity about how things break.

  • Proven experience regression testing large, multi-team platforms with scheduled release cycles.

  • Deep experience testing across a wide range of physical devices, OS versions and form factors on iOS and Android, as well as emulators, simulators and cloud device farms.

  • Advanced expertise in identifying and isolating complex issues in web and mobile applications, including performance bottlenecks, integration failures and UI/UX inconsistencies.

  • Mastery of QA tools (e.g., Proxyman, Charles, browser DevTools, Postman) and device logs for efficient troubleshooting and debugging

  • Strong exploratory and usability testing skills, with working knowledge of accessibility standards

  • Thorough understanding of test management software and the QA role throughout the SDLC

  • Critical, questioning approach to AI-generated output, with a commitment to sound testing principles and standards.

  • Strong analytical skills to identify patterns, trends and possible areas of improvement.

  • Meticulous attention to detail in creating, executing and maintaining test cases.

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to facilitate sessions with feature teams and clearly communicate quality risk to leadership.

  • Strong decision-making abilities, especially when prioritizing under tight deadlines.

  • Ability to work efficiently under pressure in a fast-paced environment.

  • Team-oriented mindset with a proactive approach to cross-functional collaboration.

  • Commitment to continuous learning and staying updated on industry trends and emerging technologies.

What sets you apart:

  • Experience working in sports betting or other highly regulated industries.

  • Experience testing geolocation, KYC, payments or responsible gaming feature.

  • Experience utilizing AI to generate skills to replace repetitive tasks.

  • Experience writing automated tests in Python for APIs, Web, or Mobile

  • Passionate about sports

What’s in it for you?

We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

  • Competitive pay and benefits

  • Flexible vacation allowance

  • Flexible work from home or office hours

  • Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand.

  • Opportunity to build products enjoyed by millions as part of a passionate team.

Roster of Uniques

We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer).

job.title: Lead Quality Engineer (Test Automation & Transformation)
job.description:
About 8 West Consulting

8 West Consulting provides consultancy services and software solutions to clients across the US, Europe and the UK. We work in sectors including insurance, healthcare and retail, helping organisations tackle complex technology challenges and modernise critical platforms.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a hands-on Lead Quality Engineer to advance test automation and AI-enabled quality engineering across enterprise client teams. You will establish pragmatic technical direction, help several projects adopt repeatable practices and lead improvements to testing capability, while personally delivering automation, dependable test data and quality support on live engagements.

This is not a strategy-only or people-management role. You will lead by building, demonstrating and coaching, helping teams move from manual-heavy testing towards reliable automation. The challenge is to make progress across established applications and different project needs, within enterprise controls and ongoing client commitments.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead cross-team transformation. Assess testing maturity across enterprise teams, prioritise common opportunities and lead phased adoption of automation, AI-assisted testing and better data practices.
  • Stay hands-on. Personally write and debug UI, API, integration and data tests; solve difficult automation problems, investigate defects and support releases.
  • Set technical direction. Define pragmatic quality engineering principles, review solutions and guide tool choices across projects while allowing for different client architectures and constraints.
  • Build shared test data capability. Design and implement reusable builders, fixtures, seeding and reset patterns for complex systems; enable independent tests across teams and environments.
  • Scale AI-enabled testing. Implement AI-assisted test design, case and script generation, synthetic data creation and failure analysis, then establish validation, safe-use practices and repeatable adoption.
  • Create reusable engineering practices. Establish lightweight patterns for frameworks, CI/CD, test reporting and governance; coach teams to apply them rather than create a central delivery bottleneck.
  • Develop engineering capability. Pair with testers and developers across projects, review implementations, mentor senior engineers and build practical training and adoption plans.
  • Influence senior stakeholders. Explain quality risks, investment choices, technical trade-offs and transformation progress to engineering leaders, delivery managers and client decision-makers.
  • Own outcomes across teams. Measure adoption and results across projects, including regression effort, test stability, independent data setup, AI effectiveness, feedback speed and release confidence.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Multi-team enterprise transformation. Has personally led substantial testing improvements across several teams, applications or workstreams in an enterprise environment, with clear evidence of adoption and delivery outcomes.
  • Recent hands-on engineering. Strong coding, debugging and automation skills, including direct work on production test suites in C#, TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Java or equivalent.
  • AI implementation and adoption. Implemented AI-assisted testing on real enterprise projects and helped other engineers adopt it; can demonstrate verified test/data generation, practical safeguards and measured results.
  • Complex test data engineering. Has personally built reusable, isolated test datasets and shared patterns for relational or integrated systems using SQL, APIs, fixtures and builders; manages integrity, synthetic/masked data and reset.
  • Automation architecture and standards. Able to set sensible patterns across UI, API, integration, contract, data and regression tests, review designs and balance reuse with project-specific needs.
  • Microsoft-based environments. Practical experience testing .NET, SQL Server and/or Azure applications, including Azure DevOps or equivalent pipelines, Git and engineering workflows.
  • Tooling and delivery integration. Broad experience with Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Postman or equivalents, plus CI/CD integration, test environments and flaky-test diagnosis.
  • Cross-project change leadership. Has built practical roadmaps, gained support across teams and delivered improvements incrementally despite competing deadlines and legacy constraints.
  • Executive communication and coaching. Can influence engineering and business leaders without formal authority, explain investment and quality trade-offs, and develop engineers through pairing and mentoring.

Desirable Experience

  • Regulated enterprise environments. Insurance, healthcare, financial services or other controlled industries, with experience of auditability, privacy and sensitive test data.
  • Advanced AI quality practices. AI-assisted test-suite maintenance, agentic testing workflows, LLM evaluation, repeatable AI-feature test datasets or governance for AI testing tools.
  • Specialist testing. Performance/load, security, accessibility (WCAG), API contracts, complex integrations or data-heavy application testing.
  • Broader platforms and consultancy. Cloud-native, distributed, legacy or mobile systems; multi-client consulting, reusable accelerators or relevant testing and Azure certifications.

Personal Profile

You are a credible technical leader who still enjoys writing code and testing software. You can see patterns across different client environments without imposing unnecessary process. You solve difficult automation and data problems yourself, mentor others patiently and communicate clearly with senior stakeholders. You are realistic about AI, security and the pressure of live delivery.

What Success Looks Like

Multiple client teams adopt reliable automation, independent test data and verified AI-assisted testing practices that fit their delivery needs. Reusable approaches reduce duplicated effort, engineers gain confidence and the improvements are sustained beyond a single project. Progress is visible in adoption, feedback speed, test stability and release confidence, alongside dependable hands-on client delivery.

job.description:
Who We Are

At Jobsity, we believe great talent should not be limited by geography.

Jobsity is a nearshore staffing partner that connects leading U.S. companies with top talent in Latin America for software engineering, contact center operations, and BPO services. Our footprint spans over 20 countries across the Americas, and we deliver fully integrated, enterprise-ready teams.

From scaling specialized tech infrastructure to delivering bilingual front-line customer service, Jobsity provides an all-in-one staffing solution including recruitment, onboarding, payroll, compliance, and more.

Why Work With Jobsity

We match standout professionals across Latin America with high-impact opportunities at leading U.S. companies. Joining Jobsity is about finding a rewarding remote role and working with innovative teams. It also means you get to become part of a community that values your experience, supports your ambition, and invests in your ongoing professional growth.

Whether you are looking for your next challenge, seeking greater flexibility, or ready to elevate your career, Jobsity gives you the platform and partnership to thrive on your terms.

Job Description

We are looking for a Mid-level QA Analystwith 3+ years of testing experience and 2+ years in US property and casualty or commercial lines insurance. You will test code changes across dev, UAT and production, run regression on policy, billing and accounting flows, validate premium, tax and fee calculations, and log clear Jira tickets. You will follow a structured training path from general regression to specializing in policy or billing, working daily with the business analysts and developers.

Responsibilities

  • Test code changes in development and UAT environments before deployment, and validate behavior again after release to production.

  • Run regression testing across policy, billing and accounting flows, navigating the system as a broker would (quote, application, issuance, endorsements, cancellations, reinstatements).

  • Build test cases based on requirements and development changes, including the ones needed to reproduce reported issues.

  • Log defects and write detailed Jira tickets with issue, expected result and steps to reproduce.

  • Validate premium, tax and fee calculations and review the resulting invoices and accounting entries.

  • Verify that data persists correctly in the system and reaches third party systems as defined in the integration mapping.

  • Follow a structured training path, starting with general regression testing, then specializing in policy or billing, and later rotating to cover the full process end to end.

Key Requirements

  • 3+ years of QA or software testing experience, ideally manual testing of insurance software.

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with US property and casualty or commercial lines insurance, with solid command of US insurance terminology (terms, endorsements, reinstatements, cancellations, earned premium, out-of-sequence transactions).

  • Ability to read requirements documents written in insurance terminology and turn them into test cases and expected results.

  • Experience validating premium, tax and fee calculations, either from scratch or using rating worksheets.

  • 2+ years logging defects and writing clear tickets in Jira.

  • Ability to validate data flowing between systems and third-party integrations (API JSON calls, flat files) against mapping documents.

  • Strong attention to detail, precise written and spoken English, and the ability to retain training quickly.

What We Offer

At Jobsity, we know that a positive professional experience goes beyond the role itself.

Depending on the position, client, country, and type of contract, professionals may have access to different benefits, programs, and resources designed to support their well-being, development, and remote-work experience.

These may include:

● Paid time off or vacation days

● Paid holidays, depending on the client and country

● Professional development and learning opportunities

● Ongoing support from our People Experience team

● Recognition initiatives and internal activities

● Remote-work flexibility

● Opportunities to collaborate with international teams

● Access to tools and resources that support your work

● Career growth opportunities based on performance, business needs, and available roles

Because each opportunity is different, the specific benefits associated with a position will always be communicated during the recruitment process.

Evolphin is building the next generation of AI-powered media workflows for enterprise media teams managing large image and video libraries at scale, including environments with tens of millions of video assets and extremely large metadata and embedding footprints. Role Overview

We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer (5–8 years experience) who can take ownership of automation strategy and quality engineering for our AI-powered platform.

This role is primarily automation-focused, but will also require hands-on manual testing for new features, exploratory scenarios, AI output validation, and edge-case workflows. You will play a critical role in ensuring the reliability, usability, performance, and scalability of our image and video automation workflows.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-moving startup environments and enjoys building automation frameworks while staying close to product behavior through manual validation when needed.

Key Responsibilities

    • Design and own the end-to-end automation framework for web, API, and AI-driven features
    • Build API automation suites for our core automation workflows and integrations (Postman/Newman/RestAssured)
    • Drive UI automation using Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress
    • Ensure cross-browser compatibility for our design-heavy, canvas-based interfaces
    • Build performance testing suites to validate image/video processing throughput under load
    • Embed quality gates into our deployment pipelines (GitHub Actions/Jenkins)
    • Enable rapid, confident releases through automated testing at every stage
    • Create validation frameworks for non-deterministic ML results—balancing precision with creative flexibility
    • Partner with Product to define acceptance criteria for AI-driven features
    • Work alongside Engineering to shift-left quality and build testability into system design
    • Experience using LLMs (ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, etc.) to generate and refactor automation scripts
    • Ability to review, validate, and harden AI-generated test code (not blindly accept output)
    • Experience building prompt templates for test case generation from user stories
    • Familiarity with AI-assisted test case generation and coverage analysis
    • Understanding of how to test AI-driven features (prompt testing, hallucination detection, cost optimizations, response validation)
    • Ability to design deterministic validation strategies for probabilistic AI outputs
    • Experience integrating automation into AI-heavy workflows (semantic search, generative features, etc.)

Requirements

  • 5 to 7 years of hands-on QA automation experience in fast-paced product environments
  • Web Automation: Deep expertise in Playwright, or Cypress—you know when to use which
  • API Testing: Proven experience with Postman, Newman, RestAssured, or similar tools
  • AI/ML Testing: Experience validating machine learning systems or computer vision pipelines
  • Programming: Proficiency in Java, Python, or JavaScript—you can read and write production code
  • CI/CD: Experience integrating tests into GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar pipelines
  • SaaS Domain: Track record testing cloud-based, multi-tenant products at scale

Good to Have

  • Growth opportunities: Lead backend strategy while mentoring and shaping engineering practices.
  • Flexible work environment: Support for remote arrangements tailored to your needs.
  • AI-First Product: You're not testing CRUD apps—you're validating cutting-edge computer vision and generative AI workflows that didn't exist three years ago.

job.title: QA Specialist - Dynamic Email
job.description:
About SH/FT

Shift Paradigm is an execution-led strategic consultancy that bridges the gap between enterprise strategy and technical reality. We partner with Fortune 500 brands and emerging leaders to solve the inherent complexity of modern digital marketing. As partners to the world’s leading MarTech platforms, including Adobe, Salesforce, Optimizely, and Braze, we deploy integrated experts across data analytics, marketing strategy, technology development, engineering, and revenue operations to ensure our clients’ tech stacks don't just exist, but perform.

The Role

As a Quality Assurance Specialist embedded within our financial services practice, you serve as the final gatekeeper safeguarding digital communications before reaching broad customer audiences.

This role allocates approximately 80% of its scope to comprehensive Content QA—auditing creative assets from initial ideation through regulatory review, followed by rigorous testing within Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC), cross-client rendering environments, and live deployment validation to guarantee alignment with technical documentation, design specs, dynamic messaging logic, and WCAG standards.

The remaining 20% involves partnering with Technical QA Analysts to conduct data schema audits, HTML structure reviews, and deployment file verifications. Working closely with cross-functional partners across creative, engineering, and project management, you will track, triage, and resolve issues in Mantis within a high-velocity enterprise ecosystem where precision and compliance are paramount.

This role will report to the Sr. Director of Development & QA.

What You'll Accomplish

Content QA: Creative Proofing (Primary)

  • Proof every creative round before client delivery: full end-to-end reviews in early rounds, targeted checks of legal and compliance edits in later rounds.
  • Ensure accuracy in spelling, grammar and punctuation, and enforce brand guidelines and the client's email design system.
  • Verify each round reflects all client feedback, with no unintended changes.
  • Confirm terms, conditions and disclosures are complete before legal review.
  • Document proofing feedback clearly in Workfront using the team's proofreading checklist.

Content QA: Email Testing (Primary)

  • Test coded emails in the Salesforce Marketing Cloud Sandbox against the user story, approved creative and test plan.
  • Validate copy, images, links and tracking across every version and audience.
  • Confirm personalized and dynamic content renders correctly for each test record, including Movable Ink elements.
  • Verify accessibility against WCAG 2.1 AA, including alt text and ARIA labels tested with a screen reader.
  • Run render tests across devices and email clients using Email on Acid and Inbox Monster.
  • Log clear, reproducible bugs in Mantis and verify fixes before closing them.
  • Support live production testing in the week before deployment, often with same-day turnarounds.

Technical QA Support (Secondary)

  • Help audit the mail plan, user story and test data before development begins.
  • Assist with HTML code reviews: template use, link URLs, alt text, ARIA labels, heading structure, fonts, subject lines and preheaders.
  • Review final file packages for completeness and naming conventions before hand-off to Salesforce.
  • Help validate accessibility and logic fixes, and back up the Technical QA Analyst during peak periods.

Team and Process

  • Join internal creative reviews and developer handoffs to flag content and testing risks early.
  • Attend daily scrum and weekly QA resource planning, and keep Workfront tasks and timesheets current.
  • Contribute to retrospectives and help improve QA checklists, test plans and workflows.

What You Bring

Experience & Expertise

  • 2–4 years focused on editorial review, creative verification, or marketing quality assurance within client-facing agency networks or corporate environments.
  • Direct operational experience validating responsive HTML communications, predominantly across Salesforce Marketing Cloud or equivalent enterprise campaign execution tools.
  • Background supporting highly regulated sectors such as banking, insurance, or health, managing multi-tier governance workflows and legal sign-offs.
  • Practical understanding of WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility guidelines, including alt tags, ARIA attributes, and semantic document markup.
  • Proven history auditing real-time dynamic content and audience personalization against technical briefs, user criteria, and test scenarios.
  • Proficiency documenting, routing, and managing issue remediation within corporate ticket management platforms like Mantis, Jira, or Azure DevOps.

Skills & Capabilities

  • Exceptional attention to detail, with strong command of grammar, spelling, punctuation and style guides.
  • Ability to read basic HTML well enough to inspect links, alt text, heading tags and font declarations.
  • Comfort with email render and testing tools such as Email on Acid, Litmus or Inbox Monster.
  • Ability to use a screen reader (VoiceOver, NVDA or JAWS) to verify accessible content.
  • Clear, concise written communication, especially bug reports that a developer can act on without a follow-up call.
  • Strong organization and prioritization across several concurrent projects with shifting deadlines.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and spreadsheets, for working with test plans, data files and change logs.

Mindset

  • Accountability: you own your QA sign-off and treat every missed error as a learning opportunity, not someone else's problem.
  • Learning: you are curious about the technical side of email and eager to grow your skills toward Technical QA.
  • Teamwork: you see QA as a partner to creative and development, not a gatekeeper, and you jump in when others are at capacity.
  • Candor: you give direct, kind and specific feedback, and you ask questions early rather than assume.
  • Composure: you stay calm and methodical during Live Testing crunches and same-day turnarounds, with compliance top of mind.

Nice to Haves

  • Salesforce Certified Marketing Cloud Email Specialist or similar certification.
  • Familiarity with AMPscript, personalization strings or dynamic content logic.
  • Experience with Movable Ink or other real-time email personalization platforms.
  • Exposure to automated accessibility audit tools such as Deque axe.
  • Experience with Adobe Workfront, Basecamp or Figma.
  • Knowledge of financial services or payments terminology, card product marketing or Card Member lifecycle communications.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation aligned with your experience and impact
  • Remote flexibility
  • Collaborative culture that values diverse perspectives and innovative thinking
  • Work that makes a measurable difference for your clients

Why SH/FT:

SH/FT is a consultancy built for transformation. We bridge the gap between marketing, data, and technology to unlock growth for some of the world's most recognized brands. At SH/FT you'll shape the future of how organizations connect with their customers through intelligent architecture, scalable systems, and the power of data-driven strategy.

Comp & Benefits

The salary range for this role is $60,000 to $72,000 USD. Salary is based on several factors including but not limited to skillset, relevant education, level of experience, certifications, and scope of responsibilities.

In addition to base salary, SH/FT offers benefits such as medical, dental, vision, STD/LTD, Life/AD&D, Flexible Paid Time Off, and various other ancillary benefits and perks.

We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities under the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

About AudienceView

AudienceView is a leading event commerce platform serving over 2,100 organizations across 12 countries. The company helps live event organizations grow audiences, increase revenue, and streamline operations through an integrated ecosystem of ticketing, CRM, marketing, and commerce solutions.

With more than 20 years of industry experience, AudienceView supports performing arts organizations, sports teams, higher education institutions, festivals, and entertainment venues worldwide.

About the Role

AudienceView is expanding its engineering organization to support several strategic modernization initiatives and product refactoring projects. We are looking for experienced Quality Engineers who are passionate about automation, quality advocacy, and leveraging modern testing practices, including AI-assisted testing and development tools.

As a Senior Quality Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the reliability, performance, and quality of highly scalable web applications used by thousands of organizations worldwide.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks
  • Build and execute automated test suites for web applications and APIs
  • Perform manual and automation testing across functional, non-functional, exploratory, integration, and regression scenarios
  • Partner closely with Software Engineers, Product Managers, and stakeholders throughout the development lifecycle
  • Automate API testing using tools such as Postman
  • Test mobile applications as part of the overall quality strategy
  • Support release management and quality validation activities
  • Identify defects, investigate root causes, and collaborate with engineering teams to resolve issues
  • Promote quality best practices across the organization
  • Leverage AI-assisted tools to improve testing efficiency, automation coverage, documentation, and quality processes

Must-Have Skills

  • 5+ years of Quality Engineering experience, combining manual and automation testing
  • Strong experience with Selenium WebDriver (or similar automation tools)
  • Strong experience with JavaScript and Java
  • Strong API testing experience
  • Mobile testing experience
  • SQL experience
  • Experience testing applications built with Node.js and React
  • Quality-first mindset
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

AI-Assisted Development & Testing Experience

We are looking for professionals who have used AI tools to support automation development, test generation, debugging, documentation, quality analysis, or engineering productivity.

Nice-to-Have Skills

Why Join AudienceView

AudienceView is a global leader in event commerce and ticketing technology, helping organizations create meaningful live-event experiences for millions of customers worldwide.

job.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
job.description:
Who Are Massive Rocket?

Massive Rocket is a rapidly scaling Braze and Snowflake agency on a mission to transform how digital marketing, product, and engineering teams connect. In just five years, we’ve grown at speed and are now gearing up for our next big milestone: hitting $100M in revenue. We build human experiences at scale, powered by cutting‑edge web, mobile, cloud, data, and AI technologies. If you’re excited by innovation, love solving complex challenges, and want to help shape the future of digital experiences, you’ll feel right at home here.

Every role at Massive Rocket is entrepreneurial. The people who thrive here don’t just focus on their own remit — they understand the goals of the teams around them and actively contribute to the success of their colleagues, customers, and partners. We’re building a culture of ownership, collaboration, and growth, and we’re looking for people who want to make a real impact.

Who Are We Looking to Add to Our Team?

As an SDET (Martech & Data) at Massive Rocket, you’ll design, build and maintain the automated testing architecture that protects the integrity, reliability and velocity of a customer data ecosystem. This is a fixed-term contract role. Working within an embedded team, you’ll be the engineering gatekeeper of the “Golden Record” as the core stack is optimised, including Databricks, mParticle, Braze, OneTrust and ThoughtSpot.

Rather than checking files by hand, your focus is writing code that tests code. You’ll build automated validation frameworks for complex data pipelines, simulate user behaviour across web and app SDKs, mock cross-platform API integrations, and make sure automated personalisation and experimentation frameworks scale without regression. You’ll work closely with Data Engineers to triage anomalies, resolve pipeline failures quickly and stop issues coming back.

You’ll thrive here if you enjoy building test automation frameworks from scratch, owning defects end to end, and keeping data accurate, compliant and ready for activation.

What Will You Do?

  • Design and implement automated validation frameworks that test data contracts, schema compliance and identity resolution/stitching logic in Databricks before data reaches downstream activation channels
  • Build and maintain automated UI and behavioural test scripts that simulate real-world customer journeys across web and app
  • Verify programmatically that behavioural events, mParticle tags and OneTrust consent tokens fire accurately at the application layer
  • Validate high-criticality data flows across the Databricks > mParticle > Braze > OneTrust ecosystem
  • Write automated integration scripts and mock API payloads to confirm actions propagate and correctly suppress or activate users across platforms
  • Design and run end-to-end tests for data collection pipelines (POS, Web, App, CRM), making sure data is cleaned, standardised and transformed accurately for downstream use
  • Validate data freshness and latency against near real-time SLAs
  • Establish and maintain automated data validation and hygiene rules that detect corrupted records and schema drift in near real-time
  • Audit data flows to make sure consent and preference management is strictly followed across every system, in line with global privacy regulations such as GDPR and UK GDPR

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • Mastery of SQL for complex data validation, including writing scripts that identify anomalies across millions of records
  • Proficiency in Python for building automated test suites and interacting with APIs
  • Proven experience establishing data test automation frameworks from scratch
  • Hands-on experience testing within Databricks (or an equivalent cloud lakehouse/warehouse), with a deep understanding of Delta Lake or similar architectures
  • Proven experience validating complex data transformations across near real-time/streaming and batch pipelines, with familiarity with orchestration tools such as Airflow or dbt
  • Experience validating data flows through a Customer Data Platform, particularly mParticle, including event ingestion, identity resolution and audience syncs into downstream engagement platforms
  • Skill in triaging data anomalies, tracking pipeline failures in tools like Jira and working closely with Data Engineers to resolve issues quickly and prevent regression
  • Experience testing REST APIs and validating data payloads between systems (for example, checking that a POS event correctly triggers a Braze data point)
  • A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering or a related technical field

Bonus points if you have:

  • Familiarity with how data is ingested into Braze via the Data Track API or Cloud Data Ingestion (CDI)
  • Experience testing CDP-to-engagement data flows, such as mParticle audience syncs and event forwarding into Braze
  • Experience testing privacy compliance and consent frameworks using tools like OneTrust
  • Experience embedding data quality checks into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI)

Why You’ll Love Working Here

Rocket‑Fuelled Growth – Big challenges, fast learning, and the chance to level up quicker than anywhere else

A Culture That Actually Gives a Damn – Supportive, positive, and built around people who want to see you win

A Global Crew – Collaborate with brilliant teammates across Europe, the US, and beyond

Remote‑First for Life – Work from wherever you feel your best

Real Career Momentum – Clear progression, real ownership, and space to grow into your next chapter

Moments That Matter – Meetups, events, and team experiences that make the journey unforgettable

A Few Things to Know Before We Get Started

Bring Your Own Device – We operate a BYOD policy, so you’ll use your own kit for work

Right to Work – You’ll need a valid work visa; we’re not able to offer sponsorship at the moment

ID Checks – We may ask for proof of identity (passport, ID card, or a recent utility bill)

References – We may request two references, so have names, relationships, and contact details ready

A Quick Note on Applications

We receive a high volume of applications, and while we’d love to reply to everyone personally, it’s not always possible. If you haven’t heard from us within two weeks, it sadly means you haven’t been successful this time. But don’t let that stop you—we’re growing fast, and new opportunities open up all the time.

job.title: Senior QA Engineer, AI & Automation
job.description:
Adventure is our Culture. Join a team that celebrates a lifestyle as bold as the terrain we love. At Backcountry, we are rooted in adventure, recognition, and wellbeing on and off the mountain. We spotlight employee stories, celebrate milestones, and offer exclusive outdoor perks. Whether you are at HQ, in a retail store, or remote, you will be part of a team that thrives on energy, exploration, and connection.

Reports to: Senior Retail Technology Architect

Location: Remote (US, Canada, or Costa Rica)

What You'll Do

    Build AI-Accelerated Test Automation

  • Build and maintain scalable automation suites using Playwright across web, API, and mobile, contributing to broader QA frameworks and release validation standards.
  • Use AI coding assistants and agents (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Playwright's planner/generator/healer agents) to generate test plans, test cases, page objects, and test data from requirements, Jira stories, and PR diffs.
  • Review, validate, and harden every AI-generated test before it merges — you own the correctness of the suite regardless of what wrote the code.
  • Drive down flaky tests and maintenance cost through resilient locator strategies, AI-assisted self-healing, and automated failure triage.
  • Integrate automated quality gates into GitHub Actions CI/CD so every deploy is validated by the pipeline rather than by manual sign-off.
  • Build and maintain functional, regression, API, and performance/load testing coverage using tools like Postman, JMeter, or k6.

    • Apply Testing Judgment Where It Matters

  • Determine what should be automated, what can be delegated to AI, and what requires human testing — balancing coverage, risk, and release timelines.
  • Perform focused exploratory testing on new features, UI/UX changes, and complex user flows to catch edge cases and usability issues that automation and AI miss.
  • Turn every escaped defect into an automated regression check so the suite strengthens with each release.
  • Partner with engineers to embed tests, API contract checks, and AI-assisted code review early in the SDLC to reduce downstream defect costs.
  • Help define how to test AI-powered customer experiences (search, recommendations) where outputs are non-deterministic and need evaluation rubrics rather than exact assertions.
  • Track and report quality metrics (automation coverage, defect escape rate, flake rate, test cycle time) to show where automation is paying off.

    • Contribute to a High-Performing Team

  • Collaborate with QA peers and engineering teams, sharing knowledge, best practices, and the AI prompts and workflows that work.
  • Provide input on quality practices and process improvements across the engineering org, focusing on reducing manual regression and UAT effort.
  • Support and mentor QA engineers on automation and responsible AI-assisted testing, fostering a culture of quality ownership.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance and Testing, including 3+ years building and maintaining test automation that runs in CI/CD.
  • Proven, hands-on experience with Playwright for web and API E2E automation; Cypress or Selenium experience is a plus.
  • Strong automation fundamentals: ability to design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable test suites and frameworks, and to diagnose and eliminate flaky tests.
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python (Java a plus); you write test code to the same standard as production code.
  • Hands-on, day-to-day use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor) to write, refactor, and debug test code, with the discipline to validate and correct AI-generated output.
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions preferred), including parallel execution, reporting, and quality gates.
  • Solid experience with functional, regression, API, and performance/load testing (Postman, JMeter, k6, or equivalent).
  • Strong exploratory testing skills and the judgment to build risk-based test strategies across automated, AI-assisted, and manual coverage.
  • Demonstrated SDLC and Agile experience with defect lifecycle management using Jira and TestRail.
  • Ability to operate effectively under a steady release cadence and manage competing priorities with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • E-commerce QA automation experience, particularly in environments shipping frequently with CI/CD integration.
  • Experience building or adopting agentic testing workflows (AI test generation, self-healing tests, MCP-connected tools, or LLM-based failure triage).
  • Experience testing AI/ML-powered features such as search, recommendations, or LLM-generated content, including evaluation of non-deterministic output.
  • Familiarity with BrowserStack or similar cloud device and browser grids.
  • Experience with observability tooling like Grafana or GCP-based infrastructure, including using production signals to prioritize test coverage.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally.

Why Join

    The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.

  • Cross-Functional Impact: Your work touches every engineering team and every release — automation coverage and quality gates you build directly shape what ships to customers across web, mobile, and API.
  • AI-First Skill Building: You will work at the frontier of AI-assisted testing, using and evaluating emerging tools daily and building expertise that is defining the next generation of quality engineering.
  • End-to-End Ownership: You own the automation framework, the CI/CD quality gates, and the testing strategy — from choosing what to automate to deciding how to evaluate non-deterministic AI features.
  • Competitive Benefits (US): Paid time off policies, 401(k) match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.
  • Competitive Benefits (Canada): Paid time off policies, RRSP match, medical, dental, and vision coverage, a variety of supplemental benefit options, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.
  • Competitive Benefits (Costa Rica): We offer an attractive benefits package including primarily remote work, private medical and life insurance, additional paid time off, monthly allowances and reimbursements, employee discounts, and opportunities for professional growth.

Interview Process

    1. Recruiter Screen - A 30-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for.
    2. Hiring Manager Interview - A deeper conversation focused on your automation experience, AI-assisted testing approach, and how you balance coverage with release velocity.
    3. Technical / Case Discussion - A hands-on session covering Playwright automation design, CI/CD integration, and your approach to evaluating and hardening AI-generated tests.
    4. In-Person Interview - We'd like to meet you at our Salt Lake City office. Details and logistics will be arranged with your recruiter.
    5. Reference Checks - Conducted in parallel with the final stages where possible.
    6. Offer - We move quickly for the right candidate.

    Interview process is subject to change. Any updates will be communicated promptly and clearly.

Please Note

  • Part of our interview process is a mandatory in-person interview with someone on our team prior to an offer. Candidates that are unwilling or unable to meet for an in-person interview will be removed from consideration immediately.
  • Due to a high volume of fraudulent applications, you must share a valid LinkedIn profile URL in the application questions below to be considered. If you do not have a LinkedIn profile, you must provide a credible reason in that field and supply alternative evidence of your professional background to verify your identity.

CSC Generation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to any characteristic protected by law. If you need an accommodation during the application process, contact .

Employment is contingent on a background check, including verification of prior employment dates.

This posting is for an existing vacancy. This position is not open to and cannot be filled by a B.C. Resident.

job.title: [Job - 32612] QA Lead
job.description:
At CI&T, we help large enterprises transform the potential of AI into real business impact with AI Deployment, AI-native execution, and tech-integrated business solutions.

With 30 years of experience in technological transformation, we accelerate innovation with expertise in Agentic SDLC, Application modernization, Data & AI, Martech and Business strategy.

We are 8,000 CI&Ters across more than 25 countries, collaborating to build solutions with real impact. AI is already part of how we work, evolve, and innovate every day.

Your Mission: Join our team in a pivotal role that combines deep technical quality assurance expertise with strong business acumen. As a QA Lead, you will work directly with the client's teams, engaging with stakeholders across the project to safeguard product quality at every stage of the software lifecycle. Your mission is to own the testing strategy, truly understand the business rules and overall functioning of the project, and bring AI-augmented practices into QA to raise the bar for quality and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Define, implement, and continuously evolve the QA strategy for the project, covering test planning, execution, and reporting.
    - Work directly with the client's teams to learn the business rules, user flows, and overall functioning of the project, translating that understanding into effective test coverage.
    - Design, produce, and execute test cases (manual and automated) across functional, regression, integration, and non-functional testing.
    - Communicate test results, risks, and quality metrics clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
    - Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and product owners to clarify requirements and surface edge cases early in the development cycle.
    - Lead and mentor other QA professionals, establishing best practices and quality standards across the team.
    - Organize and prioritize testing activities independently, managing competing deadlines with minimal supervision.
    - Identify and drive opportunities to apply AI tools to test design, test data generation, defect analysis, and overall QA efficiency.
    - Document test plans, processes, and quality reports to ensure standardization and alignment with the client's compliance and performance standards.

Requirements for this Position:

  • Excellent communication skills in English, with the confidence and clarity to engage directly with the client's teams.
    - Strong self-organization and autonomy, with a proven ability to manage priorities and deliver without close supervision.
    - Solid technical background in QA, including test case design, execution, defect tracking, and test automation concepts.
    - Strong business-oriented mindset, genuinely interested in learning the project's business rules and overall functioning, not just its technical layer.
    - Current, practical experience using AI tools applied to QA (e.g., AI-assisted test case generation, AI-powered test automation, or AI-driven defect analysis).
    - Experience with Agile methodologies and QA processes within Agile delivery.
    - Strong communication, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
    - A proactive, consultative mindset with the ability to lead discussions and influence quality-related decisions.

Stand-out Requirements: You will be one step ahead if you have:

  • Hands-on experience working in an agentic AI setting applied to QA, leveraging autonomous or semi-autonomous AI agents to support test generation, execution, or analysis.
    - Experience acting as a QA Lead or similar role embedded directly with a client's teams, without an intermediary layer of stakeholders.
    - Background in leading QA teams and building quality processes from the ground up.
    - Familiarity with test automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines.
    - Experience working in digital consulting environments.

Our benefits:

  • Health and dental insurance
  • Meal and food allowance
  • Childcare assistance
  • Extended paternity leave
  • Partnership with gyms and health and wellness professionals via Wellhub (Gympass) TotalPass;
  • Profit Sharing and Results Participation (PLR);
  • Life insurance
  • Continuous learning platform (CI&T University);
  • Discount club
  • Free online platform dedicated to physical, mental, and overall well-being
  • Pregnancy and responsible parenting course
  • Partnerships with online learning platforms
  • Language learning platform
And many more!

job.title: Software Engineer in Test 5 - Discovery & Viewing Experiences
job.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.


We’re hiring a senior Software Engineer in Test to lead how Netflix tests the experiences members use on their TVs and phones. You’ll define what quality means for complex, fast-moving features, build the tools and automation that prove it, and help every engineer around you ship with confidence.


The Teams


Live UI

The Discovery and Viewing Experience (DVX) Live team owns the UI engineering and architecture that powers Live viewing experiences across TV, iOS, and Android. Members show up for live events once, with no second airing and no patch mid-show, so every feature we build is a promise that it will work at that moment on every device that tunes in. As our senior SDET, you’ll lead the way we test Live: recreating the moments a live event creates, like a vote opening just as an ad ends, long before the event does, so we know we’re ready instead of finding out during the show.

What we’re working on:

  • The FIFA Women's World Cup, coming to Netflix in 2027 and 2031, will feature new experiences built for global, multi-match sport tournaments.
  • Interactive and navigational features that help members move through a live event and catch the moments that matter.
  • Real-time voting, which lets members influence a live show as it unfolds, alongside millions of others watching at the same moment.

Mobile Core

The DVX Mobile Core team develops and advances the architecture of Netflix's Android member app. We leverage systems and infrastructure widely available at Netflix and determine the best way to adopt and apply them on Android, enabling easier, more efficient patterns for downstream product engineering teams.


What we’re working on:

  • Modernizing our app architecture for the iOS and Android member app. This involves driving migrations and a cross-platform Player rewrite, creating leverage for product teams to ship faster and more reliably on iOS and Android.
  • Driving Quality of Experience (QoE). Owning monitoring and performance improvements across Player UI and canvases, as we scale.

The Role


Problem you’ll help solve:

  • Testing and making sure millions of members see our Live-specific UI features and capabilities at the right moment, on every TV and phone.
  • Giving every platform the same test plan, so TV, iOS, and Android are consistently validated the same way.
  • Making tests reliable enough that PMs, designers, engineers, and our partners trust them, and fast enough to run on every change.
  • Keeping quality steady while the iOS and Android apps modernize, including a cross-platform player rewrite, so faster delivery doesn’t come with more regressions.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead testing for complex features across platforms.Agree on one test plan per feature that teams can trust and validate together, and implement it on TV, iOS, and Android, rather than reconciling differences afterward.
  • Build automation that people trust.Evolve our test systems and CI integration across platforms so tests are fast and reliable.
  • Make tricky live moments easy to test. Build ways to recreate them on demand instead of waiting for a real event, using mocks, overrides, real devices, and test data that looks like a real event and doesn’t expire.
  • Make large migrations safe.Build the test strategy that lets the iOS and Android apps modernize without regressions reaching members
  • Own quality metrics.Track how well we’re covered, how reliable our tests are, and which bugs reach members, and use that to decide what to improve next. That includes the client metrics that reveal problems only scale shows, and the alerts that tell us about them quickly.
  • Make sure bugs only surprise us once.When a bug reaches members, make sure it comes back as a test, using agents to turn each finding into several, and document how to test each feature so the knowledge doesn’t live in one person’s head.
  • Build and leverage AI tools.Act as a force multiplier to flag unwanted behaviors before they reach members, and apply agents to test authoring, failure triage, and bug analysis.
  • Shape testability from the first commit.Partner with engineers on architecture and code that are easy to test, and help them write better tests themselves.
  • Test where teams meet.Agree with partner teams on the contracts between our features and theirs, so end-to-end tests verify where teams meet and rehearse what members experience, rather than retesting every team’s systems.
  • Collaborate beyond the team.Work with partner teams on shared test data, environments, and tools, and with teams that run live events to ensure features are ready before showtime and can be safely switched off if needed.
  • Mentor and grow others,including engineers and SDETs, by reviewing test plans and test code, sharing practices, and making quality everyone’s job.

What we’re looking for:

  • 8+ years of professional experience in software testing and test automation, with a strong record of leading testing for large, cross-team features or projects.
  • Comfort working across platforms. You’ve tested consumer apps on more than one platform, and you’re eager to learn the platforms you haven’t used yet.
  • Strong coding skills, with experience designing and building test frameworks and tools, not just writing test cases.
  • Experience or strong interest in using AI for testing, such as writing tests, triaging failures, or finding gaps in coverage, with clear ways to check its results.
  • Deep experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and diagnosing flaky tests, infrastructure failures, and dependency issues.
  • Experience with mocking, test data, or other ways to make hard-to-reproduce situations repeatable in tests.
  • A practical, risk-based approach to quality: knowing where to invest in tests, which risks are acceptable, and when more testing isn’t the answer.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including explaining quality risks and trade-offs to engineers, product managers, and partners in terms they can act on.
  • Alignment with Netflix's culture and values.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with live streaming, video playback, ads, or other systems where split-second timing matters.
  • Hands-on experience with testing frameworks on several platforms, such as Jest, Puppeteer, Espresso, or XCUITest.
  • Experience driving shared testing infrastructure or quality strategies adopted by multiple teams.
  • Experience testing how systems behave when things go wrong, such as chaos testing or failure drills.

Growth opportunities: We’re hiring a senior engineer, and we see this role growing into one that sets the standard for how Netflix tests its Live experiences and mobile apps at scale. Over time, you can:

  • Lead testing strategy across teams, creating the practices and tools that other teams adopt.
  • Shape client architecture for testability across platforms.
  • Influence partner teams' tooling and roadmaps, so our experiences are easy to test for everyone.
  • Mentor and grow engineers and SDETs across the organization.
Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $266,000.00 - $442,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location.

Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.

Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here.

Inclusionis a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

  • Have good organizational, collaborative, and time-management skills, and be able to work effectively in a multi-tasking and cross-team environment.
  • Have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, and be able to communicate clearly and effectively with people from different departments and levels.
