job.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
job.description:
About MariaDB

MariaDB is making a big impact on the world. Whether you’re checking your bank account, buying a coffee, shopping online, making a phone call, listening to music, taking out a loan or ordering takeout – MariaDB is the backbone of applications used everyday. Companies small and large, including 75% of the Fortune 500, run MariaDB, touching the lives of billions of people. With massive reach through Linux distributions, enterprise deployments and public clouds, MariaDB is uniquely positioned as the leading database for modern application development. MariaDB now includes GridGain, a leader in in-memory computing, extending MariaDB to handle the extreme-velocity data requirements of autonomous AI agents.

The Role

We’re looking for an experienced Senior QA Automation Engineer / SDET to join the GridGain Core QA Team and help drive the quality, reliability, and performance of our distributed database platform.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated tests and support frameworks for functional and performance testing;
  • Participate in release testing activities and contribute to improving the release validation process;
  • Validate new product features, bug fixes, and performance improvements;
  • Investigate complex issues involving distributed transactions, replication, networking, storage, and cluster management;
  • Design and implement automation solutions to reduce manual effort and improve team productivity.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in software quality assurance and test automation, or software engineering.
  • Strong Java programming skills and knowledge of the Java ecosystem;
  • Experience designing, developing, and maintaining automated tests and frameworks.
  • Experience testing distributed or backend systems;
  • Solid understanding of at least three of:
    • Multithreading;
    • Concurrency;
    • Networking;
    • Distributed systems concepts;
    • Transactions;
    • Consistency models.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with NoSQL and/or distributed databases, especially Apache Ignite or GridGain;
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes;
  • Experience with MariaDB or other relational databases;
  • Experience with modern AI tools and applying them to improve engineering productivity;
  • Experience with performance testing, profiling, and troubleshooting complex systems

Location

Hybrid / Remote – Bulgaria

Remote – Croatia, Estonia, Finland, Italy, Poland, Romania, Serbia, Spain.

Compensation

Salary Range: 59,500 – 80,500 EUR per year (gross)
Please note: The starting salary offered will be commensurate with the candidate's skills, qualifications, and relevant experience, in alignment with our gender-neutral compensation framework.

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • A globally distributed team where your is tangible, valuable and appreciated.
  • Remote or Hybrid work options (location dependent)
  • Projects that stretch your skills and make an impact at scale.
  • Competitive pay, 25 days paid annual leave (plus holidays), and a culture that values creativity and clean engineering.

How to Apply

If you are interested in this position, please submit your application along with your CV/Resume through our ATS Greenhouse on our MariaDB Careers site.

  • At MariaDB we celebrate the diverse experiences and perspectives of our employees because this drives innovation and success. MariaDB is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to creating a welcoming and inclusive workplace for everyone.
  • MariaDB does not sponsor work visas or relocation.
  • MariaDB is committed to providing accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  • MariaDB will not accept agency resumes without a prior contractual agreement with HR. Please do not forward resumes to any recruiting alias or employee directly. MariaDB is not responsible for paying any fees associated with any unsolicited submitted CV/Resumes.

job.title: Director, Quality Engineering
job.description:
HHAeXchange is the leading technology platform for home and community-based care. Founded in 2008, HHAeXchange was born out of an idea to create a fully comprehensive end-to-end homecare solution to help people who are aging or have disabilities thrive in their homes and communities. Our employees are passionate about transforming the healthcare space by building the only homecare ecosystem that fully connects patients, personal care providers, managed care organizations, and states.

The Director, Quality Engineering will lead the enterprise-wide quality strategy and Quality Assurance (QA) program across HHAeXchange. This role is responsible for standardizing testing processes and tools, driving test automation, and ensuring our products meet high standards for reliability, performance, security, and accessibility. The Director, Quality Engineering will oversee functional and non-functional testing practices, including accessibility (WCAG) and security-related validation, and will own processes that support customer User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential job duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

This is a fully remote opportunity for candidates located in the EST or CST time zones within the US only.

Essential Job Duties

  • Enterprise Quality Leadership: Develop, implement, and lead the overall quality strategy and QA operating model across the organization.
  • Standardize Testing Processes: Define and enforce consistent testing approaches including test planning, test cases, regression strategy, and release readiness criteria.
  • Tooling Ownership: Select, implement, and manage enterprise testing tools for test management, automation, performance, accessibility, and security validation.
  • Automation Strategy: Drive increased automated test coverage across UI, API, mobile, and services, reducing reliance on manual regression testing.
  • Compliance, Accessibility & VPAT Reporting:
  • Lead accessibility testing programs aligned to WCAG 2.1+
  • Oversee creation and maintenance of Voluntary Product Accessibility Templates (VPATs) and Accessibility Conformance Reports
  • Partner with Product, Legal, and Compliance to respond to customer accessibility requirements and audits
  • Security & Compliance Testing Support: Coordinate with Security teams on SAST/DAST, vulnerability validation, and remediation tracking.
  • Customer UAT Support:
  • Define and support customer UAT strategies and environments
  • Provide test plans, data guidance, and defect triage support during customer acceptance testing cycles
  • Ensure feedback from UAT informs release decisions and product quality improvements
  • Quality Metrics & Reporting: Establish KPIs to measure product quality, defect escape rate, automation coverage, UAT outcomes, and release readiness; communicate results to leadership.
  • Shift-Left Quality Practices: Embed quality earlier in the development lifecycle through collaboration on requirements, acceptance criteria, and CI/CD integration.
  • Incident & Defect Management: Oversee defect triage for high-priority production and pre-production issues and ensure timely resolution and root-cause prevention.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Product Management, Engineering, DevOps, Security, and Compliance to ensure alignment of quality practices across releases.
  • Organizational Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of QA engineers, SDETs, automation engineers, and accessibility/compliance testers.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify quality gaps and drive process improvements that improve product reliability, reduce rework, and increase delivery confidence.
  • Release Governance: Participate in release readiness reviews and serve as a key stakeholder in go/no-go decisions.
  • Coding agent advocacy: Help onboard team members to AI development tools. Share techniques, prompt patterns, and review practices that make AI-augmented development effective and safe in a regulated environment.

Other Job Duties

  • Other duties as assigned by supervisor or HHAeXchange leader.

Travel Requirements

  • Travel up to 10%, including overnight travel

Required Education, Experience, Certifications and Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field required.
  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering within a software product company, with a focus on developing scalable, high-performance systems.
  • 4+ years leading QA organizations or enterprise quality programs.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing standardized QA processes and test automation strategies in SaaS environments.
  • Hands-on experience implementing automated testing frameworks integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with accessibility testing and standards such as WCAG 2.1+ and authoring VPATs/ACRs.
  • Experience supporting security testing practices such as vulnerability scanning, SAST/DAST, and penetration test remediation validation.
  • Experience supporting or running customer UAT processes.
  • Strong understanding of quality metrics (defect rates, coverage, MTTR, escape rate, etc.) and how to operationalize them.
  • Background working in cloud-based architectures and microservices environments.
  • Demonstrated success collaborating across engineering, product, and security teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong leadership skills with experience managing and developing QA and automation teams.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex topics to technical and non-technical partners.
  • AI/ML fundamentals: Familiarity with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and how generative AI can be applied in a product context. Direct project experience preferred.
The base salary range for this US-based, full-time, and exempt position is $175,000-195,000/yr, not including variable compensation. An employee’s exact starting salary will be based on various factors including but not limited to experience, education, training, merit, location, and the ability to exemplify the HHAeXchange core values.
This is a benefits-eligible position. HHAeXchange offers competitive health plans, paid time-off, company paid holidays, 401K retirement program with a Company elected match, including other company sponsored programs.
HHAeXchange is an equal-opportunity employer. The Company offers employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, citizenship, genetic information, hairstyles, or any other status protected by local or federal law.

job.title: Senior iOS Automation Engineer, Quality Engineering
job.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The Quality Engineering team helps Airbnb build high-quality software efficiently. We enable Airbnb engineers to build highly testable systems by building and using tools leveraging AI. We own and continuously improve product test cases, automation coverage, test automation tools, environments, frameworks. We navigate Airbnb's massive codebase identifying weak spots, and help design and implement testable fault-tolerant systems.

The Difference You Will Make:

  • Be a leader in Airbnb, leveraging AI to redefine and accelerate Quality Engineering.
  • As a Senior Mobile Software Engineer, you will help us meet this challenge by building and evolving comprehensive automation coverage for features and releases across both native mobile stacks. You will work directly with the iOS and Android product engineering teams to develop and maintain our test tools, write and test product code, participate in design reviews to architect testable systems, and guide designs and code to enhance modularity and testability.
  • You are eager to understand complex systems top to bottom and thrive working across technologies and codebases. In addition, you excel at working through ambiguity, concept validation, and implementing best-in-class solutions.
  • As a global company, our mission is to develop and maintain the necessary quality engineering processes that scale to meet the needs of both our external customers and internal teams. We strive to ensure that our product and support workflows deliver a seamless experience for guests, Hosts, and support agents.

A Typical Day:

  • Leverage AI and tooling to lead the implementation of a test automation strategy, covering the entire testing pyramid (unit, service, integration, and end-to-end testing) to verify feature functionality for customer use cases on iOS and Android.
  • Lead building, maintaining, and effective utilization of automated tests in Swift and Kotlin, collaborating closely with the mobile engineering teams to ensure robust test coverage for features and releases, and actively participating in the continuous improvement of testing processes.
  • Contribute to improving existing automation frameworks to support new functionalities and optimize quality and efficiency across both native codebases.
  • Collaborate with CI/CD team to integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines, ensuring thorough test coverage at every stage of development and reducing build and feedback latency for both platforms.
  • Own the health and signal quality of the mobile automation suite, reducing flakiness, improving execution time and debuggability, and defining the metrics that show whether quality is improving.
  • Demonstrate excellent troubleshooting abilities, isolate issues, and verify bug fixes. Debug issues found during testing and after release, including device and emulator specific failures.
  • Be a player of our high-performance team to ensure code quality, commitment to craft and operational excellence
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product management, development, and other QE teams, in a fast-paced environment with short release cycles.

Your Expertise:

  • 5+ years of industry experience in software engineering and testing
  • Strong hands-on experience in one native mobile stack (Kotlin/Android SDK or Swift/iOS SDK) and working knowledge of the other, with experience using modern build tools (Gradle, Xcode)
  • Strong knowledge of test automation methodologies, tools, and frameworks
  • Strong hands-on experience with mobile automation frameworks (e.g., Espresso, Compose Test, XCUITest)
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Buildkite, Spinnaker, Jenkins, Fastlane) and version control systems (Git)
  • Experience using quality signals such as coverage, flaky test rate, suite execution time, and escaped defects to prioritize work and demonstrate impact.
  • Excellent communication skills towards facilitating interactions with cross-functional teams
  • Expertise developing solutions to ambiguous problems, and integrations across multiple teams with significant impact
  • Curiosity about applying AI/LLMs to testing and developer productivity.
  • Comfortable collaborating in English.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science/engineering or equivalent

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: . Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ or @ email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

job.title: QA Architect - Agentic Test Orchestration(H/F)
job.description:
Dans le cadre de notre croissance et afin de renforcer notre Squad Quality & Test Engineering, nous recherchons un(e) QA Architect - Agentic Test Orchestration spécialisé(e) dans les approches de test augmentées par l'IA, pour accompagner un acteur majeur dans la sécurisation et la modernisation de ses plateformes applicatives.

Vous évoluerez au sein d'une product team Agile, dans une démarche où la stratégie de test ne repose plus sur l'écriture manuelle, mais sur l'orchestration d'agents et d'outils d'IA capables de générer une couverture de test à grande échelle.

MISSIONS:

Au sein d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire, en lien étroit avec les référents techniques et la coordination Agile, vous serez amené(e) à :

  • Définir la stratégie et l'architecture de test sur l'ensemble des niveaux (unitaire, API, bout-en-bout) et structurer leur intégration dans une démarche pilotée par les tests (TDD) ;

  • Mettre en place un cadre de génération assistée par IA : référentiels de configuration, patrons de prompts et contextes de code permettant à des modèles et agents autonomes de produire un code de test rigoureux, standardisé et aligné sur le métier ;

  • Déployer une couverture de test à grande échelle sur l'existant afin de cartographier et sécuriser les règles métiers avant toute évolution ou migration technique ;

  • Contribuer à la mise en place et à l'enrichissement des chaînes d'intégration et de déploiement continus, en y intégrant le déclenchement automatisé des suites de tests et les contrôles qualité ;

  • Documenter et diffuser les bonnes pratiques d'ingénierie de prompt appliquées au test, et accompagner la montée en compétence de l'équipe sur la culture « Test-first » assistée par IA ;

  • Participer aux revues de code et à la validation critique des livrables générés.

PROFIL:

Vous justifiez d'une solide expérience en QA / test automation et savez cadrer une IA pour produire un code de test pertinent - un bon test généré ne l'est que s'il est guidé par de solides patterns d'architecture.

Compétences requises

  • Bonne maîtrise d'au moins un écosystème back moderne (.NET, Java ou équivalent) et d'un framework front SPA (Angular, React ou équivalent), pour relire et valider de manière critique le code produit par l'IA ;

  • Usage avancé d'outils de génération de tests par IA et d'IDE augmentés (type GitHub Copilot, Claude Code…) ;

  • Capacité éprouvée à contextualiser des bases de code complexes pour faire générer des scénarios de test pertinents à une IA ;

  • Esprit Software Craftsmanship : TDD, Clean Code, principe de responsabilité unique (SRP) ;

  • Maîtrise des chaînes CI/CD et de l'industrialisation logicielle ;

  • Expérience significative des environnements Agile (Scrum / Kanban).

SOFT SKILLS:

  • Passionné(e) par l'IA appliquée à l'ingénierie logicielle ;

  • Forte capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes ;

  • Esprit collaboratif et goût du travail en équipe ;

  • Excellentes capacités de communication et de documentation ;

  • Autonomie, rigueur et force de proposition ;

  • Sens de la qualité et de la non-régression.

AVANTAGE / CONTEXTE :

Entreprise de nouvelle génération à taille humaine, DHM IT s’engage fortement dans la mouvance RSE en proposant à ses consultants et salariés un cadre de travail sain où chacun pourra s’épanouir, se former et progresser à son rythme et selon ses aspirations.

  • Rémunération attractive;

  • Un fort esprit de Startup nouvelle génération;

  • Participation dans notre stratégie RSE;

  • Carte resto, Titre de transport, Mutuelle et prévoyance;

  • Team buildings, Events, Sport Collectif;

  • Travail remote friendly;

  • Un environnement de travail 100% Agile / Cloud;

  • Des challenges, des nouvelles expériences et des projets innovants;

  • Une hiérarchie Smart.

  • Assist management team with scheduling and coordinating depositions
  • Other duties & special projects, as assigned and based on business needs.
  • Training QA team
  • Implement proper workflow to grow client experience.
  • Have Monthly performance reviews with your direct reports.

    • Reviewing received reports for accuracy

Other duties & special projects, as assigned and based on business needs.

First 30 days

  • Build relationships with QA staff, physicians, Account Managers, and leadership.
  • Review existing quality standards, performance expectations, and reporting processes.
  • Identify workflow challenges and opportunities for improvement.

First 31-60 days

  • Perform daily quality audits on team members while delivering targeted guidance and training as needed.
  • Track turnaround time metrics, review precision, and outstanding medical review files.
  • Guarantee strict compliance with client specifications and facilitate punctual report distribution.
  • Remediate staff performance gaps and support resolution of complex operational and customer challenges.
  • Hold monthly performance reviews with assigned team members.

First 61-90 day

  • Ensure consistent quality, productivity, and turnaround time expectations are met.
  • Identify and implement workflow improvements to enhance efficiency and client experience.
  • Strengthen staff accountability through ongoing coaching and performance management.
  • Monitor team performance and provide regular updates to management.
  • Identify opportunities to improve quality, communication, and overall service delivery.

About the Role

Reporting to the Director of R&D Quality Assurance, the Associate Director of R&D Quality Assurance is responsible for GMP quality oversight of outsourced development, manufacturing, testing, packaging, and distribution of pre-commercial drug substances and drug products. The role partners with Pharmaceutical Sciences, Program Management, and Supply Chain to support product quality decisions, supplier oversight, and readiness for commercialization.

Let’s talk about some of the key responsibilities of the role:

Quality Assurance Responsibilities

  • Represent QA on project teams, partnering with Pharmaceutical Sciences, Program Management, and Supply Chain to prioritize QA deliverables, meet development milestones, and escalate significant quality risks
  • Participate in supplier meetings to communicate quality expectations, resolve product quality issues, and track commitments
  • Review and approve internal and supplier GMP change controls, including changes to manufacturing records, specifications, and analytical methods
  • Review and approve master manufacturing and packaging/labeling records and analytical method validation protocols and reports
  • Review and approve drug substance, drug product, and label specifications
  • Review and approve manufacturing deviations, laboratory out-of-specification (OOS) investigations, and product complaint investigations; assess root cause and product impact, approve corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and assess CAPA effectiveness
  • Review and approve test records and certificates of analysis
  • Review executed manufacturing and packaging/labeling batch records and complete batch record review documentation
  • Provide QA oversight of stability programs, including review and approval of protocols and interim and final stability reports. assess proposed changes to shelf life or storage conditions based on available data
  • Complete product disposition documentation and issue certificates of compliance within delegated QA authority
  • Author, revise, and approve QA procedures and assigned quality records in the electronic quality management system (eQMS)
  • Review and approve applicable Pharmaceutical Sciences SOPs

Vendor Management Responsibilities

  • Review supplier audit reports, including reports prepared by third-party auditors, and follow up on assigned commitments
  • Support supplier qualification, supplier audits, and Health Authority inspections, as needed

job.description:

The client is a leading company specializing in advanced cybersecurity solutions. They provide comprehensive security measures designed to protect sensitive data and systems from cyber threats. Their offerings include vulnerability management, threat intelligence, incident response, and compliance management. With cutting-edge technology and a team of experts, they ensure robust protection for organizations across various industries, helping clients stay ahead of evolving cyber threats and maintain a secure digital environment.

Role Overview

This is a hands-on role for a senior QA automation engineer who has already brought agentic workflows into a real QA team. You'll design and build AI agents that work alongside our QA engineers: turning Jira tickets into test cases, generating and maintaining Playwright and Selenium tests, exploring the application through MCP, and triaging failures in CI.

You'll partner with the QA Manager, developers, and product managers across engineering teams. You'll set the patterns, guardrails, and metrics that decide where agents are trusted, where they need to review, and how we prove they're actually improving quality.

What You'll Do

Agentic QA Workflows

  • Design, build, and run AI agents that cover the QA lifecycle: requirement and ticket analysis, test case design, test generation, execution, and failure triage
  • Build multi-agent pipelines that take a Jira ticket through to reviewed test cases and automated tests merged into CI
  • Use Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, such as Playwright MCP, for agent-driven browser interaction, exploratory testing, and self-healing locators
  • Build and maintain the prompts, tools, context, and skills our agents rely on, and version them like any other code
  • Define human-in-the-loop checkpoints so agent output is reviewed where it matters and trusted where it has earned it

Automation & Frameworks

  • Extend our automation frameworks in Selenium and Playwright, and help drive our Playwright migration with agents doing the heavy lifting
  • Use agents to convert manual regression cases to automation, keeping coverage growing without overloading the QA team
  • Write clean, reviewable test code in Java, Python, and TypeScript, following patterns such as the Page Object Model
  • Integrate agent-generated and agent-maintained tests into CI/CD pipelines with parallel execution and clear reporting

Quality & Reliability of the Agents Themselves

  • Build evaluation sets and metrics for agent output: test case accuracy, false positive rate, flake rate, and time saved per release
  • Experience testing MCP servers or AI agent tools, including tool responses, data accuracy, auth and permissions, error handling, and behavior when called by real AI agents
  • Detect and reduce hallucinated assertions, brittle generated tests, and low-value coverage
  • Investigate failures to root cause, telling product defects apart from test instability, environment issues, and agent mistakes
  • Apply security-minded practices to agent tooling, including secrets handling, data access limits, and prompt injection risk

Collaboration & Enablement

  • Partner with the QA Manager, developers, and product managers to decide where agents add the most value in our weekly release cycle
  • Teach QA engineers to work with agents day to day through pairing, documentation, and reusable templates
  • Share results, trade-offs, and lessons learned with engineering leadership in plain terms

Requirements

  • 8+ years in software quality assurance, with at least 5 years in test automation
  • 1+ years of hands-on experience bringing agentic AI into a QA team's real workflow, not just personal use of a coding assistant
  • Built at least one agent or multi-agent workflow that generates, runs, or triages tests in a production QA process, and can explain how its output was measured
  • Hands-on experience with MCP servers (Playwright MCP or similar) and with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot
  • Strong programming skills in Java, Python, and TypeScript, with clean, maintainable, reviewable test code
  • Deep hands-on experience building and maintaining automation frameworks in Playwright and Selenium WebDriver, and design patterns such as the Page Object Model
  • Strong manual and exploratory testing skills, with the judgment to know when a human check beats an automated one
  • Solid API testing experience and working SQL skills for validating data behind the UI
  • Experience running automation reliably in CI/CD pipelines and with Git
  • Sound judgment about where AI output needs human validation, and the ability to explain that trade-off to engineers and leadership
  • Strong debugging skills, with a track record of driving complex or intermittent failures to root cause

Preferred Experience

job.title: Mobile Product Tester (PCS961)
job.description:
We're looking for a Mobile Product Tester to run the testing loop for every build of a fast-growing mobile app that uses AI to identify and value vintage clothing. You will test each new build on iPhone and Android before it reaches users, report bugs clearly enough that they get fixed without a follow-up question, and check every fix on the next build.

This is not a technical role. No coding or technical background is needed. What matters is a sharp eye for detail and relentless follow-through. Today the Head of Operations does all of the hands-on product testing. You take over that whole loop and run it day to day, and they manage you. You will work directly in Slack with engineers, including AI coding agents. You send a detailed bug report, they fix it and ship a new build, and you check the fix. New builds come out several times a week, and each one gets tested by you. If a few pixels out of line bother you and you re-test things until they are actually right, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability during US business hours, with enough overlap to test builds as they ship
  • Work directly with the engineering team and the Head of Operations, with no layers in between
  • Get early access to new features before users see them, on a product with fast-growing adoption

What You'll Work On

Build Testing

  • Test every new build on iPhone and Android before it reaches users, with guidance on how to install builds
  • Re-check every fix on the next build and call out anything marked fixed that still is not
  • Follow the direct testing instructions that engineers and AI coding agents give you

Bug Reporting

  • Report each bug in Slack clearly enough to fix without a follow-up question: what you did, what you expected, what happened, plus a screen recording
  • Keep reports short, specific, and reproducible

Design and Feel

  • Compare screens closely to the approved designs, including spacing, alignment, text, colors, and how each button looks after a tap
  • Test how the app feels, including swipes, drag-to-close sheets, scrolling, animations, and load times
  • Notice what makes an app feel smooth or off, and describe it in a way the team can act on

Flows and Edge Cases

  • Test signed-in flows such as following, comments, posting, and saved searches
  • Test the odd cases, such as empty screens or the keyboard covering a field

Tracking and Follow-Through

  • Keep the open bug list moving and chase items that get stuck
  • Flag issues that keep coming back so the team can fix the cause

Requirements

What You Bring

  • An obsessive eye for detail: a few pixels out of line, a white flash between screens, or a swipe that only works from the edge of the screen bothers you
  • Clear, concise written English: you can describe a bug in three lines that anyone can reproduce
  • Follow-through: you re-test the same flow many times, track many open items at once, and chase what is stuck
  • An iPhone and an Android phone you are happy to test on, or comfort using phones we provide
  • Comfort working in Slack and recording your phone's screen
  • Heavy use of apps and a good sense of when one feels smooth and when it does not
  • Available to work full-time during US business hours

Nice to Have

  • Any QA, beta testing, or app review experience, paid or not
  • Familiarity with Figma, enough to open a design and compare it to a screen
  • Interest in fashion, vintage, or streetwear, or resale experience, so you notice when an identification or a value looks off

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself and showing your phone screen with something in an app you use that feels off. Describe it the way you would in a bug report: what you did, what you expected, and what happened

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you notice the small things most people miss and you follow every issue through to a real fix, this role gives you the ownership and the direct impact to do your best work.

Benefits

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record a video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

job.title: Business Process & Quality Assurance Lead
job.description:
Role Purpose

Lead cross-functional requirements validation, fit-to-standard process design, traceability and business acceptance across the Oracle Fusion programme, while providing independent delivery-quality assurance over design packs, configuration evidence, test readiness and phase exit criteria. The role is a governance and quality lead, not the primary hands-on test execution resource.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan and facilitate AS-IS discovery, Oracle show-and-tell, CRP1/fit-to-standard and CRP2/TO-BE workshops across business workstreams.
  • Drive configuration-first decisions and challenge unnecessary customisation or extensions in line with the programme fit-to-standard approach.
  • Own the cross-functional requirements traceability model and ensure approved requirements, design decisions, configuration, testing and business acceptance remain traceable end to end.
  • Coordinate the RD.011 / TO-BE solution-design pack and RTM content with functional leads; ensure decisions, assumptions, gaps, owners and acceptance criteria are explicit.
  • Review workstream design and configuration deliverables for completeness, internal consistency, cross-module impacts and adherence to agreed templates and governance standards.
  • Establish practical quality gates for Discovery Acceptance, Solution Design Sign-off, Build Complete/SIT Entry, UAT Sign-off and Go-Live Readiness.
  • Work with the QA/Test Lead to confirm TE.040 test coverage, scenario completeness, defect thresholds and evidence quality; support TE.130 business acceptance without replacing test execution ownership.
  • Identify cross-workstream dependencies involving Finance, Procurement, Contracts, CRM, HCM, Projects, GRC, data, security, reporting and integrations; escalate unresolved design conflicts.
  • Ensure business process designs incorporate Delegation of Authority, segregation-of-duties considerations, auditability, data ownership and bilingual business requirements where applicable.
  • Support Design Authority reviews and maintain decision/action closure discipline so critical design issues do not flow into build or test.

Drive business-owner readiness for formal sign-off and ensure approvals are evidence-based rather than meeting-driven.

Requirements

Experience & Qualifications

  • 10+ years in enterprise process transformation, Oracle ERP/Fusion business analysis, quality governance or solution delivery roles preferred.
  • At least 3 end-to-end Oracle Cloud/Fusion implementations strongly preferred, including discovery, design, build, SIT/UAT and go-live.
  • Demonstrable experience owning process design, requirements traceability and cross-functional acceptance in complex multi-module programmes.
  • Strong experience reviewing functional designs, configuration evidence, test packs and readiness gates; experience in public/semi-government or regulated UAE/GCC environments is advantageous.
  • Bachelor degree in Business, Information Systems, Engineering or related discipline; relevant Oracle/quality/process certifications are advantageous but not a substitute for implementation experience.

Key Delivery Outputs / Accountabilities

  • Approved workshop approach, decision logs and cross-functional process inventory.
  • RD.011 / TO-BE Solution Design Pack coordination and controlled RTM baseline.
  • Cross-workstream dependency and design-quality reviews.
  • Quality-gate checklists and evidence for Discovery, Design, SIT Entry, UAT and Go-Live readiness.
  • Documented design/quality findings with owners, due dates and closure evidence.
  • Business acceptance readiness and sign-off support.

Candidate Success Profile

A strong candidate combines consulting-grade process facilitation with disciplined QA governance. They should be able to challenge both business and delivery teams, keep the programme aligned to standard Oracle capability, detect cross-functional gaps early, and prevent incomplete or contradictory designs from reaching build and testing.

job.title: Senior Embedded Systems Validation & QA Lead
job.description:
Senior Embedded Systems Validation & QA Lead

This isn't a role where you simply execute someone else's test plan. You'll help define what ready to release means for an embedded platform.

Before You Apply

This is a remote, full-time employment opportunity.

We are not considering B2B, freelance, independent-contractor, or consulting arrangements for this position.

We are looking for an experienced validation professional who understands embedded systems and operating-system platforms. This is not a traditional manual QA or application-testing role.

About L4B Software

About L4B Software

L4B Software is an embedded software and platform-engineering company headquartered in Munich, Germany, with an engineering presence in Pune, India.

We design, customize, integrate, secure, and maintain operating-system platforms based on technologies such as Embedded Linux and Android/AOSP, tailored to the specific hardware, product requirements, security needs, and lifecycle expectations of our customers.

Our engineering capabilities span:

Customized Embedded Linux | Android/AOSP | BSP & Platform Integration | Cybersecurity | DevOps | System Validation

Our work supports demanding and long-lifecycle products across medical technology, automotive, industrial systems, and other embedded environments where reliability, security, maintainability, and long-term support matter.

Our engineers work deep within the platform — from BSP and hardware integration through OS customization, platform security, system services, build and deployment infrastructure, and validation.

The result isn't simply software running on an operating system.

The customized operating-system platform itself is part of what we engineer and deliver

That's where this role comes in.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Embedded Systems Validation & QA Lead to own and evolve the verification and validation strategy for L4B's Android/AOSP and Embedded Linux operating-system platforms.

This is not a traditional manual QA role.

You won't simply receive a finished product and execute predefined test cases.

You will help define:

What needs to be validated.

How it should be validated.

What should be automated.

What requires physical hardware.
What evidence must exist.
And when a platform is genuinely ready for release.

You will work closely with Android/AOSP, Embedded Linux, BSP, DevOps, cybersecurity, and other engineering teams to build validation into the platform-development lifecycle.

This role combines technical validation, test architecture, automation strategy, engineering judgement, quality ownership, and technical leadership.

What You'll Own

Validation Strategy

  • Define verification and validation strategies for Embedded Linux and Android/AOSP platforms.
  • Translate technical and product requirements into structured platform-level test strategies and test plans.
  • Establish requirements-to-test traceability.
  • Define meaningful test coverage and identify validation gaps.
  • Build regression strategies that evolve with the platform and product.

Release Confidence

  • Define measurable release-readiness criteria and quality gates.
  • Review validation results and assess release risks.
  • Establish the evidence required before platform releases.
  • Ensure critical defects, known limitations, residual risks, and validation gaps are visible before release decisions.
  • Provide clear, evidence-based recommendations on platform readiness.

Automation & CI/CD

  • Determine which validation should run automatically within CI/CD and which requires physical devices or dedicated lab environments.
  • Guide and contribute to test automation using Python and appropriate test frameworks.
  • Integrate automated validation into engineering workflows.
  • Build reusable validation frameworks rather than one-off test scripts.
  • Improve repeatability, test efficiency, and early defect detection.

Android, Linux & Hardware Validation

  • Support Android CTS, VTS, and platform-specific validation.
  • Coordinate Embedded Linux and BSP validation.
  • Coordinate functional, integration, regression, security, and hardware-dependent testing.
  • Support validation across operating-system, BSP, hardware, networking, security, and system boundaries.
  • Help investigate complex issues where the visible failure may originate in another layer of the platform.

Quality Engineering

  • Establish structured defect-management and technical-triage processes.
  • Improve traceability between requirements, tests, defects, fixes, and validation evidence.
  • Define and monitor meaningful test coverage.
  • Produce clear technical validation reports and release evidence.
  • Continuously improve L4B's validation methodology, tooling, and engineering practices.
  • Drive reusable validation approaches across projects and platforms.

Technical Leadership

  • Mentor engineers involved in verification and validation activities.
  • Challenge weak test assumptions and incomplete coverage.
  • Coordinate validation across multiple engineering disciplines.
  • Work with engineering teams to ensure validation is considered during development — not only at the end.
  • Help build a culture of quality ownership across engineering rather than quality being solely the responsibility of QA.

What You Bring

We're looking for someone who understands that validating a complex embedded platform is fundamentally different from testing a web or mobile application.

You should bring:

  • Strong professional experience validating embedded systems, operating systems, firmware-connected products, or complex software platforms.
  • Experience designing verification strategies and comprehensive test plans.
  • Strong understanding of integration, system, and regression testing.
  • Experience building, implementing, or guiding automated testing.
  • Strong Python and/or scripting capability.
  • Experience integrating validation into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong defect investigation and root-cause-analysis skills.
  • Experience establishing and maintaining test evidence and requirements traceability.
  • Ability to understand and investigate failures spanning multiple technical layers.
  • Experience coordinating validation across different engineering disciplines.
  • Strong technical judgement and communication skills.
  • Ability to assess platform readiness based on coverage, evidence, defects, and risk rather than simply test-pass percentages.

Most importantly, you should be comfortable moving beyond:

Did the test pass?

to:

Have we tested the right thing, under the right conditions, with enough evidence to trust this release?

Experience We'd Especially Value

You don't need to tick every box. Relevant depth in several of these areas would make your profile particularly interesting:

  • Embedded Linux
  • Android/AOSP platform validation
  • Android CTS and VTS
  • BSP and platform validation
  • Python
  • PyTest
  • Robot Framework
  • Jenkins or similar CI/CD platforms
  • Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing
  • Physical device and hardware-lab environments
  • Jira, Xray, or equivalent test-management tooling
  • Automotive SPICE
  • ISO 26262 environments
  • IEC 62304 / medical-device software environments
  • Cybersecurity and security validation
  • Requirements traceability
  • Long-lifecycle embedded products

This Role May Be for You If...

You see a green CI pipeline and still ask:

What haven't we tested?

You know that some failures only appear on physical hardware.

You understand that hundreds of test cases mean little if they don't trace back to meaningful requirements, interfaces, risks, and expected behaviour.

You can work with Android, Linux, BSP, DevOps, cybersecurity, and hardware engineers and understand enough across those disciplines to build an effective validation strategy.

When a defect appears at one layer, you're willing to investigate whether the actual cause sits somewhere else in the system.

And when someone asks:

Can we release?

You don't answer based on instinct.

You answer based on coverage, evidence, defects, risk, and engineering judgement.

What This Role Is Not

This is not a conventional manual QA position focused primarily on executing predefined test cases.

It is also not primarily:

  • Web application testing
  • Mobile application/UI testing
  • Manual functional testing
  • Test-case execution without platform ownership

We are looking for someone who can operate at the embedded system/platform level and influence how validation itself is designed.

What Success Looks Like

Your impact should make three questions easy to answer for every L4B platform release:

1. What have we tested?

The scope, requirements, environments, configurations, coverage, and limitations are clear.

2. What evidence do we have?

Results are traceable, repeatable, documented, and available for engineering and quality review.

3. Are we ready to release?

The decision is supported by clear quality gates, known risks, defect status, validation results, and objective evidence.

That's the capability we want this role to strengthen at L4B.

Why Join L4B?

This role offers something different from a conventional QA leadership position.

You'll work close to operating systems, hardware, cybersecurity, DevOps, and embedded product engineering rather than being separated from engineering at the end of the development lifecycle.

You'll have the opportunity to influence how validation is designed, not simply how tests are executed.

You'll work on technically demanding platforms where validation can involve real hardware, operating systems, BSPs, security, automation, CI/CD, and long-term product reliability.

And you'll have meaningful ownership in strengthening how L4B answers one of the most important questions in engineering:

Are we confident enough in this platform to release it?

Our Hiring Approach

We hire for capability, relevant experience, technical judgement, and demonstrated ownership.

You don't need to match every technology listed above.

If you have strong embedded or platform-validation experience, understand how to build validation systematically, and can work effectively across engineering disciplines, we'd like to hear from you.

Equivalent practical experience is welcome where a formal degree isn't essential to the work.

Remote | Full-Time Employment

Please note: We are not considering B2B, freelance, or independent-contractor arrangements for this position.

If you believe quality should be engineered into the platform — not inspected into it at the end — we'd like to talk.

Responsibilities

The Testing Strategy Manager (TSM) leads the development and execution of a comprehensive testing strategy for the Peraton CMS Fee‑for‑Service (FFS) healthcare program. This role focuses on advancing Agile testing practices, expanding test automation, and improving overall quality outcomes across three large, complex, mainframe‑based systems. The TSM collaborates closely with account leadership, delivery teams, and technical stakeholders to drive quality excellence, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Testing Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and implement a holistic testing strategy aligned with Agile/DevOps methodologies and prioritizing automation across all testing phases.
  • Create, maintain, and execute detailed test plans, test cases, and test schedules across hardware and software platforms.
  • Define and communicate requirements for test environments, test data, and test cycles, collaborating with Infrastructure/Data Center teams.
  • Ensure adequate testing coverage prior to production releases and support production checkout planning through risk identification and mitigation.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and coach a team of 10–15 technical and business analyst resources, including performance monitoring and annual evaluations.
  • Provide technical leadership to Testing Engineers and promote a culture of collaboration, growth, and quality-minded thinking.

Automation & Process Improvement

  • Develop and champion strategies for increasing automation across the program, including test data automation approaches.
  • Implement and refine processes and procedures that enhance efficiency, productivity, and reduce redundancy.
  • Assist in establishing and measuring quality metrics to support process adoption and continuous improvement.

Risk, Defect, and Quality Management

  • Identify and communicate risks related to testing strategies, ensuring clear visibility into business impacts.
  • Analyze defects to support triage, drive resolution, and determine technical and business impacts.
  • Support and participate in design reviews, requirement walk‑throughs, quality assessments, and post‑release reviews.
  • Administer the problem management process, monitoring and reporting on problem resolution activities.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Work with account and program leadership to align testing strategy with system roadmaps, transformation efforts, and software development priorities.
  • Collaborate with Release PMs, Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and Technical Leads on implementation planning and issue resolution.
  • Participate in requirements/user story reviews to ensure clarity, feasibility, and testability.

Strategic Insight & Recommendations

  • Provide recommendations on tools, technologies, and testing practices to improve efficiency and quality outcomes.
  • Help shape Quality Assurance policies, goals, and objectives in partnership with QA leadership.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • 10+ years of combined experience in software testing, automation, technical analysis, and business analysis.
  • 5+ years managing teams of 10+ resources.
  • Strong verbal and written communication and presentation skills.
  • CMS contract experience preferred.

Knowledge & Skills – Must have

  • Experience developing use cases, process flows, and related documentation.
  • Expertise in automated testing practices and tools, including TestRail, Open Text UFT, MS Scheduler, and WFTP Script Editor/Debugger.
  • Experience working in Agile environments and working with Confluence and Jira.
  • Strong relationship‑building abilities across QA, business, and technical teams.
  • Excellent analytical, diagnostic, and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities.
  • Knowledge of mainframe testing and Automated testing.
  • Demonstrated success implementing test automation within Agile/DevOps environments.
  • Ability to translate between business and technical concepts and work independently or within distributed teams.
  • Proven ability to exercise sound judgment and influence teams toward common goals.

Knowledge & Skills – Nice to have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Knowledge of testing within mid-tier and cloud environments desired.
  • Mid‑tier and cloud testing experience desired.
  • Knowledge of AI Testing tools and Methodologies desired.
  • Prior CMS or Federal Government contract experience desired.
  • Prior health insurance experience desired.

Target Salary Range

$104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. job.title: QA Manager, EPIC Loan Systems
job.description:
We are excited to speak to you about this opportunity. If you are interested in joining our growing team, please apply to this link directly.

Who we are

At Aquila, we invest in category-defining B2B/B2G software companies globally, acting as a thought-partner, striving for the success of our companies in the long term. We are a well-managed, profitable company that operates like a startup with the financial backing of a parent company. For our people, this means limitless possibilities.

We are unapologetically unique, pivoting to respond to the needs of the multiple markets we operate in. We have ambitious goals, and we are looking for genuine contributors with integrity, energy, flexibility, and loyalty. We are investing in building future leaders who can take an idea and make things happen.

About EPIC Loan Systems

EPIC Loan Systems is a specialized financial technology company providing lending software solutions to businesses in the lending industry. EPIC has been part of Aquila since 2018, providing specialized lending software that helps clients manage their operations, supported by a team committed to solving problems and building lasting relationships.

Its core product is a Loan Management System that helps lenders manage their end-to-end lending operations, from loan processing and administration to reporting and data management.

The company focuses on simplifying complex lending processes, improving operational efficiency, and building long-term relationships with its clients. As part of Aquila and the broader Constellation Software group, EPIC combines the agility of a specialized software business with the support and resources of an established global organization.

Who we need

Reporting to the Director of Engineering, we are hiring a QA Manager to transform our approach to software quality. In this newly created role, you will lead the shift from predominantly manual testing to sustainable automation, practical AI applications, and stronger quality practices throughout development and release. Combining technical expertise with leadership, you will work alongside an established QA team to strengthen its capabilities, improve test coverage, and build a more consistent and scalable approach to delivering reliable lending software.

This is a fully remote role open to candidates across Canada, with working hours of 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Eastern Time.

What’s in it for you

Ownership and influence. You will have the freedom to challenge existing approaches, evaluate new tools, and introduce practical applications of automation and AI. Working directly with engineering leadership in a lean organization, you will influence decisions, put your recommendations into practice, and see the results without navigating layers of approvals.

Lead and grow. You will have the opportunity to shape the future of QA, establish stronger standards, and develop the capabilities of an established team. You will influence how testing evolves while remaining directly involved in technical challenges and solutions. As the function matures, you will be well positioned to help guide its continued development.

Make an impact. At EPIC Loan Systems, your contributions will be visible, and your work will directly support the reliability of software our clients depend on to manage their lending operations. You will have the opportunity to make your mark within a smaller, collaborative business, with the backing of Aquila and Constellation Software and access to a broader network of software companies for continued learning and career growth.

As our new QA Manager, you will

  • Drive quality. You will contribute directly to functional, regression, integration, exploratory, and end-to-end testing, identifying risks and investigating defects before they affect clients. You will collaborate with Engineering and Product to strengthen test coverage, support QA and UAT deployments, and validate release readiness, improving confidence in the software we deliver.
  • Advance automation. You will lead the transition from predominantly manual testing to a more automated approach, evaluating tools, developing sustainable test frameworks, and integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines. You will explore practical applications of AI to improve test creation, coverage, and troubleshooting, helping the team work more effectively.
  • Lead and mentor a collaborative team. You will provide technical direction to an established, geographically distributed QA team, sharing knowledge, strengthening testing capabilities, and supporting automation adoption. You will encourage collaboration, consistent practices, and shared accountability for quality while contributing directly to technical problem-solving.
  • Improve how we work. You will establish consistent testing standards, strengthen defect management and release validation, and identify opportunities to improve QA processes. You will work across teams to identify issues earlier, reduce repetitive tasks, and make quality integral to software delivery.

You bring

  • The leadership experience. You have successfully led or provided technical direction to QA professionals, mentored colleagues, and improved team testing practices. You are comfortable setting priorities, sharing expertise, and supporting others while contributing directly to testing and technical problem-solving.
  • The testing expertise. You have a strong foundation in functional, regression, integration, exploratory, and end-to-end testing of complex software applications. You can develop effective test strategies, assess risks, investigate defects, and validate releases while balancing quality requirements with delivery priorities.
  • The automation skills. You have experience developing, implementing, and maintaining automated testing frameworks using tools such as Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress. You understand how to integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and can make informed decisions about where automation adds value and where manual testing remains important.
  • The technical skills. You have experience testing APIs, writing SQL queries to validate data, working with Azure DevOps, BitBucket, and using application logs to investigate issues. You can collaborate with developers to understand technical problems, identify root causes, and improve test coverage. Familiarity with AWS, performance testing, or lending and financial technology software would be an asset.
  • The drive to improve. You are motivated to strengthen testing practices and find practical ways to improve quality, consistency, and efficiency. You are curious about emerging technologies, including AI-assisted testing, and can evaluate their potential to deliver meaningful improvements. You take initiative and focus on building solutions the team can sustain.
  • The collaborative approach. You communicate clearly, share knowledge, and build productive relationships across Engineering, Product, and other teams. You can provide direction and support to colleagues working across different locations and time zones, helping everyone stay aligned on quality standards and shared priorities.
  • The flexibility. You can occasionally travel, up to 10% of the time. You understand the importance of being available to help when clients need additional support.

Why join?

EPIC Loan Systems and Aquila are part of Constellation Software Inc., one of Canada's largest and most successful software companies and its most successful technology stock over the last 10 years [TSE: CSU].

Our entrepreneurial culture, lean environment, and people come together to form a dynamic organization where purpose drives our growth. This is a place where high performance and hard work are rewarded, where leaders are grown, and where the best ideas win. With the autonomy to be creative and curious, we collaborate and iterate to achieve real impact in the communities we support.

We spend our days asking questions and challenging the status quo, manipulating our structure, roles, and internal operations in order to stay ahead in a competitive landscape.

If you share our growth mindset, relationship-focused approach, and high moral fibre, you will thrive at Aquila.

Compensation

At EPIC Loan Systems and Aquila, we believe compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of both experience and impact. The salary range for this role is $130,000–$150,000.

Compensation is determined based on skills, experience, and the scope and complexity of the role. We value open conversations about compensation and are happy to discuss our approach at any stage of the hiring process.

Apply now.

Diversity and inclusion are not mere words on paper to us. We welcome and appreciate candidates with a range of backgrounds and experiences. If you have most of the qualifications we are seeking, and want to play an integral role in our success, apply to express your interest.

What you can expect from our interview process:

  • A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor to discuss your interest in joining the company and in the role. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
  • An interview with the Director of Engineering to explore your experience in quality assurance, test automation, technical leadership, and approaches to improving testing practices.
  • A final interview with the General Manager to discuss your approach to collaboration, leadership, and contributing to the long-term success of EPIC Loan Systems.

Aquila and EPIC Loan Systems promote equal employment opportunities for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status, marital status or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities and accommodations are available on request.

job.title: Principal Quality Engineer
job.description:
Let’s Tango! Where Innovation Meets Impact.

At Tango Analytics, we're all about helping businesses make smarter decisions through powerful technology, insightful data, and a whole lot of collaboration. Whether you're a creative thinker, a strategic planner, a tech wizard, or a customer champion, there's a place for you on our team. We believe work should be meaningful and fun — so if you're ready to make a difference while enjoying the journey, come join us and let's Tango!

About the role

Tango is looking for a Principal Quality Engineer (E6) to define and drive our company-wide Quality Engineering strategy, architecture, and technical standards. As the most senior individual contributor in Quality Engineering, you will operate across products and engineering teams to shape how quality is designed, measured, and delivered throughout the software development lifecycle.

You'll translate Tango's long-term business and technology strategy into a multi-year Quality Engineering roadmap spanning test architecture, automation platforms, continuous integration and delivery, test environments, production quality signals, and AI-powered testing. You'll partner with engineering and product leadership to ensure our systems are testable, observable, secure, performant, and reliable by design. You'll establish technical standards, guide critical architectural decisions, and help senior engineers and technical leads raise the quality bar across the organization.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You'll remain deeply engaged in engineering through architectural design, code reviews, prototypes, technical investigations, and the development of reference implementations that demonstrate how quality engineering should work at scale. You'll also play a pivotal role in shaping Tango's approach to AI in Quality Engineering and establishing the evaluation frameworks needed to deliver trustworthy AI-powered products.

What You'll Do

Technical Strategy and Execution

  • Define the Quality Engineering roadmap. Translate Tango's business objectives and technology strategy into a multi-year roadmap for test architecture, automation, environments, test data, release confidence, and production quality.
  • Architect scalable quality solutions. Design and evolve the frameworks, platforms, and engineering practices that enable teams to validate complex, multi-tenant SaaS applications efficiently and consistently.
  • Make quality a design principle. Influence system architecture and technical decisions to improve testability, observability, reliability, performance, security, and maintainability from the outset.
  • Accelerate the software delivery lifecycle. Drive initiatives that improve feedback loops, enable shift-left testing, strengthen continuous quality validation, and support faster, safer releases.
  • Establish engineering standards. Define pragmatic, organization-wide standards for test automation, test design, coverage, test data, environments, CI/CD quality gates, and release readiness.
  • Solve the hardest technical problems. Lead investigations into systemic quality issues, complex failures, flaky tests, environment instability, performance bottlenecks, and production defects.
  • Stay hands-on. Build prototypes, develop reference implementations, review critical code and designs, and demonstrate engineering practices that teams can adopt and scale.
  • Measure and improve quality outcomes. Establish meaningful quality metrics and feedback mechanisms that help engineering teams identify risk, prioritize improvements, and make data-driven decisions.

Technical Leadership and Organizational Influence

  • Influence engineering strategy. Partner with engineering, product, architecture, to prioritize quality investments and align technical initiatives with business outcomes.
  • Lead cross-functional programs. Drive complex, multi-team initiatives that require technical alignment, coordinated execution, and sustained organizational change.
  • Build a strong QE technical community. Coach members of the quality team through architecture reviews, technical mentoring, and shared quality engineering practices.
  • Enable distributed quality ownership. Help development teams take responsibility for quality throughout the SDLC by providing the frameworks, tools, standards, and guidance needed to succeed.
  • Raise the technical bar. Establish reusable patterns and engineering principles that improve consistency without creating unnecessary process overhead.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies. Assess industry developments, testing approaches, and engineering tools, identifying opportunities to improve Tango's engineering capabilities and long-term competitiveness.

AI Strategy and Quality Engineering Innovation

  • Define the AI strategy for Quality Engineering. Establish a multi-year vision for incorporating AI into test engineering, automation, defect analysis, and quality decision-making.
  • Scale AI-assisted engineering. Identify and implement opportunities for AI-assisted test generation, test maintenance, failure triage, root-cause analysis, and other activities that improve engineering productivity.
  • Establish AI evaluation frameworks. Define repeatable approaches for validating AI-powered features, including agentic workflows, non-deterministic behavior, multi-step reasoning, and tool interactions.
  • Define AI quality standards. Establish evaluation criteria, test methodologies, and measurable acceptance thresholds for accuracy, reliability, consistency, robustness, and task completion.
  • Address AI-specific risks. Ensure appropriate testing for hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe behavior, data leakage, privacy, security, and other risks relevant to Tango's AI capabilities.
  • Enable continuous AI quality monitoring. Develop approaches for regression evaluation, production feedback, model or prompt changes, and ongoing monitoring of AI quality.
  • Connect innovation to business value. Measure the impact of AI-enabled quality practices on engineering productivity, defect prevention, feedback speed, and release confidence.

What You'll Bring

  • 12+ years of experience in software engineering, Quality Engineering, test architecture, or a related technical discipline, including several years operating at Staff, Principal, or equivalent quality engineering leadership scope.
  • Demonstrated success designing and scaling test architectures, automation frameworks, or quality engineering platforms adopted across multiple engineering teams.
  • Strong programming skills in at least one general-purpose language, with the ability to build prototypes, review implementation details, and solve complex technical problems.
  • Deep understanding of modern software delivery practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, test environments, test data management, and continuous quality validation.
  • Experience with multiple dimensions of software quality, including functional correctness, integration, performance, reliability, security, and production behavior.
  • Ability to design quality solutions for distributed cloud-based, multi-tenant SaaS applications.
  • Experience defining technical roadmaps and driving engineering initiatives that span multiple teams, products, or organizational boundaries.
  • Experience establishing engineering standards, reference architectures, and reusable practices that improve quality and consistency across teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor junior and senior quality engineers, facilitate technical discussions, and influence engineering leadership.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical challenges into clear recommendations, investment priorities, and business outcomes.
  • Practical experience applying AI/ML techniques to software products or using AI to improve software engineering and Quality Engineering practices.
  • Understanding of how to validate AI-powered systems whose outputs may be probabilistic, context-dependent, or non-deterministic.
  • Ability to design evaluation strategies that combine automated metrics, scenario-based testing, human judgment where appropriate, and production feedback.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing evaluation frameworks for LLM-powered applications, AI agents, or multi-step agentic workflows.
  • Experience with AI red-teaming, adversarial testing, model evaluation, or production quality monitoring.
  • Background in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), chaos engineering, distributed systems, or production observability.
  • Experience with enterprise SaaS platforms serving multiple customers, with complex configurations, integrations, and data boundaries.
  • Experience working in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments.
  • Experience leading quality strategy through a major platform migration, architectural transformation, or modernization initiative.
  • Experience evaluating and adopting emerging AI-powered development and testing tools.

job.title: Associate SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test)
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) will be responsible for advancing software quality across the Post Production Automation platform through a combination of manual validation, test automation, performance testing, and quality engineering practices. The role will partner closely with Development, DevOps, Architecture, and operational teams to improve test coverage, shorten feedback loops, and establish repeatable quality practices throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated UI, API, integration, performance, and regression tests for the Post Production Automation platform.
  • Develop and maintain reusable test frameworks, fixtures, utilities, test data, and automation standards to support scalable testing.
  • Create and maintain test cases for critical user workflows, including functional, negative, regression, integration, and edge-case scenarios.
  • Partner with Development and DevOps to identify high-value manual validation scenarios and convert appropriate scenarios into repeatable automated tests.
  • Partner with Development early in the delivery lifecycle to review requirements and acceptance criteria for testability, completeness, business risk, adjacent workflow impact, and potential defects.
  • Perform exploratory and manual testing when automation is not appropriate or additional investigation is required.
  • Troubleshoot test failures and application issues to distinguish between software defects, automation defects, test data issues, and environment-related failures.
  • Support root cause analysis for significant defects and production issues and develop regression coverage to help prevent recurrence.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and establish practical quality gates for software delivery.
  • Develop and maintain test reporting, dashboards, and quality metrics that provide visibility into test results, coverage, defects, and application quality.
  • Ability to provide off-hours operational support, including nightly deployments and incident response.
  • Collaborate with DevOps on release readiness, deployment validation, and production issues requiring additional test coverage or defect reproduction.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to improve test reliability, execution time, automation coverage, and overall quality engineering practices.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 3+ years of experience in hybrid QA, SDET, Software Quality Engineering, or similar roles combining manual testing and test automation.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Experience with test management tools such as QMetry, TestRail, or similar platforms.
  • Strong experience designing and maintaining automated UI, API, integration, regression, and performance test suites.
  • Experience with modern test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with REST API and performance testing, including analysis of application behavior under load.
  • Experience creating and maintaining reusable test cases, test data, fixtures, and regression coverage for business-critical workflows.
  • Strong systems-level troubleshooting and debugging skills, with the ability to trace failures across UI, API, application services, test automation, databases, and infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated critical-thinking skills and the ability to analyze complex problems, identify risk, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Experience performing root cause analysis and converting production defects into preventative regression coverage.
  • Experience with source control management, preferably Git.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and software build and deployment processes.
  • Ability to read and understand application code, logs, API responses, and system behavior to support defect investigation.
  • Strong cross-team collaboration skills with experience working across Development, DevOps, Architecture, Product, and operational teams.
  • Experience working in Agile, Scrum, or similar iterative software development environments.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with Production Asset Management and Media Asset Management systems.

  • Ability to adapt to changing requirements, priorities, release schedules, and production needs.
