job.description:
Looking for an innovative, high-growth, multi-award-winning company in one of the hottest segments of the security market?  Look no further than Veracode!

Veracode is a global leader in Application Risk Management for the AI era. Powered by trillions of lines of code scans and a proprietary AI-generated remediation engine, the Veracode platform is trusted by organizations worldwide to build and maintain secure software from code creation to cloud deployment.

Learn more at , on the Veracode blog, and on LinkedIn and Twitter.

We are looking for a motivated Performance Test Engineer with 3–5 years of experience to join our Quality Engineering team. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in performance testing, scripting, and analyzing application performance.

You will work closely with Performance Engineers, Developers, and Quality Engineers to identify performance bottlenecks, validate application scalability, and ensure our products meet performance and reliability expectations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, execute, and maintain performance test scripts using tools such as Apache JMeter, Locust, and K6.
  • Conduct load, stress, scalability, and endurance testing for APIs and web applications.
  • Execute weekly release performance tests, analyze results, identify regressions, and report findings to ensure release readiness.
  • Analyze performance test results to identify bottlenecks, response-time degradation, and resource utilization issues.
  • Monitor application and infrastructure metrics, including CPU, memory, throughput, latency, and error rates.
  • Collaborate with development teams to investigate performance issues and validate fixes.
  • Develop and maintain reusable performance testing scripts and test data.
  • Participate in integrating performance tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Document test scenarios, execution results, and performance findings.
  • Support performance regression testing as part of regular release cycles.
  • Work with senior engineers to improve performance testing frameworks and processes.

Required Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience in software testing, including hands-on performance testing experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Practical experience with Apache JMeter or similar performance testing tools.
  • Good understanding of performance testing concepts, including load testing, stress testing, throughput, latency, and concurrency.
  • Experience testing REST APIs and understanding HTTP/HTTPS protocols.
  • Basic programming or scripting experience with Python, Java, or JavaScript.
  • Ability to analyze performance results and troubleshoot application issues.
  • Familiarity with Linux environments and basic command-line utilities.
  • Understanding of software development lifecycles, Agile methodologies, and CI/CD processes.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with K6, Locust, or other modern performance testing frameworks.

  • Basic understanding of Kubernetes and Docker, including containers, pods, deployments, and resource utilization.
  • Experience with UI test automation using frameworks such as Cypress, Selenium, or Playwright.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted testing and development tools, including using generative AI to create test scripts, analyze results, troubleshoot failures, or improve automation efficiency.

  • Basic understanding of databases, SQL queries, and application architecture.

If you are passionate about water and technology, Trinnex is the place for you! Trinnex is a visionary company that is transforming the way water resources are managed and protected. By combining cutting-edge digital technologies, such as sensor/IoT data, models, geospatial data, and AI/machine learning, we create innovative, smart, and scalable solutions that make a difference. Whether it's optimizing water supply and demand, detecting leaks and anomalies, or enhancing water quality and resilience, Trinnex delivers value and impact to public sector clients across the country.


Job Description

Trinnex is seeking a Quality Engineer with strong experience in modern test automation, cloud-based testing, and AI-assisted quality engineering, including hands-on use of AI-assisted tooling, agents, and skills. This role is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining automated testing across APIs, web applications, mobile applications, and performance/load testing scenarios. The position also supports continuous improvement of QA processes, test reliability, CI/CD integration, AI-assisted QA enablement, and technical mentoring for QA team members. Work is performed under limited supervision and requires sound judgment, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to communicate technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Designs, develops, and maintains automated test suites across API, web, mobile, and performance testing domains.
  • Builds reusable test utilities, fixtures, and frameworks that imsaprove reliability, reduce maintenance effort, support consistent test data, and reduce flakiness.
  • Develops mobile test automation, including simulator and emulator execution, mobile authentication flows, API mocking strategies, and mobile CI/CD integration.
  • Develops and applies AI-assisted tooling, agents, and skills to support test review, debugging, documentation, automation maintenance, and developer productivity.
  • Supports scalable cloud-based load testing using Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, and related infrastructure practices.
  • Analyzes requirements, test results, defects, logs, traces, and performance metrics to identify risks, root causes, business impact, and opportunities for quality improvement.
  • Integrates automated tests into CI/CD pipelines with effective reporting, parallel execution, environment management, and failure analysis.
  • Establishes QA best practices, coding standards, documentation, and troubleshooting guidance for automation and cloud-based testing.
  • Reviews test automation pull requests and provides clear feedback on reliability, maintainability, and quality.
  • Mentors junior QA analysts and collaborates with development, product, and operations teams to improve testing outcomes.

• Performs other duties as required.


Skills & Abilities

  • Advanced experience with web, API, mobile, and load testing frameworks such as Playwright, Jest, Maestro, Artillery, or similar tools.
  • Strong experience developing automation with Node.js, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript patterns.
  • Experience with iOS and Android mobile testing, including simulator and emulator management, mobile authentication flows, YAML-based test definitions, and mobile CI/CD integration.
  • Ability to design maintainable automation frameworks using async patterns, error handling, reusable components, and clean coding practices.
  • Working knowledge of cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GKE), Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and related quality engineering practices.
  • Required hands-on experience using AI-assisted tooling, agents, and skills to support testing, debugging, documentation, code review, workflow automation, or quality engineering outcomes.
  • Ability to analyze complex failures using debugging tools, logs, traces, and performance data; troubleshoot reliability issues; and reduce test flakiness.
  • Strong communication, documentation, collaboration, presentation, and code review skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly.
  • Ability to mentor others, facilitate technical discussions, influence without direct authority, navigate ambiguity, and manage multiple priorities.

Qualifications

• Bachelors Degree

• 5 years of relevant experience

Equivalent additional directly related experience will be considered in lieu of a college degree. Domestic and/or international travel may be required. The frequency of travel is contingent on specific duties, responsibilities, and the essential functions of the position, which may vary depending on workload and project demands.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Playwright for complex end-to-end testing scenarios, including authentication, visual testing, and multi-step workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Maestro for mobile test automation, preferably with React Native or native iOS/Android applications.
  • Background in API testing, authentication flows, identity platforms, or related application integration testing.
  • Experience deploying or managing Kubernetes workloads on GKE or similar managed Kubernetes platforms.

job.title: Senior Salesforce Functional Analyst(QA)
job.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Salesforce Functional Analyst to join our team. As a Senior Salesforce Functional Analyst, you will ensure that the Salesforce solutions our teams rely on are accurate, thoroughly tested, and ready for change. Your work supports the systems that help us manage client relationships, proposals, and contracts, which make it possible to deliver clinical research that advances new treatments for patients. This position plays a key role in translating business needs into clear requirements, validating every enhancement before it reaches production, and keeping releases reliable across the sprint cycle.


You will collaborate with business analysts, developers, administrators, and business stakeholders, work within Agile methodologies, and contribute from requirements through deployment. Responsibilities include business analysis, system and integration testing, Salesforce configuration, stakeholder support, and continuous improvement, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence how Salesforce supports our business.


You will join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through rigorous testing, well-documented requirements, and dependable Salesforce releases. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Salesforce Business Analyst and Quality Assurance Analyst can explore career paths and expand skills across the Salesforce platform, Agile delivery, and clinical development business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Quality Assurance: Design, develop, and execute comprehensive system test cases for Salesforce enhancements, including managed packages and connected solutions. Perform regression testing, test integrations with other enterprise systems, maintain testing artifacts, and run end-to-end smoke testing during weekend sprint release deployments, which occur once every three weeks
  • Business Analysis: Work with stakeholders to understand business requirements and document them as user stories in collaboration with business analysts. Create Visio flows that document new and existing business processes and functionality
  • Salesforce Configuration: Administer a range of declarative solutions to support sprint work and resolve production issues when needed
  • Collaboration and Issue Resolution: Translate requirements into effective test scenarios, identify, document, and track defects throughout the testing lifecycle, and work with the development and administration team to resolve issues in a timely way. Take part in Agile ceremonies and contribute to sprint planning and retrospectives
  • Customer Support: Provide demos of new enhancements to business stakeholders and support them through user acceptance testing, including test data creation and training
  • Continuous Improvement: Analyze bugs, perform root cause analysis, and document results. Stay current on Salesforce releases and assess their impact on existing systems and tests. Proactively suggest improvements to testing processes and tools, and mentor junior team members in Salesforce testing practices and methodologies

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Strengths in Salesforce quality assurance, business analysis, and end-to-end testing of Salesforce solutions and their integrations
  • A proven track record of providing exceptional customer service to stakeholders at all levels, including C-suite leaders, and managing production issues with meticulous attention to detail
  • The ability to collaborate across teams and communicate clearly, both verbally and in writing
  • A proactive mindset, a bias for action, and a flexible approach to new learning and changing priorities
  • Comfort working in Agile environments with tools such as Jira, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced setting

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Salesforce Administrator Certification
  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience with a strong focus on business analysis, system and integration testing
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, data models, and business processes, and of Salesforce security
  • Knowledge of the full sales cycle, from lead generation and request for proposal through the contract lifecycle, including work orders and changes in scope
  • Ability to administer all aspects of Sales Cloud, including security and access, configuration (such as Flow, approval processes, validation rules, and Lightning record pages), reports and dashboards, and data management using Data Loader and Workbench
  • Proficiency in creating and executing test plans, test cases, and test scripts, and experience with automated testing tools for Salesforce (e.g., Selenium, Provar, Copado Robotic Testing)
  • Familiarity with API testing tools and techniques
  • Practical experience with Agile methodologies and related tools (e.g., Jira)
  • Microsoft Excel skills to clean and manipulate data, including formulas to compare datasets
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
  • Ability to work in shifts from 12 to 9 PM IST and provide support for weekend releases

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, clinical development, or a related field
  • Business analyst experience

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

job.title: QA Automation Lead (Android / Kotlin)

With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

We are looking for a Senior Android QA Engineer to work on Android-based payment terminals running a custom Android ROM. These devices combine an Android application processor with a secure processor responsible for payment operations.

You will focus on testing Android system components, SDKs, and their integration with hardware, ensuring that the devices work reliably in real-world conditions.


Responsibilities

  • Plan and execute functional, integration, system, and regression tests for Android-based payment terminals.
  • Test Android services, client SDKs, and communication between Android applications and the secure processor.
  • Build and maintain automated tests to improve coverage and reduce repetitive manual testing.
  • Investigate issues reported by customers or internal teams, reproduce defects, and help identify their root causes.
  • Test Android permissions, service behavior, application lifecycle, and error-handling scenarios.

  • 7+ years of experience in Software QA, with a strong background in Android testing.
  • Hands-on experience testing Android applications and devices, including system-level functionality and integrations.
  • Solid understanding of how Android works, including services, application lifecycle, permissions, and communication between components.
  • Practical experience with functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
  • Confident using ADB and logcat to investigate issues, collect logs, and troubleshoot Android devices.
  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests using Java, Kotlin, or Python.
  • Experience testing APIs, SDKs, and communication between different software components.
  • Ability to independently investigate complex bugs, reproduce issues, and provide clear technical findings to developers.
  • Experience working with Git and bug-tracking tools such as Jira.

job.title: Senior Software Quality Assurance (SQA) Tester
job.description:
Clearance: Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust
Salary Range: 130K - 145K

LTS is seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Sr. Software Quality Assurance (SQA) Tester that understands Generative AI technologies and has applied modern AI toolsets to support an innovative AI-powered modernization initiative within the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) health portfolio. This role will support quality assurance and software testing activities for a modern platform designed to accelerate the analysis, transformation, and modernization of legacy healthcare systems.

The ideal candidate will possess strong experience in manual and automated software testing, test case development, test script creation, defect management, AI-powered testing solutions, and validation of complex software applications. This individual will work closely with software engineers, architects, product owners, and other platform development team members to ensure software functionality, reliability, performance, and quality throughout the development lifecycle.

What You'll Do:

  • Leverage experience and tools, including AI-assisted products to develop, document, and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, test scenarios, and test scripts to validate software functionality and requirements.
  • Perform manual and automated testing of platform applications, features, APIs, and system integrations.
  • Design, develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts and reusable testing frameworks.
  • Conduct functionality, integration, regression, system, smoke, and end-to-end testing.
  • In an Agile/Scrum lifecycle, collaborate with developers, product owners, and technical teams to understand requirements, acceptance criteria, and expected system behavior.
  • Identify, document, track, and retest software defects through resolution.
  • Validate new functionality, enhancements, and defect fixes across development and testing environments.
  • Support API testing, data validation, and testing of integrated software components.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release readiness activities.
  • Integrate AI and automated testing into CI/CD pipelines in collaboration with development and DevSecOps teams.
  • Analyze test results, communicate quality risks, and provide recommendations to improve software reliability and performance.
  • Maintain testing documentation, defect reports, test execution results, and quality assurance metrics.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of software testing processes, automation coverage, and overall product quality.

What We're Looking For:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline; equivalent professional experience may be considered.
  • 7+ years of professional experience in software quality assurance, software testing, or a related technical role.
  • Experience testing AI/ML-enabled applications, generative AI solutions, or agentic AI platforms.
  • Familiarity with testing AI-generated outputs, workflow automation, or intelligent software agents.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing manual and automated software tests.
  • Hands-on experience creating automated test scripts using tools or frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar technologies.
  • Experience developing test cases, test plans, and test scenarios based on functional and technical requirements.
  • Proficiency with at least one scripting or programming language such as Python, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
  • Experience performing API testing using tools such as Postman, REST Assured, or similar technologies.
  • Experience testing cloud-native applications, microservices, containerized environments, or distributed systems.
  • Familiarity with performance and load testing tools such as JMeter or k6.
  • Familiarity with defect tracking and test management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or equivalent platforms.
  • Thorough understanding and experience with software development lifecycles (SDLC), software testing lifecycles (STLC), and Agile development methodologies.
  • Experience with regression testing, integration testing, and validation of complex software applications.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional technical teams.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing integration using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar tools.
  • Experience supporting federal government software development or modernization initiatives.
  • Knowledge of VA healthcare systems, VistA, or legacy application modernization.
  • Familiarity with security testing, accessibility testing, or Section 508 compliance.
  • Relevant software testing certifications such as ISTQB or equivalent.

Why Join LTS?

At LTS, we support mission-driven programs that directly improve healthcare services for Veterans nationwide. Our teams work on critical modernization initiatives focused on transforming legacy healthcare systems into secure, scalable, and innovative digital solutions. We foster a collaborative environment centered on integrity, innovation, and professional growth while empowering employees to make a meaningful impact on national healthcare missions.

LTS shares salary ranges to promote transparency. Compensation ranges are provided for informational purposes, and final compensation may vary based on experience, skills, location, and role requirements.

LTS is committed to offering eligible employees comprehensive benefits that will provide them with options intended to meet their needs and the needs of their family.

job.title: 340B Implementation Quality Assurance Analyst
job.description:
Job Title: 340B Implementation Quality Assurance Analyst

Location: Remote
Vertical / Department: Customer Engagement / Implementation & Onboarding

Reports To: Implementation Manager
Job Type: Full-Time, Exempt

Position Summary:

A 340B Implementation Quality Assurance (QA) Analyst ensures that a covered entity’s 340B Drug Discount Program is implemented, operated, and maintained in full compliance with HRSA regulations, internal policies, and program integrity standards. This role blends compliance oversight, process implementation, and quality assurance to ensure the 340B program delivers intended savings and meets all regulatory and internal standards. The role is to oversee the implementation, monitoring, and compliance of the 340B program, including audit activities, process validation, and risk mitigation to prevent duplicate discounts, diversion, and eligibility errors.

Program Compliance & Auditing:

  • Conduct regular internal audits of 340B Office of Pharmacy Affairs Information System (OPAIS) records, retail pharmacies (entity-owned and contract), and Medicaid claims to ensure adherence to HRSA requirements
  • Validate patient, provider, and drug eligibility for all 340B transactions
  • Review and interpret state Medicaid billing requirements and compare against claims data
  • Participate in external 340B program audits and prepare data/documentation for review

Implementation & Process Oversight:

  • Develop and maintain 340B policies, procedures, and workflows for purchasing, referral capture, and contract pharmacy management
  • Administer referral prescription capture processes and ensure documentation supports eligibility
  • Monitor contract pharmacy portals for missed claims, investigate denials/reversals, and coordinate remediation
  • Configure and maintain eligible provider tables, location/site mapping, and excluded NDCs/drugs in compliance with internal and HRSA standards

Quality Assurance & Risk Management:

  • Identify compliance risks, prevent diversion, and ensure consistent processes across all points of service
  • Develop training programs (e.g., 340B University OnDemand) for staff on 340B procedures and inventory management
  • Monitor regulatory updates and communicate implications to program operations

Reporting & Collaboration:

  • Generate program utilization, savings, and exception reports for management and stakeholders
  • Collaborate with IT, audit, accounting, and pharmacy teams to share data, improve efficiency, and ensure compliance
  • Provide data, reports, and insights to support other business units

Qualifications:

  • High school diploma/GED; pharmacy or healthcare-related degree preferred
  • 1–3+ years in 340B program work; prior QA, compliance, or pharmacy operations experience preferred

· In-depth knowledge of HRSA 340B regulations and program mechanics

· Proficiency in Excel, SQL, data analysis, and 340B software

· Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills

· Ability to work independently and meet deadlines

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

  • Implementation quality scores.
  • Number of post-go-live defects identified.
  • Defect resolution turnaround times.
  • First-pass testing success rates.
  • Accuracy of implementation validations.
  • Compliance audit findings.
  • Client implementation satisfaction scores.
  • On-time project delivery support.
  • Reduction in implementation rework.
  • Effectiveness of risk identification and mitigation.

What We Offer:

· Health insurance

· Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

· Dental and Vision insurance

· 401(k) retirement plan

· Paid time off

Why Join Pillr Health?

As a leading 340B Third-Party Administrator, we help covered entities maximize program compliance, improve patient access to care, and strengthen healthcare outcomes.

job.description:
Description

﻿TripleTen is a service that empowers individuals, regardless of their prior experience, to embark on the exciting and challenging journey of mastering tech professions. Our bootcamps focus on training students in Web development, Data science, Data analysis, QA Engineering and UX/UI Design in a feasible and accessible way, ultimately leading them to thrive in a new career.

Our mission is to ensure that every student has the opportunity to successfully master a new profession, find their purpose, and become a valuable member of the tech industry.

﻿

We’re looking for QA Engineering Tutors with hands-on experience and a calling to guide those who are learning to test. 🙌

This role requires solid knowledge in testing, clear communication and empathy to support and motivate students throughout their learning process.

Would you like to transform lives through education and tech?

﻿

Please note that after applying for this position, you will be required to complete a test assignment after your Online Introductory Call.

What you will do

The QA Instructional Specialist is a full-time, hybrid role combining live teaching with technical project evaluation. You will drive student success across the QA bootcamp by delivering high-density live sessions (Webinars and 1:1s) using a centralized, level-based model, while managing asynchronous project reviews and live Co-Learning blocks.

1. Synchronous Instruction & Coaching

  • Level-Based Webinars: Deliver 120-minute live webinars grouped by curriculum depth (Initial, Intermediate, Advanced) to serve multiple cohorts simultaneously.
  • 1:1 Coaching: Host targeted, 30-minute private coaching sessions via Calendly to resolve automated or manual testing blockers.
  • Policy Enforcement: Manage student accountability, ensuring adherence to the 1-session-per-week booking limit.

2. Evaluation & Cohort Support

  • Project Evaluation: Grade manual/automated testing projects, bug reports, and test plans against industry standards.
  • Co-Learning Facilitation: Lead open video-room study blocks to help students work through blockers in real time.
  • Community Management: Oversee 5 assigned cohorts and answer technical queries on Discord.

Requirements

For the QA program, we are looking for an experienced QA-engineer who has:

  • 3+ years of work experience in QA (automation, mobile experience is an advantage).
  • Experience in automation of testing: Selenium + Python.
  • You know how to work with the command line, browser DevTools, Charles/Fiddler sniffers, API testing tools: SoapUI, Postman.
  • Familiar with the theory of testing and test design and have basic knowledge of operating systems, networks, system architecture.
  • Familiar with basics of SQL.
  • B1+ English, fluent Spanish.
  • Full-time availability.

Nice to have:

  • Background as a Senior QA and experience as a hiring manager.
  • Your own experience as a student online, and the desire to help create the best place in the world to study QA.

What we can offer you

  • Fully remote collaboration.
  • Training in mentoring and communication techniques.
  • Competitive pay.
  • A schedule that’s convenient for you. There isn’t a focus on micromanaging.
  • A comfortable digital office. We use modern digital tools — Miro, Notion, Zoom, etc. — to make working together seamless.
  • A diverse and tight-knit team which is spread out across the US and LatAm, and loves what it does!
  • Cross-cultural experience — join an international team and connect with learners from diverse backgrounds.
  • Growth — our product is growing rapidly, so it’s an excellent time to join us and challenge yourself professionally.
  • Meaningful impact — share your knowledge and support others as they launch new careers in tech.

job.description:
About the role 

We are hiring an Associate on Chime’s Compliance Assurance & Testing team. You will assess Chime’s compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies by performing independent testing of our products, services, and processes.
In this role, you will own assigned compliance reviews or testing workstreams from planning through reporting and follow-up. You will exercise independent judgment to identify compliance risks and control gaps, work directly with cross-functional teams, and communicate findings and recommendations. You will also coordinate with our bank partners’ legal and compliance teams as needed. This role will report to the Head of Compliance Assurance & Testing.

In this role, you can expect to

  • Own the execution of assigned compliance reviews or testing workstreams, including developing test plans, managing timelines, performing testing, and delivering well-supported conclusions.
  • Assess compliance with applicable consumer financial protection laws and regulations, including the Truth in Lending Act (Regulation Z), Electronic Fund Transfer Act (Regulation E), Truth in Savings Act (Regulation DD), prohibitions on Unfair, Deceptive, or Abusive Acts or Practices (UDAAP), and applicable state requirements.
  • Define the testing approach for assigned areas by researching regulatory requirements, conducting process walkthroughs, identifying key risks and controls, and developing test steps in alignment with the team’s methodology.
  • Analyze data, evaluate supporting evidence, and document testing procedures and conclusions in clear, well-supported workpapers.
  • Investigate testing exceptions and control gaps, assess root causes and potential impact, and prepare findings and recommendations for review and discussion with business teams.
  • Manage follow-up on assigned findings and perform remediation validation testing to assess whether corrective actions address identified issues.
  • Serve as the primary testing contact for assigned areas, coordinating documentation requests, resolving testing questions, and communicating progress and results. Coordinate assigned bank partner compliance review requests.
  • Take responsibility for assigned improvements to testing procedures, tools, or reporting, including opportunities to use data analytics and AI automation.
  • Maintain current knowledge of applicable laws and regulations and assess their relevance to Chime’s products, services, and testing activities.

To thrive in this role, you have

  • 2–5 years of relevant experience in compliance testing, internal audit, risk consulting, or a related role within financial services or fintech.
  • Knowledge of consumer financial protection laws and regulations, with demonstrated experience applying regulatory requirements to testing or control assessments.
  • Experience reviewing documentation, analyzing data, identifying exceptions, and documenting conclusions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to investigate discrepancies and draw well-supported conclusions.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate with stakeholders across teams.
  • The ability to take ownership of deliverables, work independently, manage competing priorities, and exercise sound judgment in evaluating and escalating compliance concerns.
  • Comfort working through ambiguity and adapting to changing priorities.
  • Experience with data analytics, automation, or AI tools is a plus.

We know that great work can’t be done without a diverse team and inclusive environment. job.title: Senior Systems Engineer, Workers Authoring & Testing; Frameworks
job.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Austin, TX | Washington D.C. | Lisbon, Portugal or London, UK (Hybrid)

About the Role

Our team’s core mission is to enable developers to do what they do best — build powerful applications.  We believe they should be able to do this without having to think or worry about infrastructure, scaling, or performance. While Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare’s solution to serverless computing, handles the infrastructure part, there’s so much more that goes into enabling developers to do their jobs. Developer experience plays a critical role in the success of developers using our platform, so it is our team’s goal to make authoring and testing on our platform easy to understand, accessible, and fun! If this excites you, come join our team of talented engineers that enables developers all around the world to build low-latency planet-scale applications for the Internet and the Web!

About the Department

Our team is part of Cloudflare's Emerging Technology and Incubation (ETI) group, where new, bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. As the Workers Authoring and Testing team, we develop and maintain tools and packages within a larger collection of developer resources for one of ETIs most successful endeavors so far, Cloudflare Workers. 

What you'll do

As a member of the Workers Authoring and Testing team, you will put yourself in the shoes of a developer, and use your understanding of software engineering, Web and Internet technologies, and modern JS frameworks to propose, evaluate, and implement innovative technical solutions that create and improve the development experience on the Cloudflare Workers development platform. To this end, you will:

  • Create and improve development tools to support authoring and testing with Cloudflare Workers
  • Work on projects that span multiple development surfaces, including CLIs, build systems, CI/CD pipelines, and web framework integrations
  • Converge existing tools and systems to simplify our product portfolio and increase quality and cohesion of the development experience
  • Help feature teams craft their public JavaScript/TypeScript APIs
  • Contribute to internal and public-facing technical documentation
  • Support the health and availability of services by being part of an on-call rotation
  • Collaborate with engineers across Cloudflare, and contribute at many layers of the stack 
  • Help implement metrics and dashboards to monitor operational health after projects ship
  • Leverage your creativity and developer prowess to seek out new ways to improve the platform

About you

We want you to love it here! This role is a good fit for you if you are:

  • Excited by the idea of helping application developers be successful
  • Experienced with JavaScript and TypeScript
  • Passionate about development tools, libraries, frameworks, and workflows
  • Enthusiastic about untangling and re-architecting complex distributed systems to improve efficiency and simplify future development
  • Able to distill developer pain points into a smaller number of root causes
  • Excited to own your work from early discussions and onward
  • Naturally curious and eager to take steps to learn something new
  • Above all, a collaborator and effective communicator. You want to join a team that upholds a culture of support, open and honest communication, and vulnerability, and that values collaboration over heroism. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to the highest standard

You’ll really feel right at home if you have:

  • Experience using the Cloudflare Workers development platform
  • Experience contributing to open source projects
  • Experience with production system monitoring
  • Experience with a variety of modern JS web frameworks
  • Public speaking or developer relations skills

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

  • For New York City, New Jersey, Washington, Washington DC, and California (excluding Bay Area) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000

● For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €66,000 - €91,000.

  • The final offer will be inclusive of time exemption, in alignment with the applicable law and collective bargaining agreements.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

  • Medical/Rx Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Commuter Spending Accounts
  • Fertility & Family Forming Benefits
  • On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program
  • Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

  • Short and Long Term Disability Insurance
  • Life & Accident Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
  • Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

  • Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave
  • Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

job.title: QA Lead
job.description:
About Payoneer

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.

By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.

What's different about this role

At Payoneer, quality isn't a gate at the end of the pipeline; it's woven into how teams design, build, and ship. This role is the person who makes that real.

This is a leadership and hands-on role in equal measure. You'll set the quality strategy for large, cross-team features — defining test scope, coverage models, risk areas, and what 'production ready' actually means for each initiative. You'll review developer-written test plans, run E2E and exploratory testing on complex payment flows and microservice integrations, and own post-production validation. You influence architecture from a testability perspective — not as a reviewer, but as a voice in the room when design decisions are made.

AI is changing how quality engineering works, and this role is where that shift happens at Payoneer. You'll use AI tools to accelerate test design, automate triage, scope regressions intelligently, and build QA workflows that didn't exist before. There's no inherited playbook for what AI-assisted QA looks like at fintech scale — you'll write it.

What you'll do

  • Own the go/no-go decision for production releases — assess quality readiness, test execution status, and risk posture, and communicate your recommendation clearly to stakeholders
  • Lead end-to-end quality strategy for large, cross-team initiatives — from planning and design through production monitoring and user journey validation
  • Define test scope, coverage models, risk areas, rollout strategies, and quality KPIs for complex, multi-team features
  • Validate complex business flows — payments, integrations, microservices, and event-driven architectures — through E2E, regression, exploratory, and API testing
  • Use AI tools daily to accelerate test scenario design, defect triage, regression scoping, and coverage analysis — and build the QA workflows that make the whole team faster
  • Review and approve developer-written test plans; ensure coverage across positive, negative, edge, integration, and failure scenarios
  • Influence product design and system architecture from a testability perspective — raise quality concerns early, in the design room, not the post-mortem
  • Mentor developers and QA engineers on testing strategy, automation analysis, and quality best practices; standardize QA methodologies, tools, and processes across teams
  • Monitor production quality and own post-production validation; track and manage QA technical debt

What you bring

  • 5+ years in Quality Assurance / Quality Engineering, with meaningful experience in a QA Lead or Senior QA role
  • Hands-on experience with E2E, regression, exploratory, and API testing across web applications, microservices, and event-driven architectures
  • Strong SQL — you use it for defect investigation, data validation, and production analysis, not just basic queries
  • Experience as a QA gatekeeper for production releases — you've made the call under pressure and stood behind it
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as Postman, Swagger, mock tools, and test management systems
  • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and CI/CD practices
  • Experience with production monitoring and post-production validation
  • Daily use of AI tools to accelerate test design, scenario generation, defect triage, and regression scoping — genuinely fast, not occasional
  • Clear judgment about when AI-generated coverage is sufficient and when it needs human review and correction
  • Builds QA workflows and automations with AI assistance — not just individual prompts, but repeatable processes the team can rely on
  • Experience building and working with AI agents and AI-assisted tooling to improve testing efficiency and quality processes

Good to have:

  • Familiarity with automation frameworks and hands-on automation execution analysis
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and cloud-native architectures
  • MongoDB and RabbitMQ experience
  • Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated environments

The DNA we're looking for

  • Builder's itch. When you see QA teams re-running the same manual regression every sprint, or test plans being written from scratch for every feature, you can't leave it alone. You build the template, the workflow, the automation — and you teach the team to use it. Manual toil that a system could handle doesn't sit right with you.
  • Grounded confidence. You're the person who delays a release when the data says it's not ready — even when the pressure is on. You make the call, communicate it clearly, and own it. When new information changes the picture, you update fast without drama. You don't need consensus before every decision.
  • Production instinct. You don't just test the happy path. You're already thinking about failure modes, edge cases, and the scenario that only surfaces when real money is moving through the system. In a financial platform, a defect that slips to production isn't an abstract risk — it's a real person's transaction failing. That weight is present in how you work.

Curious and adaptive. AI is changing what quality engineering looks like faster than most disciplines. You lean into that — picking up new tools, rethinking what test coverage can mean with AI assistance, and updating how you work before anyone tells you to. The QA playbook you bring on day one won't be the same one you're running six months later.

The Payoneer Ways of Working 

Act as our customer’s partner on the inside
Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further. 

Do it. Own it.
Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do. 

Continuously improve
Always striving for a higher standard than our last. 

Build each other up 
Helping each other grow, as professionals and people. 

If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.

We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.

job.title: Test Automation Engineer
job.description:

ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring software quality by designing, developing, and maintaining automated tests for both UI and API levels. You will collaborate closely with developers, business analysts, and other QA specialists to deliver reliable, high-quality software while contributing to the continuous improvement of testing processes and automation frameworks.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING:

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated tests for web-based applications at both UI and API levels.
  • Build and enhance test automation scripts and frameworks tailored to the project's technology stack.
  • Ensure comprehensive regression and smoke test coverage through automation.
  • Collaborate with developers and business analysts to understand application functionality and define effective testing strategies.
  • Investigate complex defects, perform root cause analysis, and document findings.
  • Execute and monitor automated test runs, analyze results, and report identified issues.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous integration and delivery.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA processes, testing practices, and automation frameworks.

WHAT WE EXPECT:

  • At least 2 years of experience in test automation, preferably in web application testing.
  • Hands-on experience with test automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Karate, or Postman.
  • Good programming skills in Java, JavaScript, C#, or Python.
  • Experience working with version control systems, particularly Git.

  • Ability to investigate complex technical issues and identify their root causes.
  • Good organizational skills and the ability to work both independently and as part of an Agile team.

Nice to have:

  • Experience developing end-to-end automated test scenarios.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps.
  • Knowledge of cross-browser testing and responsive design validation.
  • Basic understanding of web technologies, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

Personal attributes:

  • Detail-oriented and quality-driven mindset.
  • Proactive approach, strong analytical skills, and critical thinking.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and test automation practices.

WHAT WE OFFER:

Salary ranges are flexible and depends on your experience.

At Addendum we believe in personalized benefits packages that cater to your unique passions. Tell us what drives you, and we'll craft a package accordingly. On top of that, here’s what’s in store automatically:

So, get your dancing shoes on and come join the fun!

We partner with some of the world's largest enterprises to move AI from idea to production — building intelligent agents, data foundations, and governance frameworks that scale.

Our teams work at the intersection of strategy, engineering, data, and design, helping clients modernize their technology, unlock data value, and create meaningful digital experiences. At Allata, you'll join an agile, cross-functional team that works closely alongside clients — making a real impact and building lasting partnerships.

Allata is looking for a QA Automation Engineer to join a client product team and play a key role in ensuring the quality and reliability of a growing technology platform.

This is an opportunity for a QA professional who enjoys working across the full testing lifecycle, combining automation expertise with strong exploratory testing and a product-oriented mindset. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering and product teams in a fast-paced environment where quality is a shared responsibility and continuous improvement is highly valued.

The ideal candidate is curious, hands-on, and comfortable leveraging modern tools—including AI—to work more efficiently while applying sound QA judgment to validate results and make informed decisions.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain end-to-end UI automation for an Angular application using Cypress.
  • Develop and maintain automated API and contract tests for Spring Boot REST services and SQS/SNS event flows.
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines, keeping tests fast, reliable, and maintainable.
  • Translate Jira acceptance criteria and Figma designs into comprehensive test plans and scenarios.
  • Perform exploratory, regression, and functional testing across QA and UAT environments.
  • Identify, document, and communicate defects with clear reproduction steps, expected vs. actual results, and relevant evidence.
  • Partner with developers and product stakeholders to drive effective defect triage and resolution.
  • Continuously assess automation coverage and identify opportunities to improve test reliability, speed, and effectiveness.
  • Use AI tools to generate test cases, scaffold automation, analyze failures, and expand coverage, while critically validating AI-generated output.
  • Contribute to improving QA processes, testing standards, and release quality across the product.

Hard Skills:

  • Experience in QA, including 2+ years focused on test automation.
  • Strong JavaScript/TypeScript skills.
  • Hands-on experience with Cypress or Playwright.
  • Experience with API testing using tools such as REST Assured, Postman/Newman, Karate, or similar.
  • Comfortable reading and understanding Java/Spring Boot code to support effective API and backend testing.
  • Experience testing REST APIs and event-driven architectures, ideally including SQS/SNS.
  • Familiarity with MongoDB queries for test data setup, validation, and verification.
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience using AI assistants in a software testing workflow, with a practical understanding of where they add value and where their output can be misleading.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with performance testing tools such as k6 or Gatling.
  • Experience with accessibility testing.
  • Experience testing feature-flagged releases and gradual rollouts.
  • Experience working with complex SaaS or consumer-facing products.

Soft Skills:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a risk-based approach to testing.
  • High attention to detail while maintaining awareness of business and user impact.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of release quality.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills when working with developers and product stakeholders.
  • Curious and proactive about improving testing practices, tools, and automation coverage.
  • Comfortable challenging assumptions and asking questions when requirements or acceptance criteria are unclear.
  • Pragmatic approach to automation, with a clear understanding of what should be automated versus what is better suited for exploratory testing.
  • Fluent English.

job.title: Senior Quality Engineer
job.description:
About Freetrade

Freetrade’s mission is to become the default place to invest. Investing has been too complicated and expensive for too long, keeping millions from making the most of their savings.

We’re changing that.

We’re building our team and looking for people who are excited to reshape how our customers invest and grow their wealth. If you’re driven by solving complex problems and building innovative products, you’ll fit right in.

2026 is a big year for us. Last year, we announced a game changing deal to become part of the IG Group. We’ll continue to operate as an independent business while gaining access to the resources and support of an established leader in the space.

This year, we’re accelerating our roadmap and taking our products to the next level. We’re building new features like mutual funds, bonds, and family investment tools. We’re also exploring how we can leverage AI to deliver an even better experience for our customers.

About the role

As a Senior Quality Engineer at Freetrade, you will be embedded in our mobile team, testing our iOS and Android apps and helping us move from largely manual testing towards a more automated approach. You will extend our existing TypeScript mobile test framework and help build quality in earlier, working alongside engineers in a collaborative team that wants to shift left. You’ll get coaching, mentoring and support from our Staff Quality Engineer.

What you’ll do

  • Hands-on functional, acceptance and planned, risk-based exploratory testing of our native iOS and Android apps

  • Be instrumental in the implementation of mobile tests that support the CI/CD pipeline for the software stacks and frameworks we support (TS, XCode, WebdriverIO)

  • Work with the Staff QE to ensure the rollout and socialisation of proactive quality information, plans and reports to project teams, enabling them to make better decisions around processes, solutions and releases

  • Advocate for, coach and educate project teams on the contextual use of testing techniques that allow us to embed shift-left and shift-right testing practices

  • Bring a quality lens to ideas before they’re built, working with engineers, product and design (e.g. Three Amigos)

  • Work comfortably in ambiguity: find gaps, chase down requirements and take initiative without being spoon-fed

  • Contribute to upcoming projects, including acceptance testing to support the backend re-architecture and our quality strategy refresh

  • Use AI tools to move faster and go broader, with appropriate guardrails to keep quality high

About You

  • Hands-on experience testing iOS and Android apps, and adding tests to an existing automation framework (we use TypeScript; familiarity helps and tool agnosticism is welcome)

  • A blend of manual and automated testing, with breadth across testing types (functional, acceptance and exploratory, with non-functional a bonus) and the judgement to know which to use when

  • You’ve owned testing and built things, such as a framework, automation or a test process your team adopted

  • Strong written and verbal communication (fluent English) and influencing skills, comfortable sharing test plans and reports and advising engineers, product owners and project managers

  • A self-starter who is comfortable with uncertainty, curious, and looks for gaps and negative cases

  • Pragmatic: you know what “good enough” looks like and help teams ship

  • Experience in exploratory testing and/or requirements discovery

  • Strong independent testing skills and opinions, and a curious but pragmatic view of AI

We are an Equal Opportunity employer committed to a diverse and representative team. Whatever your race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability - we want to hear from you.

To find out more about how we look after your personal data when you apply for a job with us, please see our Recruitment Privacy Policy here.

Please note we are not accepting agency CVs.

job.title: Senior Manager, Operations Global Quality Assurance (KYC/TM/CS)
job.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

Global Quality Assurance, Senior Manager

How you'll make impact

Lead Airwallex’s global Operations Quality Assurance framework across compliance, risk controls and key customer-supporting functions, helping the business meet its regulatory obligations and risk management standards as it scales. You’ll work closely with regional and global Compliance, Risk, Product and Operations teams to design and continuously improve QA programmes across the end-to-end customer and transaction lifecycle, including KYC, transaction monitoring, name screening, underwriting and merchant risk monitoring.

  • Lead a global team of QA analysts across different areas of expertise, including KYC, transaction monitoring, name screening, underwriting and merchant risk monitoring.

  • Build and continuously improve QA programmes that cover key operational functions and support consistent operational standards.

  • Oversee monthly QA testing and deliver clear, high-quality reports that identify operational risks, process gaps and system limitations.

  • Diagnose root causes and impacts, then translate findings into data-driven recommendations, remediation plans and optimisation opportunities.

  • Communicate QA outcomes clearly to key stakeholders and senior leadership, tracking remedial actions through to effective closure.

  • Drive global projects and initiatives for operational excellence, using analytics and insights to support informed decision-making.

You'll work from our UK or Singapore office on a hybrid working model.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 8+ years of relevant experience in financial services, fintech or consulting.

  • Experience in one or more of the following areas: AML and compliance review or advisory; credit, fraud, brand or consumer risk management; or QA, audit or consulting with strong exposure to compliance testing and risk assessments.

  • Strong understanding of AML/CTF regulations and/or risk management controls, industry practices, and regulatory or card scheme expectations in financial services, payments or fintech.

  • Familiarity with AML processes such as KYC, transaction monitoring and name screening, and/or risk controls such as underwriting and merchant risk monitoring.

  • Experience leading teams and managing QA, audit, compliance testing or risk assessment programmes.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, project management and stakeholder management skills.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Preferred

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Management, Statistics, Mathematics, Law or a related discipline.

  • CAMS, AAMLP or another relevant professional certification.

  • Experience working with data and analytics tools such as SQL or Looker.

  • Experience working across regional and global teams in a fast-growing business.

You'll thrive here if

  • You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching. Quality and accountability aren't external expectations, they're internal ones.

  • You communicate clearly and directly across cultures, and you're thoughtful about how context shifts meaning across borders.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

Learn more about your team

Operations at Airwallex is where global ambition gets translated into systems that actually hold at scale.

This team runs the high-stakes flows businesses depend on — payments, accounts, and cross-border transactions. The work sits at the intersection of product, compliance, and customer experience. The problems are rarely simple: balancing speed with rigor, global consistency with local reality, and immediate execution with the stronger systems a growing company needs next.

It's a function for operators with a builder mentality: trusted to take ownership, work cross-functionally with product and risk, and create new processes for things that have not existed before.

If you want to help build the operational backbone of a global financial platform, this is work that keeps the whole machine moving.

 

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

job.title: Test Automation Engineer
job.description:

Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company.

Vultr Cares

  • 100% company-paid insurance premiums for employee medical, dental and vision plans.

  • 401(k) plan that matches 100% up to 4%, with immediate vesting

  • Professional Development Reimbursement of $2,500 each year

  • 11 Holidays + Paid Time Off Accrual + Rollover Plan

  • Commitment matters to Vultr! Increased PTO at 3 year and 10 year anniversary + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year

  • $500 stipend for remote office setup in first year + $400 each following year

  • Internet reimbursement up to $75 per month

  • Gym membership reimbursement up to $50 per month

  • Company paid Wellable subscription

Join Vultr

Vultr is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Test Automation Engineer to report to the Site Reliability Engineering Manager. The ideal candidate is a motivated, self-starter who is excited about UI and API test automation. This is a highly visible role in a high-growth technology company, which will require experience with Python, Javascript, Selenium, Gitlab CI, and Grafana. This is your opportunity to join our fast growing team and leave your mark on Constant and the future of Cloud Infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Test Automation Development: Write efficient and maintainable UI and API tests, including thorough documentation and test reporting to ensure transparency and reproducibility of test results.

  • Test Automation Maintenance: Maintain existing tests to ensure continued support for the ways customers use our services.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with other engineering teams to align development efforts with reliability, scalability, and business objectives.

  • Documentation: Produce high-quality test plans for APIs, systems, and processes to ensure stability, speed, and scalability.

  • Mentorship: Share knowledge with team members, helping to grow expertise in test automation best practices.

 

Qualifications

  • Experience in writing automated tests using Python (Selenium or Playwright)

  • Familiarity with running tests through Gitlab CI

  • Proven ability to apply AI‑augmented automation techniques to streamline test‑creation cycles and boost team productivity

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and knowledge of cloud-based services.

  • Proficiency with observability tools such as Grafana for monitoring and reporting test failures.

  • Exceptional problem-solving skills, with a proven ability to address complex automation challenges.

  • Effective communication and collaboration abilities to work cross-functionally with teams and stakeholders.

  • A commitment to continuous learning and fostering a culture of technical excellence.

Compensation

$75,000 - $100,000

Final compensation will vary depending on years of experience, background/skill set, location, and applicable laws. We are currently accepting applications from candidates residing in the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nebraska, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, Wisconsin.

 

Inclusion & Privacy

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.

We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.

Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.

About the Role
We have an exciting role for a QA Engineer. Team responsibilities include developing scripts and tools to automate testing, building network environments for system testing, performing system tests, performing first level triage of issues discovered through test activities, and driving bug resolution with the development team.

Excellent candidates for this role will enjoy being hands on, will be excited to make positive transformational changes in our organization, and will want to be a champion of best-in-class testing practices.

teams
