job.title: Senior ATE Test Engineer (f/m/d)
job.description:
About us

We see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects

About our technology

The semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude

In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution

The Role

As a Senior Automated Test Equipment (ATE) Test Engineer, you will own the bring-up and operation of our high-volume 300 mm wafer test infrastructure for electronic-photonic integrated circuits. On a daily basis, you will set up and qualify ATE test cells, develop and debug test programs for DC, RF, and electro-optical device characterization, and drive probe card design with vendors. You will analyze wafer-level data to make pass/fail calls and share insights with design and process teams, helping us scale from engineering characterization to high-volume production.

To join our team, you should be excited to:

  • Set up, qualify, and calibrate ATE test cells, ensuring readiness for high-volume wafer testing.

  • Develop and debug automated test programs for DC, RF, optical, and electro-optical device characterization, including new measurement methods.

  • Own probe card specifications, design, qualification, and integration, alongside associated interface hardware, in collaboration with vendors.

  • Collaborate across teams to define comprehensive measurement plans and contribute to design-for-test (DFT) implementation.

  • Collect, analyze, and report wafer-level measurement data to determine pass/fail outcomes and support yield monitoring, reliability testing, and failure analysis.

  • Transfer laboratory characterization methods into production, developing automated test protocols and equipment specifications for manufacturing integration.

  • Optimize test throughput while maintaining measurement accuracy and reliability.

  • Work with manufacturing engineering to implement statistical process control (SPC), improve yield, and strengthen test efficiency and data analytics.

  • Support supplier qualification, vendor evaluation, and incoming material characterization.

  • Create test documentation and training materials, ensuring procedures meet industry standards and customer quality requirements.

Your Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline.

  • At least five years of hands-on experience setting up and operating ATE systems, including wafer probers and probe card specification, qualification, and integration.

  • Strong programming skills in Java and Python for test automation, instrument control, and automated data collection.

  • Hands-on experience performing electrical, optical, and electro-optical measurements on EIC and PIC devices; RF or high-speed testing experience is a plus.

  • A sound understanding of PIC and/or EIC device structures and operation, including EIC-to-PIC interface architectures.

  • Practical knowledge of design-for-test (DFT) methodologies and their implementation in integrated circuits.

  • A proven track record of transferring laboratory test methods and device characterization into production environments.

  • Proficiency in data processing, statistical analysis, and visualization using Python, Java, or LabVIEW, with experience applying statistical process control (SPC) and monitoring yield, process performance, and reliability.

  • Knowledge of supplier management, incoming material characterization, and vendor qualification processes.

  • Experience in a fast-paced startup or semiconductor manufacturing environment is preferred.

  • Advanced knowledge of optoelectronic device physics, graphene-based devices, and semiconductor operating principles is an advantage.

  • Familiarity with photonic component qualification methodologies and industry reliability testing standards is a plus.

  • Experience characterizing and testing optoelectronic or semiconductor packaging is an advantage.

Our work culture

People Over Processes. At Black Semiconductor, flexibility is key—we ensure work adapts to life, not the other way around. We champion work-life harmony, where careers are meaningful and enriching. Our processes are human-centric, allowing you to focus on what matters

Let’s grow together. Your potential is our priority. We provide the autonomy to make a lasting impact and nurture your growth through a culture of continuous learning. We invest in your journey for professional and personal development

Your Health and Future Matter. Your well-being is paramount. We offer a comprehensive benefits package with outstanding insurance, pension and virtual stock options for your mental, physical, and financial health. Your peace of mind is our priority - in the present and future

We Live Openness. Collaboration and inclusivity are the cornerstones of our culture. We practice openness, fostering trust and respect. Individuality is our collective strength, fueling innovation and driving us forward

We connect chips – and people. We encourage qualified individuals from any background to apply. We foster an inclusive and supportive work environment that values collaboration, innovation, and growth. Join our team and be part of an organization dedicated to making a difference in the industry

Can you picture yourself in this Role and our Company? Let’s connect!

job.title: Senior QA Engineer Performance & Scalability
job.description:
We're looking for a Senior QA Engineer, Performance & Scalability who doesn't wait to be told what to test. You'll own performance and scalability across our platform, 30+ microservices, event-driven flows, and the legacy dependencies that come with a real production system at scale. This isn't a "run a load test before release" role. This is a role where you make performance a first-class concern from day one, where you define the thresholds that decide pass or fail, and where you hold the bar when something is degrading and nobody yet knows why.

You'll be the performance voice in every room you walk into, design discussions, architecture reviews, incident retrospectives. When latency spikes, you're already halfway through the trace. When a new service is being scoped, performance is already in the delivery plan because you put it there.

What you can expect to be doing:

  • Own Performance from Day One - You embed performance thinking into the delivery plan before code is written, not as an afterthought before release. You make performance testing a natural part of how teams build and ship — not a gate they hit at the end.

  • Define What Good Looks Like - You own the thresholds, metrics, and SLOs that govern pass or fail. You decide what a breach means, you set the budgets (latency, error rate, throughput), and you make those signals objective enough that a pipeline can act on them without a human reading graphs.

  • Test Services in Isolation, at Production Scale - You design and build performance tests for individual services, stubbing downstream and third-party dependencies so each journey is tested on its own merits. You map load to real production traffic to find where things bend and where they break.

  • Lead Performance in CI - You integrate performance testing into CI/CD so regressions are caught automatically, early, and fast. You own the fail-fast signals and keep them trustworthy.

  • Build Reusable, Scalable Assets - You build performance tests as code, reusable components, templates, and utilities that scale across teams and services. You handle data seeding and test setup so runs are repeatable and realistic.

  • Diagnose, Don't Just Report - You root-cause regressions across the stack, reading logs and tracing requests through distributed systems to find the source yourself rather than waiting for someone to hand it to you.

  • Reach Out and Drive Outcomes - You engage the right stakeholders, engineering, platform, product - to turn findings into fixes. You don't file a report and walk away; you drive the outcome.

  • Influence Decisions - You raise performance and scalability risks early, challenge assumptions constructively, and bring people with you. When a design won't scale, you say so before it ships.

What we’re looking for:

  • 5+ years in performance engineering, with a track record of owning performance across complex, modern systems, not just executing someone else's load test.

  • Deep performance testing expertise. Hands-on experience designing realistic load models, running load, stress, soak and spike tests, and interpreting results meaningfully.

  • K6 or similar - You have real, hands-on depth with k6 for building and running performance tests.

  • Monitoring and observability know-how. You're comfortable with tools like Datadog, Grafana, CloudWatch or similar, and you use them proactively to correlate test results with what the system is actually doing, not just when something is already on fire.

  • Strong programming ability. You're extremely strong in at least one language. We use TypeScript across our stack; if your fundamentals are solid in another language, we're confident you'll pick it up fast.

  • Microservices and distributed systems. You understand service-oriented architectures, dependencies, and the realities of testing a service in isolation — stubbing, mocking, contract boundaries, as well as end-to-end.

  • CI/CD fluency - You've integrated performance testing into CI/CD pipelines and understand how to keep feedback fast and signals reliable. Experience with AWS infrastructure is strongly preferred.

  • Strong communication and presence. You participate fully in agile ceremonies and cross-team conversations. You don't sit quietly when something needs to be said

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, wealth management, or regulated financial services.

  • Experience using AI-assisted tooling to accelerate performance work.

  • Contributions to internal quality guilds, communities of practice, or engineering culture initiatives.

  • Experience mentoring engineers on performance and testing best practices.

What we’re really looking for: ✍️

Beyond the skills and the experience, we want someone who operates with ownership and independence. You don't wait for permission to improve something. You see a gap in coverage, a flaky test, a missing dashboard — and you fix it. You treat the Wealth Management experience line as yours, and you hold yourself to the same standard you hold the product to.

You're not a gatekeeper. You're a quality enabler. And you make every team you work with better at shipping reliable software.

Interested? We'd love to hear from you. Apply and tell us about a time you changed how quality worked on a team, not just what you tested, but how you made testing better for everyone around you.

⏰ Working Hours ⏰

  • Monday to Thursday: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

  • Friday: 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM (Start your weekend early!)

Enjoy a structured yet balanced workweek, with an early Friday finish to kickstart your weekend!

PERKS🎁

  • Workplace pension scheme - We invest in your future with a workplace pension scheme, contributing 5% on earnings up to £50,000. Plan ahead with confidence while you grow your career! 🚀

We're building the wealth super app of the future. An app to build your long-term wealth across savings, investments and pensions.

We use technology to break down barriers so users can invest like the ultra-wealthy, giving them one simple place to manage, grow and protect their wealth.

job.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) — AI-Driven Testing
job.description:
Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) — AI-Driven Testing

We operate a regulated digital asset exchange, broker, and custodian serving institutional and professional investors. Our QA practice has been rebuilt around agentic AI: test planning, test code, failure triage, and even code review happens in partnership with AI coding agents, with the engineer as the human in the loop. We're looking for an SDET to join that team. Judgment, curiosity, and clear writing matter more to us than a perfect CV — if you're strong, we're flexible on the rest.

What the role actually is

You won't spend your days hand-writing boilerplate test scripts. You'll direct AI agents to do the mechanical work, and your job is everything the machine can't be trusted with deciding what's worth testing, checking that a generated test can genuinely fail, spotting when a "passing" suite is lying, and judging whether a red run is a product bug, an environment problem, or a broken test.

What you'll do

  • Author and maintain automated UI and API tests (Playwright, TypeScript) covering the trading, custody, and customer-portal surfaces of the platform.
  • Work with agentic AI tools daily — planning tests, generating code, triaging failures, reviewing PRs — and critically verify everything an agent produces before it ships.
  • Triage nightly regression and smoke runs: separate genuine product bugs from environment noise and test-side defects, and file clear, well-evidenced bug reports that a developer outside your domain can act on.
  • Keep the suite honest: link failing tests to known bugs, release them when fixes land, and never let a silent skip or a warning-instead-of-failure hide a real defect.
  • Run and maintain suites in CI (GitHub Actions) and help keep the pipelines green, fast, and trustworthy.
  • Keep test cases traceable in our test-case-management tooling.
  • Occasionally cross the test boundary and fix what you find: QA works in the same monorepo as the product, so small bug fixes and improvements to the application itself are yours to ship, through the same PR and review process the developers use.
  • Review teammates' test PRs — and respond to review findings on your own, including findings raised by AI reviewers — with evidence, not opinion.
  • Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, and product owners across a globally distributed team.

What we're looking for

  • Hands-on experience in software testing, QA automation, or software development — typically 3–6 years, though we're flexible for the right person.
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, or clear evidence you can pick a language up quickly.
  • A solid grasp of how web applications and HTTP APIs work: requests and responses, status codes, JSON, authentication.
  • Genuine interest in AI-assisted engineering. You should be comfortable making AI tools do real work — and sceptical enough to check the output. If you already use AI assistants for real tasks, we'll want to hear how.
  • Excellent written English. In an agentic workflow, writing is the work: prompts, bug reports, test plans, and review comments all succeed or fail on clarity.
  • Attention to detail and honest reporting. A failing test you explain truthfully is worth more to us than a green one you can't.
  • Strong candidates usually bring several of the following — you don't need them all:
  • Hands-on experience with Playwright (or Cypress/Selenium).
  • Experience building or maintaining a shared test framework — fixtures, page objects, helpers, CI wiring — rather than only writing specs inside one.
  • Exposure to financial services, trading, or capital markets — order lifecycles, settlement, custody concepts.
  • WebSockets / real-time data, SQL/PostgreSQL, CI pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar).
  • Familiarity with digital assets or blockchain.

Nice to have

  • Performance or load testing (k6, JMeter, or similar).

job.description:
About the Role:

Grade Level (for internal use):

12

S&P Global Corporate

The Role: Lead Penetration Test Engineer

Location: US - Virtual, or Canada - Virtual

The Team:

The S&P Ratings Security team focuses on protecting our clients and users from modern security threats. Our mission is to safeguard systems and data by developing innovative solutions to the industry’s most complex security challenges. We are passionate problem solvers with deep security expertise.  

Responsibilities and Impact: 

We are seeking a Lead Penetration Test Engineer with extensive experience in penetration testing and offensive security. The ideal candidate will conduct penetration tests, re-testing, vulnerability scanning, and threat assessments across diverse environments. This role requires strong offensive security skills combined with cloud and application security expertise to identify vulnerabilities and develop effective mitigation strategies.

A successful candidate will excel in the following areas: 

Penetration Testing & Vulnerability Assessments

• Conduct comprehensive penetration testing of web applications, infrastructure, and cloud environments using both manual and automated techniques.
• Develop custom scripts, tools, and methodologies to enhance penetration testing capabilities and automate security testing within CI/CD pipelines.
• Apply cloud‑specific offensive techniques, including IAM abuse, container and serverless exploitation, and cloud misconfiguration testing.

Vulnerability Management & Remediation

• Collaborate with engineering and development teams to analyze vulnerabilities, develop remediation plans, and strengthen application security across development and production lifecycles.
• Perform detailed security assessments using DAST, SAST, and SCA tools to ensure continuous validation and improvement of security controls.

Attack Simulations & Research

• Lead and participate in attack simulations and tabletop exercises to validate security controls and improve organizational response capabilities.
• Research emerging threats, attack vectors, and adversarial techniques to inform offensive and defensive strategies.
• Partner with internal teams to design and execute threat assessments based on intelligence feeds and threat actor analysis.

Security Communication & Reporting

• Communicate and present penetration testing and security assessment findings to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
• Provide actionable remediation guidance and risk mitigation strategies to strengthen the organization’s overall security posture.

What We’re Looking For

Basic Required Qualifications

• Minimum 8 years of experience in information security with a strong focus on penetration testing, application security, and vulnerability management.
• Hands-on experience with penetration testing tools (e.g., Burp Suite, Nessus, Metasploit, Nmap) and methodologies (e.g., OWASP Top 10, MITRE ATT&CK, PTES).
• Expertise in identifying and exploiting common infrastructure and web application vulnerabilities (e.g., XSS, SQL Injection, IDOR).
• Familiarity with vulnerability classification and scoring frameworks (CVE, CVSS, CWE).
• Strong scripting or programming skills (e.g., Bash, Python, Go, PowerShell, JavaScript).
• Experience performing security assessments (DAST, SAST, SCA, credential scanning) and integrating security testing into CI/CD pipelines.
• Ability to translate complex technical findings into clear, actionable reports and confidently brief cross‑functional teams and executives.
• At least one recognized offensive security certification (OSCP, OSCE3, OSEP, GXPN, GPEN, or CREST CRT/CCT).

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with cloud security across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
• Knowledge of AI/ML security and adversarial testing methods, including evaluating LLMs and other models for manipulation, evasion, and data integrity risks.
• Demonstrated involvement in the infosec community (e.g., open-source projects, bug bounties, CVE research, conference talks, or security publications).
• Experience applying the MITRE ATT&CK Framework to offensive security operations and threat emulation.
• Familiarity with secure software development practices and the software development lifecycle.
• Experience with Java application technologies, deployment frameworks, and associated security best practices.
• Ability to work collaboratively across teams while independently owning deliverables and maintaining accountability to deadlines.

job.title: QA automation - Développeur.euse de tests automatisés
job.description:
Itera est à la recherche d'un(e) développeur.esue de test automatisés pour rejoindre les équipe de son partenaire Nectari Software à titre d'employé permaanent

Qui sommes-nous ?

Après 10 ans dactivité dans le secteur des progiciels de gestion intégré, Nectari Business Intelligence a été développé et lancé en 2002 en réponse à la demande des clients dune solution de veille économique supérieure. En tant quancien chef de file des progiciels de gestion intégrée (PGI) et désormais des solutions de veille économique, notre succès est en lien direct avec lengagement et le dynamisme de nos équipes. En plus de proposer des solutions robustes et innovantes, nos consultants se démarquent nettement en termes de connaissances et dexpérience. Un grand nombre dentre eux sont avec nous depuis plus de dix ans, et leur dévouement et leur professionnalisme nous ont permis détablir une solide expertise en matière de Business Intelligence.

Notre mission :

Depuis plus de 20 ans Nectari développe des solutions dintelligences daffaires pour fournir aux entreprises en temps réel les informations dont elles ont besoin afin de prendre les meilleures décisions.

Nous mettons à leur disposition un outil puissant mais simple dutilisation pour les aider à opérer plus efficacement et plus facilement en éliminant les silos et permettant une meilleure flexibilité.

Pourquoi rejoindre Nectari

Lensemble de nos équipes, quels soient orientés fonctionnel ou technique, travail dans la collaboration pour livrer des solutions qui répondent à des besoins métiers afin de donner toujours plus de valeur ajoutée à nos produits.

Rejoindre Nectari cest faire partie dune équipe à taille humaine qui développe des solutions à destination des entreprises du monde entier (plus de 60 000 utilisateurs en Amérique du nord, Europe, Australie).

Il nous tient à cœur de faire en sorte que chacun de nos employés puissent exprimer ses idées, participer au développement de nos produits et de nos méthodologies. Chez Nectari nous laissons la place, à linitiative. Quiconque souhaite sinvestir et prendre des responsabilités sera écouter et supporter en ce sens.

Notre structure:

Nectari compte parmi ses 60 employés, différentes équipes qui collaborent étroitement au quotidien.

Léquipe Phoenix est en charge de lévolution du produit, elle développe de nouvelles features pour répondre aux besoins de nos utilisateurs en apportant toujours plus de valeur ajoutée. En collaboration avec les équipes métiers elle sassure de comprendre le besoin fonctionnel et de concevoir une solution robuste à travers la livraison dun code de qualité.

Léquipe Prometheus est responsable de la modernisation de la solution, son rôle est de sattarder sur des problématiques liées à larchitecture de la solution, la migration vers de nouveaux frameworks ou encore limplémentation de nouveaux outils pour permettre la mise en place de meilleures pratiques capables de faciliter lévolution et la maintenance de la solution.

Léquipe Swatt est quant à elle responsable du support applicatif. En lien direct avec lutilisateur elle doit sattarder à analyser lensemble des bugs remontés, les corriger et les documenter. Elle collabore étroitement avec les autres équipes faisant remonter certains bugs qui nécessitent une expertise plus poussée.

Ton rôle en tant que développeur(euse) de tests automatisés

En tant que membre de léquipe Phoenix, tu participeras à la livraison de notre solution en mettant tes compétences au service de léquipe. À ce titre du auras la mission de développer des plans de test et de les automatiser via la conception de Script pour assurer le bon fonctionnement des features développés par léquipe.

Tu seras amené à:

  • Développer des plans de test, des scripts de test d'automatisation, des tests de régression et utiliser des scénarios de test pour les fonctionnalités de lapplication.
  • Effectuer un contrôle qualité manuel si nécessaire.
  • Maintenir les pipelines CI/CD.
  • Créer et développer des scripts de déploiement.
  • Fournir des outils pour améliorer les processus de développement et de sortie de fonctionnalités.
  • Traduire les test cases fonctionnels en test cases automatisés.
  • Définir des normes de qualité et continuellement collecter des mesures pour assurer la qualité.
  • Mettre en place des outils qui vérifient le bon fonctionnement de l'application (notifications, courriels, etc.).
  • Mettre en place des environnements autonomes en utilisant des conteneurs et des VM.
  • Créer des environnements dans le cloud pour les tests.
  • Apporter l'expertise auprès de l'équipe en matière d'automatisation et d'assurance qualité.

Ce que nous recherchons en priorité:

  • Expérience en tests d'applications web à l'aide de Selenium.
  • Expérience avec JavaScript et HTML/CSS.
  • Expérience en rédaction de plans de test automatisés.
  • Expérience avec les pipelines de CI/CD Azure DevOps (Atout);
  • Expérience en création de tests de régression automatisés.
  • Maîtrise de C# et de .Net Core.

Ce que nous souhaitons idéalement (autrement tu apprendras)

  • Expérience avec les services Azure Cloud (administration, déploiement, etc.).
  • Experience avec YAML, PowerShell, Docker, IIS/Windows.
  • Expérience avec Azure DevOps.
  • Expérience avec les conteneurs (Docker).
  • Expérience de travail dans un environnement Agile.
  • Expérience antérieure dans un rôle similaire, consistant à fournir une expertise à une équipe en matière d'automatisation et d'assurance qualité.
  • Connaissance des meilleures pratiques pour tester un logiciel (évolutivité, adaptabilité, performances, etc.).

Chez Nectari, tu bénéficieras de :

  • Semaine de travail flexible de 37,5 heures
  • Travaillez à domicile, au bureau ou hybride. À vous de choisir
  • Bonus annuel
  • Contributions de l'employeur à un REER
  • Assurances collectives incluant l'invalidité et les soins dentaires (individuelle ou familiale)
  • Compte de dépenses de santé
  • Télémédecine
  • Programme d'aide aux employés
  • Programme de prime à la référence
  • Programme de remboursement des frais de formation
  • Bureau moderne avec bistro, salle de gym, patios extérieurs et un lounge avec Nintendo switch. A 5 min du métro, et avec un stationnement gratuit.

English Version//

Itera is looking for a QA automation as permanent employee to join the team of his partner, Nectari software. Check the description bellow

Who are we ?

After 10 years in the ERP industry, Nectari Business Intelligence was developed and launched in 2002 in response to customer demand for a superior business intelligence solution. As a former leader in enterprise resource planning (ERP) and now business intelligence solutions, our success is directly related to the commitment and drive of our teams. In addition to providing robust and innovative solutions, our consultants are clearly distinguished by their knowledge and experience. Many of them have been with us for more than a decade, and their dedication and professionalism have allowed us to establish a solid expertise in Business Intelligence.

Why join Nectari

All of our teams, work together to deliver solutions that meet business needs with the goal of always delivering more value to our products and our users.

Joining Nectari means being part of a human-sized team that develops solutions for companies around the world (more than 60,000 users in North America, Europe, Asia, Australia...).

We are committed to ensuring that each of our employees can express their ideas and participate in the development of our products and methodologies.Anyone who wants to get involved and take responsibility will be listened to and supported in this way.

Our structure:

Nectari its about 60 employees, different teams that collaborate closely on a daily basis.

The Phoenix team is in charge of product evolution, developing new features to meet the needs of our users by always adding more value. In collaboration with the business teams.

The Prometheus team is responsible for the modernization of the solution, his role is to focus on issues related to the architecture of the solution, the migration to new frameworks or the implementation of new tools to allow the implementation of best practices, making easier the evolution and maintenance of the solution.

The Swatt team is responsible for application support. In contact with the user, the members of the team must analyze all the bugs reported, correct them and document them.

Your role as Automation test developer

As a member of the Phoenix team, you will participate in the delivery of our solution by contributing your skills to the team. As such, you will be responsible for developing test plans and automating them via scripting to ensure the proper functioning of the features developed by the team.

Your tasks:

  • Develop test plans, automation test scripts, regression tests and use test cases for application features.
  • Perform manual quality control as needed.
  • Maintain CI/CD pipelines.
  • Create and develop deployment scripts.
  • Provide tools to improve feature development and release processes.
  • Translate functional test cases into automated test cases.
  • Define quality standards and continuously collect metrics to ensure quality.
  • Implement tools that verify the proper functioning of the application (notifications, emails, etc.).
  • Set up standalone environments using containers and VMs.
  • Create cloud environments for testing.
  • Provide expertise to the team in automation and quality assurance.

What we are looking for in priority:

  • Experience testing web applications using Selenium.
  • Experience with JavaScript and HTML/CSS.
  • Experience writing automated test plans.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines (Asset);
  • Experience creating automated regression tests.
  • Proficiency with C# and .Net Core.

What we ideally want (otherwise you will learn)

  • Experience with Azure Cloud Services (administration, deployment, etc.).
  • Experience with YAML, PowerShell, Docker, IIS/Windows.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps.
  • Experience with containers (Docker).
  • Experience working in an Agile environment.
  • Previous experience in a similar role providing expertise to a team in automation and quality assurance.
  • Knowledge of best practices for testing software (scalability, adaptability, performance, etc.).

With us, you will benefit from:

  • Flexible 37.5 hour work week
  • Work from home, in the office or hybrid. The choice is yours.
  • Annual bonus
  • Employer contributions to an RRSP
  • Group insurance including disability and dental (individual or family)
  • Health Spending Account
  • Telemedicine
  • Employee assistance program
  • Referral bonus program
  • Training reimbursement program
  • Modern office with bistro, gym, outdoor patios and a lounge with Nintendo switch. 5 minutes from the metro, and with free parking.

job.title: Business Controls Testing Senior Analyst
job.description:
Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

We’re a next-generation financial services company and national bank using innovative, mobile-first technology to help our millions of members reach their goals. The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

The Role

The First Line of Defense (1LOD) Business Controls Testing (BCT) team executes independent, evidence-based control testing to evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of SoFi’s internal controls across in-scope business processes.

As a Business Controls Testing Senior Analyst, you will independently plan and execute complex control reviews, partner with business and control owners, and communicate clear, well-supported results. You will apply sound risk judgment to identify control gaps, evaluate potential impacts, and drive timely resolution activities. This role requires a strong command of control testing methodology, the ability to navigate ambiguity, and an effective, solutions-oriented approach to stakeholder management.

What You’ll Do

  • Execute design effectiveness and operating effectiveness testing, including transactional testing, in accordance with the 1LOD BCT Playbook, procedures, and applicable policies.
  • Lead control-owner engagement throughout the testing lifecycle, including walkthroughs, test-script development, evidence requests, status updates, and results discussions.
  • Assess processes, risks, controls, data, and documentation to identify weaknesses, gaps, or vulnerabilities; determine whether controls are appropriately designed and operating effectively.
  • Produce complete, accurate, and timely workpapers, testing reports, findings, and supporting documentation in required trackers and systems of record, including AuditBoard.
  • Clearly articulate testing results, risk implications, and recommended actions to control owners, business partners, management, and other stakeholders.
  • Drive accountability for timely evidence submission, issue remediation, and follow-up activities; perform validation or re-performance testing, as needed.
  • Partner with issue management and control owners to support the development of actionable remediation plans, milestones, owners, and timelines for identified control failures.
  • Exercise judgment in resolving diverse and complex testing issues; proactively identify roadblocks, communicate risks and downstream implications, and propose practical, principle-based solutions.
  • Maintain productive relationships across product, process, and control-owner teams, as well as 1LOD Risk & Business Controls and Enterprise Risk Management partners.
  • Conduct peer quality-assurance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and contribute to consistent application of BCT methodology and documentation standards.
  • Support onboarding, training, cross-training, and knowledge sharing for team members.
  • Contribute to cross-functional initiatives and continuous-improvement efforts that strengthen testing processes, reporting, and the overall control environment.

What You’ll Need

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in risk management, internal controls, control testing, audit, quality assurance, compliance, or a related field; experience in financial services, banking, fintech, or another regulated environment is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience executing control design and operating effectiveness testing, including writing or using test scripts, performing transactional testing, assessing evidence, and documenting results.
  • Strong understanding of operational risk management, internal controls, control design, issue remediation, and control-testing methodologies.
  • Ability to independently manage a portfolio of testing activities, prioritize competing deadlines, and provide proactive status updates and timely escalations.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to use data to assess risk, reach evidence-based conclusions, and recommend pragmatic solutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex control and risk concepts for varied audiences and facilitate productive stakeholder discussions.
  • Proven ability to build trust, influence without direct authority, and drive shared accountability in a cross-functional, matrixed environment.
  • High attention to detail, sound judgment, intellectual curiosity, and a continuous-improvement mindset.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace, particularly Excel/Google Sheets; experience with GRC platforms such as ServiceNow/AuditBoard is preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a first-line risk and controls, operational risk, internal audit, or second-line risk function.
  • Experience supporting risk and control self-assessments (RCSAs), issue management, remediation validation, or regulatory/exam readiness.
  • Experience testing and deep understanding of technical/ITGC/InfoSec related controls.
  • Professional certification or progress toward certification, such as CIA, CISA, CRCM, CRCM, CPA, or equivalent.

job.title: Agentic Quality Engineering Lead
job.description:
Join the team building an AI-first company 🚀

Hostinger serves more than 5.5 million clients across 150 countries, but we're still excited about what we're creating next.

AI is changing how we build products, support customers, work together, and solve problems. It helps us move faster, spend less time on repetitive work, and focus on bigger ideas.

If you want your work to influence both what we build and how we build it, we'd like to meet you.

Our culture: Guided by 10 company principles.

Your role at Hostinger

As an Agentic Quality Engineering Lead, you'll play a key role in shaping the future of quality assurance at Hostinger. You'll lead the evolution of our QA practices by introducing AI-powered testing approaches, improving automation capabilities, and helping QA engineers transition from traditional test execution to orchestrating and validating AI agents.

Working closely with Engineering, Product, AI, and DevOps teams, you'll define the tools, standards, and skills needed to ensure quality across Hostinger's products as we continue to innovate and deliver faster.

This is an opportunity to build a new approach to QA, experiment with emerging technologies, and drive meaningful change across our engineering organization.

Curious to learn more? Connect with your future lead: Asta Dagienė, Head of Delivery

Your day-to-day:

  • Shape and drive Hostinger's QA strategy, introducing AI-powered testing tools, methodologies, and best practices across engineering teams.

  • Experiment with and implement AI agents for test generation, execution, maintenance, and failure analysis.

  • Help QA engineers transition toward AI-assisted workflows by developing their skills in agent orchestration and validation.

  • Establish quality standards and metrics to ensure reliable, efficient, and consistent testing across Hostinger's products.

  • Collaborate with Engineering, Product, AI, and DevOps teams to integrate modern testing solutions into CI/CD pipelines.

  • Drive continuous improvement, encourage innovation, and turn new ideas into scalable QA practices.

What will help you succeed:

  • 5+ years in quality engineering spanning strategy and automation, with a track record of driving change across teams and a clear point of view on how agentic workflows will transform QA.

  • Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar) and programming languages such as JavaScript/TypeScript and Python.

  • Solid understanding of testing strategies, including unit, integration, API, and end-to-end testing, as well as test reliability and automation best practices.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools and agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, MCP, or similar) to improve QA workflows, with the ability to demonstrate practical applications, validate AI-generated results, and measure their impact.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git, scripting, and quality metrics.

  • Strong communication, coaching, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence teams and drive change.

  • Proactive, curious, and adaptable mindset, with a passion for experimenting with emerging technologies.

Benefits you'll love

🚀 360° Growth: You'll never stop learning here. Get access to Reforge and CoachHub, go to global conferences, and borrow from our physical and digital libraries. job.title: Test Automation Engineering Lead (Virtual, US)
job.description:
About Avaya

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.

Learn more at

Position Overview

As a Player-Coach Test Engineering Lead, you will lead a geographically distributed test engineering team while remaining a hands-on architect, coder and troubleshooter. You will own the engineering of a CI/CD-native quality system for cloud-based voice, media and contact-center platforms: functional automation, protocol- and traffic-level validation, synthetic monitoring, performance and chaos engineering. You will also transform conventional QA into an AI-enabled, continuously validating engineering capability. This is a player-coach role in a fast-paced, startup-like environment—not a coordination-only test management position.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor and grow a remote/distributed automation team; establish standards, technical direction, code review, delivery accountability and a visible engineering backlog while contributing production-quality code.
  • Architect and implement Playwright-based UI/API automation, contract and integration tests, service-level tests, and end-to-end customer journeys. Select complementary tools for protocols and real-time media where browser automation is insufficient.
  • Embed tests into GitHub Actions/Jenkins/Argo CD and GitOps delivery gates: pull-request checks, ephemeral environments, deployment verification, risk-based suites, release qualifications and fast failure feedback.
  • Build reliable voice/media/contact-center test harnesses covering SIP signaling, RTP/SRTP media, WebRTC, IVR, agent interactions, call routing, conferencing, transfers, hold/resume, recording and messaging where applicable.
  • Engineer continuous traffic generation and synthetic journeys across calling, messaging and API workflows; correlate functional outcomes with signaling traces, media quality, logs, infrastructure and service telemetry.
  • Own performance engineering: workload modeling, load/stress/soak testing, concurrency, throughput, queue depth, latency, resource saturation, capacity limits and customer-experience thresholds.
  • Introduce chaos/fault-injection scenarios (node failures, network impairment, dependency loss, rate limiting, failover, degraded media) with explicit blast-radius and rollback safeguards.
  • Build agentic workflows for test generation, execution orchestration, flaky-test diagnosis, selective retesting, impact analysis, root-cause hints and self-healing pipelines; require auditable, reviewed repairs rather than silent assertion weakening.
  • Drive observability-led troubleshooting using Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Thanos, Alloy, OpenTelemetry, traces, packet captures and traffic analysis; debug failure across browser, API, network, Kubernetes, services and databases.
  • Partner with platform, SRE, CloudOps, application engineering, security and release teams on security, zero trust, FedRAMP/PCI DSS/SOC 2 evidence, test-data protection and release readiness.

Required Experience

  • 10+ years in software/test engineering or quality engineering, including meaningful technical leadership of remote or globally distributed engineers; demonstrable current hands-on coding.
  • Strong Python, TypeScript/JavaScript or equivalent programming; Playwright and API/integration automation, testing architecture, maintainable frameworks and CI/CD integration.
  • Hands-on load and performance tooling (e.g., k6, Gatling, JMeter or Locust), measurement interpretation and systems-level bottleneck investigation.
  • Production or lab experience testing real-time voice/media or contact-center systems; ability to inspect SIP/RTP/WebRTC/HTTP traffic and reason about customer-visible outcomes.
  • Cloud-native proficiency with Kubernetes, Linux, networking, TLS, DNS, ingress/API gateways, distributed systems and observability stacks.
  • Experience applying AI coding tools or agentic workflows to real test engineering work, with validation and security controls.
  • Ability to make pragmatic technical decisions and deliver iteratively under changing priorities without sacrificing reliability.

Preferred Experience

  • Azure/GCP/AWS, Terraform, Helm, Argo CD/GitOps; Kafka, Redis, relational/document databases and event-driven architectures.
  • Telephony and contact-center technology (SBCs, codecs, jitter, packet loss, MOS, call flows, dial plans, IVR and agent desktop).
  • Experience with policy-gated autonomous remediation, MCP/tool orchestration, AI agent evaluation and protected test-data handling.
  • Engineering in regulated environments with traceability and evidence supporting FedRAMP, PCI DSS or SOC 2.

Education

Bachelor degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science or Engineering

Pay Transparency

The pay range for this opportunity is from $179,127 to $234,100 + benefits. This range represents the anticipated low and high end of the salary plus bonus for this position. Actual total compensation will vary and is based on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, and competencies.

Sponsorship and Equal Opportunity

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Avaya is an Equal Opportunity employer and a U.S. Federal Contractor. Our commitment to equality is a core value of Avaya. All qualified applicants and employees receive equal treatment without consideration for race, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other protected characteristic. In general, positions at Avaya require the ability to communicate and use office technology effectively. Physical requirements may vary by assigned work location.

This job brief/description is subject to change. Nothing in this job description restricts Avaya right to alter the duties and responsibilities of this position at any time for any reason.

job.title: Senior QA Engineer
job.description:
About us:

Airtm is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive.
The problem is clear: in emerging markets, accessing the dollar economy is difficult. Cross-border payments are slow, expensive, and often lose value to inflation. This limits the potential of millions of talented individuals.
Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market.
As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies.

About the Role:

The Senior QA Engineer is responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of the company's software products. This role involves close collaboration with product and engineering teams to define clear acceptance criteria, develop and execute comprehensive test strategies, and build robust automated testing frameworks for a modern web application and its backend services. The engineer plays a critical role in maintaining high standards for product releases and improving the overall quality assurance process, while actively pioneering the integration of AI and LLM tools into the testing lifecycle.

What you’ll be responsible for, the QA engineer:

-

  • Analyzes product specifications to derive comprehensive and testable acceptance criteria.

  • Collaborates with product managers and developers to clarify requirements and identify potential edge cases.

  • Designs, implements, and maintains a robust suite of automated tests, including end-to-end, integration, and regression tests.

  • Performs manual testing for complex or new features prior to the establishment of full automation coverage.

  • Monitors, analyzes, and improves test coverage, reliability, and performance over time.

  • Contributes to the continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) process by integrating automated tests into the deployment pipeline.

  • Enhances overall product quality by creating detailed bug reports, providing constructive feedback, and maintaining clear testing documentation.

  • Designs and deploys AI-assisted testing workflows to automate recurring tasks such as test case generation, test data synthesis, and log analysis.

  • Evaluates and integrates LLM-based testing and coding tools into the QA team's workflow, assessing their reliability, accuracy, and fitness for automated testing and edge-case discovery use cases.

Experience and skills required:

-

  • Proven experience as a Senior QA Engineer (5+ Years of experience) or similar role, specifically testing modern web applications and backend services.

  • Strong proficiency with test automation frameworks such as Cypress, Playwright, or similar tools.

  • Deep understanding of backend services, APIs (REST and GraphQL), and their common failure scenarios.

  • Ability to read and comprehend frontend and backend code to assist in debugging and test creation.

  • Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD tools and processes.

  • Hands-on experience with AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or similar) and demonstrated ability to build, deploy, or thoroughly validate agent-assisted testing systems in a near-production context.

  • Proactive and highly detail-oriented mindset.

  • Advanced proficiency in the English language.

Applicants must be based in South, North or Central America
(applications from other locations will not be considered).
This is a fully remote role, reporting to our Tech Lead.

Qualifications

job.title: Dimensional Metrology Quality Engineer
job.description:
Role Title: Dimensional Metrology Quality Engineer

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Dimensional Metrology Quality Engineers to contribute to a customer's project focused on advanced inspection and measurement solutions. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity involves evaluating and producing first-article inspection deliverables using 3D scanning and advanced metrology software, ensuring accuracy in scan-to-CAD comparisons, datum setups, and profile and position callouts. Your insight will help determine whether deviations arise from true part discrepancies or fixturing and alignment artefacts, supporting critical sign-off decisions on FAI reports.

Scope of Work

  1. Review and validate first-article inspection (FAI) reports derived from 3D scan data.
  2. Conduct detailed scan-to-CAD comparisons, analyzing measurement deviations and their sources.
  3. Set up, interpret, and document datum structures, profiles, and position callouts as per industry standards.
  4. Utilize CMM measurement techniques and perform uncertainty analysis for dimensional integrity.
  5. Differentiate between actual part deviations and artefacts caused by fixturing or alignment issues.
  6. Deliver clear, comprehensive written and verbal feedback to support decision-making on FAI sign-off.
  7. Contribute nuanced, high-quality metrology input to inform and enhance AI system development.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Expertise in Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T) and FAI processes within manufacturing or quality environments.
  2. Proficiency with 3D scanning devices and inspection software (e.g., PolyWorks, GOM Inspect, or similar).
  3. Strong background in CMM measurement techniques and uncertainty analysis.
  4. Proven ability to interpret engineering drawings, CAD models, and technical specifications.
  5. Experience producing or approving FAI reports backed by practical metrology knowledge.
  6. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a keen attention to explanatory detail.
  7. Analytical mindset for discerning true quality issues versus artefacts introduced by measurement setup.

Senior Product QA

About This Role

Saaf AI is building the infrastructure backbone for modern mortgage operations by combining advanced AI with scalable, reliable systems. As part of a top-10 private lender processing billions in loan volume, backed by leading asset managers and funds, we are growing fast, and product quality is central to how we build and operate.

As a Senior Product QA, you will own quality across the product lifecycle, going beyond traditional test execution to ensure our platform works the way users expect. You will shape requirements, ask the right questions to strengthen acceptance criteria, and use data and user insights to decide what to test and where risk lives. You will also validate AI-powered product features, ensuring outputs are accurate, consistent, and aligned with user expectations.

We are an AI-native engineering team, where AI-assisted tools are a regular part of how we build, test, and ship. From generating test cases to analyzing defect patterns and exploring edge cases, you will use these tools to improve testing coverage and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Product Quality Ownership

  • Own end-to-end quality for product features, from requirements review through release readiness.

  • Partner with product managers, designers, and engineers to challenge and refine acceptance criteria by asking the right questions and identifying edge cases early in the development cycle.

  • Think like a user: design and execute tests grounded in real user journeys, not just isolated feature checks.

  • Define and maintain test plans, test cases, and quality benchmarks that evolve with the product.

Data-Informed Testing

  • Use product analytics, user feedback, and support data to prioritize testing efforts and focus on high-risk areas.

  • Identify patterns in defects and user-reported issues to drive systemic quality improvements.

  • Communicate quality status, risks, and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders, not just bug counts, but what they mean for the user experience.

AI-Integrated QA

  • Leverage AI-assisted tools (test case generation, exploratory testing support, defect analysis) as a regular part of your testing workflow to accelerate coverage and reduce blind spots.

  • Validate AI-powered product features, ensuring model outputs, recommendations, and automated decisions meet accuracy and consistency standards.

  • Evaluate and integrate emerging AI tools and practices into the team's QA processes.

Testing Execution

  • Conduct regression, functional, and user acceptance testing (UAT) with a product-first mindset.

  • Verify that new features meet acceptance criteria and are working as expected across user flows.

  • Stay current with emerging QA practices, AI-assisted testing tools, and product quality frameworks.

Team & Process

  • Collaborate with product engineers, product managers, and founders to ensure quality supports rapid iteration and reliable delivery.

  • Document testing decisions, quality benchmarks, and known risk areas to support team knowledge sharing and onboarding.

  • Regularly review and improve testing workflows, coverage strategies, and defect triage processes.

Qualifications

Required

  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and modern testing methodologies.

  • Deep product thinking. You understand user behavior, can map complex user journeys, and know how to prioritize based on business impact.

  • Experience using data (analytics, logs, user feedback) to inform testing strategy and prioritization.

  • Excellent communication skills. You can articulate quality risks and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strong analytical skills with sharp attention to detail.

  • Demonstrated, regular use of AI-powered tools (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar) to accelerate testing workflows, documentation, or defect analysis.

  • Startup mindset: hands-on, resourceful, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred

  • Experience testing AI-powered product features, including validating model outputs, recommendation accuracy, or automated decision flows.

  • Familiarity with mortgage, lending, or fintech product domains.

  • Experience with exploratory testing techniques and risk-based testing approaches.

  • Understanding of how product analytics and observability tools can inform QA strategy.

  • Prior early-stage startup experience is highly preferred.

Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Remote-first with flexible hours

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily. 

Stumble Guys is a global sensation, with millions of fans joining the party every single day and with the ambition of becoming nothing less than a beloved franchise to be played for many years to come.

What You Will Do 

You will collaborate and coordinate with peers, senior management and external partners, to ensure operations are aligned with the departmental mission, values, and long-term strategic goals as well as ensuring continued service improvements are implemented throughout the world on behalf of Scopely QA & Deployment. 

You will help shape the future on how we continue to iterate and evolve our products at a high level, while ensuring our products delight our players release after release. Day to day responsibilities may include:

  • Lead an ambitious Mobile and Console QA & Deployment Program involving multiple disciplines, including Functionality QA, Dev QA, Live-Ops QA, Build Distribution and Submissions across all platforms
  • Manage and provide leadership, technical expertise and career development for multiple QA & Deployment Project Owners; support the skillset growth across the QA & Deployment crafts, leading to higher value individual contributors and managers
  • Build on existing team metrics for measurement of quality and operational excellence and a consistent, regular process for assessment and improvements
  • Manage day-to-day relationships with external QA vendors, aligning priorities, capacity and deliverables with project needs; assess vendor performance against agreed quality and delivery targets and drive improvement actions
  • Be an advocate and spokesperson for Automation Engineering efforts and AI implementation into QA pipelines. Clearly communicate issues, risks, concerns, and successes to stakeholders, partners, and executives
  • Establish and maintain strong communication with cross-functional teams across all disciplines for both internal and external development, QA and Localization partners
  • Work with the Deployment Project Managers and Dev QA teams to create efficient plans, assignments, and schedules for associated quality functions
  • Continually improve the operational efficiency and effectiveness of the QA & Deployment effort by assessing current practices and incorporating new strategies
  • Be the internal advocate and spokesperson for all things QA & Deployment. Clearly communicate issues, risks, concerns, and successes to stakeholders
  • Hold fellow leaders accountable for including quality as an essential factor in product development
  • Lead regular performance assessments of QA & Deployment Project Owners and their teams, using clear objectives, quality metrics and stakeholder feedback to guide coaching, development and performance improvement.

What We’re Looking For

  • 10 + years as a quality assurance professional
  • 6 + years management experience in leading a team through a full game cycle
  • Excellent written/verbal communication in English
  • Experience in building and managing a QA organization that is responsible for end-to-end validation for a critical system or application
  • Demonstrated experience managing external QA vendors, including setting delivery expectations, assessing performance and driving service improvements, alongside a strong understanding of Dev QA and external testing strategies.
  • Experience working with remote teams and with a cross functional team that is distributed around the globe
  • Experience and ease in interfacing with Senior Management, working to develop and maintain strong, effective relationships across the organization
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to multitask under pressure of hard deadlines
  • Demonstrated experience managing bug defect solutions & creating test plans
  • Strong understanding of software development (SDLC) practices & nomenclature, quality assurance techniques, frameworks and methodologies
  • Flexible and dynamic – quickly adapt to changing needs of the business
  • Good understanding of the current and evolving landscape of AI-powered testing tools, and experience driving the transition from manual testing approaches to AI-native.
  • Business awareness - the ability to view situations from a business perspective
  • Proficient with setting up and navigating through bug database management, test case management tools, Google Docs, Google Sheets/Excel, and a build distribution management system (AppLivery), JIRA
  • Mobile Freemium/F2P gaming experience

Bonus Points 

  • Experience with Console and PC deployment & compliance.
  • Any experience with Localization, LQA, build distribution and submissions 

 

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

job.title: Quality-Driven QA Engineer
job.description:
Technical QA Engineer

Location: Remote (Pakistan)

Job Type: Full-time

Work Schedule: 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time

Base Salary: Competitive, based on experience

Role Overview

We're looking for a Technical QA Engineer to help ensure the quality, reliability, and security of our software products! As we increasingly use AI and development agents to build and improve software, we need someone who can independently validate what those systems produce — both from a user perspective and at a technical level.

In this role, you'll test applications, APIs, databases, integrations, and new features; review and understand code well enough to identify potential quality, logic, and security issues; build and maintain automated tests; and investigate technical problems using logs, debugging tools, and application data.

We're in need of someone who's technically strong to understand how a system works, challenge assumptions, investigate failures, and independently determine whether software is behaving correctly.

Key Responsibilities

  • Test new features, improvements, integrations, and bug fixes across our software products.
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, API, database, exploratory, and edge-case testing.
  • Review and understand application code well enough to design better tests, identify likely failure points, investigate issues more deeply, and validate software behavior independently.
  • Build, maintain, and improve automated tests for critical functionality and regression coverage.
  • Use AI coding agents and AI-assisted tools to help create tests, expand test coverage, investigate failures, analyze logs, and improve QA efficiency.
  • Critically validate AI-generated software and tests rather than assuming generated output is correct.
  • Test APIs directly, including requests, responses, authentication, error handling, data validation, and unexpected inputs.
  • Validate application data and database behavior using SQL or similar tools.
  • Test integrations between internal and external systems and identify failure scenarios.
  • Investigate issues using logs, stack traces, browser developer tools, API responses, database queries, and other debugging information.
  • Help identify the root cause of defects rather than only reporting visible symptoms.
  • Reproduce and isolate software issues and provide developers with clear technical findings.
  • Create detailed bug reports with reproduction steps, expected vs. actual behavior, environment details, and supporting evidence.
  • Verify fixes and perform regression testing before issues are closed or released.
  • Work closely with developers to improve testability, reliability, and overall product quality.
  • Continuously improve QA processes, test coverage, and automation.

Requirements

  • Atleast 2 years of experience as a Technical QA Engineer, QA Automation Engineer, Software Engineer, Software Developer, or another technical software testing role.
  • Programming or scripting experience with Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, or another relevant language.
  • Experience using logs, debugging tools, API responses, database queries, and other technical evidence to investigate failures.
  • Experience with automated testing tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, pytest, or similar.
  • Strong understanding of web applications, APIs, HTTP, authentication, and browser technologies.
  • Hands-on experience testing APIs using Postman, curl, or similar tools.
  • Experience working with SQL and relational or NoSQL databases.
  • Comfortable using Git / GitHub or similar version control systems.
  • Comfortable using browser developer tools, logs, stack traces, and other debugging information to investigate problems.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to investigate issues beyond their visible symptoms.
  • Strong understanding of testing methodologies, regression testing, edge cases, and failure scenarios.
  • Ability to write clear, actionable bug reports with relevant technical evidence.
  • Strong attention to detail, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Good written English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of quality validation and test coverage for assigned projects or features.

Nice to Have

  • Experience testing AI-generated or agent-generated software.
  • Experience reviewing pull requests or performing basic code-level quality checks.
  • Familiarity with common web application security risks and security testing principles.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution.
  • Experience with performance or load testing.
  • Familiarity with Linux and command-line tools.
  • Experience with Docker or containerized applications.
  • Experience with web scraping or browser automation.
  • Experience designing test strategies for complex systems and integrations.

What We Value

We're looking for someone who approaches QA as a technical investigation.

When something fails, we want you to be curious about why. You should be comfortable moving between the application, API, database, logs, automated tests, and code to understand what is happening and provide developers with useful technical findings.

As more software is produced with the help of AI and development agents, independent validation becomes increasingly important. You should be comfortable testing AI-generated work critically rather than assuming that working code is necessarily correct code.

We value someone who can ask:

  • Does this actually meet the requirements?
  • What happens with unexpected or invalid inputs?
  • Are there logic or data integrity issues?
  • Could this change break something elsewhere?
  • Are there obvious security or reliability concerns?
  • What isn't being tested?
  • How can we automate this so we don't have to test it manually every time?

Your role is to provide an independent, technically capable quality layer that helps us ship reliable software with confidence.

Benefits & Perks

  • Fully Remote Work – Work from anywhere with a reliable internet connection.
  • Healthcare Coverage – Health benefits to support you and your family's well-being.
  • Leave Days, Vacation Time & Paid Holidays – Take the time you need to recharge.
  • Equipment Funds – Support for setting up or upgrading your home office.
  • Profit Sharing – Monthly and annual bonuses tied to company performance.
  • Long-Term Employment – We value team members who want to learn, grow, and build with us.
  • Collaborative Team Culture – Work with a supportive and globally distributed team.

About Us

AutoScale Ventures is a technology-driven company with 50+ team members across the Philippines, Pakistan, India, the U.S., China, and Canada.

We operate a group of businesses spanning technology, data services, recruiting, and real estate, including:

  • VinAudit – Vehicle history and market data provider
  • Proxy Services – High-speed private proxy solutions
  • EliteWork – Remote workforce platform and SaaS productivity tool
  • Voliplex – Long-term U.S. real estate investment firm

We're committed to building scalable, data-driven products and empowering a globally distributed team to take ownership, solve meaningful problems, and continuously improve how we work.

Interested in Joining Us?

If you enjoy breaking things, understanding why they broke, building automated ways to prevent them from breaking again, and critically validating software before it reaches users, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Product Quality Engineer
job.description:
About Menlo
Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable, turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.

The Role
Asimov gets built at scale on someone else's line. As Product Quality Engineer, you are Menlo's quality owner at our contract manufacturer, responsible for the final assembly and test of the robot from the first trial build through mass production. You make sure what comes off the CM line matches what our engineers designed, every unit, at rate.
You will own process yield, define and enforce final inspection criteria, and run the customer side of quality at the EMS partner. You will live in the phase gates, EVT, DVT, PVT, and into MP, catching the defects, drift, and process gaps that decide whether a ramp succeeds or stalls. This role sits between our design teams and the factory floor, and holds both to the standard.

What You'll Do

  • Own final assembly and test quality at the CM (Tier-1 / EMS), from trial production through mass production

  • Drive process yield: monitor first-pass yield and defect rates at each station, run the analysis, and lead the CM to close the gaps

  • Define, document, and maintain final inspection criteria, including inspection standards, limit samples, workmanship standards, and pass/fail criteria for the line

  • Own the customer inspection and acceptance process: OQC, outgoing quality gates, AQL sampling plans, and lot disposition before shipment

  • Represent Menlo through the NPI phase gates (EVT, DVT, PVT), driving build readiness, defining test coverage at final assembly and test, and signing off on quality exit criteria for each phase

  • Lead root cause analysis and corrective action on line failures and test escapes, using structured methods such as 8D, fishbone, and 5-whys, and verify the fix holds

  • Set up and audit the CM's process controls: FAI, in-process inspection, SPC on critical parameters, and change control on the line

  • Manage non-conformance at the CM: MRB, containment, rework and sorting decisions, and disposition of held material

  • Track and report quality metrics (yield, DPPM, defect Pareto, RTY) and drive continuous improvement reviews with the CM

  • Partner with mechanical, electrical, firmware, and manufacturing engineering to feed field and line failures back into design and process

What We Look For

  • 3 or more years in a product, supplier, or manufacturing quality role owning final assembly and test at a contract manufacturer or EMS partner

  • Direct experience taking a product through NPI phase gates (EVT / DVT / PVT) and into mass production

  • Strong command of yield analysis and defect reduction, and the discipline to chase a failure to its real source rather than its symptom

  • Hands-on ownership of final inspection and outgoing quality: inspection criteria, AQL sampling, limit samples, and lot acceptance

  • Fluency in core quality tools and methods: 8D, FMEA, SPC, control plans, FAI, and MRB / non-conformance handling

  • Comfort reading mechanical drawings and GD&T, electrical schematics, and test specs across a complex electromechanical product

  • Strong communication and influence skills to hold a CM accountable while keeping the ramp moving, working across engineering, manufacturing, and the supplier

  • Willingness to travel to and work on-site at manufacturing partners

Nice to Have

  • Experience with robotics, automotive, aerospace, medical devices, or other high-reliability electromechanical products

  • Experience managing quality at CMs in the region (for example Vietnam, China, or elsewhere in Asia)

  • Familiarity with quality systems and standards such as ISO 9001, APQP, PPAP, and IPC-A-610

  • Motor, actuator, or drivetrain assembly and test quality experience

  • Experience defining final assembly and test (FATP) test coverage and station-level test strategy

  • Scripting for quality data analysis and automation, for example Python or SQL

  • Experience standing up CM quality processes from near-zero at an early-stage hardware company

Why Join Menlo
You will own the quality of a humanoid robot as it moves from a handful of hand-built prototypes to real production volume, the phase where most hardware companies either learn to ship or quietly stall. You will define the inspection standards and yield discipline for a product that has to move in the real world, not pass a bench check, and you will hold both our engineers and our factory to them. On a small team, your sign-off is what stands between a design and a shippable robot.

A Note on AI

You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity and Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about a role but don't meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Menlo Research is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Menlo provides reasonable accommodations during the application process. If you need one, please let your recruiter know.
