job.title: Test Engineer - Ground
job.description:
Who we are

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 

The role

Airworthiness is a system-level requirement. We cannot certify an aircraft if the launcher or the control link hasn’t been rigorously de-risked. This role professionalizes our Ground-Side Engineering, moving our failure rate from the expensive flight-test phase to the low-cost laboratory phase. It is an investment in crash prevention and regulatory compliance.

The day-to-day

· Pre-Flight De-risking: Executing high-repetition "burn-in" tests on all new firmware and hardware configurations for the Ground Control Station and data links .

· Launch System Validation: Engineering tests for mechanical launch systems to ensure repeatable, safe exit velocities and structural integrity .

· The "Iron Bird" Connection: Acting as the link to the IRB Team by maintaining a ground-based "Iron Bird" to test system-wide reactions to simulated component failures .

· Regression Library: Building a library of ground-side edge cases and failure cases that must be passed before any new sub-system is cleared for flight integration .

· Documentation of Proof: Generating technical "De-risking Reports" and managing relevant testing cards in JIRA .

You should apply if you

· Infrastructure & GSE Mastery: Deep technical understanding of Ground Control Stations (GCS), pneumatic/mechanical launchers, tracking antenna arrays, and ruggedized power and control systems.

· Interface & Protocol Testing: Ability to sniff and analyse communication protocols between ground and air (IRONBIRD) to de-risk command-and-control latency and packet loss.

· HIL/SIL Setup: Experience building and maintaining Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) environments to simulate flight triggers on the bench.

· Environmental & Stress Testing: Competence in vibration, thermal, and EMI (Electromagnetic Interference) "torture tests" on supporting hardware to ensure field survivability.

· Diagnostic Tooling: Skilled in the use of oscilloscopes, spectrum analysers, and network protocol analysers to perform root-cause analysis on ground-side hardware failures.

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

Nice to Have

· Bachelor's degree (B.Sc. or B.Eng.) in a relevant engineering discipline.

· Prior exposure to defense, dual-use, or regulated hardware in a test context is strongly preferred.

· Experience in an aerospace or defense environment operating under ITAR/EAR or equivalent national defense export control frameworks is an advantage.

Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields 

  • Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns

  • The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world

  • Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward

  • In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts

  • We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and VSOP options

  • Relocation support: up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation

  • Learning: €500/£450 yearly allowance

  • Health & wellness: gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health)

  • Social: regular company events and monthly social allowances

  • Enhanced parental leave: 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers

  • Family support: 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work

  • A hands-on onboarding program (affectionately labelled “Infraduction”), in which you will be building tooling and applications to be used across the company. This is your opportunity to learn our tech stack, explore the company, and learn how we get things done - all whilst working with other engineering teams from day one 

 

Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

As an Environment Test Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, execution, and analysis of environmental stress test campaigns across the full range of Interceptor sub-systems and Ground Support Equipment (GSE). As a generalist within the Environmental Cluster, you will apply your knowledge to mechanical, thermal, and environmental qualification—across multiple hardware domains. The Environmental Cluster is the "Physical Reality" team within the Test Department. Where other clusters validate functionality, the Environmental Cluster validates survivability and performance under real-world stress.

The cluster is organized around domain specialists—Launch Systems, Ground Communication Systems—but requires a generalist backbone to ensure test coverage continuity across all sub-systems, absorb campaign overflows from specialist engineers, and extend the cluster's capability into emerging and sensitive hardware domains.

The day-to-day

  • Vibration & Shock Campaigns: Designing and executing vibration test campaigns (sine sweep, random vibration, shock) on drone sub-systems and GSE hardware to simulate transport, operational, and launch-induced dynamic environments.
  • Thermal Soak & Cycling: Executing controlled thermal exposure tests across the full operational temperature range on any sub-system assigned by the Head of Testing or cluster lead.
  • IP & Ingress Testing: Executing dust and water ingress tests on drone enclosures, connectors, and GSE hardware to validate field survivability.
  • Humidity, Salt Spray & Corrosion: Running humidity-controlled and salt-spray campaigns to identify corrosion risks in connectors, structural joints, and electronic housings.
  • Altitude Simulation: Validating component behaviour under simulated low-pressure conditions relevant to the operational altitude range of the drone.
  • Fatigue & Endurance: Running high-cycle mechanical campaigns to characterize material and joint fatigue over the required operational life of any assigned sub-system.
  • Failure Mode Boundary Testing: Deliberately pushing hardware beyond its design limits to physically map the failure envelope and validate safety margins across all assigned sub-systems.

You should apply if you

  • Environmental Standards Literacy: Working knowledge of applicable standards as the primary frameworks for environmental test campaign design and execution.
  • Instrumentation & DAQ: Expert in physical instrumentation—strain gauges, accelerometers, thermocouples, pressure transducers, and load cells. Ability to configure and operate DAQ systems across a wide range of test scenarios.
  • Mechanical Systems Understanding: Solid understanding of structural mechanics, material fatigue, vibration dynamics, and shock response for both metallic and composite structures.
  • Thermal Testing: Experience with thermal chambers, thermal cycling rigs, IR cameras, and thermocouple mapping.
  • Environmental Test Equipment Operation: Hands-on experience operating vibration tables, shock rigs, thermal chambers, IP spray equipment, and salt-spray cabinets.
  • Metrology: Proficient with precision measurement tools (load frames, calipers, torque meters, dimensional gauges) for pre- and post-test validation.
  • Awareness of ITAR/EAR export control obligations when handling test data and reports related to lethality hardware.

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

Nice to Have

  • Experience testing UAV's, UAS' or Rockets.
  • Bachelor's degree (B.Sc. or B.Eng.) in a relevant engineering discipline.
  • Direct experience with environmental chamber operation, vibration testing, and physical instrumentation is mandatory.
  • Prior exposure to defense, dual-use, or regulated hardware in a test context is strongly preferred.
  • Basic familiarity with Weapons Hardware Constraints: Understanding of the physical and regulatory constraints that govern the environmental testing of defense-related hardware.
  • Experience in an aerospace or defense environment operating under ITAR/EAR or equivalent national defense export control frameworks is an advantage.

Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields 

  • Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns

  • The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world

  • Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward

  • In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts

  • We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about

This is your opportunity to learn our tech stack, explore the company, and learn how we get things done - all whilst working with other engineering teams from day one

job.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Okta Android platform team is responsible for building Okta's Android Apps and SDKs. Okta Verify is a mobile app that allows users to securely access their apps via 2-step verification, ensuring that they, and only they, can access their app accounts. It integrates deeply with Android system features, communicating with our backend to grant proper application access across a wide variety of Android devices.

We are looking for an experienced Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join the Android platform team. The team is responsible for developing and maintaining Okta Verify and associated SDKs across the Android ecosystem (phones, tablets, and wearable devices). 

In this role, you will report to the Manager, Quality Assurance and be responsible for robust, secure releases and test automation of the Okta Verify application and SDKs on the Android platform. You will also be responsible for developing test scripts, building and expanding the test automation framework, and working collaboratively with application developers to execute tests, log, track, and validate test results.

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

  • Define and own the Android test automation strategy and framework architecture for Okta Verify and its SDKs.
  • Mentor and technically guide engineers across quality and development teams; write and review designs and code in Java/Kotlin with colleagues of varying seniority.
  • Establish and drive quality metrics, including test coverage, flakiness rates, and CI pipeline health, holding teams accountable to targets.
  • Partner with Security to define and execute security and privacy test coverage for Android authentication flows.
  • Represent quality in architecture and design reviews for new Okta Verify app and SDK features.
  • Define and communicate quality plans for the Android platform and dependency scrum teams.

Testing and Automation

  • Design and build structured test automation frameworks using Espresso, UI Automator, and Jetpack Compose testing tools using Kotlin.
  • Develop and maintain high-quality functional, regression, performance, and end-to-end tests for Okta Verify across diverse Android form factors and OS versions.
  • Validate bug fixes and recommend product improvements across Android OS versions to ensure seamless user experiences for major and minor Android/Google operating system updates.
  • Leverage CI/CD tools (e.g., CircleCI, GitHub Actions), cloud device testing platforms (e.g., Digital.ai, Sauce Labs, BrowserStack), JIRA, XRay, and ADB tools to identify and raise quality issues with development teams in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with product management, software development, and cross-functional teams using JIRA and Confluence to define test plans grounded in business requirements and application software designs.

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years of software test automation experience for Android mobile applications, with 3+ years of hands-on experience building and maintaining Android UI test automation frameworks.
  • Proficiency in developing Android test tools and scripts using Kotlin and Java.
  • Experience defining test strategy at a platform or product-area level, leading release testing, and managing complex product issues.
  • Experience building and maintaining Mobile CI/CD pipelines (e.g., CircleCI, GitHub Actions, Bitrise).

  • Experience with cloud device testing platforms (e.g., Digital.ai, Bitbar, BrowserStack, Firebase Test Lab).
  • Experience testing Jetpack Compose UI elements.

Education

job.title: Senior Quality Engineer (Automation)
job.description:
About AudienceView

AudienceView is a leading event commerce platform serving over 2,100 organizations across 12 countries. The company helps live event organizations grow audiences, increase revenue, and streamline operations through an integrated ecosystem of ticketing, CRM, marketing, and commerce solutions.

With more than 20 years of industry experience, AudienceView supports performing arts organizations, sports teams, higher education institutions, festivals, and entertainment venues worldwide.

About the Role

AudienceView is expanding its engineering organization to support several strategic modernization initiatives and product refactoring projects. We are looking for experienced Quality Engineers who are passionate about automation, quality advocacy, and leveraging modern testing practices, including AI-assisted testing and development tools.

As a Senior Quality Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the reliability, performance, and quality of highly scalable web applications used by thousands of organizations worldwide.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks
  • Build and execute automated test suites for web applications and APIs
  • Perform manual and automation testing across functional, non-functional, exploratory, integration, and regression scenarios
  • Partner closely with Software Engineers, Product Managers, and stakeholders throughout the development lifecycle
  • Automate API testing using tools such as Postman
  • Test mobile applications as part of the overall quality strategy
  • Support release management and quality validation activities
  • Identify defects, investigate root causes, and collaborate with engineering teams to resolve issues
  • Promote quality best practices across the organization
  • Leverage AI-assisted tools to improve testing efficiency, automation coverage, documentation, and quality processes

Must-Have Skills

  • 5+ years of Quality Engineering experience, combining manual and automation testing
  • Strong experience with Selenium WebDriver (or similar automation tools)
  • Strong experience with JavaScript and Java
  • Strong API testing experience
  • Mobile testing experience
  • SQL experience
  • Experience testing applications built with Node.js and React
  • Quality-first mindset
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

AI-Assisted Development & Testing Experience

AudienceView is actively adopting AI-powered engineering workflows. You should have practical experience using tools such as Claude Code.

We are looking for professionals who have used AI tools to support automation development, test generation, debugging, documentation, quality analysis, or engineering productivity.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with Playwright or Cypress in addition to Selenium
  • Python or C# experience
  • Performance testing with JMeter
  • Cloud experience (Azure preferred)
  • Ticketing, SaaS, or e-commerce platform experience
  • Experience supporting modernization or platform migration initiatives

Why Join AudienceView

AudienceView is a global leader in event commerce and ticketing technology, helping organizations create meaningful live-event experiences for millions of customers worldwide.

You'll join a team focused on innovation, modernization, AI adoption, and delivering high-quality software that powers some of the world's leading live-event organizations.

This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact while working remotely with a collaborative, international engineering team.

job.title: INGENYX- Senior Quality Engineer - Sterility Assurance & Validation (Remote, MA,
job.description:
Expected Travel: Up to 50%

Requisition ID: 14320

Ingenyx proudly launched as a new, independent company following its divestiture from Teleflex on August 3, 2026.

Ingenyx is a leading global provider of product development and production services for medical device manufacturers. We set ourselves apart with deep expertise, decades of experience, a dedication to design for manufacturability, and extensive, in-house capabilities, which include engineering, regulatory services, material selection and formulation, prototyping, manufacturing, assembly and packaging. We deliver industry-changing innovations and next-generation solutions for extrusions; diagnostic and interventional catheters; balloons and balloon catheters; sheath/dilator sets; specialty sutures, braids and fibers; and bioabsorbable sutures, yarns and resins. Join a dynamic, growing team that offers healthcare providers an array of medical technology solutions that make a difference in patients’ lives.

For more information, please visit

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Quality Engineer – Sterility Assurance & Validation to serve as the internal technical owner for sterilization and sterility assurance activities while also supporting broader Quality Engineering and process validation needs.
This is a hands-on technical role with responsibility for maintaining validated sterilization processes, providing oversight of contract sterilization providers, supporting microbiological control activities, and ensuring continued compliance with applicable regulatory and quality system requirements.
The ideal candidate brings strong medical device Quality Engineering experience with demonstrated expertise in EO and radiation sterilization, process validation, and sterility assurance.

Principal Responsibilities

Sterility Assurance & Sterilization

  • Serve as the internal technical owner for the Sterility Assurance program.
    • Provide technical oversight of ethylene oxide (EO) and radiation sterilization processes.
    • Support sterilization cycle transfer, validation, requalification, and maintenance of the validated state.
    • Review and approve sterilization qualification and requalification protocols and reports.
    • Review sterilization cycle deviations, excursions, nonconformances, and change assessments.
    • Support investigation, root cause analysis, CAPA, and risk assessment for sterilization-related issues.
    • Coordinate and review annual Sterility Assurance and bioburden technical assessments.
    • Provide oversight of radiation dose audits, including review of Quarterly Dose Audit results, as applicable.
    • Monitor bioburden data and trends and coordinate specialized microbiology support when required.
    • Provide technical oversight of contract sterilizers and support supplier qualification, audits, SCARs, and quality agreements.
    • Maintain sterilization procedures, technical documentation, validation records, and required periodic reviews.
    • Support regulatory inspections, certification audits, customer audits, and technical inquiries related to sterilization and sterility assurance.
    • Partner with external microbiology laboratories and specialized Sterilization/Microbiology SMEs as required.

Quality Engineering & Validation

  • Support manufacturing process validation activities, including IQ, OQ, and PQ.
    • Provide Quality Engineering support for manufacturing processes, process changes, equipment qualification, and technology transfers.
    • Review and approve validation protocols, reports, engineering studies, and associated quality records.
    • Support nonconformance investigations, deviations, CAPAs, and root cause analysis.
    • Participate in manufacturing and process risk management activities, including PFMEAs and change assessments.
    • Apply appropriate statistical techniques to validation, process monitoring, and problem-solving activities.
    • Partner with Operations, Engineering, Supplier Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and other Quality functions to maintain compliant and capable manufacturing processes.
    • Support continuous improvement and risk-reduction initiatives.

Education / Experience Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Microbiology, or a related technical discipline.
    • 7+ years of Quality Engineering, Validation, Sterility Assurance, or related experience within the medical device industry.
    • Demonstrated experience with medical device sterilization processes, preferably including EO and radiation sterilization.
    • Strong experience with process validation and maintenance of validated processes.

• Working knowledge of:

o ISO 11135 – Ethylene oxide sterilization
o ISO 11137 – Radiation sterilization
o ISO 11737 – Bioburden and sterility testing
o ISO 13485
o FDA medical device Quality System requirements
• Experience investigating sterilization deviations, process excursions, nonconformances, and CAPAs.
• Experience working with contract sterilization providers and/or external testing laboratories.
• Ability to independently assess technical information, make risk-based recommendations, and clearly document conclusions.
• Strong cross-functional communication and technical writing skills.

Specialized Skills / Other Requirements

  • Experience with both EO and gamma radiation sterilization.
    • Experience with sterilization cycle transfer, duplication, or establishment of new sterilization cycles.
    • Experience with bioburden trending and microbiological control programs.
    • Experience with radiation dose audits and dose-maintenance programs.
    • Experience supporting regulatory or Notified Body audits involving sterilization.
    • Experience in contract manufacturing or multi-site medical device environment.
    • ASQ CQE or other relevant Quality/Validation certification.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will establish strong internal ownership of Sterility Assurance while effectively leveraging external laboratories and specialized SMEs when deeper expertise is required. This role will ensure that sterilization processes remain validated and compliant while also providing hands-on Quality Engineering and Validation support to the broader manufacturing organization.
This position is well suited for an experienced Quality Engineer who wants to become a key technical leader in Sterility Assurance without moving away from hands-on engineering and problem solving.

The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between $115,500- $140,000, however, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position will also include benefits such as medical, prescription drug, dental and vision insurance, flexible spending accounts, participation in 401(k) savings plan, and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO, short- and long-term disability and parental leave, dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.

If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.

At Ingenyx, we follow a comprehensive hiring process. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from agency recruiters or 3rd party firms. We do not make unsolicited job offers. We do not ask for money or require equipment purchase up-front.

Ingenyx is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will be considered without regard to age, race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, sexual orientation, disability, nationality, sex, or veteran status. job.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) – Digital Banking
job.description:
Senior QA Automation Engineer / SDET (Canada-only)

Digital Banking & Credit Union Transformation

Company: Aequilibrium Software Inc.
Location: Canada (Remote)
Employment type: Full-time or contract, depending on client engagement
Seniority: Senior
Industry: Financial Services / Credit Unions

About Aequilibrium

Aequilibrium is a Canadian digital transformation and software engineering company specializing in digital banking, financial services, customer experience, and emerging technologies. We partner with Canadian and US credit unions to modernize digital banking platforms, integrate enterprise systems, and deliver reliable, intuitive member experiences. We are expanding our QA engineering capability to support multiple Canadian credit union clients undergoing digital banking modernization, platform migrations, and integration initiatives.

The Opportunity

We are looking for experienced Senior QA Automation Engineers / Software Development Engineers in Test (SDETs) who combine strong technical testing expertise with practical knowledge of banking and credit union operations. You will work with developers, business analysts, solution architects, product owners, and client teams to ensure complex digital banking applications are secure, reliable, accessible, and production-ready.

This is a hands-on engineering role. We are particularly interested in candidates who can design and maintain automated testing frameworks, validate end-to-end banking workflows, and test integrations between digital banking platforms and core banking systems.

Key Responsibilities

Test Automation & Quality Engineering

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated UI, API, and integration tests for web and mobile banking applications.

  • Build reusable test automation frameworks and integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.

  • Develop test strategies, test plans, scenarios, and traceability aligned with business requirements.

  • Execute functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, and exploratory testing.

  • Investigate defects, analyze logs, identify root causes, and collaborate with developers to resolve them.

  • Improve test coverage, automation reliability, and quality reporting.

Digital Banking & Credit Union Testing

  • Validate member-facing journeys, including login, MFA, account balances, transfers, bill payments, Interac e-Transfer, mobile cheque deposit and account servicing.

  • Test commercial banking capabilities such as delegated access, entitlements, approvals and business payments.

  • Validate integrations between digital banking platforms, core banking systems, payment services, lending applications and CRM systems.

  • Support data migration testing, reconciliation and regression testing during platform replacements.

  • Participate in system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), release readiness and production validation.

  • Collaborate with client business teams to ensure test scenarios reflect real banking operations and member needs.

Engineering & Delivery

  • Work within Agile delivery teams and contribute to sprint planning, refinement and acceptance criteria.

  • Integrate quality engineering practices into development workflows.

  • Support performance, security, and accessibility testing in collaboration with specialists.

  • Provide clear quality metrics, defect reporting, and release-readiness assessments.

  • Help establish automated quality gates for AI-assisted software development.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software testing or quality engineering experience.

  • 3+ years of hands-on test automation development.

  • Experience testing financial services, banking, credit union or other transaction-intensive applications.

  • Strong proficiency with at least one modern test automation framework such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or Appium.

  • Programming or scripting experience with TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, C#, or Python.

  • Strong API testing skills using tools such as Postman, REST Assured or equivalent.

  • Experience testing REST APIs, authentication, authorization and system integrations.

  • Experience with SQL, data validation, and troubleshooting integration issues.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or Jenkins.

  • Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile delivery, defect management and risk-based testing.

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate directly with client stakeholders.

Highly Desirable Experience

  • Direct experience with Canadian credit unions or digital banking transformation programs.

  • Testing digital banking platforms such as VeriPark, Backbase, Central 1 Forge/MemberDirect, Intellect Design, Temenos, Lumin or eBankIT.

  • Integration testing with core banking systems, especially Fiserv DNA or CGI RFS360.

  • Experience with Canadian payment capabilities, including Interac e-Transfer, bill payments, and payment processing.

  • Knowledge of mortgage lending, loan origination, commercial banking or CRM workflows.

  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Azure, and . NET-based enterprise environments.

  • Mobile application testing across iOS and Android.

  • Performance testing with JMeter, k6, or similar tools.

  • Accessibility testing aligned with WCAG standards.

  • Experience testing AI-generated code or implementing automated quality controls in AI-assisted development environments.

  • Experience supporting banking platform migration, cutover or production hypercare.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, you will be expected to:

  • Understand the client's digital banking architecture, critical workflows and integration dependencies.

  • Establish or improve automated regression coverage for high-priority banking journeys.

  • Identify gaps in test coverage and recommend practical improvements.

  • Contribute to reliable release-readiness reporting and defect management.

  • Reduce manual regression effort while improving confidence in production releases.

Why Join Aequilibrium?

  • Work on meaningful digital banking modernization projects with Canadian credit unions.

  • Collaborate with experienced engineers, designers, architects, and banking specialists.

  • Contribute to complex integration, automation, and member-experience challenges.

  • Help shape modern quality engineering practices, including AI-assisted development and testing.

  • Join a remote-first Canadian team focused on purposeful impact and technical excellence.

To apply: Please submit your resume and highlight your test automation expertise, financial services experience, banking platforms, and core banking integrations in your cover letter.

job.title: Senior Performance Test Engineer (Full time, Remote)
job.description:
Job Title: Senior Performance Test Engineer

About Quantum Strides LLC

Quantum Strides LLC is a premier enterprise software solution provider and an IBM Business Partner specializing in IBM Maximo Application Suite (IBM MAS) including IBM Maximo Real Estate and Facilities (IBM MREF). Over the last 12 years Quantum Strides has supported Fortune 1000 organizations, US Federal and State agencies and other enterprise customers across the globe implement Facilities, Asset and Workspace management solutions. We are also pioneers in Artificial Intelligence providing specialized generative AI products and solutions for the Facilities Management and Real Estate domain. Headquartered in the United States, with a global presence across India, and the Philippines, we deliver innovative enterprise solutions by leveraging emerging technologies, including AI-driven automation, cloud, and digital transformation strategies.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Performance Test Engineer with at least 5 years of hands-on experience in designing performance testing frameworks and developing test scripts using Selenium and LoadRunner. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in performance and stress testing for complex web applications, particularly those involving dynamic elements, multi-window interactions, and enterprise workflows. Experience with IBM MREF (formerly known as IBM TRIRIGA, an Integrated Workplace Management System), Maximo Application Suite (MAS), or similar enterprise systems is advantageous but not mandatory. This role involves building robust, scalable performance testing solutions to ensure the efficiency, scalability, and reliability of our applications under various load conditions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain performance testing frameworks from scratch or enhance existing ones using JMeter, ensuring reusability, scalability, and maintainability for load, stress, endurance, and spike testing.
  • Create performance test scripts for web-based applications, focusing on scenarios involving object selections, lookups, drill-downs, and child record views that often open new windows or pop-ups, simulating concurrent users and measuring metrics like response times, throughput, and resource utilization.
  • Collaborate with development, QA, and product teams to identify performance requirements, integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines, and analyze test results to identify bottlenecks and optimization opportunities.
  • Implement best practices for test data management, correlation of dynamic values, parameterization, error handling, reporting, and logging to support efficient debugging and execution.
  • Mentor junior engineers, conduct script reviews, and contribute to process improvements in the performance testing strategy.
  • Stay updated with industry trends in performance tools and technologies to recommend enhancements.

Required Qualifications and Skills

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in performance testing, with proven expertise in Selenium and LoadRunner.

· Strong programming skills in Java.

  • Solid understanding of performance metrics (e.g., latency, throughput, error rates), monitoring tools (e.g., PerfMon, Grafana), and profiling techniques for Java-based applications (e.g., JVM tuning, heap analysis).

﻿· Solid understanding to other performance tools such as LoadRunner, Gatling, or NeoLoad for comparative or hybrid testing.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps, and version control systems like Git.
  • Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies and defect tracking tools (e.g., JIRA).
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently or in a team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience performance testing enterprise applications like IBM MREF (formerly TRIRIGA), MAS, or similar IWMS/asset management systems.
  • Understanding of API performance testing (e.g., using JMeter's HTTP samplers or RestAssured) to complement UI-based load testing.
  • Certifications in performance testing (e.g., ISTQB Performance Testing Specialist) or JMeter-specific training.
  • Prior experience in domains like facilities management, real estate, or asset management software, with knowledge of monitoring tools like AppDynamics, Dynatrace, or New Relic for end-to-end analysis.

job.title: Testing Architecture Specialist
job.description:
This opportunity is in Tampa - Santo Domingo - Remote (EST +/- 6)

﻿﻿

Position Overview

Conceived on the back of the 2017 crypto wave, our client was borne of a realization. While Infura enabled the ICO boom, it also made it extremely vulnerable due to operating as a single point of failure. A secure, efficient, and censorship-resistant future for Web3 must be enabled by truly decentralized infrastructure, not by centralized platforms gating access to networks.

The pitfalls of Web2 become more obvious by the day - security breaches, gatekeepers, and ever-more aggressive censorship have turned the open-source dream of the free internet into increasingly dystopian surveillance and control system. Our client offers a radical escape: a means to bring the free internet back, only this time it's unstoppable.

Their engineering department currently includes a small stable team specialists in critical areas, our CTO, and our CEO. They achieved a great deal, but they also understand that what got you here, wont get you there. They will be scaling up the engineering team in 2022 and they want to bring smart people aboard that will help make fulfill the goals and deliver the best platform while ensuring quality.

Thats where you come in: you will be in charge of everyday research, design, and development of new testing frameworks for the Blockchain Protocol to ensure quality and provide QA Guidelines across the team and the project. You will have to drive your progress and propose new ideas and solutions that will make the Protocol be faster, leaner, robust, and secure.

You will need to architect, design, and implement the tooling that will ensure the quality in an efficient, automated, and replicable way. You will also be an active participant in the protocol research and development effort, making sure that any feature or attribute of the system quality can be properly measured, assessed, and improved on.

You should also be an active member of the community, you will have to be a leader and role model for community developers that will join the project. You will have the opportunity to do research and present papers that will drive and motivate others to participate in the development of the Blockchain Protocol.

Success will be measured primarily in qualitative terms, which may include but are not limited to: participating in ideation meetings, bringing new ideas to the table and running research to find the best solutions, and implementing those ideas with quality in mind.

Key Projects & Objectives

  • R&D
    • On a daily basis, you will be running research, designing systems, and participating in ideation meetings to bring new solutions to the table
    • Participate in other members Ideas, by discussing and proposing improvements
    • Help another team member to run research and comparison about different options
    • Write reports and papers about research results
    • Accept suggestions, ideas and help with your research tasks
    • Propose testing solutions and testing plans for every new aspect of the project
    • Ensure that other team members provide options to ensure project quality from the ground up
  • Implementation
    • Create testing infrastructure to support development
    • Describe testing strategies for every project goal
    • Implement QA systems for every step of the development and deployment process using automated tools and automated pipelines
    • Work side by side with the infrastructure specialist to implement automated testing tools down the pipeline
    • Work side by side with Protocol Specialist to ideate features with testing and QA mindset first, ensure that everything is testable and accountable
  • Review
    • Code review implementations, comment and suggest improvements
    • Help other team members to unblock their work
    • Participate in projects by providing your best knowledge
    • Review community contributions and help the community participation on the project
  • Role model
    • Participate in community channels, answer questions, and review projects
    • Follow the contribution guide patterns to be an example for the community
    • Identify improvements and bugs on community forums and GitHub comments

﻿How you will contribute

As a mission-driven organization, our client is a rewarding and engaging place to work for those who embrace our core ethos, which could be distilled as a commitment to results, truth, openness, kindness, stewardship, gratitude, and collaboration. Huge egos need not apply.

You'll come from a production environment in software engineering. You have a DevOps background and probably experience in automated tooling. What's most important is that you're a relentless optimizer and tinkerer, a great systems' thinker who can see how pieces of a process fit together, then deconstruct, rebuild and optimize them in order to produce improved outcomes (and test, test, test). You'll be a skilled practical problem solver who enjoys finding weak links and experimenting with ways to improve them.

You have some understanding of Computer Science, Networking, P2P, and preferably GoLang. You've been working on related areas like Infrastructure, Cloud, Backend, and CI/CD tooling. You love thinking about QA first, designing fault-tolerant systems and necessary automated testing tools that ensure project quality on every step. You think on QA first, analyzing every new proposal how it can be tested and how we can ensure quality.

As such, while it's important you have a grounding in a real-world software engineering environment, it's mindset and attitude they are looking for more so than any specific tech stack, job title, or level of experience. If you love engineering but wish you could spend less time on the minutiae and more time on building and optimizing a well-oiled software production machine, this might just be exactly the job for you.

While the fundamental engineering, product, and revenue infrastructure are in place and product-market fit has been proven, the vast majority of potential and impact lies in the future. For ambitious builders and innovators, there couldn't be a better time to join us. And you'll get to help solve one of the most urgent and pressing problems of our time a generational crisis - by helping us to build secure, censorship-resistant Web3 infrastructure and restore the free and open internet.

Requirements

(Please read the above)

  • >1y of experience in a startup environment
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Deep understanding of Computer Science and Networking. You don't just use tools and frameworks, you also understand how they work under the hood.
  • +1y experience in DevOps
  • You've experience working on projects that are related to Infrastructure, Cloud, Backend, and CI/CD tooling
  • Experience with QA
  • Have worked on a significant system from scratch
  • Excited about blockchain and Web3

Nice to haves

  • You have a computer science degree.
  • Experience with GoLang

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

Software Engineering


Job Description

We are seeking a detail-oriented and data-savvy QA Engineer to join our dynamic software development team. This role has an emphasis on validating data integrity, pipeline reliability, and complex analytical insights.


Our team builds a high-throughput analytics platform that processes massive datasets to deliver dashboards and metrics from diverse data streams for the emergency call handling space. You will design, develop, and execute comprehensive test strategies that span across data ingestion, processing, storage, and front-end visualization layers.


Key Responsibilities


1. Data Validation & Pipeline Testing

  • Verify the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of data as it moves through data pipelines.
  • Validate data ingestion from various sources (APIs, webhooks, databases) against strict schemas.
  • Write SQL queries to perform data reconciliation between source systems and the data warehouse/lake.

2. Analytics & Report Verification

  • Test the business logic and mathematical correctness of aggregations, KPIs, and predictive metrics.
  • Ensure that user-facing charts, graphs, and dashboards accurately reflect the underlying data.
  • Conduct regression testing on analytics algorithms and reporting features to prevent data drift.

3. Test Automation & Infrastructure - Experience Advantageous

  • Design, build, and maintain automated testing frameworks for both APIs and UI dashboards.
  • Implement automated data quality checks within the CI/CD pipeline.
  • Mock large-scale datasets to simulate edge cases, high volume, and anomalous data.

4. Performance & Scalability Testing - Experience Advantageous

  • Evaluate how the analytics platform handles heavy concurrent user loads and massive data processing spikes.
  • Monitor query performance and report latency bottlenecks to the engineering team.

5. Collaboration & Agile Processes

  • Partner closely with Product Owners, Data Engineers, and Report Developers to understand complex tracking requirements and data models.
  • Participate in sprint planning, refinement, and retrospectives to advocate for quality and testability early in the development lifecycle.


Basic Requirements

Required Technical Skills & Qualifications:

  • Experience: 3+ years of experience as a QA Engineer, ideally within a data-intensive, BI, or analytics product environment.
  • Database Proficiency: SQL skills (joins, window functions, subqueries) for deep-dive data verification.
  • Automation Skills: Hands-on experience with automation tools (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) and backend/API testing tools (e.g., Postman, RestAssured).
  • Programming (Advantageous): Proficiency in at least one scripting language (preferably Python or JavaScript) for data manipulation and test automation.
  • Data Technologies: Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and tools (e.g., Synapse, Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and ETL pipelines.
  • Methodology: Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum development cycles and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins).
  • AI: AI use is encouraged and actively used to transform our technology stack.

Soft Skills & Cultural Fit

  • The "Data Mindset": An obsessive attention to detail—you spot a misplaced decimal point or an omitted data row from a mile away.
  • Analytical Thinker: Ability to understand complex business logic and translate it into edge-case test scenarios.
  • Strong Communicator: Ability to clearly explain technical data discrepancies to both developers and non-technical stakeholders.

job.title: QA Analyst – Security Testing
job.description:
Location: USA (East Coast), LATAM - Fully Remote

Employment type: PART-TIME

About Bizmoni Corp.

Bizmoni is building an AI Business Network designed to help people and businesses connect, earn, learn, and grow in the AI era.

As a seed-stage, pre-revenue company, we are strengthening our platform, growing our global ecosystem, and laying the foundations for future funding and scale. This is an opportunity to join an entrepreneurial, international team and help shape both the product and the business.

About the Role

We're looking for a detail-driven QA Analyst to own manual testing across our web applications and APIs. You'll turn requirements into clear test cases, run structured test cycles, and give the team reliable reporting on release quality. You'll also bring a security mindset, checking for common vulnerabilities as part of everyday testing.

You'll work closely with Business Analysts, Product Owners and developers from refinement to release, and help shape how we document and evidence our testing.

What You'll Do:

  • Review user stories, specifications and acceptance criteria early, and raise gaps, ambiguities and risks before development starts.
  • Take part in backlog refinement and sprint ceremonies alongside BAs, Product Owners and developers.
  • Write clear test plans, test scenarios and detailed test cases with expected results and test data.
  • Maintain a requirements traceability matrix so every requirement has test coverage.

Test execution and defect management

  • Run manual functional, regression, integration, end-to-end and exploratory testing across web, mobile and API layers.
  • Test APIs manually using tools such as Postman or Swagger.
  • Log defects with clear steps to reproduce, expected and actual results, evidence and severity, and track them through to closure in [Jira / Azure DevOps].
  • Retest fixes and maintain regression test packs for each release.
  • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by preparing scripts, guiding business users and capturing feedback.
  • Include basic security checks in your testing, such as access control, input validation, session handling and the OWASP Top 10, and escalate findings to the security team.

Reporting and documentation

  • Produce test progress, test summary and release readiness reports for engineering and business stakeholders.
  • Track and report on QA metrics such as test coverage, pass rates, defect trends and defect leakage.
  • Keep test documentation current in [TestRail / Xray / Zephyr / Confluence].
  • Contribute to QA processes and standards, and provide testing evidence for audits such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2.

What You'll Bring:

  • Manual testing experience. 3+ years in manual QA, testing web applications and APIs in an Agile environment.
  • Test case design. Strong at writing structured test cases using techniques such as boundary value analysis, equivalence partitioning and state transition.
  • Requirements analysis. Proven ability to analyse user stories and acceptance criteria, identify gaps and turn them into testable scenarios.
  • Documentation. Experience creating and maintaining test plans, traceability matrices and test summary reports.
  • Tools. Hands-on with Jira or Azure DevOps and a test management tool (TestRail, Xray, Zephyr or similar), plus Postman for API testing.
  • Technical foundations. Good understanding of web technologies, HTTP and REST, and basic SQL for checking data.
  • Security awareness. Working knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 and how to check for common issues during manual testing.
  • Clear reporting. You write precise defect reports and explain quality risks clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Nice to Have:

  • ISTQB Foundation certification (Advanced Test Analyst a plus).
  • Hands-on use of Burp Suite or OWASP ZAP for basic security testing.
  • Some exposure to test automation (Playwright, Selenium or Cypress), even if it isn't your main focus.
  • Experience supporting UAT with business users.
  • Background in a regulated sector such as fintech, banking or healthcare.
  • Experience with accessibility testing against WCAG 2.2.

Who Thrives at Bizmoni?

We look for people who demonstrate:

  • Ownership – Taking responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks
  • Results Orientation – Focusing on quality, execution, and impact
  • Continuous Improvement – Always looking for better ways to work and improve quality
  • Collaboration – Partnering effectively across teams and functions
  • Adaptability – Thriving in a dynamic and evolving environment
  • Mission Alignment – Believing in what we're building and its future potential

Compensation & Commitment

Bizmoni currently offers ONLY an equity-based compensation model, aligned with global startup practices that enable early contributors to participate in the company's potential long-term value creation.

The role requires a flexible commitment of approximately 8–16 hours per week, with clear deliverables and results-driven accountability. Contributors may maintain a primary paid role alongside their engagement with Bizmoni. As Bizmoni is currently seed-stage, compensation is provided in company equity. Full terms and conditions will be discussed during the selection process and confirmed in the consulting agreement.

Requirements for Remote Engagement:

  • Personal computer with camera and reliable internet connection
  • Willingness to participate in Bizmoni's equity-based compensation model

Why You'll Love Working at Bizmoni

  • Design the core AI agents of an emerging AI Business Network from day one
  • Set the technical architecture and standards that the platform will scale on
  • Work directly with founders and a talented, globally distributed team
  • Gain hands-on exposure to cutting-edge agentic AI, FinTech, and product initiatives
  • Contribute directly to Bizmoni's growth, scalability, and future funding readiness

Equal Opportunity Employer

Bizmoni is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive global environment where everyone is treated with dignity, fairness, and respect.

Engagement decisions are based on relevant skills, experience, potential, and business needs, without discrimination based on any characteristic protected by applicable law. We believe diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences strengthen our culture, innovation, and global network.

Before Applying, Ask Yourself:

  • Are you open to ONLY equity-based compensation?
  • Are you open to dedicating a min. of 16 hrs weekly on our project?

If your answers are YES, then we are happy to meet you!

Recruitment Process:

  1. Interview with Leadership Team & TA Partner.
  1. Technical conversation / agent design discussion with [CTO / technical lead].
  1. Offer (based on final positive feedback).

Please send us your English CV stating the role you apply for. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview. Thank you.

job.title: Senior Quality Engineer - MONOPOLY GO!
job.description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Quality Engineer to join the MONOPOLY GO! team. The role can be based remotely in the UK, or in Barcelona or Seville on a hybrid basis, with three days a week in the office.

 

MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day—whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities. We are a global team of game lovers developing, publishing, and innovating across the games industry, connecting millions of players around the world every day.

The MONOPOLY GO! Tech Vertical develops the platforms, services, and engineering capabilities that support a reliable, responsive mobile gaming experience.We are building a Quality Engineering organization that embeds quality throughout development through automation, continuous validation, and shared engineering ownership.

 

 

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Quality Engineer who enjoys writing code, solving complex problems, and building tools that help teams deliver with confidence. Reporting to the Quality Director of Tech, you will help establish our QE capabilities through hands-on development of automation frameworks, test infrastructure, and quality insights across mobile, Unity, APIs, integrations, performance, and CI/CD.

You will help build our Quality Engineering capabilities incrementally, prioritizing the areas of greatest risk and value with the team. We are building these capabilities while supporting an active live-service game. You will take ownership of immediate testing needs, including manual, exploratory, and release validation, while developing sustainable automation and tooling. A willingness to test directly is essential. You will use what you learn to guide automation priorities, while recognizing the continuing value of exploratory testing, and develop practical AI capabilities that improve engineering effectiveness.

 

What You Will Do

  • Build reusable engineering solutions. Write, review, debug, and maintain automation frameworks, tools, and test infrastructure that other engineers can adopt and extend.
  • Improve testability from the start. Participate in technical design and code reviews to identify risks early and improve test hooks, service interfaces, and diagnostic capabilities.
  • Balance building with hands-on testing. Perform manual, exploratory, and release testing where automation is not yet available or direct investigation provides greater value. Meet current delivery needs while building sustainable solutions.
  • Develop mobile and Unity automation. Automate Android, iOS, and Unity workflows, accounting for device differences, application lifecycle events, network conditions, and client performance.
  • Strengthen API and integration testing. Validate backend services, service contracts, client-server interactions, data integrity, and failure recovery through reliable automated tests.
  • Validate player-state consistency and recovery. Test interrupted sessions, reconnects, retries, and client-server synchronization to help protect player progress and data integrity.
  • Investigate failures across systems. Use logs, metrics, traces, crash reports, and telemetry to investigate client, backend, and integration failures, support root-cause analysis, and turn findings into regression coverage.
  • Validate mobile and backend performance. Profile frame rate, memory usage, application startup, crashes, and responsiveness. Develop backend load, stress, and endurance tests, establish meaningful baselines, and investigate bottlenecks and regressions with engineers.
  • Apply risk-based testing. Prioritize validation by player impact, technical complexity, change scope, and failure history. Combine service-level tests, targeted end-to-end automation, and exploratory testing.
  • Integrate validation into CI/CD. Deliver reliable automated feedback, useful diagnostics, and maintainable quality checks. Improve test stability and execution time, with clear ownership of failures.
  • Improve test data and environments. Build utilities, fixtures, and repeatable setup processes that make testing dependable and defects easier to reproduce.
  • Develop AI-assisted quality workflows. Build and evaluate solutions for test generation, failure triage, regression selection, and coverage analysis, with human review and measurable outcomes.
  • Strengthen telemetry validation and quality visibility. Partner with engineering and analytics to validate telemetry accuracy, completeness, duplicates, schema changes, and data freshness. Query large datasets to investigate issues and build quality dashboards that inform risk assessment and release decisions.
  • Help establish the QE organization. Contribute standards, documentation, reusable patterns, and mentoring. Partner with developers, Quality Analysts, and technical leaders to strengthen shared ownership of quality.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Demonstrated quality engineering, software development in test, or software engineering experience, including hands-on ownership of automation used by other engineers.
  • Strong programming skills in C# or Python, with the ability to work effectively in Unity and automation codebases. Experience in source control, code reviews, debugging, and maintainable software design.
  • Practical experience testing and automating Android and iOS applications, including device coverage, operating system differences, and unreliable network conditions.
  • Experience developing API and integration tests, diagnosing failures across services and data flows, and integrating reliable automated tests into CI/CD.
  • Working knowledge of performance, risk-based, and exploratory testing, with sound judgment about what to automate and when to investigate directly.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and practical experience with telemetry and big data, including querying large datasets, validating events and data pipelines, and using findings to guide testing and release decisions.
  • Experience with AI-assisted engineering tools and the ability to evaluate the accuracy and usefulness of their outputs.
  • Strong ownership and collaborative problem-solving, with the ability to turn ambiguous needs into practical solutions. A passion for quality, mobile games, AI, and technology.
  • Advanced professional proficiency in spoken and written English, sufficient to participate independently in technical discussions, explain engineering decisions, and write clear documentation with global teams.

 

Additional experience we value

  • Hands-on experience with Unity, C#, Unity Test Framework, or automated testing of Unity-based mobile games.
  • Experience with live-service games, player-state consistency, reconnect behavior, live configuration, or client-server synchronization.
  • Experience with mobile device farms, observability, quality dashboards, or establishing QE capabilities within a growing team.

 

What success looks like

Teams receive faster, more trustworthy feedback and clearer visibility into release risk. Immediate testing needs are met while dependable automation grows around critical player journeys and integrations. Performance regressions surface earlier, failures are easier to diagnose, and repetitive effort decreases. Your tools are maintained, documented, and adopted by other engineers, and AI capabilities demonstrate measurable value.

 

 

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

job.title: QA/Test Automation Engineer (Journeyman)
job.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a QA/Test Automation Engineer to validate accession-processing workflows, business rules, integrations, and exception paths for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This role prepares traceable functional test cases and test data, conducts exploratory and regression testing, supports automated test coverage, and documents objective evidence of software quality.

The QA/Test Automation Engineer works with requirements analysts, developers, senior testers, architects, cybersecurity personnel, DevSecOps engineers, mission stakeholders, and Government users. The position supports defect identification and verification, sprint demonstrations, user acceptance testing, and release-readiness activities.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The QA/Test Automation Engineer will:

  • Analyze requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, workflows, and technical documentation to determine testing needs.
  • Develop and maintain functional test scenarios, test cases, test scripts, test data, and expected results.
  • Validate accession-processing workflows, business rules, calculations, decision logic, integrations, data relationships, and exception paths.
  • Ensure test cases are traceable to approved requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and identified risks.
  • Maintain traceability among requirements, test cases, test results, defects, corrections, and release outcomes.
  • Conduct functional, integration, system, exploratory, regression, smoke, and end-to-end testing.
  • Develop, execute, maintain, or improve automated regression tests where appropriate.
  • Identify repeatable, stable, and high-value test scenarios suitable for automation.
  • Support the execution of automated tests through approved build, test, or continuous-integration pipelines.
  • Prepare representative test data while protecting sensitive information.
  • Execute tests in development, integration, test, staging, or other Government-approved environments.
  • Document test results and retain complete, repeatable, and auditable test evidence.
  • Capture screenshots, logs, system responses, data comparisons, and other evidence needed to demonstrate test outcomes.
  • Identify, document, prioritize, and track software defects through resolution.
  • Prepare defect reports with reproducible steps, expected results, actual results, severity, evidence, and affected requirements.
  • Collaborate with developers and senior testers to reproduce issues, clarify expected behavior, and support root-cause analysis.
  • Verify defect corrections and perform targeted regression testing to identify unintended impacts.
  • Participate in defect-triage meetings and communicate testing progress, unresolved issues, and quality concerns.
  • Support Government user acceptance testing by preparing test cases and data, assisting users, documenting results, and tracking findings.
  • Distinguish potential defects from training, configuration, data, environment, or requirements issues.
  • Support sprint demonstrations, capability reviews, operational validation, and stakeholder-feedback activities.
  • Coordinate with cybersecurity personnel to verify approved security corrections and associated regression impacts.
  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily coordination, reviews, demonstrations, and retrospectives.
  • Maintain test artifacts, defect records, evidence, status information, and quality metrics in approved tools and repositories.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of test coverage, automation, defect prevention, evidence management, and quality practices.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Candidates must possess all the following:

  • An active Secret clearance or higher.
  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, software engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent permitted by the applicable labor category.
  • At least six years of relevant professional experience.
  • Experience performing functional software testing.
  • Experience validating complex workflows, business rules, decision logic, integrations, or exception paths.
  • Experience developing and executing functional test cases and test data.
  • Experience conducting exploratory and regression testing.
  • Experience documenting test results and retaining objective test evidence.
  • Experience identifying, documenting, tracking, and verifying software defects.
  • Ability to maintain traceability among requirements, test cases, test results, defects, and corrections.
  • Ability to develop, execute, maintain, or support automated regression tests.
  • Ability to analyze requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to determine test coverage.
  • Ability to support Government or customer user acceptance testing.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, technical documentation, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with analysts, developers, senior testers, cybersecurity personnel, DevSecOps engineers, and Government stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred:

  • A recognized software-testing certification, such as an ISTQB certification, Certified Software Tester (CSTE), Certified Software Quality Analyst (CSQA), or an equivalent credential.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense software-development or modernization programs.
  • Experience testing military accession processing, personnel processing, regulated workflows, or other rules-intensive mission systems.
  • Experience with automation tools or frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Cucumber, Postman, REST Assured, JMeter, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience developing automated tests using Java, C#, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or another supported programming language.
  • Experience testing web applications, APIs, databases, interfaces, batch processes, or event-driven services.
  • Experience with requirements traceability matrices and test-management platforms.
  • Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, TestRail, Zephyr, Xray, Confluence, or comparable testing and collaboration tools.
  • Experience integrating automated tests with continuous-integration and continuous-delivery pipelines.
  • Familiarity with performance, security, accessibility, compatibility, or resilience testing.
  • Familiarity with Section 508 accessibility testing and assistive-technology validation.
  • Familiarity with Agile, DevSecOps, configuration-management, and secure software-development practices.
