job.title: Performance & Resilience Test Engineer (Journeyman)
job.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Performance & Resilience Test Engineer to evaluate the scalability, stability, responsiveness, failover behavior, and recovery capabilities of mission-critical software supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This role develops regression, API, integration, load, stress, endurance, and resilience tests; creates realistic workload models; and produces reproducible evidence of system behavior under normal, peak, degraded, and recovery conditions.

The Performance & Resilience Test Engineer works with architects, software developers, API and integration engineers, infrastructure and cloud teams, database specialists, cybersecurity personnel, CI/CD engineers, operations teams, and Government stakeholders. The position identifies performance bottlenecks, validates failover and recovery procedures, and provides evidence-based recommendations supporting release readiness, capacity planning, and operational resilience.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Performance & Resilience Test Engineer will:

  • Develop and maintain performance, load, stress, spike, endurance, volume, scalability, failover, and recovery tests.
  • Build automated regression, API, and integration tests supporting repeatable performance and resilience validation.
  • Analyze mission workflows, usage patterns, transaction volumes, concurrency, data characteristics, interfaces, and operational objectives.
  • Develop workload models that represent normal operations, peak demand, surge conditions, degraded environments, and recovery scenarios.
  • Define test objectives, performance baselines, service thresholds, acceptance criteria, and measurable expected results.
  • Develop test plans, scenarios, scripts, data, configurations, and execution schedules.
  • Prepare representative test data for functional, high-volume, boundary, exception, failover, and recovery scenarios.
  • Maintain repeatable processes for test-data creation, setup, refresh, reset, reconciliation, and cleanup.
  • Execute tests in development, integration, test, staging, performance, or other Government-approved environments.
  • Automate test execution through approved CI/CD pipelines where appropriate.
  • Produce reproducible test results, logs, reports, metrics, graphs, and objective evidence.
  • Measure and analyze response time, throughput, latency, concurrency, error rates, resource utilization, saturation, queue depth, and transaction completion.
  • Establish performance baselines and compare results across builds, releases, configurations, environments, and infrastructure changes.
  • Identify application, database, interface, network, cloud, infrastructure, configuration, or external-service bottlenecks.
  • Correlate test results with application logs, infrastructure metrics, traces, events, and monitoring data.
  • Work with technical teams to isolate root causes and recommend appropriate corrective actions.
  • Validate failover behavior for applications, services, interfaces, databases, infrastructure components, and dependent capabilities.
  • Test approved recovery procedures and confirm that services return to an acceptable operational state.
  • Validate recovery sequencing, data consistency, transaction handling, dependency restoration, and post-recovery functionality.
  • Evaluate behavior during component failures, network interruptions, service degradation, capacity constraints, and dependency outages.
  • Verify that systems fail safely and provide appropriate errors, alerts, retries, timeouts, and recovery behavior.
  • Support disaster-recovery, continuity, restoration, and operational-readiness exercises where applicable.
  • Document performance defects, resilience gaps, capacity risks, recovery failures, and release impacts.
  • Support defect triage, root-cause analysis, correction verification, and targeted regression testing.
  • Coordinate with architects and engineering teams to evaluate scalability, capacity, extensibility, and recovery approaches.
  • Coordinate with CI/CD engineers to integrate repeatable performance checks, thresholds, reports, and quality gates.
  • Coordinate with operations teams to incorporate production observations and operational feedback into future testing.
  • Support Government demonstrations, user acceptance testing, release testing, and operational validation.
  • Provide performance and resilience results, residual risks, and release-readiness recommendations to technical and program stakeholders.
  • Maintain test source code, scripts, configurations, data, and documentation in approved version-control repositories.
  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, demonstrations, retrospectives, and release-readiness activities.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of performance engineering, workload modeling, observability, failover testing, and recovery validation.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Candidates must possess all the following:

  • An active Secret clearance or higher.
  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent permitted by the applicable labor category.
  • At least six years of relevant professional experience.
  • Experience designing and executing load and performance tests.
  • Experience developing realistic workload models based on user behavior, transaction volumes, concurrency, or operational demand.
  • Experience analyzing performance results and identifying application, integration, database, infrastructure, or network bottlenecks.
  • Experience planning or executing failover tests.
  • Experience validating system, application, service, or data recovery.
  • Ability to build or maintain regression, API, integration, and automated test coverage.
  • Ability to prepare and maintain representative test data.
  • Ability to produce repeatable automated execution and reproducible test results.
  • Ability to define measurable performance baselines, thresholds, acceptance criteria, and expected results.
  • Ability to correlate test results with logs, metrics, traces, events, or other observability data.
  • Ability to document performance defects, resilience gaps, capacity risks, recovery failures, and release impacts.
  • CompTIA Security+ CE or another Government-approved certification satisfying the required IAT Level II qualification and applicable current DoD 8140 work-role requirements, when required for the assigned duties.
  • Strong analytical, automation, troubleshooting, technical documentation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with architects, developers, integration engineers, database specialists, infrastructure teams, cybersecurity personnel, CI/CD engineers, operations teams, and Government stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred:

  • A recognized performance-testing, software-testing, cloud, or site-reliability certification.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense software-development, modernization, testing, or continuity programs.
  • Experience testing mission-critical, regulated, security-sensitive, high-volume, or high-availability systems.
  • Experience with performance-testing tools such as LoadRunner, JMeter, Gatling, k6, NeoLoad, Locust, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience developing test automation using Java, C#, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or another supported programming language.
  • Experience testing APIs, web services, event-driven systems, message brokers, databases, batch interfaces, or cloud-native services.
  • Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, New Relic, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Grafana, Prometheus, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience with AWS, Azure, containers, Kubernetes, serverless services, or hybrid cloud environments.
  • Experience with CI/CD platforms such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, AWS CodePipeline, or comparable solutions.
  • Knowledge of site reliability engineering concepts, including service-level indicators, service-level objectives, error budgets, saturation, and capacity planning.
  • Experience with disaster-recovery testing, continuity exercises, recovery-time objectives, or recovery-point objectives.
  • Experience with resilience testing, controlled fault injection, or approved chaos-engineering practices.
  • Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, TestRail, Zephyr, Xray, Confluence, or comparable testing and collaboration tools.
  • Familiarity with Agile, DevSecOps, secure software-development, configuration-management, and release-management practices.

job.title: Integration/Test Automation Engineer (Journeyman)
job.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks an Integration/Test Automation Engineer to build and maintain automated regression, API, integration, and load tests for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This role creates repeatable automated test coverage, maintains representative test data, integrates test execution with CI/CD pipelines, and produces reproducible results and objective verification evidence.

The Integration/Test Automation Engineer works with software developers, API and integration engineers, functional testers, architects, cybersecurity personnel, CI/CD engineers, operations teams, and Government stakeholders. The position helps identify defects earlier, improves regression coverage, validates interfaces and data exchanges, and provides reliable quality feedback throughout the software-development lifecycle.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Integration/Test Automation Engineer will:

  • Design, develop, execute, maintain, and improve automated software tests.
  • Build automated regression suites covering critical application capabilities and mission workflows.
  • Develop API tests that validate requests, responses, schemas, authentication, authorization, error handling, and business rules.
  • Develop integration tests that validate interfaces, adapters, services, data exchanges, dependencies, and end-to-end processing.
  • Develop load and performance tests to evaluate throughput, response time, concurrency, resource utilization, stability, and failure behavior.
  • Translate requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, interface specifications, data mappings, and technical designs into automated test coverage.
  • Maintain traceability among automated tests, requirements, interfaces, defects, and release content.
  • Design and maintain representative test data for positive, negative, boundary, exception, and high-volume scenarios.
  • Develop repeatable processes for test-data creation, setup, masking, refresh, reset, reconciliation, and cleanup.
  • Protect sensitive data and use approved synthetic, masked, or controlled test data.
  • Integrate automated tests into approved continuous-integration and continuous-delivery pipelines.
  • Configure appropriate triggers, quality gates, result thresholds, notifications, and failure conditions.
  • Ensure automated tests provide timely and actionable feedback to development, testing, integration, and operations teams.
  • Maintain automated execution across development, integration, test, staging, and other approved environments.
  • Improve test reliability by identifying and correcting unstable, inconsistent, environment-dependent, or non-deterministic tests.
  • Produce complete and reproducible test results, logs, reports, metrics, and objective evidence.
  • Document test configurations, dependencies, data conditions, execution procedures, expected results, and known limitations.
  • Analyze failed tests and distinguish product defects from test-script, test-data, environment, configuration, or dependency issues.
  • Create clear defect reports with reproducible steps, expected and actual results, evidence, and affected requirements.
  • Support defect triage, root-cause analysis, correction verification, and regression testing.
  • Coordinate with API and integration engineers to validate service contracts, mappings, schemas, data transformations, and interoperability.
  • Coordinate with CI/CD engineers to improve automated execution, artifact retention, test reporting, and pipeline reliability.
  • Coordinate with cybersecurity personnel to validate security corrections and integrate approved security testing where applicable.
  • Support Government demonstrations, user acceptance testing, release testing, and operational validation.
  • Provide automation coverage, execution status, defect trends, performance results, and quality risks for release-readiness decisions.
  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily coordination, reviews, demonstrations, and retrospectives.
  • Maintain test source code, scripts, configurations, data, and documentation in approved version-control repositories.

  • Experience producing or reviewing architecture diagrams, System Design Documents, Interface Control Documents, Interface Design Documents, requirements-traceability records, and architecture decision records.

DecisionPoint seeks a QA/Test Automation Engineer to validate complex accession-processing workflows, business rules, integrations, and exception paths for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This senior role develops traceable functional test cases and test data, conducts exploratory and regression testing, supports automated test coverage, and documents objective evidence of software quality.

job.title: Sr. Manager, QA Engineering & Automation
job.description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior QA Manager, Automation & Tooling to join our team supporting a soon-to-be-announced AAA mobile game title. This role can be remote in the US and Canada, or hybrid in Culver City.

You will lead the automation strategy for a live game, building the people, processes, frameworks, and tooling required to scale quality across frequent releases and a large, active player base. You will partner closely with Engineering, QA, Live Operations, and other disciplines to establish a development culture where automation is a shared responsibility and a core component of product quality.

At Scopely, we create and operate games played by millions of people around the world. This role is an opportunity to shape how quality engineering evolves from the ground up for a high-scale live mobile game.

What You Will Do

  • Define and execute the QA automation strategy for a live mobile game, including scalable frameworks, tooling, standards, and quality gates.
  • Build and lead an automation team from the ground up, including hiring, team structure, processes, mentorship, and career development.
  • Design, build, and implement automated testing across UI, API, integration, regression, end-to-end, mobile, and live-operations workflows.
  • Evaluate automation approaches, frameworks, platforms, and traditional or AI-assisted tools based on coverage, maintainability, speed, and value.
  • Establish automation standards, coding practices, test architecture, reporting, observability, and quality gates that can scale with the game and organization. 
  • Partner with Engineering and QA to prioritize automation, improve testability, integrate testing into CI/CD, and establish shared ownership of automated tests, ensuring automation is part of the definition of done for every feature.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership through framework design, prototypes, code reviews, automation implementation, and test-script development.
  • Mentor manual testers as they develop coding and automation skills, while defining metrics for coverage, stability, flakiness, execution time, and defect detection.
  • Communicate quality risks, automation progress, and investment needs while partnering with Product, Live Operations, Marketing, Customer Support, Localization, and external development teams.
  • Champion quality and release excellence across the organization while ensuring automation supports—not replaces—strong exploratory and risk-based testing.

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years of experience in QA, test automation, or quality engineering, including 4+ years leading or building automation teams.
  • Proven experience creating automation strategies, frameworks, tooling, and infrastructure for complex products, ideally from the ground up.
  • Experience evaluating automation approaches and tools, integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, and scaling quality practices for frequent live releases.
  • Hands-on programming experience in one or more languages; C# preferred.
  • Strong understanding of testing methodologies, automation architecture, coding practices, testability, and software development lifecycles.
  • Experience mentoring manual testers in coding, automation, and automated test-script development.
  • Proven ability to align Engineering and QA around automation, shared quality ownership, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience with mobile testing and familiarity with traditional and AI-assisted testing tools; game-testing experience preferred.
  • Experience with test management, defect tracking, source control, build systems, CI/CD, and release-management tools.
  • Strong communication, organization, analytical, stakeholder-management, and distributed-team leadership skills.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working on a live mobile, free-to-play, or core game.
  • Experience with mobile-device farms, emulators, simulators, or cloud-based device testing.
  • Experience testing Unity, Unreal, or other game-engine-based products.
  • Experience with API, backend-service, data, performance, load, or reliability automation.
  • Experience automating live events, remote configuration, experimentation, monetization, or service-driven game features.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered test generation, test maintenance, visual validation, defect triage, or code-assistance tools.
  • Experience establishing automation metrics, quality dashboards, and engineering quality gates.
  • Experience working across internal and external development partners.

 

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/. 

Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official website and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @scopely.com.

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice.

Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

job.title: Senior Quality Engineer
job.description:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

At Robinhood, Quality Engineering (QE) is a critical function within our broader engineering organization. We serve as the final line of defense for product quality—empowering teams to ship confidently by embedding robust test strategies, running critical end-to-end checks, and maintaining automation systems that scale with our product velocity. Our mission is to uphold a high bar for customer experience, especially during P0 launches, through a mix of technical expertise, test execution, and cross-functional collaboration.

As a Senior Quality Engineer, you will support high-impact product launches by designing test strategies, executing manual and automated testing, and partnering with our contractor team on regression test cycles. This role requires someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, cares deeply about the customer experience, and is eager to shape the test infrastructure behind Robinhood’s iOS, Android, and Web apps.

This role is based in our New York City, New York office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

  • Own the quality of new features, including test planning, execution, and feedback throughout the development cycle
  • Define and implement test strategies for P0 product launches, including both frontend and backend validation
  • Perform manual and automated testing, with a focus on end-to-end functionality
  • Automate mobile/web E2E test cases
  • Build test coverage that accurately reflects the user experience, including functional, regression, and exploratory testing

What you bring

  • Proven experience testing mobile (iOS/Android) and web applications in fast-paced product environments
  • Strong understanding of quality assurance principles, test case development, and test execution
  • Hands-on experience with UI automation tools such as Appium, Selenium, Playwright
  • Comfort with scripting languages (e.g., Python, Java) and test infrastructure tools
  • Familiarity with bug tracking (e.g., Jira) and test case management tools (e.g., TestRail)
  • Excellent communication skills, user empathy, and a detail-oriented mindset

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
  • Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
  • Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
  • Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process.

Base Pay Range:

Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC)
$153,000—$180,000 USD

$134,000—$158,000 USD

$119,000—$140,000 USD

Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity.

If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application.

Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. job.title: Manager, FCC Monitoring & Testing, Americas
job.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

Airwallex is redesigning its Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) Program and second-line function, and this role will provide independent assurance that the program is designed and operating effectively. Reporting to the Director of FCC Monitoring, you’ll lead monitoring and testing across the Americas, helping Airwallex meet regulatory expectations as it grows into new products, regions, customer cohorts and licensing requirements.

  • Redesign and strengthen Airwallex’s FCC monitoring and testing approach across the Americas.

  • Build and deliver a regional assurance plan covering the US, Canada, Brazil and Mexico, aligned to local risk assessments, products, entities and regulatory expectations.

  • Map the control inventory to regional risk assessments, identify gaps in testing coverage by entity and product, and draft the annual testing plan around state examination cycles.

  • Use data analytics and AI thoughtfully to make monitoring and testing more proactive, efficient and auditable, while documenting methodologies, evidence and conclusions clearly.

  • Partner with local and regional MLROs, FCC Operations, Product, the VP of FCC, regulators, banking partners and senior leadership to assess control effectiveness and support expansion into new products, regions, customer cohorts and licensing requirements.

  • Establish strong working relationships across a new global function, operating independently across multiple time zones and contributing to a future-ready FCC Program.

This remote role is based in Dallas

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • Deep understanding of global AML and Sanctions frameworks, including regulatory expectations across the US regions.

  • Proven experience in program monitoring and testing, with evidence of enhancing the effectiveness of a financial crime compliance program.

  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with demonstrated ability to engage senior executives, regulators and global business leaders on complex financial crime risk matters.

  • Experience operating in a second-line financial crime compliance, risk or assurance function, with the independence and judgment to assess program effectiveness.

  • Strong understanding of sanctions oversight and its role within an FCC Program.

  • Ability to work autonomously, manage your own workload and deliver high-quality, well-documented work across multiple jurisdictions and time zones.

  • Experience using data analytics, automation or AI-enabled approaches to improve monitoring, testing or assurance methodologies.

Preferred

  • Experience working with or supporting Group MLRO, Regional MLRO or Country MLRO functions, including governance committees, regulatory engagements and risk oversight activities.

  • Risk and controls experience.

You'll thrive here if

  • You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching. Quality and accountability aren't external expectations; they're internal ones.

  • You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work.

  • You come to the table with a point of view, not just a problem.

Learn more about your team

Regulatory & Compliance is where we build the trust, discipline, and operational resilience required to scale a generational financial platform.

As Airwallex grows across 30+ markets, this team turns regulatory complexity into strategic control. You'll lead compliance, enterprise risk, and regulatory engagement in a way that protects the business while letting it move with conviction. Our ambition goes beyond meeting expectations: we're building a risk posture that acts as a competitive moat, grounded in ownership, proactive regulatory partnerships, and frameworks that scale globally while respecting local nuance.

It's a team for strategic operators with sharp judgment, high standards, and the confidence to execute at pace in a high-stakes environment. You'll thrive here if you can balance rigor with progress and influence across functions.

If you want to architect the benchmark for trust and resilience in global finance, your work here will have a massive impact.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

job.title: Senior Security Specialist – Penetration Testing
job.description:

job.title: Director, Enterprise Quality Engineering and Agentic Evaluation
job.description:
Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

We are seeking an experienced Director, Enterprise Quality Engineering and Agentic Evaluation to build and lead a modern enterprise quality capability across Zayo’s technology organization. This role will be accountable for improving the reliability, predictability, and speed of technology delivery while providing independent assurance for critical business platforms, transformational programs, and AI-enabled solutions.

The successful candidate will combine deep quality engineering expertise with strong enterprise leadership, bringing a risk-based, automation-first approach to how quality is embedded across the software delivery lifecycle. The role will also shape how Zayo evaluates and governs emerging agentic AI capabilities, ensuring they are reliable, controlled, and ready for enterprise-scale adoption.


This is a highly collaborative and transformational leadership role, partnering across Engineering, Product, Architecture, Data and AI, Operations, and business teams to strengthen quality outcomes, reduce production risk, and establish a culture of measurable engineering excellence.


Key Responsibilities

  • Define and lead Zayo’s enterprise quality engineering strategy, operating model, roadmap, service catalog, standards, and governance.
  • Own the enterprise quality engineering platform, including Tosca, qTest, automation assets, integrations, test execution infrastructure, quality reporting, and AI-evaluation capabilities.
  • Establish risk-based quality models, release-readiness criteria, quality gates, certification standards, and evidence requirements for critical platforms, business processes, integrations, data products, and AI agents.
  • Lead a centralized quality engineering service that plans, automates, executes, and governs testing across enterprise products, platforms, programs, and high-risk releases.
  • Develop reusable automation frameworks, model-based testing patterns, API and integration testing capabilities, regression suites, and continuous testing practices aligned to business risk and production impact.
  • Establish enterprise capabilities for AI-agent evaluation, including scenario design, evaluation datasets, regression testing, tool-use validation, policy and permission checks, human escalation criteria, and production quality monitoring.
  • Own the enterprise approach to test data, test environments, service virtualization, production validation, and quality analytics to reduce release risk and delivery delays.
  • Provide independent quality intelligence and release-risk assessments to engineering, product, program, and executive stakeholders.
  • Manage vendor-outsourced quality engineering resources, Tricentis partners, systems integrators, and specialist testing providers to deliver sustained enterprise quality outcomes.
  • Build a quality engineering culture focused on automation, objective assurance, reuse, engineering discipline, measurable outcomes, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • Minimum of twelve (12) years of experience in quality engineering, software testing, test automation, platform engineering, enterprise technology delivery, or related technology disciplines, including 5+ years leading quality engineering, test automation, enterprise testing, or platform-oriented teams.
  • Demonstrated experience building or leading modern quality engineering capabilities beyond manual test execution, including automation strategy, risk-based testing, continuous testing, quality gates, and release assurance.
  • Strong experience with enterprise test automation and test management platforms, preferably Tricentis Tosca and qTest.
  • Experience leading testing or quality engineering across multiple products, platforms, business processes, programs, or business units.
  • Strong understanding of API, integration, data, workflow, cloud, event-driven, distributed-system, performance, resilience, and production validation testing.
  • Practical knowledge of generative AI, large language models, retrieval, AI agents, tool calling, evaluation methods, and responsible AI testing practices.
  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, vendor management, financial management, organizational leadership, and decision-making skills.

Estimated base salary range: $126,600 - $194,700 USD/annually.

Work Authorization Requirement: This position is not eligible for employment-based visa sponsorship. Zayo will not provide, transfer, or assume sponsorship for any employment visa or work authorization for this position now or in the future.


The base pay range shown is a guideline and reasonable estimate for this role. It takes into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions. Actual compensation offered may vary from the posted range based upon geographic location, work experience, skill level, certifications, and other business and organizational needs. Non- sales roles may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive plan. Sales roles may be eligible to participate in a sales incentive plan.


Additionally, this position may be eligible for certain benefits, such as health insurance, life insurance, disability retirement plans, paid time off.


The posting will be active for a minimum of 3 days. The active posting will continue to extend by 3 days until the position is filled.


Benefits, Rewards & Wellness

  • Excellent Health, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Retirement 401(k) Savings Plan
  • Generous paid time off policy including paid parental leave

Zayo is an equal opportunity employer to all protected groups, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the employment selection process, please contact us.


This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

job.description:
Role Overview

Our client is seeking an experienced Principal Test Lead to head and continuously enhance the organization’s software testing capability while also taking an active leadership role in major strategic initiatives. This position combines enterprise-level quality leadership with hands-on project delivery. The successful candidate will shape testing standards and governance across the business while directly leading complex project testing activities. The role requires strong technical testing expertise, proven leadership experience, and deep knowledge of both Agile and traditional software delivery environments.

Key Responsibilities

Testing Strategy & Functional Leadership

  • Define, implement, and continuously improve the organization’s overall testing strategy, frameworks, and standards.
  • Establish governance processes to ensure consistent quality practices across programs and projects.
  • Promote best practices in quality assurance, including automation and structured test lifecycle management.
  • Lead and mentor test professionals across teams, strengthening overall QA capability and performance.
  • Drive improvements in test planning, execution, reporting, metrics, and quality controls.
  • Partner with Technology, Product, and Business stakeholders to align testing efforts with delivery priorities and timelines.


Project-Level Test Leadership (Hands-On)

  • Lead testing for complex or business-critical initiatives, developing comprehensive test approaches and plans.
  • Oversee execution across functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing phases.
  • Coordinate test environments, test data, and defect management in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
  • Develop and maintain both manual and automated test assets where required.
  • Monitor and communicate testing progress, quality indicators, and risks to stakeholders.
  • Ensure traceability across requirements, test cases, and defect resolution.


Continuous Improvement & Innovation

  • Identify and evaluate modern testing tools, automation solutions, and emerging technologies (e.g., performance tools, AI-driven testing optimization).
  • Track and report on key quality metrics, using data insights to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Support DevOps and CI/CD practices by embedding automated testing within delivery pipelines.


Required Skills & Experience

Essential

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in software testing, including at least 3 years in a senior or leadership capacity.
  • Demonstrated experience leading or managing a testing function.
  • Proven ability to oversee QA efforts across multiple concurrent projects.
  • Strong understanding of test lifecycle management, automation practices, and non-functional testing (e.g., performance, security).
  • Hands-on experience with modern QA and automation tools such as XRay, Selenium, Playwright, Azure DevOps, Jira, TestRail, and Jenkins.
  • Working knowledge of Agile, Scrum, and DevOps methodologies.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder engagement, and leadership skills.


Desirable

  • Experience building or transforming a testing capability within an organization.
  • Relevant professional certification (e.g., ISTQB Advanced Test Manager or equivalent).
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and API testing tools (e.g., Postman, RestAssured).
  • Experience with test data management and environment provisioning practices.

Key Competencies

  • Strategic mindset combined with a practical, delivery-focused approach.
  • Strong commitment to quality and continuous improvement.
  • Effective mentor and team leader.
  • Analytical thinker with high attention to detail.
  • Collaborative and adaptable in cross-functional environments.

This is an excellent opportunity for a senior QA professional to influence enterprise-wide testing standards while remaining actively involved in high- impact project delivery.

job.description:
Job Title: Member of Technical Staff, Quality Engineering

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

The Role

You'll design and build an intelligent, highly automated quality engineering system where AI agents help generate tests, execute regression suites, investigate failures, and continuously improve test coverage.

You'll own the technical foundations that allow our engineering team to ship quickly and confidently without scaling QA headcount alongside product complexity.

We're looking for a Staff-level engineer with deep test automation expertise, strong software engineering fundamentals, and a track record of building systems that make quality an integrated, automated part of software development.

What You'll Do

  1. Build agentic QA systems: Design and implement AI-powered workflows for test generation, automated regression testing, failure analysis, and intelligent bug triage.
  2. Own test automation architecture: Build scalable, maintainable automation frameworks covering web applications, APIs, integrations, and critical end-to-end workflows.
  3. Make quality continuous: Integrate automated quality checks deeply into development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and release processes.
  4. Automate regression and triage: Develop systems that detect regressions, identify likely root causes, classify failures, and reduce the manual effort required to investigate issues.
  5. Improve testing intelligence: Leverage AI agents to identify coverage gaps, generate meaningful test scenarios, and prioritize testing based on product changes and risk.
  6. Design QA for scale: Build workflows that support growing product complexity and engineering velocity without requiring proportional increases in QA staffing.
  7. Establish quality observability: Create clear visibility into test reliability, regression trends, release readiness, and overall product quality.
  8. Raise the engineering bar: Mentor engineers, establish testing standards, and drive a culture where quality is owned across the engineering organization.

What We're Looking For

  1. Staff-level engineering expertise with deep experience in Quality Engineering, Software Development in Test (SDET), or Test Automation Architecture.
  2. Strong hands-on programming skills and experience building production-grade test automation frameworks.
  3. Extensive experience automating web applications, APIs, and complex end-to-end workflows.
  4. Expertise with modern testing frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, pytest, or equivalent technologies.
  5. Strong understanding of CI/CD, integration testing, contract testing, regression strategies, and test infrastructure.
  6. Proven experience designing scalable testing systems rather than exclusively writing or maintaining individual test cases.
  7. AI-native engineering habits: You already use AI coding agents extensively and have practical experience applying AI to test generation, automation, debugging, or quality workflows.
  8. Strong systems thinking, including the ability to identify bottlenecks and design automation that removes repetitive QA work.
  9. Experience establishing engineering quality standards and mentoring developers or QA engineers.
  10. Ability to independently own quality engineering architecture while remaining deeply hands-on.

Nice to have

  1. You've built AI-powered testing systems or agentic QA workflows used in real development environments.
  2. You've significantly reduced manual regression testing through intelligent automation.
  3. You've designed testing infrastructure that supports rapid product iteration with a small engineering team.
  4. You've worked on testing AI-powered products, including nondeterministic behaviors, model evaluations, or agentic workflows.
  5. You think about quality as an engineering platform rather than a separate phase of software delivery.
  6. You can move comfortably between writing automation code, investigating complex failures, and designing company-wide quality systems.

Compensation & Benefits Notice

The national pay range for this full-time position is base salary of $180,000 –$250,000. All employees are eligible for equity compensation, and employees may also receive performance-based bonuses, dependent on role and subject to company policies. micro1 provides a comprehensive benefits package, including up to 100% reimbursement for health-insurance premiums, paid time off, a 401(K) plan with a company match, and additional benefits designed to support a high-performing, remote-first workforce.

About our Company:

At Open Look Business Solutions Inc. - 032 Outsourcing, we believe that great teams build great businesses. Guided by our core values Positivity, Integrity, Tenacity, Dependability, and Belief we are committed to helping our clients grow while creating rewarding careers for our people.

About the Role:
As a Business Process Quality Assistant, you will support the Tech and Process Architect in ensuring that company processes are properly followed, documented, and continuously improved. Youll act as the first line of process policing — monitoring adherence, receiving and documenting feedback, and keeping all process documentation updated and accurate. Your role ensures that every department operates in alignment with defined procedures and that opportunities for improvement are consistently captured and escalated for review.

Key Responsibilities

1. Process Auditing and Compliance

Regularly review and monitor department operations to ensure adherence to documented processes.

Identify process gaps, inconsistencies, or non-compliance and record them clearly.

Conduct periodic spot checks and audits as scheduled.

2. Feedback and Escalation

Serve as the first receiver of feedback regarding processes, whether from staﬀ, leaders, or clients.

Organize and categorize feedback for easy tracking and resolution.

Escalate findings and recommendations to the Tech and Process Architect for evaluation and action.

3. Process Documentation

Maintain and update the companys process documentation and archives.

Assist in creating, formatting, and finalizing SOPs, process maps, and related materials.

Ensure version control and accessibility of all oﬃcial process documents.

4. Reporting and Support

Prepare regular reports summarizing audit results, feedback received, and areas for improvement.

Coordinate with department heads to clarify procedures and collect necessary data.

Support the Tech and Process Architect during process reviews, trainings, and quarterly evaluations.

What Success Looks Like

Processes across departments are clearly documented and consistently followed.

Feedback and findings are well-organized and easily traceable.

The Tech and Process Architect receives accurate reports that inform decision-making.

Departments see increased compliance and smoother internal operations.

Onboarding and Integration

During your first few weeks, youll:

Attend New Hire Orientation and Leadership Introductions.

Review the Accountability Chart, Department Deliverables, and Core Processes.

Shadow operations to understand daily workflows.

Begin documenting observations and process flow notes.

Assist in creating the Quality Audit schedule.

Support quarterly and other scheduled reviews and reporting activities.

job.title: Quality Assurance Lead
job.description:
The QA Lead is accountable for the quality assurance practice across product delivery, ensuring that software is testable, test execution is timely and transparent, critical defects are surfaced early, and releases meet agreed quality standards. This role leads day-to-day QA planning and execution, strengthens automation and regression coverage, coaches QA team members, and works closely with Product Owners and Engineering to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle rather than treating testing as a final-stage activity.

The QA Lead is expected to create clear visibility into test readiness, progress, risk, and blockers. The role owns the operating discipline of QA: defining test approaches, ensuring execution begins when planned, maintaining useful quality metrics, driving defect triage, and escalating issues early when delivery or release quality is at risk.

Key Responsibilities

Quality Leadership & Accountability
  • Own the day-to-day QA practice and establish consistent expectations for test planning, execution, documentation, and release readiness.
  • Ensure QA work begins when planned and that delays, blockers, environment issues, data needs, or scope gaps are identified and communicated immediately.
  • Create transparency into what has been tested, what remains untested, current defects, quality risks, and confidence in release readiness.
  • Hold QA team members accountable for execution commitments, timely updates, accurate status reporting, and follow-through.
  • Coach QA team members on testing discipline, risk-based thinking, root-cause analysis, and stronger ownership of outcomes.
Test Strategy, Planning & Execution
  • Develop and maintain test strategies for new features, enhancements, integrations, defects, and platform changes.
  • Partner with Product Owners early in discovery and refinement to identify test scenarios, edge cases, data needs, dependencies, and acceptance criteria before development is complete.
  • Ensure test cases provide adequate functional, integration, regression, negative, end-to-end, and workflow coverage based on business and technical risk.
  • Coordinate test data, environments, integrations, and dependencies required for successful QA execution.
  • Confirm that critical workflows can be tested end-to-end before work is considered ready for business UAT.
  • Use risk-based testing to prioritize the highest-value scenarios when time or environment constraints require tradeoffs.
Defect Management & Release Readiness
  • Lead defect triage in partnership with Product and Engineering, ensuring severity, priority, business impact, and ownership are clear.
  • Track critical defects through resolution and retest and ensure unresolved quality risks are explicitly documented before release decisions.
  • Define and enforce practical QA exit criteria, including expectations for critical defect closure, regression completion, and stability.
  • Provide an objective quality recommendation for releases based on test evidence and known risk.
  • Identify recurring defect patterns and partner with Engineering and Product on preventive actions rather than relying only on downstream testing.
Automation & Continuous Improvement
  • Develop and maintain a pragmatic test automation strategy focused on high-value regression, repeatable workflows, integrations, and business-critical scenarios.
  • Partner with QA Automation Engineers and Engineering to increase reliable automated coverage without creating brittle or low-value automation.
  • Use modern AI-assisted tools, where appropriate, to accelerate test-case creation, test-data design, automation development, and quality analysis while preserving human review and accountability.
  • Evaluate test tooling, frameworks, and processes and recommend improvements that increase efficiency, coverage, and maintainability.
  • Reduce manual regression effort over time by identifying the strongest candidates for automation and incorporating automated tests into delivery pipelines where feasible.
Cross-Functional Partnership
  • Work closely with Product Owners to ensure requirements and acceptance criteria are clear, testable, and aligned to expected business outcomes.
  • Partner with Engineering on defect prevention, unit/integration test expectations, environment stability, observability, and root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate with Architecture and platform teams when quality issues involve integration, infrastructure, data movement, or systemic technical risk.
  • Support business UAT by ensuring the product is genuinely ready for validation and by helping distinguish blocking defects from non-blocking follow-up work.
  • Communicate quality risk in clear business terms so leadership can make informed release and prioritization decisions.
Metrics & Reporting
  • Maintain a small, actionable set of QA metrics that reflect product quality and execution health rather than activity alone.
  • Track measures such as test execution progress, escaped defects, defect severity, defect reopen rate, regression coverage, automation coverage, UAT rework, and recurring defect trends.
  • Use metrics to identify systemic improvement opportunities and to show whether changes to process, automation, or requirements quality are producing measurable results.
  • Provide concise status reporting that clearly states current quality, material risks, blockers, required decisions, and next actions.
Required Qualifications
  • Significant hands-on experience in software quality assurance, including functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.
  • Experience leading QA execution, mentoring testers, or functioning as a senior/lead resource responsible for quality outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery and the role of QA throughout discovery, development, testing, UAT, and release.
  • Demonstrated ability to create test strategies and translate complex business workflows into thorough, risk-based test coverage.
  • Experience managing defects and facilitating effective triage with Product and Engineering.
  • Working knowledge of test automation concepts, frameworks, and CI/CD practices.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to surface concerns early and communicate quality risk clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong ownership mindset, organization, follow-through, and comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with multiple concurrent priorities.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience testing complex enterprise applications, healthcare technology, claims, payments, utilization management, provider data, EDI, APIs, or other heavy integration workflows.
  • Experience with automated API, UI, regression, and integration testing.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development or testing tools such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, or comparable tools.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, test-management tools, CI/CD pipelines, observability platforms, and cloud-based application environments.
  • Experience helping a QA organization mature from primarily manual testing toward a balanced automation and risk-based quality model.
Success Measures

Success in this role will be demonstrated through measurable improvement in the reliability, transparency, and efficiency of the QA function, including:
  • QA execution starts on time, with blockers surfaced immediately rather than discovered later.
  • Leaders and delivery teams have clear visibility into test progress and release risk.
  • Critical defects are identified earlier in the lifecycle, and fewer defects escape into UAT or production.
  • UAT rework and repeated defect patterns decline over time.
  • Regression coverage becomes increasingly reliable, repeatable, and automated.
  • QA team members demonstrate stronger ownership, consistency, technical capability, and accountability.
  • Release decisions are supported by objective test evidence and clearly documented risk.
Leadership Expectations

The QA Lead is expected to model transparency, ownership, and proactive communication. Problems do not need to be perfectly solved before they are raised. When quality, timing, environment stability, or test readiness is at risk, the expectation is to surface the issue early, explain the impact, and drive the appropriate next action with the delivery team.

Salary: $115,000/Annually

Benefits Offered

  • Competitive compensation and annual bonus program
  • 401(k) retirement program with company match
  • Company-paid life insurance
  • Company-paid short term disability coverage (location restrictions may apply)
  • Medical, Vision, and Dental benefits
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Sick Time
  • Paid company holidays and floating holidays
  • Quarterly company-sponsored events
  • Health and wellness programs
  • Career development opportunities

Remote Opportunities

We are actively seeking new colleagues in: Arizona, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Kentucky, Massachusetts, Michigan, North Carolina, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, and Washington.

Our Story

Founded in 2005, Integra Partners is a leading national durable medical equipment, prosthetic, and orthotic supplies (DMEPOS) network administrator. Our mission is to improve the quality of life for the communities we serve by reimagining access to in-home healthcare. We connect Payers, Providers, and Members through innovative technology and streamlined workflows affording Members access to top local Providers and culturally competent care. By focusing on transparency, accountability, and adaptability, we help deliver better health outcomes and more efficient management of complex healthcare benefits.

With a location in Michigan plus a remote workforce across the United States, Integra has a culture focused on collaboration, teamwork, and our values: One Team, Drive Results, Push the Boundaries, Value Others, and Build Community. We’re looking for energetic, talented, and dedicated individuals to join our team. See what opportunities we have available; there may be a role for you to engage in a challenging yet rewarding career in healthcare. We look forward to learning more about you.

Integra Partners is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations and will work with you to meet your needs. If you are a person with a disability and require assistance during the application process, please don’t hesitate to reach out. We celebrate our inclusive work environment and welcome members of all backgrounds and perspectives.

job.description:
Quality Assurance Engineer (L3)

NYC HQ or Remote (U.S.) | Full-time | Engineering | Reports to: Quality Assurance Lead

Who we are.

Reality Defender is an award-winning cybersecurity company helping enterprises and governments detect deepfakes and AI-generated media. Utilizing a patented multi-model approach, Reality Defender is robust against the bleeding edge of generative platforms producing video, audio, imagery, and text media. Reality Defender's API-first deepfake detection platform empowers teams and developers alike to identify fraud, disinformation campaigns, and harmful deepfakes in real time.

Backed by world class investors including DCVC, Illuminate Financial, Y Combinator, Booz Allen Hamilton, IBM, Accenture, Rackhouse, and Argon VC, Reality Defender works with leading enterprise clients, financial institutions, and governments in order to ensure AI-generated media is not used for malicious purposes.

Youtube: Reality Defender Wins RSA Most Innovative Startup

The Quality Assurance Engineer Role.

Our customers rely on Reality Defender to make high-stakes calls in real time — whether the voice on a bank's phone line or the face in a job interview is real. As a Quality Assurance Engineer, you'll make sure what we ship holds up to that standard, testing our APIs, SDKs, web app, and real-time integrations, and building the automation that lets us release faster without breaking things. This is a full-time role based at our NYC headquarters or remote within the U.S., reporting to Quality Assurance Lead. Responsibilities include:

  • Own test planning and execution for assigned product areas — APIs, SDKs, the web app, and real-time voice and video integrations — from requirements review through release sign-off.

  • Build and maintain automated test suites (API, end-to-end, and regression) and integrate them into our CI/CD pipelines.

  • Find, document, and track defects with clear reproduction steps, severity, and impact, and work with engineers through to resolution.

  • Test the reliability and performance of real-time detection under realistic conditions — latency, load, varied audio and video quality, and different platforms and devices.

  • Help maintain the test data and media sets used to validate each release.

  • Partner with the AI Research and Red Team to support model release validation and regression testing.

  • Help Customer Support and Solutions Engineering reproduce and triage customer-reported issues.

  • Contribute to QA standards, documentation, and release checklists across the engineering team.

Who you are.

  • 3+ years of experience in software QA or quality engineering, testing web applications and APIs in a fast-moving release environment.

  • Hands-on experience writing automated tests in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar, using frameworks such as Pytest, Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.

  • Experience testing REST APIs (e.g., Postman or code-based API tests) and working within CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions).

  • Strong attention to detail and a systematic approach to finding edge cases — you think about how things break, not just whether they work.

  • Clear written communication: your bug reports and test plans are easy for engineers to act on.

  • Experience testing audio, video, or real-time communication products (WebRTC, telephony, conferencing). (nice to have)

  • Experience testing ML-powered products or working with test datasets. (nice to have)

  • Exposure to performance or load testing tools (e.g., k6, Locust, JMeter). (nice to have)

Within 12 months, you'll…

  • Own QA for multiple product areas with minimal oversight.

  • Have helped establish quality metrics (escaped defects, coverage, release stability) that the team tracks and acts on.

  • Be improving QA tooling and practices beyond your own areas.

  • Be ready to take on broader scope and mentor newer QA team members.

What we offer.

Reality Defender offers the following benefits to all our employees, regardless of location:

  • Healthcare plans with 100% premium coverage for employees and partial coverage available for dependents

  • Dental and Vision plans with 100% premium coverage for employees and their dependents

  • Short/Long-term disability and life insurance plans with 100% premium coverage for employees

  • 12 weeks of Parental Leave

  • Learning and Development budget

  • Monthly wellness benefits

  • Annual company-sponsored offsite

For employees working from Reality Defender's HQ in NYC, we offer the following benefits:

  • Daily in-office lunch through UberEats

  • Commuter benefits

  • Remote Fridays

  • Happy Hours and other local events

Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Journeyman QA Specialist to support program quality-management and software quality-assurance activities for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This role supports execution of the Quality Management Plan, performs quality reviews of program deliverables and workflows, and validates Task Order Management Portal enhancements before release.

The QA Specialist will test portal forms, automations, dashboards, permissions, workflows, and data-quality controls to confirm that capabilities meet Government requirements and function as intended. The successful candidate will document and track defects, manage Corrective Action Requests and Preventive Action Requests, support root-cause analysis, and help capture lessons learned that improve program performance.

This position is remote, with preference given to candidates located in or near Chicago.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The QA Specialist will:

  • Support implementation, execution, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the program Quality Management Plan.
  • Perform quality-assurance and quality-control reviews of program deliverables, reports, workflows, forms, records, and supporting documentation.
  • Verify that deliverables are accurate, complete, consistent, traceable to requirements, and compliant with approved standards and formats.
  • Develop and execute test plans, test cases, test scripts, checklists, and validation procedures for Task Order Management Portal enhancements.
  • Validate portal forms, workflows, automations, dashboards, notifications, permissions, data fields, calculations, and reports.
  • Confirm that portal enhancements satisfy documented Government requirements and acceptance criteria before release.
  • Conduct functional, regression, integration, workflow, permissions, and data-quality testing.
  • Document test results, defects, expected and actual behavior, severity, supporting evidence, and recommended corrective actions.
  • Enter, classify, prioritize, track, retest, and close defects in accordance with approved procedures.
  • Manage Corrective Action Requests and Preventive Action Requests from identification through validated closure.
  • Perform or support root-cause analyses for defects, process failures, recurring findings, and quality-performance concerns.
  • Verify that corrective and preventive actions resolve identified issues and reduce the likelihood of recurrence.
  • Track quality-review findings, responsible owners, due dates, status, remediation evidence, and closure decisions.
  • Support Monthly Status Reports, project status meetings, Program Management Reviews, and other reporting activities with quality metrics and trend information.
  • Analyze defect trends, recurring quality issues, workflow failures, data discrepancies, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Maintain quality records, test evidence, review logs, defect registers, corrective-action records, lessons learned, and audit trails.
  • Support quality reviews of transition documentation, trip reports, purchasing packages, status reports, plans, and other program artifacts.
  • Participate in release-readiness reviews and provide evidence-based recommendations regarding deployment.
  • Coordinate testing and quality reviews with the Quality Manager, developers, portal administrators, task leads, program analysts, and Government stakeholders.
  • Assist with internal assessments, Government reviews, quality-surveillance activities, and audit preparation.
  • Capture lessons learned and recommend updates to processes, controls, templates, test suites, and quality procedures.
  • Protect sensitive Government, program, personnel, test, and performance information.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Department of Defense, federal civilian, or other Government programs.
  • Experience implementing or supporting a formal Quality Management Plan.
  • Experience reviewing contract deliverables for accuracy, completeness, consistency, traceability, and compliance.
  • Experience developing and executing test plans, test cases, test scripts, acceptance criteria, and regression-testing procedures.
  • Experience testing forms, workflows, automations, dashboards, permissions, notifications, reports, and data-quality controls.
  • Experience validating Microsoft SharePoint, Power Platform, ServiceNow, Jira, or comparable portal and workflow capabilities.
  • Experience documenting, classifying, prioritizing, tracking, retesting, and closing software defects.
  • Experience managing Corrective Action Requests, Preventive Action Requests, or comparable remediation workflows.
  • Experience performing root-cause analysis and validating corrective and preventive actions.
  • Experience conducting functional, regression, integration, workflow, permissions, and user-acceptance testing.
  • Familiarity with Agile, Scrum, DevSecOps, ITIL, or hybrid delivery environments.
  • Knowledge of requirements traceability, release management, configuration management, and change-control practices.
  • Familiarity with ISO 9001, CMMI, Lean Six Sigma, or comparable quality frameworks.
  • Experience using Azure DevOps, Jira, ServiceNow, Power BI, SharePoint, automated testing tools, or comparable quality-management platforms.
  • ITIL Foundation, CSQA, ISTQB, ASQ, Lean Six Sigma, or a comparable quality or testing certification.
  • Strong analytical, testing, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.
