job.title: Consumer Compliance Lead - Product Advisory & Testing
job.description:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 143 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the team

At Nu, Compliance is a strategic partner—not a tollgate. We view effective Risk Management & Compliance as the engine that maintains agility and empowers rapid, responsible growth across multiple global markets. Our team partners directly with internal clients using a targeted friction approach: we focus on the most relevant regulatory risks and embed compliance directly into product design rather than distributing rules after the fact.

The Global Compliance function serves as the Second Line of Defense, responsible for the full regulatory lifecycle: tracking new regulations, advising product and technology teams, testing controls, coordinating regulatory inspections, and monitoring remediation of regulatory issues.

This role is positioned at a pivotal moment. Nu has received conditional approval for a US National Bank Charter. Reporting to the Head of US Compliance, this individual contributor will independently assess complex regulatory questions, influence product and operational decisions, and lead compliance reviews from planning through reporting and remediation validation. The role also contributes to policy development, compliance risk reporting, and advice on regulatory issues.

Success requires strong regulatory judgment, practical experience evaluating controls, and the ability to turn complex requirements and findings into clear, actionable recommendations. You should be comfortable establishing processes, managing competing priorities, and driving work to completion in an evolving business.The role requires someone who can build from scratch, own outcomes, and operate with an entrepreneurial mindset in a highly regulated environment.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced consumer compliance professional to lead product compliance advisory engagements and internal compliance testing and monitoring across Nu’s US consumer banking products, including deposits, credit cards, and personal loans.

Reporting to the US Head of Compliance, this manager-level individual contributor will independently assess complex regulatory questions, influence product and operational decisions, and lead compliance reviews from planning through reporting and remediation validation. The role also contributes to policy development, compliance risk reporting, and advice on regulatory issues.

Success requires strong regulatory judgment, practical experience evaluating controls, and the ability to turn complex requirements and findings into clear, actionable recommendations. You should be comfortable establishing processes, managing competing priorities, and driving work to completion in an evolving business.

What you will do

Product Compliance Advisory

  • Serve as a primary compliance advisor to Product, Engineering, Operations, Marketing, and other business teams throughout the product lifecycle, from initial design and launch through servicing.

  • Independently interpret applicable federal and state consumer financial protection requirements and translate them into practical product requirements, controls, and business guidance.

  • Review proposed products, features, customer journeys, disclosures, marketing materials, and operational processes to identify compliance risks and recommend workable solutions.

  • Assess the compliance implications of product and process changes, documenting advice, material risks, and matters requiring escalation.

  • Provide effective challenge to business decisions and control designs, working with stakeholders to resolve concerns and escalating material or unresolved risks.

  • Evaluate relevant regulatory developments and enforcement trends and advise business partners on necessary changes.

Compliance Testing & Monitoring

  • Develop and execute risk-based compliance testing and monitoring coverage, prioritizing products, processes, and controls based on regulatory obligations, customer impact, and emerging risks.

  • Lead reviews from scoping through completion, including defining objectives, developing test procedures, selecting samples, evaluating evidence, and documenting conclusions.

  • Assess whether controls are appropriately designed and operating effectively, including whether customer outcomes and business practices meet applicable requirements.

  • Produce clear, well-supported findings and reports that explain the regulatory concern, supporting evidence, customer impact, and recommended corrective action.

  • Establish and maintain monitoring indicators that help identify compliance weaknesses, recurring exceptions, and changes in risk.

  • Evaluate remediation plans, track corrective actions, and validate that completed remediation addresses identified issues.

Policy, Risk Reporting & Issue Advisory

  • Draft and update consumer compliance policies and standards, and advise business owners on related procedures.

  • Contribute to compliance risk assessments and management reporting, communicating significant findings, trends, and unresolved exposures.

  • Advise on issue assessment, root cause analysis, customer impact, and corrective action, with business owners accountable for implementing remediation.

What we are looking for

Required

  • Substantial experience in US consumer compliance at a bank, financial institution, or fintech, with demonstrated responsibility for both product advisory and compliance testing or monitoring.

  • Strong working knowledge of consumer financial protection requirements relevant to deposits and unsecured lending, including TILA/Regulation Z, ECOA/Regulation B, EFTA/Regulation E, TISA/Regulation DD, FCRA/Regulation V, and UDAAP.

  • Demonstrated ability to research and interpret regulatory requirements, exercise sound judgment in ambiguous situations, and develop defensible recommendations.

  • Hands-on experience designing and executing compliance reviews, evaluating controls, documenting findings, and validating remediation.

  • Ability to analyze operational and customer data to identify exceptions, assess customer impact, and support conclusions.

  • Strong writing and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex requirements and influence decisions across technical, business, and leadership audiences.

  • Proven ability to independently own significant workstreams, establish priorities, and escalate issues appropriately.

Preferred experience

  • Compliance advisory or testing across digital deposit, credit card, or personal loan products.

  • Experience with building compliance capabilities for a new or growing bank or fintech.

  • Experience using data analytics or automation to improve compliance monitoring and testing.

  • CRCM preferred, but not required.

 

Work Setup

Location

Miami, Florida

Work model

Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

Office requirement

2 days per week at the office.

 

Our Benefits

  • Opportunity of earning equity at Nu

  • Medical Insurance

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • 401K

  • Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

  • Work-from-home Allowance

job.title: Senior Software Quality Engineer
job.description:
As a Senior Software Quality Engineerat vCluster Labs, you aren't just writing test cases; you are the architect of how we know our product works. You'll own test strategy end-to-end across a fast-moving codebase, build the automation frameworks that give engineering the confidence to ship daily, and be the voice for testability and reliability in every design conversation you're part of.

As a Senior Software Quality Engineer, your role will include:

  • Test framework ownership: Lead the design, development, and maintenance of automated test frameworks spanning backend services and UI, built to scale with a fast-growing product.

  • Test strategy: Own and drive test strategy across services and features, ensuring coverage is thorough and tied directly to product goals, not just ticket checkboxes.

  • Cross-functional influence: Work closely with engineering and product to shape features early, advocate for testability, and align the team on what "quality" means for this product.

  • Architectural input: Sit in on architecture and design discussions, bringing a testability and reliability lens before code gets written, not after.

  • CI/CD integration: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.) so engineers get fast, high-confidence feedback on every change.

  • Exploratory testing: Run exploratory testing to catch usability issues, edge cases, and regressions that automation won't find on its own.

  • Parallel execution: Move across multiple projects at once in a startup environment where priorities shift, without losing rigor.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • Experience depth: 7+ years in QA or software testing, including 2+ years operating at a senior or staff level.

  • Programming ability: Strong hands-on skills in at least one of Go, Python, or JavaScript, used for building automation and tooling, not just scripting one-off checks.

  • AI-assisted QA workflow: Daily use of AI tools for reviewing PRs and design docs, writing test plans, and automating test cases, paired with the judgment to know when to trust the output and when to verify it yourself.

  • Ownership mindset: You spot what needs to happen and drive it forward without waiting to be told.

  • Startup fluency: Proven ability to stay calm under ambiguity and juggle competing priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Communication: Strong written and verbal skills, with the ability to advocate for quality across engineering and product.

  • CI/CD depth: Deep understanding of CI/CD systems and hands-on experience integrating automated test suites into pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar).

  • Kubernetes fluency: Working knowledge of Kubernetes environments and distributed systems, or a strong aptitude and willingness to learn quickly.

  • Debugging skill: Excellent analytical and debugging ability, particularly for backend and infrastructure-related issues.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience testing in tenant cluster or Tenant Isolation environments.

  • Prior experience owning QA at a startup through a period of rapid product growth.

About vCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.

  • Premium Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).

  • Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

  • Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

  1. Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

  2. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

  3. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.

  4. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.

  5. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

Compensation Range: €65K - €110K

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.

Our People
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts.

About the Role:

    The Director of SDET is a pivotal role blending strong technical depth with strategic and people leadership.

    You will own the quality engineering vision for the organization, mentor the next generation of SDET managers and leads, and champion the adoption of AI-driven tools and practices to modernize how the organization builds, tests, and ships software.

    -> Quality Strategy & Architecture:
  • Own the end-to-end quality engineering vision, strategy, and roadmap across multiple product lines or business units
  • Establish quality gates, release readiness criteria, and CI/CD processes
  • Drive a "shift-left, shift-right" quality culture — embedding testability into design reviews and using production observability to close the loop
  • Conduct architectural reviews across new and existing products to proactively surface scalability, reliability, and performance risks
  • Evaluate and select tooling, frameworks, and platforms (open-source and commercial) that scale automation across teams
    • -> AI Adoption:
  • Lead the org's AI adoption strategy for quality engineering — building or integrating AI/ML-based testing tools to improve coverage, productivity, and defect prediction
  • Continuously evaluate and leverage AI for all aspects of Quality Engineering ensuring quality strategy keeps pace with how product is built
    • -> Stakeholder & People Leadership:
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, DevOps, and Security leadership to align quality goals with business and release objectives
  • Provide regular quality updates, metrics, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership
  • Define, set up, and monitor key quality and productivity metrics (KPIs/OKRs)
  • Lead succession planning and mentor SDET Managers and Leads to build the next layer of quality leadership

Requirements:

  • 15+ years in software testing/quality engineering, including 5+ years in a Director or senior engineering leadership role
  • Deep expertise in test automation frameworks (Selenium, Playwright, RestAssured, etc.) and languages (Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript)
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Harness CI/CD), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP)
  • Hands-on experience building AI/ML-based testing tools that measurably improve coverage and productivity
  • Solid grounding in performance testing, security testing, and other non-functional quality attributes
  • Experience architecting test strategies for microservices, distributed systems, and mobile platforms

Preferred Exposure:

  • Experience presenting AI or quality-transformation initiatives at conferences
  • Prior experience testing high-transaction SaaS platforms (CRM, Payments, Automation, Email, Fintech, or similar)
  • Experience building and testing AI products using Agentic AI, including evaluation frameworks
  • Contributions to open-source testing frameworks or published thought leadership on QE/AI trends

Key Competencies:

  • Quality vision and strategic execution
  • Non-functional testing (performance, security, reliability) and continuous delivery
  • Operational discipline within a fast-paced, rapid release environment
  • Stakeholder management across Engineering, Product, DevOps, and business functions
  • Team building and mentorship
  • Data-driven reporting of quality and productivity metrics to executive stakeholders

Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

QUALITY ASSURANCE

What We Do

The Quality Assurance team owns the testing process, risk management, and quality evaluation of all products and functions across Epic. Our team works closely with developers and production to ensure the best possible user experience for our community and customers.

What You'll Do

Our SDETs are first and foremost software engineers; they act as force multipliers for quality efforts across the business by providing tools, frameworks, coaching, and education. As we continue to grow a world-class technical organization within Quality Assurance, we are looking for a SDET Manager with proven leadership and test engineering vision for our Unreal Engine team.

In this role, you will

  • Lead and grow a team of SDETs building automated test coverage across Unreal Engine, as well as mentor and coach SDETS at every career stage
  • Write and ship production code in the team's test frameworks, tools, and CI integrations, as well as own the team's systems end to end, including design, reliability, and maintenance
  • Set the team's test roadmap, from unit and API coverage through input-driven end-to-end tests of the editor and runtime
  • Extend existing frameworks, including low-level, integration, and end to end tests
  • Turn manual test cases into automated coverage, as well as keep committed tests deterministic and reproducible on any machine
  • Leverage Al-assisted tools to speed up tool/framework development, test authoring, failure triage, and flake analysis
  • Increase visibility into test coverage and Cl health for engineering leadership, and influence the vision for the wider SDET organization at Epic

What we're looking for

  • Experience leading software engineering teams, including mentorship, technical roadmaps, trade-offs, and prioritization
  • A track record of writing and shipping production code while leading a team, as well as current, hands-on proficiency in C++ and at least one of C#, Python, or TypeScript
  • Strong knowledge of how game engines work. Unreal Engine 5 experience is preferred
  • Experience with automation frameworks and continuous integration at scale, and experience setting test strategy across unit, integration, and end-to-end levels
  • Experience using AI coding tools in engineering work, and judgment about when their output can be trusted
  • Ability to learn complex tech stacks quickly and extend existing investments rather than bypass them
  • Clear written communication with engineers, producers, and leadership

This role is open to multiple locations across the US (including WA).

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. What We Do

The Quality Assurance team owns the testing process, risk management, and quality evaluation of all products and functions across Epic. Our team works closely with developers and production to ensure the best possible user experience for our community and customers.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a full-time Senior Tester II for our testing group in Brazil. The person in this role will own the testing approach for a specialized domain within a major Epic product, and will be expected to make that domain measurably faster and more reliable to test over time through better methods, tooling, and use of data. You will work embedded with the development team, developing and executing tests with or without QA Analyst guidance, and proactively identifying problems beyond the day-to-day in order to solve them at the root rather than one case at a time. The Senior Tester II is also a technical reference point for the wider test team, mentoring testers and raising the quality bar through example. If you are interested in a fast-paced environment, capable of navigating interpersonal quandaries, and desire to work on a world-class QA team, then we would love to talk to you.

In this role, you will

  • Own the test approach for your area, developing and executing tests independently, with or without QA Analyst guidance
  • Design and introduce sustainable testing methods, including tooling, automation aids, or data analysis, that measurably increase the throughput or efficiency of testing efforts
  • Proactively identify systemic problems that go beyond day-to-day concerns and develop semi-permanent solutions instead of one-off fixes
  • Perform test gap and risk analysis for your domain, using defect data and coverage insights to redirect testing effort to where it matters most
  • Provide the development team with reports on blocking issues, test results, and overall quality status, framing risk in terms the team can act on
  • Escalate quality concerns that cannot be resolved within existing constraints, bringing a recommended path forward
  • Self-prioritize your work on a week-to-week basis and help shape the team's priorities aligned with product goals
  • Mentor testers on your team and act as a domain reference for adjacent teams, sharing context, methods, and standards

What we're looking for

  • A minimum of 4 years of experience in QA/Testing at games or software, including experience working embedded within a development team throughout the software development life cycle
  • Demonstrated depth in the product areas you have tested, with the judgment to know where risk concentrates and how to go after it
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese
  • A track record of improving how testing gets done, through tooling, process change, or data, with evidence of the resulting impact
  • Ability to analyze defect trends and coverage gaps, and to act on that analysis to prevent future issues
  • Experience with gaming consoles and/or mobile devices
  • Experience with game engines such as Unreal and Unity
  • Proficient with test management tools (e.g., TestRail, Xray, QMetry) and issue tracking systems like Jira
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to drive alignment on quality with developers, designers, and production
  • Experience mentoring less experienced testers

job.title: Manager, Quality Assurance
job.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details


The Manager, Quality Assurance (Consulting) is a hands-on people leadership role responsible for managing and developing a team of Sr. QA Specialists while directly supporting complex client and quality deliverables.

The role oversees Drug Establishment Licence (DEL) maintenance, foreign site approval activities, release of commercial drug products and clinical trial supplies to the Canadian market, and preparation and review of quality and compliance documentation. The Manager is accountable for timely, accurate and risk-based delivery across multiple client projects, builds productive internal and external relationships, and supports invoice reconciliation. Success requires strong ownership, initiative, sound judgment, pragmatic problem-solving and confident client-facing communication.


Primary Duties and Responsibilities:


  • Lead and assign the day-to-day work of Sr. QA Specialists, balancing client commitments, compliance risk, business needs and established timelines.
  • Provide clear direction, coaching, mentoring, training and cross-training to strengthen team capability, accountability, consistency and readiness for changing priorities.
  • Remain hands-on in day-to-day quality activities and take ownership of complex or high-impact assignments, identifying issues early, making timely decisions within authority and escalating appropriately.
  • Maintain importer Drug Establishment Licences and manage the approval process for foreign sites supporting multiple clients.
  • Ensure compliance activities associated with the importation of drugs, medical devices and natural health products are performed in accordance with applicable Health Canada regulations and guidance.
  • Perform or oversee the release of commercial drug products and/or clinical trial supplies to the Canadian market for Innomar or clients, as required.
  • Maintain and review internal and client quality documentation, including SOPs, annual product quality reviews, stability reports, qualification and validation protocols and reports, artwork and temperature studies.
  • Ensure deviations, corrective and preventive actions, product quality complaints, change controls and associated trend analyses are completed in a compliant, thorough and timely manner.
  • Provide expert consultation to clients on quality matters by assessing risks, evaluating potential impacts, and recommending practical, compliant, and sustainable solutions to support informed decision-making and business success.
  • Actively contribute to the development, maintenance and continual improvement of GMP quality systems, including addressing deficiencies or inconsistencies when identified.
  • Advise other departments on Quality Assurance requirements, risks and strategies.
  • Support or lead internal, client, third-party and regulatory audits or inspections, including serving as lead auditor or audit host when required.
  • Support recall and mock recall activities, as required.
  • Build and maintain positive, productive relationships with internal stakeholders, current and prospective clients, foreign sites and other external partners.
  • Participate actively in client meetings and presentations, communicate Quality positions clearly and respond confidently to questions while remaining collaborative and solutions-focused.
  • Demonstrate initiative by volunteering for new responsibilities and adapting quickly to changing priorities, emerging issues and unfamiliar situations.
  • Manage multiple projects efficiently and accurately, with strong follow-through and dependable completion within established timeframes.
  • Provide subject matter expertise through the delivery of training, presentations, and seminars to internal teams, clients, and external organizations, fostering awareness, capability development, and compliance excellence.
  • Complete or support invoice reconciliation and quotation activities, as assigned.
  • Understand and comply with company confidentiality and privacy requirements.
  • Perform other duties and tasks assigned by Senior QA Management.

Experience and Education:


  • Bachelor's degree in a pharmaceutical, scientific or healthcare-related field, such as chemistry, biology, microbiology, pharmacy or pharmacology.
  • Minimum 10 years of Quality Assurance experience in a regulated pharmaceutical or healthcare environment.
  • Minimum 3 years of people management or supervisory experience.
  • Demonstrated experience with Health Canada requirements, GMP compliance, drug importation and Drug Establishment Licences.
  • Experience conducting vendor audits and hosting or co-hosting client, third-party or regulatory audits is considered an asset.
  • Experience working as a consultant is considered an asset.
  • Experience with natural health products is considered an asset.

Core Skills, Knowledge and Leadership Competencies:


  • Regulatory and technical expertise: Comprehensive knowledge of the Food and Drugs Act, Health Canada GMP regulations and associated guidance. Strong working knowledge of DEL requirements, importation controls, GMP documentation, risk assessment and quality systems. Knowledge of natural health product requirements is an asset.
  • Leadership and people development: Proven ability to manage, motivate and develop employees; set clear expectations; provide practical training; delegate effectively; and foster accountability, collaboration and respectful professional relationships.
  • Ownership and dependability: Responsible, diligent and reliable, with consistent follow-through. Takes ownership of commitments and outcomes and completes work accurately and on time.
  • Judgment and decision-making: Comfortable making timely, risk-based decisions using available information. Thinks effectively in real time, identifies practical options and recognizes when escalation is appropriate.
  • Initiative and continuous improvement: Proactively identifies needs, volunteers for new or challenging work, speaks up when concerns arise and takes action to correct issues or improve processes.
  • Complex project execution: Able to lead complicated, multi-client projects, organize competing priorities, maintain attention to detail and work efficiently without compromising quality or compliance.
  • Risk-based problem-solving: Skilled in deviations, root cause analysis, CAPA and risk assessment. Identifies pragmatic, compliant solutions to operational and quality challenges.
  • Client engagement and communication: Demonstrates strong written, verbal, presentation, and public-speaking skills. Communicates clearly and confidently with clients, responds in a timely and appropriate manner, and builds credibility through professionalism, responsiveness, sound technical advice, and practical solutions to quality and compliance.
  • Technical and Digital Proficiency: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word and Excel, with the ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies and enterprise systems. Familiarity with AI tools and their business applications is considered an asset.
  • Collaboration and adaptability: Works effectively independently and in cross-functional, multidisciplinary teams. Adapts quickly, remains composed as priorities change and promotes positive, respectful and professional working relationships.

Working Conditions:

  • May involve travel up to 20%.
  • Work shift is not required unless business needs change.

What Cencora offers

We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day. In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. This encompasses support for working families, which may include backup dependent care, adoption assistance, infertility coverage, family building support, behavioral health solutions, paid parental leave, and paid caregiver leave. To encourage your personal growth, we also offer a variety of training programs, professional development resources, and opportunities to participate in mentorship programs, employee resource groups, volunteer activities, and much more.

Full time

Cencora is committed to providing equal employment opportunity without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or membership in any other class protected by federal, state or local law.

The company’s continued success depends on the full and effective utilization of qualified individuals. Therefore, harassment is prohibited and all matters related to recruiting, training, compensation, benefits, promotions and transfers comply with equal opportunity principles and are non-discriminatory.

Cencora is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities during the employment process which are consistent with legal requirements. If you wish to request an accommodation while seeking employment, please call 888.692.2272 or email . We will make accommodation determinations on a request-by-request basis. Messages and emails regarding anything other than accommodations requests will not be returned

Accessibility Policy

Cencora is committed to fair and accessible employment practices. When requested, Cencora will accommodate people with disabilities during the recruitment, assessment and hiring processes and during employment.
